desc_en: This gorge was carved through the hills by the Mabechi River, which flows through Ninohe City. Two great rocks called Ogami-iwa (Male God Rock) and Megami-iwa (Female God Rock) tower on opposite sides of the river, forming Ninohe's signature landscape. From the observatory you can take in the gorge and the town, and in the seasons of fresh green and autumn leaves the contrast between rock and trees is superb.
quiz_en: Of the two great rocks towering over Basenkyo Gorge, what is the name of the one that faces and pairs with Megami-iwa?

name: 金田一温泉郷
desc: 二戸市の馬淵川沿いに広がる、のどかな温泉郷です。古くから湯治場として親しまれ、素朴な田園の中に宿が点在しています。この温泉郷は、子どもの姿をした精霊「座敷わらし」が現れるという宿があることで全国的に知られ、出会いを願って泊まりに来る人もいます。
quiz: 金田一温泉の宿に現れると言われ、出会えると幸運が訪れるという子どもの姿の精霊は？
desc_en: This peaceful hot spring village spreads along the Mabechi River in Ninohe City. Long loved as a therapeutic spa, it has inns scattered through simple farmland. The village is known nationwide for an inn where a zashiki-warashi, a spirit in the form of a child, is said to appear, and some people come to stay hoping to meet it.
quiz_en: What is the child-like spirit said to appear at an inn in Kindaichi Onsen, bringing good fortune to those who meet it?

name: 浄法寺まつり天台寺例大祭
addr: 二戸市浄法寺町御山久保33-1（天台寺境内）
desc: 二戸市浄法寺町の天台寺で行われる例大祭です。天台寺は「桂清水」の名で親しまれる東北屈指の古刹で、杉木立に囲まれた長い石段の参道を上ると、山中に静かに本堂がたたずみます。作家・瀬戸内寂聴が住職を務めたことでも知られ、例大祭には多くの参拝者が訪れて境内がにぎわいます。
quiz: 天台寺の住職を務め、その法話に全国から多くの人が集まった作家・尼僧は誰？
desc_en: This annual grand festival is held at Tendai-ji Temple in Joboji, Ninohe City. Affectionately known as "Katsura Shimizu," Tendai-ji is one of Tohoku's foremost historic temples; climb the long stone steps surrounded by cedar groves and the main hall stands quietly in the mountains. It is also known for having had the writer Jakucho Setouchi as its head priest, and many worshippers fill the grounds for the festival.
quiz_en: Who was the writer and Buddhist nun who served as head priest of Tendai-ji, drawing crowds from across Japan to her sermons?

name: 折爪岳
desc: 二戸市と軽米町・九戸村にまたがる山で、山頂付近からは周囲の山々を広く見渡せます。この山の森は、小さな光を放つヒメボタルの国内有数の生息地として知られ、夏の夜には森の中が無数の光の点滅で幻想的に彩られます。昼の展望と夜の光、二つの顔を持つ山です。
quiz: 夏の夜、折爪岳の森の中を小さな金色の光で彩る生き物の名前は何でしょう？
desc_en: This mountain straddles Ninohe City, Karumai Town and Kunohe Village, and from near its summit you can look far out over the surrounding mountains. Its forest is known as one of Japan's leading habitats of the himebotaru, a tiny firefly, and on summer nights countless blinking lights fill the woods with a magical glow. It is a mountain with two faces: daytime views and nighttime lights.
quiz_en: On summer nights, what creature decorates the forests of Mount Orizume with countless tiny golden lights?

name: 岩手山
desc: 盛岡の北西にそびえる岩手県の最高峰です。盛岡側から見ると片側がなだらかな姿をしていることから「南部片富士」と呼ばれ、市民の心のふるさととして親しまれています。石川啄木や宮沢賢治もこの山を愛しました。春先に山肌に現れる残雪の形も、季節の便りになっています。
quiz: 盛岡から見ると片側がなだらかな岩手山。その姿からつけられた愛称は何でしょう？
desc_en: Rising northwest of Morioka, this is the highest peak in Iwate Prefecture. Seen from Morioka, one side has a gentle slope, which earned it the name "Nanbu Kata-Fuji" (the one-sided Fuji of Nanbu), and residents cherish it as the home of their hearts. Takuboku Ishikawa and Kenji Miyazawa also loved this mountain. The shapes of lingering snow that appear on its slopes in early spring are a seasonal sign as well.
quiz_en: Seen from Morioka, one side of Mount Iwate slopes gently. What nickname was the mountain given because of that shape?

name: 八幡平
desc: 岩手・秋田の県境に広がる、なだらかな山頂部の高原です。アオモリトドマツの森の間に湿原や沼が点在し、夏は高山植物、秋は紅葉、冬は樹氷と季節ごとに表情を変えます。山岳道路のアスピーテラインを走れば、雄大な景色と、あちこちに湧く山の温泉が旅人を迎えます。
quiz: 雪解けの時期、八幡平の鏡沼に現れる、巨大な目のように見える現象は何と呼ばれる？
desc_en: This plateau with a gently rounded summit area spreads across the Iwate-Akita border. Marshes and ponds dot the Maries' fir forests, and the scenery changes with the seasons: alpine plants in summer, autumn leaves in fall and rime-covered trees in winter. Drive the Aspite Line mountain road and you will be greeted by magnificent views and mountain hot springs bubbling up here and there.
quiz_en: During the snowmelt season, what is the phenomenon called that appears on Kagami-numa pond at Hachimantai and looks like a giant eye?

name: 松川温泉郷
addr: 八幡平市松尾寄木1-41（周辺）
desc: 八幡平の山中、松川渓谷沿いに湧く温泉郷です。乳白色の硫黄泉が自慢の一軒宿が点在し、深い森の中の秘湯らしい趣が残っています。近くには地熱を利用した発電所があり、山の大地のエネルギーを身近に感じられる土地。秋は渓谷が紅葉に包まれます。
quiz: 松川温泉の近くにある、日本で初めて本格的な営業運転を始めた発電所の種類は何？
desc_en: This hot spring village rises along the Matsukawa Gorge in the mountains of Hachimantai. Single inns proud of their milky-white sulfur springs are scattered here, retaining the charm of secret hot springs deep in the forest. Nearby is a power plant that uses geothermal heat, making this a place where you can feel the energy of the earth close at hand. In autumn the gorge is wrapped in fall colors.
quiz_en: What type of power plant, the first in Japan to begin full-scale commercial operation, is located near Matsukawa Onsen?

name: 八幡平温泉郷
addr: 八幡平市松尾寄木1-590（周辺）
desc: 八幡平の東側のふもと、高原のリゾート地に点在する温泉郷です。周辺にはスキー場やホテルが集まり、冬はスキーのあとに、夏は高原の涼しい風を感じながら温泉を楽しめます。岩手山を間近に望む開放的な景色が魅力で、八幡平の山々を巡る旅の拠点にもぴったりです。
quiz: 八幡平温泉郷に泊まったら、翌日に訪れたい八幡平周辺の名所はどこ？
desc_en: This hot spring village is scattered across a highland resort area at the eastern foot of Hachimantai. Ski areas and hotels gather nearby, so you can enjoy hot springs after skiing in winter or in the cool highland breeze in summer. Its open scenery with Mount Iwate close at hand is a highlight, and it makes an ideal base for a trip around the Hachimantai mountains.
quiz_en: If you stayed overnight at Hachimantai Onsen Village, which famous spot around Hachimantai would you like to visit the next day?

name: 新安比温泉
desc: 八幡平市の安代地区、安比川の流れる山あいにある温泉です。周辺は安比高原などスキーで知られる高原地帯で、冬は雪景色の中の湯が楽しみ。山里の静かな環境に包まれ、日帰りでも宿泊でも、ゆっくりと体を温められます。スキーや高原散策の帰りに立ち寄るのもおすすめです。
quiz: 安比高原の近くの新安比温泉、ひと滑りしたあとの湯で一番うれしかったことは？
desc_en: This hot spring lies in the hills of the Ashiro area of Hachimantai City, where the Appi River flows. The surroundings are a highland area known for skiing, including the Appi Kogen highlands, and bathing amid the snowy scenery is a winter treat. Wrapped in the quiet of a mountain village, you can warm up at leisure on a day trip or an overnight stay. It is also a good stop on the way back from skiing or a highland walk.
quiz_en: At Shin-Appi Onsen near the Appi Kogen highlands, what was the best part of soaking in the bath after a few ski runs?

name: 胆沢城跡
desc: 平安時代のはじめ、坂上田村麻呂によって築かれた古代の城柵の跡です。のちに陸奥国の鎮守府が置かれ、東北地方を治める重要な拠点となりました。現在は広々とした史跡となり、発掘調査の成果をもとに当時の姿を伝えています。水沢の田園の中で、古代東北の歴史に思いを馳せられます。
quiz: 胆沢城を築いた、平安時代初めの征夷大将軍として知られる人物は誰でしょう？
desc_en: These are the remains of an ancient fortified government outpost built by Sakanoue no Tamuramaro at the beginning of the Heian period. Later, the Chinjufu, the military headquarters of Mutsu Province, was placed here, making it an important base for governing the Tohoku region. Today it is a spacious historic site that conveys how it once looked based on excavation findings. Amid the farmland of Mizusawa, you can reflect on the history of ancient Tohoku.
quiz_en: Who built Isawa Castle and is known as the shogun charged with subduing the north at the beginning of the Heian period?

name: 正法寺
addr: 奥州市水沢区黒石町字正法寺129
desc: 奥州市水沢区の山里にある曹洞宗の古刹で、東北地方における曹洞宗の拠点として栄えました。巨大な茅葺き屋根の本堂は国の重要文化財で、その堂々とした姿は圧巻。杉木立に囲まれた境内は静寂に包まれ、雪をかぶった冬の茅葺き屋根もまた見事な眺めです。
quiz: 正法寺の本堂を覆っている、日本でも最大級といわれる巨大な屋根は何でふかれている？
desc_en: This historic Soto Zen temple in a mountain village of Mizusawa Ward, Oshu City, flourished as the center of the Soto school in the Tohoku region. Its main hall with an enormous thatched roof is a national Important Cultural Property, and its imposing form is breathtaking. The grounds, surrounded by cedar groves, are wrapped in stillness, and the thatched roof covered in snow in winter is also a magnificent sight.
quiz_en: The main hall of Shobo-ji has one of the largest roofs of its kind in Japan. What material is that huge roof made of?

name: 鞍掛山
desc: 岩手山の南東に寄り添うようにそびえる、滝沢市の山です。登山道が整い、短い時間で山頂に立てるため、家族連れや初心者にも親しまれています。山頂からは目の前に迫る岩手山の雄大な姿と、盛岡方面の平野を一望できます。ふもとにはキャンプ場もあり、自然を満喫できます。
quiz: 鞍掛山の山頂で目の前に迫る岩手山を見て、あなたが思わず口にした言葉は？
desc_en: This mountain in Takizawa City rises as if nestled against the southeastern side of Mount Iwate. With well-maintained trails that let you reach the summit in a short time, it is popular with families and beginners. From the top you can take in the grand form of Mount Iwate looming right in front of you and the plains toward Morioka. There is also a campground at its foot for enjoying nature to the full.
quiz_en: Seeing Mount Iwate looming right in front of you from the summit of Mount Kurakake, what words slipped out of your mouth?

name: 寿公園
desc: 雫石町の鶯宿温泉の近くにある公園です。山あいの温泉地らしい緑豊かな場所で、湯めぐりの合間の散歩にぴったり。鶯宿温泉は盛岡の奥座敷として親しまれる静かな温泉街で、川沿いに宿が並びます。季節の花や木々の緑を楽しみながら、温泉地の穏やかな時間を過ごせます。
quiz: 鶯宿温泉の近くの寿公園、湯めぐりの合間に散歩してみたくなる季節はいつ？
desc_en: This park is near Oshuku Onsen in Shizukuishi Town. A green spot typical of a mountain hot spring area, it is perfect for a walk between baths. Oshuku Onsen is a quiet hot spring town loved as a retreat for Morioka, with inns lining the river. You can spend peaceful time in the spa town while enjoying seasonal flowers and the greenery of the trees.
quiz_en: At Kotobuki Park near Oshuku Onsen, in which season would you most like to take a walk between hot spring baths?

name: 御所湖広域公園 乗り物広場
addr: 雫石町西安庭11-7-4（御所湖周辺）
desc: 御所湖のほとりに広がる広域公園の中にある、子ども向けの乗り物が楽しめる広場です。湖畔の開放的な景色の中、家族で体を動かして遊べる場所として親しまれています。周辺には芝生広場や散策路もあり、晴れた日には湖の向こうに岩手山を望みながら一日を過ごせます。
quiz: 御所湖広域公園の乗り物広場で、子どものころに戻ってあなたが乗ってみたいのは？
name_en: Lake Gosho Regional Park Rides Plaza
desc_en: This plaza within the regional park on the shore of Lake Gosho offers rides for children. Amid the open lakeside scenery, it is a popular place for families to play and get moving. Lawns and walking paths surround it, and on clear days you can spend the whole day with views of Mount Iwate beyond the lake.
quiz_en: At the rides plaza in Lake Gosho Regional Park, if you could be a child again, which ride would you want to try?

name: くずまき高原牧場まつり
addr: 葛巻町葛巻40-57-125（くずまき高原牧場）
desc: 葛巻町のくずまき高原牧場を舞台にした、牧場の恵みを楽しむまつりです。葛巻町は酪農が盛んな高原の町で、「ミルクとワインとクリーンエネルギーの町」として知られています。広い牧草地で牛がのんびり草を食む風景の中、乳製品などの味覚を味わえるのが魅力です。
quiz: 葛巻町の高原にずらりと並び、町のクリーンエネルギーを生み出している設備は何？
desc_en: This festival celebrates the bounty of the farm at Kuzumaki Kogen Farm in Kuzumaki Town. Kuzumaki is a highland town where dairy farming thrives, known as "the town of milk, wine and clean energy." Its appeal is tasting dairy products and other flavors amid scenery of cows leisurely grazing on wide pastures.
quiz_en: What facilities line the highlands of Kuzumaki Town in a row, producing the town's clean energy?

name: 黒石温泉
desc: 岩手町の一方井地区にある温泉です。岩手町は盛岡の北に位置する高原の町で、東北を代表する大河・北上川の源流がある地としても知られています。田畑と森に囲まれたのどかな環境の中で、地元の人々に混じってゆっくりと湯を楽しみ、北上川のはじまりを訪ねてみてください。
quiz: 岩手町にある「弓弭の泉」は、東北地方を流れるどの大河の源流として知られる？
desc_en: This hot spring is in the Ikatai area of Iwate Town. Iwate Town is a highland town north of Morioka, also known as the home of the source of the Kitakami River, the great river of the Tohoku region. In peaceful surroundings of fields and forests, take your time to enjoy the bath alongside local people, and then go and visit the beginning of the Kitakami River.
quiz_en: The Yuhazu Spring in Iwate Town is known as the source of which great river flowing through the Tohoku region?

name: 矢巾温泉郷
desc: 盛岡の南隣、矢巾町の山すそに湧く温泉郷です。盛岡市街から近く、奥羽山脈の山並みを背にした静かな環境で、気軽に温泉気分を味わえます。周囲には田園風景が広がり、季節ごとに表情を変える景色も魅力。盛岡観光の拠点として、また日帰りの湯として親しまれています。
quiz: 盛岡近郊の矢巾温泉郷で湯につかったあと、盛岡で食べたいご当地の麺料理は何？
desc_en: This hot spring village rises at the foot of the mountains in Yahaba Town, just south of Morioka. Close to central Morioka, it lets you casually enjoy a hot spring getaway in quiet surroundings backed by the Ou Mountains. Farmland spreads all around, and the scenery that changes with each season is another attraction. It is loved both as a base for sightseeing in Morioka and as a day-trip bath.
quiz_en: After soaking at Yahaba Onsen Village near Morioka, which local Morioka noodle dish would you like to eat?

name: 湯本温泉
desc: 秋田県境に近い西和賀町の湯田温泉峡にある温泉の一つです。西和賀は全国屈指の豪雪地帯で、冬は深い雪に包まれた温泉街で雪見の湯が楽しめます。町内を走る北上線には駅舎に温泉がある駅もあり、温泉の里らしい雰囲気。紅葉の錦秋湖とあわせて訪れたい場所です。
quiz: 北上線の駅舎の中に温泉施設がある、西和賀町のユニークな駅の名前は何？
desc_en: This is one of the hot springs of the Yuda Onsen gorge in Nishiwaga Town, near the Akita border. Nishiwaga is among Japan's snowiest areas, and in winter you can enjoy snow-viewing baths in a spa town wrapped in deep snow. On the Kitakami Line running through the town, there is even a station with a hot spring in its building, fitting for a hot spring village. It is a place to visit along with Lake Kinshu and its autumn leaves.
quiz_en: What is the name of the unique station in Nishiwaga Town on the Kitakami Line that has a hot spring facility inside the station building?

name: 湯川温泉
desc: 西和賀町の山深くにある温泉で、湯田温泉峡の奥座敷ともいえる静かな湯の里です。渓流沿いに宿が並び、周囲は奥羽山脈の深い森に囲まれています。西和賀は山菜の宝庫として知られ、春から初夏には山の恵みを味わえるのも楽しみ。雪深い冬は秘湯の趣が一段と増します。
quiz: 山菜の宝庫・西和賀町の名産で、春に摘まれる粘りの強い山菜の代表は何？
desc_en: This hot spring lies deep in the mountains of Nishiwaga Town, a quiet spa village that could be called the secluded inner retreat of the Yuda Onsen gorge. Inns line the mountain stream, surrounded by the deep forests of the Ou Mountains. Nishiwaga is known as a treasure trove of wild mountain vegetables, and tasting the mountain's bounty from spring to early summer is a pleasure. In snowy winter, its charm as a secret hot spring grows even stronger.
quiz_en: Which sticky wild mountain vegetable, picked in spring, is the most representative specialty of Nishiwaga, a treasure trove of wild greens?

name: 巣郷温泉
desc: 西和賀町の南部、秋田県との県境近くにある温泉です。岩手と秋田を結ぶ国道沿いにあり、県境越えの旅の途中で立ち寄れます。周囲は奥羽山脈の山々に囲まれた豪雪地帯で、冬は一面の銀世界。雪に閉ざされた静けさの中で湯につかれば、体の芯まで温まります。
quiz: 県境近くの巣郷温泉、雪の季節に湯につかりながら窓の外に見たい景色は何？
desc_en: This hot spring lies in southern Nishiwaga Town, near the border with Akita Prefecture. Located along the national highway linking Iwate and Akita, it makes an easy stop on a trip across the prefectural border. The surroundings are a heavy-snow area enclosed by the Ou Mountains, turning into a silver world in winter. Soak in the stillness of the snowbound landscape and you will be warmed to the core.
quiz_en: At Sugo Onsen near the prefectural border, what scenery would you like to see out the window while soaking in the snowy season?

name: 志賀来温泉
desc: 西和賀町沢内地区にある温泉です。沢内は奥羽山脈に囲まれた雪深い盆地で、かつて住民の命を守るための先進的な医療・福祉の取り組みで知られた土地でもあります。田園と山に囲まれた穏やかな環境の中、地元の人々にも親しまれる湯でゆっくりと疲れを癒やせます。
quiz: 雪深い沢内の盆地にある志賀来温泉、あなたが入るなら冬の雪見風呂？それとも新緑の頃？
desc_en: This hot spring is in the Sawauchi area of Nishiwaga Town. Sawauchi is a snowy basin surrounded by the Ou Mountains, and it was once known for pioneering medical and welfare efforts to protect residents' lives. In calm surroundings of farmland and mountains, you can unwind slowly in a bath that is also loved by local people.
quiz_en: At Shigarai Onsen in the snowy Sawauchi basin, which would you choose: a snow-viewing bath in winter, or the season of fresh green?

name: 沢内高原温泉
desc: 西和賀町沢内の山あいに湧く温泉で、奥羽山脈の自然に囲まれた静かな湯です。周辺はブナの森が広がる山深い地域で、秋田県境の和賀山塊へ向かう登山の拠点にもなります。夏は涼しく、冬は深い雪に包まれ、四季を通じて山の湯らしい落ち着いた時間を過ごせます。
quiz: 沢内地域の西にそびえる、和賀山塊の最高峰として知られる山の名前は何？
desc_en: This quiet hot spring rises in the hills of Sawauchi, Nishiwaga Town, surrounded by the nature of the Ou Mountains. The area is a remote mountain region of spreading beech forests and also serves as a base for climbing into the Waga Mountains on the Akita border. It is cool in summer and wrapped in deep snow in winter, so you can spend calm, mountain-spa time throughout the four seasons.
quiz_en: What is the name of the mountain, known as the highest peak of the Waga Mountains, that rises to the west of the Sawauchi area?

name: 真昼温泉
desc: 西和賀町沢内の西部、秋田県境にそびえる山のふもとにある温泉です。周囲は田園と森に囲まれ、山の稜線を眺めながらゆったりと湯につかれます。雪国の西和賀らしく冬は雪景色の中の湯が楽しめ、春から秋は登山やハイキングの帰りに立ち寄る人も多い湯です。
quiz: 真昼温泉の名前にもなっている、西和賀町と秋田県の境にそびえる山の名前は？
desc_en: This hot spring lies in western Sawauchi, Nishiwaga Town, at the foot of a mountain rising on the Akita border. Surrounded by farmland and forest, you can soak at leisure while gazing at the mountain ridgeline. As befits snowy Nishiwaga, you can enjoy baths amid snowy scenery in winter, and from spring to autumn many people stop by on the way back from climbing or hiking.
quiz_en: What is the name of the mountain on the border of Nishiwaga Town and Akita Prefecture that also gives Mahiru Onsen its name?

name: 中尊寺菊まつり
desc: 世界遺産・平泉の中尊寺で、秋に開かれる菊のまつりです。丹精込めて育てられた菊の花が境内に並び、紅葉に染まる杉木立の参道とともに秋の平泉を彩ります。中尊寺は奥州藤原氏ゆかりの寺で、金色に輝く金色堂は平安時代の浄土への祈りを今に伝えています。
quiz: 中尊寺にある、内外を金箔で覆われた平安時代のお堂は何と呼ばれている？
desc_en: This chrysanthemum festival is held in autumn at Chuson-ji Temple in Hiraizumi, a World Heritage site. Carefully grown chrysanthemums line the grounds, adorning autumn in Hiraizumi along with the approach through cedar groves colored by autumn leaves. Chuson-ji is a temple associated with the Oshu Fujiwara clan, and its gleaming Konjikido (Golden Hall) conveys the Heian-period prayer for the Pure Land to the present day.
quiz_en: What is the Heian-period hall at Chuson-ji, covered inside and out with gold leaf, called?

name: 毛越寺あやめまつり
desc: 世界遺産・平泉の毛越寺で、初夏にあやめ園の花の見ごろを迎えて開かれるまつりです。毛越寺には大泉が池を中心とする平安時代の浄土庭園が残り、紫や白の花が池のほとりを彩る姿は優雅そのもの。平安の人々が思い描いた極楽浄土の世界を感じられます。
quiz: 毛越寺の庭園で、遣水に浮かべた盃が流れ着く前に和歌を詠む雅な行事を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: This festival is held in early summer at Motsu-ji Temple in Hiraizumi, a World Heritage site, when the flowers of its iris garden reach their peak. Motsu-ji preserves a Heian-period Pure Land garden centered on the Oizumi-ga-ike pond, and the sight of purple and white flowers adorning the pond's edge is elegance itself. Here you can sense the world of paradise that people of the Heian era envisioned.
quiz_en: At Motsu-ji's garden, what is the elegant event called in which people compose waka poems before a sake cup floating down a stream reaches them?

name: 滝観洞
desc: 住田町の山中にある鍾乳洞で、洞窟の奥に滝が流れ落ちる珍しい場所です。ひんやりとした洞内の通路を進むと、轟音とともに岩の割れ目から勢いよく落ちる滝が現れ、その迫力に驚かされます。地底を流れる水の力を体感できる、まさに洞窟探検のような体験ができます。
quiz: 滝観洞の洞窟の奥で、轟音を響かせて流れ落ちる滝の名前は何でしょう？
desc_en: This limestone cave in the mountains of Sumita Town is a rare place where a waterfall pours down deep inside. As you follow the cool passages through the cave, a waterfall appears with a roar, plunging forcefully from a crack in the rock, and its power will astonish you. It is a true cave-exploration experience where you can feel the force of water flowing underground.
quiz_en: What is the name of the waterfall that roars as it plunges down deep inside Rokando Cave?

name: 浪板不動滝
desc: 大槌町浪板地区、三陸の海の近くにある滝です。周囲の木々に囲まれた静かな場所で、山から海へ向かう清らかな水の流れを感じられます。近くの浪板海岸は、寄せた波が返らないように見える独特の波で知られ、サーフィンも楽しまれている海。山と海が近い三陸らしい場所です。
quiz: 大槌町の浪板海岸で知られる、「寄せては返さない」と言われる独特の波を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: This waterfall is in the Namiita area of Otsuchi Town, near the Sanriku sea. It is a quiet spot surrounded by trees, where you can feel the clear flow of water heading from the mountains to the sea. The nearby Namiita Coast is known for distinctive waves that seem to come in without going back out, and surfing is enjoyed there. It is a place typical of Sanriku, where mountains and sea are close together.
quiz_en: What are the distinctive waves of Namiita Coast in Otsuchi Town called, said to "come in but never go back out"?

name: 蓬莱島
desc: 大槌湾に浮かぶ小さな島で、赤い灯台と小さな祠がたたずむ姿が印象的です。人形劇『ひょっこりひょうたん島』のモデルの一つとして知られ、地元の人々に愛されています。東日本大震災の津波で被災しましたが、灯台は再建され、復興を見守る大槌のシンボルとなっています。
quiz: 蓬莱島がモデルの一つとして知られる、NHKで放送された人形劇の番組名は何？
desc_en: This small island floating in Otsuchi Bay is striking, with a red lighthouse and a small shrine standing on it. Known as one of the models for the puppet show "Hyokkori Hyotanjima," it is beloved by local people. It was damaged by the tsunami of the Great East Japan Earthquake, but the lighthouse was rebuilt and has become a symbol of Otsuchi watching over the town's recovery.
quiz_en: What is the name of the NHK puppet show for which Horai Island is known as one of the models?

name: 新山高原
desc: 大槌町と遠野市の境に広がる高原で、北上山地の山並みを見渡す開放感あふれる場所です。尾根には大きな風車が並び、牧草地を渡る風の強さを感じられます。晴れた日には遠く太平洋を望むことも。ドライブで訪れたい雄大な景色です。
quiz: 新山高原の尾根に並ぶ大きな風車、あなたが近くで見上げたときの感想は？
desc_en: This highland spreads across the border of Otsuchi Town and Tono City, an open place looking out over the ridges of the Kitakami Mountains. Large wind turbines line the ridge, letting you feel the strength of the wind sweeping across the pastures. On clear days you may even see the Pacific Ocean in the distance. It is a magnificent landscape well worth a drive.
quiz_en: When you looked up close at the large wind turbines lining the ridge of the Shinyama Highlands, what were your impressions?

name: 山田八幡宮祭典
desc: 三陸の港町・山田町で、秋に行われる山田八幡宮の祭典です。町内を神輿や郷土芸能の行列が練り歩き、威勢のいい掛け声と太鼓の音が港町に響きます。山田湾はカキやホタテの養殖が盛んな穏やかな湾で、まつりの季節は秋の海の幸もおいしくなる時期です。
quiz: 山田湾をはじめ三陸の海で養殖が盛んな、冬に旬を迎える殻付きの貝の代表は何？
desc_en: This festival of Yamada Hachimangu Shrine is held in autumn in Yamada, a port town on the Sanriku coast. Processions of mikoshi (portable shrines) and folk performing arts parade through town, and spirited shouts and drumbeats echo through the port. Yamada Bay is a calm bay where oyster and scallop farming thrive, and the festival season is also when autumn seafood becomes delicious.
quiz_en: Which shellfish, farmed widely in Yamada Bay and elsewhere in the Sanriku seas, is the classic in-shell favorite that comes into season in winter?

name: 龍泉洞
desc: 岩泉町にある日本有数の鍾乳洞で、国の天然記念物に指定されています。洞内には透明度の高い地底湖がいくつもあり、ライトに照らされた水は吸い込まれるような青色。この神秘的な色は「ドラゴンブルー」と呼ばれます。洞窟から湧く水は名水としても知られています。
quiz: 龍泉洞の地底湖で、ライトに照らされて輝く澄んだ青い水の色は何と呼ばれている？
desc_en: One of Japan's foremost limestone caves, Ryusendo in Iwaizumi Town is designated a national Natural Monument. Inside are several highly transparent underground lakes, and the water lit by lights is a blue that seems to draw you in. This mysterious color is called "Dragon Blue." The water that springs from the cave is also known as famously pure water.
quiz_en: What is the name given to the clear blue color of the water that glows when lit in Ryusendo's underground lakes?

name: 早坂高原
addr: 岩泉町釜津田字権現（ほか）
desc: 岩泉町と盛岡方面を結ぶ道沿いの、北上山地の中にある高原です。標高が高く、夏でも涼しい風が吹き抜け、広々とした牧草地や森が続きます。峠越えのドライブの途中で車を停めれば、北上高地のなだらかな山並みが幾重にも重なる、岩手の山奥らしい雄大な景色が広がります。
quiz: 北上山地の早坂高原、ドライブの途中で車を停めて見たい景色は朝？それとも夕暮れ？
desc_en: This highland lies in the Kitakami Mountains along the road linking Iwaizumi Town and the Morioka area. Its high elevation brings cool breezes even in summer, and wide pastures and forests stretch on. Stop the car during a drive over the pass and a grand landscape typical of Iwate's deep mountains spreads before you, with the gentle ridges of the Kitakami Highlands layered one after another.
quiz_en: At the Hayasaka Highlands in the Kitakami Mountains, would you rather stop your car to see the view in the morning or at dusk?

name: 御所野縄文公園
desc: 一戸町にある縄文時代の大規模な集落跡・御所野遺跡を整備した公園です。発掘調査の成果をもとに、屋根を土で覆った竪穴住居などが復元され、縄文の村の風景を体感できます。北海道・北東北の縄文遺跡群のひとつとして世界遺産に登録され、豊かな森に囲まれています。
quiz: 御所野縄文公園に復元された竪穴住居、屋根は何で覆われているのが特徴でしょう？
desc_en: This park was developed at the Goshono Site in Ichinohe Town, the remains of a large Jomon-period settlement. Based on excavation findings, pit dwellings with earth-covered roofs and other structures have been reconstructed, letting you experience the scenery of a Jomon village. Surrounded by rich forest, it is registered as a World Heritage site as one of the Jomon Prehistoric Sites in Northern Japan, covering Hokkaido and northern Tohoku.
quiz_en: The pit dwellings reconstructed at Goshono Jomon Park have a distinctive roof covering. What material are their roofs covered with?

name: 奥中山高原温泉
addr: 一戸町奥中山字西田子662-1
desc: 一戸町の奥中山高原にある温泉です。奥中山は北上川と馬淵川の分水嶺に近い高原地帯で、酪農が盛んな牧歌的な風景が広がります。冬はスキー場がにぎわい、夏は涼しい高原の空気が心地よい場所。かつては鉄道の峠越えの難所としても知られ、列車ファンにもなじみ深い土地です。
quiz: かつての鉄道の難所・奥中山で、蒸気機関車が3両連なって坂を上る姿を何と呼んだ？
desc_en: This hot spring is in the Okunakayama Highlands of Ichinohe Town. Okunakayama is a highland area near the watershed between the Kitakami and Mabechi rivers, with pastoral scenery where dairy farming thrives. In winter the ski area is lively, and in summer the cool highland air is pleasant. It was once known as a difficult mountain pass for the railway and is a familiar place to train fans.
quiz_en: At Okunakayama, once a difficult stretch for the railway, what was the sight of three steam locomotives coupled together climbing the slope called?

name: 仙台七夕まつり
desc: 毎年8月6日から8日に開かれる、東北を代表する夏祭りです。仙台の商店街を中心に、和紙で作られた色鮮やかな吹き流しが無数に飾られ、アーケードの下はまるで光と色のトンネル。伊達政宗の時代から続くと伝えられる伝統行事で、前夜祭には花火大会も行われます。
quiz: 仙台七夕の竹飾りで、くす玉の下に長く垂れ下がる豪華な和紙の飾りを何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: Held every year from August 6 to 8, this is one of Tohoku's representative summer festivals. Centered on Sendai's shopping streets, countless brilliantly colored streamers made of washi paper are hung up, turning the arcades into tunnels of light and color. It is a traditional event said to date back to the time of Date Masamune, and a fireworks display is held on the eve of the festival.
quiz_en: In the bamboo decorations of Sendai Tanabata, what are the gorgeous washi paper decorations that hang long beneath the kusudama balls called?

name: 鳴子峡
desc: 大崎市鳴子温泉の近くにある、大谷川が深く刻んだ峡谷です。両岸に切り立つ断崖が続き、秋には一面が赤や黄色に染まる東北屈指の紅葉の名所として知られます。展望台から見下ろす峡谷の景色は迫力満点で、紅葉の谷の中を走る列車の姿も見どころのひとつです。
quiz: 鳴子峡の紅葉の中、鉄橋やトンネルを抜けて走っていく列車は何という線？
desc_en: This gorge near Naruko Onsen in Osaki City was carved deep by the Otani River. Sheer cliffs continue along both banks, and it is known as one of Tohoku's finest autumn foliage spots, turning red and yellow all over in fall. The view of the gorge from the observatory is spectacular, and a train running through the valley of autumn leaves is another highlight.
quiz_en: Amid the autumn leaves of Naruko Gorge, what is the name of the railway line whose trains pass over bridges and through tunnels?

name: 鳴子温泉の潟沼、温泉神社、滝の湯
desc: 大崎市にある東北屈指の温泉地で、多くの種類の泉質が湧く湯の町です。温泉街の共同浴場「滝の湯」は温泉神社に湧く湯を引いた歴史ある浴場で、木の湯船が趣深い雰囲気。近くの潟沼はエメラルド色の水をたたえた火口湖です。こけしの産地としても知られています。
quiz: 鳴子温泉の名産で、首を回すと「キュッキュッ」と音が鳴る伝統の木の人形は何？
name_en: Naruko Onsen: Katanuma Lake, Onsen Shrine and Takinoyu
desc_en: This is one of Tohoku's foremost hot spring areas in Osaki City, a spa town where many types of spring water bubble up. Takinoyu, the town's public bathhouse, is a historic bath that draws water from the spring at Onsen Shrine, and its wooden tubs create a charming atmosphere. Nearby Katanuma is a crater lake holding emerald-colored water. The town is also known for producing kokeshi dolls.
quiz_en: What is the traditional wooden doll, a Naruko Onsen specialty, that makes a squeaking "kyu-kyu" sound when you turn its head?

name: 蔵王の樹氷
desc: 冬の蔵王連峰では、強い季節風が運ぶ雪と氷が木々を覆い、巨大な樹氷が姿を現します。宮城県側では、雪上車に乗って樹氷原まで上るツアーが人気。真っ白な怪物のような樹氷が立ち並ぶ光景は、自然が生み出す冬の芸術です。晴れた日は青空とのコントラストが見事です。
quiz: 宮城蔵王で樹氷原まで連れて行ってくれる、キャタピラーで雪の上を進む乗り物は何？
desc_en: In winter on the Zao mountain range, snow and ice carried by strong seasonal winds cover the trees, and giant rime-covered trees emerge. On the Miyagi side, tours that ride up to the fields of frosted trees in snow vehicles are popular. The scene of pure white, monster-like trees standing in rows is a winter work of art created by nature. On clear days, the contrast with the blue sky is superb.
quiz_en: At Miyagi Zao, what is the vehicle that moves over the snow on caterpillar tracks to take you to the fields of snow monsters?

name: 瑞厳寺
desc: 松島の海辺にある臨済宗の古刹で、伊達政宗が力を注いで再建した寺として知られます。国宝の本堂は桃山様式の豪華な建築で、内部の襖絵や彫刻は見応えがあります。杉並木の参道の脇には修行の場とされた洞窟が並び、松島の景観とともに歴史の深さを感じられます。
quiz: 瑞巌寺を現在の姿に再建したことで知られる、仙台藩の初代藩主は誰でしょう？
desc_en: This historic Rinzai Zen temple by the sea at Matsushima is known as a temple that Date Masamune devoted great effort to rebuilding. Its main hall, a National Treasure, is a lavish building in the Momoyama style, and the sliding-door paintings and carvings inside are well worth seeing. Caves said to have been places of ascetic practice line the cedar-flanked approach, letting you feel the depth of history along with the Matsushima scenery.
quiz_en: Who was the first lord of the Sendai Domain, known for rebuilding Zuigan-ji into the form it has today?

name: 松島
desc: 松島湾に大小さまざまな島々が浮かぶ景勝地で、日本三景のひとつに数えられます。松に覆われた島々や波に削られた奇岩が織りなす景色は、遊覧船から眺めるのが定番。松尾芭蕉も『おくのほそ道』で訪れた地です。海辺の茶屋で焼きガキを味わうのも松島の楽しみです。
quiz: 松島は、京都の天橋立、広島の宮島とともに何と呼ばれる景勝地のひとつ？
desc_en: This scenic spot, where islands large and small float in Matsushima Bay, is counted among the Three Views of Japan. The scenery woven from pine-covered islands and rocks carved by the waves is classically viewed from a sightseeing boat. It is also a place Matsuo Basho visited in "The Narrow Road to the Deep North." Tasting grilled oysters at a seaside teahouse is another of Matsushima's pleasures.
quiz_en: Along with Amanohashidate in Kyoto and Miyajima in Hiroshima, Matsushima is one of a famous trio of scenic spots. What is this trio called?

name: 秋田城跡外郭東門
desc: 奈良時代に築かれ、日本海側の北の拠点として置かれた古代の城柵・秋田城の跡です。発掘調査をもとに外郭の東門と築地塀が復元され、往時の姿を目の当たりにできます。遺跡からは当時の暮らしを伝える珍しい遺構も見つかり、古代の東北と大陸との交流の歴史を感じられる場所です。
quiz: 秋田城跡で見つかった、奈良時代のものとされる珍しいトイレの遺構は何式のトイレ？
name_en: East Gate of the Outer Wall, Akita Castle Ruins
desc_en: These are the remains of Akita Castle, an ancient fortified outpost built in the Nara period and placed as the northern base on the Sea of Japan side. Based on excavations, the east gate of the outer enclosure and its earthen walls have been reconstructed, letting you see how it once looked. Rare remains that tell of daily life at the time have also been found, making this a place to feel the history of exchange between ancient Tohoku and the Asian continent.
quiz_en: A rare toilet structure believed to date from the Nara period was found at the Akita Castle Ruins. What type of toilet was it?

name: 星辻神社だるま祭
desc: 秋田市大町の星辻神社で行われる、縁起物のだるまにちなんだお祭りです。町なかの神社に大小さまざまなだるまが並び、一年の無病息災や商売繁盛を願う人々でにぎわいます。雪の季節の秋田の街に、赤いだるまの色がひときわ鮮やか。昔ながらの縁日の雰囲気を味わえます。
quiz: 星辻神社のだるま祭で、あなたがだるまに込めたい今年の願いごとは何？
desc_en: This festival at Hoshitsuji Shrine in Omachi, Akita City, is devoted to daruma, the lucky dolls. Daruma of all sizes line the in-town shrine, which bustles with people praying for good health and business prosperity in the year ahead. In the snowy season in Akita, the red of the daruma stands out vividly. You can enjoy the atmosphere of an old-fashioned shrine fair.
quiz_en: At the Daruma Festival of Hoshitsuji Shrine, what wish for this year would you like to place in your daruma doll?

name: 大正寺おけさまつり
desc: 秋田市雄和の大正寺地区に伝わる民謡「大正寺おけさ」を踊るまつりです。地域に根づいた唄と踊りを地元の人々が大切に受け継ぎ、夏の夜に輪になって踊ります。のどかな田園の中に唄と囃子が響き、地域の人々の温かいつながりを感じられます。
quiz: 雄和地区を流れて秋田市で日本海に注ぐ、秋田県を代表する大きな川の名前は何？
desc_en: At this festival, people dance to "Taishoji Okesa," a folk song handed down in the Taishoji area of Yuwa, Akita City. Local residents carefully carry on this song and dance rooted in their community, dancing in a circle on summer nights. Singing and festival music echo through the peaceful countryside, and you can feel the warm ties among the local people.
quiz_en: What is the name of the major river representative of Akita Prefecture that flows through the Yuwa area and into the Sea of Japan at Akita City?

name: 岩見温泉
addr: 秋田市河辺三内字外川原110
desc: 秋田市河辺の山あい、岩見川の上流に湧く温泉です。秋田市の中心部から車で行ける距離にありながら、周囲は深い緑に囲まれた静かな山里。近くの岩見川沿いには渓谷の景勝地もあり、新緑や紅葉の季節には川沿いの散策とあわせて、山の湯でゆったりと過ごせます。
quiz: 秋田市の奥座敷・岩見温泉、湯上がりに川沿いを歩くならどの季節がいい？
desc_en: This hot spring rises along the upper Iwami River in the hills of Kawabe, Akita City. Although it is within driving distance of central Akita, it is a quiet mountain village surrounded by deep greenery. There is also a scenic gorge along the nearby Iwami River, so in the seasons of fresh green and autumn leaves you can combine a riverside walk with a relaxing time at this mountain spa.
quiz_en: At Iwami Onsen, a secluded retreat of Akita City, which season would be best for a walk along the river after your bath?

name: 貝の沢温泉
desc: 秋田市太平地区、太平山のふもとに湧く温泉です。太平山は秋田市の東にそびえる信仰の山で、市民に古くから親しまれてきました。周囲には田園と森が広がり、山の澄んだ空気の中でのんびりと湯につかれます。登山やハイキングの帰りに立ち寄り、汗を流すのにぴったりです。
quiz: 秋田市の東にそびえ、古くから市民の信仰を集めてきた「太平山」は何と読む？
desc_en: This hot spring rises at the foot of Mount Taiheizan in the Taihei area of Akita City. Mount Taiheizan is a sacred mountain rising east of Akita City and has long been beloved by residents. Farmland and forest spread around it, and you can soak at leisure in the clear mountain air. It is perfect for stopping by to wash off the sweat on the way back from climbing or hiking.
quiz_en: After a soak at Kainosawa Onsen, would you rather climb sacred Mount Taiheizan or stroll through the farmland around its foot?

name: 秋田県北部地方のきりたんぽ鍋
desc: 炊いたご飯をつぶして杉の棒に巻きつけて焼いた「きりたんぽ」を、鶏のだしのきいたスープで煮込む秋田を代表する鍋料理です。鹿角や大館など県北部が発祥の地として知られます。ごぼうやまいたけ、セリなどの具材とともに味わう、新米の季節から冬にかけての味覚です。
quiz: きりたんぽ鍋のスープのだしに欠かせない、秋田を代表するブランド地鶏の名前は何？
name_en: Kiritanpo Hot Pot of Northern Akita
desc_en: This signature Akita hot pot dish features "kiritanpo," cooked rice mashed, wrapped around cedar sticks and grilled, simmered in a soup rich with chicken stock. The northern part of the prefecture, such as Kazuno and Odate, is known as its birthplace. Enjoyed with burdock, maitake mushrooms, Japanese parsley and other ingredients, it is a taste of the season from the new rice harvest through winter.
quiz_en: What is the name of Akita's signature brand of local chicken, essential for the broth of kiritanpo hot pot?

name: 白神山地のブナ原生林
desc: 秋田・青森の県境に広がる白神山地は、人の手が入らないブナの原生林が広く残る世界自然遺産です。秋田県側の藤里町や八峰町方面からも森に入ることができ、巨木が立ち並ぶ森を歩けば、多くの生き物を育むブナの森の豊かさを実感できます。秋は森全体が黄金色に輝きます。
quiz: 白神山地のブナの森に棲む、黒い体に赤い頭が目立つ大型のキツツキの名前は何？
name_en: Beech Forests of the Shirakami Mountains (Akita Side)
desc_en: The Shirakami Mountains, spreading across the Akita-Aomori border, are a World Natural Heritage site where vast virgin beech forests untouched by human hands remain. You can also enter the forest from the Akita side, around Fujisato and Happo towns, and walking among the towering giant trees lets you feel the richness of a beech forest that nurtures many living things. In autumn the whole forest glows gold.
quiz_en: What is the name of the large woodpecker with a black body and striking red head that lives in the beech forests of Shirakami?

name: 銀杏山神社・七座天神宮
addr: 能代市二ツ井町仁鮒・小繋字天神道上67
desc: 能代市二ツ井町、米代川沿いの山あいに鎮座する神社です。二ツ井は米代川が山々の間を縫うように流れる景勝の地で、川沿いには七座山の緑が迫ります。静かな森に囲まれた境内は清々しく、秋には木々が色づいて境内を彩ります。米代川の流れと山の自然に包まれた神社です。
quiz: 二ツ井町の米代川沿いにある、明治天皇の巡幸にちなんだ名で知られる景勝地はどこ？
name_en: Ichozan Shrine and Nanakura Tenmangu Shrine
desc_en: These shrines sit in the hills along the Yoneshiro River in Futatsui, Noshiro City. Futatsui is a scenic area where the Yoneshiro River winds among the mountains, with the greenery of Mount Nanakura pressing close along the river. The grounds, surrounded by quiet forest, feel refreshing, and in autumn the trees take on color and adorn the precincts. These shrines are embraced by the flow of the Yoneshiro River and mountain nature.
quiz_en: What is the scenic spot along the Yoneshiro River in Futatsui, known by a name connected to an imperial tour by Emperor Meiji?

name: 桜づつみ河畔公園
desc: 能代市を流れる米代川の河畔に、桜並木が続く公園です。春には川沿いの土手が桜色に染まり、川面を渡る風を感じながら花見を楽しめます。能代は日本海に面した木材の町として栄え、高校バスケットボールの強豪校があることでも全国に知られています。
quiz: 高校バスケットボールの強豪校があることから、能代市は何の街として知られている？
desc_en: This park with a long row of cherry trees lies on the banks of the Yoneshiro River, which flows through Noshiro City. In spring the riverside embankment turns cherry-pink, and you can enjoy viewing the blossoms while feeling the breeze blowing across the water. Noshiro prospered as a lumber town facing the Sea of Japan and is also known nationwide for a powerhouse high school basketball team.
quiz_en: Because it is home to a powerhouse high school basketball team, Noshiro City is known as the city of what?

name: 沖掵神社･手足観音まつり
addr: 横手市平鹿町下鍋倉字上掵
desc: 横手市平鹿町の沖掵神社で行われる、手足観音にちなんだまつりです。手足の健康を願う人々の信仰を集め、地域の人々によって大切に受け継がれてきました。横手盆地の田園地帯に位置し、まつりの日には近隣から参拝者が訪れ、素朴でのどかな里の祭りの雰囲気に包まれます。
quiz: 手足観音のまつりにお参りするなら、あなたは誰の手足の健康を願いたい？
desc_en: This festival at Okihake Shrine in Hiraka, Yokote City, is devoted to the Teashi (Hands and Feet) Kannon. It draws the faith of people who pray for healthy hands and feet and has been carefully carried on by the local community. Located in the farmland of the Yokote Basin, the shrine welcomes worshippers from nearby on festival day, wrapped in the simple, peaceful atmosphere of a village festival.
quiz_en: If you visited the Teashi Kannon festival to pray, whose hands and feet would you wish good health for?

name: 木戸五郎兵衛神社初午祭
addr: 横手市雄物川町沼館字高畑
desc: 横手市雄物川町沼館の木戸五郎兵衛神社で行われる初午祭です。初午は稲荷信仰と結びついた行事で、豊作や商売繁盛を願う祭りとして各地で受け継がれています。雪深い横手盆地で迎える冬の祭りは、地域の人々が集い、春の訪れと一年の実りを祈る大切な機会になっています。
quiz: 初午祭は、暦の上で何月の最初の「午の日」に行われるのが一般的な行事でしょう？
desc_en: This Hatsuuma festival is held at Kido Gorobe Shrine in Numadate, Omonogawa, Yokote City. Hatsuuma is an observance tied to Inari worship and is carried on in many places as a festival praying for bountiful harvests and business prosperity. Held in winter in the snowy Yokote Basin, it is an important occasion for local people to gather and pray for the coming of spring and the year's harvest.
quiz_en: The Hatsuuma festival is generally held on the first "Day of the Horse" of which month in the traditional calendar?

name: 横手公園桜まつり
desc: 横手城跡の横手公園で、春に開かれる桜のまつりです。丘の上には天守を模した展望台が立ち、満開の桜と城の姿を一緒に楽しめます。展望台からは横手の市街地や横手盆地、奥羽の山々を一望。冬のかまくらで知られる横手の街が、春は桜色に包まれます。
quiz: 横手市の小正月行事で、雪で作った室の中に水神様を祀り子どもたちが集うものは何？
desc_en: This cherry blossom festival is held in spring at Yokote Park, the site of Yokote Castle. On the hilltop stands an observatory modeled on a castle keep, so you can enjoy cherries in full bloom together with the castle. From the observatory you can take in central Yokote, the Yokote Basin and the Ou Mountains. Yokote, known for its winter kamakura, is wrapped in cherry-pink in spring.
quiz_en: In Yokote's Little New Year event, children gather inside snow huts where the water god is enshrined. What are these snow huts called?

name: 金沢公園
desc: 横手市金沢地区の丘陵にある公園で、平安時代後期の戦いの舞台となった城柵の跡と伝えられる歴史の地です。園内には八幡神社が鎮座し、古戦場の面影を感じながら散策できます。春の桜や秋の紅葉も美しく、高台からは横手盆地の広々とした田園風景を見渡せます。
quiz: 金沢公園一帯が舞台とされる、源義家が戦った平安時代後期の戦いを何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: This park in the hills of the Kanazawa area of Yokote City is a historic place said to be the site of a fortified stockade that was the stage of a battle in the late Heian period. Hachiman Shrine stands within the park, and you can stroll while sensing traces of the old battlefield. Spring cherry blossoms and autumn leaves are also beautiful, and from the heights you can look out over the wide farmland of the Yokote Basin.
quiz_en: What is the late Heian-period war fought by Minamoto no Yoshiie, said to have taken place around Kanazawa Park, called?

name: 三所神社梵天まつり
addr: 横手市増田町増田字伊勢堂34
desc: 横手市増田町の三所神社で行われる、梵天を奉納するまつりです。梵天は色鮮やかな飾りをつけた大きな柱状の奉納物で、若者たちが威勢よく担いで神社へ向かいます。増田は蔵の町並みが残る歴史ある町で、雪深い冬に響く掛け声が町を活気づけます。
quiz: 増田の町並みに多く残る、母屋の中に建てられて大切に守られてきた蔵を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: At this festival at Sansho Shrine in Masuda, Yokote City, bonten are offered to the shrine. Bonten are large pillar-like offerings adorned with colorful decorations, and young men carry them spiritedly to the shrine. Masuda is a historic town where streets of kura storehouses remain, and the shouts echoing through the snowy winter bring the town to life.
quiz_en: What are the storehouses called, found in many Masuda homes, that were built inside the main house and carefully protected?

name: 真人公園桜まつり
addr: 横手市増田町亀田字上掵
desc: 横手市増田町の真人公園で開かれる桜のまつりです。真人山のふもとに広がる公園には多くの桜が植えられ、池のほとりに咲く花や夜桜を楽しむ人々でにぎわいます。増田町は果樹栽培が盛んな地域で、周辺にはりんご畑も広がり、春は花の里らしいのどかな景色です。
quiz: 真人公園の桜まつり、あなたが楽しみたいのは昼の青空の桜？それとも夜桜？
desc_en: This cherry blossom festival is held at Manto Park in Masuda, Yokote City. The park, spreading at the foot of Mount Manto, is planted with many cherry trees and bustles with people enjoying the blossoms beside the pond and the cherries lit up at night. Masuda is an area where fruit growing thrives, with apple orchards around it, creating a peaceful scene befitting a village of flowers in spring.
quiz_en: At the Manto Park Cherry Blossom Festival, which would you rather enjoy: cherries under a blue daytime sky, or blossoms at night?

name: 吉田城跡
addr: 横手市平鹿町上吉田間内字吉田
desc: 横手市平鹿町上吉田にある城跡です。横手盆地の平野部に位置し、周囲には広々とした田園が広がっています。かつてこの地域を治めた人々の歴史を伝える場所で、静かな史跡にたたずめば、戦国の世の盆地の姿に思いを馳せることができます。四季の田んぼの風景も魅力です。
quiz: 横手盆地の田園に残る吉田城跡、あなたならどの季節の田んぼと一緒に眺めたい？
desc_en: These castle ruins are in Kamiyoshida, Hiraka, Yokote City. Located on the plains of the Yokote Basin, the site is surrounded by wide farmland. It conveys the history of the people who once ruled this area, and as you stand at the quiet historic site, you can imagine the basin in the age of the warring states. The rice paddy scenery through the four seasons is another attraction.
quiz_en: At the Yoshida Castle Ruins amid the farmland of the Yokote Basin, in which season of rice paddies would you like to view the site?

name: 琵琶沼
addr: 横手市平鹿町浅舞字浅舞
desc: 横手市平鹿町浅舞にある沼です。横手盆地は奥羽山脈の水が地下を通って湧き出す、水に恵まれた土地。沼のほとりは静かな水辺の空間で、地元の人々の散策や憩いの場になっています。水面に映る空や周囲の緑を眺めながら、のんびりとした時間を過ごせます。
quiz: 横手盆地の水辺・琵琶沼、ほとりを歩くならどんな生き物に出会いたい？
desc_en: This pond is in Asamai, Hiraka, Yokote City. The Yokote Basin is a land blessed with water, where water from the Ou Mountains travels underground and springs to the surface. The pondside is a quiet waterside space, a place for local people to stroll and relax. You can spend a leisurely time gazing at the sky reflected on the water and the surrounding greenery.
quiz_en: If you walked along the shore of Biwa-numa, a waterside spot in the Yokote Basin, what creatures would you like to encounter?

name: 首塚神社
addr: 横手市雄物川町今宿字高花
desc: 横手市雄物川町今宿にある神社です。雄物川流域の田園地帯に鎮座し、地域の人々に守られてきました。周囲には横手盆地の広い田んぼが広がり、季節ごとに緑や黄金色に色を変える景色の中にたたずむ社は、里の暮らしと信仰の結びつきを感じさせてくれます。
quiz: 雄物川流域の田園にたたずむ首塚神社、その名の由来を地元で聞いてみたことはある？
desc_en: This shrine is in Imajuku, Omonogawa, Yokote City. It stands in the farmland along the Omono River and has been cared for by local people. The wide rice paddies of the Yokote Basin spread around it, and the shrine standing amid scenery that turns green or gold with the seasons lets you feel the bond between village life and faith.
quiz_en: Have you ever asked local people about the origin of the name of Kubizuka Shrine, standing in the farmland of the Omono River basin?

name: 波宇志別神社神楽殿
addr: 横手市大森町八沢木字宮脇106
desc: 横手市大森町、保呂羽山の信仰の中心となってきた波宇志別神社の神楽殿です。古い時代の建築様式を伝える建物として国の重要文化財に指定されています。この神社では古くから神楽が受け継がれ、山里の静かな境内で、長い歴史に培われた信仰の姿に触れられます。
quiz: 波宇志別神社が信仰の中心となっている、横手市大森町の山の名前は何でしょう？
desc_en: This is the kagura hall of Hojiwake Shrine in Omori, Yokote City, which has been the center of faith in Mount Horowa. As a building that preserves an architectural style from early times, it is designated a national Important Cultural Property. Kagura sacred dance has been handed down at this shrine since long ago, and in its quiet mountain-village grounds you can encounter a faith nurtured over a long history.
quiz_en: What is the name of the mountain in Omori, Yokote City, at the center of the faith of Hojiwake Shrine?

name: 梨木公園
addr: 横手市十文字町西原二番町
desc: 横手市十文字町にある公園で、地域の人々の憩いの場として親しまれています。十文字町は横手盆地の南部に位置する町で、煮干しだしのあっさりした中華そばが名物。公園で季節の花や緑を楽しんだら、町の食堂で昔ながらの一杯を味わうのもおすすめです。
quiz: 横手市十文字町のご当地ラーメン「十文字中華そば」に入っている、ちょっと珍しい具は？
desc_en: This park in Jumonji, Yokote City, is loved as a place for local people to relax. Jumonji is a town in the southern part of the Yokote Basin, famous for its light chuka soba (ramen) made with dried sardine broth. After enjoying the seasonal flowers and greenery of the park, it is a good idea to taste an old-fashioned bowl at a local diner.
quiz_en: What slightly unusual topping is found in "Jumonji chuka soba," the local ramen of Jumonji in Yokote City?

name: 三ツ又温泉
desc: 横手市山内地区の山あいにある温泉です。山内は奥羽山脈に抱かれた自然豊かな地域で、名産の里芋「山内いものこ」で知られています。秋には芋の子汁を囲む風景も見られ、山の幸に恵まれた土地。静かな温泉で湯につかり、山里の味覚とともにのんびり過ごせます。
quiz: 山内地区の名産で、秋の芋の子汁に欠かせないねっとりとした里芋は何と呼ばれる？
desc_en: This hot spring is in the hills of the Sannai area of Yokote City. Sannai is an area rich in nature, embraced by the Ou Mountains, and known for its specialty taro, "Sannai imonoko." In autumn you may see people gathered around pots of imonoko-jiru taro soup, in a land blessed with mountain bounty. Soak in the quiet hot spring and relax with the flavors of the mountain village.
quiz_en: What is the name of the sticky taro, a Sannai specialty, that is essential for the autumn taro soup imonoko-jiru?

name: 桜つづみ公園
addr: 横手市大雄字木戸口西54地先
desc: 横手市大雄地区にある、川沿いの土手に桜が植えられた公園です。春には桜並木が続き、のどかな田園地帯に花の帯が現れます。周辺は横手盆地の豊かな米どころ。花見のあとには、太めの麺に甘めのソース、目玉焼きをのせた名物の横手やきそばを味わうのもいいですね。
quiz: ご当地グルメ「横手やきそば」のトッピングとして、麺の上にのせられている卵料理は？
desc_en: This park in the Taiyu area of Yokote City has cherry trees planted along a riverside embankment. In spring a row of cherry trees continues on and on, creating a ribbon of flowers through the peaceful farmland. The surrounding Yokote Basin is a rich rice-growing region. After viewing the blossoms, why not try the famous Yokote yakisoba, with thick noodles, sweetish sauce and a fried egg on top?
quiz_en: As a topping on the local specialty Yokote yakisoba, what egg dish is placed on top of the noodles?

name: 大滝温泉
addr: 大館市字十二所字上川代
desc: 大館市十二所、米代川沿いに湧く温泉です。古くから湯治場として利用されてきた歴史ある湯の町で、川沿いの落ち着いた雰囲気が残っています。大館は秋田犬のふるさととして知られ、渋谷で主人を待ち続けた忠犬ハチ公もこの地の生まれ。湯とともに秋田犬の町を楽しめます。
quiz: 渋谷駅で主人の帰りを待ち続けたことで有名な、大館市生まれの秋田犬の名前は何？
desc_en: This hot spring rises along the Yoneshiro River in Juniso, Odate City. It is a historic spa town long used for therapeutic bathing, retaining a calm riverside atmosphere. Odate is known as the home of the Akita dog, and the faithful dog Hachiko, who kept waiting for his master in Shibuya, was born here. You can enjoy the town of Akita dogs along with the hot springs.
quiz_en: What is the name of the Akita dog born in Odate City, famous for waiting for his master's return at Shibuya Station?

name: 小安峡温泉
desc: 湯沢市皆瀬、皆瀬川が刻んだ深いV字の渓谷沿いに広がる温泉です。渓谷の岩の割れ目からは熱湯と蒸気が勢いよく噴き出し、谷底へ下りる遊歩道からその迫力を間近に見られます。秋は渓谷が紅葉に包まれ、湯けむりと色づく木々の組み合わせが見事な景色をつくります。
quiz: 小安峡で、渓谷の岩の割れ目から熱湯と蒸気が勢いよく噴き出している場所を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: This hot spring spreads along a deep V-shaped gorge carved by the Minase River in Minase, Yuzawa City. Boiling water and steam spurt forcefully from cracks in the gorge's rocks, and a walking path down to the valley floor lets you see their power up close. In autumn the gorge is wrapped in fall colors, and the combination of rising steam and colorful trees creates a superb view.
quiz_en: At Oyasukyo, what is the spot called where boiling water and steam spurt forcefully from cracks in the rocks of the gorge?

name: 泥湯温泉
desc: 湯沢市高松の山奥、噴気が立ちのぼる谷間にひっそりとたたずむ温泉です。名前のとおり、灰色の泥まじりの湯が湧くことで知られ、まわりの荒々しい地形と湯けむりが秘湯の雰囲気を漂わせます。近くには草木の生えない硫黄の噴気地帯もあり、大地の力を感じられる場所です。
quiz: 泥湯温泉の近くにある、草木が生えず硫黄の噴気が立ちこめる荒涼とした霊場の名前は？
desc_en: This hot spring sits quietly deep in the mountains of Takamatsu, Yuzawa City, in a valley where volcanic fumes rise. As its name, meaning "mud hot water," suggests, it is known for gray, muddy spring water, and the rugged terrain and rising steam around it create the feel of a hidden hot spring. Nearby there is also a sulfurous fumarole area where no plants grow, a place to feel the power of the earth.
quiz_en: What is the name of the desolate sacred site near Doroyu Onsen, where no plants grow and sulfurous fumes hang in the air?

name: 木地山高原温泉
desc: 湯沢市高松の木地山高原にある温泉です。木地山は古くから木地師が暮らした地域で、素朴な表情の伝統こけしの産地として知られています。高原の澄んだ空気と森に囲まれた静かな環境で、湯につかりながらのんびりと過ごせます。秋は周辺の山々の紅葉が美しい季節です。
quiz: 湯沢市の木地山地区で、木地師たちが代々作り続けてきた伝統の木の人形は何？
desc_en: This hot spring is in the Kijiyama Highlands of Takamatsu, Yuzawa City. Kijiyama is an area where kijishi, woodturners, have lived since long ago, and it is known for producing traditional kokeshi dolls with simple, rustic expressions. In quiet surroundings of clear highland air and forest, you can relax while soaking in the bath. Autumn is a beautiful season, with the surrounding mountains in fall colors.
quiz_en: In the Kijiyama area of Yuzawa City, what traditional wooden doll have woodturners continued to make for generations?

name: 後生掛温泉の泥火山、箱蒸し、泥、オンドル湯治
addr: 鹿角市八幡平字熊沢国有林
desc: 八幡平の山中にある湯治の宿で、周辺には泥がぼこぼこと噴き上がる泥火山や噴気孔が点在しています。箱の中に入って首だけを出し蒸気で温まる箱蒸し、地熱で床を温めるオンドルなど、昔ながらの湯治文化が今も息づいています。自然研究路を歩けば、大地の鼓動を間近に感じられます。
quiz: 「馬で来て足駄で帰る後生掛」という言葉は、この温泉のどんなところをたとえたもの？
name_en: Goshogake Onsen: Mud Volcanoes and Traditional Healing Baths
desc_en: This therapeutic spa inn lies in the mountains of Hachimantai, surrounded by mud volcanoes where mud bubbles up and by steaming vents. Traditional healing culture is still alive here, such as the box steam bath, where you sit in a box with only your head outside and warm up in the steam, and ondol rooms with floors heated by geothermal warmth. Walking the nature trail, you can feel the pulse of the earth up close.
quiz_en: There is a saying, "Come to Goshogake on a horse, go home in wooden clogs." What quality of this hot spring does it describe?

name: 湯瀬温泉郷
desc: 鹿角市八幡平、米代川の渓谷沿いに湧く温泉郷です。川の瀬から湯が湧いていたことが名の由来とされ、川沿いに旅館が並ぶ落ち着いた湯の町。花輪線の列車が渓谷沿いを走り、秋には渓谷が紅葉に包まれます。八幡平や十和田湖への旅の拠点としても便利な場所です。
quiz: 鹿角市で夏に行われ、豪華な屋台が町を練り歩くユネスコ無形文化遺産の祭りの名前は？
desc_en: This hot spring village rises along the Yoneshiro River gorge in Hachimantai, Kazuno City. Its name is said to come from hot water that once bubbled up from the river's shallows, and it is a calm spa town with inns lining the river. Hanawa Line trains run along the gorge, and in autumn the valley is wrapped in fall colors. It is also a convenient base for trips to Hachimantai and Lake Towada.
quiz_en: What is the name of the summer festival in Kazuno City, a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage, in which lavish floats parade through town?

name: 大湯温泉郷
desc: 鹿角市十和田大湯の、大湯川沿いに広がる温泉郷です。古くから湯治場として栄えた歴史ある温泉で、町には共同浴場もあり、湯めぐりも楽しみのひとつ。近くには縄文時代の大規模な環状列石があり、世界遺産の縄文遺跡と温泉を一緒に楽しめるのがこの地ならではの魅力です。
quiz: 大湯温泉の近くにある、縄文時代に石を円形に並べてつくられた遺跡を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: This hot spring village spreads along the Oyu River in Towada-Oyu, Kazuno City. It is a historic hot spring that has long flourished as a therapeutic spa, and the town has public bathhouses, so hopping between baths is part of the fun. Nearby are large Jomon-period stone circles, and the chance to enjoy World Heritage Jomon sites together with hot springs is a charm unique to this place.
quiz_en: What is the site near Oyu Onsen called, where stones were arranged in circles during the Jomon period?

name: 史跡尾去沢鉱山
addr: 鹿角市尾去沢字獅子沢13-5
desc: 鹿角市にある、長い歴史を持つ鉱山の跡です。昭和に閉山するまで多くの鉱石が掘り出され、地域の発展を支えてきました。現在は坑道の一部が観光用に公開され、ひんやりとした坑道の中を歩きながら、かつての採掘の様子や鉱山で働いた人々の暮らしに触れることができます。
quiz: 尾去沢鉱山で主に掘り出されていた、電線などにも使われる赤みを帯びた金属は何？
desc_en: This is the site of a mine with a long history in Kazuno City. Until it closed in the Showa era, large amounts of ore were dug out here, supporting the region's development. Today part of the mine tunnels is open to visitors, and as you walk through the cool shafts, you can learn about past mining methods and the lives of the people who worked in the mine.
quiz_en: What reddish metal, also used in electric wires and cables, was mainly mined at the Osarizawa Mine?

name: 鳥海山
desc: 秋田と山形の県境にそびえる東北有数の高峰で、日本海からすっと立ち上がる姿が美しい独立峰です。各地で「富士」の名を冠した愛称で呼ばれ、山頂近くまで残る雪や、夏の高山植物が登山者を魅了します。山の雪解け水は豊かな伏流水となって、ふもとの田畑や海を潤しています。
quiz: 秋田では「秋田富士」と呼ばれる鳥海山、山形県側では何という名前で呼ばれている？
desc_en: Rising on the border of Akita and Yamagata, this is one of Tohoku's highest peaks, a beautiful solitary mountain that rises straight up from the Sea of Japan. In various places it is called by nicknames bearing the name "Fuji," and snow lingering near the summit and alpine plants in summer captivate climbers. Its snowmelt becomes abundant underground water that nourishes the fields and sea at its foot.
quiz_en: In Akita, Mount Chokai is called "Akita Fuji." By what name is it known on the Yamagata Prefecture side?

name: 石沢峡
addr: 由利本荘市大簗猿木沢
desc: 由利本荘市大簗の山あいに続く渓谷です。川が山を削ってつくった谷には清らかな流れが続き、岩と木々がつくる静かな景色が広がります。新緑の季節は瑞々しい緑に、秋は紅葉に包まれ、渓流沿いを歩けば水音と山の空気に癒やされます。由利本荘の自然を感じられる場所です。
quiz: 由利本荘市の山あいの石沢峡、渓流沿いを歩いて一番心に残った音は何だった？
desc_en: This gorge runs through the hills of Oyana, Yurihonjo City. In the valley carved through the mountains by the river, a clear stream flows on, and a quiet landscape of rocks and trees unfolds. It is wrapped in fresh, vivid green in early summer and autumn colors in fall, and walking along the stream you will be soothed by the sound of water and the mountain air. It is a place to feel the nature of Yurihonjo.
quiz_en: Walking along the stream at Ishizawa Gorge in the hills of Yurihonjo, what sound stayed with you the most?

name: 鶴舞温泉
desc: 由利本荘市の市街地にある温泉で、町なかで気軽に湯を楽しめます。本荘は子吉川の河口近くに開けた城下町で、川沿いには穏やかな町並みが広がります。散策や観光の合間に立ち寄れる便利さが魅力で、旅の疲れを癒やしたら、日本海の幸を味わいに町へ繰り出しましょう。
quiz: 由利本荘市の中心部を流れ、日本海へと注いでいる川の名前は何でしょう？
desc_en: This hot spring is in central Yurihonjo City, where you can casually enjoy a bath right in town. Honjo is a castle town that developed near the mouth of the Koyoshi River, with calm streets spreading along the river. Its appeal is the convenience of stopping by between walks and sightseeing, and after easing your travel fatigue, head into town to taste seafood from the Sea of Japan.
quiz_en: What is the name of the river that flows through the center of Yurihonjo City and empties into the Sea of Japan?

name: 天鷺ワイン城
addr: 由利本荘市岩城下蛇田字高城2-1
desc: 由利本荘市岩城の日本海を見下ろす高台にある、城の形をした施設です。岩城はかつて亀田藩の城下として栄えた地域で、高台からは日本海の大きな眺めが広がります。晴れた日の夕暮れには、海に沈む夕日が空と海を染める絶景に。歴史と海の景色をあわせて楽しめる場所です。
quiz: 日本海を見下ろす天鷺ワイン城、夕暮れに眺めるならどんな色の空がいい？
desc_en: This castle-shaped facility stands on a hill overlooking the Sea of Japan in Iwaki, Yurihonjo City. Iwaki once prospered as the castle town of the Kameda Domain, and from the hill there are broad views over the Sea of Japan. At dusk on a clear day, the sun sinking into the sea colors the sky and water in a spectacular view. It is a place to enjoy history and sea views together.
quiz_en: At Tensagi Wine Castle overlooking the Sea of Japan, what color of sky would you most like to see at dusk?

name: 鳥海高原由利原まつり
addr: 由利本荘市西沢字南由利原373
desc: 鳥海山の北麓に広がる由利原高原で開かれるまつりです。由利原は牧草地や畑が広がるなだらかな高原で、目の前にどっしりとそびえる鳥海山の姿は圧巻。高原の涼しい風が吹き抜ける中、まつりの催しを楽しみながら、雄大な山と広い空の景色を存分に味わえます。
quiz: 由利原高原のまつりで、目の前にそびえる鳥海山を背景にあなたが撮りたい一枚は？
desc_en: This festival is held on the Yurihara Highlands at the northern foot of Mount Chokai. Yurihara is a gently rolling plateau of pastures and fields, and the sight of Mount Chokai rising majestically before you is breathtaking. As the cool highland breeze blows through, you can enjoy the festival events while fully taking in the scenery of the grand mountain and wide sky.
quiz_en: At the festival on the Yurihara Highlands, what photo would you like to take with Mount Chokai towering behind you?

name: かしわ温泉
addr: 由利本荘市西目町西目字釜ヶ沢96-5
desc: 由利本荘市西目町にある温泉です。西目は日本海に近い田園の町で、のどかな里の風景が広がります。地元の人々に親しまれる湯につかって体を温めたら、少し足をのばして日本海の海岸へ。晴れた日には南に鳥海山の姿を望み、夕暮れどきには海に沈む夕日も楽しめます。
quiz: 日本海に近い西目町のかしわ温泉、湯上がりに見たいのは鳥海山？それとも海の夕日？
desc_en: This hot spring is in Nishime, Yurihonjo City. Nishime is a farming town near the Sea of Japan with peaceful village scenery. After warming up in a bath loved by local people, head a little farther to the Sea of Japan coast. On clear days you can see Mount Chokai to the south, and at dusk you can also enjoy the sun setting into the sea.
quiz_en: After a soak at Kashiwa Onsen in Nishime near the Sea of Japan, which would you rather see: Mount Chokai or a sunset over the sea?

name: 滝温泉
addr: 由利本荘市滝字湯の沢30
desc: 由利本荘市の滝地区、湯の沢の山あいにある温泉です。周囲は里山の自然に囲まれ、四季の移ろいを感じながら静かに湯につかれます。にぎやかな温泉街とは違う、素朴で落ち着いた雰囲気が魅力。由利地域の山里の暮らしに触れながら、のんびりと過ごしたい人におすすめです。
quiz: 由利本荘の山あいの滝温泉、静かな湯につかりながら耳を澄ますと何が聞こえた？
desc_en: This hot spring lies in the hills of Yunosawa in the Taki area of Yurihonjo City. Surrounded by the nature of the countryside, you can soak quietly while feeling the changing seasons. Its charm is a simple, calm atmosphere quite different from a busy spa town. It is recommended for those who want to spend unhurried time while experiencing mountain-village life in the Yuri region.
quiz_en: At Taki Onsen in the hills of Yurihonjo, what did you hear when you listened carefully while soaking in the quiet bath?

name: 強首温泉
desc: 大仙市西部、雄物川の流れに沿った田園地帯にある温泉です。川が大きく蛇行する穏やかな風景の中に宿がたたずみ、のどかな里の空気に包まれて湯を楽しめます。川の流れを眺めながら、落ち着いた時間を過ごせるのが魅力。ちょっと読みにくい地名も印象に残ります。
quiz: 雄物川沿いの「強首温泉」、ちょっと変わったこの地名は何と読むでしょう？
desc_en: This hot spring is in the farmland along the Omono River in western Daisen City. The inn stands amid gentle scenery where the river makes great bends, and you can enjoy the bath wrapped in the peaceful air of the countryside. Its charm is spending calm time watching the river flow. The somewhat tricky-to-read place name also sticks in the memory.
quiz_en: At Kowakubi Onsen beside the great bends of the Omono River, how would you like to spend a calm afternoon watching the water flow?

name: 中里温泉
addr: 大仙市太田町中里字新屋敷114
desc: 大仙市太田町、奥羽山脈のふもとに広がる田園地帯にある温泉です。周囲には仙北平野の広い田んぼが続き、背後の山並みとともにのどかな景色が広がります。大仙市は夏の花火大会で全国的に知られる町で、地元の人々の暮らしに寄り添う湯で、ゆったりと体を休められます。
quiz: 大仙市で毎年夏に開かれ、全国の花火師が技を競う花火大会は通称何と呼ばれる？
desc_en: This hot spring is in the farmland spreading at the foot of the Ou Mountains in Ota, Daisen City. The wide rice paddies of the Senboku Plain continue all around, creating a peaceful scene together with the mountains behind. Daisen City is known nationwide for its summer fireworks competition, and in this bath close to local people's daily lives, you can rest your body at leisure.
quiz_en: What is the popular name of the fireworks competition held every summer in Daisen City, where pyrotechnicians from all over Japan compete?

name: 八幡宮綴子神社例大祭
desc: 北秋田市綴子の八幡宮綴子神社で、夏に行われる例大祭です。祭りの主役は、直径が人の背丈を大きく超える巨大な太鼓。重低音が腹の底まで響きわたり、多くの見物客を圧倒します。夏の北秋田を熱くする、地域の人々が誇りをもって受け継ぐ祭りです。
quiz: 綴子神社の例大祭で打ち鳴らされる、ギネス世界記録にも認定された巨大な楽器は何？
desc_en: This annual grand festival is held in summer at Hachimangu Tsuzureko Shrine in Tsuzureko, Kitaakita City. The star of the festival is a giant drum whose diameter far exceeds a person's height. Its deep bass booms right through to your gut, overwhelming the many spectators. It is a festival that heats up summer in Kitaakita, carried on with pride by local people.
quiz_en: What is the giant musical instrument, recognized by Guinness World Records, that is played at the Tsuzureko Shrine annual festival?

name: 湯の岱温泉
addr: 北秋田市小森字湯ノ岱67
desc: 北秋田市小森の山あいにある温泉です。北秋田市は森吉山をはじめとする豊かな山岳地帯を抱え、冬には雪と氷が木々を覆う幻想的な景色も見られる土地。山深い静かな環境の中で、地元の人々に親しまれる湯にゆっくりつかり、北秋田の自然の恵みを感じられます。
quiz: 北秋田市の森吉山で冬に見られる、雪と氷が木を覆いつくしてできる自然の造形は何？
desc_en: This hot spring lies in the hills of Komori, Kitaakita City. Kitaakita embraces a rich mountain region, including Mount Moriyoshi, and in winter you can see magical scenery where snow and ice cover the trees. In the quiet of the deep mountains, you can take a leisurely soak in a bath loved by local people and feel the blessings of Kitaakita's nature.
quiz_en: What natural formations, created when snow and ice completely cover the trees, can be seen on Mount Moriyoshi in Kitaakita in winter?

name: 打当温泉
addr: 北秋田市阿仁打当字仙北渡上ミ67
desc: 北秋田市阿仁打当、山深いマタギの里にある温泉です。阿仁地方は、山の神を敬いながら狩猟を行う伝統的な狩人・マタギの文化が受け継がれてきた土地として知られています。周辺にはマタギの暮らしを紹介する施設もあり、山の恵みを生かした料理とともに独特の文化に触れられます。
quiz: 阿仁地方に伝わる、山の神を敬いながら集団で狩猟を行う伝統的な狩人を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: This hot spring is in Utto, Ani, Kitaakita City, a village of the Matagi deep in the mountains. The Ani region is known as a land where the culture of the Matagi, traditional hunters who hunt while revering the mountain gods, has been handed down. Nearby there are also facilities introducing the Matagi way of life, and you can experience this unique culture along with dishes that make use of the mountain's bounty.
quiz_en: What are the traditional hunters of the Ani region called, who hunt in groups while revering the mountain gods?

name: 元滝
addr: にかほ市象潟町小滝字麻針堰地内
desc: にかほ市象潟の山あいにある滝で、苔むした岩肌の間から幾筋もの水が湧き出すように流れ落ちます。この水は鳥海山に降った雪や雨が長い年月をかけて地中を通った伏流水で、夏でもひんやりとした空気に包まれます。緑の苔と白い水の流れがつくる景色は神秘的です。
quiz: 元滝の苔むした岩から湧き出す伏流水は、もとはどの山に降った雪や雨でしょう？
desc_en: This waterfall in the hills of Kisakata, Nikaho City, flows down in many streams that seem to spring out from between moss-covered rocks. The water is underground water from snow and rain that fell on Mount Chokai and passed through the earth over many years, and the air around it stays cool even in summer. The scenery created by green moss and streams of white water is mystical.
quiz_en: The underground water springing from the mossy rocks of Mototaki Falls originally fell as snow and rain on which mountain?

name: 奈曽の白滝
addr: にかほ市象潟町小滝字大ヒド地内
desc: にかほ市象潟の金峰神社の境内にある滝で、国の名勝に指定されています。鳥海山の雪解け水を集めた奈曽川が、岩壁を白い布のように流れ落ちる姿は見事。滝つぼへ下りる石段を進むと、しぶきと轟音が迫ってきます。象潟はかつて島々が浮かぶ入り江の景勝地でした。
quiz: かつて島々が浮かぶ入り江だった象潟を訪れた松尾芭蕉の紀行文の題名は何？
desc_en: This waterfall is within the grounds of Kinpo Shrine in Kisakata, Nikaho City, and is designated a national Place of Scenic Beauty. The Naso River, gathering snowmelt from Mount Chokai, pours down the rock wall like a sheet of white cloth in a splendid sight. As you descend the stone steps to the plunge pool, spray and a thundering roar close in. Kisakata was once a scenic inlet dotted with islands.
quiz_en: What is the title of Matsuo Basho's travel journal recording his visit to Kisakata, once an inlet dotted with islands?

name: 玉川温泉
addr: 仙北市田沢湖玉川字渋黒沢
desc: 八幡平の西側の山中に湧く、強い酸性の湯で知られる温泉です。源泉からは大量の熱湯が噴き出し、周辺の地熱地帯では岩盤の上にござを敷いて体を温める人々の姿が見られます。この地には特別天然記念物の珍しい鉱物も産出し、湯治場として全国から多くの人が訪れます。
quiz: 玉川温泉で産出する、ラジウムを含むことで知られる特別天然記念物の鉱物は何？
desc_en: This hot spring in the mountains on the western side of Hachimantai is known for its strongly acidic water. A huge amount of boiling water gushes from its source, and in the surrounding geothermal area you can see people warming themselves on straw mats spread over the bedrock. A rare mineral designated a Special Natural Monument is also found here, and many people visit from all over Japan for therapeutic bathing.
quiz_en: What is the mineral found at Tamagawa Onsen, designated a Special Natural Monument and known for containing radium?

name: 乳頭温泉郷の源泉浴場群
desc: 乳頭山のふもと、ブナの森の中に個性豊かな一軒宿が点在する温泉郷です。宿ごとに源泉が異なり、白く濁った湯や透明な湯など、湯めぐりで違いを楽しめます。茅葺き屋根の古い湯治宿が残る景色は、まるで昔話の世界。雪深い冬の露天風呂も格別の趣があります。
quiz: 乳頭温泉郷で最も古い歴史を持つとされ、茅葺きの長屋と白濁の露天風呂で知られる宿は？
desc_en: This hot spring village at the foot of Mount Nyuto has distinctive single inns scattered through the beech forest. Each inn has its own spring source, so as you hop between baths you can enjoy the differences, from milky white water to clear water. The scenery of old thatched-roof spa inns looks just like a world from a folktale. Open-air baths in deep winter snow have a special charm too.
quiz_en: Which inn is said to have the oldest history in Nyuto Onsen Village, known for its thatched row house and milky open-air bath?

name: 高原・水沢温泉郷地区
addr: 仙北市田沢湖生保内字下高野・生保内字駒ヶ岳
desc: 仙北市田沢湖の、田沢湖と秋田駒ヶ岳の間の高原に広がる温泉郷です。スキー場やホテル、ペンションが集まる高原リゾートで、冬はスキー、夏は登山やハイキングの拠点としてにぎわいます。高原からは田沢湖を見下ろす眺めもよく、山の湯と高原の涼風を楽しめます。
quiz: 田沢湖高原の上にそびえ、夏は高山植物の宝庫として知られる山の名前は何？
desc_en: This hot spring area spreads across the plateau between Lake Tazawa and Mount Akita-Komagatake in Tazawako, Semboku City. It is a highland resort with ski areas, hotels and guesthouses, busy in winter with skiing and in summer as a base for climbing and hiking. The view looking down on Lake Tazawa from the highlands is also lovely, and you can enjoy mountain hot springs and cool highland breezes.
quiz_en: What is the name of the mountain that rises above the Tazawako Highlands and is known in summer as a treasure trove of alpine plants?

name: 抱返紅葉祭
addr: 仙北市田沢湖卒田字黒倉
desc: 仙北市田沢湖の抱返り渓谷で、秋の紅葉シーズンに開かれる祭りです。玉川が刻んだ渓谷には、透き通ったコバルトブルーの流れと切り立った岩壁が続き、赤や黄色の紅葉との色の対比が見事。吊り橋を渡り、渓谷沿いの遊歩道を歩けば、秋の東北らしい絶景が広がります。
quiz: 抱返り渓谷の遊歩道の先にある、思わず振り返るほど美しいことが名の由来とされる滝は？
desc_en: This festival is held during the autumn foliage season at Dakigaeri Gorge in Tazawako, Semboku City. In the gorge carved by the Tama River, a crystal-clear cobalt-blue stream and sheer rock walls continue on, and the color contrast with red and yellow autumn leaves is superb. Cross the suspension bridge and walk the trail along the gorge, and a stunning view typical of autumn in Tohoku unfolds.
quiz_en: What is the waterfall at the end of the Dakigaeri Gorge trail, said to be named for being so beautiful that people turn back to look?

name: 田沢湖
addr: 仙北市田沢湖田沢字春山・潟前・上石神
desc: 水深が日本一深い湖として知られる、ほぼ円形の湖です。湖の水は深い瑠璃色をたたえ、冬でも湖面が凍らないことで知られています。湖畔には、永遠の美しさを願って龍になったという伝説の姫をかたどった金色の像が立ち、湖の青との対比が印象的。湖畔一周のドライブもおすすめです。
quiz: 田沢湖のほとりに立つ金色の像は、湖に伝わる伝説の何という姫の姿でしょう？
desc_en: This nearly circular lake is known as the deepest lake in Japan. Its water holds a deep lapis-lazuli blue, and it is known for not freezing over even in winter. On the shore stands a golden statue modeled on a legendary princess who is said to have become a dragon in her wish for eternal beauty, creating a striking contrast with the lake's blue. A drive around the lake is also recommended.
quiz_en: The golden statue on the shore of Lake Tazawa depicts a princess from the lake's legend. What is her name?

name: 十和田湖
addr: 鹿角郡小坂町十和田湖
desc: 青森との県境にまたがる十和田湖の、秋田県小坂町側の湖畔です。湖を見下ろす発荷峠の展望台からは、外輪山に囲まれた湖と半島が織りなす雄大な眺めが広がります。湖にはヒメマスが放流され、湖畔の名物料理として味わえます。秋の紅葉に包まれた湖の景色は格別です。
quiz: 十和田湖で、苦労の末にヒメマスの養殖を成功させたことで知られる人物は誰？
desc_en: This is the lakeshore on the Kosaka Town side, Akita Prefecture, of Lake Towada, which straddles the border with Aomori. From the Hakka Pass observatory overlooking the lake, a grand view unfolds of the lake and peninsulas surrounded by the outer caldera rim. Himemasu (kokanee salmon) have been released into the lake and can be enjoyed as a local specialty. The lake wrapped in autumn leaves is exceptional.
quiz_en: Who is the person known for succeeding, after great hardship, in farming himemasu kokanee salmon in Lake Towada?

name: 藤里峡
addr: 藤里町藤琴字藤琴沢国有林内・藤里町藤琴字滝の沢地内・藤里町粕毛字南鹿瀬内地内
desc: 白神山地の秋田県側の玄関口、藤里町の山あいに広がる渓谷です。清らかな流れに沿ってブナを中心とした深い森が続き、新緑の季節には瑞々しい緑が、秋には色とりどりの紅葉が谷を染め上げます。水音と鳥の声に包まれながら歩けば、世界自然遺産の森へと続く豊かな自然の気配を間近に感じられます。
quiz: 藤里峡の渓谷沿いを歩くなら、新緑と紅葉、あなたはどちらの季節に訪れたい？
desc_en: This gorge spreads through the mountains of Fujisato Town, the Akita-side gateway to the Shirakami Mountains. Deep forests, mostly of beech, line its clear stream, with fresh green foliage in early summer and colorful autumn leaves dyeing the valley in fall. Walking amid the sound of water and birdsong, you can feel up close the rich nature that leads on to the World Natural Heritage forest.
quiz_en: If you walked along Fujisato Gorge, which season would you rather visit: the fresh greenery of early summer or the autumn foliage?

name: 森岳温泉郷
addr: 三種町森岳字木戸沢内
desc: 三種町の森岳地区に湧く温泉郷で、田園と里山に囲まれたのどかな湯の里です。旅館や日帰り施設が点在し、地元の人々にも親しまれてきました。三種町はじゅんさいの産地として全国に知られ、初夏にはつるりとした食感の摘みたてを味わえます。湯上がりに田んぼを渡る風を感じるのも格別です。
quiz: 三種町が産地として知られる、ぬめりのある水草の食材は何でしょう？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) village in the Moritake district of Mitane Town is a peaceful spa retreat surrounded by rice fields and wooded hills. Inns and day-use bathing facilities dot the area, and it has long been loved by locals. Mitane is known nationwide for producing junsai (water shield), and in early summer you can taste freshly picked shoots with their smooth, slippery texture. Feeling the breeze across the rice paddies after a bath is a special pleasure.
quiz_en: What slippery aquatic plant, eaten as a delicacy, is Mitane Town known throughout Japan for producing?

name: 尼子岩・白瀑神社
desc: 日本海に面した八峰町八森に鎮座する白瀑神社は、社殿の背後に白い滝が流れ落ちる神秘的な神社です。近くの海辺には尼子岩と呼ばれる岩があり、日本海の荒波が打ち寄せる海岸線とともに独特の景観をつくっています。山の滝と海の岩、両方の表情を一度に味わえるのがこの地の魅力です。
quiz: 八峰町の白瀑神社で、社殿の背後を白く流れ落ちているものは何でしょう？
desc_en: Standing in Hachimori, Happo Town, facing the Sea of Japan, Shirataki Shrine is a mystical shrine with a white waterfall cascading behind its main hall. On the nearby shore is a rock called Amako Rock, which, together with a coastline battered by the rough waves of the Sea of Japan, creates a distinctive landscape. The charm of this place is that you can enjoy both a mountain waterfall and a seaside rock at once.
quiz_en: At Shirataki Shrine in Happo Town, what is it that flows down in a white stream behind the main hall?

name: 留山
addr: 八峰町八森字水の目地内
desc: 八峰町の山中にある留山は、白神山地の一角に連なるブナの森です。「留山」とはかつて木の伐採を禁じた山を指す言葉で、その名のとおり人の手があまり入らずに守られてきた森の姿を今に伝えています。苔むした倒木やブナの大木の間を歩けば、ひんやりとした空気と深い静けさに包まれます。
quiz: 留山のブナの森を歩いたら、どんな音や香りがいちばん印象に残りましたか？
desc_en: Tomeyama, in the mountains of Happo Town, is a beech forest that forms part of the Shirakami Mountains. The name Tomeyama refers to a mountain where tree felling was once prohibited, and true to its name, the forest has been protected with little human interference and still shows its original form. Walking among moss-covered fallen trees and giant beeches, you are enveloped in cool air and deep silence.
quiz_en: If you walked through the beech forest of Tomeyama, which sounds or scents do you think would stay with you the most?

name: 白瀑神社例大祭
desc: 八峰町八森の白瀑神社で夏に行われる例大祭です。担ぎ手たちが神輿とともに社殿裏の滝へ入っていく勇壮な姿で知られ、水しぶきを浴びながら進む神輿に見物客から大きな歓声が上がります。日本海沿いの小さな漁師町が一年でいちばん熱くなる日で、町の人々の祈りと活気が伝わってきます。
quiz: 白瀑神社例大祭で、神輿が担ぎ手とともに入っていく場所はどこでしょう？
desc_en: This grand annual festival is held in summer at Shirataki Shrine in Hachimori, Happo Town. It is known for the dramatic sight of bearers carrying a mikoshi (portable shrine) into the waterfall behind the shrine hall, and the crowd cheers loudly as the mikoshi advances through the spray. It is the day this small fishing town on the Sea of Japan comes most alive, conveying the prayers and energy of its people.
quiz_en: During the Shirataki Shrine Annual Festival, where do the bearers carry the mikoshi, or portable shrine, together with them?

name: 蔵王温泉の酸性泉と源泉浴場群
desc: 蔵王連峰の西麓、標高の高い山あいに広がる蔵王温泉は、強い酸性の硫黄泉で知られる東北屈指の名湯です。温泉街には地元の人も通う共同浴場が点在し、湯けむりと硫黄の香りが漂います。冬はスキーと樹氷観賞の拠点としてにぎわい、雪景色の中で浸かる湯は格別です。
quiz: 蔵王温泉の湯の特徴としてよく知られる泉質は、何性の硫黄泉でしょう？
name_en: Zao Onsen Acidic Springs and Public Baths
desc_en: Spreading across high mountain terrain at the western foot of the Zao mountain range, Zao Onsen is one of the finest hot springs in Tohoku, known for its strongly acidic sulfur water. Public bathhouses also used by locals dot the onsen town, where steam and the scent of sulfur drift through the air. In winter it bustles as a base for skiing and viewing rime-ice trees, and a soak amid the snowy scenery is exceptional.
quiz_en: In terms of its chemical character, what kind of sulfur spring is the water of Zao Onsen best known for being?

name: 花笠まつり
desc: 毎年8月上旬に山形市の中心街で開かれる花笠まつりは、東北を代表する夏祭りのひとつです。紅花をあしらった花笠を手にした大勢の踊り手が、威勢のよい掛け声とともに通りを埋め尽くします。笠をくるりと回す華やかな群舞と花笠太鼓の響きが、夏の夜の街を熱気で包みます。
quiz: 花笠まつりで踊り手たちが声をそろえる掛け声は「ヤッショ、」何でしょう？
desc_en: Held every year in early August in central Yamagata City, the Hanagasa Festival is one of Tohoku's leading summer festivals. Large numbers of dancers holding hanagasa, hats decorated with safflowers, fill the streets with spirited chants. The colorful group dance, with hats twirled in unison, and the boom of hanagasa drums wrap the summer night in excitement.
quiz_en: At the Hanagasa Festival, the dancers shout a chant in unison that begins with 'Yassho.' What word follows it in the chant?

name: 立石寺（山寺）
desc: 山寺の名で親しまれる立石寺は、平安時代に慈覚大師円仁が開いたと伝わる天台宗の古刹です。奇岩がそそり立つ山肌に堂宇が点在し、千段を超える石段を登った先の五大堂からは山あいの集落を一望できます。松尾芭蕉が『おくのほそ道』の旅で名句を詠んだ地としても知られています。
quiz: 芭蕉が山寺で詠んだ「閑さや岩にしみ入る」の後に続く言葉は何でしょう？
desc_en: Affectionately known as Yamadera, or mountain temple, Risshaku-ji is an ancient Tendai Buddhist temple said to have been founded in the Heian period by the priest Ennin (Jikaku Daishi). Halls are scattered across a mountainside of towering rocks, and from the Godaido Hall, reached after climbing more than a thousand stone steps, you can look out over the villages in the valley. It is also known as the place where Matsuo Basho composed a famous haiku on his journey of The Narrow Road to the Deep North.
quiz_en: Basho's haiku at Yamadera begins 'Ah, this stillness, sinking into the rocks...' What words complete the famous poem?

name: 出羽三山神社
addr: 鶴岡市羽黒町手向字手向7
desc: 羽黒山・月山・湯殿山の三山からなる出羽三山は、古くから修験道の霊場として信仰を集めてきました。羽黒山頂の三神合祭殿には三山の神々が祀られ、参道の杉並木の中には国宝の羽黒山五重塔が静かに立っています。白装束の山伏が行き交う姿に、今も続く山岳信仰の息づかいを感じます。
quiz: 出羽三山を構成する三つの山は、羽黒山・月山と、もう一つは何山でしょう？
desc_en: Dewa Sanzan, made up of the three sacred mountains of Haguro, Gassan and Yudono, has long drawn worship as a center of Shugendo, a form of mountain asceticism. The Sanjin Gosaiden hall atop Mount Haguro enshrines the deities of all three mountains, and the Haguro Five-Story Pagoda, a National Treasure, stands quietly among the cedars lining the approach. Seeing yamabushi (mountain ascetics) in white robes passing by, you can sense mountain worship still alive today.
quiz_en: The Dewa Sanzan are Mount Haguro, Mount Gassan and one more sacred peak. What is the name of the third mountain?

name: 月山
desc: 出羽三山の主峰である月山は、なだらかな山容が印象的な信仰の山です。豪雪地帯にあるため春から初夏まで雪が残り、夏スキーが楽しめる山としても知られています。雪解け後の山肌には高山植物が咲き広がり、山頂には月山神社が祀られています。庄内平野から仰ぐ穏やかな姿も魅力です。
quiz: 出羽三山の主峰・月山の山頂に祀られている神社の名前は何でしょう？
desc_en: Mount Gassan, the main peak of the Dewa Sanzan, is a sacred mountain with a strikingly gentle profile. Located in an area of very heavy snowfall, it keeps its snow from spring into early summer and is also known as a mountain where you can enjoy summer skiing. After the snow melts, alpine flowers spread across its slopes, and Gassan Shrine stands at the summit. Its calm silhouette seen from the Shonai Plain is also part of its appeal.
quiz_en: What is the name of the shrine enshrined at the summit of Mount Gassan, the main peak of the Dewa Sanzan?

name: 最上川
addr: 酒田市・庄内町・戸沢村
desc: 山形県のほぼ全域を流れて日本海へ注ぐ最上川は、日本三大急流のひとつに数えられる母なる川です。戸沢村あたりでは両岸に山が迫り、船頭の舟唄を聞きながら下る舟下りが人気です。下流の酒田は川と海の舟運で栄えた港町で、松尾芭蕉もこの川の流れの速さを句に詠みました。
quiz: 芭蕉の句「五月雨をあつめて早し」の後に続く言葉は何でしょう？
area_en: Sakata City, Shonai Town and Tozawa Village
desc_en: Flowing through nearly all of Yamagata Prefecture before emptying into the Sea of Japan, the Mogami River is a mother river counted among Japan's three fastest-flowing rivers. Around Tozawa Village, mountains close in on both banks, and boat trips down the river while listening to the boatman's songs are popular. Sakata, downstream, is a port town that prospered on river and sea shipping, and Matsuo Basho also wrote a haiku about the swiftness of this river's current.
quiz_en: Basho wrote a haiku beginning 'Gathering the rains of early summer, how swift...' What words complete this famous poem?

name: 蔵王の樹氷
desc: 冬の蔵王の山上では、アオモリトドマツに雪と氷が吹きつけられて巨大な樹氷が生まれます。その姿から「スノーモンスター」とも呼ばれ、見渡す限りの白い怪物たちが並ぶ光景は世界的にも珍しいものです。ロープウェイで山頂付近へ上がれば間近に眺められ、夜にはライトアップも行われます。
quiz: 蔵王の樹氷は、その不思議な姿から英語で「スノー」何と呼ばれているでしょう？
desc_en: In winter on the upper slopes of Zao, snow and ice are blown onto Maries' fir trees to form giant rime-covered trees. Because of their appearance they are also called snow monsters, and the sight of white monsters lined up as far as the eye can see is rare even by world standards. Taking the ropeway up near the summit lets you view them up close, and they are also illuminated at night.
quiz_en: Would you rather see Zao's snow monsters up close in the daytime or under the special illuminations at night?

name: 銀山温泉の旅館街と共同浴場群
desc: 銀山川の両岸に木造の多層旅館が建ち並ぶ銀山温泉は、大正ロマンの面影を残す温泉街です。その名は江戸時代に栄えた延沢銀山に由来します。夕暮れになるとガス灯がともり、雪の積もる冬の夜景は幻想的な美しさです。川沿いの共同浴場や足湯で、のんびりと湯めぐりを楽しめます。
quiz: 銀山温泉の夜、川沿いの旅館街を柔らかく照らす明かりは何でしょう？
name_en: Ginzan Onsen Inn Town and Public Baths
desc_en: With multistory wooden inns lining both banks of the Ginzan River, Ginzan Onsen is a hot spring town that retains the romantic atmosphere of the Taisho era. Its name comes from the Nobesawa Silver Mine, which flourished in the Edo period. At dusk the gas lamps are lit, and on snowy winter nights the scene is magically beautiful. You can leisurely hop between the riverside public baths and footbaths.
quiz_en: At night in Ginzan Onsen, what kind of lights softly illuminate the streets of inns along the river?

name: 飯豊山
desc: 山形・福島・新潟の三県にまたがる飯豊連峰の主峰で、山形県側の小国町は登山口のひとつです。豪雪がつくる残雪の雪渓が夏まで残り、稜線にはお花畑が広がります。山深く奥行きのある連峰は、何日もかけて縦走する登山者に愛されてきました。麓の小国町はブナの森と清流に恵まれた町です。
quiz: 飯豊連峰の稜線を歩くなら、残雪の雪渓とお花畑、どちらを一番に見たい？
desc_en: Mount Iide is the main peak of the Iide mountain range, which straddles Yamagata, Fukushima and Niigata prefectures, and Oguni Town on the Yamagata side is one of its trailheads. Snowfields formed by heavy snowfall linger into summer, and flower meadows spread along the ridges. The deep, extensive range has long been loved by hikers who traverse it over several days. Oguni at its foot is a town blessed with beech forests and clear streams.
quiz_en: If you hiked the ridges of the Iide range, which would you most want to see: lingering snowfields or alpine flower meadows?

name: 鳥海山
desc: 山形と秋田の県境にそびえる鳥海山は、日本海のすぐそばから立ち上がる独立峰です。その美しい姿から「出羽富士」とも呼ばれ、遊佐町の田園からは水田に映る山影を眺められます。山麓には伏流水が湧き出す場所が多く、豊かな水が庄内の米づくりを支えています。
quiz: 鳥海山の山頂に本殿を構え、山そのものを神として祀る神社は何でしょう？
desc_en: Rising on the border of Yamagata and Akita, Mount Chokai is a solitary peak that soars up right beside the Sea of Japan. Its beautiful shape has earned it the nickname Dewa Fuji, and from the farmland of Yuza Town you can see its reflection in the flooded rice paddies. Many springs of underground water emerge around its foothills, and this abundant water supports rice growing in the Shonai region.
quiz_en: What is the name of the shrine whose main sanctuary stands at the summit of Mount Chokai and worships the mountain itself as a deity?

name: 若松城（鶴ヶ城）
desc: 会津若松のシンボル鶴ヶ城は、戊辰戦争で新政府軍の攻撃に約1か月耐えた名城です。現在の天守は昭和に再建されたもので、のちに屋根瓦が幕末当時の赤瓦に葺き替えられました。春には城跡を約千本の桜が彩り、白壁と赤瓦、桜の取り合わせが見事です。天守内は郷土博物館になっています。
quiz: 会津若松の鶴ヶ城、現在の天守の屋根に葺かれている瓦は何色でしょう？
desc_en: Tsuruga Castle, the symbol of Aizuwakamatsu, is a famous castle that withstood about a month of attacks by the new government army during the Boshin War. The current keep was rebuilt in the Showa era, and its roof tiles were later replaced with red tiles like those of the late Edo period. In spring, about a thousand cherry trees adorn the castle grounds, creating a splendid combination of white walls, red tiles and blossoms. Inside the keep is a local history museum.
quiz_en: What color are the tiles covering the roof of the present-day keep of Tsuruga Castle in Aizuwakamatsu, Fukushima?

name: 飯豊山
desc: 喜多方市の山都町一ノ木は、飯豊山へ向かう福島県側の登山口のひとつです。飯豊山は古くから信仰の山として崇められ、かつては地元の若者が成人の証として登拝する習わしもありました。深い山並みと残雪の稜線は雄大そのもの。下山後は蔵の町喜多方で名物のラーメンを味わうのも楽しみです。
quiz: 飯豊山の登山を終えたら、麓の喜多方で食べたい名物は何ですか？
desc_en: Ichinoki in the Yamato district of Kitakata City is one of the Fukushima-side trailheads for Mount Iide. The mountain has long been revered as sacred, and there was once a custom in which local young men climbed it to worship as proof of reaching adulthood. Its deep ranges and snow-streaked ridges are truly majestic. After descending, a treat awaits in the storehouse town of Kitakata, where you can enjoy its famous ramen.
quiz_en: After finishing a climb of Mount Iide, what local specialty would you want to eat in Kitakata at the foot of the mountain?

name: 相馬野馬追
desc: 相馬地方に千年以上続くとされる相馬野馬追は、甲冑に身を包んだ数百騎の騎馬武者が集う勇壮な祭りです。旗指物をなびかせた武者行列、甲冑競馬、空に打ち上げられた御神旗を奪い合う神旗争奪戦と、戦国絵巻のような光景が繰り広げられます。国の重要無形民俗文化財にも指定されています。
quiz: 相馬野馬追で、打ち上げられた御神旗を騎馬武者が奪い合う行事を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: Said to have continued in the Soma region for more than a thousand years, Soma Nomaoi is a thrilling festival that gathers several hundred mounted warriors clad in armor. Processions of warriors with banners streaming from their backs, armored horse races, and the Shinki Sodatsusen, in which riders compete for sacred flags launched into the sky, unfold like a scene from a Sengoku-era picture scroll. It is designated an Important Intangible Folk Cultural Property of Japan.
quiz_en: At Soma Nomaoi, what is the event called in which mounted warriors compete to seize sacred flags launched into the sky?

name: 大内宿
desc: 江戸時代に会津と日光方面を結ぶ街道の宿場として栄えた大内宿は、茅葺き屋根の民家が街道沿いに整然と並ぶ集落です。国の重要伝統的建造物群保存地区に選定され、往時の宿場の面影がそのまま残ります。名物は長ねぎ1本を箸の代わりにして食べるそばで、冬の雪景色の宿場も趣があります。
quiz: 大内宿の名物そばを食べるとき、箸の代わりに使うものは何でしょう？
desc_en: Ouchi-juku flourished in the Edo period as a post town on the road linking Aizu with the Nikko area, and its thatched-roof houses stand in neat rows along the old road.
