It is known as the birthplace of the song Yukiyama Sanka (Ode to the Snowy Mountains), said to have been written by mountaineer Nishibori Eizaburo and others who once visited, and a monument stands here. In winter it is blanketed in snow, and warming up in the water at a lodge-like inn is exceptional.
quiz_en: What song, much loved by mountain climbers in Japan, is Kazawa Onsen known as the birthplace of?

name: 浅間高原
desc: 浅間山の北麓、嬬恋村に広がる浅間高原は、冷涼な気候を生かしたキャベツ畑が見渡す限り続く高原です。嬬恋村は夏秋キャベツの一大産地として知られ、夏には緑の畑が波打つように広がります。高原の向こうには浅間山がそびえ、澄んだ空気の中のドライブや散策が気持ちよい場所です。
quiz: 嬬恋村の浅間高原に広がる畑で、夏から秋に収穫される名産の野菜は何？
desc_en: Spreading across Tsumagoi Village at the northern foot of Mount Asama, the Asama Highlands are a plateau where cabbage fields, taking advantage of the cool climate, stretch as far as the eye can see. Tsumagoi is known as a major producer of summer and autumn cabbage, and in summer the green fields spread out like waves. Mount Asama towers beyond the highlands, making this a pleasant place for drives and walks in the clear air.
quiz_en: What famous vegetable, harvested from summer to autumn, grows in the fields spreading across the Asama Highlands of Tsumagoi?

name: 草津温泉
desc: 草津温泉は自然湧出量が日本一ともいわれる名湯で、温泉街の中心には湯けむりを上げる「湯畑」があります。熱い源泉を木の樋に通して冷ます湯畑の光景は草津の象徴です。熱い湯を板でかき混ぜて冷ます「湯もみ」の実演も名物で、夜には湯畑がライトアップされ幻想的な雰囲気に包まれます。
quiz: 草津温泉で、熱い湯を長い板でかき混ぜて冷ますことを何と呼ぶでしょう？
desc_en: Kusatsu Onsen is a renowned hot spring said to have the largest natural flow in Japan, and at the center of the town is the steaming Yubatake, or hot water field. The sight of the Yubatake, where hot spring water is cooled as it runs through wooden channels, is the symbol of Kusatsu. Demonstrations of yumomi, stirring hot water with boards to cool it, are a specialty, and at night the Yubatake is illuminated, wrapping it in a magical atmosphere.
quiz_en: At Kusatsu Onsen, what is the practice of stirring the hot water with long wooden boards to cool it called?

name: 吾妻渓谷温泉郷
desc: 東吾妻町の吾妻渓谷は、吾妻川が深く刻んだ渓谷で、「関東の耶馬渓」とも呼ばれる紅葉の名所です。渓谷の周辺には温泉が点在し、八ッ場ダムの建設に伴って移転した川原湯温泉もそのひとつです。秋には切り立った岩壁を紅葉が彩り、渓谷美と湯めぐりを同時に楽しめます。
quiz: 吾妻渓谷は、その渓谷美から「関東の」何と呼ばれているでしょう？
desc_en: Agatsuma Gorge in Higashiagatsuma Town is a valley carved deep by the Agatsuma River and a famous spot for autumn leaves, also called the Yabakei of Kanto. Hot springs dot the area around the gorge, including Kawarayu Onsen, which was relocated due to the construction of Yamba Dam. In autumn, colorful leaves adorn the sheer rock walls, so you can enjoy the beauty of the gorge and hot spring hopping at the same time.
quiz_en: Agatsuma Gorge is nicknamed after a famous gorge elsewhere in Japan, as 'the ___ of Kanto.' Which gorge fills the blank?

name: 尾瀬ヶ原
desc: 尾瀬ヶ原の群馬県側、片品村の鳩待峠は尾瀬への代表的な入口です。湿原の西には蛇紋岩でできた至仏山がそびえ、東の燧ヶ岳とともに尾瀬ヶ原を見守っています。夏にはニッコウキスゲの黄色い花が湿原を彩り、どこまでも続く木道を歩けば、池塘に映る空と山の美しさに心洗われます。
quiz: 尾瀬ヶ原の西にそびえる、蛇紋岩でできた山の名前は何でしょう？
desc_en: Hatomachi Pass in Katashina Village, on the Gunma side of Ozegahara, is the main gateway to Oze. To the west of the marsh rises Mount Shibutsu, made of serpentinite, which together with Mount Hiuchigatake to the east watches over Ozegahara. In summer, the yellow flowers of Nikko day lilies color the marsh, and as you walk the endless boardwalks, the beauty of the sky and mountains reflected in the ponds refreshes your soul.
quiz_en: What is the name of the mountain made of serpentinite that rises to the west of the Ozegahara marsh?

name: 丸沼高原
desc: 片品村の丸沼高原は、日光白根山の西麓に広がる高原リゾートです。冬はスキー場としてにぎわい、夏は山頂駅へ向かうロープウェイで標高2000メートル付近まで上がれます。山頂駅周辺からは日光白根山や周囲の山々を望め、高原の涼しい風の中で散策や足湯を楽しめます。
quiz: 丸沼高原のロープウェイの先にそびえる、群馬と栃木の境の山は何でしょう？
desc_en: Marunuma Kogen in Katashina Village is a highland resort at the western foot of Mount Nikko-Shirane. In winter it bustles as a ski area, and in summer a ropeway takes you up to the summit station at around 2,000 meters above sea level. From around the summit station you can view Mount Nikko-Shirane and the surrounding mountains, and enjoy walks and a footbath in the cool highland breeze.
quiz_en: Which mountain on the border of Gunma and Tochigi towers beyond the top of the Marunuma Highlands ropeway?

name: 土出温泉
desc: 片品村の土出温泉は、尾瀬へ向かう道筋にある山あいの温泉です。片品川の上流域にあたり、周囲には高原の畑や森が広がります。尾瀬の湿原歩きを終えたあとに疲れた足を湯で癒すのにぴったりの場所で、夏の夜には澄んだ空に満天の星が広がります。
quiz: 尾瀬ハイキングのあと、土出温泉の湯に浸かりながら思い出す景色は何ですか？
desc_en: Tsuchiide Onsen in Katashina Village is a mountain hot spring on the route to Oze. It lies in the upper reaches of the Katashina River, surrounded by highland fields and forests. It is a perfect place to soothe tired legs in the water after a walk across the Oze marshes, and on summer nights a sky full of stars spreads across the clear air.
quiz_en: After hiking in Oze, what scenery would you recall while soaking in the hot water at Tsuchiide Onsen?

name: 鎌田温泉
desc: 片品村鎌田の温泉で、村の中心部に近く、尾瀬や丸沼方面への分岐点にあたります。片品川沿いの集落には民宿や旅館が点在し、素朴な山里の雰囲気が残ります。片品村はとうもろこしの産地としても知られ、夏には甘い焼きとうもろこしを味わいながらの湯めぐりが楽しめます。
quiz: 片品村の夏の名物として知られる、甘くて香ばしい野菜は何でしょう？
desc_en: This hot spring in the Kamata area of Katashina Village is near the center of the village, at the junction of roads toward Oze and Marunuma. Guesthouses and inns dot the settlement along the Katashina River, which retains the rustic atmosphere of a mountain village. Katashina is also known for its corn, and in summer you can enjoy hopping between hot springs while savoring sweet grilled corn.
quiz_en: What sweet and fragrant vegetable, often enjoyed grilled, is known as a summer specialty of Katashina Village in Gunma?

name: 花咲温泉
desc: 片品村の花咲温泉は、武尊山の麓に広がる花咲の集落にある温泉です。名前のとおり花を思わせる美しい響きの地名で、春から夏にかけては周囲の山里に草花が咲き誇ります。冬には近隣のスキー場への拠点ともなり、雪景色の中で温まる湯は旅の疲れをじんわりとほぐしてくれます。
quiz: 花咲温泉の麓からそびえる、群馬県北部の百名山は何という山でしょう？
desc_en: Hanasaku Onsen is a hot spring in the Hanasaku settlement spreading at the foot of Mount Hotaka in Katashina Village. True to its beautiful-sounding name, meaning blooming flowers, wildflowers bloom in profusion around the mountain village from spring to summer. In winter it also serves as a base for nearby ski areas, and warming up in the water amid the snowy scenery gently eases the fatigue of travel.
quiz_en: Which of Japan's 100 Famous Mountains in northern Gunma rises above the foothills where Hanasaku Onsen lies?

name: 水上温泉
desc: みなかみ町の水上温泉は、利根川の上流に開けた群馬を代表する温泉地です。谷川岳をはじめとする山々に囲まれ、春から秋にかけては利根川の急流でラフティングなどのアウトドアが盛んです。川沿いに旅館が建ち並び、渓谷を眺めながらの露天風呂も魅力です。
quiz: 水上温泉の近くで人気の、ゴムボートで川の急流を下るアクティビティは何？
desc_en: Minakami Onsen in Minakami Town is one of Gunma's leading hot spring areas, developed along the upper reaches of the Tone River. Surrounded by mountains including Mount Tanigawa, it is a lively place for outdoor activities such as rafting on the rapids of the Tone from spring to autumn. Inns line the river, and open-air baths overlooking the gorge are another attraction.
quiz_en: What activity, popular near Minakami Onsen, involves riding down the river rapids in an inflatable rubber boat?

name: 上牧温泉
desc: みなかみ町の上牧温泉は、利根川の清流沿いに湧く落ち着いた温泉地です。JR上越線の駅からも近く、谷川岳方面への旅の途中に立ち寄るのにも便利です。川の流れと山並みを望む宿で、四季折々の景色を眺めながらゆったりと湯に浸かれば、旅の疲れもすっかり癒されます。
quiz: 上牧温泉で利根川の流れを眺めながら、湯上がりに飲みたいものは何ですか？
desc_en: Kamimoku Onsen in Minakami Town is a calm hot spring area along the clear Tone River. It is close to a station on the JR Joetsu Line, making it convenient to stop by on a trip toward Mount Tanigawa. At inns overlooking the river and mountains, soaking at leisure while viewing the seasonal scenery will completely heal the fatigue of your travels.
quiz_en: While watching the flow of the Tone River at Kamimoku Onsen, what would you like to drink after your bath?

name: 玉村八幡宮
desc: 玉村町下新田にある玉村八幡宮は、利根川と烏川に挟まれた平野の町の鎮守です。木々に囲まれた境内には歴史を感じさせる社殿が建ち、地元の人々から厚く信仰されてきました。広い関東平野の中にあって、杜に一歩踏み入れると空気が変わるような落ち着いた雰囲気に包まれます。
quiz: 玉村八幡宮のような町の鎮守にお参りするとき、あなたが必ずすることは何？
desc_en: Tamamura Hachimangu in the Shimoshinden area of Tamamura Town is the guardian shrine of a town on the plain between the Tone and Karasu rivers. In grounds surrounded by trees stand shrine buildings that convey a sense of history, and the shrine has been deeply revered by local people. Amid the wide Kanto Plain, stepping into the shrine forest, you are enveloped in a calm atmosphere, as if the air itself has changed.
quiz_en: When you visit a local guardian shrine like Tamamura Hachimangu, what is the one thing you always do?

name: 高鳥天満宮
desc: 板倉町大高嶋にある高鳥天満宮は、学問の神様として菅原道真公を祀る天満宮です。板倉町は渡良瀬遊水地に近い水郷地帯で、低地に暮らす人々は水害に備えた「水塚」と呼ばれる高台の蔵を築いてきました。受験シーズンには合格を願う参拝者も訪れます。
quiz: 天満宮に祀られている、学問の神様として知られる人物は誰でしょう？
desc_en: Takatori Tenmangu in the Otakashima area of Itakura Town is a Tenmangu shrine dedicated to Sugawara no Michizane as the god of learning. Itakura is a waterside region near the Watarase Retarding Basin, and people living in the lowlands have built mizuka, storehouses on raised ground, to prepare for floods. During entrance exam season, worshippers also come to pray for success.
quiz_en: Who is the historical figure enshrined at Tenmangu shrines across Japan and known as the god of learning?

name: 光恩寺 初詣・春秋不動尊大祭
desc: 千代田町赤岩の光恩寺は、利根川のほとりにある古刹です。初詣や春と秋の不動尊大祭の日には多くの参拝者でにぎわい、境内に露店が並んで活気に包まれます。近くには利根川を渡って埼玉県側と結ぶ渡し船が今も残り、川の町ならではの風景にも出会えます。
quiz: 千代田町赤岩の近くに残る、利根川を渡る昔ながらの交通手段は何でしょう？
name_en: Koon-ji Temple New Year and Fudo Festivals
desc_en: Koon-ji in the Akaiwa area of Chiyoda Town is an ancient temple on the banks of the Tone River. On days such as hatsumode, the first visit of the New Year, and the spring and autumn grand festivals of Fudo Myoo, it bustles with worshippers, and stalls line the grounds, filling them with energy. Nearby, a ferry that crosses the Tone River to the Saitama side still operates, offering scenery unique to a river town.
quiz_en: What traditional means of transportation for crossing the Tone River still survives near Akaiwa in Chiyoda Town?

name: 農業祭
desc: さいたま市北区見沼で開かれる農業祭は、地元の農産物の魅力を伝える祭りです。新鮮な野菜や果物、植木などが並び、生産者と直接言葉を交わしながら買い物を楽しめます。さいたま市の見沼周辺には首都圏に残る貴重な緑地が広がり、都市近郊農業の豊かさを実感できます。
quiz: 農業祭で新鮮な野菜を買うなら、あなたが真っ先に手に取るのは何ですか？
desc_en: Held in the Minuma area of Kita Ward, Saitama City, this agricultural festival showcases the appeal of local farm produce. Fresh vegetables, fruit, garden plants and more are on offer, and you can enjoy shopping while chatting directly with the growers. The Minuma area of Saitama City holds valuable green space remaining in the Tokyo metropolitan area, letting you feel the richness of farming on the edge of the city.
quiz_en: If you bought fresh vegetables at an agricultural festival, which one would you reach for first?

name: 鉄道博物館
addr: さいたま市大宮区大成町3-47
desc: さいたま市大宮区の鉄道博物館は、JR東日本の創立20周年記念事業として開館した鉄道の総合博物館です。歴代の蒸気機関車や新幹線などの実物車両がずらりと並び、運転シミュレーターなどの体験展示も充実しています。展示室中央の転車台では、車両がゆっくりと回転する様子を見られます。
quiz: 鉄道博物館の展示室中央にある、車両の向きを変える回転台を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: The Railway Museum in Omiya Ward, Saitama City, is a comprehensive railway museum opened as a project marking the 20th anniversary of JR East's founding. Actual vehicles, from generations of steam locomotives to shinkansen bullet trains, are lined up, and hands-on exhibits such as driving simulators are plentiful. On the turntable in the center of the exhibition hall, you can watch a train slowly rotate.
quiz_en: What is the rotating platform in the center of the Railway Museum's exhibition hall, used to change a train's direction, called?

name: 秋ケ瀬公園
desc: さいたま市桜区の秋ケ瀬公園は、荒川の河川敷に広がる広大な公園です。豊かな樹林や広い芝生、運動施設があり、休日には多くの人がバーベキューやスポーツを楽しみます。近くには国の特別天然記念物「田島ケ原サクラソウ自生地」があり、春には可憐なサクラソウが咲きます。
quiz: 秋ケ瀬公園の近くで春に咲く、国の特別天然記念物にもなっている花は何？
desc_en: Akigase Park in Sakura Ward, Saitama City, is a vast park spreading across the floodplain of the Arakawa River. With rich woodland, wide lawns and sports facilities, it draws many people on holidays for barbecues and sports. Nearby is the Tajimagahara Primrose Habitat, a national Special Natural Monument, where delicate Japanese primroses bloom in spring.
quiz_en: Which flower, blooming in spring near Akigase Park, grows in a habitat designated a national Special Natural Monument?

name: 川越の街並み
desc: 「小江戸」と呼ばれる川越には、江戸時代から明治にかけて建てられた重厚な蔵造りの商家が建ち並びます。明治の大火のあと、燃えにくい蔵造りの建物が多く建てられ、今の町並みになりました。町のシンボル「時の鐘」は今も時を告げ、近くの菓子屋横丁では懐かしい駄菓子が楽しめます。
quiz: 川越の蔵造りの町並みで、今も一日数回時を告げる鐘楼は何と呼ばれる？
desc_en: Kawagoe, known as Little Edo, is lined with stately kurazukuri, storehouse-style merchant houses, built from the Edo period through the Meiji era. After a great fire in the Meiji era, many fire-resistant storehouse-style buildings were built, creating today's townscape. The town's symbol, the Toki no Kane bell tower, still tolls the hours, and nearby Kashiya Yokocho, or Candy Alley, offers nostalgic traditional sweets.
quiz_en: In Kawagoe's townscape of storehouse buildings, what is the bell tower that still tolls the time several times a day called?

name: 川越水上公園
desc: 川越市池辺にある川越水上公園は、夏には大型のプールがにぎわう公園です。流れるプールや波のプールなどで水遊びを楽しむ家族連れの歓声が響き、夏の定番レジャースポットとなっています。プールの季節以外も広い芝生や池があり、釣りや散策を楽しめる憩いの場です。
quiz: 夏の水上公園で、あなたが一番好きなプールはどんなプールですか？
desc_en: Kawagoe Water Park in the Ikenobe area of Kawagoe City is a park whose large pools bustle in summer. The cheers of families enjoying the lazy river, the wave pool and more ring out, making it a classic summer leisure spot. Outside the pool season, too, it has wide lawns and a pond, offering a relaxing place for fishing and strolling.
quiz_en: On a hot summer day at a water park like this one, which kind of pool do you enjoy the most?

name: めぬまラドン温泉
desc: 熊谷市江波にあるめぬまラドン温泉は、利根川に近い妻沼地区の温泉施設です。妻沼は国宝の歓喜院聖天堂（妻沼聖天山）で知られる門前町で、聖天さまへのお参りと合わせて立ち寄るのもおすすめです。夏の暑さで知られる熊谷ですが、湯上がりには利根川の土手を渡る風が心地よく感じられます。
quiz: 熊谷市妻沼にある、国宝の本殿で知られる寺の通称は何でしょう？
desc_en: Menuma Radon Onsen, in the Enami area of Kumagaya City, is a hot spring facility in the Menuma district near the Tone River. Menuma is a temple town known for the Kangiin Shoden-do (Menuma Shoden-zan), a National Treasure, and it is recommended to stop by in combination with a visit to the temple. Kumagaya is known for its summer heat, but after your bath, the breeze blowing over the Tone River embankment feels pleasant.
quiz_en: What is the popular name of the temple in Menuma, Kumagaya, known for its main hall designated a National Treasure?

name: 星渓園
desc: 熊谷市鎌倉町の星渓園は、市街地の中にひっそりとたたずむ回遊式の日本庭園です。荒川の伏流水が湧き出してできた池を中心に、木々や石が配され、池の周りを歩くたびに景色が移り変わります。夏の暑さで知られる熊谷の街なかで、水と緑に包まれた静かなひとときを過ごせる場所です。
quiz: 星渓園の池のほとりを歩いたら、季節のどんな景色に出会えましたか？
desc_en: Seikeien in the Kamakura-cho area of Kumagaya City is a stroll-style Japanese garden quietly nestled in the city. Trees and stones are arranged around a pond formed by spring water from the underground flow of the Arakawa River, and the scenery changes with every step around the pond. In the streets of Kumagaya, known for its summer heat, it is a place to spend a quiet moment surrounded by water and greenery.
quiz_en: When you walked along the pond at Seikeien Garden, what kind of seasonal scenery did you come across?

name: 保安寺
desc: 熊谷市箕輪にある保安寺は、荒川の流れに近い熊谷西部の住宅地と田畑に囲まれた寺院です。境内は手入れが行き届き、地域の人々の暮らしに寄り添ってきた落ち着いた雰囲気が漂います。夏の暑さで知られる熊谷ですが、木陰の境内に入ればほっとひと息つける、静かな祈りの場です。
quiz: お寺の境内を訪れたとき、あなたが思わず足を止めてしまうものは何ですか？
desc_en: Hoan-ji in the Minowa area of Kumagaya City is a temple surrounded by houses and fields in western Kumagaya, near the flow of the Arakawa River. The grounds are well kept, with a calm atmosphere that has long been part of local people's daily lives. Kumagaya is known for its summer heat, but stepping into the shaded grounds lets you breathe a sigh of relief in this quiet place of prayer.
quiz_en: When you visit the grounds of a temple, what is it that makes you stop and look without thinking?

name: 大我井神社火祭り
desc: 熊谷市妻沼の大我井神社で行われる火祭りです。大我井神社は国宝の聖天堂で知られる妻沼聖天山の近くに鎮座し、古くから地域の信仰を集めてきました。祭りの夜には炎が燃え上がり、闇の中に揺れる火の明かりと人々の熱気が、利根川のほとりの町に特別な一夜をつくり出します。
quiz: 火祭りで燃え上がる炎を見たら、あなたはどんな願いを込めますか？
desc_en: This fire festival is held at Ogai Shrine in the Menuma area of Kumagaya City. Ogai Shrine stands near Menuma Shoden-zan, known for its National Treasure Shoden-do hall, and has long drawn local worship. On the night of the festival, flames blaze up, and the firelight flickering in the darkness, along with the excitement of the crowd, creates a special night in this town beside the Tone River.
quiz_en: If you watched the flames blazing up at a fire festival, what wish would you put into them?

name: 蓮まつり
desc: 行田市小針の古代蓮の里で、蓮の花の見頃に開かれるまつりです。この地の古代蓮は、公共施設の建設工事の際に地中で眠っていた種が自然に発芽して咲いたものとされます。夏の早朝、池一面に咲く薄紅色の大輪の花は神秘的な美しさ。近くでは稲で巨大な絵を描く田んぼアートも見られます。
quiz: 古代蓮の里の近くで見られる、色の違う稲で巨大な絵を描く取り組みは何？
desc_en: This festival is held when the lotus flowers are at their best at the Ancient Lotus Village in the Kobari area of Gyoda City. The ancient lotuses here are said to have bloomed when seeds that had lain dormant underground sprouted naturally during construction of a public facility. On summer mornings, large pale pink blossoms covering the entire pond are mysteriously beautiful. Nearby you can also see rice paddy art, in which giant pictures are drawn with rice plants.
quiz_en: What is the project near the Ancient Lotus Village in which giant pictures are created using rice plants of different colors?

name: 桜ボンボリまつり
desc: 行田市の水城公園で、桜の季節に行われるまつりです。水城公園は忍城の外堀の名残を生かして整えられた公園で、池の周りに咲く桜をぼんぼりの灯りがやさしく照らします。夜には水面に映る夜桜が幻想的で、城下町行田らしい情緒ある春の夜を楽しめます。
quiz: 行田の水城公園が外堀を生かして整えられた、近くにあるお城の名前は何？
desc_en: This festival is held during cherry blossom season at Suijo Park in Gyoda City. The park was created making use of remnants of the outer moat of Oshi Castle, and bonbori lanterns gently light up the cherry blossoms blooming around the pond. At night, the blossoms reflected on the water are magical, and you can enjoy an atmospheric spring evening befitting the castle town of Gyoda.
quiz_en: Suijo Park in Gyoda was laid out making use of the old outer moat of which nearby castle?

name: 芝桜まつり
desc: 秩父市の羊山公園では、春になると「芝桜の丘」に多くの品種の芝桜が咲き、まつりが開かれます。ピンクや白、紫の芝桜が模様を描くように丘を埋め尽くし、背後には秩父のシンボル武甲山がそびえます。花のじゅうたんと山の雄大な姿が織りなす景色は、秩父の春を代表する風景です。
quiz: 羊山公園の芝桜の丘の背後にそびえる、秩父のシンボルの山は何でしょう？
desc_en: At Hitsujiyama Park in Chichibu City, many varieties of shibazakura (moss phlox) bloom on the Shibazakura Hill each spring, and a festival is held. Pink, white and purple flowers fill the hill as if drawing patterns, while Mount Buko, the symbol of Chichibu, towers behind. The scene woven by the carpet of flowers and the majestic mountain is a landscape that represents spring in Chichibu.
quiz_en: Which mountain, regarded as the symbol of Chichibu, towers behind the flower-covered Shibazakura Hill at Hitsujiyama Park?

name: 龍勢祭
desc: 秩父市吉田の椋神社の例大祭で奉納される龍勢は、農民たちが手作りした木製のロケットを打ち上げる伝統行事です。竹筒に火薬を詰めた龍勢が轟音とともに大空へ駆け上がり、白煙を引く姿は天に昇る龍のよう。流派ごとに口上が述べられ、秋の秩父の山あいが大きな歓声に包まれます。
quiz: 秩父・吉田の祭りで打ち上げられる、手作りの木製ロケットを何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: The Ryusei, offered at the grand annual festival of Muku Shrine in the Yoshida area of Chichibu City, is a traditional event in which handmade wooden rockets built by local farmers are launched. Packed with gunpowder in bamboo tubes, the Ryusei soar into the sky with a roar, trailing white smoke like a dragon ascending to heaven. Each school recites a spoken introduction, and the mountains of Chichibu in autumn are filled with loud cheers.
quiz_en: What are the handmade wooden rockets launched at the festival in the Yoshida area of Chichibu called?

name: 中津峡
desc: 秩父市の奥地、荒川の支流中津川がつくる中津峡は、切り立った岩壁が続く深い渓谷です。埼玉県内でも有数の紅葉の名所として知られ、秋には赤や黄に染まった木々が谷を覆い尽くします。清流の青さと紅葉の鮮やかさが織りなす景色は、奥秩父の山深さを感じさせてくれます。
quiz: 奥秩父の中津峡で紅葉狩りをしたら、帰りに秩父で食べたい名物は何ですか？
desc_en: Nakatsu Gorge, formed by the Nakatsu River, a tributary of the Arakawa, deep in the backcountry of Chichibu City, is a deep valley lined with sheer rock walls. It is known as one of the best spots for autumn foliage in Saitama Prefecture, and in fall trees dyed red and yellow cover the valley. The scenery woven by the blue of the clear stream and the vivid foliage conveys the depth of the Okuchichibu mountains.
quiz_en: After viewing the autumn leaves at Nakatsu Gorge in Okuchichibu, what local specialty would you want to eat in Chichibu?

name: 荒川しだれ桜まつり
addr: 秩父市荒川上田野557・690・1926
desc: 秩父市荒川地区の上田野などでは、春にしだれ桜が見事な花を咲かせ、まつりが開かれます。寺院の境内などに大きく枝を垂らしたしだれ桜が咲き誇り、薄紅色の花がまるで滝のように流れ落ちます。秩父の山並みを背景にした素朴な山里の春景色は、心がほっと和むような美しさです。
quiz: 荒川地区のしだれ桜を見るなら、満開の日中と夕暮れ、どちらを選びますか？
desc_en: In places such as Kamitano in the Arakawa district of Chichibu City, weeping cherry trees produce splendid blossoms in spring, and a festival is held. Weeping cherries with long drooping branches bloom in temple grounds and elsewhere, their pale pink flowers cascading down like waterfalls. The simple spring scenery of the mountain village, set against the Chichibu mountains, has a beauty that puts your heart at ease.
quiz_en: To see the weeping cherries of the Arakawa district, would you choose the daytime in full bloom or dusk?

name: 狭山湖
desc: 所沢市の狭山丘陵にある狭山湖は、東京都の水道水源として造られた貯水池です。湖を囲む豊かな森は野鳥の宝庫で、堤防の上からは湖面越しに奥多摩や秩父の山々を、空気の澄んだ日には富士山を望むことができます。夕暮れどき、湖と富士山のシルエットが重なる景色は格別です。
quiz: 所沢市の狭山丘陵にある狭山湖、その正式な名称は何という貯水池でしょう？
desc_en: Lake Sayama, in the Sayama Hills of Tokorozawa City, is a reservoir built as a source of tap water for Tokyo. The rich forest surrounding the lake is a treasure trove of wild birds, and from the top of the embankment you can see the mountains of Okutama and Chichibu across the water and, on clear days, Mount Fuji. At dusk, the view of the lake with the silhouette of Mount Fuji is exceptional.
quiz_en: Lake Sayama in the Sayama Hills of Tokorozawa is a popular name. What is the official name of this reservoir?

name: 上名栗八坂神社大祭
desc: 飯能市上名栗の八坂神社で行われる大祭です。名栗は入間川の上流、名栗川沿いの山あいの里で、江戸に木材を送った西川材の産地として知られてきました。祭りの日には静かな山里に囃子の音が響き、地域の人々が力を合わせて伝統を受け継ぐ温かな光景が見られます。
quiz: 名栗など飯能周辺で育てられ、江戸へ送られた木材は何と呼ばれていたでしょう？
desc_en: This grand festival is held at Yasaka Shrine in the Kaminaguri area of Hanno City. Naguri is a mountain village along the Naguri River, the upper reaches of the Iruma River, long known as a source of Nishikawa timber sent to Edo. On festival day, the sound of festival music echoes through the quiet mountain village, and you can see the heartwarming sight of local people working together to carry on tradition.
quiz_en: What was the timber grown around Hanno, including the Naguri area, and shipped to Edo called?

name: 總願寺
desc: 加須市不動岡の總願寺は、「不動岡不動尊」として親しまれる真言宗の寺院です。厄除けの不動尊として古くから多くの参拝者を集め、門前には参道の町並みが続きます。節分の行事も有名で、毎年大勢の人でにぎわいます。加須は手打ちうどんの町としても知られ、参拝後の一杯が楽しみです。
quiz: 總願寺のある加須市が名物として知られる、手打ちの麺料理は何でしょう？
desc_en: Sogan-ji in the Fudooka area of Kazo City is a Shingon Buddhist temple affectionately known as Fudooka Fudoson. As a Fudo temple for warding off misfortune, it has drawn many worshippers since long ago, and a townscape of shops lines the approach. Its Setsubun event is also famous, crowded with people every year. Kazo is also known as a town of handmade udon, so a bowl after your visit is something to look forward to.
quiz_en: What handmade noodle dish is Kazo City, home of Sogan-ji, famous for as a local specialty?

name: 千方神社
desc: 加須市中央にある千方神社は、市街地の中に鎮座する神社です。地元の人々に親しまれ、四季を通じて参拝者が訪れます。加須は利根川に近い平野の町で、こいのぼりの生産が盛んなことでも知られ、春には巨大なこいのぼりが空を泳ぐ催しが行われます。
quiz: 加須市が生産地として知られ、春に巨大なものが空を泳ぐ飾りは何でしょう？
desc_en: Chikata Shrine in the Chuo area of Kazo City is a shrine located in the middle of the city. Beloved by local people, it welcomes worshippers throughout the four seasons. Kazo is a town on the plain near the Tone River, also known for its thriving production of koinobori (carp streamers), and in spring an event is held in which a giant carp streamer swims through the sky.
quiz_en: What decoration, produced in Kazo City, swims through the sky in giant form at a spring event there?

name: 玉敷神社 だるま市 節分祭
desc: 加須市騎西の玉敷神社で、節分に合わせて開かれるだるま市と節分祭です。境内には縁起物のだるまを売る露店が並び、豆まきの声とともに人々が一年の福を願います。玉敷神社は神楽の伝統でも知られる古社で、冬の澄んだ空気の中、境内が新春らしい活気に包まれます。
quiz: 玉敷神社のだるま市で縁起だるまを買ったら、最初に目を入れるのはどちら？
name_en: Tamashiki Shrine Daruma Market and Setsubun Festival
desc_en: This daruma market and Setsubun festival are held at Tamashiki Shrine in the Kisai area of Kazo City in time for Setsubun. Stalls selling lucky daruma dolls line the grounds, and people wish for good fortune for the year amid the shouts of the bean-throwing ritual. Tamashiki Shrine is an ancient shrine also known for its kagura (sacred dance) tradition, and in the clear winter air the grounds are filled with New Year energy.
quiz_en: If you bought a lucky daruma at the Tamashiki Shrine daruma market, which eye would you paint in first?

name: 若泉公園桜まつり
desc: 本庄市の若泉公園で、春の桜の見頃に合わせて開かれるまつりです。園内の桜が咲きそろうと、花見を楽しむ地元の人々でにぎわいます。本庄はかつて中山道最大の宿場として栄えた町で、桜を楽しんだあとに古い町の歴史をたどる散策もおすすめです。
quiz: 本庄がかつて最大の宿場町として栄えた、江戸時代の街道は何でしょう？
desc_en: This festival is held at Wakaizumi Park in Honjo City to coincide with the peak of the spring cherry blossoms. When the park's cherry trees are in full bloom, it bustles with local people enjoying blossom viewing. Honjo once flourished as the largest post town on the Nakasendo road, so after enjoying the cherry blossoms, a walk tracing the history of the old town is also recommended.
quiz_en: Along which Edo-period highway did Honjo once flourish as the largest of all the post towns?

name: 立岩寺ぼたん園
desc: 本庄市滝瀬にある立岩寺のぼたん園は、春になると境内が大輪の牡丹で彩られる花の名所です。幾重にも重なる花びらを持つ牡丹が色とりどりに咲き競い、寺の落ち着いた雰囲気と相まって華やかながら気品のある光景が広がります。花の香りに包まれながら境内を歩くひとときは格別です。
quiz: 立岩寺のぼたん園で見てみたい、あなたの好きな牡丹の色は何色ですか？
desc_en: The peony garden of Ryugan-ji in the Takise area of Honjo City is a flower spot where the temple grounds are adorned with large peonies in spring. Peonies with many layered petals bloom in competing colors, and combined with the calm atmosphere of the temple, they create a scene that is gorgeous yet elegant. Strolling the grounds wrapped in the fragrance of the flowers is a special pleasure.
quiz_en: What is your favorite color of peony that you would like to see at the peony garden of Ryugan-ji?

name: 産泰神社春季大祭
desc: 本庄市四方田の産泰神社で行われる春の大祭です。産泰神社は安産や子育ての神として信仰され、祭りの日には周辺に露店が並び、子ども連れの家族などで大いににぎわいます。本庄の田園地帯に春の訪れを告げる行事として、地域の人々に長く親しまれてきました。
quiz: 安産や子育ての神様として知られる神社に、あなたは誰の幸せを願いますか？
desc_en: This spring grand festival is held at Santai Shrine in the Yomoda area of Honjo City. Santai Shrine is worshipped as a deity of safe childbirth and child-raising, and on festival day stalls line the surrounding area, which bustles with families with children. As an event announcing the arrival of spring in Honjo's farmland, it has long been cherished by local people.
quiz_en: At a shrine known for its deity of safe childbirth and child-raising, whose happiness would you pray for?

name: 小山川の千本桜まつり
addr: 本庄市児玉町児玉（小山川河川敷）
desc: 本庄市児玉町を流れる小山川の河川敷には、長い桜並木が続き、春にはまつりが開かれます。川沿いの土手を薄紅色に染める桜のトンネルの中を歩けば、花びらが川面に舞い落ちる風情ある景色に出会えます。児玉町は盲目の国学者・塙保己一のふるさととしても知られています。
quiz: 本庄市児玉町がふるさととして知られる、江戸時代の盲目の国学者は誰？
name_en: Koyama River Thousand Cherry Trees Festival
desc_en: A long row of cherry trees lines the floodplain of the Koyama River, which flows through the Kodama area of Honjo City, and a festival is held in spring. Walking through the tunnel of cherry blossoms that tints the riverside embankment pale pink, you will come across the charming sight of petals fluttering down onto the river. Kodama is also known as the hometown of Hanawa Hokiichi, a blind scholar of Japanese classics.
quiz_en: Who was the blind Edo-period scholar of Japanese classics whose hometown was Kodama in Honjo City?

name: 深谷桜まつり
addr: 深谷市西島5-6-1（瀧宮神社内）
desc: 深谷市の瀧宮神社を中心に開かれる春の桜まつりです。境内とその周辺の桜が咲きそろい、湧水の池を囲む風景がやわらかな春の色に包まれます。深谷は特産の深谷ねぎで知られ、新一万円札の顔となった渋沢栄一のふるさとでもあります。花見のあとは渋沢ゆかりの地めぐりも楽しめます。
quiz: 深谷市出身で、新しい一万円札の肖像に選ばれた実業家は誰でしょう？
desc_en: This spring cherry blossom festival centers on Takinomiya Shrine in Fukaya City. When the cherry trees in and around the shrine grounds are in full bloom, the scenery around the spring-fed pond is wrapped in soft spring colors. Fukaya is known for its specialty Fukaya green onions and is also the hometown of Shibusawa Eiichi, the face of the new 10,000-yen note. After blossom viewing, you can also enjoy touring places associated with Shibusawa.
quiz_en: Which businessman from Fukaya City was chosen as the portrait on Japan's new 10,000-yen banknote?

name: 草加宿場まつり
desc: 草加市で開かれる宿場まつりは、日光街道の宿場町として栄えた草加の歴史を伝える祭りです。綾瀬川沿いには松並木の「草加松原」が続き、松尾芭蕉の『おくのほそ道』ゆかりの地としても知られます。祭りの日には町が活気に包まれ、名物の草加せんべいの香ばしい香りが漂います。
quiz: 日光街道の宿場町・草加の名物として知られる、香ばしい焼き菓子は何？
desc_en: The post town festival held in Soka City conveys the history of Soka, which flourished as a post town on the Nikko Kaido road. Along the Ayase River stretches Soka Matsubara, a row of pine trees, also known as a place associated with Matsuo Basho's The Narrow Road to the Deep North. On festival day the town is full of energy, and the savory aroma of the famous Soka senbei rice crackers fills the air.
quiz_en: What savory baked treat is known as the famous specialty of Soka, a post town on the Nikko Kaido road?

name: 梅林公園梅まつり
addr: 越谷市大林203−1（越谷梅林公園）
desc: 越谷市大林の越谷梅林公園で、梅の花の見頃に開かれるまつりです。園内には紅梅や白梅など多くの梅の木が植えられ、早春の訪れとともに可憐な花が咲き、甘い香りが漂います。まだ肌寒い季節にひと足早い春を感じられる、のどかな梅見のひとときを楽しめます。
quiz: 越谷梅林公園の梅まつりで見たい梅は、紅梅と白梅のどちらですか？
desc_en: This festival is held at Koshigaya Bairin Park in the Obayashi area of Koshigaya City when the plum blossoms are at their best. Many plum trees, including red and white varieties, grow in the park, and with the arrival of early spring their delicate flowers bloom and a sweet fragrance drifts through the air. You can enjoy peaceful plum viewing and feel spring a little early in a still-chilly season.
quiz_en: At the plum festival in Koshigaya Bairin Park, which would you rather see: red plum or white plum blossoms?

name: 中仙道武州蕨宿宿場まつり
addr: 蕨市北町 から 中央5（中山道本町通り）
desc: 蕨市の中山道本町通りを中心に開かれる宿場まつりです。蕨宿は江戸を出て中山道の二番目の宿場として栄えた町で、祭りでは宿場時代を思わせる行列や催しが通りを彩ります。蕨市は面積が日本一小さい市としても知られ、コンパクトな町並みに歴史の香りが残ります。
quiz: 中山道の宿場町だった蕨市は、何が「日本一小さい市」として知られている？
desc_en: This post town festival centers on Nakasendo Honcho-dori street in Warabi City. Warabi-juku flourished as the second post town on the Nakasendo after leaving Edo, and at the festival, processions and events evoking the post town era brighten the street. Warabi City is also known as the smallest city in Japan by area, and its compact townscape retains a sense of history.
quiz_en: Warabi City, once a post town on the Nakasendo, is known as Japan's smallest city in terms of what?

name: 彩夏祭
desc: 朝霞市の彩夏祭は、関東各地からよさこいチームが集う「関八州よさこいフェスタ」を中心とした夏祭りです。鳴子を手にした踊り手たちが色鮮やかな衣装で市内を練り踊り、迫力ある演舞に観客が引き込まれます。夜には花火も打ち上げられ、朝霞の夏の夜空を華やかに彩ります。
quiz: よさこい踊りで踊り手が手に持ち、カタカタと鳴らす道具は何でしょう？
desc_en: Asaka City's Saikasai is a summer festival centered on the Kanhasshu Yosakoi Festa, which brings together yosakoi dance teams from across the Kanto region. Dancers holding naruko clappers parade and dance through the city in vivid costumes, and spectators are drawn in by the powerful performances. At night, fireworks are launched, brilliantly decorating Asaka's summer night sky.
quiz_en: What is the wooden clapper that yosakoi dancers hold in their hands and rattle as they dance called?

name: 平林寺半僧坊大祭
desc: 新座市野火止の平林寺で行われる半僧坊大祭です。平林寺は臨済宗の禅寺で、武蔵野の面影を残す広大な雑木林の境内を持ち、川越藩主松平信綱の墓所があることでも知られます。大祭の日には境内の半僧坊に参拝者が訪れ、ふだんは静かな禅寺の森がにぎわいを見せます。
quiz: 新座の平林寺に墓所がある、「知恵伊豆」と呼ばれた江戸時代の大名は誰？
desc_en: This Hansobo Grand Festival is held at Heirin-ji in the Nobidome area of Niiza City. Heirin-ji is a Rinzai Zen temple with vast grounds of mixed woodland that preserve the look of old Musashino, and it is also known for the grave of Matsudaira Nobutsuna, lord of the Kawagoe Domain. On the day of the grand festival, worshippers visit the Hansobo hall in the grounds, and the usually quiet Zen temple forest comes alive.
quiz_en: Who was the Edo-period daimyo known as Chie Izu, or Izu the Wise, whose grave is at Heirin-ji in Niiza?

name: 城山公園
desc: 桶川市川田谷にある城山公園は、荒川に近い台地の上に広がる公園です。中世の城館があったと伝わる地に整えられ、広い芝生や池、運動施設などがそろいます。周辺には雑木林や田園が残り、季節の花や緑に囲まれた中で家族連れがのびのびと過ごしています。
quiz: 城山公園のような広い公園で、休日にあなたがしたい過ごし方は何ですか？
desc_en: Shiroyama Park in the Kawataya area of Okegawa City spreads across a plateau near the Arakawa River. Laid out on land where a medieval fortified residence is said to have stood, it has wide lawns, a pond, sports facilities and more. Mixed woodland and farmland remain in the surrounding area, and families spend carefree time here surrounded by seasonal flowers and greenery.
quiz_en: In a large park like Shiroyama Park, how would you most like to spend your day off?

name: 鷲宮神社
desc: 久喜市の鷲宮神社は、関東でも有数の古社として知られる神社です。この地に伝わる「土師一流催馬楽神楽」は関東の神楽の源流ともいわれ、国の重要無形民俗文化財に指定されています。近年はアニメ作品の舞台としても注目を集め、全国から多くのファンが訪れるようになりました。
quiz: 鷲宮神社に伝わる、国の重要無形民俗文化財に指定された神楽の名前は？
desc_en: Washinomiya Shrine in Kuki City is known as one of the oldest shrines in the Kanto region. The Haji Ichiryu Saibara Kagura handed down here is said to be a source of Kanto's kagura (sacred dance) and is designated a national Important Intangible Folk Cultural Property. In recent years it has also drawn attention as the setting of an anime, and many fans have come to visit from all over Japan.
quiz_en: What is the name of the kagura dance handed down at Washinomiya Shrine and designated an Important Intangible Folk Cultural Property?

name: 菖蒲神社の藤まつり
desc: 久喜市菖蒲町の菖蒲神社で、藤の花の見頃に開かれるまつりです。境内の藤棚から薄紫の花房が長く垂れ下がり、風に揺れる様子は優雅そのもの。甘い香りに誘われて多くの人が訪れます。菖蒲町はラベンダーの栽培でも知られる花の町で、初夏には紫色の花があちこちを彩ります。
quiz: 菖蒲神社の藤まつりで、藤棚から垂れ下がる花は何色をしているでしょう？
desc_en: This festival is held at Shobu Shrine in the Shobu area of Kuki City when the wisteria is at its best. Long clusters of pale purple flowers hang from the wisteria trellis in the grounds, swaying elegantly in the wind. Drawn by the sweet fragrance, many people visit. Shobu is a town of flowers also known for growing lavender, and in early summer purple blossoms color the area here and there.
quiz_en: At the Shobu Shrine Wisteria Festival, what color are the flowers hanging down from the wisteria trellis?

name: 天神社
desc: 北本市本宿にある天神社は、学問の神様を祀る地域の鎮守です。北本はかつて中山道の宿場があった地で、「本宿」という地名にもその名残が感じられます。木々に囲まれた静かな境内は地元の人々の憩いの場となっており、受験の季節には合格を願う参拝者の姿も見られます。
quiz: 天神社で合格祈願をするなら、絵馬にどんな言葉を書きたいですか？
desc_en: Tenjinsha in the Honjuku area of Kitamoto City is a local guardian shrine dedicated to the god of learning. Kitamoto was once home to a post town on the Nakasendo, and traces of this can be felt in the place name Honjuku, meaning original post town. The quiet grounds surrounded by trees are a place of relaxation for local people, and in exam season you can also see worshippers praying for success.
quiz_en: If you prayed for exam success at Tenjinsha, what words would you write on your ema wooden plaque?

name: 氷川神社
desc: 北本市高尾にある氷川神社は、荒川を見下ろす台地の上に鎮座する神社です。周辺には雑木林や谷戸の地形が残り、武蔵野らしい里山の雰囲気が漂います。氷川神社は埼玉県や東京都に多く見られる神社で、その総本社はさいたま市大宮の氷川神社です。
quiz: 埼玉や東京に多い氷川神社、その総本社はどこの都市にあるでしょう？
desc_en: Hikawa Shrine in the Takao area of Kitamoto City stands on a plateau overlooking the Arakawa River. Mixed woodland and yato valley landforms remain in the area, giving it the atmosphere of the satoyama countryside typical of Musashino. Hikawa shrines are found in large numbers in Saitama Prefecture and Tokyo, and their head shrine is Hikawa Shrine in Omiya, Saitama City.
quiz_en: Hikawa shrines are common in Saitama and Tokyo. In which city is the head shrine of all Hikawa shrines located?

name: みさと公園
desc: 三郷市高州にあるみさと公園は、東京都との境にある小合溜（こあいだめ）のほとりに広がる水辺の公園です。対岸には東京都の水元公園が広がり、水辺の景観が一体となった開放的な風景が楽しめます。広い芝生でのピクニックや水辺の散策で、のびのびとした時間を過ごせます。
quiz: みさと公園の対岸、小合溜をはさんで広がる東京都の公園は何でしょう？
desc_en: Misato Park in the Takasu area of Misato City is a waterside park spreading along the shore of the Koaidame reservoir on the border with Tokyo. Across the water lies Tokyo's Mizumoto Park, and you can enjoy an open landscape where the waterside scenery merges as one. You can spend relaxed time picnicking on the wide lawns or strolling along the water.
quiz_en: What Tokyo park spreads across the water from Misato Park, on the opposite shore of the Koaidame?

name: 幸手権現堂桜堤（県営権現堂公園）
desc: 幸手市の権現堂桜堤は、中川沿いの堤に約千本のソメイヨシノが続く桜の名所です。春には桜のトンネルの下に菜の花が一面に咲き、薄紅色と黄色のコントラストが見事な景色をつくります。初夏にはあじさい、秋には曼珠沙華と、四季を通じて花の名所として親しまれています。
quiz: 幸手の権現堂桜堤で、春に桜と一緒に堤を黄色く彩る花は何でしょう？
desc_en: The Gongendo cherry embankment in Satte City is a famous cherry blossom spot where about a thousand Somei-Yoshino cherry trees line a bank along the Naka River. In spring, rapeseed blossoms bloom all over beneath the tunnel of cherry trees, creating a splendid contrast of pale pink and yellow. With hydrangeas in early summer and red spider lilies in autumn, it is loved as a flower spot throughout the year.
quiz_en: At the Gongendo cherry embankment in Satte, what flower colors the bank yellow together with the cherry blossoms in spring?

name: 鶴ヶ島桜まつり
desc: 鶴ヶ島市太田ヶ谷で開かれる春の桜まつりです。会場周辺の桜が咲きそろうと、花見を楽しむ地元の人々でにぎわいます。鶴ヶ島は武蔵野の台地に広がる住宅都市で、身近な場所で季節の移ろいを感じられる憩いの行事です。家族や友人と、桜の下でのんびりとしたひとときを過ごせます。
quiz: 鶴ヶ島の桜まつりで、満開の桜の下で一緒に過ごしたいのは誰ですか？
desc_en: This spring cherry blossom festival is held in the Otagaya area of Tsurugashima City. When the cherry trees around the venue are in full bloom, it bustles with local people enjoying blossom viewing. Tsurugashima is a residential city spreading across the Musashino plateau, and this is a relaxing event where you can feel the change of seasons close to home. You can spend a leisurely time under the cherry blossoms with family and friends.
quiz_en: At the Tsurugashima Cherry Blossom Festival, who would you like to spend time with under the cherry trees in full bloom?

name: 鎌北湖
addr: 毛呂山町大谷木字鎌北
desc: 毛呂山町の山あいにある鎌北湖は、農業用水のために造られた溜池で、周囲を奥武蔵の山々に囲まれた静かな湖です。春には湖畔の桜、秋には紅葉が湖面を彩り、季節ごとに表情を変えます。ハイキングコースの起点にもなっており、山歩きと合わせて訪れる人も多い場所です。
quiz: 奥武蔵の鎌北湖を訪れるなら、桜の春と紅葉の秋のどちらに行きたいですか？
desc_en: Lake Kamakita, in the mountains of Moroyama Town, is an irrigation pond built for agricultural water, a quiet lake surrounded by the mountains of Okumusashi. Cherry blossoms on the shore in spring and colorful foliage in autumn adorn the lake surface, changing its look with each season. It is also the starting point of hiking trails, and many people visit in combination with a mountain walk.
quiz_en: If you visited Lake Kamakita in Okumusashi, would you rather go in spring for the cherry blossoms or in autumn for the foliage?

name: 黒山三滝
desc: 越生町の黒山三滝は、男滝・女滝・天狗滝の三つの滝の総称です。上下二段に続く男滝と女滝が寄り添うように流れ落ち、少し離れた場所に天狗滝があります。古くから修験の行場としても知られ、新緑や紅葉に包まれた渓谷を歩けば、清らかな水音に心が洗われます。
quiz: 黒山三滝の三つの滝は、男滝・女滝と、もう一つは何という滝でしょう？
desc_en: Kuroyama Santaki in Ogose Town is the collective name for three waterfalls: Odaki, Medaki and Tengu Falls. Odaki and Medaki, continuing in upper and lower tiers, fall as if nestled together, while Tengu Falls lies a little apart. Long known as a training site for Shugendo mountain ascetics, the gorge wrapped in fresh greenery or autumn leaves refreshes the soul with the sound of clear water.
quiz_en: The three falls of Kuroyama Santaki are Odaki, Medaki and one more. What is the third waterfall called?

name: 鬼鎮神社節分祭
desc: 嵐山町の鬼鎮神社は、全国でも珍しい鬼を祀る神社です。節分祭の豆まきでは「福は内、鬼は内、悪魔外」と唱えるのがならわしで、鬼を追い払うのではなく迎え入れる独特の掛け声が響きます。境内には金棒が奉納され、ユニークな節分の行事として多くの参拝者が訪れます。
quiz: 鬼鎮神社の節分の掛け声は「福は内、鬼は」何と唱えるでしょう？
desc_en: Kijin Shrine in Ranzan Town is a shrine that enshrines oni (ogres), something rare in Japan. At the bean-throwing ritual of its Setsubun Festival, the custom is to chant 'Fortune in, ogres in, devils out,' and this unique chant rings out, welcoming the oni instead of driving them away. Iron clubs are offered in the grounds, and many worshippers visit this unusual Setsubun event.
quiz_en: At Kijin Shrine's Setsubun bean-throwing, the chant begins 'Fortune in, ogres...' Are the ogres told to come in or go out?

name: 嵐山桜まつり
desc: 嵐山町を流れる都幾川の桜堤で開かれる春のまつりです。川沿いに続く桜並木が満開を迎え、清流と桜の取り合わせが見事な景色をつくります。嵐山の地名は、近くの渓谷が京都の嵐山に似ていることから名付けられた「武蔵嵐山」に由来し、のどかな川辺の春を存分に楽しめます。
quiz: 埼玉の嵐山町の名は、どこの景勝地に似ていることから名付けられた？
desc_en: This spring festival is held on the cherry embankment of the Toki River flowing through Ranzan Town. The rows of cherry trees along the river reach full bloom, and the combination of clear water and blossoms creates a splendid scene. The name Ranzan comes from Musashi Ranzan, named because a nearby gorge resembles Arashiyama in Kyoto, and you can fully enjoy spring by this peaceful river.
quiz_en: Ranzan Town in Saitama was named because its scenery resembles which famous scenic spot elsewhere in Japan?

name: 物見山
desc: 鳩山町石坂の物見山は、比企丘陵に連なる穏やかな山です。名前のとおり見晴らしのよい場所として親しまれ、雑木林に囲まれた散策路を歩けば、丘陵の起伏と里山の風景が広がります。気軽に登れる低山で、季節の草花や野鳥との出会いを楽しみながら、のんびりと山歩きができます。
quiz: 物見山のような見晴らしのよい丘で、あなたが一番眺めたい景色は何ですか？
desc_en: Mount Monomi in the Ishizaka area of Hatoyama Town is a gentle mountain in the Hiki Hills. True to its name, meaning lookout mountain, it is loved as a place with fine views, and walking the trails surrounded by mixed woodland, you can see the rolling hills and countryside scenery. It is a low mountain that is easy to climb, perfect for a leisurely hike while enjoying encounters with seasonal flowers and wild birds.
quiz_en: From a hill with a fine view like Mount Monomi, what kind of scenery would you most like to look out on?

name: 笛吹峠
desc: 鳩山町と嵐山町の境にある笛吹峠は、比企丘陵の中を越える峠です。南北朝時代には新田氏と足利尊氏の軍勢が戦った「笛吹峠の戦い」の舞台となりました。今は雑木林に囲まれた静かな峠道で、戦の歴史に思いをはせながら、鎌倉街道の面影をたどる散策が楽しめます。
quiz: 鳩山町の笛吹峠で、南北朝時代に新田氏の軍勢と戦った武将は誰でしょう？
desc_en: Usui Pass, on the border between Hatoyama Town and Ranzan Town, crosses through the Hiki Hills. In the Nanbokucho period it was the stage of the Battle of Usui Pass, fought between the forces of the Nitta clan and Ashikaga Takauji. Today it is a quiet pass road surrounded by mixed woodland, where you can enjoy a walk tracing remnants of the old Kamakura Kaido road while reflecting on its history of battle.
quiz_en: At Usui Pass in Hatoyama, which warlord fought against the forces of the Nitta clan during the Nanbokucho period?

name: 宝登山神社
desc: 長瀞町の宝登山神社は、宝登山の麓に鎮座する秩父地方屈指の古社です。日本武尊が山火事に遭った際、山犬に助けられたという伝説が社名の由来として語られます。極彩色の彫刻で飾られた社殿は見ごたえがあり、ロープウェイで上る山頂では冬にロウバイが黄色く咲き誇ります。
quiz: 冬の宝登山の山頂を黄色く彩り、甘い香りを放つ花は何でしょう？
desc_en: Hodosan Shrine in Nagatoro Town, at the foot of Mount Hodo, is one of the foremost ancient shrines of the Chichibu region. The shrine's name is said to derive from a legend in which Yamato Takeru was rescued by mountain dogs when caught in a mountain fire. The shrine buildings decorated with richly colored carvings are well worth seeing, and at the summit, reached by ropeway, wintersweet blooms in yellow profusion in winter.
quiz_en: Which flower colors the summit of Mount Hodo yellow in winter and gives off a sweet fragrance?

name: 両神山
desc: 小鹿野町の両神山は、日本百名山のひとつに数えられる奥秩父の名峰です。ぎざぎざとした岩稜が連なる険しい山容が特徴で、古くから信仰の山として崇められてきました。山中には鎖場もあり、登りごたえのある山として登山者に人気です。山頂からは奥秩父の山々を見渡せます。
quiz: 両神山の岩場を登りきったら、山頂で真っ先に何をしたいですか？
desc_en: Mount Ryokami in Ogano Town is a celebrated peak of Okuchichibu counted among Japan's 100 Famous Mountains. It is characterized by a rugged form of jagged rocky ridges and has been revered as a sacred mountain since ancient times. With chain-assisted sections on the trail, it is popular among climbers as a challenging mountain. From the summit you can see across the mountains of Okuchichibu.
quiz_en: After finishing the climb up the rocky sections of Mount Ryokami, what is the first thing you would want to do at the summit?

name: 四阿屋山
desc: 小鹿野町両神にある四阿屋山は、山麓に花の名所を抱く親しみやすい山です。麓の両神地区は早春に咲くセツブンソウの自生地として知られ、可憐な白い花が春の訪れを告げます。山頂付近には岩場もあり、手軽ながら変化に富んだ山歩きを楽しめます。
quiz: 四阿屋山の麓で早春に咲く、節分の頃に花を開く白い花は何でしょう？
desc_en: Mount Azumaya in the Ryokami area of Ogano Town is an approachable mountain with famous flower spots at its foot. The Ryokami area at its base is known as a habitat of wild setsubunso (Eranthis pinnatifida), whose delicate white flowers bloom in early spring, heralding its arrival. There are rocky sections near the summit, offering an easy yet varied hike.
quiz_en: What white flower blooms in early spring at the foot of Mount Azumaya, opening around the time of Setsubun?

name: 二子山
desc: 小鹿野町河原沢の二子山は、その名のとおり二つの峰が並ぶ石灰岩の山です。切り立った岩壁は国内有数のロッククライミングの名所として知られ、多くのクライマーが訪れます。山頂からは秩父の山々を見渡すことができ、ごつごつとした岩の造形が印象的です。
quiz: 二子山の切り立った岩壁を舞台に楽しまれている、岩登りのスポーツは何？
desc_en: Mount Futago in the Kawarasawa area of Ogano Town is a limestone mountain with, as its name meaning twin peaks suggests, two peaks side by side. Its sheer rock walls are known as one of Japan's leading rock climbing spots, attracting many climbers. From the summit you can see across the Chichibu mountains, and the rugged rock formations are striking.
quiz_en: What climbing sport is enjoyed on the sheer rock walls of Mount Futago in Ogano Town?

name: 尾ノ内渓谷
desc: 小鹿野町河原沢の尾ノ内渓谷は、清流と岩場が続く小さな渓谷です。冬になると沢の水を引いてつくられる巨大な氷柱が渓谷を埋め尽くし、「尾ノ内百景氷柱」として多くの見物客が訪れます。渓谷に架かる吊り橋から見下ろす氷の世界は圧巻で、夜のライトアップも幻想的です。
quiz: 尾ノ内渓谷で冬に見られる、沢の水でつくられる氷の造形物は何でしょう？
desc_en: Onouchi Gorge in the Kawarasawa area of Ogano Town is a small gorge of clear streams and rocky areas. In winter, giant icicles made by drawing water from the stream fill the gorge, and many visitors come to see the Onouchi Hyakkei Icicles. The world of ice seen from the suspension bridge spanning the gorge is overwhelming, and the nighttime illumination is magical.
quiz_en: What ice formations, created using water from the mountain stream, can be seen at Onouchi Gorge in winter?

name: 丸神の滝
addr: 小鹿野町両神小森滝前
desc: 小鹿野町両神小森にある丸神の滝は、「日本の滝百選」に選ばれた埼玉県を代表する名瀑です。三段に分かれて流れ落ちる優美な姿が特徴で、周囲の森に囲まれた滝つぼにはひんやりとした空気が漂います。新緑や紅葉の季節には、白い流れと山の彩りが美しく調和します。
quiz: 丸神の滝が選ばれている、全国の名瀑を集めた百選は何と呼ばれる？
desc_en: Marugami Falls in the Ryokami Komori area of Ogano Town is a famous waterfall representing Saitama Prefecture, selected as one of Japan's Top 100 Waterfalls. It is characterized by its graceful form, falling in three tiers, and cool air drifts around the plunge pool surrounded by forest. In the seasons of fresh greenery and autumn leaves, the white stream harmonizes beautifully with the colors of the mountains.
quiz_en: What is the name of the nationwide list of one hundred famous waterfalls that Marugami Falls has been selected for?

name: 城峯公園
desc: 神川町矢納の城峯公園は、神流湖を見下ろす山の中腹に広がる公園です。秋から冬にかけて冬桜が花を咲かせることで知られ、見頃の時期には紅葉と白い冬桜が同時に楽しめる珍しい光景が広がります。春には普通の桜も咲き、山あいの自然を一年を通して味わえる場所です。
quiz: 城峯公園で秋から冬にかけて咲き、紅葉と共演する花は何でしょう？
desc_en: Jomine Park in the Yano area of Kamikawa Town spreads across a mountainside overlooking Lake Kanna. It is known for its winter cherry trees, which bloom from autumn into winter, and at their peak you can enjoy the rare sight of autumn leaves and white winter cherry blossoms at the same time. Ordinary cherry trees also bloom in spring, making it a place to savor mountain nature throughout the year.
quiz_en: Which flower blooms at Jomine Park from autumn into winter, sharing the stage with the autumn leaves?

name: 円良田湖
desc: 寄居町末野にある円良田湖は、山あいに造られた農業用の溜池で、周囲を緑の森に囲まれた静かな湖です。釣りを楽しむ人々の姿が見られ、湖畔を巡る散策路も整備されています。春の桜や秋の紅葉が湖面に映り込み、季節ごとに違った美しさを見せてくれます。
quiz: 円良田湖のような静かな山の湖で、あなたが一番してみたいことは何ですか？
desc_en: Lake Tsuburata in the Sueno area of Yorii Town is an agricultural irrigation pond built in the mountains, a quiet lake surrounded by green forest. People can be seen enjoying fishing, and a walking path around the lakeshore has been developed. Spring cherry blossoms and autumn leaves are reflected on the lake surface, showing a different beauty each season.
quiz_en: At a quiet mountain lake like Lake Tsuburata, what would you most like to try doing there?

name: 鐘撞堂山
desc: 寄居町の鐘撞堂山は、戦国時代に鉢形城の見張り場が置かれ、異変を知らせる鐘をついたことが名前の由来とされる山です。気軽に登れる低山で、山頂からは寄居の町並みや関東平野、晴れた日には遠くの山々まで見渡せます。山頂には鐘が吊るされ、登った記念に鳴らす人もいます。
quiz: 鐘撞堂山で見張りを置き、鐘で異変を知らせたとされる城は何でしょう？
desc_en: Mount Kanetsukido in Yorii Town is said to get its name from a lookout post for Hachigata Castle placed here in the Sengoku period, where a bell was rung to warn of trouble. It is a low mountain that is easy to climb, and from the summit you can see the townscape of Yorii, the Kanto Plain and, on clear days, distant mountains. A bell hangs at the summit, and some people ring it to commemorate their climb.
quiz_en: Which castle is said to have placed a lookout on Mount Kanetsukido and used a bell to warn of trouble?

name: 釜伏山
desc: 寄居町と皆野町などにまたがる釜伏山は、外秩父の山並みに連なる山で、山頂近くに釜伏神社が鎮座します。麓の風布地区には、環境省の名水百選に選ばれた「日本水（やまとみず）」が湧き出しています。山歩きのあとに清らかな名水を味わえる、水と信仰の山です。
quiz: 釜伏山の麓、寄居町風布に湧く名水百選の湧き水は何と呼ばれるでしょう？
desc_en: Straddling Yorii Town, Minano Town and other areas, Mount Kamabuse is part of the Sotochichibu mountain range, with Kamabuse Shrine standing near its summit. In the Fuppu area at its foot springs Yamato Mizu, selected as one of the Ministry of the Environment's 100 Best Waters of Japan. It is a mountain of water and faith, where you can taste pure, famous spring water after a hike.
quiz_en: What is the name of the spring water, selected as one of Japan's 100 Best Waters, that wells up in Fuppu at the foot of Mount Kamabuse?

name: 千葉神社
desc: 千葉市中央区の千葉神社は、北辰妙見尊星王を祀る「妙見本宮」として知られます。平安時代から千葉の地を治めた千葉氏が厚く信仰した妙見さまは、北極星や北斗七星を神格化した星の神様です。上下二層の重層社殿は珍しい造りで、厄除け・八方除けの神社として多くの参拝者を集めています。
quiz: 千葉神社で祀られる妙見さまは、夜空の何を神格化した神様でしょう？
desc_en: Chiba Shrine in Chuo Ward, Chiba City, is known as the head shrine of Myoken, enshrining Hokushin Myoken Sonjo-o. Myoken, deeply revered by the Chiba clan that ruled the Chiba area from the Heian period, is a star deity who personifies the North Star and the Big Dipper. Its two-story shrine building is an unusual structure, and it draws many worshippers as a shrine for warding off misfortune from all directions.
quiz_en: Myoken, the deity enshrined at Chiba Shrine, is a deification of what in the night sky?

name: 稲毛浅間神社
desc: 千葉市稲毛区の稲毛浅間神社は、富士山を神格化した木花咲耶姫命を祀る神社です。かつては境内のすぐ前まで海が迫り、海中に立つ鳥居が名物でした。現在は埋め立てで海岸線は遠ざかりましたが、松林に囲まれた境内には海辺の神社だった頃の面影が残り、夏の例大祭はにぎわいを見せます。
quiz: 稲毛浅間神社に祀られている、富士山の神とされる女神は誰でしょう？
desc_en: Inage Sengen Shrine in Inage Ward, Chiba City, enshrines Konohanasakuya-hime, the deified spirit of Mount Fuji. The sea once came right up to the front of the shrine grounds, and its torii standing in the sea was a famous sight. Land reclamation has since pushed the coastline far away, but the grounds surrounded by pine woods retain traces of its days as a seaside shrine, and the grand summer festival draws lively crowds.
quiz_en: Who is the goddess regarded as the deity of Mount Fuji who is enshrined at Inage Sengen Shrine?

name: 千葉市動物公園
desc: 千葉市若葉区の千葉市動物公園は、広い園内にさまざまな動物が暮らす動物園です。後ろ足ですっくと立ち上がる姿が話題になったレッサーパンダ「風太」がいたことで全国的に知られました。草原のような展示エリアや子どもが動物と触れ合えるコーナーもあり、家族で一日楽しめます。
quiz: 千葉市動物公園で、立ち上がる姿で一躍人気者になったレッサーパンダの名前は？
desc_en: Chiba Zoological Park in Wakaba Ward, Chiba City, is a zoo where a wide variety of animals live on spacious grounds. It became known nationwide as the home of Futa, a red panda who made headlines for standing upright on his hind legs. With grassland-like exhibit areas and corners where children can interact with animals, families can enjoy a full day here.
quiz_en: What was the name of the red panda at Chiba Zoological Park who became famous for standing up on his hind legs?

name: 泉自然公園
desc: 千葉市若葉区に広がる泉自然公園に到着しました。雑木林や池、谷あいの湿地が残る広い公園で、市街地の近くとは思えない静けさに包まれています。春は桜、秋は紅葉が園内を彩り、散策路をのんびり歩けば野鳥の声も聞こえてきます。季節ごとに表情を変える里山の風景を味わってください。
quiz: 泉自然公園の散策路を歩くなら、桜の春と紅葉の秋、あなたはどちらの季節を選ぶ？
desc_en: You have arrived at Izumi Nature Park, spreading across Wakaba Ward in Chiba City. This large park preserves mixed woodland, ponds and valley wetlands, wrapped in a stillness that is hard to believe so close to the city. Cherry blossoms in spring and autumn leaves in fall color the grounds, and as you stroll the walking paths you can hear wild birds singing. Enjoy a satoyama countryside landscape that changes with every season.
quiz_en: If you were walking the trails of Izumi Nature Park, which season would you choose: spring with its cherry blossoms or autumn with its colorful leaves?

name: いなげの浜
desc: 千葉市美浜区のいなげの浜に到着しました。東京湾の埋め立て地につくられた人工の海浜で、遠浅の砂浜が長く続きます。都心から近いのに広々とした海辺が広がり、夕方には海越しに沈む夕日を眺めに多くの人が訪れます。潮風を感じながら砂浜を散歩して、湾岸の街の暮らしにふれてみてください。
quiz: いなげの浜で夕日を眺めるなら、どの季節の夕暮れがいちばん美しいと思う？
desc_en: You have arrived at Inage Beach in Mihama Ward, Chiba City. This artificial beach was created on reclaimed land in Tokyo Bay, with a long stretch of sand and gently shelving shallow water. Although it is close to central Tokyo, a spacious seashore opens up here, and in the evening many people come to watch the sun set over the sea. Stroll along the sand in the sea breeze and get a feel for life in this bayside city.
quiz_en: If you were watching the sunset at Inage Beach, in which season do you think the evening sky over the bay would look most beautiful?

name: 見浜園
desc: 幕張の海辺にある日本庭園、見浜園に到着しました。高層ビルが立ち並ぶ幕張新都心のすぐそばに、池を巡る回遊式の庭が静かに広がっています。水面に映る木々や石灯籠、茶室のたたずまいが落ち着いた雰囲気をつくり、四季の草花や紅葉も楽しめます。近未来的な街並みとの対比も見どころです。
quiz: 高層ビルのすぐ近くにある見浜園、庭園のどんな景色にいちばん心がなごむ？
desc_en: You have arrived at Mihama-en, a Japanese garden by the sea in Makuhari. Right beside the high-rise towers of Makuhari New City, a strolling garden quietly unfolds around a pond. Trees reflected on the water, stone lanterns and a teahouse create a calm atmosphere, and you can enjoy seasonal flowers and autumn leaves as well. The contrast with the futuristic cityscape nearby is another highlight.
quiz_en: Mihama-en sits right next to tall skyscrapers, so which part of the garden scenery do you think would make you feel most at peace?

name: 満願寺
desc: 太平洋に突き出た銚子の地にある満願寺に到着しました。銚子市天王台の高台に位置するお寺で、広い境内には立派な堂宇が建ち並んでいます。銚子は利根川の河口と外洋に囲まれた港町で、漁業と醤油づくりで栄えてきました。参拝のあとは港町らしい新鮮な魚料理も味わってみてください。
quiz: 銚子の満願寺を参拝したあと、港町銚子で食べてみたい海の幸は何？
desc_en: You have arrived at Mangan-ji, a temple in Choshi, a town that juts out into the Pacific Ocean. It stands on high ground in the Tennodai area of Choshi City, and its spacious grounds are lined with impressive halls. Choshi is a port town surrounded by the mouth of the Tone River and the open sea, and it has prospered through fishing and soy sauce making. After your visit, be sure to try some fresh seafood dishes typical of a port town.
quiz_en: After visiting Mangan-ji Temple, what kind of seafood would you most like to try in the lively fishing port town of Choshi?

name: 飯沼観音
desc: 銚子の街なかにある飯沼観音に到着しました。坂東三十三観音の第二十七番札所として知られ、古くから巡礼者や漁師町の人々の信仰を集めてきました。境内の周りには門前町が形づくられ、銚子の町の発展とともに歩んできたお寺です。朱色の堂塔を眺めながら、港町の歴史に思いをはせてみてください。
quiz: 銚子の飯沼観音は、坂東三十三観音霊場のうち第何番の札所でしょう？
desc_en: You have arrived at Iinuma Kannon in the heart of Choshi. It is known as the 27th temple of the Bando 33 Kannon pilgrimage, and since long ago it has drawn the faith of pilgrims and the people of this fishing town. A temple town grew up around its grounds, and the temple has developed together with the town of Choshi. Gaze at its vermilion halls and pagoda and reflect on the history of this port town.
quiz_en: Iinuma Kannon in Choshi is one of the temples on the Bando 33 Kannon pilgrimage route, so what number is it among those temples?

name: 猿田神社
desc: 銚子市猿田町の猿田神社に到着しました。道ひらきの神として知られる猿田彦大神を祀る神社で、うっそうとした社叢に囲まれた境内は厳かな空気に満ちています。物事のよい方向へ導く神様として、旅の安全や新たな門出を願って参拝する人も多くいます。旅の道中の無事をお願いしてみてください。
quiz: 猿田神社に祀られている、道ひらきの神として知られる神様の名前は？
desc_en: You have arrived at Saruta Shrine in Sarutacho, Choshi City. It enshrines Sarutahiko no Okami, known as a deity who opens the way, and its grounds, surrounded by a dense sacred grove, are filled with a solemn air. As a god who guides things in a good direction, he is visited by many people praying for safe travels or a fresh start. Why not pray here for a safe journey?
quiz_en: Saruta Shrine enshrines a deity known for opening the way and guiding travelers, so what is the name of this god?

name: 里見公園
desc: 市川市国府台の里見公園に到着しました。江戸川を見下ろす高台にあり、戦国時代に北条氏と里見氏が争った国府台合戦の舞台として知られています。園内は桜の名所で、春には多くの花見客でにぎわい、バラ園も見事です。川向こうに東京の街並みを眺めながら、歴史と花の公園を散策してください。
quiz: 里見公園の一帯は、戦国時代のある合戦の舞台です。その合戦の名前は？
desc_en: You have arrived at Satomi Park in Konodai, Ichikawa City. Set on a hill overlooking the Edogawa River, it is known as the site of the Battles of Konodai, fought between the Hojo and Satomi clans in the Sengoku (Warring States) period. The park is a famous cherry blossom spot that draws crowds of flower viewers in spring, and its rose garden is also superb. Stroll this park of history and flowers while gazing at Tokyo across the river.
quiz_en: The area around Satomi Park was the stage for a battle during the Warring States period, so what is the name of that battle?

name: 葛飾八幡宮（初詣除く）
desc: 市川市八幡の葛飾八幡宮に到着しました。下総国の総鎮守として古くから崇敬を集めてきた神社です。境内には「千本公孫樹」と呼ばれる大イチョウがそびえ、国の天然記念物に指定されています。秋になると黄金色に色づいた葉が境内を明るく照らし、多くの参拝者が見上げる名物の景色となります。
quiz: 葛飾八幡宮の境内にある、国の天然記念物の大イチョウは何と呼ばれている？
desc_en: You have arrived at Katsushika Hachimangu in Yawata, Ichikawa City. This shrine has long been revered as the chief guardian shrine of Shimousa Province. In its grounds towers a great ginkgo tree called the Senbon Icho, designated a National Natural Monument. In autumn its golden leaves brighten the grounds, creating a famous sight that many visitors stop to look up at.
quiz_en: In the grounds of Katsushika Hachimangu stands a giant ginkgo tree that is a National Natural Monument, so what is this tree called?

name: 観賞植物園
desc: 市川市大町の観賞植物園に到着しました。大町公園の自然豊かなエリアにある植物園で、温室では熱帯や亜熱帯の植物、屋外では季節の花々を楽しめます。周辺には谷津の湿地や雑木林が残り、市川市の動植物園とあわせて一日ゆっくり過ごせる場所です。珍しい草花をじっくり観察してみてください。
quiz: 植物園の温室で出会ったら思わず見入ってしまう、あなたの好きな花や植物は何？
desc_en: You have arrived at the Ornamental Plant Garden in Omachi, Ichikawa City. Located in a nature-rich part of Omachi Park, this botanical garden lets you enjoy tropical and subtropical plants in its greenhouse and seasonal flowers outdoors. Valley wetlands and mixed woods remain nearby, and together with Ichikawa's zoo and botanical park it is a place where you can spend a relaxed day. Take your time observing unusual plants and flowers.
quiz_en: If you came across it in the greenhouse of this botanical garden, which favorite flower or plant of yours would make you stop and stare?

name: 平砂浦海岸
desc: 館山市の平砂浦海岸に到着しました。房総半島の南端近く、太平洋に面して弓なりの砂浜が長く続く海岸です。外洋からの波が打ち寄せるためサーフィンの人気スポットとなっており、背後には防砂林と砂丘が広がります。温暖な南房総らしい明るい海辺で、潮風と波音を存分に味わってください。
quiz: 平砂浦海岸のような外洋に面した浜で、サーフィンの次にやってみたい海遊びは何？
desc_en: You have arrived at Heisaura Beach in Tateyama City. Near the southern tip of the Boso Peninsula, a long arc of sand stretches along the Pacific Ocean. Waves rolling in from the open sea make it a popular surfing spot, and behind the beach lie sand-break forests and dunes. This is a bright seaside typical of warm Minami-Boso, so enjoy the sea breeze and the sound of the waves to the fullest.
quiz_en: At a beach facing the open ocean like Heisaura, what other seaside activity would you like to try after surfing?

name: 鶴谷八幡宮
desc: 館山市八幡の鶴谷八幡宮に到着しました。安房国の総社として知られ、地元では親しみを込めて「八幡さま」と呼ばれています。毎年秋には「やわたんまち」と呼ばれる安房国司祭が行われ、各地から神輿や山車が集まって町は大いににぎわいます。安房の人々の暮らしに根づいた神社を訪ねてください。
quiz: 鶴谷八幡宮で秋に行われる安房国司祭は、地元で何と呼ばれている？
desc_en: You have arrived at Tsurugaya Hachimangu in Yawata, Tateyama City. Known as the soja (combined provincial shrine) of Awa Province, it is affectionately called Hachiman-sama by locals. Every autumn the Awa Kuni Shisai festival, known as Yawatanmachi, is held here, and portable shrines and festival floats gather from all over, filling the town with excitement. Visit a shrine rooted in the lives of the people of Awa.
quiz_en: The Awa Kuni Shisai festival held every autumn at Tsurugaya Hachimangu goes by an affectionate local name, so what do people call it?

name: 那古寺
desc: 館山市那古の那古寺に到着しました。坂東三十三観音の第三十三番札所、つまり巡礼を締めくくる結願の寺として知られています。山の中腹に堂宇が建ち、境内からは館山湾を見渡すことができます。関東各地を巡ってきた巡礼者がここで旅を終える、特別な思いのこもった場所です。
quiz: 坂東三十三観音の巡礼を締めくくる那古寺のような寺を、何の寺と呼ぶ？
desc_en: You have arrived at Nago-ji in Nago, Tateyama City. It is the 33rd temple of the Bando 33 Kannon pilgrimage, known as the kechigan temple where the pilgrimage is completed. Its halls stand partway up a mountain, and from the grounds you can look out over Tateyama Bay. This is a special place, full of emotion, where pilgrims who have traveled around the Kanto region end their journey.
quiz_en: A temple like Nago-ji, where the Bando 33 Kannon pilgrimage comes to its end, is given a special name, so what kind of temple is it called?

name: 赤山地下壕跡
desc: 館山市の赤山地下壕跡に到着しました。太平洋戦争の時代に館山の海軍航空隊の周辺に掘られた地下壕で、岩山の内部に通路が網の目のように延びています。ひんやりとした壕の中を歩くと、東京湾の入口を守る要地だった館山の歴史が身近に感じられます。静かに平和について考える場所です。
quiz: 赤山地下壕跡のような戦争遺跡を訪ねて、あなたがいちばん心に残ったことは何？
desc_en: You have arrived at the Akayama Underground Bunker Ruins in Tateyama City. These tunnels were dug around the Tateyama naval air base during the Pacific War, with passages branching like a web inside a rocky hill. Walking through the cool tunnels brings home the history of Tateyama, once a key point guarding the entrance to Tokyo Bay. It is a place to quietly reflect on peace.
quiz_en: When you visit war heritage sites like the Akayama Underground Bunker Ruins, what is the thing that stays with you most afterward?

name: 高蔵寺
desc: 木更津市矢那の高蔵寺に到着しました。坂東三十三観音の第三十番札所で、「高倉観音」の名でも親しまれています。緑深い丘陵に囲まれた境内には観音堂が建ち、木々の間を抜ける風が心地よく感じられます。巡礼者が今も訪れる古刹で、房総の里山の落ち着いた空気を味わってください。
quiz: 高蔵寺は坂東三十三観音の札所。この寺の観音さまは何観音の名で親しまれている？
desc_en: You have arrived at Kozo-ji in Yana, Kisarazu City. It is the 30th temple of the Bando 33 Kannon pilgrimage and is also fondly known as Takakura Kannon. Its Kannon hall stands in grounds surrounded by deep green hills, and the breeze through the trees feels refreshing. Pilgrims still visit this ancient temple today, so savor the calm air of the Boso countryside.
quiz_en: Kozo-ji is one of the Bando 33 Kannon pilgrimage temples, so by what other name is the Kannon of this temple affectionately known?

name: 證誠寺
desc: 木更津市富士見の證誠寺に到着しました。月夜に狸たちが腹つづみを打って踊ったという狸ばやしの伝説で知られ、童謡「証城寺の狸囃子」のモデルとなったお寺です。境内には狸にちなんだ塚もあり、子どもから大人まで楽しめます。思わず歌を口ずさみたくなる、ほほえましいお寺です。
quiz: 證誠寺の伝説をもとにした、狸が腹つづみを打つ有名な童謡のタイトルは？
desc_en: You have arrived at Shojo-ji in Fujimi, Kisarazu City. It is known for the legend of raccoon dogs (tanuki) that danced and drummed on their bellies on a moonlit night, and it inspired the children's song "Shojoji no Tanuki-bayashi." The grounds even have a mound dedicated to the tanuki, making it fun for children and adults alike. It is a charming temple that might make you start humming the song.
quiz_en: What is the title of the famous children's song, based on the legend of Shojo-ji, in which tanuki drum on their bellies?

name: 本土寺
desc: 松戸市平賀の本土寺に到着しました。日蓮宗の古刹で、「あじさい寺」として広く知られています。梅雨の時期には境内を何万株ものあじさいが埋め尽くし、青や紫の花が参道を彩ります。春の花しょうぶ、秋の紅葉も見事で、四季を通じて花の寺として多くの人が訪れます。雨の日の散策も風情があります。
quiz: 本土寺は花の寺として有名です。梅雨の時期に境内を彩る花から付いた別名は？
desc_en: You have arrived at Hondo-ji in Hiraga, Matsudo City. This ancient temple of the Nichiren sect is widely known as the Hydrangea Temple. During the rainy season, tens of thousands of hydrangeas fill the grounds, their blue and purple blossoms lining the approach. Irises in spring and autumn leaves are also splendid, so many people visit this temple of flowers all year round. A walk here on a rainy day has its own charm.
quiz_en: Hondo-ji is a famous temple of flowers, so what nickname does it get from the blossoms that fill its grounds in the rainy season?

name: 源泉七光台温泉
desc: 野田市七光台の源泉七光台温泉に到着しました。住宅街の中にある日帰りで楽しめる温泉で、旅の疲れを気軽に癒やすことができます。野田市は江戸時代から醤油づくりで栄えた町で、利根川と江戸川に挟まれた穏やかな土地です。湯上がりには醤油の町ならではの味を探してみてください。
quiz: 醤油の町・野田で温泉に入ったあと、醤油の香りが楽しめる料理なら何を食べたい？
desc_en: You have arrived at Gensen Nanakodai Onsen in Nanakodai, Noda City. This onsen (hot spring) in a residential area can be enjoyed on a day trip, an easy way to soothe your travel fatigue. Noda has prospered through soy sauce making since the Edo period, a peaceful land lying between the Tone and Edogawa rivers. After your bath, look for flavors that only a soy sauce town can offer.
quiz_en: After a soak at an onsen in Noda, the town of soy sauce, what dish would you like to eat that brings out the aroma of soy sauce?

name: 成田山新勝寺
desc: 成田山新勝寺に到着しました。不動明王を本尊とする真言宗智山派の大本山で、平安時代の平将門の乱の平定を祈ったことに始まると伝わります。初詣には全国有数の参拝者が訪れ、境内には大本堂や三重塔などが並びます。参道にはうなぎ料理の店が軒を連ね、門前町歩きも楽しみのひとつです。
quiz: 成田山新勝寺の表参道で、多くの店が名物として出している川魚の料理は何？
desc_en: You have arrived at Naritasan Shinsho-ji. It is a head temple of the Chisan school of Shingon Buddhism with Fudo Myoo as its principal image, and it is said to have begun with prayers for the suppression of Taira no Masakado's rebellion in the Heian period. It draws one of the largest numbers of New Year visitors in Japan, and its grounds hold the Great Main Hall and a three-story pagoda. Eel restaurants line the approach, and exploring the temple town is part of the fun.
quiz_en: Many shops along the main approach to Naritasan Shinsho-ji serve a famous river fish dish, so what kind of dish is it?

name: 小御門神社
desc: 成田市名古屋の小御門神社に到着しました。南北朝時代の公卿・藤原師賢を祀る神社で、杉などの大木が茂る深い社叢に囲まれています。境内は空気が澄み、参道を歩くだけで心が落ち着くような静けさがあります。成田山のにぎわいとはまた違う、北総の里山にたたずむ神社の趣を味わってください。
quiz: 深い森に囲まれた小御門神社の参道、歩いてみてどんな音や香りが印象に残った？
desc_en: You have arrived at Komikado Shrine in Nagoya, Narita City. It enshrines Fujiwara no Morokata, a court noble of the Nanboku-cho period, and is surrounded by a deep sacred grove of cedars and other great trees. The air in the grounds is clear, and the stillness makes your heart settle just by walking the approach. Enjoy the atmosphere of a shrine nestled in the countryside of northern Boso, quite different from the bustle of Naritasan.
quiz_en: Walking the approach to Komikado Shrine through its deep forest, what sounds or scents do you think would leave the strongest impression on you?

name: 佐倉武家屋敷
desc: 城下町佐倉の武家屋敷に到着しました。佐倉城の城下に残る鏑木小路には、江戸時代の武士の住まいが保存・公開されています。生け垣や土塁に囲まれた屋敷や、茅葺きの建物の中をのぞくと、当時の暮らしぶりがよくわかります。坂の多い城下町をゆっくり歩いて、侍の町の面影を感じてください。
quiz: 城下町佐倉で、武家屋敷が保存されている通りは何という名前の小路でしょう？
desc_en: You have arrived at the samurai residences of the castle town of Sakura. Along Kaburagi-koji, below Sakura Castle, the homes of Edo-period samurai are preserved and open to the public. Peek into residences surrounded by hedges and earthen walls, or the thatched-roof buildings, and you can clearly picture how people lived back then. Take a slow walk through this hilly castle town and feel the lingering traces of a samurai town.
quiz_en: In the castle town of Sakura, what is the name of the lane where the old samurai residences have been preserved for visitors?

name: 鎌数伊勢大神宮
desc: 旭市鎌数の鎌数伊勢大神宮に到着しました。伊勢の神様を祀る神社として地域の人々に大切にされてきました。旭市は九十九里浜の北端に位置し、広い平野に田畑が広がる農業と漁業の町です。のどかな田園の中に鎮座する神社で、土地の豊かな実りに感謝しながら参拝してみてください。
quiz: 九十九里浜に近い旭市、海と田畑の恵みでつくる名物なら何を味わってみたい？
desc_en: You have arrived at Kamakazu Ise Daijingu in Kamakazu, Asahi City. As a shrine dedicated to the deities of Ise, it has long been cherished by the local people. Asahi lies at the northern end of Kujukuri Beach, a town of farming and fishing with fields spreading across a broad plain. This shrine sits amid peaceful farmland, so pay your respects with gratitude for the land's rich harvests.
quiz_en: Asahi City lies near Kujukuri Beach, so what local specialty made from the bounty of the sea and fields would you like to taste?

name: 谷津バラ園
desc: 習志野市の谷津バラ園に到着しました。数多くの品種のバラが植えられた花の名所で、春と秋の見頃には園内が色とりどりの花と甘い香りに包まれます。アーチや花壇に咲くバラは種類ごとに形や色が異なり、見比べるのも楽しみです。近くには谷津干潟もあり、あわせて散策するのもおすすめです。
quiz: 谷津バラ園で見つけたい、あなたがいちばん好きなバラの色は何色？
desc_en: You have arrived at Yatsu Rose Garden in Narashino City. This famous flower spot is planted with a great many varieties of roses, and in peak seasons in spring and autumn the garden is wrapped in colorful blooms and sweet fragrance. The roses on arches and in flower beds differ in shape and color by variety, so comparing them is part of the fun. The Yatsu Tidal Flat is nearby, and exploring both together is recommended.
quiz_en: If you could find one at Yatsu Rose Garden among its many varieties, what color of rose would be your very favorite?

name: 誕生寺
desc: 鴨川市小湊の誕生寺に到着しました。日蓮聖人の生誕の地に建てられた日蓮宗の大本山で、立派な仁王門や祖師堂が並びます。目の前の海は鯛の浦と呼ばれ、タイの群れが見られる場所として国の特別天然記念物に指定されています。お参りのあとは遊覧船で鯛の浦を巡るのも楽しみです。
quiz: 誕生寺の前に広がる、タイの群れで知られる特別天然記念物の海域は何と呼ばれる？
desc_en: You have arrived at Tanjo-ji in Kominato, Kamogawa City. A head temple of the Nichiren sect built at the birthplace of the priest Nichiren, it has an impressive Nio gate and founder's hall. The sea in front is called Tainoura, designated a Special Natural Monument as a place where schools of sea bream can be seen. After your visit, a sightseeing boat tour around Tainoura is another treat.
quiz_en: The sea in front of Tanjo-ji is a Special Natural Monument famous for schools of sea bream, so what is this stretch of water called?

name: 清澄寺
desc: 鴨川市清澄の清澄寺に到着しました。清澄山の山上にある古刹で、日蓮聖人が修行し、立教開宗を宣言した地として知られています。境内には樹齢を重ねた巨大な「千年杉」がそびえ、深い森の空気に満ちています。山上から昇る朝日を拝んだ日蓮聖人にならい、早朝に訪れるのもおすすめです。
quiz: 清澄寺の境内にそびえる、長い年月を重ねてきた巨大な杉は何と呼ばれている？
desc_en: You have arrived at Seicho-ji in Kiyosumi, Kamogawa City. This ancient temple atop Mount Kiyosumi is known as the place where Nichiren trained and declared the founding of his teaching. In the grounds towers an enormous old cedar called the Sennen Sugi (Thousand-Year Cedar), and the air is that of a deep forest. Following Nichiren, who worshipped the sunrise from this mountaintop, an early-morning visit is recommended.
quiz_en: In the grounds of Seicho-ji towers a giant cedar that has stood for a very long time, so what is this great tree called?

name: 仁右衛門島
desc: 鴨川市太海の仁右衛門島に到着しました。岸からすぐ近くに浮かぶ小島で、代々平野仁右衛門を名乗る一家が所有し、手漕ぎの渡し船で渡ります。島には源頼朝が隠れたという伝説の洞窟などがあり、岩場から眺める太平洋は迫力満点です。ぎいぎいと櫓をこぐ音を聞きながらの船旅も楽しんでください。
quiz: 鴨川の仁右衛門島へ渡るとき、観光客が乗るのはどんな方法で進む渡し船でしょう？
desc_en: You have arrived at Niemonjima in Futomi, Kamogawa City. This small island floats just off the shore, owned by a family whose heads have taken the name Hirano Niemon for generations, and you cross by hand-rowed ferry. The island has a cave where Minamoto no Yoritomo is said to have hidden, and the view of the Pacific from its rocks is breathtaking. Enjoy the boat ride as you listen to the creak of the oar.
quiz_en: When visitors cross over to Niemonjima Island in Kamogawa, how is the little ferry boat they ride on moved across the water?

name: 鏡忍寺
desc: 鴨川市広場の鏡忍寺に到着しました。日蓮聖人が襲撃を受けた「小松原法難」の地に建つ日蓮宗の寺院で、聖人を守ろうとして命を落とした人々を弔う場として受け継がれてきました。のどかな田園と山に囲まれた境内は静かで、歴史の舞台に立っていることを感じさせます。
quiz: 鏡忍寺が建つ地で、日蓮聖人が襲撃を受けた出来事は何と呼ばれている？
desc_en: You have arrived at Kyonin-ji in Hiroba, Kamogawa City. This Nichiren-sect temple stands at the site of the Komatsubara Persecution, where Nichiren was attacked, and it has been passed down as a place to mourn those who died trying to protect him. Its grounds, surrounded by peaceful fields and mountains, are quiet and make you feel that you are standing at a stage of history.
quiz_en: At the site where Kyonin-ji now stands, the priest Nichiren was once attacked, so what is that historic incident called today?

name: 鴨川松島
desc: 鴨川市の鴨川松島に到着しました。海岸の沖に大小の島々が点在し、その景色が日本三景の松島を思わせることからこの名で呼ばれています。島の上に松が生える姿は外房ならではの趣があり、朝日が島々の間から昇る光景は格別です。海沿いを歩いて、変化に富んだ眺めを楽しんでください。
quiz: 鴨川松島の名前の由来になった、日本三景のひとつに数えられる場所はどこ？
desc_en: You have arrived at Kamogawa Matsushima in Kamogawa City. Large and small islands dot the sea off the coast, and because the scenery recalls Matsushima, one of Japan's Three Great Views, it came to be called by this name. The pine-topped islands have a charm unique to the Sotobo coast, and the sight of the sun rising between them is exceptional. Walk along the shore and enjoy the ever-changing views.
quiz_en: Kamogawa Matsushima is named after a place counted among the Three Great Views of Japan, so where is that famous place?

name: 三石観音寺
desc: 君津市草川原の三石観音寺に到着しました。三石山の山頂近くに建つお寺で、巨大な岩が重なり合う独特の景観で知られています。岩の間に堂が組み込まれるように建ち、自然と信仰が一体となった神秘的な雰囲気です。房総の山並みを見渡す眺めもよく、山歩きをかねて参拝するのも楽しいところです。
quiz: 三石観音寺の境内で、思わず見上げてしまうほどの見どころといえば何？
desc_en: You have arrived at Mitsuishi Kannon-ji in Kusagawara, Kimitsu City. This temple stands near the summit of Mount Mitsuishi and is known for its unique scenery of huge piled-up boulders. Its hall is built as if fitted between the rocks, creating a mystical atmosphere where nature and faith are one. The views over the Boso mountains are fine too, so combining a visit with a hike is enjoyable.
quiz_en: In the grounds of Mitsuishi Kannon-ji, what is the most striking sight that makes visitors stop and look up in amazement?

name: 富津公園
desc: 富津市の富津公園に到着しました。東京湾に細長く突き出した富津岬にある公園で、先端には五葉松をかたどった展望台が建っています。展望台からは東京湾をはさんで三浦半島や横浜方面を望み、空気の澄んだ日には富士山も見えます。潮干狩りの季節には海辺も大にぎわいです。
quiz: 富津岬の先端にある展望台は、何という木の形をかたどっている？
desc_en: You have arrived at Futtsu Park in Futtsu City. The park lies on Cape Futtsu, which juts out long and narrow into Tokyo Bay, and at its tip stands an observation tower shaped like a five-needle pine. From the tower you can see the Miura Peninsula and Yokohama across the bay, and on clear days even Mount Fuji. In clam-digging season, the shore is packed with people.
quiz_en: The observation tower at the tip of Cape Futtsu was designed in the shape of a particular tree, so which kind of tree is it?

name: 東京湾観音
desc: 富津市小久保の東京湾観音に到着しました。丘の上に立つ白い巨大な観音像で、平和を願って建てられました。像の内部には階段があり、胎内を巡りながら上へ登ることができます。高い位置にある展望窓からは東京湾や房総の山々が一望でき、晴れた日には富士山まで見渡せます。
quiz: 東京湾観音の像の中を登っていくと、窓からどんな景色が見えた？
desc_en: You have arrived at Tokyo Bay Kannon in Kokubo, Futtsu City. This huge white statue of Kannon stands on a hill and was built as a prayer for peace. Inside the statue are stairs, letting you climb upward as you make your way through its interior. From viewing windows high up, you can take in Tokyo Bay and the Boso mountains, and on clear days you can see all the way to Mount Fuji.
quiz_en: As you climb up through the inside of the Tokyo Bay Kannon statue, what kind of view do you see from its windows?

name: 袖ケ浦公園
desc: 袖ケ浦市飯富の袖ケ浦公園に到着しました。大きな池を中心に広がる緑豊かな公園で、水辺の花や季節の木々を眺めながら散策できます。池には水鳥が集まり、のんびりと過ごす家族連れの姿も見られます。袖ケ浦市は東京湾岸の工業地帯と内陸の田園が共存する町で、公園はその穏やかな一面を見せてくれます。
quiz: 袖ケ浦公園の池のほとりでのんびりするなら、どんな季節の花を眺めたい？
desc_en: You have arrived at Sodegaura Park in Obu, Sodegaura City. This green park spreads around a large pond, and you can stroll while admiring waterside flowers and seasonal trees. Waterfowl gather on the pond, and families can be seen relaxing here. Sodegaura is a town where an industrial zone along Tokyo Bay coexists with inland farmland, and the park shows its gentle side.
quiz_en: If you were relaxing beside the pond in Sodegaura Park, which season's flowers would you most like to gaze at there?

name: 百目木公園
desc: 袖ケ浦市の百目木公園に到着しました。房総の丘陵地に広がる公園で、緑の中で体を動かしたり、のんびり散歩したりと思い思いに過ごせます。周辺には里山の風景や田畑が残り、季節によって木々の色合いが移り変わります。地元の人に親しまれる憩いの場で、ひと休みしてから旅を続けてください。
quiz: 百目木公園のような里山の公園で、あなたがいちばん好きな過ごし方は何？
desc_en: You have arrived at Domeki Park in Sodegaura City. Spreading over the hills of Boso, it is a park where you can spend time as you like, whether getting some exercise in the greenery or taking a leisurely walk. Countryside scenery and fields remain in the area, and the colors of the trees change with the seasons. It is a resting spot loved by locals, so take a break here before continuing your journey.
quiz_en: In a countryside park like Domeki Park surrounded by satoyama scenery, what is your favorite way to spend the time?

name: 石橋農園
desc: 袖ケ浦市三箇の石橋農園に到着しました。袖ケ浦市は都心に近い一方で、内陸部に畑や果樹園が広がる農業の盛んな地域です。農園では季節に合わせた作物の収穫を楽しめ、とれたての味は格別です。畑の土の香りや、自分の手で摘み取る楽しさを味わいながら、房総の豊かな実りを体験してください。
quiz: 農園で自分の手で収穫するなら、あなたがいちばん摘んでみたい果物や野菜は何？
desc_en: You have arrived at Ishibashi Farm in Sanga, Sodegaura City. While Sodegaura is close to central Tokyo, it is also a thriving farming area, with fields and orchards spreading across its inland parts. At the farm you can enjoy harvesting seasonal crops, and the taste of freshly picked produce is exceptional. Savor the smell of the soil and the joy of picking with your own hands as you experience the rich harvests of Boso.
quiz_en: If you were harvesting with your own hands at a farm like this, which fruit or vegetable would you most like to pick?

name: 大房岬
addr: 南房総市富浦町多田良
desc: 南房総市富浦町の大房岬に到着しました。東京湾の入口近くに突き出した岬で、全体が自然公園として整備されています。照葉樹の森や断崖、磯の風景が変化に富み、展望台からは東京湾越しに富士山を望むこともできます。かつての軍事施設の跡も残り、自然と歴史の両方を感じられる岬です。
quiz: 大房岬の展望台から、東京湾越しに晴れた日に見える日本一の山はどこ？
desc_en: You have arrived at Taibusa Cape in Tomiura, Minamiboso City. This cape juts out near the entrance to Tokyo Bay, and the whole area is maintained as a nature park. Evergreen broadleaf forests, cliffs and rocky shores offer varied scenery, and from the observation deck you may even see Mount Fuji across the bay. Remains of former military facilities are also found here, so you can feel both nature and history on this cape.
quiz_en: From the observation deck at Taibusa Cape, which is Japan's highest mountain that you can see across Tokyo Bay on clear days?

name: 厳島神社
desc: 房総半島の南端、南房総市白浜の厳島神社に到着しました。厳島の名を持つ神社は、海や水にゆかりのある市杵島姫命を祀ることが多く、海とともに暮らしてきた白浜の人々の信仰を感じさせます。白浜は海女漁や花づくりで知られる温暖な土地で、海辺の景色とあわせて参拝してください。
quiz: 房総半島の南端・白浜で、海辺を歩いたら探してみたい海の名物は何？
desc_en: You have arrived at Itsukushima Shrine in Shirahama, Minamiboso City, at the southern tip of the Boso Peninsula. Shrines bearing the name Itsukushima often enshrine Ichikishimahime no Mikoto, a goddess connected with the sea and water, reflecting the faith of Shirahama's people, who have lived alongside the sea. Shirahama is a warm land known for ama (women free divers) and flower growing, so pair your visit with the seaside scenery.
quiz_en: In Shirahama at the southern tip of the Boso Peninsula, what local specialty of the sea would you like to look for while walking along the shore?

name: 高家神社
addr: 南房総市千倉町南朝夷164
desc: 南房総市千倉町の高家神社に到着しました。料理の神様である磐鹿六雁命を祀る、全国でも珍しい神社です。料理人や食品関係者の信仰が厚く、境内では古式にのっとり、手を触れずに包丁と箸で魚をさばく「包丁式」が奉納されます。食の旅の無事と、おいしい出会いを祈ってみてください。
quiz: 高家神社で奉納される、手を触れずに包丁と箸で魚をさばく儀式は何と呼ばれる？
desc_en: You have arrived at Takabe Shrine in Chikura, Minamiboso City. It is a rare shrine in Japan that enshrines Iwaka Mutsukari no Mikoto, the god of cooking. It is deeply revered by chefs and people in the food industry, and in its grounds a hocho-shiki ceremony is offered, in which a fish is prepared in the ancient manner using only a knife and chopsticks, without touching it by hand. Pray for a safe food journey and delicious encounters.
quiz_en: At Takabe Shrine, a ritual is offered in which a fish is prepared with only a knife and chopsticks, never touched by hand, so what is it called?

name: 真野寺
desc: 南房総市久保の真野寺に到着しました。房総の丘陵に抱かれた古いお寺で、木々に囲まれた静かな境内が広がっています。南房総は温暖な気候に恵まれ、早春から花が咲き始める土地として知られています。のどかな里山の道を歩いてたどり着く古刹で、ゆったりとした時間の流れを感じてください。
quiz: 南房総の里山にある古いお寺を訪ねたら、境内で探してみたいものは何？
desc_en: You have arrived at Shinno-ji in Kubo, Minamiboso City. This old temple is cradled in the hills of Boso, with quiet grounds surrounded by trees. Minamiboso is blessed with a warm climate and known as a land where flowers start blooming in early spring. Reached by walking along a peaceful country road, this ancient temple lets you feel the gentle flow of time.
quiz_en: If you visited an old temple in the countryside of Minamiboso, what would you like to look for as you wander around its grounds?

name: 石堂寺
desc: 南房総市石堂の石堂寺に到着しました。房総でも有数の古刹とされ、山あいの境内には本堂や多宝塔など歴史ある建物が残っています。静かな山里にたたずむ堂塔は落ち着いた美しさがあり、新緑や紅葉の季節には周囲の木々と見事に調和します。古建築の細部をじっくり眺めてみてください。
quiz: 石堂寺に残る古い堂塔のなかで、上下で形の違う二層の塔は何と呼ばれる？
desc_en: You have arrived at Ishido-ji in Ishido, Minamiboso City. It is regarded as one of the oldest temples in Boso, and its mountain grounds retain historic buildings such as the main hall and a tahoto pagoda. The halls standing in this quiet mountain village have a serene beauty, harmonizing wonderfully with the surrounding trees in the seasons of fresh green and autumn leaves. Take time to admire the details of the old architecture.
quiz_en: Among the old buildings at Ishido-ji, what is the two-story pagoda with different shapes on its upper and lower levels called?

name: 小松寺
desc: 南房総市千倉町大貫の小松寺に到着しました。房総の山あいにある古いお寺で、渓流と木々に囲まれた境内は四季折々の美しさを見せてくれます。新緑の季節には緑が目にまぶしく、秋には紅葉が山を彩ります。海の町として知られる千倉の、山側の静かな表情にふれられる場所です。
quiz: 海の町・千倉の山側にある小松寺、紅葉と新緑ならどちらの季節に訪ねたい？
desc_en: You have arrived at Komatsu-ji in Onuki, Chikura, Minamiboso City. This old temple lies in the Boso mountains, and its grounds, surrounded by a mountain stream and trees, show a different beauty in each season. In the season of fresh greenery the leaves are dazzling, and in autumn colorful foliage adorns the hills. It is a place to discover the quiet mountain side of Chikura, a town known for the sea.
quiz_en: Komatsu-ji sits on the mountain side of the seaside town of Chikura, so would you rather visit it in the fresh green season or in autumn?

name: 日運寺
desc: 南房総市加茂の日運寺に到着しました。房総の丘陵にたたずむお寺で、季節の花が境内を彩ります。南房総市は温暖な気候で花の栽培が盛んな地域であり、里山を歩けば田畑と森が織りなす穏やかな風景が広がります。お寺の静けさに身をゆだね、旅の途中のひと息をついてください。
quiz: 花の栽培が盛んな南房総で、あなたがいちばん見てみたい季節の花は何？
