desc_en: You have arrived at the Kirinzan Castle ruins in Tsugawa, Aga Town. These are the remains of a mountain castle built atop Mount Kirin, rising at the confluence of the Agano and Tokonami rivers, which controlled a key route linking Aizu and Echigo. The mountain, with cliffs dropping to the river, is also known as a scenic spot. Tsugawa is a town with legends of foxes, and every spring a fox wedding procession is held.
quiz_en: In the town of Tsugawa at the foot of Mount Kirin, what fox-themed procession is held every spring?

name: 中ノ沢渓谷森林公園
desc: 阿賀町の中ノ沢渓谷森林公園に到着しました。山あいの渓谷に沿って整備された森林公園で、清らかな沢の流れと森の緑に囲まれて過ごせます。夏は川遊びやキャンプ、秋は紅葉の散策が楽しめ、自然を身近に感じられる場所です。せせらぎの音を聞きながら、阿賀の山里の静けさを味わってください。
quiz: 渓谷の森林公園で過ごすなら、川遊びとキャンプのどちらをいちばん楽しみたい？
desc_en: You have arrived at Nakanosawa Gorge Forest Park in Aga Town. This forest park, laid out along a mountain gorge, lets you spend time surrounded by a clear stream and green forest. In summer you can enjoy playing in the river and camping, and in autumn walks among the colored leaves, making it a place to feel close to nature. Listen to the murmuring stream and savor the quiet of Aga's mountain villages.
quiz_en: If you spent time at a gorge forest park like this one, which would you enjoy more: playing in the river or camping?

name: 御神楽岳
desc: 阿賀町の御神楽岳に到着しました。新潟と福島の県境近くにある山で、切り立った岩壁を持つ険しい姿から、越後の岩の山として登山者に知られています。山頂へは体力を要しますが、稜線からは周囲の山々を見渡す大展望が広がります。山の神が神楽を舞ったという名の響きにも、山深い土地の神秘を感じます。
quiz: 切り立った岩壁が迫る山に登ったら、山頂でいちばん見てみたい景色は何？
desc_en: You have arrived at Mount Mikagura in Aga Town. This mountain near the border between Niigata and Fukushima is known among climbers as a rock mountain of Echigo for its rugged form with sheer rock walls. Reaching the summit takes stamina, but the ridges offer a grand view of the surrounding mountains. In the sound of its name, which tells of a mountain god dancing kagura (sacred dance), you can sense the mystery of this deep mountain land.
quiz_en: If you climbed a mountain with sheer rock walls rising around you, what view would you most want to see from the summit?

name: 小木の城跡
desc: 出雲崎町の小木の城跡に到着しました。出雲崎は日本海に面した港町で、江戸時代には佐渡の金銀を本土へ陸揚げする港として栄え、北国街道の宿場町としてもにぎわいました。良寛の生誕地としても知られています。丘陵に残る城跡を訪ねながら、港町の歴史の奥行きを感じてください。
quiz: 出雲崎で生まれた、子どもたちと手まりをついて遊んだと伝わる江戸時代の僧は誰？
desc_en: You have arrived at the Ogi castle ruins in Izumozaki Town. Izumozaki is a port town on the Sea of Japan that prospered in the Edo period as the port where gold and silver from Sado were unloaded onto the mainland, and it also thrived as a post town on the Hokkoku Kaido highway. It is also known as the birthplace of Ryokan. Visit the castle ruins in the hills and feel the depth of this port town's history.
quiz_en: Who was the Edo-period monk, born in Izumozaki, who is said to have played with temari balls together with local children?

name: 谷川岳
desc: 湯沢町の谷川岳に到着しました。新潟と群馬の県境にそびえる山で、日本百名山のひとつです。一ノ倉沢の大岩壁に代表される険しい岩場は、多くのクライマーを引きつけてきました。群馬側からはロープウェイで中腹まで上がれ、山頂の双耳峰からは上越国境の山並みを一望できます。
quiz: 谷川岳の山頂は二つの峰が並んでいます。このような形の山を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: You have arrived at Mount Tanigawa in Yuzawa Town. This mountain rising on the border between Niigata and Gunma is one of Japan's 100 Famous Mountains. Its rugged rock faces, exemplified by the great wall of Ichinokurasawa, have attracted many climbers. From the Gunma side you can ride a ropeway partway up, and from the twin peaks of the summit you can take in the mountains along the Joshu-Echigo border.
quiz_en: The summit of Mount Tanigawa has two peaks standing side by side, so what is a mountain with this kind of shape called?

name: 苗場山頂周辺の湿原
desc: 湯沢町の苗場山頂周辺の湿原に到着しました。苗場山の山頂部はなだらかな台地になっており、一面に湿原が広がって無数の池塘が点在しています。池塘が田んぼのように見えることが、苗場という山名の由来とも言われます。木道を歩けば夏は高山植物が咲き、天空の楽園のような景色が広がります。
quiz: 苗場山の山頂湿原に点在する、小さな池のような水たまりを何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: You have arrived at the wetlands around the summit of Mount Naeba in Yuzawa Town. The summit of Mount Naeba forms a gentle plateau covered in wetlands dotted with countless small ponds. It is said that these ponds, which look like rice paddies, are the origin of the mountain's name, Naeba (seedling field). Walk the boardwalks and in summer alpine flowers bloom, revealing scenery like a paradise in the sky.
quiz_en: What are the small pond-like pools of water called that dot the wetlands on the summit of Mount Naeba?

name: おわら風の盆
desc: 富山市八尾のおわら風の盆に到着しました。毎年九月一日から三日にかけて行われる行事で、坂の多い町並みを、編み笠を目深にかぶった踊り手たちが静かに踊り歩きます。胡弓や三味線が奏でる哀調を帯びた越中おわら節の調べが夜の町に響き、ぼんぼりの明かりが幻想的な雰囲気をつくり出します。
quiz: おわら風の盆の伴奏で、三味線とともに哀愁ある音色を奏でる、弓で弾く弦楽器は何？
desc_en: You have arrived at the Owara Kaze no Bon in Yatsuo, Toyama City. Held every year from September 1 to 3, it sees dancers with straw hats pulled low over their faces dance quietly through the sloping streets. The melancholy tunes of Etchu Owara-bushi, played on the kokyu and shamisen, echo through the night town, while the light of paper lanterns creates a dreamlike atmosphere.
quiz_en: In the music of Owara Kaze no Bon, what bowed stringed instrument plays sorrowful tones together with the shamisen?

name: 富山湾の蜃気楼
desc: 富山湾の蜃気楼に到着しました。春から初夏にかけて、冷たい海水と暖かい空気の温度差によって、対岸の街並みや船が伸びたり逆さまに見えたりする不思議な現象が見られます。富山湾は蜃気楼の名所として古くから知られ、とくに魚津の海岸が観察地として有名です。運が良ければ幻の景色に出会えます。
quiz: 富山湾の蜃気楼が見られやすいのは、一年のうちどの季節でしょう？
desc_en: You have arrived to see the mirages of Toyama Bay. From spring to early summer, the temperature difference between cold seawater and warm air causes a mysterious phenomenon in which the towns and ships on the opposite shore appear stretched or upside down. Toyama Bay has long been known as a famous mirage spot, and the coast of Uozu is particularly well known as a viewing place. If you are lucky, you may encounter this phantom scenery.
quiz_en: During which season of the year are mirages most likely to be seen over Toyama Bay, especially from the coast of Uozu?

name: 雲ノ平
desc: 北アルプスの雲ノ平に到着しました。黒部川の源流を囲む山々の奥にある溶岩台地で、どの登山口からも長い道のりを要することから「日本最後の秘境」とも呼ばれます。高原には木道が延び、夏には高山植物が咲き、周囲を名峰がぐるりと囲みます。たどり着いた人だけが見られる、雲上の楽園の景色です。
quiz: 北アルプスの奥深くにあり、たどり着くのが大変な雲ノ平は何と呼ばれている？
desc_en: You have arrived at Kumonotaira in the Northern Alps. This lava plateau lies deep among the mountains surrounding the headwaters of the Kurobe River, and because it takes a long journey from any trailhead, it is also called Japan's last unexplored wilderness. Boardwalks stretch across the plateau, alpine flowers bloom in summer, and famous peaks encircle it. This is the scenery of a paradise above the clouds that only those who make it here can see.
quiz_en: Kumonotaira lies deep in the Northern Alps and is very hard to reach, so what is it often called because of this?

name: 薬師岳
desc: 富山市の薬師岳に到着しました。北アルプスの中央部にそびえる標高二九二六メートルの山で、日本百名山に数えられます。東面には氷河が削ってできたカールと呼ばれる地形がいくつも並び、国の特別天然記念物に指定されています。どっしりとした山容と、雄大な稜線歩きが登山者を魅了します。
quiz: 薬師岳の東面に並ぶ、氷河が削ってできたお椀のような地形を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: You have arrived at Mount Yakushi in Toyama City. Rising 2,926 meters in the central Northern Alps, it is counted among Japan's 100 Famous Mountains. On its eastern face, several landforms called cirques, carved out by glaciers, line up and are designated a Special Natural Monument. Its massive form and magnificent ridge walks captivate climbers.
quiz_en: What are the bowl-shaped landforms called that were carved out by glaciers and line up along the eastern face of Mount Yakushi?

name: 白馬三山
desc: 北アルプス北部の白馬三山に到着しました。白馬岳、杓子岳、白馬鑓ヶ岳の三つの峰からなり、富山と長野の県境に連なっています。夏は稜線一帯に高山植物のお花畑が広がり、長野側の白馬大雪渓は登山者に人気のルートです。三つの峰を縦走すれば、北アルプスの雄大な眺めを存分に味わえます。
quiz: 白馬三山を構成する三つの峰は、白馬岳、白馬鑓ヶ岳ともうひとつはどこ？
desc_en: You have arrived at the Hakuba Sanzan in the northern Northern Alps. Made up of three peaks, Mount Shirouma, Mount Shakushi and Mount Hakuba Yari, they line the border between Toyama and Nagano. In summer, alpine flower fields spread along the ridges, and the Hakuba Daisekkei snowfield on the Nagano side is a popular route for climbers. Traverse all three peaks and you can fully enjoy the grand views of the Northern Alps.
quiz_en: The Hakuba Sanzan are made up of three peaks, so besides Mount Shirouma and Mount Hakuba Yari, what is the third one?

name: 黒部峡谷
desc: 黒部峡谷に到着しました。北アルプスの間を黒部川が深く削った日本有数のV字峡谷で、切り立った岩壁が両岸にそびえます。宇奈月温泉から欅平まではトロッコ電車が走り、鉄橋やトンネルを抜けながらエメラルド色の渓流を眺められます。秋には山肌が紅葉に染まり、峡谷全体が見事な彩りに包まれます。
quiz: 宇奈月温泉から黒部峡谷の奥へと観光客を運ぶ、小さな列車は何と呼ばれる？
desc_en: You have arrived at Kurobe Gorge. Carved deep through the Northern Alps by the Kurobe River, it is one of Japan's foremost V-shaped gorges, with sheer rock walls towering on both banks. The trolley train runs from Unazuki Onsen to Keyakidaira, letting you view the emerald stream as you pass over iron bridges and through tunnels. In autumn the mountainsides are dyed with colorful leaves, wrapping the whole gorge in magnificent color.
quiz_en: What is the name of the small train that carries sightseers from Unazuki Onsen deep into Kurobe Gorge?

name: 城端曳山祭
desc: 南砺市の城端曳山祭に到着しました。毎年五月に行われる城端神明宮の祭礼で、豪華な彫刻や漆塗りで飾られた曳山が町を巡ります。曳山の前を行く庵屋台からは、粋な庵唄が笛や三味線とともに流れます。ユネスコ無形文化遺産「山・鉾・屋台行事」のひとつにも登録された、絹織物で栄えた町の華やかな祭りです。
quiz: 城端曳山祭で、庵屋台から笛や三味線にのせて流れる唄は何と呼ばれる？
desc_en: You have arrived at the Johana Hikiyama Festival in Nanto City. Held every May as the festival of Johana Shinmeigu Shrine, it features hikiyama floats adorned with lavish carvings and lacquer touring the town. From the iori-yatai stalls leading the floats, stylish iori-uta songs flow along with flutes and shamisen. Registered as part of the UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage Yama, Hoko, Yatai float festivals, it is the splendid festival of a town that prospered through silk weaving.
quiz_en: At the Johana Hikiyama Festival, what are the songs called that flow from the iori-yatai stalls with flute and shamisen accompaniment?

name: 五箇山合掌造り集落
desc: 南砺市の五箇山合掌造り集落に到着しました。相倉と菅沼の二つの集落は、岐阜県の白川郷とともに世界文化遺産に登録されています。急勾配の茅葺き屋根の家々が山あいに寄り添い、冬には雪に包まれた幻想的な光景となります。五箇山は和紙づくりや民謡「こきりこ節」でも知られ、昔ながらの暮らしの知恵が息づいています。
quiz: 五箇山に伝わる、ささらを鳴らして踊る日本最古ともいわれる民謡は何？
desc_en: You have arrived at the Gokayama gassho-zukuri villages in Nanto City. The two villages of Ainokura and Suganuma are registered as a World Cultural Heritage site together with Shirakawa-go in Gifu Prefecture. Houses with steep thatched roofs nestle together in the mountains, becoming a dreamlike scene wrapped in snow in winter. Gokayama is also known for washi paper making and the folk song Kokiriko-bushi, and traditional wisdom for living lives on here.
quiz_en: What folk song from Gokayama, danced while sounding the sasara clapper, is said to be one of the oldest folk songs in Japan?

name: 剱岳
desc: 上市町の剱岳に到着しました。標高二九九九メートル、岩と雪の殿堂とも呼ばれる険しい岩峰で、日本の登山者の憧れの山です。明治時代に測量隊が登頂した際、山頂で古い錫杖の頭などが見つかったという出来事は小説や映画「劔岳 点の記」でも描かれました。鋭くそそり立つ山容は見る者を圧倒します。
quiz: 剱岳の初登頂をめぐる明治の測量隊を描いた、新田次郎の小説の題名は何？
desc_en: You have arrived at Mount Tsurugi in Kamiichi Town. At 2,999 meters, this rugged rocky peak, also called a temple of rock and snow, is a mountain Japanese climbers long to climb. When a Meiji-era survey team reached the summit, they reportedly found the head of an old monk's staff and other items, an episode depicted in the novel and film Tsurugidake: Ten no Ki. Its sharply soaring form overwhelms all who see it.
quiz_en: What is the title of the novel by Nitta Jiro depicting the Meiji-era survey team and the first recorded ascent of Mount Tsurugi?

name: 黒部第四ダム
desc: 立山町の黒部ダムに到着しました。昭和三十年代に難工事の末に完成したアーチ式ダムで、堤の高さは日本一を誇ります。夏から秋にかけて行われる観光放水では、毎秒十トン以上の水が轟音とともに噴き出し、水しぶきに虹がかかることもあります。立山黒部アルペンルートの見どころとして、多くの旅人が訪れます。
quiz: 黒部ダムで夏から秋にかけて行われる、勢いよく水を噴き出すイベントは何と呼ばれる？
desc_en: You have arrived at Kurobe Dam in Tateyama Town. Completed in the 1960s after an extremely difficult construction, this arch dam boasts the tallest embankment in Japan. During the sightseeing water discharge held from summer to autumn, over ten tons of water per second gush out with a roar, and rainbows sometimes appear in the spray. As a highlight of the Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route, it attracts many travelers.
quiz_en: What is the event called, held at Kurobe Dam from summer to autumn, in which water gushes out powerfully for visitors to see?

name: 立山のライチョウ
desc: 立山のライチョウに到着しました。ライチョウは高山帯にすむ国の特別天然記念物の鳥で、立山の室堂周辺はその姿に出会いやすい場所として知られています。夏は褐色まだら、冬は真っ白な羽に衣替えし、天敵から身を守ります。登山道でハイマツの陰から現れる姿は、高山を訪れた人へのご褒美です。
quiz: 特別天然記念物の立山のライチョウは、冬になると羽の色が何色に変わる？
desc_en: You have arrived to see the raicho (rock ptarmigan) of Tateyama. The ptarmigan is a bird of the alpine zone designated a Special Natural Monument, and the area around Murodo on Tateyama is known as a good place to encounter it. It changes its plumage to mottled brown in summer and pure white in winter, protecting itself from predators. Seeing one appear from the shade of creeping pines along the trail is a reward for visitors to the high mountains.
quiz_en: The rock ptarmigan of Tateyama is a Special Natural Monument, so what color do its feathers change to when winter arrives?

name: 称名滝
desc: 立山町の称名滝に到着しました。立山の弥陀ヶ原台地から流れ落ちる滝で、落差は約三五〇メートルと日本一を誇り、日本の滝百選にも選ばれています。四段に折れながら落ちる水は轟音を響かせ、雪解けの季節には水量が増して迫力が一段と増します。春から初夏には隣にハンノキ滝が現れ、二筋の滝が並びます。
quiz: 立山の称名滝の落差は約何メートルで、日本一を誇っているでしょう？
desc_en: You have arrived at Shomyo Falls in Tateyama Town. Plunging from the Midagahara plateau of Tateyama, it boasts a drop of about 350 meters, the highest in Japan, and is one of Japan's 100 Best Waterfalls. The water falls in four stages with a thunderous roar, and in the snowmelt season its volume increases, making it even more powerful. From spring to early summer, Hannoki Falls appears beside it, and two streams fall side by side.
quiz_en: Shomyo Falls on Tateyama boasts the greatest drop of any waterfall in Japan, so roughly how many meters is that drop?

name: 立山
desc: 立山に到着しました。富士山、白山と並ぶ日本三霊山のひとつで、最高峰の大汝山や雄山を中心とした峰々の総称です。立山黒部アルペンルートを使えば標高約二四五〇メートルの室堂まで乗り物で上がれ、春には雪の壁がそびえる「雪の大谷」が現れます。雄山の山頂には雄山神社の峰本社が鎮座しています。
quiz: 立山黒部アルペンルートで春に見られる、雪の壁にはさまれた道は何と呼ばれる？
desc_en: You have arrived at Tateyama. Along with Mount Fuji and Mount Hakusan, it is one of Japan's Three Holy Mountains, a collective name for peaks centered on Mount Onanji, the highest, and Mount Oyama. Using the Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route, you can ride up to Murodo at about 2,450 meters, and in spring the Yuki no Otani (Great Snow Valley) appears, with towering walls of snow. At the summit of Oyama stands the summit shrine of Oyama Shrine.
quiz_en: On the Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route in spring, what is the road called that runs between towering walls of snow?

name: 金沢のひがし茶屋街
desc: 金沢のひがし茶屋街に到着しました。江戸時代に加賀藩の許しを得て開かれた茶屋町で、紅殻格子の美しい町家が石畳の通りに並び、国の重要伝統的建造物群保存地区に選定されています。夕暮れ時には三味線の音が聞こえてくることもあります。金沢名産の金箔を使った菓子や工芸品の店をのぞくのも楽しみです。
quiz: ひがし茶屋街の町家の窓に見られる、細かい木の格子を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: You have arrived at the Higashi Chaya District of Kanazawa. This teahouse district was opened in the Edo period with the permission of the Kaga domain, and beautiful townhouses with red-ocher lattices line its stone-paved streets. It is designated a national Important Preservation District for Groups of Traditional Buildings. At dusk you may even hear the sound of the shamisen. Browsing shops selling sweets and crafts made with Kanazawa's famous gold leaf is another pleasure.
quiz_en: What are the fine wooden lattices called that can be seen on the windows of the townhouses in the Higashi Chaya District?

name: 妙立寺
desc: 金沢市野町の妙立寺に到着しました。加賀藩前田家の祈願所として建てられた日蓮宗の寺で、「忍者寺」の通称で知られています。外観からは想像できないほど内部は複雑で、隠し階段や落とし穴、見張り台など、敵の侵入に備えたとされるしかけが数多くあります。見学は案内付きで、驚きの連続です。
quiz: 隠し階段や落とし穴などのしかけがある妙立寺は、通称何寺と呼ばれている？
desc_en: You have arrived at Myoryu-ji in Nomachi, Kanazawa City. This Nichiren-sect temple was built as a prayer hall for the Maeda family of the Kaga domain and is known by its nickname, the Ninja Temple. Its interior is far more complex than its exterior suggests, with many devices said to have been designed against enemy intrusion, such as hidden staircases, pitfalls and lookout posts. Tours are guided and full of surprises.
quiz_en: Myoryu-ji is full of tricks such as hidden staircases and pitfalls, so what nickname is this temple commonly known by?

name: 伏見寺
desc: 金沢市寺町の伏見寺に到着しました。犀川の南側に広がる寺町寺院群の一角にあるお寺です。寺町には加賀藩の城下町づくりの中でたくさんの寺院が集められ、今も多くの寺が並ぶ落ち着いた町並みが続きます。風情ある通りを歩きながら寺々を巡り、城下町金沢の歴史の層の厚さを感じてください。
quiz: 金沢の寺町寺院群を歩くとき、あなたがいちばん注目したいものは何？
desc_en: You have arrived at Fushimi-ji in Teramachi, Kanazawa City. It stands in one corner of the Teramachi temple district spreading south of the Sai River. Many temples were gathered in Teramachi as part of the Kaga domain's castle town planning, and a calm townscape lined with numerous temples continues today. Walk the charming streets visiting the temples and feel the deep layers of history of the castle town of Kanazawa.
quiz_en: When walking through the Teramachi temple district of Kanazawa, what would you most like to pay attention to along the way?

name: 湯涌温泉
desc: 金沢市の湯涌温泉に到着しました。金沢の市街地から山あいへ入った場所にある温泉地で、「金沢の奥座敷」と呼ばれています。大正時代の画家・詩人の竹久夢二がこの地に滞在したゆかりがあり、温泉街には夢二の記念館があります。静かな山里の湯で、ゆったりとした時間を過ごしてください。
quiz: 湯涌温泉にゆかりがあり、記念館もある大正ロマンを代表する画家は誰？
desc_en: You have arrived at Yuwaku Onsen in Kanazawa City. This hot spring resort lies in the mountains beyond central Kanazawa and is called the inner retreat of Kanazawa. It has ties to Takehisa Yumeji, a Taisho-era painter and poet who stayed here, and the hot spring town has a memorial museum dedicated to him. Spend a relaxing time in the hot springs of this quiet mountain village.
quiz_en: Which painter, a leading figure of Taisho Romanticism, has ties to Yuwaku Onsen and a memorial museum there?

name: 深谷温泉
desc: 金沢市深谷町の深谷温泉に到着しました。金沢の市街地から北へ向かった郊外の静かな土地にある温泉です。金沢は加賀百万石の城下町として栄えた歴史ある都市で、兼六園や茶屋街などの名所から少し足を延ばせば、こうした落ち着いた湯にも出会えます。観光の合間に、のんびりと湯船で体をほぐしてください。
quiz: 金沢観光の合間に郊外の温泉でひと休みしたら、次はどの名所に出かけたい？
desc_en: You have arrived at Fukatani Onsen in Fukatanimachi, Kanazawa City. This onsen (hot spring) lies in a quiet suburb north of central Kanazawa. Kanazawa is a historic city that prospered as the castle town of the Kaga domain, famed for its wealth, and by going a little beyond sights like Kenroku-en and the teahouse districts, you can find calm hot springs like this. Between sightseeing, relax your body slowly in the bath.
quiz_en: After taking a break at a suburban onsen between sightseeing spots in Kanazawa, which famous place would you like to visit next?

name: 曲水温泉
desc: 金沢市七曲町の曲水温泉に到着しました。金沢の市街地から郊外へ向かった丘陵に位置する温泉で、周囲には田園や里山の景色が広がります。曲水という名も、どこか風雅な響きがあります。城下町の散策で歩き疲れた足を湯で休めながら、加賀の里のゆったりとした空気を味わってください。
quiz: 温泉の湯上がりに、金沢ならではの和菓子をひとつ選ぶとしたら何にする？
desc_en: You have arrived at Kyokusui Onsen in Nanamagarimachi, Kanazawa City. This onsen (hot spring) is located in the hills heading from central Kanazawa toward the suburbs, with farmland and countryside scenery all around. The name Kyokusui, meaning winding stream, has an elegant ring to it. Rest your feet, tired from strolling the castle town, in the hot water and savor the relaxed air of the Kaga countryside.
quiz_en: If you could pick just one wagashi sweet unique to Kanazawa to enjoy after your bath, which one would you choose?

name: 赤蔵山
desc: 七尾市三引町の赤蔵山に到着しました。七尾湾に面した七尾市の南部にある山で、古くから信仰の山として地域の人々に大切にされてきました。木々に覆われた山を歩くと、能登の里山らしい落ち着いた雰囲気に包まれます。山の上から見下ろす里の景色を眺めながら、能登の自然と信仰の結びつきを感じてください。
quiz: 能登の里山を歩くなら、どの季節の森の色をいちばん楽しみたい？
desc_en: You have arrived at Mount Akakura in Mihikimachi, Nanao City. This mountain in southern Nanao, facing Nanao Bay, has long been cherished by local people as a mountain of faith. Walking the tree-covered mountain, you will be wrapped in the calm atmosphere typical of Noto's satoyama. Gaze down at the villages from the mountain and feel the bond between Noto's nature and faith.
quiz_en: If you went walking in the satoyama countryside of Noto, in which season would you most enjoy the colors of the forest?

name: 別所岳
desc: 七尾市中島町の別所岳に到着しました。能登半島の中ほどにある山で、のと里山海道のサービスエリアが設けられています。展望台からは七尾湾に浮かぶ能登島や穏やかな内浦の海を見渡すことができ、ドライブの途中に立ち寄る人も多い場所です。里山と海が溶け合う、能登らしい風景を一望してください。
quiz: 別所岳の展望台から、七尾湾の中に浮かんで見える大きな島はどこ？
desc_en: You have arrived at Mount Bessho in Nakajima, Nanao City. This mountain in the middle of the Noto Peninsula has a service area on the Noto Satoyama Kaido expressway. From the observation deck you can look out over Notojima Island in Nanao Bay and the calm waters of the inner bay, and many people stop by during a drive. Take in a panorama typical of Noto, where countryside and sea blend together.
quiz_en: From the observation deck on Mount Bessho, which large island can you see floating in the waters of Nanao Bay?

name: 七尾城址
addr: 七尾市古城町・古屋敷町・竹町入会地字大塚14-1／2-4／15-2
desc: 七尾市の七尾城址に到着しました。戦国時代に能登の守護・畠山氏が築いた巨大な山城の跡で、日本五大山城のひとつに数えられています。上杉謙信が攻め落としたことでも知られ、山上には幾重にも重なる石垣が残ります。本丸跡からは七尾湾と能登島を見渡せ、天然の要害であったことがよくわかります。
quiz: 七尾城を築き、戦国時代に能登の守護として城主を務めた一族は何氏？
desc_en: You have arrived at the Nanao Castle ruins in Nanao City. These are the remains of a huge mountain castle built in the Warring States period by the Hatakeyama clan, the military governors of Noto, and it is counted among Japan's five great mountain castles. It is also known for being captured by Uesugi Kenshin, and layers of stone walls remain on the mountain. From the main enclosure site you can look over Nanao Bay and Notojima, making it clear that this was a natural fortress.
quiz_en: Which clan built Nanao Castle and served as its lords while acting as the military governors of Noto in the Warring States period?

name: 和倉温泉
desc: 七尾市の和倉温泉に到着しました。七尾湾の海から湯が湧き出したことに始まると言われる、能登を代表する温泉地です。海に面して大きな旅館が建ち並び、湯につかりながら穏やかな七尾湾と能登島を眺められます。能登半島地震で大きな被害を受けましたが、復興に向けて歩みを続けています。
quiz: 七尾湾に面した和倉温泉、湯につかりながら眺めたい海の景色はどんな時間帯？
desc_en: You have arrived at Wakura Onsen in Nanao City. It is said to have begun when hot water gushed up from the sea of Nanao Bay, and it is Noto's representative hot spring resort. Large inns line the waterfront, and you can gaze at calm Nanao Bay and Notojima while soaking. The area suffered severe damage in the Noto Peninsula Earthquake, but it continues on its path toward recovery.
quiz_en: At Wakura Onsen facing Nanao Bay, at what time of day would you most like to gaze at the sea while soaking?

name: 湯川温泉
desc: 七尾市湯川町の湯川温泉に到着しました。七尾市は能登半島の付け根近く、七尾湾に面した港町で、古くから能登の中心として栄えてきました。市内には和倉温泉のほかにもこうした温泉があり、里山の静けさの中で湯を楽しめます。能登の海の幸とともに、素朴な湯の温もりを味わってください。
quiz: 能登の温泉宿で夕食に出てきたらうれしい、七尾湾の海の幸は何？
desc_en: You have arrived at Yukawa Onsen in Yukawamachi, Nanao City. Nanao is a port town on Nanao Bay near the base of the Noto Peninsula, long prospering as the center of Noto. Besides Wakura Onsen, the city has hot springs like this one, where you can enjoy the bath in the quiet of the countryside. Savor the simple warmth of the water along with seafood from the Noto coast.
quiz_en: If it were served at dinner in a hot spring inn in Noto, which seafood from Nanao Bay would make you happiest?

name: 赤崎温泉
desc: 七尾市大田町の赤崎温泉に到着しました。七尾湾に近い土地にある温泉で、能登の穏やかな内海の風景が身近に感じられます。七尾湾は波が静かで、牡蠣の養殖が行われるなど豊かな海として知られています。海辺の町の湯でゆっくりと温まり、能登の里と海が育んだ暮らしにふれてください。
quiz: 能登の穏やかな七尾湾で養殖が盛んな、冬に旬を迎える貝は何でしょう？
desc_en: You have arrived at Akasaki Onsen in Otamachi, Nanao City. This onsen (hot spring) sits near Nanao Bay, where you can feel close to the scenery of Noto's calm inland sea. Nanao Bay has gentle waves and is known as a rich sea, where oysters are farmed. Warm up slowly in the hot water of this seaside town and experience a way of life nurtured by Noto's land and sea.
quiz_en: Which shellfish, farmed widely in the calm waters of Nanao Bay in Noto, is at its best in the winter season?

name: 那谷寺
desc: 小松市の那谷寺に到着しました。奈良時代に白山を開いた泰澄が開いたとされる古刹で、境内には「奇岩遊仙境」と呼ばれる白い岩山がそびえています。松尾芭蕉が「おくのほそ道」の旅で立ち寄り、「石山の石より白し秋の風」の句を詠みました。秋には紅葉が奇岩を彩り、境内は息をのむ美しさです。
quiz: 那谷寺で松尾芭蕉が詠んだ句「石山の石より白し」に続く言葉は何？
desc_en: You have arrived at Natadera in Komatsu City. This ancient temple is said to have been founded by Taicho, who opened Mount Hakusan in the Nara period, and in its grounds rises a white rocky hill called Kigan Yusenkyo. Matsuo Basho stopped here on his journey of Oku no Hosomichi (The Narrow Road to the Deep North) and composed a haiku: whiter than the stones of Ishiyama, the autumn wind. In autumn, colored leaves adorn the strange rocks, making the grounds breathtakingly beautiful.
quiz_en: In the haiku Matsuo Basho composed at Natadera, which words follow the opening line, whiter than the stones of Ishiyama?

name: 大倉岳高原
desc: 小松市尾小屋町の大倉岳高原に到着しました。小松市の南部、白山の山並みに近い高原で、冬はスキー、夏はキャンプや散策が楽しめるレジャーの場として親しまれています。高原からは加賀平野や日本海を望むことができ、澄んだ空気の中で開放的な時間を過ごせます。夜は満天の星空も見どころです。
quiz: 大倉岳高原のような高原でキャンプをするなら、夜空を見上げて探したい星座は何？
desc_en: You have arrived at the Okuradake Kogen highlands in Ogoya, Komatsu City. In southern Komatsu near the Hakusan mountains, these highlands are loved as a leisure spot for skiing in winter and camping and walking in summer. From the plateau you can view the Kaga Plain and the Sea of Japan, spending an open, refreshing time in the clear air. At night, a sky full of stars is another highlight.
quiz_en: If you went camping at a highland spot like Okuradake Kogen, which constellation would you want to look for in the night sky?

name: 荒俣峡
desc: 小松市赤瀬町の荒俣峡に到着しました。郷谷川が山あいを削ってできた渓谷で、岩の間を清流が流れ、両岸を緑の木々が覆っています。夏は涼を求めて訪れる人が多く、秋には渓谷が紅葉に彩られます。近くには赤瀬ダムもあり、小松の山里の自然をゆっくりと味わえる場所です。
quiz: 山あいの渓谷を訪ねたら、清流のほとりでどんなふうに過ごしたい？
desc_en: You have arrived at Aramata Gorge in Akasemachi, Komatsu City. This gorge was carved through the mountains by the Gogo River, with a clear stream flowing between the rocks and green trees covering both banks. In summer many people come seeking coolness, and in autumn the gorge is colored with autumn leaves. Akase Dam is also nearby, making it a place to slowly savor the nature of Komatsu's mountain villages.
quiz_en: If you visited a mountain gorge like Aramata, how would you like to spend your time beside the clear stream?

name: 小松天満宮
desc: 小松市天神町の小松天満宮に到着しました。江戸時代に加賀藩三代藩主の前田利常によって創建された神社で、学問の神様・菅原道真を祀っています。梯川のほとりに鎮座し、受験生の合格祈願に訪れる人も多くいます。境内には梅の木が植えられ、早春には梅の花が境内を彩ります。
quiz: 学問の神様を祀る小松天満宮を創建した、加賀藩の三代藩主は誰でしょう？
desc_en: You have arrived at Komatsu Tenmangu in Tenjinmachi, Komatsu City. Founded in the Edo period by Maeda Toshitsune, the third lord of the Kaga domain, it enshrines Sugawara no Michizane, the god of learning. It stands on the banks of the Kakehashi River, and many people visit to pray for success in exams. Plum trees are planted in the grounds, and their blossoms color the shrine in early spring.
quiz_en: Who was the third lord of the Kaga domain who founded Komatsu Tenmangu, a shrine dedicated to the god of learning?

name: 粟津温泉
addr: 小松市井口町ホ59-9（粟津温泉観光協会）
desc: 小松市の粟津温泉に到着しました。奈良時代に白山を開いた泰澄が開湯したと伝わる北陸の古い温泉地のひとつで、長い歴史を持つ老舗旅館が今も湯を守り続けています。温泉街には総湯もあり、気軽に湯を楽しめます。加賀の湯けむりに包まれながら、千年以上の時を重ねた湯の歴史を感じてください。
quiz: 加賀の粟津温泉を開湯したとされる、白山を開いた奈良時代の僧は誰でしょう？
desc_en: You have arrived at Awazu Onsen in Komatsu City. Said to have been opened by Taicho, who founded worship on Mount Hakusan in the Nara period, it is one of the old hot spring resorts of Hokuriku, and long-established inns with long histories still guard its waters. The hot spring town also has a public bath called the soyu, where you can easily enjoy a soak. Wrapped in the steam of Kaga, feel the history of waters spanning more than a thousand years.
quiz_en: Who was the Nara-period monk, known for opening Mount Hakusan, who is said to have founded Awazu Onsen in Kaga?

name: 木場温泉
desc: 小松市木場町の木場温泉に到着しました。近くの木場潟は豊かな水辺の自然が残る潟で、周囲を散策路がめぐり、晴れた日には湖面の向こうに雪をいただいた白山を望むことができます。四季折々の景色が楽しめる潟のほとりで、ゆったりと湯につかって旅の疲れを癒やしてください。
quiz: 小松の木場潟のほとりから、晴れた日に湖面の向こうに見える霊峰はどこ？
desc_en: You have arrived at Kiba Onsen in Kibamachi, Komatsu City. Nearby Kibagata is a lagoon where rich waterside nature remains, with walking paths circling it, and on clear days you can see snowcapped Mount Hakusan beyond the water. On the shores of this lagoon, where you can enjoy the scenery of all four seasons, soak in the hot water at leisure and soothe the fatigue of your journey.
quiz_en: From the shores of Kibagata in Komatsu, which sacred mountain can you see beyond the surface of the water on a clear day?

name: 赤穂谷温泉
desc: 小松市中海町の赤穂谷温泉に到着しました。小松市の郊外、加賀平野から山あいへと入る谷筋にある温泉です。小松は加賀の国の要地として栄えた町で、九谷焼の産地としても知られています。静かな谷の湯でゆったりと温まり、湯上がりには加賀の伝統工芸にふれる旅を続けてみてください。
quiz: 九谷焼の産地・小松で、お土産に九谷焼を選ぶならどんな器がほしい？
desc_en: You have arrived at Akoudani Onsen in Nakaumimachi, Komatsu City. This onsen (hot spring) lies in a valley leading from the Kaga Plain into the mountains on the outskirts of Komatsu. Komatsu prospered as a key town of Kaga Province and is also known for producing Kutani ware. Warm up slowly in this quiet valley hot spring, and after your bath, continue your journey exploring the traditional crafts of Kaga.
quiz_en: If you chose Kutani ware as a souvenir in Komatsu, where this pottery is made, what kind of dish or vessel would you want?

name: 輪島白米千枚田
desc: 輪島市の白米千枚田に到着しました。日本海に面した急斜面に小さな田んぼが幾重にも連なる棚田で、海と田んぼが一体となった景観は能登を象徴する風景です。「能登の里山里海」として世界農業遺産にも認定されています。能登半島地震で被害を受けましたが、保全に携わる人々の手で再生が進められています。
quiz: 白米千枚田を含む「能登の里山里海」が認定されている国際的な遺産は何？
desc_en: You have arrived at Shiroyone Senmaida in Wajima City. On a steep slope facing the Sea of Japan, small rice paddies stack up layer upon layer, and this landscape uniting sea and paddies symbolizes Noto. It is also recognized as a Globally Important Agricultural Heritage System as part of Noto's Satoyama and Satoumi. It was damaged in the Noto Peninsula Earthquake, but restoration is moving forward thanks to the people who care for it.
quiz_en: What international heritage designation has been given to Noto's Satoyama and Satoumi, which includes the Shiroyone Senmaida rice terraces?

name: 舳倉島
desc: 輪島市の舳倉島に到着しました。輪島港から北へ遠く離れた日本海に浮かぶ小さな島で、海女漁の拠点として知られてきました。平らで小さな島ですが、春と秋には渡り鳥の中継地となり、多くの珍しい鳥を観察できる場所としてバードウォッチャーの憧れです。澄んだ海と静かな時間を味わってください。
quiz: 舳倉島で古くから受け継がれてきた、海に潜ってアワビやサザエをとる漁は何？
desc_en: You have arrived at Hegurajima in Wajima City. This small island floats in the Sea of Japan far north of Wajima Port and has long been known as a base for ama free diving. Although it is a small, flat island, it becomes a stopover for migratory birds in spring and autumn, making it a dream destination for birdwatchers where many rare birds can be observed. Savor the clear sea and quiet time.
quiz_en: What is the traditional form of fishing long handed down on Hegurajima, in which divers go under the sea to gather abalone and turban shells?

name: 輪島温泉郷
addr: 輪島市河井町・塚田町・鳳至町
desc: 輪島市の輪島温泉郷に到着しました。輪島は堅牢で美しい漆器「輪島塗」の産地として知られ、市街地の河井町などに宿が点在しています。能登半島地震では朝市通りをはじめ町に大きな被害が出ましたが、人々は復興に向けて歩み続けています。湯につかりながら、漆の町の手仕事の文化に思いをはせてください。
quiz: 輪島の名産で、下地に地元の珪藻土を使って塗り重ねる丈夫な漆器を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: You have arrived at the Wajima hot spring area in Wajima City. Wajima is known for producing Wajima-nuri, durable and beautiful lacquerware, and inns are scattered around Kawaimachi and other parts of the city center. The Noto Peninsula Earthquake caused severe damage to the town, including the morning market street, but its people continue working toward recovery. While soaking in the hot water, reflect on the handicraft culture of this lacquer town.
quiz_en: What is the name of Wajima's durable lacquerware, made by applying many coats over a base that uses local diatomaceous earth?

name: ねぶた温泉
addr: 輪島市大野町ねぶた温泉
desc: 輪島市大野町のねぶた温泉に到着しました。輪島の市街地から少し離れた日本海側の土地にある温泉で、海辺の静かな環境の中で湯を楽しめます。能登の外浦は、冬には荒々しい波が打ち寄せる変化に富んだ海岸が続きます。地元の人々に親しまれてきた湯で、能登の海風を感じながら体を温めてください。
quiz: 能登の外浦の海辺で温泉に入ったあと、地元で味わいたい冬の海の幸は何？
desc_en: You have arrived at Nebuta Onsen in Onomachi, Wajima City. This onsen (hot spring) lies on the Sea of Japan side a little away from central Wajima, letting you enjoy the bath in quiet seaside surroundings. Noto's outer coast, the Sotoura, is a varied coastline where rough waves crash in winter. In waters loved by local people, warm your body as you feel the sea breeze of Noto.
quiz_en: After a soak at an onsen on the seashore of Noto's outer coast, what winter seafood would you like to taste locally?

name: 猿山岬
desc: 輪島市門前町の猿山岬に到着しました。能登半島の西側、外浦に突き出した岬で、日本海に落ち込む断崖が続く豪快な景勝地です。早春には雪割草が斜面に群生して可憐な花を咲かせ、岬の上には灯台が建っています。眼下に広がる日本海の大パノラマを眺めながら、能登の自然の厳しさと美しさを感じてください。
quiz: 猿山岬の斜面で早春に群生して咲く、雪の中から顔を出す可憐な花は何？
desc_en: You have arrived at Cape Saruyama in Monzen, Wajima City. Jutting out into the Sotoura on the western side of the Noto Peninsula, this cape is a dramatic scenic spot with cliffs plunging into the Sea of Japan. In early spring, yukiwariso (hepatica) grow in clusters on the slopes and bloom with dainty flowers, and a lighthouse stands atop the cape. Gazing at the grand panorama of the Sea of Japan below, feel both the harshness and the beauty of Noto's nature.
quiz_en: What dainty flower grows in clusters on the slopes of Cape Saruyama in early spring, peeking out from the melting snow?

name: 釼地八幡神社大祭
addr: 輪島市門前町剱地レ136（剱地八幡神社）
desc: 輪島市門前町剱地の釼地八幡神社大祭に到着しました。剱地は能登半島の西側、日本海に面した集落です。能登の祭りでは大きな灯籠の「キリコ」や神輿が出ることが多く、地域の人々が総出で祭りを支えています。夜の闇に灯りがともり、掛け声が響き渡る中で、能登の人々の祭りへの熱い思いを感じてください。
quiz: 能登の祭りで、明かりをともして担がれる大きな縦長の灯籠を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: You have arrived at the grand festival of Tsurugiji Hachiman Shrine in Tsurugiji, Monzen, Wajima City. Tsurugiji is a settlement facing the Sea of Japan on the western side of the Noto Peninsula. Noto festivals often feature large lanterns called kiriko and mikoshi (portable shrines), and the whole community turns out to support them. As lights glow in the darkness of night and chants echo all around, feel the passion of Noto's people for their festivals.
quiz_en: At festivals in Noto, what are the large, tall lanterns called that are lit up and carried through the streets by many people?

name: 珠洲温泉
desc: 珠洲市宝立町の珠洲温泉に到着しました。能登半島の先端に位置する珠洲市は、穏やかな内浦と荒々しい外浦の両方の海を持つ土地です。宝立町の沖には、その形から「軍艦島」とも呼ばれる見附島が浮かび、能登を代表する景勝地となっています。海を感じる最果ての町の湯で、ゆったりと過ごしてください。
quiz: 珠洲市の宝立町の沖に浮かび、軍艦島とも呼ばれる島の名前は何でしょう？
desc_en: You have arrived at Suzu Onsen in Horyumachi, Suzu City. Suzu, at the tip of the Noto Peninsula, is a land with both a calm inner coast and a rugged outer coast. Off Horyumachi floats Mitsukejima, also called Gunkanjima (Battleship Island) for its shape, one of Noto's representative scenic spots. Relax in the hot springs of this town at the end of the land, where you can feel the sea.
quiz_en: What is the name of the island floating off Horyumachi in Suzu City that is also known as Battleship Island because of its shape?

name: 葭ヶ浦温泉
desc: 珠洲市三崎町寺家の葭ヶ浦温泉に到着しました。能登半島の先端、禄剛埼にも近い海辺の温泉で、ランプの灯りがともる宿が秘湯の趣を伝えています。崖に囲まれた入り江の奥にひっそりとたたずみ、波の音だけが聞こえる静けさが魅力です。最果ての地の夜を、やわらかな灯りの中で過ごしてください。
quiz: 能登半島の先端の秘湯で、ランプの灯りの下で過ごす夜に聞きたい音は何？
desc_en: You have arrived at Yoshigaura Onsen in Jike, Misaki, Suzu City. This seaside onsen (hot spring) at the tip of the Noto Peninsula, close to Cape Rokkozaki, has an inn lit by lamps that conveys the charm of a hidden hot spring. It stands quietly at the back of a cove surrounded by cliffs, and its appeal is a stillness where only the sound of the waves can be heard. Spend a night at the end of the land in soft lamplight.
quiz_en: At a hidden hot spring on the tip of the Noto Peninsula, what sound would you like to hear during a night spent under lamplight?

name: 鉢ヶ崎温泉
addr: 珠洲市蛸島町鉢ヶ崎部36-4
desc: 珠洲市の鉢ヶ崎温泉に到着しました。近くの鉢ヶ崎海岸は白い砂浜が続く美しい海岸で、夏には海水浴客でにぎわいます。能登半島の先端に位置する珠洲は、昔ながらの製法で作られる揚げ浜式の塩づくりでも知られています。海辺の開放的な景色とともに、湯でゆっくりと疲れを癒やしてください。
quiz: 珠洲の海辺で受け継がれてきた、海水をまいて天日で塩をつくる伝統の製法は何？
desc_en: You have arrived at Hachigasaki Onsen in Suzu City. The nearby Hachigasaki coast is a beautiful shoreline of white sand that bustles with swimmers in summer. Suzu, at the tip of the Noto Peninsula, is also known for agehama-style salt making, produced using traditional methods. Along with the open seaside scenery, slowly soothe your fatigue in the hot water.
quiz_en: What is the traditional method handed down on the Suzu coast in which seawater is spread over sand and dried by the sun to make salt?

name: 寺家キリコ祭り
desc: 珠洲市三崎町寺家のキリコ祭りに到着しました。能登では夏から秋にかけて各地でキリコ祭りが行われ、大きな灯籠「キリコ」を大勢で担いで練り歩きます。寺家のキリコは特に大きいことで知られ、夜空にそびえる灯りが集落を照らす光景は圧巻です。能登の人々が一年で最も熱くなる祭りの夜を味わってください。
quiz: 寺家のキリコ祭りで、夜空にそびえるほど大きなキリコを担ぐ人は何人くらいだと思う？
desc_en: You have arrived at the Kiriko Festival in Jike, Misaki, Suzu City. From summer to autumn, kiriko festivals are held all over Noto, with large lanterns called kiriko carried through the streets by many people. The kiriko of Jike are known for being especially large, and the sight of their lights towering into the night sky and illuminating the village is overwhelming. Savor a festival night when the people of Noto are at their most passionate of the year.
quiz_en: At the Jike Kiriko Festival, about how many people do you think it takes to carry one of the giant kiriko that tower into the night sky?

name: 山代温泉
addr: 加賀市山代温泉北部3-70（事務局）
desc: 加賀市の山代温泉に到着しました。奈良時代に行基が開いたと伝わる北陸有数の温泉地で、温泉街の中心には共同浴場の総湯と、明治期の姿を復元した古総湯があります。周りを旅館や店が取り囲む町並みは「湯の曲輪」と呼ばれます。北大路魯山人ゆかりの地でもあり、九谷焼などの器文化も息づいています。
quiz: 山代温泉の中心部、総湯を囲むように宿や店が並ぶ町並みは何と呼ばれる？
desc_en: You have arrived at Yamashiro Onsen in Kaga City. Said to have been founded by the monk Gyoki in the Nara period, it is one of Hokuriku's leading hot spring resorts, with the public bath Soyu and the Kosoyu, restored to its Meiji-era appearance, at the center of town. The townscape, where inns and shops surround the baths, is called Yu no Kuruwa. It is also associated with Kitaoji Rosanjin, and a culture of tableware such as Kutani ware lives on here.
quiz_en: In the center of Yamashiro Onsen, what is the townscape called where inns and shops are arranged around the public bath?

name: 山中温泉
addr: 加賀市山中温泉西桂木町ト5-1（事務局）
desc: 加賀市の山中温泉に到着しました。大聖寺川の渓谷・鶴仙渓に沿って広がる温泉地で、松尾芭蕉が「おくのほそ道」の旅で長く滞在し、名湯をたたえました。渓谷には総檜造りのこおろぎ橋や、S字形のあやとりはしが架かり、遊歩道の散策が楽しめます。木地挽きの技が光る山中漆器の産地でもあります。
quiz: 山中温泉の鶴仙渓に架かる、総檜造りの趣ある橋は何と呼ばれる？
desc_en: You have arrived at Yamanaka Onsen in Kaga City. This hot spring resort spreads along Kakusenkei, the gorge of the Daishoji River, where Matsuo Basho stayed for a long time during his Oku no Hosomichi journey and praised its fine waters. Across the gorge stretch the all-cypress Korogi Bridge and the S-shaped Ayatori Bridge, and you can enjoy walks along the trail. It is also the home of Yamanaka lacquerware, showcasing the art of wood turning.
quiz_en: What is the name of the charming bridge made entirely of Japanese cypress that spans Kakusenkei Gorge at Yamanaka Onsen?

name: 全昌寺
desc: 加賀市大聖寺の全昌寺に到着しました。大聖寺藩主山口家ゆかりの曹洞宗の寺で、境内の羅漢堂には五百羅漢像が並び、一体一体異なる表情に見入ってしまいます。松尾芭蕉と弟子の曽良が「おくのほそ道」の旅で宿泊した寺としても知られています。城下町大聖寺の落ち着いた町並みとあわせて訪ねてください。
quiz: 全昌寺の羅漢堂に並ぶ羅漢像は、全部で何体あることで知られている？
desc_en: You have arrived at Zensho-ji in Daishoji, Kaga City. This Soto Zen temple is associated with the Yamaguchi family, lords of the Daishoji domain, and its Rakan Hall houses statues of the Five Hundred Arhats, each with a different expression that draws you in. It is also known as the temple where Matsuo Basho and his disciple Sora stayed during their Oku no Hosomichi journey. Visit it together with the calm streets of the castle town of Daishoji.
quiz_en: How many arhat statues are the Rakan Hall of Zensho-ji known for housing, each one with its own unique expression?

name: 片山津温泉
addr: 加賀市片山津町ツ71（事務局）
desc: 加賀市の片山津温泉に到着しました。柴山潟のほとりに広がる温泉地で、湖畔には旅館が並び、湖面越しに霊峰白山を望むことができます。晴れた日には雪をかぶった白山の姿が湖に映り、朝夕で表情を変える湖の景色が魅力です。湖畔の遊歩道を散策して、水辺の温泉地ならではの風情を味わってください。
quiz: 湖面越しに白山を望む片山津温泉が、ほとりに広がっている湖の名前は何でしょう？
desc_en: You have arrived at Katayamazu Onsen in Kaga City. This hot spring resort spreads along the shores of Shibayamagata, with inns lining the lakeside and a view of sacred Mount Hakusan across the water. On clear days the snowcapped form of Hakusan is reflected in the lake, and the lake's changing expressions from morning to evening are part of its charm. Stroll the lakeside path and savor the atmosphere unique to a waterside hot spring resort.
quiz_en: What is the name of the lake along whose shores Katayamazu Onsen spreads, offering views of Mount Hakusan across the water?

name: 柴山温泉
desc: 加賀市柴山町の柴山温泉に到着しました。柴山潟の湖畔にある温泉で、水辺の静かな景色の中で湯を楽しめます。柴山潟には水鳥が集まり、晴れた日には遠くに白山の姿を望めます。加賀温泉郷の中心地からほど近く、湖を眺めながらゆったりと過ごせる、落ち着いた雰囲気の湯です。
quiz: 柴山潟の湖畔の温泉で、湖面に映ったらいちばん見てみたい景色は何？
desc_en: You have arrived at Shibayama Onsen in Shibayamamachi, Kaga City. This onsen (hot spring) is on the shores of Shibayamagata, letting you enjoy the bath amid quiet waterside scenery. Waterfowl gather on the lagoon, and on clear days you can see Mount Hakusan in the distance. Close to the center of the Kaga hot spring area, it is a calm hot spring where you can relax while gazing at the lake.
quiz_en: At this onsen on the shores of Shibayamagata, what scene would you most like to see reflected on the surface of the lake?

name: 邑知潟
addr: 羽咋市東潟町、西潟町、南潟町
desc: 羽咋市の邑知潟に到着しました。能登半島の付け根に広がる潟湖で、周囲には平野と田園が広がっています。冬になると北の国から多くのコハクチョウが飛来し、田んぼや湖面で羽を休める姿が見られる飛来地として知られています。白い鳥が群れをなして舞う冬の光景は、羽咋の季節の風物詩です。
quiz: 冬の邑知潟に北の国から群れで飛来する、白い大きな渡り鳥は何でしょう？
desc_en: You have arrived at Ochigata in Hakui City. This lagoon spreads at the base of the Noto Peninsula, surrounded by plains and farmland. In winter, many tundra swans fly in from the north, and it is known as a wintering site where they can be seen resting in the rice paddies and on the water. The winter sight of flocks of white birds dancing in the sky is a seasonal tradition of Hakui.
quiz_en: What large white migratory bird flies in flocks from the north to spend the winter at Ochigata Lagoon?

name: 気多大社
desc: 羽咋市の気多大社に到着しました。能登国一宮として古くから崇敬を集める神社で、大国主命を祀り、縁結びの神様として多くの参拝者が訪れます。社殿の背後には古来人の立ち入りが禁じられてきた「入らずの森」が広がり、神聖な空気に満ちています。日本海に近い境内で、良縁を祈ってみてください。
quiz: 気多大社の社殿の背後に広がる、古来人の立ち入りが禁じられた森は何と呼ばれる？
desc_en: You have arrived at Keta Taisha in Hakui City. As the ichinomiya (highest-ranked shrine) of Noto Province, it has long been revered, enshrining Okuninushi no Mikoto, and many visitors come to pray to him as a god of matchmaking. Behind the shrine buildings spreads the Irazu no Mori (Forbidden Forest), where people have been forbidden to enter since ancient times, filling the place with a sacred air. In these grounds near the Sea of Japan, pray for a good match.
quiz_en: What is the forest called that spreads behind the buildings of Keta Taisha, where people have been forbidden to enter since ancient times?

name: 永光寺
desc: 羽咋市酒井町の永光寺に到着しました。鎌倉時代に曹洞宗の瑩山紹瑾によって開かれた古刹で、能登の山あいに静かに伽藍を構えています。杉木立に囲まれた参道を歩くと、禅寺らしい凛とした空気が感じられます。新緑や紅葉、雪景色と、四季ごとに異なる表情を見せる山寺の風情を味わってください。
quiz: 永光寺を開いた、曹洞宗の発展に大きな役割を果たした鎌倉時代の僧は誰？
desc_en: You have arrived at Yoko-ji in Sakaimachi, Hakui City. This ancient temple was founded in the Kamakura period by Keizan Jokin of the Soto Zen school, and its buildings stand quietly in the mountains of Noto. Walking the approach surrounded by cedar groves, you can feel the crisp air typical of a Zen temple. Savor the charm of a mountain temple that shows a different face each season, from fresh green and autumn leaves to snowy scenes.
quiz_en: Who was the Kamakura-period monk who founded Yoko-ji and played a major role in the development of the Soto Zen school?

name: 妙成寺五重塔祭り
desc: 羽咋市滝谷町の妙成寺で行われる五重塔祭りに到着しました。妙成寺は加賀藩前田家の庇護を受けて堂塔が整えられた日蓮宗の名刹で、緑の中にそびえる五重塔はその象徴です。祭りの日には多くの人が境内に集い、普段とは違うにぎわいに包まれます。歴史ある伽藍を背景に、祭りの雰囲気を楽しんでください。
quiz: 妙成寺の五重塔を見上げたら、写真に撮るならどのアングルから狙う？
desc_en: You have arrived at the Five-Story Pagoda Festival held at Myojo-ji in Takidanimachi, Hakui City. Myojo-ji is a renowned Nichiren-sect temple whose halls and pagoda were developed under the patronage of the Maeda family of the Kaga domain, and its five-story pagoda rising amid the greenery is its symbol. On festival day, many people gather in the grounds, filling them with an unusual liveliness. Enjoy the festive atmosphere against the backdrop of these historic buildings.
quiz_en: If you looked up at the five-story pagoda of Myojo-ji, from which angle would you try to take your best photo of it?

name: 白山
desc: 白山市の白山に到着しました。石川と岐阜の県境にそびえる標高二七〇二メートルの山で、富士山、立山とともに日本三霊山に数えられます。奈良時代に泰澄が開山したとされ、全国の白山神社の信仰の源となっています。夏には山頂一帯にハクサンの名を持つ高山植物が咲き誇り、御来光を拝む登山者でにぎわいます。
quiz: 富士山、立山とともに日本三霊山に数えられる、石川県と岐阜県にまたがる山は？
desc_en: You have arrived at Mount Hakusan in Hakusan City. Rising 2,702 meters on the border between Ishikawa and Gifu, it is counted among Japan's Three Holy Mountains, along with Mount Fuji and Tateyama. It is said to have been opened by Taicho in the Nara period and is the source of faith for Hakusan shrines across Japan. In summer, alpine plants bearing the Hakusan name bloom across the summit area, and it bustles with climbers coming to worship the sunrise.
quiz_en: Which mountain straddling Ishikawa and Gifu prefectures is counted among Japan's Three Holy Mountains along with Mount Fuji and Tateyama?

name: 弘法池
desc: 白山市釜清水町、手取川沿いの山あいにある小さな池です。白山麓の豊かな水に育まれた静かな水辺で、周囲の木々を映す水面が旅の足を止めさせます。近くには手取峡谷の断崖も広がり、深い緑と清らかな水が織りなす白山麓らしい風景をゆっくり味わえます。
quiz: 白山麓の弘法池のほとりで、あなたが見つけた季節の景色は何でしたか？
desc_en: This small pond sits in the mountains along the Tedori River in Kamashimizu, Hakusan City. Fed by the abundant waters of the Hakusan foothills, it is a quiet spot where the surface mirrors the surrounding trees and invites travelers to pause. The sheer cliffs of Tedori Gorge lie nearby, so you can take your time enjoying the deep greenery and clear water so typical of the Hakusan foothills.
quiz_en: Beside Kobo Pond in the Hakusan foothills, what seasonal scenery did you discover during your visit, and what made it memorable?

name: 手取峡谷
addr: 白山市釜清水町 から 河原山町地内
desc: 白山を源とする手取川が刻んだ峡谷で、切り立った岩壁が数キロにわたって続きます。峡谷に流れ落ちる綿ヶ滝は見どころの一つで、白い水しぶきが新緑や紅葉に映えます。橋の上から深い谷底を見下ろすと、長い年月をかけて川が大地を削った迫力が伝わってきます。
quiz: 手取峡谷に流れ落ちる、白い綿のような姿から名付けられた滝は何という？
desc_en: Carved by the Tedori River, which rises on Mount Hakusan, this gorge features sheer rock walls that continue for several kilometers. One highlight is Watagataki Falls, which plunges into the gorge, its white spray standing out against fresh spring greenery or autumn leaves. Looking down from a bridge into the deep valley floor, you can sense the power of a river that has cut into the land over countless years.
quiz_en: What is the name of the waterfall that pours into Tedori Gorge, named for its resemblance to fluffy white cotton?

name: 鳥越城跡附二曲城跡
addr: 白山市三坂町・別宮町・上野町
desc: 戦国時代、加賀の一向一揆が織田勢に抵抗した拠点の山城跡で、二曲城跡とともに国の史跡に指定されています。山上には本丸や門の跡が整備され、白山麓の山並みと手取川流域を見渡せます。百年近く「百姓の持ちたる国」と呼ばれた加賀の歴史をしのばせる場所です。
quiz: 「百姓の持ちたる国」と呼ばれた加賀で、織田勢と戦った宗教勢力の一揆は何？
name_en: Torigoe Castle Ruins and Futamage Castle Ruins
desc_en: These are the remains of a mountain castle that served as a stronghold for the Ikko-ikki uprising of Kaga as it resisted the Oda forces during the Warring States period. Together with the Futamage Castle ruins, it is designated a National Historic Site. The hilltop has restored traces of the main enclosure and gates, with views over the Hakusan foothills and the Tedori River basin. It evokes the history of Kaga, called "a province ruled by peasants" for nearly a century.
quiz_en: In Kaga, once called "a province ruled by peasants," which religious uprising fought against the forces of Oda Nobunaga?

name: 聖興寺
desc: 白山市の松任地区にある寺院で、江戸時代の俳人・加賀千代女ゆかりの寺として知られています。境内には千代女をしのぶ句碑などがあり、俳句好きの旅人が訪れます。かつて北国街道の宿場町として栄えた松任の町なかで、静かに手を合わせたいお寺です。
quiz: 「朝顔に つるべとられて もらい水」の句で知られる、松任出身の女流俳人は誰？
desc_en: Located in the Matto district of Hakusan City, this temple is known for its ties to Kaga no Chiyojo, a haiku poet of the Edo period. The grounds hold monuments inscribed with her verses, drawing travelers who love haiku. Set in the heart of Matto, which once thrived as a post town on the Hokkoku Kaido highway, it is a temple where you may wish to quietly put your hands together in prayer.
quiz_en: Who is the female haiku poet from Matto known for a famous verse about borrowing water because morning glories had entwined her well bucket?

name: 一閑寺
desc: 白山市鶴来本町にある寺院です。鶴来は加賀一宮・白山比咩神社の門前町として栄え、酒蔵や古い町家が残る落ち着いた町並みが魅力です。手取川が平野へ流れ出る扇の要に位置する町を歩きながら、寺の静けさとともに門前町の歴史の重なりを感じてみてください。
quiz: 鶴来の町歩きで、寺めぐりのあとに味わいたい地元の名物は何ですか？
desc_en: This temple stands in Tsurugi Honmachi, Hakusan City. Tsurugi prospered as the gateway town of Shirayama Hime Shrine, the foremost shrine of Kaga Province, and its calm streets of sake breweries and old townhouses are a major draw. As you stroll this town at the point where the Tedori River fans out onto the plain, feel the layers of history of a shrine town along with the stillness of the temple.
quiz_en: While strolling around Tsurugi after visiting its temples, which local specialty would you most like to taste, and why?

name: 美川温泉
desc: 手取川の河口近く、日本海に面した美川地区の温泉です。海辺の町らしく潮風を感じながら湯につかることができ、天気の良い夕方には日本海に沈む夕日も楽しみです。美川は北前船の寄港地として栄えた港町で、湯上がりには古い町並みや海辺の散策もおすすめです。
quiz: 美川温泉で湯上がりに眺めたい、日本海側ならではの景色は何ですか？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) lies in the Mikawa district, near the mouth of the Tedori River and facing the Sea of Japan. True to its seaside setting, you can soak while feeling the sea breeze, and on clear evenings look forward to the sun sinking into the Sea of Japan. Mikawa flourished as a port of call for Kitamaebune trading ships, so after your bath, a stroll through the old streets and along the shore is recommended.
quiz_en: After a soak at Mikawa Onsen, what scenery unique to the Sea of Japan coast would you like to gaze at?

name: 中宮温泉
desc: 白山の山懐、標高の高い谷あいにたたずむ秘湯で、古くから胃腸に効く湯として親しまれてきました。白山白川郷ホワイトロードの石川県側の入口近くにあり、周辺は深いブナの森と渓流に囲まれています。冬は雪に閉ざされるため、新緑から紅葉の季節に訪れたい山の湯です。
quiz: 中宮温泉から岐阜県の白川郷へ抜ける、白山を巡る山岳道路の名前は何？
desc_en: Tucked into a high valley on the slopes of Mount Hakusan, this secluded hot spring has long been cherished as a bath good for the stomach and digestion. It sits near the Ishikawa entrance of the Hakusan Shirakawa-go White Road, surrounded by deep beech forests and mountain streams. Because the area is closed off by snow in winter, it is a mountain spa best visited between the fresh greenery of spring and the autumn foliage.
quiz_en: What is the name of the mountain road around Mount Hakusan that runs from Chugu Onsen to Shirakawa-go in Gifu Prefecture?

name: 千丈温泉
desc: 白山市河内町の山あいにある温泉です。手取川の支流が流れる静かな里にあり、周囲の山々の緑や雪景色を眺めながらのんびり過ごせます。金沢方面からも足を延ばしやすい距離にあり、白山麓の自然の中でドライブやハイキングの疲れを癒やす湯として利用されています。
quiz: 千丈温泉のある白山麓の里で、季節ごとにおすすめの楽しみ方は何ですか？
desc_en: This hot spring lies in the mountains of Kawachi, Hakusan City. Set in a quiet village along a tributary of the Tedori River, it lets you relax while gazing at the green or snow-covered mountains around you. Within easy reach of the Kanazawa area, it is used as a bath for soothing the fatigue of driving and hiking amid the nature of the Hakusan foothills.
quiz_en: In the village of the Hakusan foothills where Senjo Onsen is located, what are your recommended ways to enjoy each season?

name: 瀬女温泉
desc: 白山市瀬戸、手取川上流の白山麓にある温泉です。国道157号沿いの山里にあり、白山へ向かう旅の途中に立ち寄れます。周囲は四方を山に囲まれ、春の新緑、夏の渓流、秋の紅葉、冬の雪景色と、季節ごとに表情を変える白山麓の暮らしの風景を湯船から感じられます。
quiz: 白山麓の瀬女温泉に浸かったあと、地元で味わいたい山の幸は何ですか？
desc_en: This hot spring is located in Seto, Hakusan City, in the Hakusan foothills along the upper Tedori River. Set in a mountain village on National Route 157, it makes a convenient stop on the way to Mount Hakusan. Surrounded by mountains on all sides, it lets you feel from the bath the changing faces of life in the foothills: fresh green in spring, mountain streams in summer, autumn leaves, and winter snow.
quiz_en: After soaking at Senyo Onsen in the Hakusan foothills, which local mountain delicacies would you like to taste?

name: 辰口温泉
desc: 能美市にある加賀地方の温泉地で、穏やかな丘陵に囲まれた落ち着いた湯の町です。能美市は九谷焼の産地として知られ、周辺では器づくりの文化にも触れられます。湯めぐりのあとは九谷焼の器や工房をのぞき、加賀の工芸と温泉の両方を味わう旅を楽しんでください。
quiz: 辰口温泉のある能美市が産地として知られる、色鮮やかな上絵付けの焼き物は何？
desc_en: This hot spring area in Nomi City, part of the Kaga region, is a calm spa town surrounded by gentle hills. Nomi is known as a production center of Kutani ware, so you can also experience the local culture of pottery-making nearby. After enjoying the baths, browse Kutani ware pieces and workshops, and savor a trip that combines Kaga's crafts with its hot springs.
quiz_en: Nomi City, home of Tatsunokuchi Onsen, is known for producing which colorful pottery famous for its overglaze painting?

name: 川北温泉
desc: 手取川の北側、加賀平野に広がる川北町の温泉です。周囲には田園が広がり、晴れた日には遠くに白山を望むことができます。町の暮らしに溶け込んだ気軽な湯として地元の人にも親しまれ、田んぼの風景を眺めながらの湯上がりのひとときは、のどかな加賀の里ならではです。
quiz: 川北温泉のまわりに広がる田園から、晴れた日に遠く望める霊峰は何？
desc_en: This hot spring is in Kawakita Town, which spreads across the Kaga Plain on the north side of the Tedori River. Farmland surrounds the area, and on clear days you can see Mount Hakusan in the distance. Locals also enjoy it as a casual bath woven into town life, and relaxing after a soak while looking out over the rice fields is a pleasure unique to the peaceful Kaga countryside.
quiz_en: From the farmland surrounding Kawakita Onsen, which sacred mountain can be seen in the distance on clear days?

name: 木窪大滝
desc: 津幡町の山あいに流れ落ちる滝です。津幡町は石川県のほぼ中央、富山県との境に近い町で、里山の豊かな自然が残っています。木々に囲まれた静かな森の中に響く水音は涼やかで、夏の暑い日や紅葉の頃に訪れると、山里の水辺ならではの清々しさを感じられます。
quiz: 木窪大滝のマイナスイオンを浴びたら、次に訪れたい津幡町の名所はどこですか？
desc_en: This waterfall tumbles down in the mountains of Tsubata Town. Tsubata sits near the center of Ishikawa Prefecture, close to the border with Toyama, and keeps the rich nature of its satoyama woodlands. The sound of water echoing through the quiet forest is refreshing, and if you visit on a hot summer day or in the autumn foliage season, you can enjoy the crisp feel of a mountain village waterside.
quiz_en: After soaking up the refreshing air of Kikubo Otaki Falls, which other attraction in Tsubata Town would you like to visit next?

name: 渤海温泉
desc: 能登半島の外浦、志賀町富来にある温泉です。名前は古代に日本海の対岸にあった渤海国に由来し、この沿岸が大陸との交流の舞台だった歴史を思わせます。周辺には荒波が岩を洗う能登金剛の海岸景勝地もあり、湯とあわせて日本海の雄大な景色を楽しめます。
quiz: 渤海温泉の名の由来となった、古代に日本と使節を交わした大陸の国は何？
desc_en: This hot spring is in Togi, Shika Town, on the outer coast of the Noto Peninsula. Its name comes from the ancient kingdom of Bohai (Bokkai) across the Sea of Japan, recalling a history in which this coast was a stage for exchange with the continent. Nearby is Noto Kongo, a scenic coastline where rough waves wash over the rocks, so you can enjoy the grand Sea of Japan views together with the baths.
quiz_en: Which ancient kingdom on the continent, which exchanged envoys with Japan, gave Bokkai Onsen its name?

name: 明千寺キリコ祭り
desc: 穴水町の明千寺地区で行われるキリコ祭りです。能登では夏から秋にかけて、灯をともした巨大な灯籠「キリコ」を担いで練り歩く祭りが各地で続きます。集落の人々が力を合わせて担ぐキリコが夜の闇に浮かび上がる光景は、能登の暮らしに根づいた祈りと絆を感じさせます。
quiz: 能登のキリコ祭り、明千寺で見たキリコの灯りはどんな色や絵柄でしたか？
desc_en: This Kiriko festival is held in the Myosenji district of Anamizu Town. Across Noto, from summer into autumn, festivals take place in which people carry huge illuminated lanterns called kiriko through the streets. The sight of kiriko, shouldered by villagers working together, glowing in the darkness of night conveys the prayers and bonds rooted in daily life on Noto.
quiz_en: At the Kiriko festival in Myosenji, what colors or pictures did you see on the glowing kiriko lanterns?

name: 奥能登の黒瓦の集落群
desc: 奥能登の集落には、黒く光る釉薬瓦の屋根が連なる風景が残っています。雪や潮風に強い能登瓦は、日本海の厳しい気候の中で暮らしを守ってきました。能登町宮地の家並みも、黒瓦と板張りの壁が田園や里山に溶け込み、能登の里山里海の原風景を今に伝えています。
quiz: 奥能登の家々の屋根を黒く輝かせている、雪や潮風に強い瓦を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: In the villages of Oku-Noto, the far tip of the Noto Peninsula, you can still see rows of roofs covered in glossy black glazed tiles. Resistant to snow and salty sea winds, Noto tiles have protected homes through the harsh Sea of Japan climate. The houses of Miyaji in Noto Town, with black tiles and board walls blending into fields and wooded hills, preserve the original landscape of Noto's countryside and coast.
quiz_en: What are the snow- and salt-resistant tiles that give the roofs of Oku-Noto houses their shiny black color called?

name: 真脇遺跡公園
desc: 能登町真脇の入り江にある縄文時代の遺跡で、国の史跡に指定されています。大量のイルカの骨や、巨大な木柱を円形に並べた環状木柱列が見つかったことで知られます。公園では復元された木柱列や縄文館を見学でき、海とともに暮らした縄文人の姿を身近に感じられます。
quiz: 真脇遺跡から大量に骨が見つかり、縄文人の暮らしを支えたとされる海の生き物は何？
desc_en: Located on an inlet at Mawaki in Noto Town, this Jomon period site is designated a National Historic Site. It is known for the discovery of large numbers of dolphin bones and a ring of huge wooden pillars arranged in a circle. In the park you can see the reconstructed pillar circle and the Jomon museum, bringing you closer to the lives of Jomon people who lived alongside the sea.
quiz_en: Large numbers of bones of which sea creature, thought to have supported the Jomon people's lives, were found at the Mawaki site?

name: 一乗谷朝倉氏遺跡
desc: 戦国大名朝倉氏が五代約百年にわたって本拠とした城下町の跡で、国の特別史跡です。谷あいに館跡や武家屋敷、町屋の遺構が広がり、一部では町並みが復原されています。唐門や庭園跡も見どころで、織田信長に攻められて滅んだ戦国の都の栄華をしのぶことができます。
quiz: 一乗谷を本拠とした戦国大名・朝倉氏を攻め滅ぼした戦国武将は誰でしょう？
desc_en: These are the remains of the castle town that the Asakura, a Warring States daimyo family, used as their base for about a century over five generations. It is a Special Historic Site. Remains of residences, samurai houses, and townhouses spread through the valley, and part of the townscape has been reconstructed. With the Karamon gate and old garden sites among its highlights, it lets you imagine the glory of a Warring States capital destroyed after an attack by Oda Nobunaga.
quiz_en: Which Warring States warlord attacked and destroyed the Asakura clan, the daimyo family that made Ichijodani their base?

name: 丸岡城
desc: 江戸時代以前に建てられた天守が今も残る、全国でも数少ない城の一つです。小ぶりながら古風な天守は石瓦で葺かれ、霞ヶ城の別名でも呼ばれます。「一筆啓上 火の用心」の短い手紙にちなむ一筆啓上賞でも知られ、春には桜に包まれて天守がいっそう美しく映えます。
quiz: 丸岡城にちなむ「日本一短い手紙」は、何という言葉で書き出されている？
desc_en: This is one of the few castles in Japan whose keep, built before the Edo period, still stands. Small yet old-fashioned, the keep is roofed with stone tiles, and the castle is also called Kasumigajo, the "Castle of Mist." It is known for a short-letter contest inspired by a brief note reading "A word to you: beware of fire," and in spring the keep looks even more beautiful wrapped in cherry blossoms.
quiz_en: The "shortest letter in Japan" associated with Maruoka Castle begins with which phrase, meaning roughly "a brief word to you"?

name: 永平寺
desc: 鎌倉時代に道元禅師が開いた曹洞宗の大本山で、今も多くの修行僧が日々坐禅に励んでいます。深い杉木立の山中に七堂伽藍が回廊で結ばれて建ち並び、張りつめた静けさが漂います。修行の場であることを心に留め、凛とした空気の中で心を整える参拝をしてみてください。
quiz: 永平寺を開いた、鎌倉時代の禅僧で曹洞宗の開祖とされる人物は誰でしょう？
desc_en: Founded by the Zen master Dogen in the Kamakura period, this is a head temple of the Soto school of Zen, where many trainee monks still practice zazen meditation every day. Deep in a mountain grove of cedars, its seven main halls stand linked by covered corridors, filled with a taut silence. Keep in mind that this is a place of training, and visit in a way that lets you settle your mind in the crisp atmosphere.
quiz_en: Who was the Kamakura-period Zen monk who founded Eihei-ji and is regarded as the founder of the Soto school?

name: 三方五湖
desc: 若狭湾に近い美浜町と若狭町にまたがる五つの湖の総称です。淡水、汽水、海水と湖ごとに水質が異なり、水の色が少しずつ違って見えるのが特徴で、ラムサール条約湿地にも登録されています。山頂公園やドライブウェイから見下ろす五色の湖と若狭湾の眺めは格別です。
quiz: 三方五湖の五つの湖のうち、梅丈岳の麓にある一番大きな湖の名前は何？
desc_en: This is the collective name for five lakes spanning Mihama Town and Wakasa Town near Wakasa Bay. Each lake has different water, from fresh to brackish to seawater, so their colors look slightly different, and they are registered as a Ramsar Convention wetland. The view of the five-colored lakes and Wakasa Bay from the summit park or the scenic driveway is exceptional.
quiz_en: Of the Mikata Five Lakes, what is the name of the largest one, lying at the foot of Mount Baijo?

name: 昇仙峡
desc: 甲府市の北、荒川が花崗岩を削ってできた渓谷で、国の特別名勝に指定されています。天を突く岩峰・覚円峰や、落差のある仙娥滝など見どころが続き、遊歩道で奇岩と清流の景観を楽しめます。秋の紅葉はとりわけ見事で、甲州名産の水晶細工の店がある渓谷の上流も散策できます。
quiz: 昇仙峡の遊歩道の終点近くで、轟音を立てて流れ落ちる滝の名前は何？
desc_en: North of Kofu City, this ravine was formed as the Arakawa River carved through granite, and it is designated a Special Place of Scenic Beauty. Highlights follow one after another, such as the soaring rock peak Kakuenpo and the tall Sengataki Falls, and walking trails let you enjoy the strange rocks and clear stream. The autumn foliage is especially splendid, and you can also explore the upper gorge, where shops sell crystal crafts, a Yamanashi specialty.
quiz_en: What is the name of the waterfall that thunders down near the end of the walking trail through Shosenkyo Gorge?

name: 金櫻神社
desc: 昇仙峡の奥、御岳の地に鎮座する古社で、金峰山を仰ぐ信仰の拠点として栄えました。境内の鬱金の桜は淡い黄色の花を咲かせることで知られ、金運のご利益を求める参拝者も訪れます。杉木立に囲まれた社殿は山の霊気に満ち、昇仙峡の散策とあわせて訪れたい神社です。
quiz: 金櫻神社の境内で春に咲く、淡い黄色の花をつける珍しい桜の名前は何でしょう？
desc_en: This ancient shrine stands in Mitake, deep beyond Shosenkyo Gorge, and flourished as a center of worship of Mount Kinpu. The Ukon cherry tree on its grounds is known for its pale yellow blossoms, and visitors also come seeking blessings for wealth. Surrounded by cedars, the shrine buildings are filled with the spiritual air of the mountains, making it a shrine worth visiting along with a walk through Shosenkyo.
quiz_en: What is the name of the rare cherry tree that blooms with pale yellow flowers in spring on the grounds of Kanazakura Shrine?

name: 武田神社
desc: 武田信玄を祀る神社で、武田氏の本拠だった躑躅ヶ崎館の跡に鎮座しています。境内には館時代の堀や土塁が残り、戦国の名将の拠点の面影を感じられます。甲府駅から北へ延びる武田通りの先にあり、勝運のご利益を求める参拝者や、春の桜を楽しむ人々でにぎわいます。
quiz: 武田神社が建つ場所は、もともと武田氏が本拠とした何という館の跡でしょう？
desc_en: Dedicated to Takeda Shingen, this shrine stands on the site of the Tsutsujigasaki residence, the base of the Takeda clan. Moats and earthen ramparts from the residence remain on the grounds, conveying the atmosphere of a great Warring States general's headquarters. Located at the end of Takeda-dori Avenue, which runs north from Kofu Station, it is busy with worshippers seeking luck in winning and people enjoying the spring cherry blossoms.
quiz_en: Takeda Shrine stands on the site of which residence that originally served as the headquarters of the Takeda clan?

name: 柳町大神宮節分祭
desc: 甲府の中心市街地、中央にある柳町大神宮で行われる節分の行事です。寒さの厳しい甲府盆地の冬、立春を前に福を呼び込み厄を払う豆まきが行われ、町の人々が集います。にぎやかな商店街に近い社で季節の節目を感じ、冬の甲府の町歩きとあわせて楽しんでください。
quiz: 柳町大神宮の節分祭、あなたの地元では豆まきのとき何と唱えますか？
desc_en: This Setsubun event takes place at Yanagicho Daijingu Shrine in Chuo, in central Kofu. In the bitterly cold winter of the Kofu Basin, just before the start of spring on the old calendar, people gather for a bean-throwing ceremony to welcome good fortune and drive away bad luck. Feel the turn of the seasons at this shrine near a lively shopping street, and enjoy it along with a winter stroll around Kofu.
quiz_en: At the Yanagicho Daijingu Setsubun Festival people throw beans; what do people chant during bean-throwing where you come from?

name: 甲府大好きまつり
desc: 甲府市で開かれる、市民が主役の祭りです。甲府は戦国時代に武田氏の城下町として開かれ、今も山梨県の県都としてにぎわいます。四方を山に囲まれた甲府盆地の町に人々が集い、地元の味や催しを通じてふるさとの魅力を分かち合う、町への愛着が伝わる祭りです。
quiz: 甲府大好きまつりで味わいたい、山梨ならではのご当地グルメは何ですか？
desc_en: Held in Kofu City, this is a festival in which the citizens themselves take center stage. Kofu was founded as the castle town of the Takeda clan in the Warring States period and remains a lively capital of Yamanashi Prefecture today. People gather in this basin town ringed by mountains to share the charms of their hometown through local food and events, and the festival conveys their deep affection for the city.
quiz_en: At the Kofu Daisuki Festival, which local Yamanashi specialty dish would you most like to try?

name: 吉田の火祭り・すすき祭り
desc: 富士山の山じまいの祭りとして毎年夏の終わりに行われる、北口本宮冨士浅間神社と諏訪神社の祭礼で、日本三奇祭の一つに数えられます。町の通りに並べた大松明に次々と火が灯され、夜の上吉田が炎に包まれます。翌日のすすき祭りで、富士の夏山シーズンが締めくくられます。
quiz: 吉田の火祭りで、町なかに燃え上がる大松明はどんな形をしている？
name_en: Yoshida Fire Festival and Susuki Festival
desc_en: Held every year at the end of summer to close Mount Fuji's climbing season, this is the festival of Kitaguchi Hongu Fuji Sengen Shrine and Suwa Shrine, counted among Japan's three most unusual festivals. Giant torches set up along the streets are lit one after another, wrapping Kamiyoshida in flames at night. The Susuki Festival the following day brings Fuji's summer climbing season to an end.
quiz_en: During the Yoshida Fire Festival, what shape are the giant torches that blaze along the streets of the town?

name: リフレふじよしだ春祭り
desc: 富士吉田市新屋の施設「リフレふじよしだ」で開かれる春の祭りです。富士山の北麓に位置する富士吉田は、残雪を抱いた富士山がとりわけ大きく迫って見える町です。長い冬が明けた春の訪れを祝い、地元の人々が集うひとときを、富士の眺めとともに味わってください。
quiz: リフレふじよしだ春祭りの会場から見た春の富士山、雪はどこまで残っていましたか？
desc_en: This spring festival takes place at Refre Fujiyoshida, a facility in Araya, Fujiyoshida City. Located at the northern foot of Mount Fuji, Fujiyoshida is a town where the snow-capped mountain looks especially huge and close. Celebrating the arrival of spring after a long winter, it is a time for local people to gather, so enjoy it together with views of Fuji.
quiz_en: Looking at Mount Fuji in spring from the Refre Fujiyoshida Spring Festival grounds, how far down the slopes did the snow still reach?

name: 西沢渓谷
desc: 笛吹川の源流部に位置する渓谷で、奥秩父の原生林の中を清流が流れ下ります。渓谷を一周する遊歩道には大小の滝が続き、なかでもエメラルド色の滝つぼが連なる七ツ釜五段の滝は日本の滝百選に選ばれています。新緑と紅葉の時期は特に美しく、多くのハイカーが訪れます。
quiz: 西沢渓谷のハイライト、五段に連なって流れ落ちる滝の名前は何？
desc_en: Located at the headwaters of the Fuefuki River, this gorge has a clear stream flowing through the virgin forests of Oku-Chichibu. The loop trail around the gorge passes a series of large and small waterfalls, and Nanatsugama Godan Falls, with its chain of emerald plunge pools, is listed among Japan's 100 best waterfalls. The gorge is especially beautiful in the fresh green and autumn foliage seasons, attracting many hikers.
quiz_en: What is the name of the highlight of Nishizawa Gorge, a waterfall that cascades down in five connected tiers?

name: 鼓川温泉
desc: 山梨市牧丘町の山あいにある温泉です。牧丘はぶどうの産地として知られ、斜面に果樹園が広がるのどかな土地です。湯船からは周囲の山並みや果樹の里の風景を眺めることができ、ぶどう狩りや秋の行楽の帰りに立ち寄れば、果物の里ならではの一日を締めくくれます。
quiz: 鼓川温泉のある牧丘で、旅のおみやげに選びたい果物は何ですか？
desc_en: This hot spring lies in the mountains of Makioka, Yamanashi City. Makioka is known for growing grapes, a peaceful area where orchards cover the slopes. From the bath you can look out over the surrounding mountains and orchard countryside, and if you stop by on your way back from grape picking or an autumn outing, it is a fitting end to a day in fruit country.
quiz_en: In Makioka, home of Tsuzumigawa Onsen, which fruit would you choose to take home as a souvenir of your trip?

name: 猿橋
desc: 桂川の深い谷に架かる木造の橋で、日本三奇橋の一つに数えられます。橋脚を立てず、両岸から張り出した刎木を重ねて支える独特の構造で、国の名勝にも指定されています。甲州街道の要所として旅人が渡った橋で、谷底を見下ろすと、その架橋の工夫に驚かされます。
quiz: 猿橋のように、橋脚を使わず両岸から木を張り出して支える橋の構造を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: This wooden bridge spans the deep valley of the Katsura River and is counted among Japan's three strangest bridges. With no piers, it uses a unique structure of cantilevered beams stacked out from both banks, and it is designated a National Place of Scenic Beauty. Travelers crossed it as a key point on the Koshu Kaido highway, and looking down into the gorge, you will be amazed at the ingenuity of its construction.
quiz_en: What is the bridge style called in which, like Saruhashi, timbers project from both banks to support the span without piers?

name: かがり火市民祭り
desc: 大月市で開かれる市民の祭りで、名前のとおり夜を彩るかがり火が祭りを象徴します。大月は桂川沿いに開けた町で、甲州街道の宿場が点在した歴史を持ち、周囲を山に囲まれています。山あいの町に灯る火のぬくもりと、集う人々のにぎわいを感じてください。
quiz: かがり火市民祭りで、かがり火の明かりの中で一番印象に残った光景は何ですか？
desc_en: This citizens' festival in Otsuki City is symbolized, as its name suggests, by bonfires (kagaribi) that light up the night. Otsuki developed along the Katsura River, has a history of post towns dotting the Koshu Kaido highway, and is surrounded by mountains. Feel the warmth of the fires glowing in this mountain town and the lively bustle of the people who gather.
quiz_en: At the Kagaribi Citizens' Festival, what scene in the glow of the bonfires left the deepest impression on you?

name: 武田の里にらさき・ふるさとまつり
addr: 韮崎市（駅前中央通り・本町通り）
desc: 韮崎市の駅前中央通りや本町通りを舞台に開かれるふるさとの祭りです。韮崎は甲斐源氏・武田氏ゆかりの地で、武田勝頼が築いた新府城の跡も市内にあります。釜無川の流れと八ヶ岳や南アルプスの山々に抱かれた町で、通りを埋めるにぎわいを楽しんでください。
quiz: 韮崎市に城跡が残る、武田勝頼が最後に築いた城の名前は何でしょう？
name_en: Takeda no Sato Nirasaki Hometown Festival
desc_en: This hometown festival takes place on Ekimae Chuo-dori and Honcho-dori streets in Nirasaki City. Nirasaki is linked to the Kai Genji clan and the Takeda family, and the ruins of Shinpu Castle, built by Takeda Katsuyori, are also in the city. In a town embraced by the Kamanashi River and the peaks of Yatsugatake and the Southern Alps, enjoy the crowds that fill the streets.
quiz_en: What is the name of the last castle built by Takeda Katsuyori, whose ruins remain in Nirasaki City?

name: 武田乃郷 白山温泉
desc: 韮崎市神山町の山あいにある温泉です。武田氏ゆかりの里にふさわしい名を持ち、地元の人に親しまれる湯として知られています。韮崎の高台からは八ヶ岳や南アルプス、富士山の眺めも楽しめる土地柄で、山々に抱かれた甲斐の里の静けさの中で、旅の疲れをゆっくり癒やせます。
quiz: 武田乃郷 白山温泉のある韮崎から見える山々のうち、あなたが一番好きな山はどれ？
desc_en: This hot spring is located in the mountains of Kamiyama, Nirasaki City. Its name suits a village associated with the Takeda clan, and it is known as a bath loved by local people. The heights of Nirasaki offer views of Yatsugatake, the Southern Alps, and Mount Fuji, and in the quiet of this Kai countryside surrounded by mountains, you can leisurely soothe the fatigue of your travels.
quiz_en: Of the mountains you can see from Nirasaki, home of Takeda no Sato Hakusan Onsen, which one is your favorite?

name: 白峰三山
desc: 南アルプスの北部にそびえる北岳、間ノ岳、農鳥岳の三山の総称です。北岳は富士山に次ぐ日本第二の高峰で、三山を結ぶ稜線は三千メートル級の山々が連なる国内屈指の縦走路です。夏には高山植物が咲き誇り、稜線から望む富士山の姿は登山者の大きな励みになります。
quiz: 白峰三山の一つで、富士山に次ぐ日本第二の高峰として知られる山はどれでしょう？
desc_en: This is the collective name for three peaks in the northern Southern Alps: Kitadake, Ainodake, and Notoridake. Kitadake is Japan's second-highest peak after Mount Fuji, and the ridge linking the three, lined with peaks around 3,000 meters high, is one of the country's finest traverse routes. Alpine flowers bloom in summer, and the view of Mount Fuji from the ridge greatly encourages climbers.
quiz_en: Which of the three Shiramine peaks is known as Japan's second-highest mountain after Mount Fuji?

name: 仙丈ヶ岳
addr: 南アルプス市芦安芦倉
desc: 南アルプスの北部にそびえる標高三千メートルを超える山で、その優美な山容から「南アルプスの女王」と呼ばれます。山頂付近には氷河が削ったカールが残り、夏にはお花畑が広がります。山梨県側の芦安から林道バスで北沢峠へ向かい、そこから登るのが一般的なルートです。
quiz: 仙丈ヶ岳の山頂近くに見られる、氷河が削ってできたお椀形の地形を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: Rising over 3,000 meters in the northern Southern Alps, this mountain is called the "Queen of the Southern Alps" for its graceful shape. Near the summit are cirques carved by glaciers, which turn into fields of flowers in summer. The usual route is to take a forest-road bus from Ashiyasu on the Yamanashi side to Kitazawa Pass and climb from there.
quiz_en: What is the bowl-shaped landform carved by glaciers, seen near the summit of Mount Senjo, called?

name: 湧暇李の里 樹園
desc: 南アルプス市野牛島にある施設です。南アルプス市は甲府盆地の西側、御勅使川がつくる扇状地に広がり、さくらんぼやすもも、桃などの果樹栽培が盛んな土地です。背後には南アルプスの山々が迫り、果樹の里の豊かな実りと雄大な山の景色を一度に味わえます。
quiz: 果樹の里・南アルプス市で、あなたが一番味わいたい旬のフルーツは何ですか？
desc_en: This facility is located in Yagoshima, Minami-Alps City. The city spreads over the alluvial fan of the Midai River on the western side of the Kofu Basin, an area where fruit growing, including cherries, plums, and peaches, thrives. With the Southern Alps rising behind, you can enjoy both the rich harvests of fruit country and grand mountain scenery at once.
quiz_en: In Minami-Alps City, a land of orchards, which seasonal fruit would you most like to taste during your visit?

name: 甲斐駒ヶ岳
desc: 山梨と長野の県境にそびえる南アルプス北端の名峰で、白い花崗岩の山肌と鋭いピラミッド形の姿が印象的です。古くから信仰の山として登られ、山梨県側の黒戸尾根は日本有数の急登として知られます。北杜市の白州や長坂から見上げる堂々とした姿は、八ヶ岳南麓の旅の象徴です。
quiz: 甲斐駒ヶ岳の山梨県側から山頂へ続く、急登で知られる尾根の名前は何？
desc_en: Rising on the border of Yamanashi and Nagano, this celebrated peak at the northern end of the Southern Alps is striking for its white granite slopes and sharp pyramid shape. It has long been climbed as a sacred mountain, and the Kurodo Ridge on the Yamanashi side is known as one of Japan's steepest ascents. Its majestic form, seen from Hakushu and Nagasaka in Hokuto City, symbolizes travel in the southern foothills of Yatsugatake.
quiz_en: What is the name of the ridge on the Yamanashi side of Mount Kaikoma, famous as a steep route to the summit?

name: 八ヶ岳
desc: 山梨と長野にまたがり南北に連なる火山群で、主峰の赤岳をはじめ多くの峰が並びます。山梨県側の北杜市の南麓には牧場や高原リゾートが広がり、清里や大泉の高原からは堂々とした山並みを仰げます。夏の高山植物、秋の紅葉、冬の雪山と、四季を通じて魅力のある山域です。
quiz: 八ヶ岳連峰の最高峰で、赤い岩肌にちなんで名付けられた山は何でしょう？
desc_en: Spanning Yamanashi and Nagano, this volcanic range runs north to south with many peaks, led by its main summit, Akadake. On the Yamanashi side, ranches and highland resorts spread over the southern foothills in Hokuto City, and from the plateaus of Kiyosato and Oizumi you can look up at the imposing range. With alpine flowers in summer, autumn leaves, and snowy peaks in winter, it is appealing all year round.
quiz_en: What is the highest peak of the Yatsugatake range, named after the reddish color of its rocky slopes?

name: シミック八ヶ岳薬用植物園
addr: 北杜市小淵沢町上笹尾3332-3
desc: 八ヶ岳南麓、北杜市小淵沢町にある薬用植物園です。古くから薬として使われてきた草木を中心に、さまざまな植物が育てられ、身近な草花の意外な効能を学びながら散策できます。標高の高い高原の澄んだ空気の中、季節の花々とともに植物と人の暮らしの関わりにふれてみてください。
quiz: シミック八ヶ岳薬用植物園で、あなたが「これも薬草なの？」と驚いた植物は何？
desc_en: This medicinal plant garden is in Kobuchizawa, Hokuto City, at the southern foot of Yatsugatake. It grows a wide variety of plants, centered on herbs and trees long used as medicine, so you can stroll while learning surprising benefits of familiar plants. In the clear air of the high plateau, explore the ties between plants and human life alongside the seasonal flowers.
quiz_en: At the CMIC Yatsugatake Medicinal Botanical Garden, which plant surprised you the most when you learned it was a medicinal herb?

name: 山梨県立まきば公園
desc: 八ヶ岳南麓の北杜市大泉町に広がる県立の牧場公園です。のびやかな草原では羊などの動物とふれあうことができ、晴れた日には富士山や南アルプスの山並みを一望できます。高原の爽やかな風を感じながら、芝生でのんびり過ごしたり、乳製品を味わったりするのが楽しみです。
quiz: まきば公園の草原から、晴れた日に南の方角に望める日本一の山は何？
desc_en: This prefectural ranch park spreads across Oizumi, Hokuto City, at the southern foot of Yatsugatake. On its open meadows you can interact with sheep and other animals, and on clear days you can take in Mount Fuji and the Southern Alps at a glance. Relaxing on the grass in the refreshing highland breeze or tasting dairy products are among its pleasures.
quiz_en: From the meadows of Makiba Park, which mountain, the tallest in Japan, can be seen to the south on clear days?

name: 甲斐源氏祭り
desc: 北杜市須玉町で開かれる、甲斐源氏の歴史にちなんだ祭りです。北杜市一帯は平安時代の終わりから甲斐源氏が勢力を広げた地とされ、のちの武田氏へとつながる歴史の舞台でもあります。八ヶ岳と南アルプスに囲まれた里で、郷土の歴史に思いを寄せるひとときを過ごしてください。
quiz: 甲斐源氏の流れをくみ、戦国時代に武田信玄を輩出した一族は何氏でしょう？
desc_en: Held in Sutama, Hokuto City, this festival celebrates the history of the Kai Genji clan. The Hokuto area is said to be where the Kai Genji expanded their power from the end of the Heian period, making it a stage of the history that led to the later Takeda clan. In a village surrounded by Yatsugatake and the Southern Alps, spend a moment reflecting on local history.
quiz_en: Which clan, descended from the Kai Genji, produced the famous Warring States warlord Takeda Shingen?

name: みずがき山自然公園
desc: 奥秩父の瑞牆山の麓、北杜市須玉町に広がる自然公園です。花崗岩の巨岩が林立する瑞牆山の荒々しい姿を間近に望め、広い芝生や森の散策路で過ごせます。岩峰は岩登りの場としても知られ、秋には山肌の紅葉と白い岩のコントラストが見事な景観をつくります。
quiz: みずがき山自然公園から見上げる、花崗岩の岩峰が林立する山の名前は何？
desc_en: This nature park spreads across Sutama, Hokuto City, at the foot of Mount Mizugaki in Oku-Chichibu. You can view the rugged form of Mount Mizugaki, bristling with huge granite rocks, up close, and spend time on wide lawns and forest trails. The rock peaks are also known for rock climbing, and in autumn the contrast between the colored leaves and white rock creates a magnificent scene.
quiz_en: What is the name of the mountain bristling with granite rock pinnacles that you look up at from Mizugakiyama Nature Park?

name: 實相寺（神代桜）
desc: 北杜市武川町にある日蓮宗の寺院で、境内の山高神代桜で全国に知られています。樹齢二千年ともいわれるエドヒガンの古木で、日本三大桜の一つに数えられ、国の天然記念物にも指定されています。春には南アルプスの雪山を背景に花を咲かせ、多くの花見客が訪れます。
quiz: 實相寺の神代桜とともに「日本三大桜」に数えられる、福島県三春町の桜は何？
desc_en: This Nichiren school temple in Mukawa, Hokuto City, is known nationwide for the Yamataka Jindai Zakura on its grounds. An ancient Edohigan cherry said to be some 2,000 years old, it is counted among Japan's three great cherry trees and designated a Natural Monument. In spring it blooms against a backdrop of the snowy Southern Alps, drawing many blossom viewers.
quiz_en: Which cherry tree in Miharu, Fukushima Prefecture, is counted with Jisso-ji's Jindai cherry among Japan's three great cherry trees?

name: 北杜市甲斐駒の里 名水まつり
desc: 北杜市白州町で開かれる名水にちなんだ祭りです。白州は甲斐駒ヶ岳の花崗岩が育んだ清らかな水に恵まれた土地で、名水の里として知られ、酒造りやウイスキーづくりにも水が生かされています。甲斐駒ヶ岳を仰ぐ里で、水の恵みに感謝する人々の祭りを楽しんでください。
quiz: 白州の名水の里で、あなたがおいしい水を使って味わいたいものは何ですか？
name_en: Hokuto Kaikoma no Sato Spring Water Festival
desc_en: This festival in Hakushu, Hokuto City, celebrates the area's famous spring water. Hakushu is blessed with pure water nurtured by the granite of Mount Kaikoma and is known as a home of fine water, used in sake brewing and whisky making. In this village beneath Mount Kaikoma, enjoy a festival where people give thanks for the gift of water.
quiz_en: In Hakushu, known for its pure spring water, what would you most like to taste that is made with that delicious water?

name: 北杜ふるさと祭り
addr: 北杜市高根町村山東割98
desc: 北杜市高根町で開かれるふるさとの祭りです。高根町は八ヶ岳の南麓に位置し、清里高原へと続く土地で、高原野菜や米づくりが盛んです。八ヶ岳を背に広がる田園と高原の町で、地域の人々が集って郷土の魅力を分かち合う、温かな雰囲気の祭りです。
quiz: 八ヶ岳南麓の北杜ふるさと祭りで、味わいたい地元の高原の恵みは何ですか？
desc_en: This hometown festival is held in Takane, Hokuto City. Takane lies at the southern foot of Yatsugatake, leading up to the Kiyosato Plateau, and highland vegetables and rice farming thrive here. In this town of farmland and plateaus backed by Yatsugatake, local people gather to share the charms of their hometown at a festival with a warm atmosphere.
quiz_en: At the Hokuto Furusato Festival at the southern foot of Yatsugatake, which local highland produce would you like to taste?

name: 浅尾ダイコン祭り
addr: 北杜市明野町浅尾5259-950(明野温泉太陽館）
desc: 北杜市明野町浅尾で開かれる、ダイコンを主役にした祭りです。明野は日照時間の長さで知られ、夏の広大なひまわり畑でも有名な土地です。昼夜の寒暖差の大きい高原の畑で育ったダイコンの収穫を祝う祭りで、冬の澄んだ空気の中、富士山や南アルプスの眺めも楽しめます。
quiz: 浅尾ダイコン祭りで手に入れたダイコン、あなたならどんな料理にしますか？
desc_en: This festival in Asao, Akeno, Hokuto City, puts the daikon radish center stage. Akeno is known for its long hours of sunshine and is also famous for its vast summer sunflower fields. The festival celebrates the harvest of daikon grown in highland fields with large temperature swings between day and night, and in the clear winter air you can also enjoy views of Mount Fuji and the Southern Alps.
quiz_en: If you brought home a daikon radish from the Asao Daikon Radish Festival, what kind of dish would you make with it?

name: 甲府盆地の桃畑
desc: 山梨県は桃の生産量が全国一位で、笛吹市を中心とする甲府盆地東部には桃畑が一面に広がります。春になると盆地一帯が桃の花のピンク色に染まり、「桃源郷」と呼ばれる景色が現れます。背後の南アルプスの残雪や富士山と花の取り合わせは、山梨の春を代表する風景です。
quiz: 山梨県が全国一位の生産量を誇る果物で、春に盆地をピンク色に染める花は何？
name_en: Peach Orchards of the Kofu Basin
desc_en: Yamanashi Prefecture ranks first in Japan for peach production, and peach orchards spread across the eastern Kofu Basin, centered on Fuefuki City. In spring the whole basin turns pink with peach blossoms, creating a landscape called a "Shangri-La of peaches." The combination of blossoms with the lingering snow of the Southern Alps or Mount Fuji behind them is a quintessential Yamanashi spring scene.
quiz_en: Which fruit, of which Yamanashi is Japan's top producer, has blossoms that turn the Kofu Basin pink each spring?

name: ももの里温泉
desc: 笛吹市一宮町の桃畑に囲まれた温泉です。甲府盆地を見渡せる高台にあり、春には周囲一面が桃の花に彩られ、夏には実った桃が甘い香りを漂わせます。夜には盆地に広がる町の灯りを眺めることができ、果物王国・山梨らしいのどかな景色の中で湯浴みを楽しめます。
quiz: ももの里温泉から眺める甲府盆地、あなたが好きなのは春の花と夜景のどちら？
desc_en: This hot spring in Ichinomiya, Fuefuki City, is surrounded by peach orchards. Set on high ground overlooking the Kofu Basin, it is framed by peach blossoms in spring, while in summer the ripe fruit fills the air with a sweet scent. At night you can gaze at the town lights spreading across the basin, enjoying a bath amid the peaceful scenery of Yamanashi, the kingdom of fruit.
quiz_en: When gazing over the Kofu Basin from Momo no Sato Onsen, which do you prefer: the spring blossoms or the night view?

name: 石和温泉夜桜祭り
desc: 山梨を代表する温泉地・石和温泉で開かれる春の夜桜の祭りです。石和温泉は昭和の中ごろにぶどう畑から湯が湧き出して開けた温泉地で、笛吹川沿いに旅館やホテルが並びます。ライトアップされた桜並木の下を浴衣で散策するひとときは、春の温泉街ならではの楽しみです。
quiz: 石和温泉の夜桜を眺めながら食べたい、山梨のご当地グルメは何ですか？
name_en: Isawa Onsen Night Cherry Blossom Festival
desc_en: This spring festival of evening cherry blossoms is held at Isawa Onsen, one of Yamanashi's leading hot spring resorts. Isawa Onsen developed after hot water gushed from a vineyard in the mid-Showa era, and inns and hotels now line the Fuefuki River. Strolling in a yukata (light cotton kimono) beneath the illuminated rows of cherry trees is a pleasure unique to a spa town in spring.
quiz_en: Which local Yamanashi specialty would you like to eat while admiring the illuminated night cherry blossoms of Isawa Onsen?

name: 牛倉神社例大祭
desc: 上野原市の牛倉神社で行われる例大祭です。上野原は山梨県の東端、東京都や神奈川県と境を接する町で、かつては甲州街道の宿場として栄えました。桂川がつくる河岸段丘の上に開けた町に祭り囃子が響き、地域の人々が受け継いできた伝統の祭礼を見ることができます。
quiz: 牛倉神社の例大祭で、あなたが一番心に残った祭りの場面は何ですか？
desc_en: This is the annual grand festival of Ushikura Shrine in Uenohara City.
