quiz_en: When you watched the fireflies along the Daianji River, in what kind of rhythm were their lights blinking?

name: 鳩吹山
desc: 可児市の木曽川沿いにそびえる低山で、手軽に登れるハイキングの山として親しまれています。山頂付近からは木曽川の流れや濃尾平野を見渡すことができ、晴れた日には遠く名古屋方面まで望めます。春にはカタクリの花が咲く山としても知られ、多くのハイカーが訪れます。
quiz: 鳩吹山で春先に咲く、うつむいた紫色の花が特徴の山野草は何でしょう？
desc_en: This low mountain rises along the Kiso River in Kani City and is popular as an easy hiking mountain. Near the summit you can look out over the Kiso River and the Nobi Plain, and on clear days see as far as the Nagoya area. It is also known as a mountain where dogtooth violet (katakuri) flowers bloom in spring, drawing many hikers.
quiz_en: What is the wildflower with drooping purple blossoms that blooms on Mount Hatofuki in early spring?

name: 釜ヶ滝
desc: 郡上市美並町の山あいに落ちる滝です。郡上市は長良川の上流域に広がる自然豊かな土地で、清らかな川と深い森に恵まれています。森の中に響く水音と、岩を伝って流れ落ちる滝の姿は涼やかで、夏の暑さを忘れさせてくれます。美並の山里の静かな自然を感じられる場所です。
quiz: 郡上市美並町の釜ヶ滝で、滝の水しぶきを浴びたときに感じたことは何ですか？
desc_en: This waterfall drops in the mountains of Minami, Gujo City. Gujo spreads over the upper Nagara River basin, a land rich in nature and blessed with clear rivers and deep forests. The sound of water echoing through the forest and the sight of the falls cascading over the rocks are refreshing, making you forget the summer heat. It is a place to feel the quiet nature of the Minami mountain villages.
quiz_en: When the spray of Kamagataki Falls in Minami, Gujo City, touched your face, what did you feel?

name: 阿弥陀ケ滝
desc: 郡上市白鳥町の山中にある滝で、日本の滝百選に選ばれています。切り立った岩壁から一筋の流れが真っすぐに落ちる姿は神々しく、古くから白山信仰の修行の場としても大切にされてきました。夏は涼を求める人々でにぎわい、秋は紅葉に彩られます。冬には凍った姿を見せることもあります。
quiz: 阿弥陀ケ滝が選ばれている、全国の名瀑を集めたリストを何と呼ぶでしょう？
desc_en: This waterfall in the mountains of Shirotori, Gujo City, is listed among Japan's 100 best waterfalls. The sight of a single stream plunging straight down a sheer rock wall is divine, and it has long been treasured as a training site for Hakusan worship. In summer it bustles with people seeking cool air, and in autumn it is adorned with colored leaves. In winter it may even appear frozen.
quiz_en: What is the name of the nationwide list of famous waterfalls in which Amidagataki Falls has been selected?

name: 湯の平温泉
desc: 郡上市高鷲町の山あいにある温泉です。高鷲はひるがの高原を擁する高原の町で、冬は多くのスキー場が集まるウインタースポーツの地としてにぎわいます。スキーやスノーボードで冷えた体を温める湯として、また夏の高原ドライブの立ち寄り湯として親しまれています。
quiz: 高鷲のスキー場で滑ったあと湯の平温泉で温まるなら、あなたはどちらを先に楽しむ？
desc_en: This hot spring is in the mountains of Takasu, Gujo City. Takasu is a highland town that includes the Hirugano Plateau, bustling in winter as a winter sports area with many ski resorts. It is loved as a bath to warm bodies chilled by skiing and snowboarding, and as a stop on summer drives through the highlands.
quiz_en: Skiing at Takasu and warming up at Yunohira Onsen: which of the two would you enjoy first on your trip?

name: 郡上温泉
desc: 郡上市八幡町の山あいにある温泉です。郡上八幡は長良川の支流が流れる水の城下町で、町なかを流れる水路や湧水が暮らしを潤しています。夏には三十夜あまりにわたって踊り続ける郡上おどりが開かれ、町中が熱気に包まれます。湯で温まったら、城下町の散策を楽しんでください。
quiz: 郡上八幡で夏に開かれ、徹夜で踊る日もあることで知られる盆踊りは何でしょう？
desc_en: This hot spring is in the mountains of Hachiman, Gujo City. Gujo Hachiman is a castle town of water, with tributaries of the Nagara River flowing through it and canals and springs running through town to enrich daily life. In summer, the Gujo Odori dance is held for more than thirty nights, and the whole town is filled with excitement. After warming up in the baths, enjoy a stroll around the castle town.
quiz_en: Which summer Bon dance held in Gujo Hachiman is famous for nights when people dance until dawn?

name: 鍾乳洞
addr: 郡上市八幡町安久田2298・八幡町美山421・八幡町入間1180
desc: 郡上市八幡町の山中には、石灰岩の大地が長い年月をかけて削られてできた鍾乳洞が点在しています。洞内では、天井から垂れ下がる鍾乳石や、地面から伸びる石筍がつくる神秘的な景色が広がり、地下を流れる滝が見られる洞窟もあります。一年を通して気温が安定し、夏は涼しく過ごせます。
quiz: 鍾乳洞の中で、天井から落ちる水滴によって地面から上へ伸びる石を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: In the mountains of Hachiman, Gujo City, limestone caves are scattered about, formed as water eroded the limestone over many years. Inside, stalactites hanging from the ceiling and stalagmites rising from the floor create mysterious scenery, and in some caves you can see waterfalls flowing underground. The temperature stays stable all year, so they are cool places to spend time in summer.
quiz_en: Inside a limestone cave, what is the formation called that grows upward from the floor as water drips from the ceiling?

name: 桂昌寺ぼたん園
desc: 郡上市美並町の桂昌寺にあるぼたん園です。春になると境内に植えられたぼたんが大輪の花を咲かせ、色とりどりの花が寺を華やかに彩ります。「百花の王」とも呼ばれるぼたんの気品ある姿を、長良川沿いの山里の静かな寺の風情とともに楽しめる、季節限定の見どころです。
quiz: 華やかな大輪の花を咲かせることから、ぼたんは「百花の何」と呼ばれている？
desc_en: This peony garden is at Keisho-ji Temple in Minami, Gujo City. In spring the peonies planted on the grounds bloom with large flowers, and colorful blossoms brighten the temple. You can enjoy the elegant form of the peony, also called the "king of a hundred flowers," together with the quiet charm of a temple in a mountain village along the Nagara River, a seasonal highlight.
quiz_en: Because of its gorgeous large blossoms, the peony is called the "what of a hundred flowers" in Japan?

name: めいほう高原音楽祭
desc: 郡上市明宝の高原で開かれる音楽祭です。明宝は奥美濃の山々に囲まれた地域で、夏も涼しい高原の気候と豊かな自然に恵まれています。開放的な野外の会場で山並みを眺めながら音楽を楽しむひとときは格別です。高原の風に乗って響く音色が、夏の山の夜を盛り上げます。
quiz: めいほう高原音楽祭のような野外の音楽祭で、あなたが聴きたい音楽のジャンルは？
desc_en: This music festival is held on a plateau in Meiho, Gujo City. Meiho is an area surrounded by the mountains of Oku-Mino, blessed with a highland climate that stays cool even in summer and rich nature. Enjoying music at an open-air venue while gazing at the mountains is a special experience. The sounds carried on the highland breeze liven up summer nights in the mountains.
quiz_en: At an open-air music festival like the Meiho Kogen Music Festival, which genre of music would you most like to hear?

name: 御嶽山
desc: 長野と岐阜の県境にそびえる霊峰で、岐阜県下呂市側からは濁河温泉を起点に登るルートがあります。古くから山岳信仰の山として登拝されてきた一方、二〇一四年の噴火で大きな被害を受けた火山でもあり、登山前には火山情報の確認が欠かせません。下呂市の各地からその雄大な姿を望めます。
quiz: 御嶽山の岐阜県側の登山口にある、標高の高い場所に湧く温泉の名前は何でしょう？
desc_en: This sacred peak rises on the border of Nagano and Gifu, and on the Gero City side of Gifu there is a route that starts from Nigorigo Onsen. While it has long been climbed as a mountain of worship, it is also a volcano that suffered great damage in the 2014 eruption, so checking volcanic information before climbing is essential. Its majestic form can be seen from many places in Gero City.
quiz_en: What is the name of the high-altitude hot spring at the trailhead on the Gifu side of Mount Ontake?

name: 東仙峡金山湖
desc: 下呂市金山町の山あいにある渓谷と湖です。金山町は飛騨川と馬瀬川が合流する地域で、山々に囲まれた水辺の景色が広がります。湖面に周囲の森が映る穏やかな風景は心を落ち着かせ、秋には紅葉が湖を彩ります。静かな水辺で、飛騨の山あいの自然をゆっくり楽しんでください。
quiz: 東仙峡金山湖のほとりで、あなたが一番楽しみたい過ごし方は何ですか？
desc_en: This valley and lake lie in the mountains of Kanayama, Gero City. Kanayama is where the Hida and Maze rivers meet, and waterside scenery surrounded by mountains spreads out here. The peaceful sight of the surrounding forest reflected on the lake calms the mind, and in autumn colored leaves adorn the lake. Take your time enjoying the nature of the Hida mountains by the quiet water.
quiz_en: On the shores of Tosenkyo Gorge and Lake Kanayama, how would you most like to spend your time?

name: 横谷峡 四つの滝
desc: 下呂市金山町の横谷峡には、渓谷沿いの遊歩道に四つの滝が連なっています。歩みを進めるごとに姿の異なる滝が現れ、清らかな水が岩を流れ落ちる様子を間近に楽しめます。新緑の頃や紅葉の季節には、緑や朱に染まる木々と白い流れのコントラストが美しく、気軽な渓谷散策にぴったりです。
quiz: 横谷峡の四つの滝を巡って、あなたが一番気に入った滝はどれでしたか？
desc_en: In Yokotani Gorge in Kanayama, Gero City, four waterfalls line the walking trail along the valley. With every few steps a waterfall of a different shape appears, and you can enjoy clear water cascading over the rocks up close. In the fresh green and autumn foliage seasons, the contrast between trees colored green or vermilion and the white streams is beautiful, perfect for an easy gorge walk.
quiz_en: After touring the four waterfalls of Yokotani Gorge, which one did you like the best, and why?

name: 下呂温泉
desc: 飛騨川沿いに旅館が建ち並ぶ岐阜県を代表する温泉地で、江戸時代の儒学者・林羅山が有馬、草津とともに天下の三名泉に数えたことで知られます。なめらかな肌ざわりの湯は「美人の湯」とも呼ばれます。温泉街には足湯が点在し、浴衣姿で湯めぐりや散策を楽しむ人々でにぎわいます。
quiz: 林羅山が下呂とともに「天下の三名泉」に挙げた二つの温泉はどこでしょう？
desc_en: Lined with inns along the Hida River, this is Gifu Prefecture's leading hot spring resort, known for being counted among the three finest springs in the land, together with Arima and Kusatsu, by the Edo-period Confucian scholar Hayashi Razan. Its silky-smooth water is also called a "bath of beauty." Footbaths dot the spa town, which bustles with people in yukata enjoying bath-hopping and strolling.
quiz_en: Which two hot springs did Hayashi Razan name alongside Gero as the "three finest springs in the land"?

name: 巌立峡 がんだて公園
desc: 下呂市小坂町にある渓谷で、御嶽山の噴火で流れ出た溶岩が冷え固まってできた巨大な岩壁「巌立」が見どころです。高さ数十メートルに及ぶ岩壁には柱状節理と呼ばれる柱のような模様がくっきりと刻まれ、圧倒的な迫力があります。周辺には多くの滝があり、滝めぐりも楽しめます。
quiz: 巌立の岩壁に見られる、溶岩が冷え固まるときにできる柱状の割れ目を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: This gorge in Osaka, Gero City, is famous for Gandate, a huge rock wall formed when lava from an eruption of Mount Ontake cooled and hardened. The wall, several tens of meters high, is clearly etched with pillar-like patterns called columnar joints, and its presence is overwhelming. Many waterfalls are found in the surrounding area, so you can also enjoy a waterfall tour.
quiz_en: What are the column-shaped cracks seen on the Gandate rock wall, formed as lava cools and hardens, called?

name: 禅昌寺
desc: 下呂市萩原町にある臨済宗の古刹です。萩原町は飛騨川沿いに開けた町で、かつては飛騨と美濃を結ぶ街道沿いの要地でした。山を背にした静かな境内には歴史を感じさせる伽藍が建ち、庭園や季節の木々が落ち着いた雰囲気をつくります。下呂温泉の旅の途中に足を延ばしたいお寺です。
quiz: 禅昌寺のような禅寺の静かな境内で、あなたが心を整えるためにしたいことは？
desc_en: This is an ancient Rinzai Zen temple in Hagiwara, Gero City. Hagiwara developed along the Hida River and was once an important point on the road linking Hida and Mino. In the quiet grounds backed by mountains stand halls with a sense of history, while the garden and seasonal trees create a calm atmosphere. It is a temple worth a detour during a trip to Gero Onsen.
quiz_en: In the quiet grounds of a Zen temple like Zensho-ji, what would you like to do to calm and settle your mind?

name: 木曽川の輪中集落
desc: 木曽川、長良川、揖斐川の木曽三川が集まる海津市一帯には、洪水から集落や田畑を守るために周囲を堤防で囲んだ「輪中」が形づくられました。家々の敷地には石垣を高く積んだ避難用の建物「水屋」が見られ、水と闘い共に生きてきた人々の知恵を今に伝えています。
quiz: 輪中の家で、洪水に備えて石垣の上に高く建てられた避難用の建物を何と呼ぶ？
name_en: Wajyu Ring-Levee Villages of the Kiso River
desc_en: Around Kaizu City, where the three Kiso rivers, the Kiso, Nagara, and Ibi, come together, "wajyu" were formed: settlements and farmland enclosed by levees to protect them from floods. On home sites you can see "mizuya," evacuation buildings raised high on stone walls, which pass on the wisdom of people who fought against and lived with water.
quiz_en: In wajyu ring-levee villages, what are the evacuation buildings raised high on stone walls in preparation for floods called?

name: 海津温泉
desc: 海津市海津町にある温泉です。海津市は岐阜県の最南端、木曽三川に囲まれた低地に広がる町で、輪中の歴史を伝える土地です。近くには木曽三川公園があり、展望タワーから三つの大河が並んで流れる景色を眺められます。のどかな田園地帯の湯で、水郷の旅の疲れを癒やしてください。
quiz: 海津温泉のある海津市を囲んで流れる「木曽三川」、三つの川の名前を言えますか？
desc_en: This hot spring is in Kaizu, Kaizu City. Kaizu, at the southern tip of Gifu Prefecture, spreads over lowlands surrounded by the three Kiso rivers and preserves the history of the ring-levee villages. Nearby is Kiso Sansen Park, where an observation tower offers views of three great rivers flowing side by side. In a bath set in peaceful farmland, soothe the fatigue of your journey through this land of water.
quiz_en: Can you name the three rivers, known as the "Kiso Sansen," that flow around Kaizu City, home of Kaizu Onsen?

name: 南宮大社
desc: 垂井町に鎮座する美濃国一宮で、金属・鉱山の神である金山彦命を祀り、古くから金属業に携わる人々の信仰を集めてきました。関ヶ原の戦いの際に焼失したのち、江戸時代に徳川家光によって再建された朱塗りの社殿は、国の重要文化財に指定されています。南宮山を背に建つ姿は壮麗です。
quiz: 南宮大社に祀られている、金属や鉱山を司る神様の名前は何でしょう？
desc_en: Standing in Tarui Town, this is the foremost shrine of Mino Province, dedicated to Kanayamahiko no Mikoto, the god of metals and mining, and it has long drawn the faith of people in the metal trades. After burning down during the Battle of Sekigahara, its vermilion-lacquered buildings were rebuilt by Tokugawa Iemitsu in the Edo period and are designated Important Cultural Properties. Set against Mount Nangu, it looks magnificent.
quiz_en: What is the name of the deity of metals and mining who is enshrined at Nangu Taisha Shrine?

name: 藤橋城
desc: 揖斐川町藤橋の山あいに建つ城で、天守の形をした建物の中には天文台やプラネタリウムを備えた施設があります。揖斐川上流の徳山ダム方面へ向かう途中にあり、周囲は奥揖斐の深い山々に囲まれています。空気が澄んだ山里は星空観察にも適しており、昼も夜も楽しめる場所です。
quiz: 藤橋城のある奥揖斐の山里で、星空を見上げたらあなたが探したい星は何ですか？
desc_en: This castle stands in the mountains of Fujihashi, Ibigawa Town, and inside its keep-shaped building is a facility with an observatory and planetarium. It lies on the way toward Tokuyama Dam on the upper Ibi River, surrounded by the deep mountains of Oku-Ibi. The mountain village, with its clear air, is well suited to stargazing, so it can be enjoyed both day and night.
quiz_en: Looking up at the starry sky in the Oku-Ibi mountain village around Fujihashi Castle, which star would you look for?

name: 横蔵寺もみじまつり
desc: 揖斐川町谷汲の横蔵寺で、紅葉の季節に開かれるもみじまつりです。横蔵寺は多くの文化財を伝えることから「美濃の正倉院」とも呼ばれる天台宗の古刹で、秋には境内が真っ赤なもみじに包まれます。山あいの寺を彩る紅葉と、歴史ある伽藍が織りなす景色は、西美濃屈指の秋の風景です。
quiz: 多くの文化財を伝えることから、横蔵寺は「美濃の何」と呼ばれているでしょう？
desc_en: This maple festival is held during the autumn foliage season at Yokokura-ji in Tanigumi, Ibigawa Town. Yokokura-ji is an ancient Tendai temple also called the "Shosoin of Mino" because it preserves many cultural properties, and in autumn its grounds are wrapped in bright red maples. The scenery woven by the foliage coloring this mountain temple and its historic halls is among the finest autumn sights in western Mino.
quiz_en: Because it preserves many cultural treasures, Yokokura-ji is called the "what of Mino" after a famous Nara treasure house?

name: おおの温泉
desc: 揖斐郡大野町にある温泉です。大野町は濃尾平野の北西部、揖斐川の流域に広がる町で、富有柿の産地として知られています。秋には柿畑が実りの色に染まり、田園と里山ののどかな景色が広がります。平野の湯でくつろぎながら、西美濃の穏やかな里の暮らしにふれてください。
quiz: 大野町など岐阜県が産地として知られる、甘柿の代表品種の名前は何でしょう？
desc_en: This hot spring is in Ono Town, Ibi District. Ono spreads over the Ibi River basin in the northwestern Nobi Plain and is known for producing Fuyu persimmons. In autumn the persimmon orchards take on the colors of the harvest, and peaceful scenery of farmland and wooded hills spreads out. Relax in the baths of the plain and experience the calm village life of western Mino.
quiz_en: What is the name of the leading variety of sweet persimmon for which Ono Town and Gifu Prefecture are known?

name: 円鏡寺
desc: 本巣郡北方町にある古刹で、地域の人々の信仰を集めてきたお寺です。北方町は濃尾平野の中ほど、岐阜市の北西に接する小さな町で、古くからの寺社や町並みが残っています。平野の町に静かにたたずむ境内では、歴史ある堂宇や季節の木々に囲まれ、穏やかなひとときを過ごせます。
quiz: 北方町の円鏡寺を訪ねたら、境内で見つけたい季節の花や木は何ですか？
desc_en: This ancient temple in Kitagata Town, Motosu District, has long been a focus of local faith. Kitagata is a small town in the middle of the Nobi Plain, bordering Gifu City to the northwest, where old temples, shrines, and streetscapes remain. In the grounds standing quietly in this town on the plain, you can spend a peaceful moment surrounded by historic halls and seasonal trees.
quiz_en: When you visit Enkyo-ji in Kitagata Town, which seasonal flowers or trees would you like to find on its grounds?

name: 蘇水峡川まつり
desc: 八百津町の木曽川沿い、蘇水峡で開かれる川の祭りです。蘇水峡は木曽川がつくる渓谷の景勝地で、両岸に岩が連なる景色が楽しめます。八百津町は「命のビザ」で多くの人を救った外交官・杉原千畝の出身地としても知られます。夏の川辺に人々が集い、水辺の祭りのにぎわいを楽しめます。
quiz: 八百津町出身で、第二次世界大戦中に「命のビザ」を発給した外交官は誰でしょう？
desc_en: This river festival is held at Sosuikyo Gorge along the Kiso River in Yaotsu Town. Sosuikyo is a scenic gorge formed by the Kiso River, with rocks lining both banks. Yaotsu is also known as the hometown of Sugihara Chiune, the diplomat who saved many people with his "visas for life." People gather by the river in summer, and you can enjoy the bustle of a waterside festival.
quiz_en: Who is the diplomat born in Yaotsu Town who issued "visas for life" during World War II?

name: よってりゃあみたけ夢いろ街道宿場まつり
addr: 御嵩町（名鉄御嵩駅前周辺）
desc: 御嵩町の名鉄御嵩駅前周辺で開かれる宿場まつりです。御嵩町はかつて中山道の御嶽宿として栄えた町で、今も宿場の面影を伝える建物が残っています。街道沿いに人々が集い、宿場町の歴史を感じさせる催しでにぎわいます。中山道を旅した人々の往来に思いを馳せながら楽しんでください。
quiz: 御嵩町にかつてあった、江戸と京都を結ぶ街道の宿場は何という街道の宿場？
name_en: Yotterya Mitake Yumeiro Kaido Post Town Festival
desc_en: This post-town festival is held around Meitetsu Mitake Station in Mitake Town. Mitake once prospered as Mitake-juku, a post town on the Nakasendo road, and buildings that preserve the feel of the post town still remain. People gather along the old road, which bustles with events evoking the town's history. Enjoy it while imagining the comings and goings of travelers on the Nakasendo.
quiz_en: Mitake Town was once a post town on which highway that connected Edo and Kyoto?

name: 白山
desc: 石川・岐阜の県境にそびえる霊峰で、富士山、立山とともに日本三名山の一つに数えられます。古くから白山信仰の山として崇められ、夏には高山植物が咲き誇ります。岐阜県白川村側は世界遺産の白川郷の里に近く、合掌造りの集落から白山に連なる山並みを感じられます。
quiz: 白山とともに「日本三名山」に数えられる、富士山以外のもう一つの山は何？
desc_en: This sacred peak rises on the border of Ishikawa and Gifu and is counted among Japan's three famous mountains, along with Mount Fuji and Tateyama. It has long been revered as the mountain of Hakusan worship, and alpine flowers bloom in profusion in summer. The Shirakawa Village side in Gifu is close to the World Heritage village of Shirakawa-go, where you can sense the mountains leading to Hakusan from the gassho-style farmhouses.
quiz_en: Besides Mount Fuji, which other mountain is counted with Mount Hakusan among Japan's "three famous mountains"?

name: 平瀬温泉
desc: 白川村平瀬、庄川沿いにある温泉地で、白山への登山口の一つ大白川方面への入口に位置します。世界遺産・白川郷の合掌造り集落からも近く、合掌集落の観光とあわせて訪れやすい湯の里です。冬は深い雪に包まれ、山あいの静かな温泉で雪見をしながらゆっくりと温まれます。
quiz: 平瀬温泉から近い世界遺産・白川郷の家の屋根は、何という造りでしょう？
desc_en: This hot spring area lies along the Sho River in Hirase, Shirakawa Village, at the entrance toward Oshirakawa, one of the trailheads for Mount Hakusan. It is close to the gassho-style villages of World Heritage Shirakawa-go, making it an easy spa village to visit along with sightseeing there. In winter it is wrapped in deep snow, and you can warm up slowly while viewing the snow at a quiet mountain hot spring.
quiz_en: What is the distinctive style of the thatched roofs on the houses of World Heritage Shirakawa-go, near Hirase Onsen, called?

name: 赤石岳
desc: 南アルプス南部にそびえる標高三千メートルを超える名峰で、静岡県側では大井川の源流部に位置します。静岡市葵区の山奥、椹島を起点に深い原生林の中を長い道のりで登ります。山頂付近からは富士山や南アルプスの峰々を一望でき、奥深さゆえの雄大な自然が登山者を待っています。
quiz: 赤石岳の静岡県側の登山の起点となる、大井川上流の地名は何でしょう？
desc_en: This renowned peak of over 3,000 meters rises in the southern Southern Alps and, on the Shizuoka side, sits at the headwaters of the Oi River. Deep in the mountains of Aoi Ward, Shizuoka City, climbers start from Sawarajima and make a long ascent through deep virgin forest. Near the summit you can see Mount Fuji and the peaks of the Southern Alps, and grand, remote nature awaits climbers.
quiz_en: What is the name of the place on the upper Oi River that serves as the starting point for climbing Mount Akaishi from Shizuoka?

name: 大井川鐵道のＳＬ列車
desc: 大井川沿いを走る大井川鐵道では、蒸気機関車が客車を引く「SL列車」がほぼ毎日のように運行され、多くの鉄道ファンや観光客を魅了しています。汽笛を響かせ煙を上げて走る姿は迫力満点で、車窓には大井川の流れと茶畑が広がります。昔懐かしい客車の旅を楽しめます。
quiz: 大井川鐵道のSL列車の車窓に広がる、静岡県を代表する農産物の畑は何？
desc_en: On the Oigawa Railway, which runs along the Oi River, "SL trains" with steam locomotives pulling passenger cars operate nearly every day, captivating many rail fans and tourists. The sight of the train running with its whistle sounding and smoke rising is thrilling, and outside the windows the Oi River and tea fields spread out. You can enjoy a nostalgic journey in vintage passenger cars.
quiz_en: Fields of which crop, a signature product of Shizuoka Prefecture, spread outside the windows of the Oigawa Railway steam trains?

name: 紅葉山庭園
desc: 徳川家康ゆかりの駿府城公園の中にある日本庭園です。静岡の自然を表現した庭で、池を中心に、海や里、山の景色が巧みに表されています。茶室ではお茶をいただきながら、四季折々の庭の眺めを楽しめます。静岡市の中心部にありながら、静けさに包まれた空間で心穏やかに過ごせます。
quiz: 紅葉山庭園がある駿府城公園は、晩年をここで過ごした誰ゆかりの城跡でしょう？
desc_en: This Japanese garden is inside Sunpu Castle Park, a place associated with Tokugawa Ieyasu. The garden expresses Shizuoka's nature, skillfully depicting scenes of sea, countryside, and mountains around a central pond. In the teahouse you can enjoy tea while viewing the garden in each season. Although in central Shizuoka City, it is a space wrapped in stillness where you can spend time peacefully.
quiz_en: Sunpu Castle Park, where Momijiyama Garden is located, is the castle site associated with which figure who spent his final years here?

name: 広野海岸公園
desc: 静岡市駿河区の海辺に整備された公園で、駿河湾に面した開放的な景色が広がります。晴れた日には海の向こうに富士山や伊豆半島を望むことができ、潮風を感じながらの散歩や広場での遊びが楽しめます。夕暮れどきに海が茜色に染まる時間もおすすめです。
quiz: 広野海岸公園から駿河湾越しに眺めたい、晴れた日ならではの景色は何ですか？
desc_en: This park on the seashore of Suruga Ward, Shizuoka City, offers open views across Suruga Bay. On clear days you can see Mount Fuji and the Izu Peninsula across the sea, and you can enjoy walks in the sea breeze and play in the open spaces. The time at dusk, when the sea is tinted a deep red, is also recommended.
quiz_en: Looking across Suruga Bay from Hirono Coastal Park on a clear day, what view would you most like to see?

name: 鉄舟寺
desc: 静岡市清水区村松にある寺院で、古代から続いた久能寺の流れを受け、明治時代に山岡鉄舟が再興したことから鉄舟寺と呼ばれるようになりました。清水の町と駿河湾を望む高台にあり、境内は緑に包まれた落ち着いた雰囲気です。幕末明治の剣客・鉄舟の足跡を偲べる寺です。
quiz: 鉄舟寺の名の由来となった、幕末から明治にかけて活躍した剣・禅・書の達人は誰？
desc_en: This temple in Muramatsu, Shimizu Ward, Shizuoka City, carries on the lineage of Kuno-ji, a temple dating back to ancient times, and came to be called Tesshu-ji after Yamaoka Tesshu revived it in the Meiji era. Set on high ground overlooking the town of Shimizu and Suruga Bay, its grounds have a calm atmosphere wrapped in greenery. It is a temple where you can trace the footsteps of Tesshu, a swordsman of the late Edo and Meiji eras.
quiz_en: Who was the master of swordsmanship, Zen, and calligraphy, active from the late Edo to the Meiji era, who gave Tesshu-ji its name?

name: 浜松のうなぎ料理
desc: 浜松は浜名湖周辺で明治時代にうなぎの養殖が始まった地として知られ、うなぎの町として名高い場所です。市内には多くのうなぎ料理店があり、香ばしく焼き上げたかば焼きをご飯にのせたうな重やうな丼が味わえます。夏の土用の丑の日には、多くの人がうなぎを求めて店を訪れます。
quiz: 夏に「うなぎを食べる日」として知られる、季節の変わり目の日を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: Hamamatsu is known as the place where eel farming began around Lake Hamana in the Meiji era, and it is famous as a town of eel. The city has many eel restaurants where you can enjoy unaju and unadon, savory grilled kabayaki eel served over rice. On the Day of the Ox in midsummer, many people visit restaurants in search of eel.
quiz_en: What is the day at the turn of the season, known in Japan as "the day to eat eel" in summer, called?

name: 祝田厄除観音大祭
desc: 浜松市北区細江町中川にある祝田の観音様で行われる、厄除けの大祭です。細江町は浜名湖の北東、引佐細江と呼ばれる入り江に面した地域で、穏やかな湖と里山の風景が広がっています。厄除けを願う多くの参拝者が訪れ、地域に根づいた祈りの行事として大切に受け継がれています。
quiz: 祝田厄除観音大祭のような厄除けの行事、あなたの地元ではどんな風習がありますか？
desc_en: This grand festival for warding off misfortune is held at the Kannon of Hoda in Nakagawa, Hosoe, Kita Ward, Hamamatsu City. Hosoe lies northeast of Lake Hamana, facing an inlet called Inasa-Hosoe, with peaceful scenery of lake and wooded hills. Many worshippers come to pray for protection from misfortune, and it is cherished as a ritual of prayer rooted in the community.
quiz_en: Events for warding off bad luck, like the Hoda Yakuyoke Kannon Grand Festival, take many forms; what customs do you have in your hometown?

name: 龍潭寺
addr: 浜松市北区引佐町井伊谷1989
desc: 浜松市北区引佐町井伊谷にある臨済宗の寺院で、井伊家の菩提寺として知られています。戦国時代に井伊家を守った「おんな城主」井伊直虎ゆかりの寺としても注目を集めました。本堂裏の池泉鑑賞式庭園は小堀遠州の作と伝えられ、国の名勝に指定されています。
quiz: 龍潭寺を菩提寺とし、江戸時代に彦根藩主となった一族は何家でしょう？
desc_en: This Rinzai Zen temple in Iinoya, Inasa, Kita Ward, Hamamatsu City, is known as the family temple of the Ii clan. It has also drawn attention for its ties to Ii Naotora, the "female castle lord" who protected the Ii family in the Warring States period. The pond garden behind the main hall, made for viewing, is said to be the work of Kobori Enshu and is designated a National Place of Scenic Beauty.
quiz_en: Which family, whose family temple is Ryotan-ji, became the lords of the Hikone domain in the Edo period?

name: 奥山高原
addr: 浜松市北区引佐町奥山1736-1
desc: 浜松市北区引佐町奥山の高台に広がる高原で、春にはツツジや芝桜などの花が丘を彩ります。高台からは浜名湖方面を見渡す眺めが広がり、のどかな花の丘の散策が楽しめます。近くには方広寺があり、奥山の里の寺社めぐりとあわせて春の行楽に訪れたい場所です。
quiz: 奥山高原の花の丘を歩くなら、あなたが一番見たい春の花は何ですか？
desc_en: This plateau spreads over high ground in Okuyama, Inasa, Kita Ward, Hamamatsu City, and in spring flowers such as azaleas and moss phlox color the hills. From the heights you can look out toward Lake Hamana and enjoy strolling the peaceful flower hills. Hoko-ji Temple is nearby, making it a place to visit on a spring outing together with a tour of Okuyama's temples and shrines.
quiz_en: If you were to walk the flower-covered hills of the Okuyama Highlands, which spring flower would you most want to see?

name: カナメ神宮
addr: 浜松市北区引佐町奥山1737-341
desc: 浜松市北区引佐町奥山の山あいに鎮座する神社です。奥山は臨済宗方広寺派の大本山・方広寺がある地として知られ、深い山の緑に包まれた信仰の里です。静かな山中の社に参拝すれば、清らかな空気に心が洗われます。奥山の寺社めぐりの一つとして足を延ばしてみてください。
quiz: カナメ神宮のある奥山の里で、寺社めぐりとあわせて楽しみたいことは何ですか？
desc_en: This shrine stands in the mountains of Okuyama, Inasa, Kita Ward, Hamamatsu City. Okuyama is known as the home of Hoko-ji, the head temple of the Hokoji branch of Rinzai Zen, and is a village of faith wrapped in deep mountain greenery. Visiting this shrine in the quiet mountains, your mind will be cleansed by the pure air. Make the trip as part of a tour of Okuyama's temples and shrines.
quiz_en: In the village of Okuyama, home of Kaname Jingu, what would you like to enjoy along with visiting its temples and shrines?

name: 光月神社大祭
addr: 浜松市北区細江町小野764
desc: 浜松市北区細江町小野にある光月神社で行われる大祭です。細江町は浜名湖の北東部に位置し、湖に面した穏やかな里で、古くからの祭りが地域の人々によって受け継がれています。祭りの日には氏子たちが集い、境内に活気があふれます。湖北の里の祭りの温かな雰囲気を楽しんでください。
quiz: 浜名湖の北に位置する細江の光月神社大祭、あなたが心に残った場面は何ですか？
desc_en: This grand festival takes place at Kogetsu Shrine in Ono, Hosoe, Kita Ward, Hamamatsu City. Hosoe lies in the northeastern part of Lake Hamana, a peaceful village facing the lake where long-standing festivals have been handed down by local people. On festival day, parishioners gather and the grounds overflow with energy. Enjoy the warm atmosphere of a festival in this village north of the lake.
quiz_en: At the Kogetsu Shrine Grand Festival in Hosoe, north of Lake Hamana, which scene stayed with you the most?

name: 大福寺
addr: 浜松市北区三ヶ日町福長220-3
desc: 浜松市北区三ヶ日町にある古刹で、寺に伝わる「浜納豆」で知られています。大豆を発酵させて塩味を効かせた黒い粒状の納豆は、糸を引く納豆とは異なる独特の味わいです。三ヶ日は浜名湖の北に位置するみかんの産地で、温暖な丘陵に囲まれた静かな境内に心が和みます。
quiz: 大福寺に伝わる、糸を引かない黒い粒状の納豆は何と呼ばれているでしょう？
desc_en: This ancient temple in Mikkabi, Kita Ward, Hamamatsu City, is known for "Hama natto," handed down at the temple. Made by fermenting soybeans and seasoned with salt, these black, grain-like natto have a unique flavor quite different from the stringy kind. Mikkabi, north of Lake Hamana, is a mandarin orange-growing area, and the quiet grounds, surrounded by mild hills, are soothing.
quiz_en: What is the name of the black, grain-like natto that does not form sticky strings, handed down at Daifuku-ji Temple?

name: 白倉峡
addr: 浜松市天竜区龍山町大嶺1279-3
desc: 浜松市天竜区龍山町の山あいに広がる峡谷です。天竜区は天竜川流域の豊かな森林に覆われた地域で、天竜美林と呼ばれる杉やヒノキの林が広がります。峡谷では清流と岩の織りなす景色を楽しめ、遊歩道を歩けば滝や淵が現れます。夏は涼しく、秋は紅葉が谷を彩ります。
quiz: 白倉峡の渓谷歩きで出会った、清流や滝の中で一番印象に残った景色は何ですか？
desc_en: This gorge spreads through the mountains of Tatsuyama, Tenryu Ward, Hamamatsu City. Tenryu Ward is an area covered with rich forests in the Tenryu River basin, where cedar and cypress woods known as the Tenryu Bijin forests spread out. In the gorge you can enjoy scenery of clear water and rock, and walking the trail reveals waterfalls and pools. It is cool in summer, and autumn leaves color the valley.
quiz_en: Among the clear streams and waterfalls you encountered while walking Shirakura Gorge, which scene impressed you the most?

name: 明神峡紅葉
desc: 浜松市天竜区豊岡の明神峡は、天竜川の支流がつくる渓谷で、秋の紅葉の名所として知られています。両岸の木々が赤や黄色に色づき、清らかな流れにその色が映り込む景色は見事です。天竜の深い山々に抱かれた谷で、澄んだ空気の中、秋の深まりを感じながら散策を楽しんでください。
quiz: 明神峡の紅葉が映る川面、あなたが撮った一枚にはどんな色が写っていましたか？
desc_en: Myojin Gorge in Toyooka, Tenryu Ward, Hamamatsu City, is a valley formed by a tributary of the Tenryu River and is known as a famous spot for autumn foliage. The scenery of trees on both banks turning red and yellow, with their colors reflected in the clear stream, is magnificent. In a valley embraced by the deep mountains of Tenryu, enjoy a stroll in the crisp air while feeling autumn deepen.
quiz_en: In the photo you took of the river reflecting Myojin Gorge's autumn leaves, what colors were captured in the shot?

name: 秋葉寺
addr: 浜松市天竜区春野町領家848
desc: 浜松市天竜区春野町、秋葉山の山上にある寺院で、火防の神として信仰される三尺坊大権現を祀っています。秋葉山は古くから火伏せの霊山として全国に信仰が広がり、各地に秋葉講や秋葉灯籠が残っています。山上からは遠州の山並みや天竜川を見渡せ、霊山の空気が満ちています。
quiz: 秋葉山の信仰が全国に広がった理由である、この山の神仏が授けるご利益は何？
desc_en: This temple stands atop Mount Akiha in Haruno, Tenryu Ward, Hamamatsu City, and enshrines Sanjakubo Daigongen, worshipped as a deity of fire prevention. Mount Akiha has long been revered as a sacred mountain for protection against fire, with faith spreading nationwide, and Akiha worship groups and Akiha lanterns remain across Japan. The summit overlooks the mountains of Enshu and the Tenryu River, filled with the air of a sacred peak.
quiz_en: What blessing granted by the deity of Mount Akiha caused faith in the mountain to spread throughout Japan?

name: 青崩峠
desc: 静岡県浜松市天竜区水窪町と長野県の境にある峠で、遠州と信州を結ぶ秋葉街道の要所でした。海辺の塩や物資を山国へ運ぶ人々が行き交った道で、峠を越える古道には歴史の面影が残ります。峠の名は崩れやすい青みがかった岩肌に由来するとされ、日本列島を貫く中央構造線が通る地としても知られます。
quiz: 青崩峠付近を通り、日本列島を西南日本の内帯と外帯に分ける大断層を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: This pass lies on the border between Misakubo in Tenryu Ward, Hamamatsu City, and Nagano Prefecture, and was a key point on the Akiha Kaido road linking Enshu and Shinshu. People traveled this road carrying salt and goods from the coast to the mountain provinces, and the old road over the pass still holds traces of history. The name is said to come from its crumbling, bluish rock faces, and it is also known as a place crossed by the Median Tectonic Line that runs through the Japanese archipelago.
quiz_en: What is the great fault line, passing near Aokuzure Pass, that divides southwestern Japan into inner and outer zones called?

name: 山住神社秋季例大祭
addr: 浜松市天竜区水窪町山住230
desc: 浜松市北部、水窪の山深くに鎮座する山住神社の秋の例大祭です。山住神社は古くから山犬（オオカミ）を神の使いとする信仰で知られ、境内には杉の巨木が立ち並びます。色づき始めた奥山の澄んだ空気の中、地域の人々が大切に受け継いできた祭礼のひとときに触れられます。
quiz: 山住神社で古くから神の使いとして信仰されてきた動物は何でしょう？
desc_en: This is the autumn grand festival of Yamazumi Shrine, which sits deep in the mountains of Misakubo in northern Hamamatsu. The shrine has long been known for a faith that regards the yamainu (mountain dog, or wolf) as a messenger of the gods, and giant cedars line its grounds. In the clear air of the deep mountains as the leaves begin to turn, you can share in a festival the local people have carefully handed down.
quiz_en: Which animal has long been revered at Yamazumi Shrine as a messenger of the gods?

name: 白倉峡もみじまつり
desc: 天竜川流域の山あい、浜松市天竜区龍山町の渓谷・白倉峡で開かれる紅葉のまつりです。切り立った岩肌と清らかな流れを、赤や黄色に染まった木々が彩ります。山里ならではの素朴なもてなしとともに、天竜の深い山々が見せる秋の表情をゆっくり味わえます。
quiz: 白倉峡のもみじまつりで紅葉を眺めながら味わいたい、山里の味覚は何？
desc_en: This autumn leaves festival is held at Shirakura Gorge, a ravine in Tatsuyama, Tenryu Ward, Hamamatsu, among the mountains of the Tenryu River basin. Trees dyed red and yellow frame the sheer rock faces and clear stream. Along with the simple hospitality of a mountain village, you can take your time savoring the autumn face of Tenryu's deep mountains.
quiz_en: Which mountain-village delicacy would you like to taste while admiring the autumn colors at the Shirakura Gorge festival?

name: 熱海城
desc: 熱海の市街地と海を見下ろす錦ヶ浦の高台に建つ、天守風の観光施設です。歴史上の城ではなく昭和期に建てられたもので、館内では城や武家文化に関する展示を楽しめます。展望台からは温泉街と相模湾が一望でき、晴れた日には初島や伊豆大島まで見渡せます。
quiz: 熱海城の展望台から眺めた景色で、いちばん心に残ったものは何？
desc_en: Standing on the heights of Nishikigaura overlooking Atami's town and the sea, this is a tourist facility built in the style of a castle keep. It is not a historical castle but was built in the Showa era, and inside you can enjoy exhibits on castles and samurai culture. The observation deck offers a sweeping view of the hot spring town and Sagami Bay, and on clear days you can see as far as Hatsushima and Izu Oshima.
quiz_en: Of all the scenery you saw from the Atami Castle observation deck, what stayed with you the most?

name: 伊豆山神社例大祭
desc: 熱海の伊豆山に鎮座し、源頼朝と北条政子ゆかりの社として知られる伊豆山神社の例大祭です。海から山上の社殿へと続く長い石段の参道があり、祭礼の日は神輿や行列で賑わいます。山の麓には海辺の洞窟から湯が湧く走り湯もあり、温泉地熱海の古い信仰の姿を感じられます。
quiz: 伊豆山神社の麓にある、洞窟から湯が湧き出す横穴式源泉の名前は何でしょう？
desc_en: This is the annual grand festival of Izusan Shrine, which stands on Izusan in Atami and is known for its ties to Minamoto no Yoritomo and Hojo Masako. A long stone stairway leads from the sea up to the shrine buildings on the hill, and on festival days it bustles with mikoshi (portable shrines) and processions. At the foot of the hill is Hashiriyu, where hot water springs from a seaside cave, offering a glimpse of the old faith of the onsen town of Atami.
quiz_en: What is the name of the horizontal-cave hot spring source at the foot of Izusan Shrine, where hot water gushes from a cave?

name: 阿治古神社例大祭
desc: 温泉と海の町・熱海で、地域に根づく阿治古神社の例大祭です。相模湾に面した熱海では、漁や温泉とともに暮らしてきた人々が氏神を大切に祀ってきました。祭りの日には神輿や囃子が町を巡り、観光地とはひと味違う、地元の人々の素顔に出会えます。
quiz: 熱海の祭りを見物したあと、ひと休みに立ち寄りたい温泉や名物は何？
desc_en: This is the annual grand festival of Ajiko Shrine, rooted in the community of Atami, a town of hot springs and the sea. Facing Sagami Bay, Atami's people have lived alongside fishing and hot springs, and have long cherished their guardian deity. On festival day, mikoshi (portable shrines) and festival music make their way through the town, letting you meet the everyday faces of the locals, a little different from the tourist spot.
quiz_en: After watching a festival in Atami, which hot spring or local specialty would you like to stop by for a break?

name: 山中城跡公園
desc: 箱根の西麓に築かれた後北条氏の山城、山中城の跡を整備した公園です。石垣を用いず土を削って築いた城で、堀の中に畝を残した独特の障子堀が見事に復元されています。豊臣秀吉の小田原攻めで落城した激戦地でもあり、芝に覆われた曲輪からは富士山を望めます。
quiz: 山中城跡で見られる、堀の底に畝を残して区切った独特の堀を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: This park preserves the ruins of Yamanaka Castle, a mountain castle built by the Later Hojo clan on the western foot of Hakone. The castle was made by carving earth rather than using stone walls, and its distinctive shoji-bori moats, with ridges left inside the moat, have been beautifully restored. It was also the site of fierce fighting, falling during Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Odawara campaign, and from its grassy enclosures you can see Mount Fuji.
quiz_en: What is the distinctive type of moat at the Yamanaka Castle ruins, divided by ridges left on the moat floor, called?

name: 三島大通り宿場まつり
desc: 東海道の宿場町として栄えた三島の大通りを舞台にした祭りです。三島は箱根越えの拠点として旅人で賑わった町で、三嶋大社の門前町でもあります。富士山の湧き水が街なかを流れる水の都らしい風情の中、宿場の歴史を感じながら祭りの賑わいを楽しめます。
quiz: 三島の宿場まつりを楽しんだあと、食べてみたい三島の名物は何？
desc_en: This festival takes place on the main street of Mishima, which prospered as a post town on the Tokaido road. Mishima was a base for crossing the Hakone pass and bustled with travelers, and it is also the temple town of Mishima Taisha Shrine. Amid the charm of this city of water, where spring water from Mount Fuji flows through the streets, you can enjoy the festival's liveliness while sensing the history of the post town.
quiz_en: After enjoying the Mishima post town festival, which Mishima specialty would you like to try?

name: 富士山
desc: 静岡県と山梨県にまたがる、標高3776メートルの日本最高峰です。美しい円錐形の成層火山で、古くから信仰の対象となり、多くの芸術作品にも描かれてきました。世界文化遺産にも登録され、夏の登山シーズンには山頂でのご来光を目指して多くの人が登ります。
quiz: 静岡県と山梨県にまたがる日本一高い山・富士山の標高は、何メートルでしょう？
desc_en: Straddling Shizuoka and Yamanashi prefectures, this is Japan's highest peak at 3,776 meters. A beautifully conical stratovolcano, it has long been an object of worship and has been depicted in many works of art. It is registered as a World Cultural Heritage site, and during the summer climbing season many people climb it, aiming to see goraiko, the sunrise from the summit.
quiz_en: How many meters high is Mount Fuji, Japan's tallest mountain, which straddles Shizuoka and Yamanashi prefectures?

name: 白糸の滝
desc: 富士宮市にある、富士山の湧き水が溶岩の崖から幾筋にも流れ落ちる名瀑です。幅広い岩壁から絹糸のような白い水が無数に垂れる姿は優美で、国の名勝・天然記念物に指定され、世界文化遺産の構成資産にもなっています。水しぶきが涼しく、夏でも清々しい空気に包まれます。
quiz: 白糸の滝のすぐ近くにある、曽我兄弟の伝説にちなむ豪快な滝の名前は？
desc_en: Located in Fujinomiya, these famous falls are formed by Mount Fuji's spring water pouring in countless strands down a lava cliff. The graceful sight of white water hanging like silk threads from the wide rock wall has earned designation as a national Place of Scenic Beauty and Natural Monument, and the falls are also a component of the World Cultural Heritage site. The spray keeps the air cool and refreshing even in summer.
quiz_en: What is the name of the powerful waterfall right near Shiraito Falls, associated with the legend of the Soga brothers?

name: 伊豆高原桜まつり
desc: 別荘地や美術館が点在する伊豆高原で、春に開かれる桜のまつりです。伊豆高原駅周辺から続く桜並木が満開になると、通り一帯が薄紅色のトンネルに包まれます。相模湾に近い温暖な土地で、花見のあとは海の幸や温泉も楽しめる、伊豆らしい春の散策が楽しめます。
quiz: 伊豆高原の桜並木を歩いたあと、立ち寄りたい伊豆の名物グルメは何？
desc_en: This spring cherry blossom festival is held in Izu Kogen, a highland area dotted with vacation homes and art museums. When the rows of cherry trees stretching from around Izu-Kogen Station reach full bloom, the whole street is wrapped in a pale pink tunnel. In this mild area near Sagami Bay, you can enjoy seafood and hot springs after the blossoms, for a classic Izu springtime stroll.
quiz_en: After walking under the Izu Kogen cherry trees, which Izu specialty dish would you like to stop for?

name: 伊豆高原桜まつり（さくらの里会場）
desc: 伊豆高原の桜まつりのうち、大室山の麓に広がる「さくらの里」を会場とするものです。さまざまな品種の桜が植えられ、早咲きから遅咲きまで長い期間花を楽しめます。芝生の丘越しにお椀を伏せたような大室山が見える、のびやかな景色が魅力です。
quiz: さくらの里の背後にそびえる、お椀を伏せたような形の山の名前は何？
name_en: Izu Kogen Cherry Blossom Festival (Sakura no Sato Venue)
desc_en: Part of the Izu Kogen cherry blossom festival, this venue is Sakura no Sato, which spreads out at the foot of Mount Omuro. Many varieties of cherry trees are planted here, so you can enjoy blossoms over a long period, from early to late bloomers. The relaxed scenery, with bowl-shaped Mount Omuro visible beyond the grassy hill, is a big part of its appeal.
quiz_en: What is the name of the mountain shaped like an upturned bowl that rises behind Sakura no Sato?

name: 蓬莱橋
desc: 島田市の大井川に架かる木造の歩道橋で、世界一長い木造歩道橋としてギネス世界記録に認定されています。明治時代に牧之原台地の開墾に通う人々のために架けられたのが始まりです。素朴な木の橋をゆっくり歩けば、広い川原と山並みが広がる大井川らしい風景を味わえます。
quiz: 蓬莱橋の長さ897.4メートルにかけた、縁起のよい語呂合わせは何？
desc_en: Spanning the Oi River in Shimada, this wooden footbridge is certified by Guinness World Records as the world's longest wooden pedestrian bridge. It was originally built in the Meiji era for people commuting to cultivate the Makinohara Plateau. Walking slowly across this simple wooden bridge, you can take in the classic Oi River scenery of wide riverbeds and mountain ranges.
quiz_en: The Horai Bridge is 897.4 meters long. What lucky Japanese wordplay is associated with this particular number?

name: 新豊院大観音祭
desc: 製紙の町として知られる富士市で、新豊院の観音さまをお祀りする大祭です。富士市は富士山の麓に広がり、晴れた日には町のどこからでも大きな富士山を仰げます。地域の人々が集う境内の賑わいの中で、富士の裾野に暮らす人々の信仰と季節の行事に触れられます。
quiz: 富士市の祭りを訪れたら、ぜひ写真に収めたい富士山のビュースポットはどこ？
desc_en: This is a grand festival honoring the Kannon (Goddess of Mercy) of Shinpoin Temple in Fuji, a city known for papermaking. Fuji spreads out at the foot of Mount Fuji, and on clear days you can look up at the great mountain from almost anywhere in town. Amid the bustle of the temple grounds where locals gather, you can experience the faith and seasonal events of people living at the base of Fuji.
quiz_en: If you visit a festival in Fuji City, which Mount Fuji viewpoint would you most like to photograph?

name: 府八幡宮
desc: かつて遠江国の国府が置かれた磐田市中泉に鎮座する八幡宮です。その名のとおり国府ゆかりの社として地域で崇敬されてきました。境内には朱塗りの楼門が構え、木々に囲まれた落ち着いた雰囲気が漂います。古代から遠江の中心だった磐田の歴史を感じられる場所です。
quiz: 府八幡宮の「府」は、かつて磐田に置かれた何という役所に由来する？
desc_en: This Hachiman shrine stands in Nakaizumi, Iwata, where the provincial capital of Totomi Province was once located. As its name suggests, it has been revered locally as a shrine connected with the provincial government. A vermilion two-story gate stands on the grounds, and a calm atmosphere surrounded by trees fills the air. It is a place to sense the history of Iwata, the heart of Totomi since ancient times.
quiz_en: The "Fu" in Fu Hachimangu comes from what kind of government office that was once located in Iwata?

name: 医王寺
desc: 磐田市鎌田に建つ寺院です。磐田は天竜川の東に広がる平野の町で、古くから遠江の中心地として栄え、市内には由緒ある寺社が数多く残ります。のどかな住宅地と田畑の間にたたずむ境内で、地域に寄り添ってきたお寺の静かな時間を感じてください。
quiz: 医王寺の名に含まれる「医王」は、どの仏さまを表す言葉でしょう？
desc_en: This temple stands in Kamata, Iwata. Iwata is a town on the plain east of the Tenryu River that has long flourished as the center of Totomi, and many historic temples and shrines remain in the city. Standing between quiet residential areas and fields, its grounds let you feel the peaceful time of a temple that has stayed close to its community.
quiz_en: The word "Io" (King of Medicine) in the temple name Io-ji refers to which Buddha in Buddhist tradition?

name: 福王寺
desc: 磐田市城之崎にある寺院です。城之崎は市街地の西寄り、天竜川に近い一帯で、川がつくった豊かな平野が広がります。地元の人々の暮らしの中で守られてきた境内は落ち着いた雰囲気で、町歩きの途中に足を止めて手を合わせたくなる、穏やかな祈りの場です。
quiz: 磐田の寺めぐりの途中で味わいたい、遠州地方の名物や郷土の味は何？
desc_en: This temple is in Jonosaki, Iwata. Jonosaki lies toward the west of the city center, near the Tenryu River, where a rich plain formed by the river spreads out. Protected within the lives of local people, the grounds have a calm atmosphere, making this a gentle place of prayer where you may want to pause and put your hands together during a stroll through town.
quiz_en: Which Enshu specialty or local dish would you like to taste during a tour of Iwata's temples?

name: 法雲寺
desc: 磐田市北部の向笠にある寺院です。向笠は台地と田園が広がる自然豊かな地域で、のどかな里山の風景が残ります。周囲の緑に抱かれた境内は四季折々の表情を見せ、静かに参拝したい人におすすめです。磐田の市街地とは違う、素朴な田園の空気を味わえます。
quiz: 向笠の田園風景の中にある法雲寺を訪れたら、どの季節の景色を見てみたい？
desc_en: This temple is in Mukasa, in northern Iwata. Mukasa is a nature-rich area of plateaus and farmland where peaceful satoyama (rural hillside) scenery remains. Embraced by the surrounding greenery, the grounds show a different face in each season, and it is recommended for those who want to worship quietly. You can enjoy the simple countryside air, quite different from central Iwata.
quiz_en: If you visited Houn-ji amid the farmland of Mukasa, which season's scenery would you like to see?

name: 掛川城
desc: 戦国時代に山内一豊が城主を務め、城を大きく整備した掛川城です。現在の天守は平成に木造で復元されたもので、白く端正な姿から東海の名城と呼ばれます。麓には全国でも数少ない現存の城郭御殿である二の丸御殿が残り、江戸時代の藩政の舞台を間近に見られます。
quiz: 掛川城の城主を務め、のちに土佐藩の初代藩主となった武将は誰でしょう？
desc_en: Kakegawa Castle was ruled during the Sengoku (Warring States) period by Yamauchi Kazutoyo, who greatly developed it. The current keep was rebuilt in wood in the Heisei era, and its neat white form has earned it the title of a famous castle of the Tokai region. At its foot stands the Ninomaru Goten, one of the few surviving castle palaces in Japan, where you can see up close the stage of Edo-period domain government.
quiz_en: Which warlord served as lord of Kakegawa Castle and later became the first lord of the Tosa Domain?

name: 粟ヶ岳
desc: 掛川市東山にそびえる、遠州のお茶どころを見守る山です。山肌には木々で描かれた大きな「茶」の文字があり、麓から見上げるとはっきり読み取れます。山頂付近からは一面の茶畑や遠州灘、天気がよければ富士山まで見渡せ、新茶の季節は特に緑が鮮やかです。
quiz: 粟ヶ岳の山肌に、木々を植えて大きく描かれている漢字一文字は何？
desc_en: Rising in Higashiyama, Kakegawa, this mountain watches over Enshu's tea-growing country. On its slope, trees form a giant kanji character meaning "tea", clearly readable when you look up from the foot. Near the summit you can see across tea fields and the Enshu-nada Sea, and as far as Mount Fuji in good weather. The greenery is especially vivid in the season of new tea.
quiz_en: Which single kanji character is drawn in giant form with planted trees on the slope of Mount Awagatake?

name: 高天神城跡
desc: 掛川市の山上に残る高天神城の跡です。「高天神を制する者は遠江を制す」と言われた要害で、戦国時代には徳川氏と武田氏が激しい争奪戦を繰り広げました。険しい尾根に曲輪や堀の跡が残り、木々に覆われた山道を歩けば、戦国の攻防の厳しさを肌で感じられます。
quiz: 高天神城をめぐり、武田氏と激しい争奪戦を繰り広げた戦国武将は誰？
desc_en: These are the remains of Takatenjin Castle on a mountaintop in Kakegawa. It was a stronghold of which it was said, "Whoever controls Takatenjin controls Totomi," and in the Sengoku period the Tokugawa and Takeda clans fought fiercely over it. Remains of enclosures and moats survive on its steep ridges, and walking the tree-covered mountain trails you can feel how harsh the battles of the era were.
quiz_en: Which Sengoku-period warlord fought fiercely against the Takeda clan for control of the mountain stronghold of Takatenjin Castle?

name: 龍尾神社の花庭園
desc: 掛川市下西郷の龍尾神社の境内に広がる花庭園です。早春には見事なしだれ梅が咲き誇り、枝いっぱいに垂れた花が訪れる人を迎えます。神社の杜と花々が織りなす景色は華やかで、季節ごとに異なる花が楽しめます。お茶どころ掛川らしい穏やかな空気の中で散策できます。
quiz: 龍尾神社の花庭園で、早春に枝を垂らして咲き誇る花は何でしょう？
desc_en: This flower garden spreads across the grounds of Ryubi Shrine in Shimosaigo, Kakegawa. In early spring, magnificent weeping plum trees burst into bloom, welcoming visitors with branches heavy with flowers. The scenery woven by the shrine forest and the blossoms is splendid, and different flowers can be enjoyed each season. You can stroll in the gentle atmosphere typical of Kakegawa's tea country.
quiz_en: Which flower blooms in early spring at the Ryubi Shrine flower garden, its branches hanging down in splendor?

name: 横須賀城跡
desc: 遠州灘に近い掛川市大須賀に残る横須賀城の跡です。丸い河原石を積んだ玉石積みの石垣が特徴で、全国でも珍しい景観として知られます。城下には城下町の面影が残り、毎年春には勇壮な三熊野神社の大祭で町が賑わいます。
quiz: 横須賀城跡の石垣で見られる、角のない丸い石を積み上げる積み方を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: These are the ruins of Yokosuka Castle in Osuka, Kakegawa, near the Enshu-nada Sea. It is notable for its tamaishi-zumi stone walls built from round river stones, a sight known to be rare in Japan. Traces of the old castle town remain below, and every spring the town comes alive with the spirited grand festival of Mikumano Shrine.
quiz_en: What is the method of stacking round, cornerless stones seen in the walls of the Yokosuka Castle ruins called?

name: 史跡 田中城下屋敷
desc: 藤枝市にあった田中城の下屋敷跡を整備した史跡です。田中城は堀が同心円状に巡る珍しい形の城で、徳川家康も鷹狩りの際にたびたび訪れました。下屋敷跡には庭園が整えられ、移築された城の建物も見られます。東海道の宿場町・藤枝の歴史を感じられる場所です。
quiz: 田中城下屋敷で城の歴史に触れたあと、藤枝の町でぜひ味わいたい名物は何？
desc_en: This historic site preserves the shimoyashiki (secondary residence) of Tanaka Castle in Fujieda. Tanaka Castle had an unusual layout with moats arranged in concentric circles, and Tokugawa Ieyasu visited it often while falconry hunting. A garden has been laid out on the site, and relocated castle buildings can also be seen. It is a place to feel the history of Fujieda, a post town on the Tokaido road.
quiz_en: After learning about the castle's history at Tanaka Castle Shimoyashiki, which Fujieda specialty would you like to taste?

name: 飽波神社例祭
desc: 東海道の宿場町として栄えた藤枝で、飽波神社に伝わる例祭です。地域の氏神として親しまれてきた神社で、祭りの日には神輿や屋台が出て町が賑わいます。藤枝はお茶の産地でもあり、祭りの合間に地元のお茶でひと息つけば、志太の町の温かさを感じられます。
quiz: 藤枝の飽波神社の例祭で、いちばん盛り上がる瞬間はどんな場面？
desc_en: This annual festival is held at Akunami Shrine in Fujieda, which flourished as a post town on the Tokaido road. The shrine has been cherished as the local guardian deity, and on festival day mikoshi (portable shrines) and festival floats come out and the town bustles. Fujieda is also a tea-producing area, and taking a break with local tea between festivities lets you feel the warmth of the Shida area.
quiz_en: At the Akunami Shrine annual festival in Fujieda, what kind of moment do you think is the most exciting?

name: 鬼岩寺例祭
desc: 藤枝市の古刹・鬼岩寺で行われる例祭です。鬼岩寺はその名に「鬼」と「岩」を含む印象的な寺名を持ち、藤枝の市街地近くで地域の人々の信仰を集めてきました。祭りの日には多くの参拝者が訪れ、境内が賑わいます。由緒ある寺の雰囲気と町の人々の温かさに触れてください。
quiz: 藤枝の鬼岩寺の例祭を訪れたら、境内や門前でぜひ見てみたいものは何？
desc_en: This annual festival is held at Kigan-ji, an old temple in Fujieda. The temple has a striking name that includes the characters for "demon" and "rock", and it has long drawn the faith of local people near central Fujieda. On festival day many worshippers visit and the grounds come alive. Come experience the atmosphere of this historic temple and the warmth of the townspeople.
quiz_en: If you visit the Kigan-ji annual festival in Fujieda, what would you like to see on the grounds or in front of the gate?

name: 志太温泉
desc: 藤枝市の山あいにある、静かな雰囲気の温泉です。志太地域の里山に囲まれ、にぎやかな温泉街とは違う、ひっそりとした湯治場のような趣が魅力です。茶畑が広がるのどかな景色の中で湯に浸かれば、旅の疲れがじんわりとほどけていきます。
quiz: 志太温泉でゆっくり湯に浸かったあと、地元で味わいたいものは何？
desc_en: This is a quiet onsen (hot spring) in the hills of Fujieda. Surrounded by the satoyama (rural hills) of the Shida area, its charm lies in a hushed, toji-ba (therapeutic bathing retreat) feel, quite unlike a busy hot spring town. Soak in the water amid peaceful scenery of spreading tea fields, and the fatigue of travel will gently melt away.
quiz_en: After a relaxing soak at Shida Onsen, what local food or drink would you like to try?

name: 酒塚観音大祭
desc: 遠州のほぼ中央に位置する袋井市で行われる、酒塚観音の大祭です。袋井は東海道の宿場町として栄え、法多山や可睡斎などの古刹でも知られる町です。観音さまへの祈りとともに地域の人々が集う祭りの雰囲気を楽しみながら、遠州の素朴な信仰に触れられます。
quiz: 袋井で観音さまの大祭を楽しんだら、ぜひ味わってみたい袋井の名物料理は何？
desc_en: This is the grand festival of Sakazuka Kannon in Fukuroi, located near the center of the Enshu region. Fukuroi prospered as a post town on the Tokaido road and is also known for old temples such as Hattasan and Kasuisai. Enjoy the atmosphere of a festival where locals gather to pray to Kannon (Goddess of Mercy), and experience the simple faith of Enshu.
quiz_en: After enjoying the grand Kannon festival in Fukuroi, which Fukuroi specialty dish would you like to try?

name: 本興寺
desc: 浜名湖の西岸、湖西市にある日蓮宗の古刹です。重厚な堂宇が並ぶ境内は落ち着いた雰囲気で、緑の木々に包まれています。周辺は浜名湖の豊かな自然に恵まれた土地で、湖畔をめぐるドライブや散策の途中に立ち寄れば、静かな祈りの時間を過ごせます。
quiz: 湖西市の本興寺を訪れたあと、浜名湖周辺で味わいたい名物は何？
desc_en: This is an old temple of the Nichiren school in Kosai, on the western shore of Lake Hamana. Its grounds, lined with stately halls, have a calm atmosphere and are wrapped in green trees. The area is blessed with the rich nature of Lake Hamana, and stopping by during a lakeside drive or walk lets you spend a quiet moment of prayer.
quiz_en: After visiting Honko-ji in Kosai, which Lake Hamana area specialty would you like to taste?

name: 修善寺温泉の川畔旅館街と「独鈷の湯」、修禅寺
desc: 伊豆半島の中央、桂川沿いに旅館が並ぶ修善寺温泉です。川の中にある「独鈷の湯」は弘法大師が湧かせたという伝説で知られ、温泉街の象徴となっています。古刹・修禅寺や竹林の小径もあり、しっとりとした街並みを浴衣で散策するのが楽しい温泉地です。
quiz: 修善寺温泉の独鈷の湯は、どの高僧が岩を打って湧かせたと伝わる？
name_en: Shuzenji Onsen, Tokko-no-Yu and Shuzen-ji Temple
desc_en: Shuzenji Onsen lies in the center of the Izu Peninsula, with ryokan (traditional inns) lining the Katsura River. Tokko-no-Yu, a spring in the middle of the river, is known for the legend that Kobo Daishi made it gush forth, and it has become the symbol of the hot spring town. With the old temple Shuzen-ji and a bamboo grove path, it is a delightful onsen town to stroll in a yukata (light cotton kimono).
quiz_en: Which great priest is said to have struck a rock and made the Tokko-no-Yu spring at Shuzenji Onsen gush forth?

name: 恋人岬
desc: 伊豆市の西海岸、駿河湾に突き出た岬です。遊歩道の先の展望デッキには鐘があり、カップルで鳴らす人気のスポットになっています。晴れた日には駿河湾越しに富士山を望め、夕暮れ時には海と空が茜色に染まる、西伊豆らしいロマンチックな景色が広がります。
quiz: 恋人岬の展望デッキで、ふたりで鳴らすと幸せになれるといわれるものは何？
desc_en: This cape juts into Suruga Bay on the west coast of Izu City. At the end of the walking path, the observation deck has a bell, a popular spot for couples to ring together. On clear days you can see Mount Fuji across Suruga Bay, and at dusk the sea and sky turn madder red in a romantic scene typical of West Izu.
quiz_en: What is it on the Koibito Misaki observation deck that is said to bring happiness when two people ring it together?

name: 萬城の滝
desc: 天城の山中、伊豆市地蔵堂にある滝です。深い森に囲まれた落差のある滝で、柱状の岩肌を白い水が勢いよく落ちていきます。周辺はキャンプ場なども整備され、清流と緑に包まれて涼をとるには最適です。伊豆の山々の豊かな水を実感できる場所です。
quiz: 萬城の滝がある天城の山々で、清流を生かして育てられる名産品は何？
desc_en: This waterfall is in Jizodo, Izu City, in the Amagi mountains. Surrounded by deep forest, it is a tall fall where white water rushes down a columnar rock face. The area also has facilities such as a campground, making it ideal for cooling off amid clear streams and greenery. It is a place to feel the abundant water of Izu's mountains.
quiz_en: In the Amagi mountains where Banjo Falls is located, which local specialty is grown using the clear streams?

name: 元湯温泉
desc: 西伊豆の土肥温泉で、源泉の原点とされる「元湯」の名を持つ温泉です。土肥はかつて金山で栄えた町で、今も金山跡を見学できます。駿河湾に面した温泉街で、湯上がりに海辺を歩けば、夕日に染まる西伊豆の海が迎えてくれます。
quiz: 土肥の町が江戸時代に栄えるもとになった鉱山では、何が採れた？
desc_en: This onsen in Toi Onsen, West Izu, bears the name "Motoyu", which is regarded as the origin of the area's hot spring sources. Toi was once a thriving gold mining town, and the old mine can still be toured today. It is a hot spring town facing Suruga Bay, and if you walk along the shore after bathing, the West Izu sea glowing in the sunset will greet you.
quiz_en: What was mined at the site that made the town of Toi prosper in the Edo period?

name: 桜ヶ池
desc: 御前崎市の池宮神社の境内にある、深い森に囲まれた神秘的な池です。遠州七不思議のひとつに数えられ、秋の彼岸には赤飯を詰めたお櫃を池に沈める神事が受け継がれています。木々に囲まれた静かな水面は澄んでいて、古くからの信仰の気配を感じられます。
quiz: 桜ヶ池で秋の彼岸に行われる、赤飯のお櫃を池に沈める神事を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: This mysterious pond, surrounded by deep forest, lies within the grounds of Ikemiya Shrine in Omaezaki. It is counted among the Seven Wonders of Enshu, and a ritual of sinking wooden tubs filled with sekihan (red bean rice) into the pond during the autumn equinox week has been handed down. The still, clear water surrounded by trees carries a sense of ancient faith.
quiz_en: What is the ritual held at Sakuragaike during the autumn equinox week, in which tubs of red bean rice are sunk into the pond, called?

name: 牧之原の茶畑
desc: 菊川市など複数の市にまたがる牧之原台地に広がる茶畑です。明治時代に旧幕臣たちが開墾したことで大茶園が生まれ、日本有数のお茶どころとなりました。畝が幾重にも続く緑のじゅうたんは壮観で、新茶の季節には摘み取りの風景と爽やかな香りに包まれます。
quiz: 牧之原台地の茶園を明治時代に切り開いたのは、もとはどんな身分の人々？
desc_en: These tea fields spread across the Makinohara Plateau, which extends over several cities including Kikugawa. When former retainers of the shogunate cleared the land in the Meiji era, a vast tea plantation was born and the area became one of Japan's leading tea regions. The green carpet of endless rows is spectacular, and in the season of new tea you are surrounded by picking scenes and a fresh aroma.
quiz_en: What social status did the people who cleared the Makinohara Plateau tea fields in the Meiji era originally hold?

name: 潮海寺八坂神社祇園祭り
desc: 菊川市の潮海寺地区に鎮座する八坂神社の祇園祭りです。祇園祭りは疫病除けを願う夏の祭りで、地域では古くから大切に受け継がれてきました。祭りの日には山車や神輿が町を巡り、囃子の音が響きます。お茶どころ菊川の夏を彩る、地元の熱気あふれる行事です。
quiz: 潮海寺の祇園祭りで、町を巡る山車や神輿を見て印象に残ったものは何？
desc_en: This is the Gion festival of Yasaka Shrine in the Chokai-ji district of Kikugawa. A Gion festival is a summer festival to pray for protection from epidemics, and the local community has treasured it for generations. On festival day, floats and mikoshi (portable shrines) go around town to the sound of festival music. It is a lively local event that colors summer in Kikugawa, a tea-growing area.
quiz_en: What made the strongest impression on you as the floats and portable shrines went around town at the Chokai-ji Gion festival?

name: 大頭龍神社例大祭
desc: 菊川市の大頭龍神社で行われる例大祭です。龍の名を冠した神社は地域の守り神として親しまれ、祭りの日には多くの参拝者で賑わいます。茶畑が広がる菊川の穏やかな風景の中で、地元の人々が受け継いできた祭礼の雰囲気を楽しめます。
quiz: 菊川の大頭龍神社の例大祭で、ぜひ見てみたい祭りの見どころはどこ？
desc_en: This annual grand festival is held at Daitoryu Shrine in Kikugawa. Bearing the name of a dragon, the shrine is cherished as a guardian of the area, and on festival day it bustles with many worshippers. Amid the gentle scenery of Kikugawa's spreading tea fields, you can enjoy the atmosphere of a festival handed down by the local people.
quiz_en: Which highlight of the Daitoryu Shrine annual grand festival in Kikugawa would you most like to see?

name: 代官屋敷梅まつり
desc: 菊川市にある代官屋敷、黒田家住宅で開かれる梅のまつりです。黒田家住宅は江戸時代に代官を務めた家の屋敷で、堂々とした長屋門が残ります。早春には屋敷の周りで梅が咲き、古い建物と紅白の花が織りなす風景が見事です。春の訪れを感じる穏やかな散策が楽しめます。
quiz: 代官屋敷の梅まつりで、古い屋敷と梅の花をどんな構図で写真に撮りたい？
desc_en: This plum festival is held at the Daikan Yashiki, the Kuroda family residence in Kikugawa. The Kuroda residence belonged to a family that served as magistrates in the Edo period, and its imposing nagayamon (row-house gate) still stands. In early spring, plum trees bloom around the residence, and the scene of old buildings and red and white blossoms is superb. Enjoy a gentle stroll that heralds the arrival of spring.
quiz_en: At the magistrate's residence plum festival, how would you like to frame a photo of the old house and the plum blossoms?

name: 見高入谷高原温泉
desc: 早咲きの河津桜で知られる河津町の山あいにある温泉です。高原の静かな環境にあり、周囲の緑に包まれてのんびりと湯に浸かれます。河津町は七滝などの渓谷美や清流にも恵まれ、温泉と自然散策をあわせて楽しめます。春には町じゅうが桜色に染まります。
quiz: 河津町の名を全国に広めた、2月ごろから咲く早咲きの桜の品種名は何でしょう？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) is in the hills of Kawazu, a town known for its early-blooming Kawazu cherry blossoms. Set in a quiet highland environment, it lets you soak at leisure surrounded by greenery. Kawazu is also blessed with clear streams and beautiful valleys such as the Seven Falls, so you can enjoy hot springs together with nature walks. In spring the whole town is dyed cherry pink.
quiz_en: What is the name of the early-blooming cherry variety, flowering from around February, that made Kawazu Town famous nationwide?

name: 山名神社天王祭
desc: 森町の山名神社で夏に行われる天王祭です。祭りで奉納される舞楽は古い形を伝えるもので、国の重要無形民俗文化財に指定されています。素朴で古風な舞が境内で次々と演じられ、遠州の小京都とも呼ばれる森町の歴史の深さを感じさせます。
quiz: 森町出身とされ、清水次郎長の子分として浪曲で知られる人物は誰？
desc_en: This is the Tenno Festival held in summer at Yamana Shrine in Mori. The bugaku dances offered at the festival preserve an old form and are designated a national Important Intangible Folk Cultural Property. Simple, old-fashioned dances are performed one after another on the shrine grounds, conveying the depth of history in Mori, a town also called the "Little Kyoto" of Enshu.
quiz_en: Who is the figure said to be from Mori Town, famous in rokyoku narrative singing as a follower of Shimizu no Jirocho?

name: 名古屋城
desc: 徳川家康の命で築かれた尾張徳川家の居城で、天守の屋根に輝く金の鯱で知られる名古屋城です。天守は戦災で焼失した後に再建され、本丸御殿は近年、豪華な障壁画とともに復元されました。広い城内では石垣や櫓をめぐり、春には桜も楽しめます。
quiz: 名古屋城の天守の屋根に輝く、想像上の生き物をかたどった金の飾りを何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: Built on the orders of Tokugawa Ieyasu as the residence of the Owari Tokugawa family, Nagoya Castle is known for the golden shachi shining on the roof of its keep. The keep was rebuilt after being destroyed in the war, and the Honmaru Palace was recently restored along with its lavish painted screens and wall panels. On the spacious grounds you can explore stone walls and turrets, and enjoy cherry blossoms in spring.
quiz_en: What is the golden ornament shaped like an imaginary creature that shines on the roof of Nagoya Castle's keep called?

name: 熱田神宮
desc: 名古屋市熱田区に鎮座し、三種の神器のひとつ草薙神剣を祀る由緒ある神社です。「熱田さん」と呼ばれて親しまれ、伊勢神宮に次ぐ格式の社として古くから崇敬を集めてきました。大楠がそびえる深い杜に包まれ、都会の真ん中とは思えない静けさが広がります。
quiz: 熱田神宮に祀られている、三種の神器のひとつである剣の名前は何？
desc_en: Located in Atsuta Ward, Nagoya, this historic shrine enshrines the Kusanagi sword, one of the Three Sacred Treasures. Affectionately called "Atsuta-san", it has long been revered as a shrine of a rank second only to Ise Grand Shrine. Wrapped in a deep forest with towering camphor trees, it offers a tranquility hard to believe in the middle of a city.
quiz_en: What is the name of the sword enshrined at Atsuta Jingu, one of the Three Sacred Treasures of Japan?

name: 尾張津島天王祭り（津島祭り）
desc: 津島神社の夏の祭礼で、天王川公園の池を舞台に繰り広げられる川祭りです。宵祭では無数の提灯を飾ったまきわら船が水面を進み、幻想的な光景が広がります。翌朝の朝祭では能人形を飾った船が漕ぎ出します。ユネスコ無形文化遺産「山・鉾・屋台行事」のひとつです。
quiz: 尾張津島天王祭の宵祭で、提灯を半円形に飾り水面を進む船を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: This summer festival of Tsushima Shrine is a river festival held on the pond of Tennogawa Park. At the evening festival, makiwara boats decorated with countless lanterns glide across the water in a magical scene. At the morning festival the next day, boats adorned with Noh dolls set out. It is one of the festivals inscribed on UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage list as "Yama, Hoko, Yatai float festivals".
quiz_en: At the evening festival of the Owari Tsushima Tenno Matsuri, what are the boats decorated with semicircles of lanterns called?

name: 博物館明治村
cat: テーマ・公園テーマ施設
desc: 犬山市の入鹿池のほとりに広がる、明治時代の建築を移築・保存する野外博物館です。帝国ホテル中央玄関や教会、駅舎など多くの建物が並び、蒸気機関車や京都市電も走ります。レトロな街並みを歩けば、まるで明治の町にタイムスリップしたような気分を味わえます。
quiz: 明治村に移築された帝国ホテル中央玄関を設計した、アメリカの建築家は誰？
desc_en: Spreading along the shore of Iruka Pond in Inuyama, this open-air museum relocates and preserves Meiji-era architecture. Many buildings line the grounds, including the central entrance of the Imperial Hotel, churches and station buildings, and a steam locomotive and a Kyoto streetcar also run here. Strolling the retro streets, you may feel as if you had slipped back in time to a Meiji-era town.
quiz_en: Which American architect designed the central entrance of the Imperial Hotel that was relocated to Meiji-mura?

name: あのう温泉
desc: 津市の芸濃町にある温泉です。芸濃町は鈴鹿山脈の南の麓に広がる自然豊かな地域で、田園と山並みののどかな風景が続きます。肩ひじ張らずに立ち寄れる湯でゆったりと体を温めれば、旅の疲れが和らぎます。周辺の里山散策と組み合わせて楽しめます。
quiz: あのう温泉で湯上がりに味わいたい、三重県の名物や地元グルメは何？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) is in Geino, Tsu City. Geino is a nature-rich area at the southern foot of the Suzuka Mountains, where peaceful scenery of fields and mountain ranges continues. Warm yourself at leisure in this easygoing bath, and the fatigue of travel will ease. It pairs well with walks through the surrounding satoyama (rural hills).
quiz_en: After a soak at Ano Onsen, which Mie specialty or local food would you like to enjoy?

name: 君ヶ野ダム公園桜まつり
desc: 津市美杉町の山あいにある君ヶ野ダム周辺で開かれる桜まつりです。ダム湖のほとりに桜が咲き、山の緑と湖面に映る花の色が美しい景色をつくります。美杉は奈良県境に近い山深い地域で、澄んだ空気の中でのんびりとした花見が楽しめます。
quiz: 君ヶ野ダム公園の桜を湖と一緒に眺めるなら、どの時間帯がおすすめ？
name_en: Kiminono Dam Park Cherry Blossom Festival
desc_en: This cherry blossom festival is held around Kiminono Dam in the hills of Misugi, Tsu City. Cherry trees bloom along the shore of the dam lake, and the green of the mountains and the colors of the blossoms reflected on the water create a beautiful scene. Misugi is a deep mountain area near the Nara border, where you can enjoy relaxed blossom viewing in clear air.
quiz_en: If you were viewing the Kiminono Dam Park cherry blossoms together with the lake, what time of day would you recommend?

name: 香良洲海岸
desc: 津市香良洲町にある、伊勢湾に面した海岸です。遠浅で穏やかな砂浜が続き、夏には海水浴を楽しむ人々で賑わいます。雲出川の河口に近い開放的な浜辺で、対岸には知多半島方面の陸地も望めます。夕暮れ時には伊勢湾が柔らかな光に包まれます。
quiz: 香良洲海岸で過ごすなら、海水浴・散歩・夕日鑑賞のどれを楽しみたい？
desc_en: This beach in Karasu, Tsu City, faces Ise Bay. A calm sandy shore with shallow water stretches along it, and in summer it bustles with swimmers. It is an open beach near the mouth of the Kumozu River, and you can see land toward the Chita Peninsula across the bay. At dusk, Ise Bay is wrapped in soft light.
quiz_en: If you spent time at Karasu Beach, which would you like to enjoy most: swimming, walking or watching the sunset?

name: 榊原温泉
desc: 津市の山あいにある榊原温泉です。清少納言の『枕草子』に名湯として登場する「ななくりの湯」はこの地のこととされ、古くから知られた温泉です。肌あたりのやわらかな湯は美肌の湯として親しまれ、静かな里山の宿でゆったりと過ごせます。
quiz: 『枕草子』に名湯として登場し、榊原温泉のことだとされる湯の名前は？
desc_en: Sakakibara Onsen is in the hills of Tsu City. The "Nanakuri no Yu", which appears as a famous hot spring in Sei Shonagon's The Pillow Book, is said to refer to this place, and it has been known since ancient times. Its gentle water is loved as a bath for beautiful skin, and you can spend relaxing time at an inn in the quiet countryside hills.
quiz_en: What is the name of the hot spring that appears in The Pillow Book and is said to be Sakakibara Onsen?

name: 三多気桜まつり
desc: 津市美杉町の三多気で開かれる桜のまつりです。真福院へと続く参道に山桜の並木が連なり、国の名勝にも指定されています。山里の棚田や民家と桜が溶け合う風景は日本の原風景そのもので、日本さくら名所100選にも選ばれています。
quiz: 三多気の桜並木は、どの寺院へと続く参道に植えられているでしょう？
desc_en: This cherry blossom festival is held in Mitake, Misugi, Tsu City. A row of mountain cherry trees lines the approach leading to Shinpukuin Temple, and it is designated a national Place of Scenic Beauty. The scenery of terraced rice fields and farmhouses blending with the blossoms is the very image of Japan's traditional countryside, and it has been selected as one of Japan's Top 100 Cherry Blossom Spots.
quiz_en: The cherry tree avenue of Mitake is planted along the approach leading to which temple?

name: 石山観音
desc: 津市芸濃町の山中にある、岩肌に刻まれた磨崖仏群です。山道を進むと、巨岩に彫られた観音像や地蔵像が次々と現れます。素朴でやさしい表情の仏さまが木々の中にたたずむ姿は神秘的で、静かな山歩きとともに古くからの祈りの気配を感じられます。
quiz: 岩肌に直接彫られた石山観音のような仏像を、何と呼ぶでしょう？
desc_en: Found in the mountains of Geino, Tsu City, this is a group of magaibutsu, Buddhist images carved into the rock face. As you follow the mountain path, statues of Kannon and Jizo carved into giant boulders appear one after another. The sight of Buddhas with simple, gentle expressions standing among the trees is mysterious, and along with a quiet mountain walk you can sense prayers from long ago.
quiz_en: What are Buddhist images carved directly into a rock face, like those at Ishiyama Kannon, called?

name: 猪の倉温泉
desc: 津市の郊外、山あいに湧く猪の倉温泉です。周囲は緑豊かな里山で、自然に囲まれた静かな環境でゆったりと湯に浸かれます。日帰りでも気軽に立ち寄れ、四季折々の山の景色を眺めながら、ゆっくりと体を休められます。
quiz: 猪の倉温泉の名前にも入っている、山里に暮らす動物は何でしょう？
desc_en: Inokura Onsen springs up in the hills on the outskirts of Tsu City. Surrounded by green satoyama (rural hills), it lets you soak at leisure in a quiet natural setting. It is easy to drop by even on a day trip, and you can rest your body slowly while gazing at the mountain scenery of each season.
quiz_en: Which animal that lives in the mountain villages also appears in the name of Inokura Onsen, the hot spring near Tsu?

name: 津観音寺
desc: 津市の中心部にあり、「津観音」の名で親しまれる寺院です。東京の浅草観音、名古屋の大須観音とともに日本三観音のひとつに数えられ、古くから多くの参拝者を集めてきました。境内には朱色の五重塔がそびえ、門前の大門商店街とあわせて、城下町・津の賑わいを感じられます。
quiz: 津観音・大須観音とともに日本三観音に数えられる、東京の寺院はどこでしょう？
desc_en: Located in central Tsu, this temple is affectionately known as "Tsu Kannon". Together with Asakusa Kannon in Tokyo and Osu Kannon in Nagoya, it is counted among Japan's Three Great Kannon temples, and it has drawn many worshippers since long ago. A vermilion five-story pagoda rises on the grounds, and together with the Daimon shopping street in front of the gate, you can feel the bustle of the castle town of Tsu.
quiz_en: Which Tokyo temple is counted, along with Tsu Kannon and Osu Kannon, among Japan's Three Great Kannon temples?

name: 北畠神社
desc: 津市美杉町の多気に鎮座し、伊勢国司として南北朝から戦国時代にかけてこの地を治めた北畠氏を祀る神社です。境内には北畠氏館跡の庭園が残り、石組みの力強い景観は国の名勝・史跡に指定されています。山深い里で、中世の武家文化の面影に触れられます。
quiz: 北畠氏の一族で、南北朝時代に『神皇正統記』を著した南朝の重臣は誰でしょう？
desc_en: Located in Tage, Misugi, Tsu City, this shrine honors the Kitabatake clan, who ruled this area as provincial governors of Ise from the Nanboku-cho period through the Sengoku period. The garden of the Kitabatake residence ruins remains on the grounds, and its powerful stone arrangements are designated a national Place of Scenic Beauty and Historic Site. In this deep mountain village, you can glimpse traces of medieval samurai culture.
quiz_en: Which member of the Kitabatake clan, a senior retainer of the Southern Court, wrote the Jinno Shotoki during the Nanboku-cho period?

name: 伊勢神宮（豊受大神宮）
desc: 伊勢神宮の外宮にあたる豊受大神宮です。内宮の天照大御神のお食事を司る豊受大御神を祀り、衣食住や産業の守り神として崇敬されています。伊勢参りは外宮から内宮へ参るのがならわしとされ、伊勢市駅からほど近い深い杜の中に、簡素で清らかな社殿が並びます。
quiz: 外宮に祀られている、食物や産業を司るとされる神さまの名前は何でしょう？
name_en: Ise Grand Shrine (Toyouke Daijingu, Outer Shrine)
desc_en: This is Toyouke Daijingu, the Geku (Outer Shrine) of Ise Grand Shrine. It enshrines Toyouke-no-Omikami, who oversees the meals of Amaterasu-Omikami at the Inner Shrine, and is revered as a guardian of food, clothing, shelter and industry. Custom holds that an Ise pilgrimage goes from the Outer Shrine to the Inner Shrine, and simple, pure shrine buildings stand in a deep forest not far from Iseshi Station.
quiz_en: What is the name of the deity enshrined at the Outer Shrine, said to oversee food and industry?

name: 式年遷宮
desc: 伊勢神宮で20年に一度、社殿や神宝をすべて新しく造り替え、神さまにお遷りいただく最大の祭事です。1300年以上にわたって受け継がれ、宮大工の技や伝統工芸の継承にも大きな役割を果たしてきました。御木曳や御白石持行事など、市民も参加する行事が多いのも特徴です。
quiz: 伊勢神宮で社殿を新しく建て替える式年遷宮は、何年ごとに行われるでしょう？
desc_en: This is the greatest ritual of Ise Grand Shrine, held once every 20 years, in which the shrine buildings and sacred treasures are all made anew and the deities are invited to move into them. Handed down for over 1,300 years, it has played a major role in passing on the skills of shrine carpenters and traditional crafts. Another feature is the many events in which citizens take part, such as Okihiki and Oshiraishi-mochi.
quiz_en: How often is the Shikinen Sengu, in which the shrine buildings of Ise Grand Shrine are newly rebuilt, carried out?

name: 松阪牛のすき焼き
desc: 日本を代表するブランド牛・松阪牛を使ったすき焼きです。きめ細かな霜降りの肉は甘みのある脂が特徴で、割下や砂糖としょうゆで焼くように煮て、溶き卵にくぐらせていただきます。松阪市内には老舗の牛肉料理店が並び、城下町の風情とともに味わえます。
quiz: 松阪牛として育てられる牛は、主にどの毛色の和牛品種でしょう？
desc_en: This is sukiyaki made with Matsusaka beef, one of Japan's leading brand beefs. The finely marbled meat is known for its sweet fat, and it is cooked in a sauce called warishita, or seared with sugar and soy sauce, then dipped in beaten egg before eating. Long-established beef restaurants line the streets of Matsusaka, where you can enjoy it amid the charm of a castle town.
quiz_en: Cattle raised as Matsusaka beef are mainly of which coat color of Japanese wagyu breed?

name: みえこどもの城
desc: 松阪市にある、子どもたちが遊びながら学べる大型の児童館です。科学や文化、ものづくりなどの体験プログラムが用意され、親子で一日たっぷり過ごせます。周辺は緑豊かな公園に囲まれ、屋内外で元気に体を動かせます。雨の日のお出かけ先としても頼りになる施設です。
quiz: みえこどもの城で親子一緒に挑戦してみたい体験やあそびは何ですか？
desc_en: Located in Matsusaka, this large children's center lets kids learn while they play. Hands-on programs in science, culture, crafts and more are available, so parents and children can spend a full day here. Surrounded by a green park, it offers room to run around both indoors and outdoors, and it is a reliable choice for an outing on a rainy day.
quiz_en: Which activity or game at Mie Children's Castle would you like to try together as parent and child?

name: 三峰山
desc: 松阪市と奈良県の境にそびえる、台高山脈の北端に位置する山です。冬には木々の枝に氷が付着して白い花が咲いたように見える霧氷の名所として知られ、多くの登山者が訪れます。山頂付近は開けた草原で、晴れた日には遠くの山並みまで見渡せる爽快な眺めが広がります。
quiz: 三峰山で冬に見られる、枝に白い氷の花が咲いたように見える現象を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: Rising on the border between Matsusaka and Nara Prefecture, this mountain sits at the northern end of the Daiko Mountains. It is known as a famous spot for muhyo (rime ice), when ice clings to tree branches in winter so that they look like they are blooming with white flowers, and many climbers visit. Near the summit is an open grassland, and on clear days the view stretches refreshingly to distant mountain ranges.
quiz_en: What is the winter phenomenon on Mount Miune, in which branches look as if white ice flowers are blooming on them, called?

name: 森林公園
desc: 松阪市にある森林公園です。木々に囲まれた園内には遊歩道や広場があり、森林浴を楽しみながら散策できます。季節ごとに花や新緑、紅葉が移ろい、家族連れでのピクニックにもぴったりです。城下町松阪の観光の合間に、緑の中でひと息つける場所です。
quiz: 松阪の森林公園でのんびり過ごすなら、どの季節の森を歩いてみたい？
desc_en: This forest park is in Matsusaka. Surrounded by trees, the park has walking paths and open lawns where you can stroll while enjoying shinrin-yoku (forest bathing). Flowers, fresh greenery and autumn leaves change with the seasons, and it is perfect for family picnics. It is a spot to take a breather in the greenery between sightseeing in the castle town of Matsusaka.
quiz_en: If you were spending a relaxing day at the Matsusaka forest park, which season's forest would you like to walk through?

name: 九華公園
desc: 桑名城の跡を整備した公園で、揖斐川のほとりに広がります。桑名城は徳川四天王のひとり本多忠勝が初代藩主として整備した城で、水に囲まれた縄張りが特徴でした。園内には堀や石垣が残り、春の桜やつつじ、花菖蒲が美しく、水辺の城跡散策が楽しめます。
quiz: 桑名藩の初代藩主として桑名城を整備した、徳川四天王のひとりは誰でしょう？
desc_en: This park preserves the site of Kuwana Castle and spreads along the banks of the Ibi River. Kuwana Castle was developed by Honda Tadakatsu, one of Tokugawa's Four Heavenly Kings, as the first lord of the domain, and its layout was surrounded by water. Moats and stone walls remain in the park, and with beautiful cherry blossoms, azaleas and irises in spring, you can enjoy a waterside walk through the castle ruins.
quiz_en: Which of Tokugawa's Four Heavenly Kings developed Kuwana Castle as the first lord of the Kuwana Domain?

name: 多度大社
desc: 桑名市の多度山の麓に鎮座する古社で、「お伊勢参らばお多度もかけよ」とうたわれてきました。毎年5月の多度祭では、騎手を乗せた馬が急な坂を駆け上がる上げ馬神事が奉納され、大勢の見物客で賑わいます。境内には清流が流れ、緑に包まれた神域が広がります。
quiz: 多度大社で5月に行われる、騎手を乗せた馬が急坂を駆け上がる神事を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: This ancient shrine stands at the foot of Mount Tado in Kuwana, long celebrated in the saying, "If you visit Ise, visit Tado too." At the Tado Festival every May, the Ageuma Shinji is offered, in which horses carrying riders charge up a steep slope, drawing crowds of spectators. A clear stream flows through the grounds, and the sacred precinct is wrapped in greenery.
quiz_en: What is the ritual held at Tado Taisha in May, in which horses carrying riders charge up a steep slope, called?

name: 加佐登神社
desc: 鈴鹿市の小高い山の上に鎮座する神社で、日本武尊を祀っています。東征の帰途、能褒野で亡くなった日本武尊が白鳥となって飛び立ったという伝説が残り、近くには白鳥塚と呼ばれる古墳もあります。日本武尊が身に着けていた笠と杖を祀ったことが社名の由来とされます。
quiz: 加佐登神社に祀られ、白鳥になって飛び立ったと伝わる古代の英雄は誰？
desc_en: Standing on a small hill in Suzuka, this shrine honors Yamato Takeru. A legend tells that Yamato Takeru, who died at Nobono on his way back from his eastern campaign, turned into a white bird and flew away, and a burial mound called Shiratori-zuka is nearby. The shrine's name is said to come from its enshrining the hat (kasa) and staff that Yamato Takeru carried.
quiz_en: Who is the ancient hero enshrined at Kasado Shrine, said to have turned into a white bird and flown away?

name: 椿大神社
desc: 鈴鹿山脈の入道ヶ岳の麓、鈴鹿市山本町に鎮座する神社です。道ひらきの神・猿田彦大神を祀り、全国の猿田彦大神を祀る社の総本宮とされます。境内には天之鈿女命を祀る椿岸神社もあり、芸能の神として信仰を集めています。深い杜の中の参道は清々しい空気に満ちています。
quiz: 椿大神社の主祭神で、道ひらきの神として信仰されている神さまは誰？
desc_en: This shrine stands in Yamamoto, Suzuka, at the foot of Mount Nyudogatake in the Suzuka Mountains. It enshrines Sarutahiko-no-Okami, the god of guidance who opens the way, and is regarded as the head shrine of all shrines dedicated to Sarutahiko. The grounds also include Tsubaki Kishi Shrine, dedicated to Ame-no-Uzume, worshipped as a goddess of the performing arts. The approach through the deep forest is filled with refreshing air.
quiz_en: Who is the main deity of Tsubaki Grand Shrine, worshipped as the god of guidance who opens the way?

name: やなせ宿
desc: 名張市にある、初瀬街道の宿場町の歴史にちなむ施設です。名張はかつて大和と伊勢を結ぶ初瀬街道の宿場として栄え、伊勢参りの旅人が行き交いました。名張川が流れる城下町の古い町並みには、今も昔ながらの商家の面影が残り、のんびり散策するのが楽しい町です。
quiz: 名張の町を歩いて、宿場町や城下町の名残を感じたのはどんなところ？
desc_en: This facility in Nabari draws on the history of the post towns of the Hase Kaido road. Nabari once thrived as a post town on the Hase Kaido connecting Yamato and Ise, where travelers on pilgrimage to Ise came and went. In the old streets of this castle town along the Nabari River, traces of traditional merchant houses still remain, making it a pleasant town for a leisurely stroll.
quiz_en: As you walked around Nabari, where did you feel the lingering traces of the old post town and castle town?

name: 青蓮寺湖
desc: 名張市にある、青蓮寺川をせき止めてつくられたダム湖です。山々に囲まれた湖面は静かで、春の桜や秋の紅葉が水面に映り込む景色が見事です。湖の周辺にはぶどう狩りなどができる観光農園が点在し、ドライブや湖畔の散策とあわせて一日楽しめます。
quiz: 青蓮寺湖のほとりを訪れたら、湖と一緒に楽しみたいことは何ですか？
desc_en: This dam lake in Nabari was created by damming the Shorenji River. Its surface, surrounded by mountains, is calm, and the scenery of spring cherry blossoms and autumn leaves reflected on the water is superb. Tourist farms offering activities such as grape picking dot the area around the lake, so you can enjoy a full day combined with a drive or a lakeside walk.
quiz_en: If you visited the shores of Lake Shorenji, what would you like to enjoy along with the lake?

name: 青蓮寺湖観光農園
desc: 名張市の青蓮寺湖のほとりに広がる観光農園です。ぶどう狩りをはじめとする果物狩りが楽しめ、もぎたての甘い実をその場で味わえます。湖と山々に囲まれた明るい畑で、家族や友人とわいわい収穫するのは格別です。夏から秋にかけて特に賑わいます。
quiz: 青蓮寺湖観光農園のぶどう狩りで、いちばんおいしかった品種は何ですか？
desc_en: These tourist farms spread along the shore of Lake Shorenji in Nabari. You can enjoy fruit picking, grapes above all, and taste the sweet, freshly picked fruit on the spot. Harvesting with family and friends in bright fields surrounded by the lake and mountains is a special pleasure. The farms are especially busy from summer through autumn.
quiz_en: When you went grape picking at the Lake Shorenji tourist farms, which grape variety tasted the best to you?

name: 赤目四十八滝
desc: 名張市の赤目渓谷に、大小さまざまな滝が連なる景勝地です。原生林の中の遊歩道を進むと、不動滝や千手滝、布曳滝など個性豊かな滝が次々と現れます。忍者の修行の地だったという伝承も残り、入口近くにはオオサンショウウオを見られる施設もあります。
quiz: 赤目四十八滝の中でも特に名高い5つの滝を、まとめて何と呼ぶでしょう？
desc_en: This scenic spot in the Akame Valley of Nabari features a chain of waterfalls large and small. Following the walking path through the primeval forest, you encounter one distinctive waterfall after another, such as Fudo Falls, Senju Falls and Nunobiki Falls. Legend has it that ninja once trained here, and near the entrance there is a facility where you can see Japanese giant salamanders.
quiz_en: What are the five especially famous waterfalls among the Akame 48 Waterfalls in Nabari collectively called?

name: 名張桜まつり
desc: 名張市で春に開かれる桜のまつりです。名張は伊賀盆地の南に位置し、名張川や宇陀川が流れる水と緑の町です。川沿いや公園が桜に包まれると、町じゅうが華やかな雰囲気になります。花見のあとは城下町の古い町並みを歩いて、名張の春をたっぷり満喫できます。
quiz: 名張桜まつりでお花見をするなら、一緒に食べたいお弁当のおかずは何？
desc_en: This cherry blossom festival is held in Nabari in spring. Nabari lies at the southern end of the Iga Basin and is a town of water and greenery through which the Nabari and Uda rivers flow. When the riverbanks and parks are wrapped in cherry blossoms, the whole town takes on a festive mood. After viewing the blossoms, stroll the old streets of the castle town to fully savor spring in Nabari.
quiz_en: If you were enjoying hanami (blossom viewing) at the Nabari Cherry Blossom Festival, what would you want in your bento lunch?

name: 三木里海岸
desc: 尾鷲市の南部、賀田湾に面した海岸です。入り組んだリアス式の海岸線に囲まれた穏やかな入り江で、松林を背にした砂浜が広がります。夏には透明度の高い海で海水浴が楽しめ、熊野古道伊勢路も近くを通ります。山と海が迫る東紀州らしい風景に出会えます。
quiz: 三木里海岸で泳いだあと、尾鷲の港町で食べたい海の幸は何ですか？
desc_en: This beach in southern Owase faces Kata Bay. It is a calm inlet surrounded by an intricate ria coastline, with a sandy beach backed by pine trees. In summer you can swim in its very clear water, and the Ise-ji route of the Kumano Kodo pilgrimage trail passes nearby. Here you can encounter scenery typical of Higashi-Kishu, where mountains press close to the sea.
quiz_en: After a swim at Mikisato Beach, which seafood would you like to eat in the port town of Owase?

name: 観音山公園
desc: 亀山市にある、小高い山を整備した公園です。春には多くの桜が咲き、山全体が花に覆われる桜の名所として親しまれています。山上からは亀山の町並みや鈴鹿の山々を見渡せます。東海道の宿場町・亀山の歴史散策とあわせて訪れたい場所です。
quiz: 観音山公園で桜を眺めたあと、東海道の宿場町・亀山でどこを散策してみたい？
desc_en: This park in Kameyama was created on a small hill. In spring, many cherry trees bloom and the whole hill is covered in flowers, making it a beloved cherry blossom spot. From the top you can look out over the streets of Kameyama and the Suzuka Mountains. It is a place to visit together with a historical stroll through Kameyama, a post town on the Tokaido road.
quiz_en: After viewing the cherry blossoms at Kannonyama Park, where would you like to stroll in Kameyama, a post town on the Tokaido?

name: 亀山市桜まつり
desc: 亀山市で開かれる桜のまつりです。亀山は東海道の宿場町、城下町として栄えた町で、亀山城跡には江戸時代の多門櫓が今も残ります。石垣の上に建つ白壁の櫓と桜の花が並ぶ景色は風情たっぷりで、町歩きをしながら春の訪れを満喫できます。
quiz: 亀山城跡に現存する、石垣の上に長屋のように建つ櫓を何と呼ぶでしょう？
desc_en: This cherry blossom festival is held in Kameyama. Kameyama flourished as a post town on the Tokaido road and as a castle town, and the Edo-period tamon yagura turret still stands on the Kameyama Castle ruins. The view of the white-walled turret on its stone wall alongside the cherry blossoms is full of charm, and you can enjoy the arrival of spring as you walk around town.
quiz_en: What is the surviving turret at the Kameyama Castle ruins, built like a long row house on top of a stone wall, called?

name: 鬼ヶ城
desc: 熊野市の熊野灘に面して、波の浸食でできた大小の洞窟が連なる奇岩の景勝地です。海岸の断崖に沿って遊歩道が整備され、迫力ある岩肌を間近に見られます。かつて鬼が住み、坂上田村麻呂が退治したという伝説が残り、世界遺産「紀伊山地の霊場と参詣道」の一部でもあります。
quiz: 鬼ヶ城に伝わる鬼退治の伝説で、鬼を退治したとされる武将は誰でしょう？
desc_en: Facing the Kumano-nada Sea in Kumano City, this scenic spot of strange rocks features a series of caves large and small carved by wave erosion. A walking path runs along the coastal cliffs, letting you see the dramatic rock faces up close. A legend says demons once lived here and were defeated by Sakanoue no Tamuramaro, and the site is part of the World Heritage "Sacred Sites and Pilgrimage Routes in the Kii Mountain Range".
quiz_en: In the demon-slaying legend of Onigajo, which warrior is said to have defeated the demons?

name: 湯元湯ノ口温泉
desc: 熊野市紀和町の山あいに湧く温泉です。紀和町はかつて紀州鉱山で栄えた地域で、鉱山の坑道を走ったトロッコが観光用として運行され、温泉へのアクセスに利用されています。山の緑に囲まれた静かな湯で、鉱山の歴史に思いを馳せながらのんびりと過ごせます。
quiz: 湯ノ口温泉へ向かう、かつての鉱山の軌道を走る小さな乗り物は何？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) springs up in the hills of Kiwa, Kumano City. Kiwa once thrived thanks to the Kishu Mine, and a mine car that ran through the mine tunnels now operates for tourists and is used to reach the hot spring. It is a quiet bath surrounded by mountain greenery, where you can relax while reflecting on the history of the mine.
quiz_en: What is the small vehicle that runs along the former mine track on the way to Yunokuchi Onsen?

name: 瀞峡
desc: 三重・奈良・和歌山の3県にまたがる、北山川の峡谷です。中でも瀞八丁と呼ばれる区間は、切り立った岩壁の間を深い碧色の流れが静かに続き、国の特別名勝に指定されています。川を進む観光船に乗れば、両岸に迫る奇岩や巨岩の迫力を間近に体感できます。
quiz: 瀞峡の中でも、特に美しく国の特別名勝に指定されている区間を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: This gorge of the Kitayama River straddles three prefectures: Mie, Nara and Wakayama. In the section called Dorohatcho in particular, a deep blue-green current flows quietly between sheer rock walls, and it is designated a national Special Place of Scenic Beauty.
