quiz_en: Yagyu Munenori, who built Hotoku-ji Temple, served the Tokugawa shoguns as an instructor in what discipline?

name: 郡山城跡
desc: 豊臣秀吉の弟・秀長が入城し、大和・紀伊・和泉を治める拠点とした城の跡です。石垣には寺院の石材や石仏なども使われ、逆さに積まれた「逆さ地蔵」が有名です。復元された追手門や櫓が往時の姿を伝え、春には城跡一帯が桜で埋め尽くされます。城下町・大和郡山は金魚の産地としても知られています。
quiz: 郡山城の城下町・大和郡山は、何という観賞魚の産地として有名でしょう？
desc_en: These are the ruins of the castle where Hidenaga, younger brother of Toyotomi Hideyoshi, took up residence and governed the provinces of Yamato, Kii, and Izumi. Stones from temples and even stone Buddhas were used in the walls, and the "Upside-down Jizo," set in the wall upside down, is famous. The restored Oute Gate and turrets convey the castle's former appearance, and in spring the entire site is filled with cherry blossoms. The castle town of Yamatokoriyama is also known for producing goldfish.
quiz_en: The castle town of Yamatokoriyama, below Koriyama Castle, is famous for producing what kind of ornamental fish?

name: 松尾寺
desc: 大和郡山市の矢田丘陵の山中にある古刹で、古くから厄除けの寺として信仰を集めてきました。山中の参道を登っていくと、森に包まれた境内に本堂や三重塔が現れます。厄年を迎えた人が参拝に訪れるほか、秋にはカエデが色づき、山寺らしい静かな景色の中で心を落ち着けることができます。
quiz: 松尾寺に厄除けの祈願に訪れる人も多い、災いが多いとされる年齢を何と呼ぶでしょう？
desc_en: This historic temple in the mountains of the Yata Hills in Yamatokoriyama has long been revered as a temple for warding off misfortune. Climbing the mountain approach, you come upon the main hall and three-story pagoda in grounds surrounded by forest. People reaching their yakudoshi visit to pray, and in autumn the maples change color, letting you calm your mind amid the quiet scenery of a mountain temple.
quiz_en: Many people visit Matsuo-dera to pray for protection during certain ages believed to bring misfortune. What are these ages called?

name: 矢田寺
desc: 矢田丘陵の中腹にある古刹で、「あじさい寺」の名で広く知られています。初夏になると境内のあじさい園に約60種1万株ともいわれる花が咲き、青や紫、ピンクの花が斜面を埋め尽くします。本尊は地蔵菩薩で、「矢田のお地蔵さん」として親しまれ、梅雨空の下でもしっとりとした美しさを楽しめます。
quiz: 矢田寺が初夏に境内を埋め尽くす花から、何という愛称で呼ばれているでしょう？
desc_en: This historic temple, halfway up the Yata Hills, is widely known as the "Hydrangea Temple." In early summer, the hydrangea garden in the grounds blooms with what is said to be about 10,000 plants of some 60 varieties, with blue, purple, and pink flowers covering the slopes. The principal image is Jizo Bosatsu, affectionately known as "Yata's Ojizo-san," and you can enjoy the temple's gentle beauty even under rainy-season skies.
quiz_en: Because of the flowers that fill its grounds in early summer, what nickname is Yata-dera Temple known by?

name: 石上神宮（初詣を含む）
desc: 日本最古の神社の一つとされ、古代の豪族・物部氏がまつったと伝えられる神社です。神宝として国宝の七支刀が伝わり、深い杉木立に包まれた境内には神聖な空気が満ちています。境内では神の使いとされる鶏が放し飼いにされ、のびのびと歩く姿は参拝者を和ませます。初詣にも多くの人が訪れます。
quiz: 石上神宮に伝わる国宝で、左右に枝のような刃が出た独特の形の刀を何と呼ぶでしょう？
desc_en: Considered one of the oldest shrines in Japan, it is said to have been worshipped by the Mononobe, a powerful ancient clan. The National Treasure Seven-Branched Sword has been handed down as a sacred treasure, and the grounds, surrounded by a deep cedar grove, are filled with a sacred atmosphere. Chickens, regarded as messengers of the gods, roam freely in the grounds, and their carefree strolling charms visitors. Many people also come for hatsumode, the first shrine visit of the New Year.
quiz_en: What is the name of the National Treasure sword at Isonokami Jingu with its unique shape of branch-like blades on both sides?

name: 長岳寺
desc: 日本最古の道ともいわれる山の辺の道沿いに建つ古刹です。平安時代に建てられた鐘楼門は、日本最古の鐘楼門とされています。境内は四季の花に彩られ、春のツツジや初夏のカキツバタ、秋の紅葉が見事です。山の辺の道を歩く途中に立ち寄り、のどかな大和の田園風景とともに楽しんでみてください。
quiz: 長岳寺が沿う、日本最古の道ともいわれる天理から桜井へ続く古道は何でしょう？
desc_en: This historic temple stands along the Yamanobe-no-michi, said to be the oldest road in Japan. Its bell-tower gate, built in the Heian period, is considered the oldest of its kind in Japan. The grounds are colored by flowers throughout the year, with azaleas in spring, irises in early summer, and autumn leaves that are spectacular. Stop by while walking the Yamanobe-no-michi and enjoy it along with the peaceful countryside of Yamato.
quiz_en: What is the name of the ancient road running from Tenri to Sakurai, said to be Japan's oldest, along which Chogaku-ji stands?

name: 今井町の街並み
desc: 戦国時代に称念寺を中心とした寺内町として発展し、江戸時代には商業の町として栄えた町並みです。東西約600m、南北約310mの範囲に江戸時代の町家が数多く残り、国の重要伝統的建造物群保存地区に選定されています。格子や虫籠窓のある家並みが続く通りを歩けば、まるで江戸時代にタイムスリップしたかのようです。
quiz: 今井町のように、寺院を中心にして堀や土塁で囲まれ発展した町を何と呼ぶでしょう？
desc_en: This townscape developed in the Sengoku period as a temple town centered on Shonen-ji, and it prospered as a merchant town in the Edo period. Many Edo-period townhouses remain within an area of about 600 meters east to west and 310 meters north to south, and it has been selected as a national Important Preservation District for Groups of Traditional Buildings. Walking streets lined with latticed houses and mushiko-mado windows feels like slipping back in time to the Edo period.
quiz_en: What is the name for a town like Imaicho that developed around a temple and was enclosed by moats and earthen walls?

name: 橿原神宮
desc: 畝傍山の東南のふもと、初代天皇とされる神武天皇が即位した宮があったと伝わる地に、明治23年に創建された神社です。広大な神域には玉砂利の参道が続き、檜皮葺きの本殿や外拝殿が厳かな雰囲気を醸し出します。初詣には多くの参拝者でにぎわい、深い森と広い空が印象的な場所です。
quiz: 橿原神宮にまつられている、日本の初代天皇とされるのは誰でしょう？
desc_en: Founded in 1890 at the southeastern foot of Mount Unebi, this shrine stands on the site where the palace of Emperor Jimmu, regarded as Japan's first emperor, is said to have been when he ascended the throne. Gravel paths stretch across the vast sacred grounds, and the cypress-bark-roofed main sanctuary and outer worship hall create a solemn atmosphere. It is crowded with worshippers for the New Year's first shrine visit, and its deep forest and wide sky leave a lasting impression.
quiz_en: Who is enshrined at Kashihara Jingu Shrine and regarded in tradition as the very first emperor of Japan?

name: 聖林寺
desc: 桜井市の山の中腹に建つ寺で、天平時代を代表する仏像・国宝の十一面観音立像がまつられています。明治時代の神仏分離の際に大神神社の神宮寺から移されたと伝えられ、均整の取れた優美な姿は多くの人を魅了してきました。境内からは三輪山や大和盆地の田園を見渡すことができます。
quiz: 聖林寺にまつられている国宝の観音像、頭の上にいくつもの顔をもつこの観音を何と呼ぶでしょう？
desc_en: This temple stands halfway up a mountain in Sakurai and enshrines a National Treasure standing statue of the Eleven-Headed Kannon, one of the finest Buddhist sculptures of the Tenpyo era. It is said to have been moved here from the shrine-temple of Omiwa Shrine during the separation of Shinto and Buddhism in the Meiji era, and its well-proportioned, graceful form has captivated many. From the grounds you can look out over Mount Miwa and the farmland of the Nara Basin.
quiz_en: What is the name of the type of Kannon, enshrined at Shorin-ji as a National Treasure, that has many faces on its head?

name: 石位寺
desc: 桜井市の山あいにある小さなお堂で、古い時代の石仏が伝わっています。一枚の石に三尊仏が浮き彫りにされたその石仏は、柔らかな表情が印象的で、日本の石仏の中でも古いものの一つとされています。普段は静かな集落の中にたたずみ、訪れる人もまばらな、知る人ぞ知る祈りの場所です。
quiz: 石位寺に伝わる石仏のように、中央の仏と左右の仏の三体で構成される仏像を何と呼ぶでしょう？
desc_en: This small hall in the mountains of Sakurai preserves a stone Buddha from ancient times. Carved in relief on a single stone, the Buddhist triad is striking for its gentle expressions and is considered one of the oldest stone Buddhas in Japan. Usually it stands quietly within a peaceful village, a little-known place of prayer that sees only a handful of visitors.
quiz_en: What is the name for a group of Buddhist images, like Ishii-dera's stone Buddha, made up of a central figure and two attendants?

name: 等弥神社
desc: 桜井市の鳥見山の北のふもとに鎮座する古社です。鳥見山は、神武天皇が皇祖神をまつった霊畤の地とも伝えられる由緒ある山で、神社の背後から山頂へ登る道も整備されています。木立に囲まれた静かな境内は、古代から信仰が受け継がれてきた大和の地らしい厳かな空気に満ちています。
quiz: 等弥神社の背後にそびえる鳥見山、あなたが山頂から眺めてみたい大和の景色はどこですか？
desc_en: This ancient shrine sits at the northern foot of Mount Tomi in Sakurai. Mount Tomi is a mountain of distinguished history, said to be the site where Emperor Jimmu worshipped his imperial ancestral deities, and a trail leads from behind the shrine up to the summit. The quiet, tree-lined grounds are filled with the solemn air of the Yamato region, where faith has been handed down since ancient times.
quiz_en: From the summit of Mount Tomi, which rises behind Tomi Shrine, which view of the Yamato region would you like to see?

name: 金剛寺
desc: 五條市にある古刹で、「ぼたん寺」の名で親しまれています。春から初夏にかけて境内の庭園には多くの牡丹が咲き誇り、大輪の花の華やかな色彩と香りに包まれます。周辺は吉野川が流れるのどかな里で、柿の産地としても知られる五條の素朴な風景の中で、花の寺の美しさをゆっくり楽しめます。
quiz: 金剛寺は、春に境内の庭園を彩る大輪の花から、何寺と呼ばれて親しまれているでしょう？
desc_en: This historic temple in Gojo is affectionately known as the "Peony Temple." From spring into early summer, many peonies bloom in the garden, enveloping visitors in the vivid colors and fragrance of their large blossoms. The surrounding area is a peaceful village along the Yoshino River, and amid the simple scenery of Gojo, also known for growing persimmons, you can take your time enjoying the beauty of this flower temple.
quiz_en: Because of the large flowers that color its garden in spring, what kind of temple is Kongo-ji affectionately called?

name: 榮山寺
desc: 吉野川のほとりにたたずむ古刹で、奈良時代に藤原武智麻呂によって創建されたと伝えられます。境内に建つ八角円堂は、奈良時代の建築として国宝に指定されており、法隆寺夢殿と並ぶ貴重な八角堂です。川の流れと木々に包まれた静かな境内は、歴史の重みを感じさせる落ち着いた雰囲気に満ちています。
quiz: 榮山寺の国宝の建物は、上から見るとどんな形をしているでしょう？
desc_en: This historic temple stands on the banks of the Yoshino River and is said to have been founded by Fujiwara no Muchimaro in the Nara period. The Octagonal Hall in the grounds is designated a National Treasure as a work of Nara-period architecture, and it is a precious octagonal hall ranked alongside the Yumedono of Horyu-ji. Surrounded by the flowing river and trees, the quiet grounds are filled with a calm atmosphere that conveys the weight of history.
quiz_en: When viewed from directly above, what shape does the National Treasure building at Eisan-ji Temple have?

name: 宝山寺
desc: 生駒山の中腹にある真言律宗の寺で、「生駒の聖天さん」の名で親しまれ、商売繁盛の祈願に多くの人が訪れます。江戸時代に湛海律師が開いた寺で、岩山を背にした般若窟の景観が印象的です。参道には石段と石灯籠が続き、生駒ケーブルの宝山寺駅から門前町の風情を味わいながら歩いて参拝できます。
quiz: 宝山寺は、商売繁盛のご利益で知られることから「生駒の何さん」と呼ばれているでしょう？
desc_en: This temple of the Shingon Ritsu school, halfway up Mount Ikoma, is affectionately known as "Ikoma no Shoten-san," and many people visit to pray for business prosperity. It was founded in the Edo period by the priest Tankai, and the view of the Hannya Cave set against the rocky mountain is striking. Stone steps and stone lanterns line the approach, and you can walk from Hozanji Station on the Ikoma Cable Line while enjoying the atmosphere of the temple town.
quiz_en: Because it is known for blessings of business prosperity, Hozan-ji Temple is affectionately called "Ikoma no what-san"?

name: 阿日寺
desc: 香芝市にある、平安時代の僧・恵心僧都源信の生誕地と伝わる寺です。源信は「往生要集」を著して浄土信仰を広めたことで知られます。寺は、長患いせず安らかな最期を願う「ぽっくり往生」の寺としても信仰を集め、高齢の参拝者が多く訪れます。のどかな住宅地の中にある、穏やかな祈りの場です。
quiz: 阿日寺で生まれたと伝わる恵心僧都源信が著した、浄土信仰の書物は何でしょう？
desc_en: This temple in Kashiba is said to be the birthplace of Eshin Sozu Genshin, a monk of the Heian period. Genshin is known for writing the "Ojoyoshu" and spreading Pure Land faith. The temple is also revered as a temple of "pokkuri ojo," where people pray for a peaceful end without long illness, and many elderly worshippers visit. It is a gentle place of prayer set in a quiet residential area.
quiz_en: What is the title of the book on Pure Land faith written by Eshin Sozu Genshin, said to have been born at Anichi-ji?

name: 石光寺
desc: 二上山のふもとにある寺で、中将姫が蓮の糸を五色に染めた井戸が残ることから「染寺」とも呼ばれています。花の寺としても知られ、特に冬から早春にかけて咲く寒牡丹は、雪囲いの藁の中で花を開く姿が愛らしく人気です。春の牡丹や芍薬、秋の萩なども楽しめ、四季を通じて花の香りに包まれます。
quiz: 石光寺が「染寺」と呼ばれるのは、伝説の姫が何を染めた井戸があるからでしょう？
desc_en: This temple at the foot of Mount Nijo is also called "Some-dera" (Dyeing Temple) because a well remains where Princess Chujo is said to have dyed lotus threads in five colors. It is known as a temple of flowers, and its winter peonies, which bloom from winter to early spring, are especially popular, looking charming as they open inside straw snow shelters. You can also enjoy spring peonies, herbaceous peonies, and autumn bush clover, so the temple is filled with floral fragrance year-round.
quiz_en: Sekko-ji is called the "Dyeing Temple" because it has a well where a legendary princess dyed what?

name: 屋敷山公園
desc: 葛城市の市街地にある公園で、江戸時代に陣屋が置かれていた地が整備されています。園内には池や芝生広場、樹木が配され、地元の人々の憩いの場として親しまれています。春には桜が咲き、二上山や葛城山を背景にした景色を楽しみながら散策できます。歴史の面影を感じつつのんびり過ごせる公園です。
quiz: 屋敷山公園で過ごすなら、お花見とピクニック、あなたはどんな楽しみ方をしたいですか？
desc_en: This park in central Katsuragi has been developed on the site of a jinya, an administrative residence established in the Edo period. Ponds, lawns, and trees are arranged throughout, and it is beloved by local people as a place to relax. In spring the cherry trees bloom, and you can stroll while enjoying views set against Mount Nijo and Mount Katsuragi. It is a park where you can spend a leisurely time while sensing traces of history.
quiz_en: If you spent a day at Yashikiyama Park, how would you like to enjoy it, with cherry-blossom viewing or a picnic?

name: 室生寺
desc: 宇陀市の室生川沿いの山中にある真言宗の古刹です。女性の参拝を受け入れてきたことから「女人高野」と呼ばれ、国宝の金堂や本堂が山の斜面に建ち並びます。境内の五重塔は屋外にある五重塔として国内最小とされ、春には石楠花に囲まれて可憐な姿を見せます。秋の紅葉も見事です。
quiz: 女性の参拝を受け入れてきた室生寺は、何という愛称で呼ばれてきたでしょう？
desc_en: This historic Shingon temple lies in the mountains along the Muro River in Uda. Because it has long welcomed women worshippers, it is called "Nyonin Koya" (Women's Koya), and its National Treasure Golden Hall and Main Hall stand on the mountainside. Its five-story pagoda is considered the smallest outdoor five-story pagoda in Japan, and in spring it shows its dainty form surrounded by rhododendrons. The autumn foliage is also magnificent.
quiz_en: Muro-ji Temple, which has long welcomed women worshippers, has traditionally been called by what nickname?

name: 大野寺
desc: 室生寺への入り口にあたる宇陀川のほとりに建つ寺です。川を挟んだ対岸の岩壁には、巨大な弥勒菩薩の磨崖仏が線刻されており、その壮大さに驚かされます。春には見事な枝垂れ桜が境内を彩り、岩壁の磨崖仏と桜が並ぶ光景を見に、多くの人が訪れます。
quiz: 大野寺の対岸の岩壁に刻まれた、岩に直接彫った仏像のことを何と呼ぶでしょう？
desc_en: This temple stands on the banks of the Uda River, at the entrance to Muro-ji. On the cliff on the opposite bank, a giant image of Miroku Bosatsu has been engraved in line carving, and its grand scale is astonishing. In spring, magnificent weeping cherry trees color the grounds, and many people come to see the cliff carving and the cherry blossoms side by side.
quiz_en: What is the term for a Buddhist image carved directly into rock, like the one on the cliff across from Ono-dera?

name: 竜鎮渓谷
desc: 宇陀市の山あいにある渓谷で、清らかな流れが岩の間を縫うように続きます。渓谷の奥には滝もあり、竜が鎮まる場所という名のとおり、どこか神秘的な雰囲気が漂います。夏は木陰と水辺の涼しさを求めてキャンプや水遊びを楽しむ人々が訪れ、秋には周囲の木々が色づき、渓流を彩ります。
quiz: 竜鎮渓谷の澄んだ流れのそばで、あなたが楽しみたい夏のアウトドアは何ですか？
desc_en: This gorge in the mountains of Uda features a clear stream that weaves its way between the rocks. Deep in the gorge there is also a waterfall, and true to its name, meaning "place where the dragon rests," a somewhat mystical atmosphere hangs in the air. In summer people come seeking the cool shade and waterside for camping and water play, and in autumn the surrounding trees change color and adorn the stream.
quiz_en: Beside the clear waters of Ryuchin Gorge, what kind of summer outdoor activity would you like to enjoy?

name: 寺社
desc: 宇陀市には、室生寺や大野寺をはじめとする古刹や、由緒ある神社が数多く点在しています。山々に囲まれた盆地の町には、古くから伊勢へ向かう街道が通り、旅人たちが行き交いました。城下町の名残をとどめる宇陀松山の町並みとあわせて寺社を巡れば、大和の山里に息づく信仰と歴史を感じられます。
quiz: 宇陀市の寺社巡りで、あなたが一番訪れてみたいお寺や神社はどこですか？
desc_en: Uda is dotted with many historic temples, including Muro-ji and Ono-dera, as well as shrines of distinguished history. Since ancient times, a highway leading to Ise passed through this basin town surrounded by mountains, and travelers came and went. If you tour the temples and shrines along with the Uda Matsuyama townscape, which retains traces of a castle town, you can feel the faith and history living on in the mountain villages of Yamato.
quiz_en: On a tour of the temples and shrines of Uda City, which temple or shrine would you most like to visit?

name: 龍田大社
desc: 三郷町に鎮座する、古くから風の神をまつる神社です。風水害を鎮め、五穀豊穣をもたらす神として朝廷からも篤く崇敬されてきました。夏には風を鎮める祭りが行われ、多くの参拝者でにぎわいます。境内の近くを流れる大和川沿いや龍田の山々は、紅葉の名所として和歌にも詠まれてきた土地です。
quiz: 龍田大社にまつられているのは、自然の何をつかさどる神様として知られているでしょう？
desc_en: This shrine in Sango has long been dedicated to the gods of wind. As deities who calm wind and flood damage and bring abundant harvests, they were deeply revered even by the imperial court. In summer, a festival to calm the winds is held, drawing many worshippers. The banks of the Yamato River flowing near the shrine and the Tatsuta mountains are a famous spot for autumn leaves celebrated in waka poetry.
quiz_en: The deities enshrined at Tatsuta Taisha are known as gods who govern which element of the natural world?

name: 法隆寺
desc: 聖徳太子ゆかりの寺で、金堂や五重塔を中心とする西院伽藍は、現存する世界最古の木造建築群として知られています。1993年に姫路城とともに日本初の世界文化遺産に登録されました。夢殿のある東院伽藍や、数々の国宝を収める大宝蔵院も見どころで、飛鳥時代の仏教文化を今に伝えています。
quiz: 法隆寺の東院伽藍にある、八角形の仏堂は何と呼ばれているでしょう？
desc_en: This temple is associated with Prince Shotoku, and its Western Precinct, centered on the Golden Hall and five-story pagoda, is known as the world's oldest surviving group of wooden buildings. In 1993, together with Himeji Castle, it became one of Japan's first World Cultural Heritage Sites. The Eastern Precinct with the Yumedono hall and the Great Treasure Hall housing numerous National Treasures are also highlights, conveying the Buddhist culture of the Asuka period today.
quiz_en: What is the name of the octagonal Buddhist hall found in the Eastern Precinct of Horyu-ji Temple?

name: 中宮寺
desc: 法隆寺の東院に隣接する尼寺で、聖徳太子が母のために建てた寺と伝えられています。本尊の菩薩半跏像は、頬に指を添えて静かに微笑む姿が美しく、その微笑みは世界の三つの微笑像の一つとも称されます。池に浮かぶように建つ本堂の静かなたたずまいとともに、穏やかな時間を過ごせます。
quiz: 中宮寺の菩薩半跏像の穏やかな微笑みは、古代美術の言葉で何スマイルと呼ばれるでしょう？
desc_en: This nunnery adjoins the Eastern Precinct of Horyu-ji and is said to have been built by Prince Shotoku for his mother. The principal image, a half-seated bodhisattva with a finger resting on its cheek and a quiet smile, is beautiful, and its smile has been called one of the three great smiling statues of the world. Together with the tranquil main hall, which seems to float on a pond, it offers a peaceful time.
quiz_en: In the language of ancient art, what kind of smile is the gentle smile of Chugu-ji's half-seated bodhisattva called?

name: 法起寺
desc: 斑鳩の里の田園にたたずむ寺で、聖徳太子ゆかりの寺院の一つです。境内に立つ三重塔は飛鳥時代に建てられ、現存する三重塔として日本最古のものとされ、国宝に指定されています。法隆寺とともに世界遺産に登録されており、秋にはコスモス畑の向こうに三重塔が見える、のどかな風景が広がります。
quiz: 法起寺の国宝の塔は、何重の塔として日本最古とされているでしょう？
desc_en: This temple stands among the farmland of the Ikaruga countryside and is one of the temples associated with Prince Shotoku. Its pagoda was built in the Asuka period and is considered the oldest surviving three-story pagoda in Japan, designated a National Treasure. It is registered as a World Heritage Site together with Horyu-ji, and in autumn a peaceful scene unfolds, with the pagoda visible beyond fields of cosmos.
quiz_en: The National Treasure pagoda at Hokki-ji is considered the oldest in Japan among pagodas with how many stories?

name: 曽爾高原
desc: 曽爾村の倶留尊山の西麓に広がる高原です。なだらかな山肌一面がススキに覆われ、秋には銀色の穂が風に揺れて波のようにきらめきます。夕方には西日を受けて黄金色に輝き、多くの人がその光景を見に訪れます。高原の中ほどにはお亀池と呼ばれる湿地もあり、春の山焼き後の若草の景色も美しいです。
quiz: 曽爾高原の山肌を秋に一面の銀色や黄金色に染め上げる植物は何でしょう？
desc_en: This highland spreads across the western foot of Mount Kuroso in Soni Village. Its gentle slopes are covered with Japanese pampas grass, and in autumn the silver plumes sway in the wind, shimmering like waves. In the evening they glow gold in the setting sun, and many people come to see the sight. In the middle of the highland is a wetland called Okame Pond, and the scenery of fresh grass after the spring burning is also beautiful.
quiz_en: What plant covers the slopes of the Soni Highlands and turns them silver and gold in the autumn?

name: 高取城跡
desc: 高取町の高取山の山頂に築かれた山城の跡で、日本三大山城の一つに数えられます。江戸時代には植村氏が城主を務め、険しい山上に広大な城郭が築かれました。今は建物は残っていませんが、苔むした高い石垣が森の中に連なり、その壮大さに圧倒されます。城下の土佐街道の町並みとあわせて歩くのがおすすめです。
quiz: 高取城は、岩村城、備中松山城と並んで何と呼ばれる城の一つでしょう？
desc_en: These are the ruins of a mountain castle built atop Mount Takatori in Takatori, counted as one of Japan's three great mountain castles. In the Edo period the Uemura clan served as lords, and a vast castle complex was built on the steep summit. No buildings remain today, but tall, moss-covered stone walls stretch through the forest, overwhelming visitors with their grandeur. Walking it together with the Tosa Kaido townscape below is recommended.
quiz_en: Along with Iwamura Castle and Bitchu Matsuyama Castle, Takatori Castle is counted among what group of castles?

name: 子嶋寺
desc: 高取町にある古刹で、平安時代の作とされる国宝の「両界曼荼羅」を伝えることで知られています。紺色の絹地に金銀泥で描かれたこの曼荼羅は「子島曼荼羅」と呼ばれ、日本の密教美術を代表する名品です。境内は落ち着いた雰囲気に包まれ、のどかな高取の町の歴史の深さを感じさせてくれます。
quiz: 子嶋寺に伝わる国宝の曼荼羅は、寺の名にちなんで何と呼ばれているでしょう？
desc_en: This historic temple in Takatori is known for preserving a National Treasure Mandala of the Two Realms, believed to date from the Heian period. Painted in gold and silver on dark blue silk, this mandala is called the "Kojima Mandala" and is a masterpiece representing Japan's esoteric Buddhist art. The grounds are wrapped in a calm atmosphere that lets you feel the depth of history in the peaceful town of Takatori.
quiz_en: Named after the temple itself, what is the National Treasure mandala preserved at Kojima-dera Temple called?

name: 光雲寺
desc: 高取町にある寺です。高取町は高取城の城下町として発展した町で、土佐街道沿いには町家や武家屋敷の面影が残ります。また、古くから「くすりの町」として知られ、置き薬の文化が根づいてきました。町歩きの途中に静かな境内を訪ねれば、城下町らしい落ち着いた空気を感じられます。
quiz: 高取町は古くから何の町として知られ、置き薬の文化が根づいてきたでしょう？
desc_en: This temple is located in Takatori. Takatori developed as the castle town of Takatori Castle, and traces of townhouses and samurai residences remain along the Tosa Kaido. It has also long been known as a "town of medicine," where the culture of okigusuri, household medicine kits, took root. If you visit the quiet grounds during a town walk, you can feel the calm atmosphere of a castle town.
quiz_en: Takatori Town has long been known as a town of what, where the culture of household medicine kits took root?

name: 橘寺
desc: 明日香村にある、聖徳太子の生誕地と伝えられる寺です。境内には、善と悪の二つの顔が彫られた「二面石」をはじめ、明日香らしい不思議な石造物が残ります。秋には周辺の田園に彼岸花が咲き、のどかな明日香の風景と古寺の組み合わせが美しく、自転車で村をめぐる旅人の立ち寄りどころとなっています。
quiz: 橘寺の境内にある、左右に善と悪の顔が彫られた石は何と呼ばれているでしょう？
desc_en: This temple in Asuka is said to be the birthplace of Prince Shotoku. Its grounds contain mysterious stone objects typical of Asuka, including the "Nimen-seki," a stone carved with two faces representing good and evil. In autumn, red spider lilies bloom in the surrounding fields, and the combination of Asuka's peaceful scenery and the old temple is beautiful, making it a stopping point for travelers touring the village by bicycle.
quiz_en: What is the name of the stone in the grounds of Tachibana-dera that has faces of good and evil carved on either side?

name: 吉野山のサクラ
desc: 吉野山は古くから桜の名所として知られ、尾根から谷にかけて約3万本ともいわれる桜が咲き誇ります。下千本、中千本、上千本、奥千本と、山の麓から上へ順に開花が進み、長い期間花見を楽しめます。桜の多くはシロヤマザクラで、修験道の本尊にささげる御神木として植えられてきた歴史があります。
quiz: 吉野山で、ひと目で千本もの桜が見渡せるほどの景色をたとえた言葉は何でしょう？
desc_en: Mount Yoshino has long been famous for cherry blossoms, with what is said to be about 30,000 trees blooming from its ridges to its valleys. The blossoms open in order from the foot of the mountain upward, through the Shimo Senbon, Naka Senbon, Kami Senbon, and Oku Senbon areas, so you can enjoy hanami over a long period. Most of the trees are Shiroyamazakura, with a history of being planted as sacred trees offered to the principal deity of Shugendo.
quiz_en: What Japanese phrase describes the view at Mount Yoshino, meaning that a thousand cherry trees can be seen at a single glance?

name: 中荘温泉
desc: 桜の名所・吉野山の麓、吉野町にある温泉です。吉野川の流れに近い山あいに位置し、静かな環境でゆったりと湯につかれます。春の花見や秋の紅葉狩りで吉野を訪れた際に立ち寄れば、山歩きの疲れが癒やされます。吉野の名物である柿の葉寿司や葛を使った菓子とともに、湯上がりのひとときを楽しめます。
quiz: 中荘温泉で温まったあと、吉野の名物で味わいたいものは何ですか？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) is located in Yoshino Town at the foot of Mount Yoshino, famous for its cherry blossoms. Set in the mountains near the Yoshino River, it lets you soak at leisure in a quiet environment. Stop by when visiting Yoshino for spring cherry blossoms or autumn leaves, and the fatigue of mountain walking will melt away. After bathing, you can enjoy Yoshino specialties such as kakinoha-zushi (sushi wrapped in persimmon leaves) and sweets made with kudzu.
quiz_en: After warming up at Nakanosho Onsen, which of Yoshino's local specialties would you like to taste?

name: 世尊寺
desc: 大淀町にある寺で、飛鳥時代の古代寺院の流れをくむとされています。境内には古代寺院の塔の礎石などが残り、その跡は国の史跡にも指定されています。吉野へ向かう道筋にあたるのどかな地域で、静かな境内を歩けば、はるか昔からこの地で受け継がれてきた祈りの歴史を感じられます。
quiz: 世尊寺の境内に残る、塔や建物の柱を支えていた大きな石を何と呼ぶでしょう？
desc_en: This temple in Oyodo is said to carry on the lineage of an ancient temple from the Asuka period. Foundation stones of the ancient temple's pagoda and other remains survive in the grounds, and the site has been designated a national historic site. It lies in a peaceful area along the route to Yoshino, and walking the quiet grounds, you can feel the long history of prayer passed down here since ancient times.
quiz_en: What is the name for the large stones that remain at Seson-ji and once supported the pillars of pagodas and buildings?

name: 瀞峡
desc: 奈良・和歌山・三重の三県にまたがる北山川の渓谷で、十津川村側からもその景観に触れられます。両岸には切り立った岩壁や奇岩が続き、深い緑色をたたえた静かな水面が「瀞」の名のとおり穏やかに広がります。国の特別名勝・天然記念物に指定され、ジェット船に乗って渓谷を進むと、迫力ある景色が間近に迫ります。
quiz: 瀞峡の「瀞」という字は、川のどんな状態を表しているでしょう？
desc_en: This gorge on the Kitayama River spans the three prefectures of Nara, Wakayama, and Mie, and its scenery can also be enjoyed from the Totsukawa side. Sheer cliffs and strange rock formations line both banks, and the still, deep-green water spreads calmly, true to the name "Doro," meaning tranquil waters. It is designated a national Special Place of Scenic Beauty and Natural Monument, and riding a jet boat through the gorge brings the dramatic scenery right up close.
quiz_en: Riding a jet boat through Dorokyo Gorge, which scenery or rock formation would you most like to see up close?

name: 十津川温泉
desc: 日本有数の面積を誇る十津川村の山あいに湧く温泉です。村内の温泉は、加水や循環をしない源泉かけ流しを宣言したことでも知られ、豊かな湯量を存分に味わえます。周辺には日本有数の長さを誇る谷瀬の吊り橋や、世界遺産の熊野参詣道小辺路が通り、山深い秘境の旅を楽しめます。
quiz: 十津川村にある、川の上を長くゆらゆらと渡る名物の吊り橋は何でしょう？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) wells up in the mountains of Totsukawa, one of Japan's largest villages by area. The village's hot springs are known for declaring themselves gensen kakenagashi, free-flowing straight from the source without added water or recirculation, so you can fully enjoy the abundant hot water. Nearby are the Tanize Suspension Bridge, one of the longest in Japan, and the Kohechi route of the World Heritage Kumano pilgrimage trails, making for a journey into a remote mountain hideaway.
quiz_en: What is the name of the famous long suspension bridge in Totsukawa Village that sways as you cross high above the river?

name: 紀伊半島森林植物公園
desc: 紀伊山地の山深い十津川村にある森林植物公園です。豊かな雨に育まれた紀伊半島の森には多様な樹木が茂り、園内の散策路では山野草や花木を観察しながら森林浴を楽しめます。新緑の季節には山々が鮮やかな緑に包まれ、深呼吸するたびに澄んだ空気が体にしみわたります。
quiz: 紀伊半島森林植物公園の森を歩くなら、あなたが見つけてみたい植物や生き物は何ですか？
desc_en: This forest botanical park lies in Totsukawa, deep in the Kii Mountains. The forests of the Kii Peninsula, nurtured by abundant rain, are home to a wide variety of trees, and on the park's trails you can enjoy forest bathing while observing wild mountain flowers and flowering trees. In the season of fresh greenery the mountains are wrapped in vivid green, and with every deep breath the clear air seems to soak into your body.
quiz_en: If you walked through the forest of Kii Peninsula Forest Botanical Park, what plants or creatures would you like to find?

name: 大台ヶ原山
desc: 奈良県と三重県の境にまたがる台地状の山で、日本有数の多雨地帯として知られます。最高峰の日出ヶ岳へは遊歩道が整備され、霧に包まれた苔むす森や、立ち枯れたトウヒが並ぶ正木ヶ原など独特の景観が広がります。断崖絶壁の大蛇嵓からは、深い谷と山並みを見下ろす迫力ある眺めが楽しめます。
quiz: 大台ヶ原にある、断崖絶壁の上から谷を見下ろせる岩場は何と呼ばれているでしょう？
desc_en: This plateau-like mountain straddles the border of Nara and Mie prefectures and is known as one of the rainiest areas in Japan. A trail leads to Mount Hidegatake, its highest peak, through unique landscapes such as moss-covered forests shrouded in mist and Masakigahara, lined with dead standing spruce trees. From the sheer cliff of Daijagura, you can enjoy a breathtaking view down over deep valleys and mountain ranges.
quiz_en: What is the name of the rocky outcrop at Odaigahara from which you can look down into the valley from a sheer cliff?

name: 小処温泉
desc: 上北山村の山奥、深い森に包まれた谷あいにひっそりと湧く温泉です。人里離れた場所にあり、まさに秘湯と呼ぶにふさわしい静けさが魅力です。周囲は清流と原生的な森に囲まれ、川のせせらぎや鳥の声を聞きながら湯につかれば、日常を忘れてくつろげます。大台ヶ原方面の旅とあわせて訪れてみてください。
quiz: 小処温泉のような山奥の秘湯で、あなたが一番楽しみにしているひとときは何ですか？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) wells up quietly in a valley wrapped in deep forest, far into the mountains of Kamikitayama. Located far from any settlement, its appeal is a tranquility that truly deserves the name hito (secret hot spring). Surrounded by clear streams and primeval forest, you can forget everyday life as you soak while listening to the murmur of the river and birdsong. Try visiting it as part of a trip toward Odaigahara.
quiz_en: At a secluded mountain hot spring like Kodokoro Onsen, what moment are you looking forward to the most?

name: 高見山
desc: 奈良県と三重県の境にそびえる、尖った山容が印象的な山です。その姿から「関西のマッターホルン」とも呼ばれ、登山者に親しまれています。冬には木々の枝が霧氷で白く覆われ、山全体が樹氷の花に包まれる光景が見られます。山頂からは台高山脈や大和の山並みを見渡す雄大な眺望が楽しめます。
quiz: 高見山の冬の名物で、木の枝に霧が凍りついて白い花のように見える現象は何でしょう？
desc_en: This mountain, rising on the border of Nara and Mie prefectures, is striking for its pointed shape. Because of its form it is also called the "Matterhorn of Kansai" and is popular with climbers. In winter, the branches of the trees are coated white with rime ice, and the whole mountain can be seen wrapped in frost flowers. From the summit, you can enjoy grand views over the Daiko Mountains and the ranges of Yamato.
quiz_en: What is the name of Mount Takami's winter phenomenon in which fog freezes onto tree branches so they look like white flowers?

name: 紀三井寺
desc: 和歌山市の名草山の中腹にある古刹で、西国三十三所観音霊場の第二番札所です。和歌山県内でもいち早く咲く早咲きの桜の名所として知られ、「近畿に春を呼ぶ寺」とも呼ばれます。急な石段を登りきると、和歌浦の海と町並みを見下ろす素晴らしい眺めが広がり、春には桜越しに海を望めます。
quiz: 紀三井寺は、観音さまを巡る西国三十三所観音霊場の第何番札所にあたるでしょう？
desc_en: This historic temple sits halfway up Mount Nagusa in Wakayama City and is a stop on the Saigoku Thirty-Three Kannon Pilgrimage. It is known for cherry trees that bloom earlier than almost anywhere else in Wakayama Prefecture and is called the "temple that brings spring to Kinki." Once you climb its steep stone steps, a wonderful view opens up over the sea of Wakanoura and the town, and in spring you can see the sea through the cherry blossoms.
quiz_en: Which numbered stop is Kimii-dera Temple on the Saigoku Thirty-Three Kannon Pilgrimage, which visits sacred sites of Kannon?

name: 養翠園
desc: 紀州藩の十代藩主・徳川治宝が造らせた大名庭園です。海水を引き入れた潮入りの池を中心とする池泉回遊式庭園で、池には三つ橋が架かり、松林の向こうに和歌浦の自然が感じられます。国の名勝に指定され、藩主の別邸として建てられた建物も残ります。松の緑と水面が織りなす穏やかな景色が広がります。
quiz: 養翠園の池のように、海水を引き入れて潮の満ち引きを取り込んだ池を何と呼ぶでしょう？
desc_en: This daimyo garden was created by order of Tokugawa Harutomi, the tenth lord of the Kishu domain. It is a strolling garden centered on a pond that draws in seawater, with three bridges across the pond and the nature of Wakanoura felt beyond the pine grove. It is designated a national Place of Scenic Beauty, and buildings constructed as the lord's villa also remain. The gentle scenery woven from green pines and the water's surface spreads before you.
quiz_en: What is the name for a pond like the one at Yosuien that draws in seawater and rises and falls with the tide?

name: 淡嶋神社
desc: 和歌山市加太の海辺に鎮座する神社で、人形供養の神社として全国に知られています。境内には全国から奉納された無数の人形や置物が並び、圧倒される光景が広がります。毎年3月3日には、ひな人形を小舟に乗せて海へ流す「雛流し」が行われ、女の子の健やかな成長を願う春の風物詩となっています。
quiz: 淡嶋神社で毎年3月3日に行われる、ひな人形を小舟に乗せて海へ送る神事を何と呼ぶでしょう？
desc_en: This shrine stands by the sea in Kada, Wakayama City, and is known throughout Japan as a shrine for memorial services for dolls. Countless dolls and figurines offered from all over the country line the grounds, creating an overwhelming sight. Every year on March 3, the "Hina Nagashi" ceremony is held, in which hina dolls are placed on small boats and sent out to sea, a springtime tradition praying for the healthy growth of girls.
quiz_en: What is the name of the ritual held every March 3 at Awashima Shrine in which hina dolls are sent out to sea on small boats?

name: 四季の郷公園
desc: 和歌山市の郊外、山あいに広がる農業体験型の公園です。季節の野菜や果物の収穫体験、動物とのふれあいなど、農と自然に触れられる催しが楽しめます。広い芝生や遊具もあり、家族連れが一日のんびりと過ごせます。園内では四季折々の花が咲き、名前のとおり季節の移ろいを感じられる場所です。
quiz: 四季の郷公園で収穫体験をするなら、あなたはどんな野菜や果物を採ってみたいですか？
desc_en: This agricultural experience park spreads across the hills on the outskirts of Wakayama City. You can enjoy activities that connect you with farming and nature, such as harvesting seasonal vegetables and fruits and interacting with animals. There are also wide lawns and play equipment, so families can spend a relaxing day here. Seasonal flowers bloom throughout the park, and true to its name, meaning "village of the four seasons," it is a place to feel the seasons change.
quiz_en: If you tried a harvesting experience at Shiki no Sato Park, which vegetables or fruits would you like to pick?

name: 和歌山北港魚釣公園
desc: 和歌山北港の海に突き出すように整備された釣り公園です。足場の良い釣り場から紀淡海峡に近い豊かな海を相手に竿を出すことができ、初心者から上級者まで気軽に釣りを楽しめます。季節によってアジやサバなどさまざまな魚が狙え、海風を受けながら水平線を眺めるだけでも心がほどけます。
quiz: 和歌山北港魚釣公園で、あなたが一番釣り上げてみたい魚は何ですか？
desc_en: This fishing park has been built so that it juts out into the sea at Wakayama North Port. From fishing spots with good footing, you can cast your line into the rich waters near the Kitan Strait, and anyone from beginners to experts can easily enjoy fishing. Depending on the season you can aim for various fish such as horse mackerel and mackerel, and simply gazing at the horizon in the sea breeze will relax your mind.
quiz_en: Which fish would you most like to reel in at the Wakayama Kitako Fishing Park, and in which season?

name: 友ヶ島
desc: 紀淡海峡に浮かぶ、沖ノ島や地ノ島などの総称で、加太港から船で渡ることができます。明治時代に築かれた砲台跡や弾薬庫が森の中に残り、レンガ造りの遺構が自然と一体化した風景は、映画の世界のようだと人気を集めています。灯台や海岸の景色も美しく、島を一周するハイキングが楽しめます。
quiz: 友ヶ島の森の中に残る、明治時代に海峡を守るために造られた遺構は何でしょう？
desc_en: Tomogashima is the collective name for islands such as Okinoshima and Jinoshima floating in the Kitan Strait, reachable by boat from Kada Port. Gun battery ruins and ammunition depots built in the Meiji era remain in the forest, and the scenery of brick remains merging with nature has become popular for looking like something out of a movie. The lighthouse and coastal views are also beautiful, and you can enjoy hiking around the island.
quiz_en: What are the remains in the forests of Tomogashima that were built in the Meiji era to defend the strait?

name: 和歌浦天満宮
desc: 景勝地として万葉の時代から歌に詠まれてきた和歌浦を見下ろす高台に鎮座する神社です。菅原道真が大宰府へ向かう途中、この地に立ち寄ったことにちなむとされ、学問の神様として受験生に親しまれています。急な石段を登りきると、和歌浦の海と町並みが一望でき、桃山時代の様式を伝える社殿も見事です。
quiz: 和歌浦天満宮にまつられ、受験生に人気の学問の神様として知られる人物は誰でしょう？
desc_en: This shrine stands on a hill overlooking Wakanoura, a scenic spot celebrated in poetry since the Man'yo era. It is said to be linked to Sugawara no Michizane stopping here on his way to Dazaifu, and it is beloved by students taking exams as a shrine to the god of learning. After climbing the steep stone steps, you can take in the sea and townscape of Wakanoura, and the shrine buildings, which convey the Momoyama-period style, are also magnificent.
quiz_en: Who is the figure enshrined at Wakaura Tenmangu, known as the god of learning and popular with students taking exams?

name: 竈山神社
desc: 和歌山市和田に鎮座する神社で、神武天皇の兄・彦五瀬命をまつります。神武東征の際に傷を負って亡くなった彦五瀬命の墓とされる竈山墓が社殿の背後にあり、古代の物語を今に伝える場所です。森に包まれた静かな境内は、地域の人々に大切に守られ、落ち着いた空気に満ちています。
quiz: 竈山神社にまつられている彦五瀬命は、どの天皇の兄とされているでしょう？
desc_en: This shrine in Wada, Wakayama City, is dedicated to Hikoitsuse no Mikoto, elder brother of Emperor Jimmu. Behind the shrine buildings is the Kamayama Tomb, said to be the grave of Hikoitsuse no Mikoto, who was wounded and died during Jimmu's eastern expedition, a place that conveys ancient stories to the present day. Wrapped in forest, the quiet grounds are carefully protected by the local community and filled with a calm atmosphere.
quiz_en: Hikoitsuse no Mikoto, the deity enshrined at Kamayama Shrine, is said to be the elder brother of which emperor?

name: 伊太祁曽神社
desc: 「木の国」と呼ばれた紀伊国の一宮で、日本に樹木の種をまいて国土を緑にしたとされる五十猛命をまつる神社です。木の神様として林業関係者などの信仰を集め、境内は豊かな木々に包まれています。厄除けのご利益でも知られ、御神木の割れ目をくぐって厄を落とす「木の俣くぐり」も人気です。
quiz: 伊太祁曽神社にまつられ、日本中に木の種をまいたとされる神様は誰でしょう？
desc_en: This is the ichinomiya (highest-ranking shrine) of Kii Province, once called the "Land of Trees," and it is dedicated to Isotakeru no Mikoto, said to have sown tree seeds across Japan to make the land green. As a god of trees he is revered by people in forestry and others, and the grounds are surrounded by lush trees. The shrine is also known for warding off misfortune, and "Ki no Mata Kuguri," crawling through a split in the sacred tree to shed bad luck, is popular.
quiz_en: Who is the deity enshrined at Itakiso Shrine who is said to have sown tree seeds all across Japan?

name: 食祭
desc: 和歌山市で開かれる、食をテーマにしたイベントです。和歌山県はみかんや梅、しらす、醤油など全国に知られる名産品が多い土地で、会場では地元の味覚を一度に楽しめます。グルメの屋台や物産の販売に多くの人が集まり、にぎやかな雰囲気の中で紀州の豊かな食文化に触れられます。
quiz: 和歌山の食のイベントで、あなたが一番味わってみたい紀州の名産は何ですか？
desc_en: This is a food-themed event held in Wakayama City. Wakayama is a land with many nationally known specialties, such as mandarin oranges, ume plums, shirasu (whitebait), and soy sauce, and at the venue you can enjoy local flavors all at once. Gourmet food stalls and local product sales draw large crowds, and in the lively atmosphere you can experience the rich food culture of Kishu.
quiz_en: At a food event in Wakayama, which Kishu specialty would you most like to taste, and how would you enjoy it?

name: 木本八幡宮に奉納の獅子舞
desc: 和歌山市の木本八幡宮で、祭礼の際に奉納される獅子舞です。地域の人々によって受け継がれてきた伝統芸能で、太鼓や笛の囃子に合わせて獅子が勇ましく舞い、厄を払い豊作や地域の安全を祈ります。獅子に頭を噛んでもらうと無病息災になるといわれ、子どもたちが獅子に近づいては歓声を上げる姿も見られます。
quiz: 獅子舞で、獅子に頭を噛んでもらうとどんなご利益があるといわれているでしょう？
name_en: Lion Dance Offered at Kimoto Hachimangu Shrine
desc_en: This lion dance is offered at Kimoto Hachimangu Shrine in Wakayama City during its festival. A traditional performing art handed down by local people, it features the lion dancing boldly to the music of drums and flutes, driving away misfortune and praying for good harvests and community safety. Having your head bitten by the lion is said to bring good health, and children can be seen approaching the lion and shrieking with delight.
quiz_en: In the lion dance, what blessing is it said you receive when the lion bites your head?

name: 藤白神社
desc: 熊野古道の紀伊路沿いに鎮座する神社で、熊野九十九王子の中でも格式の高い五体王子の一つ「藤白王子」の跡とされます。全国の鈴木姓の発祥の地とされ、境内には鈴木屋敷が残ります。また、飛鳥時代の悲劇の皇子・有間皇子ゆかりの地としても知られ、熊野詣の歴史と物語を伝えています。
quiz: 藤白神社は、日本で特に多い名字の一つの発祥の地とされています。その名字は何でしょう？
desc_en: This shrine stands along the Kiiji route of the Kumano Kodo and is said to be the site of Fujishiro Oji, one of the five highest-ranking of the many Kumano Oji subsidiary shrines. It is regarded as the birthplace of the Suzuki family name nationwide, and the Suzuki residence remains in the grounds. It is also known as a place connected to Prince Arima, a tragic prince of the Asuka period, conveying the history and stories of the Kumano pilgrimage.
quiz_en: Fujishiro Shrine is said to be the birthplace of one of Japan's most common family names. Which name is it?

name: 長保寺
desc: 海南市下津町の山あいにある古刹で、紀州徳川家の菩提寺として知られます。鎌倉時代から南北朝時代に建てられた本堂・多宝塔・大門がそろって国宝に指定されており、一つの寺にこれだけの国宝建築が残るのは貴重です。裏山には歴代藩主の墓所が広がり、厳かな雰囲気に包まれています。
quiz: 長保寺は、江戸時代に徳川御三家のうち、どの徳川家の菩提寺とされたでしょう？
desc_en: This historic temple in the mountains of Shimotsu-cho, Kainan, is known as the family temple of the Kishu Tokugawa clan. Its main hall, Tahoto pagoda, and great gate, built between the Kamakura and Nanboku-cho periods, are all designated National Treasures, and it is rare for so many National Treasure buildings to survive at one temple. The hill behind holds the graves of successive domain lords, wrapped in a solemn atmosphere.
quiz_en: In the Edo period, Choho-ji became the family temple of which branch of the three main Tokugawa houses?

name: わんぱく公園
desc: 海南市の丘陵地にある、子どもたちが思いきり体を動かして遊べる公園です。大型の遊具や広い芝生広場があり、休日には家族連れでにぎわいます。高台からは海南の町並みや海を望むことができ、ピクニックや散策にもぴったりです。季節の花を眺めながら、のびのびと一日を過ごせます。
quiz: わんぱく公園で子どもの頃に戻るなら、あなたが一番遊んでみたい遊具は何ですか？
desc_en: This park on the hills of Kainan is a place where children can run around and play to their hearts' content. With large play equipment and a wide lawn, it bustles with families on weekends and holidays. From the heights you can see the townscape of Kainan and the sea, making it perfect for picnics and walks. You can spend a carefree day here while admiring the seasonal flowers.
quiz_en: If you could become a child again at Wanpaku Park, which piece of play equipment would you most want to try?

name: 温山荘園
desc: 海南市の海辺にある、大正から昭和初期にかけて造られた庭園です。海水を引き込んだ潮入りの池を中心に、数寄屋造りの建物や茶室が配され、庭園は国の名勝に指定されています。潮の満ち引きで表情を変える池と、松の緑、建物が調和した美しい景観をゆっくりと堪能できます。
quiz: 温山荘園の池が潮の満ち引きで水位を変えるのは、池に何を取り入れているからでしょう？
desc_en: This garden by the sea in Kainan was created from the Taisho era to the early Showa era. Centered on a pond that draws in seawater, it features sukiya-style buildings and tea rooms, and the garden is designated a national Place of Scenic Beauty. You can take your time savoring the beautiful harmony of the pond, which changes with the tides, the green of the pines, and the buildings.
quiz_en: The water level of the pond at Onzanso Garden changes with the tides because the pond takes in what?

name: 紀文まつり
desc: みかんの産地として知られる有田市で開かれる祭りです。名前は、江戸時代に紀州みかんを江戸へ運んで財を成したと伝わる豪商・紀伊国屋文左衛門にちなみます。祭りでは踊りやパレードが町を彩り、地域の人々が一体となって盛り上がります。有田みかんの里らしい明るく活気ある雰囲気を楽しめます。
quiz: 紀文まつりの名前の由来となった、紀州みかんで財を成したと伝わる商人は誰でしょう？
desc_en: This festival is held in Arida, a city known for growing mandarin oranges. Its name comes from Kinokuniya Bunzaemon, a wealthy merchant said to have made his fortune in the Edo period by shipping Kishu mandarins to Edo. During the festival, dances and parades brighten the town, and local people come together to celebrate. You can enjoy the cheerful, lively atmosphere of this home of Arida mandarins.
quiz_en: Who was the merchant, said to have made his fortune from Kishu mandarins, after whom the Kibun Festival is named?

name: 御坊祭
desc: 御坊市の小竹八幡神社の秋の例大祭で、御坊の町を挙げて行われる大きな祭りです。各地区から四つ太鼓や獅子舞、幟などが繰り出し、町は終日にぎわいます。なかでも、子どもたちが雀の装いをして踊る「雀踊り」は祭りを象徴する伝統芸能です。御坊の町が熱気と笑顔に包まれる、地元の誇りの祭りです。
quiz: 御坊祭で披露される、軽やかに跳ねる鳥の姿をまねた踊りは何と呼ばれているでしょう？
desc_en: This is the annual autumn festival of Obata Hachiman Shrine in Gobo, a major event involving the whole town. Yotsu-daiko drum floats, lion dances, and banners set out from each district, and the town bustles all day long. Above all, the "Suzume Odori," in which children dress as sparrows and dance, is the traditional performing art that symbolizes the festival. It is a festival the locals are proud of, filling the town of Gobo with excitement and smiles.
quiz_en: What is the name of the dance performed at the Gobo Festival that imitates the lightly hopping movements of a bird?

name: 熊野本宮大社
desc: 全国に数千社ある熊野神社の総本宮で、熊野三山の一つです。世界遺産「紀伊山地の霊場と参詣道」に含まれ、熊野古道を歩いてたどり着く参詣者を迎えます。かつて社殿があった熊野川の中州・大斎原には日本最大級の大鳥居がそびえ、境内では神の使いとされる八咫烏の姿を描いたお札やポストも見られます。
quiz: 熊野本宮大社で神の使いとされる、三本の足を持つカラスを何と呼ぶでしょう？
desc_en: This is the head shrine of the thousands of Kumano shrines across Japan and one of the three grand shrines of Kumano. It is part of the World Heritage Site "Sacred Sites and Pilgrimage Routes in the Kii Mountain Range" and welcomes pilgrims who arrive on foot along the Kumano Kodo. At Oyunohara, a sandbar in the Kumano River where the shrine once stood, rises one of Japan's largest torii gates, and talismans and a mailbox feature Yatagarasu, regarded as a messenger of the gods.
quiz_en: What is the name of the three-legged crow regarded as a messenger of the gods at Kumano Hongu Taisha?

name: 湯の峰温泉のつぼ湯と湯筒
desc: 熊野本宮大社の近く、谷あいの湯の峰温泉は日本最古の湯ともいわれる温泉です。川岸の小屋の中にある「つぼ湯」は、一日に何度も湯の色が変わると伝わり、世界遺産に登録された温泉として知られます。川沿いの湯筒では、湧き出す高温の源泉で卵や野菜を茹でる「湯筒料理」を楽しめます。
quiz: 湯の峰温泉にある、世界遺産の一部として登録されている小さな岩風呂は何と呼ばれているでしょう？
name_en: Tsuboyu and Yuzutsu of Yunomine Onsen
desc_en: Yunomine Onsen, in a valley near Kumano Hongu Taisha, is said to be one of the oldest hot springs in Japan. Tsuboyu, inside a small hut on the riverbank, is said to change color several times a day and is known as a hot spring registered as part of a World Heritage Site. At the Yuzutsu by the river, you can enjoy "yuzutsu cooking," boiling eggs and vegetables in the scalding spring water that gushes out.
quiz_en: What is the name of the small rock bath at Yunomine Onsen that is registered as part of a World Heritage Site?

name: 紀州備長炭記念公園
desc: 良質な紀州備長炭のふるさと、田辺市秋津川にある公園です。園内には備長炭の歴史や製法を紹介する展示施設があり、炭焼き窯の見学や炭焼き体験もできます。ウバメガシを高温で焼き上げる紀州備長炭は、硬く火持ちが良いことから料理人に重宝されています。山里の静かな空気の中で、炭文化に触れられます。
quiz: 紀州備長炭の主な原料として使われる、硬くて丈夫な木は何でしょう？
desc_en: This park is located in Akitsugawa, Tanabe, the home of high-quality Kishu binchotan charcoal. It has an exhibition facility introducing the history and production methods of binchotan, and you can tour a charcoal kiln and try charcoal making yourself. Kishu binchotan, made by firing ubame oak at high temperatures, is prized by chefs because it is hard and burns for a long time. In the quiet air of the mountain village, you can encounter charcoal culture.
quiz_en: What hard, sturdy type of tree is mainly used as the raw material for making Kishu binchotan charcoal?

name: 高山寺
desc: 田辺市の市街地を見下ろす高台にある寺です。境内には、田辺で後半生を過ごした博物学者・南方熊楠の墓があり、多くの人が訪れます。また、合気道の創始者・植芝盛平も田辺出身で、この寺に墓所があります。会津川の流れや田辺の町並みを見渡しながら、郷土の偉人たちに思いを馳せられる場所です。
quiz: 高山寺に眠る、粘菌の研究などで知られる田辺ゆかりの博物学者は誰でしょう？
desc_en: This temple stands on a hill overlooking central Tanabe. Its grounds hold the grave of the naturalist Kumagusu Minakata, who spent the latter half of his life in Tanabe, and many people come to visit it. Morihei Ueshiba, the founder of aikido, was also from Tanabe, and his grave is at this temple too. Looking out over the Aizu River and the townscape of Tanabe, it is a place to reflect on the great figures of the region.
quiz_en: Who is the naturalist with ties to Tanabe, known for research on slime molds, who rests at Kozan-ji Temple?

name: 奇絶峡
desc: 田辺市上秋津、右会津川の上流に続く渓谷です。巨大な岩が折り重なる谷を清流が勢いよく流れ、その名のとおり絶景と呼ぶにふさわしい荒々しい景観が広がります。岩肌に刻まれた磨崖仏や小さな滝もあり、渓谷沿いを散策しながら自然と信仰の跡に触れられます。秋には紅葉が岩と水を彩り、一段と美しくなります。
quiz: 奇絶峡の巨岩と清流、あなたは新緑と紅葉のどちらの季節に訪れてみたいですか？
desc_en: This gorge stretches along the upper reaches of the Migi-Aizu River in Kamiakizu, Tanabe. A clear stream rushes through a valley of piled-up giant rocks, creating a rugged landscape that truly deserves to be called spectacular, as its name suggests. There are also Buddhist images carved into the rock face and small waterfalls, so you can encounter both nature and traces of faith while walking along the gorge. In autumn, colorful leaves adorn the rocks and water, making it even more beautiful.
quiz_en: To see the giant rocks and clear stream of Kizetsukyo Gorge, would you rather visit in fresh green or autumn leaves?

name: 新庄総合公園
desc: 田辺市の丘陵に広がる総合公園です。運動施設や広々とした芝生広場、遊具などが整い、スポーツやピクニックを楽しむ市民の憩いの場となっています。高台からは田辺湾や市街地を見渡すことができ、海と山に囲まれた田辺の地形がよくわかります。季節の花を眺めながら、気持ちよく体を動かせる場所です。
quiz: 新庄総合公園の高台から田辺湾を眺めながら、あなたがしたい過ごし方は何ですか？
desc_en: This general park spreads across the hills of Tanabe. Equipped with sports facilities, a spacious lawn, and play equipment, it is a place where citizens relax while enjoying sports and picnics. From the heights you can look out over Tanabe Bay and the city, getting a clear sense of Tanabe's landscape surrounded by sea and mountains. It is a pleasant place to get some exercise while admiring the seasonal flowers.
quiz_en: While looking out over Tanabe Bay from the heights of Shinjo General Park, how would you like to spend your time?

name: 龍神温泉
desc: 紀伊山地の山深く、日高川の上流に湧く温泉です。島根の湯の川温泉、群馬の川中温泉とともに「日本三美人の湯」の一つに数えられ、とろりとした肌触りの湯が特徴です。弘法大師が開いたという伝説も残ります。川沿いに旅館が並ぶ静かな温泉街で、渓谷の緑や紅葉を眺めながら湯につかれます。
quiz: 龍神温泉は、湯の川温泉・川中温泉とともに何と呼ばれる温泉の一つでしょう？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) wells up deep in the Kii Mountains along the upper Hidaka River. Together with Yunokawa Onsen in Shimane and Kawanaka Onsen in Gunma, it is counted among Japan's three "hot springs of beauty," and its water is known for its silky feel on the skin. A legend also says it was founded by Kobo Daishi. It is a quiet hot spring town with inns lining the river, where you can soak while viewing the green or autumn colors of the gorge.
quiz_en: Together with Yunokawa Onsen and Kawanaka Onsen, Ryujin Onsen is counted as one of what group of hot springs?

name: 翔龍祭
desc: 田辺市龍神村で開かれる、村の名にちなんだ祭りです。龍神村は紀伊山地の山あいに位置し、日高川の清流と豊かな森林、そして名湯・龍神温泉で知られます。祭りの日には地域の人々や訪れた人々が集い、山里ならではの温かなもてなしの中で、にぎやかなひとときを過ごせます。
quiz: 龍神村の祭りに参加したら、あなたが味わってみたい山里の味は何ですか？
desc_en: This festival, held in Ryujin Village, Tanabe, takes its theme from the village's name, which means "dragon god." Ryujin Village lies in the mountains of the Kii range and is known for the clear Hidaka River, rich forests, and the famous Ryujin Onsen hot spring. On festival day, local people and visitors gather, and amid the warm hospitality unique to a mountain village, you can enjoy a lively time together.
quiz_en: If you took part in the festival in Ryujin Village, which flavors of the mountain village would you like to try?

name: 熊野速玉大社
desc: 熊野川の河口近く、新宮市に鎮座する熊野三山の一つです。朱塗りの鮮やかな社殿が印象的で、境内には平安時代の平重盛の手植えと伝わる梛の大木があり、国の天然記念物に指定されています。もとは近くの神倉山の巨岩・ゴトビキ岩にまつられていた神を迎えたとされ、毎年2月には神倉神社で勇壮な御燈祭が行われます。
quiz: 熊野速玉大社の境内にそびえる、国の天然記念物に指定されたご神木は何の木でしょう？
desc_en: Located in Shingu near the mouth of the Kumano River, this is one of the Kumano Sanzan, the three grand shrines of Kumano. Its vivid vermilion buildings are striking, and the grounds hold a large nagi tree said to have been planted by Taira no Shigemori in the Heian period, designated a national Natural Monument. The deities are said to have been welcomed from Gotobiki-iwa, a giant rock on nearby Mount Kamikura, and every February the spirited Oto Matsuri fire festival is held at Kamikura Shrine.
quiz_en: What kind of tree is the sacred tree in the grounds of Kumano Hayatama Taisha that is designated a national Natural Monument?

name: 瀞峡
desc: 熊野川の支流・北山川の中流に続く峡谷で、新宮市の熊野川町から上流へと続きます。上流から奥瀞、上瀞、下瀞（瀞八丁）と呼ばれ、特に瀞八丁は両岸に高い岩壁が迫り、エメラルド色の静かな水面が続く景勝地です。ジェット船で川をさかのぼれば、巨岩や奇岩が次々と現れ、深い谷の神秘に包まれます。
quiz: 瀞峡のうち、両岸に岩壁が迫り特に美しいとされる下瀞の区間は何と呼ばれているでしょう？
desc_en: This gorge runs along the middle reaches of the Kitayama River, a tributary of the Kumano River, continuing upstream from Kumanogawa-cho in Shingu. From upstream, its sections are called Okudoro, Kamidoro, and Shimodoro, and Shimodoro in particular is a scenic spot where tall cliffs close in on both banks and the calm, emerald-colored water flows on. Travel upriver by jet boat, and giant and curious rocks appear one after another as you are wrapped in the mystery of the deep valley.
quiz_en: In Dorokyo Gorge, what is the name of the Shimodoro section, considered especially beautiful, where cliffs close in on both banks?

name: 徐福公園
desc: 新宮市の駅前にある、徐福をまつる公園です。徐福は中国の秦の始皇帝の命を受け、不老不死の霊薬を求めて海を渡り、この地にたどり着いたと伝えられています。中国風の鮮やかな楼門が目を引き、園内には徐福の墓とされる碑や、天台烏薬と呼ばれる霊薬の木が植えられています。
quiz: 徐福が始皇帝の命を受けて探し求めたとされる、不老不死の何でしょう？
desc_en: This park in front of Shingu Station is dedicated to Xu Fu, known in Japan as Jofuku. Jofuku is said to have crossed the sea on the orders of Qin Shi Huang, the First Emperor of China, in search of an elixir of immortality, and to have arrived here. A vivid Chinese-style gate catches the eye, and the park contains a monument said to be Jofuku's grave as well as tendai-uyaku trees, regarded as a miraculous medicine.
quiz_en: On the orders of the First Emperor, what kind of elixir granting eternal life is Jofuku said to have searched for?

name: 神通温泉
desc: 紀の川市の山あいにある温泉です。紀の川市は桃や柿などの果物の産地として知られ、のどかな果樹園の風景が広がります。山の緑に囲まれた静かな環境で、ゆっくりと湯につかって日頃の疲れを癒やせます。湯上がりには、季節の果物や地元の味覚を味わいながら、紀の川の里の穏やかな時間を楽しめます。
quiz: 紀の川市で温泉に入ったあと、味わってみたい旬の果物は何ですか？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) is located in the mountains of Kinokawa. Kinokawa is known for producing fruits such as peaches and persimmons, and peaceful orchard scenery spreads across the area. In a quiet setting surrounded by green mountains, you can soak at leisure and soothe your daily fatigue. After bathing, you can enjoy a relaxing time in the Kinokawa countryside while tasting seasonal fruit and local flavors.
quiz_en: After a soak at a hot spring in Kinokawa City, which seasonal fruit would you most like to taste?

name: 龍門山温泉
desc: 紀の川市の龍門山の麓にある温泉です。龍門山はその美しい山容から「紀州富士」とも呼ばれ、登山者に親しまれています。山歩きのあとに汗を流せる温泉として人気があり、紀の川の流れる平野と山の景色に囲まれて心身ともにくつろげます。周辺は果樹園が広がり、季節ごとにさまざまな果物が実ります。
quiz: 龍門山温泉の近くにそびえる龍門山は、その姿から何という愛称で呼ばれているでしょう？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) lies at the foot of Mount Ryumon in Kinokawa. Mount Ryumon, called "Kishu Fuji" for its beautiful shape, is popular with hikers. The hot spring is a favorite place to wash off the sweat after a mountain walk, and surrounded by the plains of the Kinokawa River and mountain scenery, you can relax body and mind. Orchards spread around the area, bearing various fruits each season.
quiz_en: Because of its beautiful shape, what nickname is given to Mount Ryumon, which rises near Ryumonzan Onsen?

name: 粉河寺
desc: 紀の川市粉河にある、西国三十三所観音霊場の第三番札所の古刹です。寺の創建の由来を描いた国宝「粉河寺縁起絵巻」を伝えることでも知られています。巨大な本堂は西国霊場の中でも屈指の規模を誇り、本堂前には石組みが見事な庭園があり国の名勝に指定されています。門前町の風情も味わえます。
quiz: 粉河寺に伝わる、寺の創建の由来を描いた国宝の絵巻は何と呼ばれているでしょう？
desc_en: This historic temple in Kokawa, Kinokawa, is the third stop on the Saigoku Thirty-Three Kannon Pilgrimage. It is also known for preserving a National Treasure picture scroll depicting the story of the temple's founding. Its huge main hall is one of the largest among the Saigoku pilgrimage temples, and in front of it lies a garden with magnificent stonework designated a national Place of Scenic Beauty. You can also enjoy the atmosphere of the temple town.
quiz_en: What is the name of the National Treasure picture scroll at Kokawa-dera that depicts the story of the temple's founding?

name: 長田観音
desc: 紀の川市にある、厄除けの観音さまとして古くから信仰を集める寺です。厄年を迎えた人をはじめ、新年には特に多くの参拝者が訪れ、厄除けの祈願をする姿が見られます。周囲は紀の川流域の穏やかな田園と山並みに囲まれ、地域の人々に大切に守られてきた観音信仰の温かな雰囲気が伝わります。
quiz: 長田観音へ厄除けのお参りに来る人が特に多くなるのは、一年のうちいつ頃でしょう？
desc_en: This temple in Kinokawa has long been revered for its Kannon, who protects against misfortune. Many worshippers, including those reaching their yakudoshi (unlucky years), visit to pray for protection, especially at New Year. The temple is surrounded by the gentle farmland and mountains of the Kinokawa River basin, and you can feel the warm atmosphere of Kannon worship carefully preserved by the local community.
quiz_en: At what time of year do especially large numbers of people visit Nagata Kannon to pray for protection from misfortune?

name: 粉河祭
desc: 紀の川市粉河の夏を彩る祭りで、粉河寺の鎮守とされる粉河産土神社の祭礼です。各地区から豪華な山車（だんじり）が繰り出し、笛や太鼓の囃子とともに門前町を練り歩きます。紀州を代表する夏祭りの一つで、提灯に照らされた山車が夜の町を進む光景は、見る人の心を高揚させます。
quiz: 粉河祭で門前町を練り歩く、飾り立てられた山車のことを地元では何と呼ぶでしょう？
desc_en: This festival brightens summer in Kokawa, Kinokawa, and is the annual rite of Kokawa Ubusuna Shrine, regarded as the guardian shrine of Kokawa-dera. Gorgeous floats set out from each district and parade through the temple town to the music of flutes and drums. It is one of Kishu's leading summer festivals, and the sight of lantern-lit floats moving through the town at night lifts the hearts of all who see it.
quiz_en: What do locals call the decorated floats that parade through the temple town during the Kokawa Festival?

name: 紀州根来寺かくばん祭り
desc: 新義真言宗の総本山・根来寺で行われる、宗祖・興教大師覚鑁にちなむ祭りです。根来寺は戦国時代には僧兵を擁して一大勢力を誇り、境内には国宝の大塔がそびえます。祭りでは法要や催しが行われ、多くの人々が境内に集います。紅葉の名所としても知られ、歴史ある伽藍を巡る散策も楽しめます。
quiz: 根来寺にそびえる国宝の大塔は、どんな形式の仏塔として知られているでしょう？
desc_en: This festival, held at Negoro-ji, head temple of the Shingi Shingon school, honors its founder Kogyo Daishi Kakuban. In the Sengoku period Negoro-ji was a major power with its own warrior monks, and its National Treasure Great Pagoda towers over the grounds. During the festival, Buddhist services and events are held, drawing many people to the grounds. The temple is also known for autumn leaves, and you can enjoy strolling around its historic buildings.
quiz_en: The National Treasure Great Pagoda at Negoro-ji is known as a Buddhist pagoda of which architectural type?

name: 生石高原県立自然公園
desc: 紀美野町と有田川町にまたがる生石ヶ峰一帯の県立自然公園です。山頂付近にはススキの草原が広がり、秋には一面が銀色の穂に覆われて関西有数のススキの名所となります。晴れた日には紀伊水道や四国の山並みまで見渡せ、山焼きで保たれてきた雄大な草原の景色の中で、爽快な散策を楽しめます。
quiz: 生石高原の草原を守るため、春先に枯れ草を焼き払う行事を何と呼ぶでしょう？
desc_en: This prefectural natural park covers the area around Mount Oishigamine, spanning Kimino and Aridagawa towns. Near the summit spreads a grassland of Japanese pampas grass, and in autumn it is covered in silver plumes, making it one of the finest pampas grass spots in Kansai. On clear days you can see as far as the Kii Channel and the mountains of Shikoku, and you can enjoy a refreshing walk amid the grand grassland maintained by controlled burning.
quiz_en: What is the name of the event held in early spring to burn off dead grass in order to preserve the Oishi Kogen grassland?

name: かつらぎ公園
addr: かつらぎ町大字丁ノ町2530-10
desc: かつらぎ町の高台にある公園で、春には園内が桜に包まれる花見の名所です。眼下には紀の川がゆったりと流れ、対岸の山並みや柿畑の広がる町並みを一望できます。かつらぎ町は柿や桃などの果物の産地として知られ、公園からの眺めには実り豊かな里の風景が広がっています。
quiz: かつらぎ公園から紀の川を見下ろしながら、あなたが楽しみたいお花見のお供は何ですか？
desc_en: This park on a hill in Katsuragi Town is a famous cherry-blossom viewing spot, with the grounds wrapped in blossoms in spring. Below, the Kinokawa River flows gently, and you can take in the mountains on the far bank and the townscape dotted with persimmon orchards. Katsuragi is known for growing fruits such as persimmons and peaches, and the view from the park reveals the landscape of a bountiful countryside.
quiz_en: While looking down on the Kinokawa River from Katsuragi Park, what food or drink would you bring for cherry-blossom viewing?

name: 丹生都比売神社
desc: かつらぎ町上天野の山上の盆地に鎮座する紀伊国一宮で、世界遺産「紀伊山地の霊場と参詣道」の構成資産です。空海が高野山を開く際、この社の神から神領を授かったと伝わり、高野山と深い結びつきを持ちます。朱塗りの輪橋と呼ばれる太鼓橋を渡ると、極彩色の楼門と本殿が現れ、山里の静けさの中で神々しい雰囲気に包まれます。
quiz: 丹生都比売神社の入口に架かる、大きく弧を描いた朱塗りの太鼓橋は何と呼ばれているでしょう？
desc_en: This is the ichinomiya (highest-ranking shrine) of Kii Province, located in a mountaintop basin in Kamiamano, Katsuragi, and a component of the World Heritage Site "Sacred Sites and Pilgrimage Routes in the Kii Mountain Range." When Kukai founded Mount Koya, the shrine's deity is said to have granted him the land, giving it deep ties to Koyasan. Cross the vermilion arched bridge called Rinkyo to reach the richly colored gate and main sanctuary, wrapped in a divine atmosphere amid mountain village quiet.
quiz_en: What is the name of the vermilion arched bridge with a great curve that spans the entrance to Niutsuhime Shrine?

name: 真田まつり
desc: 関ヶ原の戦いのあと、真田昌幸・信繁（幸村）父子が蟄居生活を送った九度山町で行われる祭りです。真田家にちなむ武者行列が町を練り歩き、赤い甲冑に身を包んだ一行が真田の勇姿をよみがえらせます。町には真田庵や真田ミュージアムなどゆかりの地も多く、戦国ファンにはたまらない一日となります。
quiz: 真田まつりの武者行列でもおなじみ、真田家の家紋として知られる六つの銭の紋は何でしょう？
desc_en: This festival is held in Kudoyama, where Sanada Masayuki and his son Nobushige (Yukimura) lived in confinement after the Battle of Sekigahara. A samurai procession honoring the Sanada family parades through the town, and the participants, clad in red armor, bring the valiant Sanada warriors back to life. The town has many related sites, such as Sanada-an and the Sanada Museum, making it an irresistible day for fans of the Sengoku period.
quiz_en: Familiar from the Sanada Festival's samurai procession, what is the Sanada family crest made up of six coins called?

name: 大収穫祭
desc: 九度山町で開かれる、実りの季節を祝う催しです。九度山町は富有柿の産地として知られ、秋になると山の斜面の柿畑が橙色の実で彩られます。会場には地元でとれた農産物や加工品が並び、生産者との会話を楽しみながら旬の味覚を手に入れられます。高野山への玄関口でもある町の、豊かな秋を感じられます。
quiz: 九度山町が産地として知られ、秋に山の斜面を橙色に彩る果物は何でしょう？
desc_en: This event in Kudoyama celebrates the season of harvest. Kudoyama is known for growing Fuyu persimmons, and in autumn the orchards on the mountain slopes are colored with orange fruit. Local farm produce and processed goods line the venue, and you can pick up seasonal flavors while chatting with the producers. You can feel the bountiful autumn of this town, which is also a gateway to Mount Koya.
quiz_en: Which fruit, for which Kudoyama Town is known, colors the mountain slopes orange in the autumn?

name: 玉川峡
desc: 高野山を源とする丹生川が、九度山町の山あいに刻んだ渓谷です。透明度の高い清流が大小の岩の間を流れ、深い淵や瀬が次々と現れます。夏には川遊びやキャンプを楽しむ人々でにぎわい、秋には両岸の木々が色づいて渓谷を彩ります。高野山への道すがら、自然のままの清らかな流れに触れられる場所です。
quiz: 玉川峡の透き通った清流で、あなたが夏にやってみたい川遊びや過ごし方は何ですか？
desc_en: This gorge was carved into the mountains of Kudoyama by the Nyu River, which originates on Mount Koya. The highly transparent stream flows between rocks large and small, with deep pools and rapids appearing one after another. In summer it bustles with people enjoying river play and camping, and in autumn the trees on both banks change color and adorn the gorge. On the way to Mount Koya, it is a place to experience a clear, unspoiled stream.
quiz_en: In the crystal-clear stream of Tamagawa Gorge, what kind of river play or pastime would you like to try in summer?

name: 高野山の宿坊の精進料理
desc: 真言密教の聖地・高野山では、宿坊に泊まって修行僧と同じ精進料理を味わえます。肉や魚を使わず、野菜や豆、穀物などで仕立てた料理は、素材の持ち味を生かした滋味深い味わいです。高野山の名物・ごま豆腐や高野豆腐が膳に並び、静かな寺の一室でいただく食事は、心まで清められるような体験です。
quiz: 高野山の精進料理に欠かせない、ごまと葛を練り上げてつくる名物は何でしょう？
desc_en: On Mount Koya, the sacred center of Shingon esoteric Buddhism, you can stay at shukubo (temple lodgings) and eat the same shojin ryori (Buddhist vegetarian cuisine) as the training monks. Made without meat or fish, using vegetables, beans, and grains, the dishes draw out the natural flavors of the ingredients and have a deep, nourishing taste. Koyasan specialties such as goma-dofu and koya-dofu line the tray, and eating in a quiet temple room feels like an experience that purifies even the heart.
quiz_en: What is the Koyasan specialty, essential to its shojin cuisine, made by kneading together sesame and kudzu starch?

name: 二の丸温泉
desc: 醤油発祥の地として知られる湯浅町の山あいにある温泉です。湯浅の町には醤油蔵の並ぶ古い町並みが残り、国の重要伝統的建造物群保存地区に選定されています。町歩きで醤油づくりの歴史に触れたあと、温泉でゆったりと体を休めれば、紀州の旅がいっそう充実したものになります。
quiz: 二の丸温泉のある湯浅町が発祥の地として知られる、日本の食卓に欠かせない調味料は何でしょう？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) lies in the mountains of Yuasa, known as the birthplace of a key Japanese seasoning. The town of Yuasa retains an old townscape lined with brewery storehouses and has been selected as a national Important Preservation District for Groups of Traditional Buildings. After learning about the history of brewing on a town walk, rest your body at leisure in the hot spring, and your trip to Kishu will be even more fulfilling.
quiz_en: Which seasoning, essential to Japanese dining tables, is Yuasa Town, home of Ninomaru Onsen, known as the birthplace of?

name: 生石高原
desc: 有田川町側から登ることもできる生石高原は、生石ヶ峰の山頂付近に広がる草原です。ススキの穂が秋風に揺れる景色が有名で、夕暮れ時には草原全体が黄金色に輝きます。山頂からは有田川流域の山々や、晴れた日には遠く海まで見渡せます。夜は空気が澄み、星空観察の場所としても親しまれています。
quiz: 生石高原で夕暮れのススキ野原を眺めたあと、あなたはどんな夜を過ごしたいですか？
desc_en: Oishi Kogen, which can also be climbed from the Aridagawa side, is a grassland spreading near the summit of Mount Oishigamine. It is famous for the sight of pampas grass plumes swaying in the autumn wind, and at dusk the whole grassland glows gold. From the summit you can see the mountains of the Arida River basin and, on clear days, as far as the distant sea. At night the air is clear, and it is also popular as a place for stargazing.
quiz_en: After watching the pampas grass fields of Oishi Kogen at dusk, how would you like to spend the night there?

name: かなや明恵峡温泉
desc: 有田川町の有田川のほとりにある温泉です。名前にある「明恵」は、この地で生まれた鎌倉時代の高僧・明恵上人にちなみます。川沿いの静かな環境で、清流の眺めとともにゆったりと湯につかれます。有田川流域はみかんの産地として知られ、山の斜面に広がるみかん畑が温泉への道中を彩ります。
quiz: かなや明恵峡温泉の名前の由来となった、この地で生まれた鎌倉時代の高僧は誰でしょう？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) sits on the banks of the Arida River in Aridagawa. The "Myoe" in its name comes from a renowned Kamakura-period monk who was born in this area. In a quiet riverside setting, you can soak at leisure while viewing the clear stream. The Arida River basin is known for growing mandarin oranges, and orchards spreading across the mountain slopes add color to the journey to the hot spring.
quiz_en: Who was the renowned Kamakura-period monk born in this area, from whom Kanaya Myoekyo Onsen takes its name?

name: 二川温泉
desc: 有田川町の上流、清水地域の山あいにある温泉です。有田川の清流に沿った静かな場所で、四季折々の山の景色を眺めながら湯につかれます。周辺は豊かな自然が残り、夏の川遊びや秋の紅葉狩りの拠点にもぴったりです。都会の喧騒を離れた山里で、のんびりと過ごす時間が心と体を癒やしてくれます。
quiz: 二川温泉のような山里の温泉に泊まったら、あなたが夕食に期待したい料理は何ですか？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) is located in the mountains of the Shimizu area, along the upper Arida River. In a quiet spot beside the clear river, you can soak while viewing mountain scenery that changes through the seasons. Rich nature remains in the surrounding area, making it a perfect base for river play in summer and leaf viewing in autumn. Spending relaxed time in a mountain village far from the bustle of the city soothes both mind and body.
quiz_en: If you stayed at a mountain village hot spring like Futakawa Onsen, what dishes would you hope for at dinner?

name: 白崎海洋公園
desc: 由良町の白崎海岸に広がる海洋公園です。白く輝く石灰岩の岩肌と、青く澄んだ海とのコントラストが美しく、「日本のエーゲ海」とも呼ばれます。展望台からは白い岩が連なる独特の海岸線と紀伊水道が一望でき、キャンプ場やダイビングスポットもあります。夕日に染まる白い岩も見事です。
quiz: 白い石灰岩と青い海が美しい白崎海岸は、ヨーロッパのどの海にたとえられているでしょう？
desc_en: This ocean park spreads along the Shirasaki coast in Yura. The contrast between the gleaming white limestone rocks and the clear blue sea is beautiful, earning the area comparisons to a famous European sea. From the observation deck you can take in the unique coastline of white rocks and the Kii Channel, and there is also a campground and diving spots. The white rocks dyed by the setting sun are also spectacular.
quiz_en: The Shirasaki coast, with its white limestone and blue sea, has been compared to which sea in Europe?

name: 由良海つり公園
desc: 由良町の穏やかな由良湾に面した海釣り公園です。足場の整った釣り場から、初心者や家族連れでも安心して釣りを楽しめます。湾の周囲は緑の山に囲まれ、波の静かな海面が広がる景色にも癒やされます。季節ごとにさまざまな魚が釣れ、のんびりと糸を垂らしながら海辺の時間を満喫できます。
quiz: 由良海つり公園の穏やかな海で、あなたが釣ってみたい魚は何ですか？
desc_en: This sea fishing park faces the calm Yura Bay in Yura. From well-built fishing platforms, even beginners and families can enjoy fishing with peace of mind. The bay is surrounded by green mountains, and the view of the gentle, quiet sea is soothing in itself. Various fish can be caught each season, and you can make the most of your time by the sea while leisurely dangling your line.
quiz_en: In the calm waters of the Yura Sea Fishing Park, which fish would you most like to try to catch?

name: 鶴の湯温泉
desc: 梅の里として知られるみなべ町の山あいにある温泉です。みなべ町は日本一の梅の産地として知られ、高級梅干しの代名詞である南高梅の発祥の地でもあります。早春には周囲の山々が白い梅の花に覆われ、甘い香りに包まれます。温泉でくつろいだあとは、地元の梅を使った料理や梅干しを味わってみてください。
quiz: 鶴の湯温泉のあるみなべ町が発祥の地として知られる、梅の代表的な品種は何でしょう？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) is located in the mountains of Minabe, known as the home of ume plums. Minabe is known as Japan's largest producer of ume and is also the birthplace of a premium variety that has become synonymous with high-quality umeboshi (pickled plums). In early spring the surrounding mountains are covered with white plum blossoms and wrapped in a sweet fragrance. After relaxing in the hot spring, try dishes made with local ume and umeboshi.
quiz_en: What is the leading ume plum variety that originated in Minabe Town, where Tsurunoyu Onsen is located?

name: 道成寺
desc: 日高川町にある、和歌山県最古の寺とされる古刹です。安珍・清姫の伝説の舞台として知られ、恋に破れた清姫が大蛇となって、鐘の中に隠れた安珍を焼き殺したという物語が伝わります。境内では僧侶が絵巻を使って伝説を語る「絵とき説法」が行われ、桜の季節には参道や境内が華やかに彩られます。
quiz: 道成寺の伝説で、清姫は恋の怒りから何の姿に変わったと語られているでしょう？
desc_en: This historic temple in Hidakagawa is considered the oldest temple in Wakayama Prefecture. It is known as the setting of the legend of Anchin and Kiyohime, in which Kiyohime, spurned in love, transforms into a monstrous creature and burns Anchin to death as he hides inside the temple bell. In the grounds, monks tell the legend using picture scrolls in a practice called "etoki seppo," and in cherry-blossom season the approach and grounds are brightly colored.
quiz_en: In the legend of Dojo-ji, what creature did Kiyohime turn into out of the rage of her spurned love?

name: 南紀白浜温泉の「崎の湯」と海沿いの外湯巡り
desc: 日本三古湯の一つに数えられる白浜温泉には、太平洋の荒波が打ち寄せる岩場に設けられた露天風呂「崎の湯」があります。万葉の時代から天皇や貴族が訪れたと伝わる歴史ある湯で、目の前に広がる大海原を眺めながら入浴できます。海沿いには外湯が点在し、湯巡りを楽しみながら白良浜まで散策できます。
quiz: 白浜温泉の「崎の湯」は、有馬・道後とともに何と呼ばれる古い温泉の一つに数えられるでしょう？
name_en: Sakinoyu and Seaside Baths of Nanki-Shirahama Onsen
desc_en: Shirahama Onsen, counted among Japan's three oldest hot springs, has Sakinoyu, an open-air bath set on rocks where the rough waves of the Pacific crash. It is a historic bath said to have been visited by emperors and nobles since the Man'yo era, and you can bathe while gazing at the vast ocean before you. Public bathhouses are dotted along the shore, so you can stroll to Shirarahama Beach while enjoying bathhouse hopping.
quiz_en: Shirahama Onsen, home of Sakinoyu, is counted along with Arima and Dogo as one of what group of hot springs?

name: 熊野那智大社
desc: 那智山の中腹に鎮座する熊野三山の一つで、那智の滝を神としてまつったことに始まると伝えられます。朱色の社殿が並ぶ境内からは那智の山並みと滝を望め、隣接する青岸渡寺の三重塔と滝が並ぶ景色は熊野を代表する風景です。毎年7月14日の扇祭りでは、大松明が石段を清める勇壮な火祭りが繰り広げられます。
quiz: 熊野那智大社で毎年7月に行われ、大松明が石段を清める火祭りは何と呼ばれているでしょう？
desc_en: Located halfway up Mount Nachi, this is one of the Kumano Sanzan, the three grand shrines of Kumano, and is said to have begun with the worship of Nachi Falls as a deity. From the grounds lined with vermilion buildings you can see the Nachi mountains and the falls, and the view of the falls beside the three-story pagoda of neighboring Seiganto-ji is the quintessential Kumano scene. At the annual fire festival on July 14, giant torches purify the stone steps in a spectacular rite.
quiz_en: What is the name of the fire festival held every July at Kumano Nachi Taisha in which giant torches purify the stone steps?

name: 那智滝
desc: 那智山の原生林から流れ落ちる、落差133mの日本を代表する名瀑です。一段の滝としての落差は日本一とされ、日本三名瀑の一つに数えられます。古くから滝そのものが神としてまつられ、飛瀧神社の御神体となっています。滝の前に立つと、轟音とともに降りかかるしぶきに、自然への畏敬の念を感じずにはいられません。
quiz: 那智滝を御神体としてまつる、滝のすぐ前にある神社は何でしょう？
desc_en: Plunging 133 meters from the primeval forest of Mount Nachi, this is one of Japan's most celebrated waterfalls. Its drop is said to be the highest of any single-tier waterfall in Japan, and it is counted among Japan's three great waterfalls. Since ancient times the falls themselves have been worshipped as a deity and serve as the sacred object of a shrine. Standing before the falls, amid the roar and the falling spray, you cannot help but feel awe toward nature.
quiz_en: What is the name of the shrine right in front of Nachi Falls that worships the waterfall itself as its sacred object?

name: 高野山熊野三山（熊野那智・大社・熊野速玉大社・熊野本宮大社・青岸渡寺・補陀洛山寺）
desc: 熊野本宮大社・熊野速玉大社・熊野那智大社の熊野三山と、那智山の青岸渡寺、補陀洛山寺などからなる熊野の聖地群は、世界遺産「紀伊山地の霊場と参詣道」の中核です。古くから神仏習合の信仰の地として、上皇から庶民まで多くの人々が熊野古道を歩いて参詣し、「蟻の熊野詣」と呼ばれるほどのにぎわいを見せました。
quiz: 熊野へ参詣する人々の列が絶えないことを、ある小さな生き物にたとえて何と呼んだでしょう？
desc_en: The sacred sites of Kumano, made up of the Kumano Sanzan (Kumano Hongu Taisha, Kumano Hayatama Taisha, and Kumano Nachi Taisha), together with Seiganto-ji on Mount Nachi, Fudarakusan-ji, and others, form the core of the World Heritage Site "Sacred Sites and Pilgrimage Routes in the Kii Mountain Range." Long a center of faith blending Shinto and Buddhism, Kumano drew everyone from retired emperors to commoners, who walked the Kumano Kodo to worship here in such numbers that the crowds were likened to a line of small creatures.
quiz_en: The endless lines of pilgrims heading to Kumano were compared to which small creature, giving rise to a famous phrase?

name: まぐろ祭り
desc: 那智勝浦町の勝浦漁港で開かれる、まぐろをテーマにした催しです。勝浦は生まぐろの水揚げ量が日本有数の港として知られ、冷凍しない新鮮なまぐろが味わえるのが自慢です。祭りの日には、まぐろの解体ショーや即売などが行われ、多くの人でにぎわいます。港町の活気とともに、とれたての味覚を堪能できます。
quiz: 勝浦のまぐろ祭りで、あなたが一番味わってみたいまぐろ料理は何ですか？
desc_en: This tuna-themed event is held at Katsuura Fishing Port in Nachikatsuura. Katsuura is known as one of Japan's leading ports for landing fresh tuna, and it prides itself on serving fresh, never-frozen tuna. On festival day, tuna-cutting shows and on-the-spot sales are held, drawing large crowds. Along with the energy of the port town, you can savor freshly caught flavors to your heart's content.
quiz_en: At the Katsuura Tuna Festival, which tuna dish would you most like to try, and how would you like it prepared?

name: お城山展望台河原城
desc: 鳥取市河原町の、千代川を見下ろす丘の上に建つ城の形をした展望台です。天守のような外観が目を引き、最上階からは千代川の流れや河原町の町並み、因幡の山々を一望できます。周辺は鮎釣りでも知られる清流の里で、春には桜、秋には紅葉が丘を彩り、四季折々の眺めを楽しめます。
quiz: 河原城の展望台から見下ろす千代川、夏に釣り人に人気の川魚は何でしょう？
desc_en: This castle-shaped observatory stands on a hill overlooking the Sendai River in Kawahara-cho, Tottori. Its keep-like exterior catches the eye, and from the top floor you can take in the flowing Sendai River, the townscape of Kawahara, and the mountains of Inaba. The surrounding area is a village of clear streams known for ayu (sweetfish) fishing, and with cherry blossoms in spring and autumn leaves in fall decorating the hill, you can enjoy views through all four seasons.
quiz_en: Which river fish, looked for in the Sendai River below the Kawahara Castle observatory, is popular with anglers in summer?

name: 鳥取温泉
desc: 鳥取駅から歩いて行けるほど市街地の中心にある、全国でも珍しい都市型の温泉です。明治時代に湧出が確認されて以来、町なかの旅館やホテル、銭湯で温泉が楽しまれてきました。仕事帰りや観光の合間に気軽に湯につかれるのが魅力で、鳥取砂丘観光の拠点としても便利な温泉です。
quiz: 鳥取温泉を拠点に訪れたい、日本最大級の砂丘として知られる鳥取の名所はどこでしょう？
desc_en: Located in the heart of the city, within walking distance of Tottori Station, this is a rare urban onsen (hot spring) even by national standards. Since the spring was confirmed in the Meiji era, its waters have been enjoyed at inns, hotels, and public bathhouses around town. Its appeal is that you can casually take a dip after work or between sightseeing, and it is also a convenient base for visiting the Tottori Sand Dunes.
quiz_en: Using Tottori Onsen as a base, which famous Tottori attraction, known as one of Japan's largest sand dunes, would you visit?

name: 吉岡温泉
desc: 鳥取市の郊外、山あいの静かな温泉地です。古くから湯治場として親しまれてきた歴史を持ち、こぢんまりとした温泉街には旅館や共同浴場が並びます。昔ながらの素朴な雰囲気が残り、地元の人々とともに湯につかれば、因幡の里の温かさに触れられます。市街地から近いので気軽に足を延ばせます。
quiz: 吉岡温泉のような素朴な湯治場で、あなたが過ごしてみたい一日の流れは？
desc_en: This is a quiet onsen (hot spring) resort in the mountains on the outskirts of Tottori City. It has a long history as a toji-ba, a place for therapeutic bathing, and its compact hot spring town is lined with inns and communal baths. A simple, old-fashioned atmosphere remains, and bathing alongside local people lets you feel the warmth of the Inaba countryside. It is close to the city, so you can easily make a trip here.
quiz_en: At a simple, traditional bathing retreat like Yoshioka Onsen, how would you like to spend an entire day from morning to night?

name: 鹿野温泉
desc: 戦国武将・亀井茲矩が治めた鹿野城の城下町に湧く温泉です。城下町には昔ながらの町並みが残り、落ち着いた通りをのんびりと散策できます。城跡の堀は桜の名所として知られ、春には花見客でにぎわいます。町歩きのあとに温泉で体を温めれば、因幡の小さな城下町の魅力をじっくり味わえます。
quiz: 鹿野温泉のある城下町を治め、海外との交易にも意欲を見せた戦国武将は誰でしょう？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) wells up in the former castle town of Shikano Castle, which was ruled by the Sengoku warlord Kamei Korenori. Old-fashioned streets remain in the castle town, and you can stroll leisurely along its calm lanes. The moat of the castle ruins is known for its cherry blossoms, and in spring it bustles with blossom viewers. Warm up in the hot spring after a town walk to fully savor the charms of this small castle town in Inaba.
quiz_en: Who was the Sengoku warlord who ruled the castle town of Shikano Onsen and showed strong interest in overseas trade?

name: 浜村温泉
desc: 日本海に面した気高町の浜村海岸近くに湧く温泉です。鳥取民謡「貝殻節」の発祥の地として知られ、町には貝殻節にちなんだ記念碑などが見られます。温泉街から少し歩けば広い砂浜が広がり、日本海に沈む夕日を眺められます。冬には松葉ガニ、夏には新鮮な魚介など、海の幸も楽しみの一つです。
quiz: 浜村温泉が発祥の地として知られる、ホタテ貝漁にちなんだ鳥取の民謡は何でしょう？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) wells up near Hamamura Beach in Ketaka-cho, facing the Sea of Japan. It is known as the birthplace of a Tottori folk song, and monuments related to the song can be seen around town. A short walk from the hot spring town brings you to a wide sandy beach where you can watch the sunset over the Sea of Japan. Seafood, such as Matsuba crab in winter and fresh fish and shellfish in summer, is another pleasure here.
quiz_en: What is the Tottori folk song, connected with scallop fishing, for which Hamamura Onsen is known as the birthplace?

name: 安蔵森林公園
desc: 鳥取市の東部、山間に広がる森林公園です。豊かな森の中には散策路やキャンプ場が整備され、木々に包まれながら自然を満喫できます。春の新緑、夏の涼しい木陰、秋の紅葉と、季節ごとに森の表情が移り変わります。小鳥のさえずりを聞きながら森林浴をすれば、心も体もリフレッシュできます。
quiz: 安蔵森林公園の森でキャンプをするなら、あなたが作ってみたいキャンプ料理は何ですか？
desc_en: This forest park spreads across the mountains of eastern Tottori City. Walking trails and a campground have been laid out in the rich forest, letting you fully enjoy nature surrounded by trees. The forest changes its expression with the seasons, from the fresh greenery of spring and cool shade of summer to the autumn leaves. Forest bathing while listening to birdsong will refresh both mind and body.
quiz_en: If you went camping in the forest of Anzo Forest Park, what kind of camp meal would you like to cook?

name: 貝がら節まつり
desc: 鳥取民謡「貝殻節」の発祥の地・気高町浜村で行われる夏祭りです。祭りでは、そろいの浴衣や法被に身を包んだ踊り手たちが、哀愁を帯びた貝殻節の調べに合わせて町を踊り歩きます。かつての帆立貝漁の苦労をしのぶ歌詞を味わいながら、海辺の町の夏の夜を、地元の人々と一緒に楽しめます。
quiz: 貝殻節まつりで踊るなら、あなたは浴衣派？それとも法被派ですか？
desc_en: This summer festival is held in Hamamura, Ketaka-cho, the birthplace of the Tottori folk song "Kaigarabushi." During the festival, dancers dressed in matching yukata or happi coats dance through the town to the melancholy melody of Kaigarabushi. Savoring the lyrics that recall the hardships of scallop fishing in the past, you can enjoy a summer night in this seaside town together with the local people.
quiz_en: If you danced at the Kaigarabushi Festival, would you prefer to wear a yukata or a happi coat, and why?

name: あおやようこそまつり
desc: 日本海に面した鳥取市青谷町で行われる夏祭りです。青谷町は、弥生時代の集落跡・青谷上寺地遺跡があることで知られ、和紙づくりの伝統も受け継がれています。祭りの日には地域の人々が集い、海辺の町らしい開放的な雰囲気の中で、催しや屋台を楽しみながら夏のひとときを過ごせます。
quiz: あおやようこそまつりで、海辺の町の夏の夜に一番見たいものは何ですか？
desc_en: This summer festival is held in Aoya-cho, Tottori City, facing the Sea of Japan. Aoya is known for the Aoya Kamijichi site, the remains of a Yayoi-period settlement, and it also carries on a tradition of washi papermaking. On festival day, local people gather, and in the open atmosphere typical of a seaside town, you can spend a summer moment enjoying events and food stalls.
quiz_en: At the Aoya Yokoso Festival, what would you most like to see on a summer night in this seaside town?

name: 宇部神社
desc: 鳥取市国府町に鎮座する因幡国一宮で、正式には宇倍神社と表記されます。長寿の忠臣として知られる武内宿禰をまつり、長寿や商売繁盛のご利益で信仰を集めています。明治時代には紙幣の図柄に社殿と武内宿禰が描かれたことから、お金にまつわるご利益を求める参拝者も多く訪れます。
quiz: 宇倍神社にまつられている、長寿の忠臣として知られる古代の人物は誰でしょう？
desc_en: This shrine in Kokufu-cho, Tottori City, is the ichinomiya (highest-ranking shrine) of the old Inaba Province, and its official name is written with different characters. It is dedicated to Takenouchi no Sukune, known as a long-lived loyal retainer, and attracts worshippers seeking longevity and business prosperity. Because the shrine and Takenouchi no Sukune appeared on banknotes in the Meiji era, many visitors also come seeking blessings related to money.
quiz_en: Who is the ancient figure enshrined at Ube Shrine, known as a loyal retainer who lived a very long life?

name: 倉田八幡宮
desc: 鳥取市の市街地東部、馬場の地に鎮座する八幡宮です。鎮守の森に包まれた境内は、まちなかとは思えない静けさに満ちており、地域の人々の信仰の拠り所として大切にされてきました。四季折々の祭事が営まれ、初詣や七五三などの節目に家族で参拝する姿が見られます。
quiz: 倉田八幡宮のような地元の神社で、あなたが家族と一緒にお参りした思い出の行事は何ですか？
desc_en: This Hachiman shrine stands in Baba, in the eastern part of central Tottori City. Wrapped in a sacred grove, its grounds are filled with a tranquility you would not expect in town, and it has been cherished as a center of faith for local people. Festivals are held throughout the year, and families can be seen visiting at milestones such as the New Year's first shrine visit and Shichi-Go-San, a celebration for children.
quiz_en: At a local shrine like Kurata Hachimangu, what special occasion do you remember visiting with your family?

name: 栗渓神社
desc: 鳥取市栗谷町に鎮座する神社です。鳥取市街地の北東、山に寄り添う静かな場所にあり、木々に囲まれた境内には落ち着いた空気が流れています。城下町として発展した鳥取の町の近くにありながら、豊かな自然を感じられる場所で、散策の途中に立ち寄って静かにお参りするのにふさわしい神社です。
quiz: 栗渓神社の静かな境内を訪ねるなら、あなたは新緑と紅葉、どちらの季節を選びますか？
desc_en: This shrine stands in Kuriya-cho, Tottori City. It is located in a quiet spot nestled against the mountains northeast of central Tottori, and a calm atmosphere flows through its tree-lined grounds. Although close to the town of Tottori, which developed as a castle town, it is a place where you can feel rich nature, and it is a fitting shrine to stop by for a quiet prayer during a walk.
quiz_en: If you visited the quiet grounds of Kurii Shrine, would you choose the season of fresh greenery or of autumn leaves?

name: 白兎神社
desc: 古事記に登場する「因幡の白兎」の神話ゆかりの神社で、白兎を神としてまつっています。大国主命に助けられた白兎の物語にちなみ、縁結びの神社として多くの参拝者が訪れます。境内には白兎が傷を洗ったとされる御身洗池があり、参道には白兎の石像が並びます。目の前には日本海が広がっています。
quiz: 白兎神社に伝わる因幡の白兎の神話で、傷ついた白兎を助けた神様は誰でしょう？
desc_en: This shrine is associated with the myth of the "White Hare of Inaba" from the Kojiki and enshrines the white hare as a deity.
