quiz_en: In Innosho, home of Seigan-ji Temple, which historical figure is known for the tale of carving a Chinese poem into a cherry tree?

name: 長法寺
desc: 津山市井口にある寺院で、「美作のあじさい寺」として知られています。梅雨の季節になると境内一面にあじさいが咲き誇り、青や紫、白の花が古い堂宇を美しく彩ります。雨にぬれた花はいっそう色鮮やかで、しっとりとした風情を求めて多くの人が訪れます。山あいの静かな寺で季節の花を愛でてください。
quiz: 長法寺のあじさいは、青・紫・白など何色の花が一番好きですか？
desc_en: This temple in the Iguchi area of Tsuyama City is known as the "Hydrangea Temple of Mimasaka." In the rainy season, hydrangeas bloom across the grounds, their blue, purple and white flowers beautifully decorating the old halls. Wet with rain, the flowers become even more vivid, and many people visit seeking that moist, elegant atmosphere. Come admire the seasonal flowers at this quiet temple in the mountains.
quiz_en: Among the hydrangeas of Chobo-ji Temple, in colors such as blue, purple and white, which color do you like best?

name: 瀬戸内海の多島景観
desc: 玉野市の海岸からは、瀬戸内海に島々が重なり合う多島美の風景を楽しめます。四国へ向かう航路の拠点だった宇野港があり、現在は直島や豊島など現代アートで知られる島々へのフェリーが発着します。王子が岳など海を見下ろす高台に登れば、穏やかな海に浮かぶ島影と行き交う船が一望できます。
quiz: 玉野市の宇野港からフェリーで渡れる、現代アートで知られる島はどこ？
desc_en: From the coast of Tamano City you can enjoy the beautiful scenery of islands overlapping in the Seto Inland Sea. Uno Port, once a hub for routes to Shikoku, now has ferries to islands known for contemporary art, such as Naoshima and Teshima. Climb a hilltop overlooking the sea, such as Mount Ojigatake, and you can take in island silhouettes floating on the calm sea and ships coming and going.
quiz_en: Which island famous for contemporary art can you reach by ferry from Uno Port in Tamano City?

name: みやま公園
desc: 玉野市田井にある広々とした総合公園です。瀬戸内の温暖な気候に恵まれた丘陵地に、緑の芝生や花の庭園、遊具やスポーツ施設が整い、家族連れでにぎわいます。季節ごとに草花が園内を彩り、のんびり散策するのにぴったりです。港町・玉野の観光とあわせて立ち寄りたいスポットです。
quiz: みやま公園の広い芝生の上で、あなたなら何をして一日を過ごしたい？
desc_en: This spacious general park is in the Tai area of Tamano City. On hills blessed with the mild climate of the Seto Inland Sea, it offers green lawns, flower gardens, play equipment and sports facilities, and is busy with families. Seasonal flowers color the park, making it perfect for a leisurely stroll. It is a spot to stop by along with sightseeing in the port town of Tamano.
quiz_en: If you spent a whole day on the wide lawns of Miyama Park, what would you like to do there?

name: 北木島
desc: 笠岡諸島最大の島で、良質な花崗岩「北木石」の産地として知られます。北木石は大阪城の石垣をはじめ各地の建築に使われてきました。島には深く掘り下げられた石切り場が残り、切り立った岩壁と青い水をたたえた丁場の景観は圧巻です。笠岡港から船で渡る、石と海の島の旅を楽しめます。
quiz: 北木島で切り出される良質な花崗岩は、島の名前をとって何と呼ばれる？
desc_en: The largest island of the Kasaoka Islands is known for producing a high-quality granite called "Kitagi stone." Kitagi stone has been used in buildings in many places, including the stone walls of Osaka Castle. Deeply dug quarries remain on the island, and the scenery of sheer rock walls and quarry pits filled with blue water is overwhelming. You can enjoy a trip by boat from Kasaoka Port to this island of stone and sea.
quiz_en: Named after the island itself, what is the high-quality granite quarried on Kitagi Island called?

name: 白石島
desc: 笠岡諸島に浮かぶ、白い砂浜と花崗岩の奇岩が美しい島です。夏は海水浴客でにぎわい、穏やかな瀬戸内の海を満喫できます。島に伝わる盆踊り「白石踊」は国の重要無形民俗文化財で、さまざまな踊りが一つの歌に合わせて同時に踊られる珍しいものです。のんびりした島時間を味わえます。
quiz: 白石島に伝わる、国の重要無形民俗文化財に指定された盆踊りの名前は何？
desc_en: Floating among the Kasaoka Islands, this island is beautiful for its white sand beaches and unusual granite rocks. In summer it is busy with swimmers enjoying the calm Seto Inland Sea. The island's Bon dance, "Shiraishi Odori," is an Important Intangible Folk Cultural Property of Japan, and it is unusual in that various dances are performed simultaneously to a single song. Here you can savor relaxed island time.
quiz_en: What is the name of the Bon dance passed down on Shiraishi Island that is an Important Intangible Folk Cultural Property?

name: 天神峡
desc: 井原市芳井町、清流が岩の間を縫うように流れる渓谷です。両岸の緑と川の流れが織りなす景観は、季節ごとに表情を変えます。川べりではせせらぎを聞きながら散策や水遊びを楽しめ、夏は涼を求める人々が訪れます。井原の山あいの穏やかな自然に包まれて、ゆっくりと過ごしたい場所です。
quiz: 天神峡の清流のほとりで、あなたなら夏の一日をどんなふうに過ごしたい？
desc_en: This gorge in the Yoshii area of Ibara City has a clear stream threading its way between rocks. The scenery woven by the greenery on both banks and the flow of the river changes its look with each season. By the river you can enjoy walks and playing in the water while listening to the murmur, and in summer people come seeking coolness. It is a place to spend time slowly, wrapped in the gentle nature of Ibara's mountains.
quiz_en: Beside the clear stream of Tenjinkyo Gorge, how would you like to spend a summer day there?

name: 備中国分寺
desc: 吉備路の田園風景の中にそびえる五重塔で知られる寺院です。奈良時代に聖武天皇の命で全国に建てられた国分寺のひとつで、現在の五重塔は江戸時代に建てられたもので、国の重要文化財に指定されています。春のれんげ畑や菜の花、秋のコスモスなど、季節の花と塔がつくる風景は吉備路を代表する眺めです。
quiz: 備中国分寺の五重塔と一緒に撮りたい、吉備路の季節の花といえば何？
desc_en: This temple is known for its five-story pagoda rising amid the rural landscape of the Kibiji area. It is one of the provincial temples built across Japan by order of Emperor Shomu in the Nara period, and the current pagoda dates from the Edo period and is designated an Important Cultural Property. The scenery of the pagoda with seasonal flowers, such as spring milk vetch and rapeseed blossoms and autumn cosmos, is a signature view of Kibiji.
quiz_en: Which seasonal flower of the Kibiji area would you most like to photograph together with the five-story pagoda of Bitchu Kokubun-ji?

name: 砂川公園
desc: 総社市黒尾、砂川の清流沿いに広がる公園です。川遊びやキャンプ、バーベキューなどを楽しめ、夏は家族連れでにぎわいます。木々に囲まれた河原で水に足をひたせば、自然の涼しさが心地よく感じられます。吉備路の歴史散策の合間に、のんびりと自然の中で過ごすひとときにおすすめです。
quiz: 砂川公園の河原でバーベキューをするなら、焼いてみたい岡山の食材は何？
desc_en: This park spreads along the clear Sunagawa River in the Kuroo area of Soja City. You can enjoy river play, camping and barbecues, and in summer it is busy with families. Dip your feet in the water on the tree-lined riverbank and the natural coolness feels wonderful. It is recommended for a relaxing time in nature between history walks along the Kibiji area.
quiz_en: If you had a barbecue on the riverbank at Sunagawa Park, which Okayama ingredients would you like to grill?

name: 鬼ノ城
desc: 総社市の鬼城山の山頂に築かれた古代山城の跡です。7世紀ごろの築城と考えられ、全長約2.8キロの城壁が山を取り囲んでいました。復元された西門は迫力があり、眼下には吉備平野が広がります。鬼・温羅が住んだ城という伝説が残り、桃太郎伝説のもとになった話のひとつとして知られます。
quiz: 鬼ノ城に住んでいたと伝わる、桃太郎の鬼退治のもとになった鬼の名前は？
desc_en: These are the ruins of an ancient mountain fortress built on the summit of Mount Kinojo in Soja City. Thought to date from around the 7th century, its walls, about 2.8 kilometers long, once encircled the mountain. The reconstructed West Gate is impressive, and the Kibi Plain spreads out below. A legend says the ogre Ura lived in the castle, and it is known as one of the stories behind the Momotaro legend.
quiz_en: What is the name of the ogre said to have lived in Kinojo Castle, whose story inspired Momotaro's ogre-slaying tale?

name: 井山宝福寺
desc: 総社市にある臨済宗の古刹で、画僧・雪舟が少年時代に修行した寺として知られます。修行をさぼって柱に縛られた雪舟が、こぼした涙で足元にねずみを描いたという逸話は有名です。境内には三重塔が建ち、秋の紅葉や初夏の新緑に包まれた伽藍は、落ち着いた禅寺の趣を感じさせます。
quiz: 宝福寺で修行した少年時代の雪舟が、涙で描いたと伝わる動物は何？
desc_en: This ancient Rinzai Zen temple in Soja City is known as the place where the painter-monk Sesshu trained as a boy. The tale of Sesshu, tied to a pillar for slacking off his training, drawing a mouse at his feet with his fallen tears is famous. A three-story pagoda stands in the grounds, and the temple buildings, wrapped in autumn leaves or the fresh green of early summer, convey the calm feel of a Zen temple.
quiz_en: According to legend, what animal did the young Sesshu draw with his tears while training at Hofuku-ji Temple?

name: 備中松山城
desc: 標高約430メートルの臥牛山に建つ、現存天守を持つ山城として最も高い場所にある城です。天守は江戸時代のもので、国の重要文化財に指定されています。秋から冬の早朝には雲海に浮かぶ姿が見られることがあり、「天空の山城」として人気です。岩盤の上に築かれた石垣も見事です。
quiz: 備中松山城は、現存天守を持つ山城の中で何が日本一とされている？
desc_en: Standing on Mount Gagyu at about 430 meters, this is the highest of the mountain castles with an original surviving keep. The keep dates from the Edo period and is designated an Important Cultural Property of Japan. Early on autumn and winter mornings it can sometimes be seen floating above a sea of clouds, making it popular as the "castle in the sky." Its stone walls built on bedrock are also magnificent.
quiz_en: Among mountain castles with an original surviving keep, in what respect is Bitchu Matsuyama Castle considered number one in Japan?

name: 頼久寺庭園
desc: 高梁市にある頼久寺の庭園で、小堀遠州の作と伝えられる枯山水の庭として国の名勝に指定されています。背後の愛宕山を借景に取り込み、白砂の海に鶴島・亀島を配した構成が見事です。大きなサツキの刈り込みが波を表し、初夏には花が咲いていっそう華やかになります。
quiz: 頼久寺庭園のように、遠くの山などを庭の背景に取り込む技法を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: This garden at Raikyu-ji Temple in Takahashi City is a dry landscape garden said to be the work of Kobori Enshu, and it is designated a National Place of Scenic Beauty. It skillfully incorporates Mount Atago behind it as borrowed scenery, with Crane Island and Turtle Island set in a sea of white sand. Large clipped satsuki azaleas represent waves, and in early summer they bloom, making the garden even more gorgeous.
quiz_en: What is the Japanese garden technique, used at Raikyu-ji Temple Garden, of incorporating distant mountains into the garden's background called?

name: 弥高山
desc: 高梁市川上町の吉備高原にある山で、山頂からは360度のパノラマが広がります。なだらかな高原に点在する集落や、重なり合う山並みを一望でき、条件がよければ遠くの山々まで見渡せます。山頂一帯は公園として整備され、季節の花や新緑、紅葉を楽しみながら、さわやかな高原の風を感じられます。
quiz: 弥高山の山頂で360度の眺めを見渡したら、一番遠くに見つけたいものは何？
desc_en: This mountain on the Kibi Plateau in the Kawakami area of Takahashi City offers a 360-degree panorama from its summit. You can take in villages dotted across gentle highlands and layers of overlapping mountains, and in good conditions see far-off peaks. The summit area has been made into a park, where you can feel the fresh highland breeze while enjoying seasonal flowers, fresh greenery and autumn leaves.
quiz_en: Taking in the 360-degree view from the summit of Mount Yatakayama, what would you most like to spot in the far distance?

name: 西山高原
desc: 高梁市備中町の西山高原は、吉備高原の西部に広がる見晴らしのよい高原です。標高が高く、夏でもさわやかな風が吹き抜け、キャンプや散策を楽しむ人々が訪れます。夜は街明かりが少ないため、満天の星空を眺められるのも魅力です。のびやかな高原の風景の中で、心身ともにリフレッシュできます。
quiz: 西山高原で一晩過ごすなら、夜空に一番見つけたい星や星座は何ですか？
desc_en: The Nishiyama Highlands in the Bitchu area of Takahashi City are scenic uplands spreading across the western Kibi Plateau. Thanks to the high elevation, refreshing breezes blow through even in summer, and people come to camp and walk. Because there are few city lights, you can also gaze at a sky full of stars at night. Amid the expansive highland scenery, you can refresh both body and mind.
quiz_en: If you spent a night at the Nishiyama Highlands, which star or constellation would you most want to find in the night sky?

name: 満奇洞
desc: 新見市にある鍾乳洞で、大正時代に歌人・与謝野晶子が訪れ「奇に満ちた洞」と詠んだことから満奇洞と名付けられました。洞内には地底湖や「千枚田」と呼ばれる段々状の石灰華、さまざまな形の鍾乳石が連なり、幻想的な照明に浮かび上がる姿は神秘的です。夏でもひんやりと涼しく快適です。
quiz: 満奇洞を訪れ、その名の由来となる言葉を詠んだ明治・大正の歌人は誰？
desc_en: This limestone cave in Niimi City was named Makido after the poet Yosano Akiko visited in the Taisho era and described it in verse as "a cave filled with wonders." Inside are an underground lake, terraced travertine formations called "Senmaida," and stalactites of many shapes, looking mysterious in the dreamlike lighting. It stays pleasantly cool even in summer.
quiz_en: Who was the Meiji and Taisho era poet who visited Makido Cave and wrote the words that gave it its name?

name: 井倉洞
desc: 新見市の高梁川沿い、高さ240メートルほどの石灰岩の絶壁にぽっかりと口を開ける鍾乳洞です。洞内は全長1キロを超え、高低差のある通路を上り下りしながら、地下の滝や巨大な鍾乳石を見学できます。洞窟の入口近くには滝も落ち、そそり立つ岩壁と清流がつくる景観も見どころです。
quiz: 井倉洞のような鍾乳洞は、どんな種類の岩が水に溶けてできるでしょう？
desc_en: This limestone cave opens in a limestone cliff about 240 meters high along the Takahashi River in Niimi City. The cave is over a kilometer long, and as you climb up and down passages of varying heights you can see underground waterfalls and huge stalactites. A waterfall also drops near the entrance, and the scenery of towering rock walls and a clear stream is another highlight.
quiz_en: Limestone caves like Ikurado Cave are formed when what kind of rock is dissolved by water over a long time?

name: 神郷温泉
desc: 新見市神郷、鳥取県境に近い山あいに湧く温泉です。神郷は中国山地の自然に囲まれた静かな地域で、渓流や森の景色が四季を通じて楽しめます。山里の空気の中で湯につかれば、心も体もほぐれていきます。新見名物の千屋牛など、周辺の味覚とあわせて訪れたい湯です。
quiz: 神郷温泉に泊まるなら、新見の名物でぜひ味わいたいブランド牛は何？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) wells up in the mountains of the Shingo area of Niimi City, near the Tottori border. Shingo is a quiet area surrounded by the nature of the Chugoku Mountains, where you can enjoy mountain streams and forests year-round. Soaking in the mountain village air relaxes both mind and body. It is a hot spring worth visiting along with local delicacies such as Niimi's famous Chiya beef.
quiz_en: If you stayed at Shingo Onsen, which famous brand of beef from Niimi would you most want to taste?

name: 大佐山
desc: 新見市大佐にある山で、中国山地の山並みを見渡すことのできる高原の山です。山麓から中腹にかけてはキャンプ場などのレジャー施設があり、夏はアウトドアを楽しむ人々でにぎわいます。冬には雪に覆われ、まったく違う表情を見せます。四季の自然を身近に感じられる、新見の山遊びの拠点です。
quiz: 大佐山で過ごすなら、夏のアウトドアと冬の雪遊び、どちらに挑戦したい？
desc_en: This highland mountain in the Osa area of Niimi City offers views across the ranges of the Chugoku Mountains. From the foot to the middle slopes there are leisure facilities such as campgrounds, and in summer it is busy with people enjoying the outdoors. In winter it is covered in snow and shows a completely different face. It is a base for mountain fun in Niimi where you can feel nature through all four seasons.
quiz_en: If you spent time at Mount Osa, would you rather try summer outdoor activities or winter snow play, and why?

name: 八塔寺川ダム公園
desc: 備前市吉永町、八塔寺川をせき止めたダム湖のほとりに整備された公園です。山々に囲まれた静かな湖面は、季節ごとに表情を変え、春の新緑や秋の紅葉が水面に映り込みます。周辺の八塔寺地区には茅葺き民家の残る里山の風景が広がり、ドライブや散策とあわせてのんびり過ごせます。
quiz: 八塔寺川ダム公園の湖面に映る景色、いちばん美しいと思う季節はいつ？
desc_en: This park lies on the shore of the reservoir formed by damming the Hattoji River in the Yoshinaga area of Bizen City. The quiet lake surrounded by mountains changes its look with each season, reflecting fresh spring greenery and autumn leaves on its surface. In the surrounding Hattoji district, a rural landscape with remaining thatched-roof houses spreads out, so you can relax combining it with a drive or a walk.
quiz_en: In which season do you think the scenery reflected on the lake at Hattojigawa Dam Park is most beautiful?

name: 田倉牛神社
desc: 備前市吉永町の山中にある神社で、境内に奉納された無数の備前焼の牛の置物で知られます。参拝者が小さな牛の焼き物を借りて帰り、願いが叶うと倍にして返すという習わしがあり、積み重なった牛の数は圧巻です。牛馬の守り神として信仰され、備前焼の里らしい独特の光景が広がります。
quiz: 田倉牛神社にたくさん奉納されている牛の置物は、何という焼き物でできている？
desc_en: This shrine in the mountains of the Yoshinaga area of Bizen City is known for the countless Bizen-ware ox figurines offered in its grounds. There is a custom in which worshippers borrow a small ceramic ox to take home and, when their wish comes true, return twice as many, and the piled-up number of oxen is overwhelming. Worshipped as a guardian of cattle and horses, it presents a unique sight befitting the home of Bizen ware.
quiz_en: What kind of Japanese pottery are the many ox figurines offered at Takura Ushigami Shrine made of?

name: 八塔寺ふるさと農園
desc: 備前市吉永町の八塔寺ふるさと村にある農園です。八塔寺地区は茅葺き民家が残る山里で、昔ながらの日本の農村風景が今も息づいています。農園では季節の野菜づくりなどの農業体験ができ、土に触れながらのんびりとした里山の暮らしを味わえます。都会の喧騒を離れたい人にぴったりの場所です。
quiz: 八塔寺ふるさと村の茅葺き民家を眺めながら、体験してみたい田舎暮らしは何？
desc_en: This farm is in Hattoji Furusato Village in the Yoshinaga area of Bizen City. Hattoji is a mountain village with remaining thatched-roof houses, where the traditional Japanese farming landscape still lives on. At the farm you can try farming activities such as growing seasonal vegetables, savoring relaxed rural life while getting your hands in the soil. It is the perfect place for those who want to escape the bustle of the city.
quiz_en: While gazing at the thatched-roof houses of Hattoji Furusato Village, what kind of country life experience would you like to try?

name: 亀の浦
addr: 備前市日生町日生（鴻島）
desc: 備前市日生の沖合に浮かぶ鴻島にある浜辺です。日生は牡蠣の養殖で知られる漁師町で、周囲の海には大小の島々が点在する日生諸島の風景が広がります。島へは船で渡り、穏やかな瀬戸内の海と静かな浜辺で、のんびりとした時間を過ごせます。冬は名物のカキオコも楽しみです。
quiz: 日生の名物で、牡蠣をたっぷり入れたお好み焼きを略して何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: This beach is on Kojima Island, off the coast of Hinase in Bizen City. Hinase is a fishing town known for oyster farming, and the surrounding sea shows the scenery of the Hinase Islands, dotted with islands large and small. You cross to the island by boat and can spend relaxed time on the calm Seto Inland Sea and a quiet beach. In winter, the local specialty kaki-oko is another treat.
quiz_en: What is the shortened nickname for Hinase's specialty okonomiyaki savory pancake packed with plenty of oysters?

name: 備前国分寺跡
desc: 奈良時代に聖武天皇の命で全国に建てられた国分寺のひとつ、備前国分寺の跡です。赤磐市の田園の中に広がる寺域では、発掘調査で金堂や塔などの建物跡が確認され、国の史跡に指定されています。広々とした遺跡を歩けば、かつてこの地にそびえた大伽藍の姿が目に浮かぶようです。
quiz: 備前国分寺のような国分寺を、全国に建てるよう命じた天皇は誰でしょう？
desc_en: These are the ruins of Bizen Kokubun-ji, one of the provincial temples built across Japan by order of Emperor Shomu in the Nara period. Within the temple grounds spreading amid the farmland of Akaiwa City, excavations have confirmed the remains of buildings such as the main hall and pagoda, and the site is designated a National Historic Site. Walking the spacious site, you can almost picture the great temple complex that once towered here.
quiz_en: Which Nara-period emperor ordered provincial temples such as Bizen Kokubun-ji to be built in every province throughout Japan?

name: 城山公園
desc: 赤磐市周匝にある城山公園は、吉井川を見下ろす高台に広がる公園です。かつて山城があった場所とされ、園内からは川沿いの町並みや周囲の山々を一望できます。春は桜、秋は紅葉と季節の彩りも楽しめ、散策やひと休みにぴったりです。吉井川の流れとのどかな里の景色に心がなごみます。
quiz: 城山公園の高台から吉井川を見下ろしたら、どんな景色が一番印象的でしたか？
desc_en: Shiroyama Park, in the Suzai area of Akaiwa City, spreads over high ground overlooking the Yoshii River. It is said to be the site of a former mountain castle, and from the park you can take in the riverside town and surrounding mountains. You can also enjoy seasonal colors, with cherry blossoms in spring and autumn leaves in fall, making it perfect for a walk or a rest. The flow of the Yoshii River and the peaceful countryside soothe the heart.
quiz_en: Looking down on the Yoshii River from the high ground of Shiroyama Park, what scenery left the strongest impression on you?

name: 木山寺
desc: 真庭市の木山の山上に建つ古刹です。古くから「木山さま」と呼ばれて親しまれ、神仏習合の姿をとどめる寺として知られます。杉の大木に囲まれた参道を進むと、山の霊気に包まれた荘厳な伽藍が現れます。境内からは真庭の山並みを見渡すことができ、秋の紅葉の季節はとくに美しい眺めです。
quiz: 木山寺へ杉木立の参道を歩いて登ったら、山上で一番に何をしたい？
desc_en: This ancient temple stands atop Mount Kiyama in Maniwa City. Long affectionately called "Kiyama-sama," it is known as a temple that preserves the fusion of Shinto and Buddhism. Walking the approach lined with huge cedar trees, you come upon solemn temple buildings wrapped in the spiritual air of the mountain. From the grounds you can see the mountains of Maniwa, and the view is especially beautiful in the autumn leaves season.
quiz_en: After climbing the cedar-lined approach to Kiyama-ji Temple, what would you want to do first at the mountaintop?

name: 醍醐桜まつり
desc: 真庭市別所の丘の上に一本だけ立つ巨木「醍醐桜」を愛でるまつりです。樹齢約千年とも言われるアズマヒガンの古木で、後醍醐天皇が隠岐に流される途中で賞賛したという話から名付けられたとされます。満開の季節には、大きく枝を広げた桜が山里の空を薄紅色に染め上げます。
quiz: 醍醐桜の名前の由来となったとされる、隠岐へ流された天皇は誰でしょう？
desc_en: This festival celebrates the "Daigo-zakura," a giant tree standing alone on a hill in the Bessho area of Maniwa City. It is an old Azuma-higan cherry said to be about 1,000 years old, and it is said to have been named after a story that Emperor Go-Daigo praised it on his way into exile in Oki. In full bloom, its widely spreading branches dye the sky over the mountain village a pale pink.
quiz_en: Which emperor, exiled to the Oki Islands, is said to have given the Daigo-zakura cherry tree its name?

name: 休暇村蒜山高原
desc: 蒜山三座を望む蒜山高原にある休暇村です。標高500メートルほどの高原には牧草地が広がり、ジャージー牛がのんびり草をはむ姿が見られます。夏は涼しく、サイクリングやハイキングを楽しめます。名物の「ひるぜん焼そば」やジャージー牛乳のソフトクリームも、高原の旅に欠かせない味です。
quiz: 蒜山高原でのんびり草をはむ姿が見られる、牛乳がおいしい牛の品種は何？
desc_en: This Kyukamura resort lodge is on the Hiruzen Highlands, with views of the three peaks of Hiruzen. On the highlands, about 500 meters above sea level, pastures spread out and Jersey cows can be seen grazing leisurely. Summers are cool, and you can enjoy cycling and hiking. The famous "Hiruzen yakisoba" and soft-serve ice cream made with Jersey milk are essential tastes of a highland trip.
quiz_en: What is the breed of cow, known for delicious milk, that you can see leisurely grazing on the Hiruzen Highlands?

name: 足温泉
desc: 真庭市都喜足、旭川の流域に湧く温泉です。真庭市は岡山県北部の中国山地に広がる市で、湯原温泉や蒜山高原など自然の魅力にあふれた地域です。山あいの静かな湯で、川の流れや緑の景色を眺めながらのんびり過ごせます。地名にちなむ、どこか親しみのある名前も記憶に残る温泉です。
quiz: 足温泉のある真庭市で、ほかにもめぐってみたい温泉地や名所はどこ？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) wells up along the Asahi River in the Tsugitaru area of Maniwa City. Maniwa spreads across the Chugoku Mountains in northern Okayama Prefecture and is a region full of natural attractions such as Yubara Onsen and the Hiruzen Highlands. At this quiet mountain spa, you can relax while gazing at the flowing river and green scenery. Its somewhat friendly name, taken from the place name, also makes it memorable.
quiz_en: In Maniwa City, home of Taru Onsen, which other hot spring towns or famous sights would you like to visit?

name: 大芦高原
desc: 美作市上山の山あいに広がる高原です。上山地区は、かつて多くの棚田が広がっていた地域で、近年は地元の人々や移住者の手で棚田の再生が進められています。高原の上からは、重なり合う山並みと里山の風景を望め、季節の風を感じながら、ゆったりとした時間を楽しめます。
quiz: 大芦高原のある美作市上山地区で、昔から人々が守ってきた田んぼの風景は何？
desc_en: These highlands spread across the mountains of the Ueyama area of Mimasaka City. Ueyama once had many terraced rice fields, and in recent years local people and new residents have been working to restore them. From the top of the highlands you can see layers of mountains and rural scenery, and enjoy a leisurely time feeling the seasonal breeze.
quiz_en: In the Ueyama district of Mimasaka City, home of the Oashi Highlands, what rice field landscape have people long worked to preserve?

name: 藤波池
desc: 浅口市鴨方町にある池で、周囲を緑に囲まれた静かな水辺です。鴨方町は手延べそうめんの産地として知られ、晴れの日が多い気候から天体観測の適地として天文台が置かれたことでも有名です。池のほとりを散策すれば、水面を渡る風と季節の草花が心をなごませてくれます。
quiz: 藤波池のある浅口市鴨方町で古くからつくられている、名物の麺は何？
desc_en: This pond in the Kamogata area of Asakuchi City is a quiet waterside surrounded by greenery. Kamogata is known for producing hand-stretched somen noodles, and it is also famous for having observatories because its many sunny days make it ideal for astronomical observation. Strolling along the pond, the breeze across the water and seasonal flowers will soothe your heart.
quiz_en: What famous noodles have long been made in the Kamogata area of Asakuchi City, where Fujinami Pond is located?

name: 和気鵜飼谷温泉
desc: 和気町にある日帰りの温泉施設です。和気町は吉井川が流れる町で、奈良時代の忠臣・和気清麻呂の生誕地として知られます。山を背にした静かな環境で、ゆったりと湯につかって旅の疲れを癒やせます。近くの藤公園や吉井川の河原など、町の見どころとあわせて立ち寄りたい温泉です。
quiz: 和気鵜飼谷温泉のある和気町で生まれたとされる、奈良時代の忠臣は誰？
desc_en: This is a day-trip hot spring facility in Wake Town. Wake is a town along the Yoshii River, known as the birthplace of Wake no Kiyomaro, a loyal retainer of the Nara period. In a quiet setting backed by mountains, you can soak at leisure and soothe the fatigue of travel. It is a hot spring to stop by along with the town's sights, such as the nearby Fuji Park and the banks of the Yoshii River.
quiz_en: Who is the loyal Nara-period retainer said to have been born in Wake Town, home of Wake Ukaidani Onsen?

name: 藤公園
desc: 和気清麻呂の生誕地・和気町にある藤の名所です。和気氏の姓がもとは藤野であったことにちなんで造られ、全国各地から集めた多くの品種の藤が植えられています。見頃の季節には、紫や白、薄紅色の長い花房が藤棚から垂れ下がり、甘い香りに包まれた園内は幻想的な雰囲気になります。
quiz: 和気町の藤公園と縁の深い、和気町出身とされる奈良時代の人物は誰？
desc_en: This famous wisteria spot is in Wake Town, the birthplace of Wake no Kiyomaro. It was created in connection with the fact that the Wake clan's surname was originally Fujino, and many varieties of wisteria gathered from all over Japan are planted here. In peak season, long clusters of purple, white and pale pink flowers hang from the trellises, and the park, wrapped in a sweet fragrance, takes on a dreamlike atmosphere.
quiz_en: Who is the Nara-period figure, said to come from Wake Town, who is closely connected to the town's Fuji Park?

name: 大通寺庭園
desc: 旧山陽道の宿場町・矢掛にある大通寺の庭園です。矢掛は本陣と脇本陣が共に現存する宿場町として知られ、白壁や格子の町並みが残ります。大通寺の庭は池を中心に石組や木々を配した趣深い構成で、季節の移ろいとともに表情を変えます。宿場町散策の途中で静かな時間を過ごせます。
quiz: 大通寺庭園のある宿場町・矢掛で、大名などが泊まった格式の高い宿を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: This is the garden of Daitsu-ji Temple in Yakage, a post town on the old Sanyo-do highway. Yakage is known as a post town where both the honjin and waki-honjin inns survive, and its streets of white walls and latticework remain. The garden of Daitsu-ji has a tasteful design of stones and trees arranged around a pond, changing its look with the seasons. You can spend a quiet moment here while exploring the post town.
quiz_en: In the post town of Yakage, home of Daitsu-ji Temple Garden, what were the high-ranking inns where feudal lords stayed called?

name: 大釣温泉
desc: 鏡野町奥津、吉井川の上流に湧く温泉です。近くには渓谷美で知られる奥津渓があり、川の浸食でできた甌穴や奇岩、秋の紅葉が見事です。山あいの静かな温泉で、渓流の音を聞きながらゆったりと湯につかれます。奥津温泉郷のひとつとして、渓谷散策とあわせて楽しみたい湯です。
quiz: 大釣温泉の近くにある、紅葉と奇岩の美しさで知られる渓谷の名前は何？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) wells up on the upper reaches of the Yoshii River in the Okutsu area of Kagamino Town. Nearby is Okutsukei Gorge, known for its beauty, with magnificent potholes and unusual rocks formed by river erosion and colorful autumn leaves. At this quiet mountain spa, you can soak at leisure while listening to the stream. One of the Okutsu hot spring villages, it is best enjoyed along with a walk in the gorge.
quiz_en: What is the name of the gorge near Otsuri Onsen that is known for the beauty of its autumn leaves and unusual rocks?

name: 奥津温泉
desc: 湯原、湯郷とともに「美作三湯」に数えられる温泉です。吉井川沿いに旅館が並び、川で女性が足踏みで洗濯をした「足踏み洗濯」の風習が名物として知られています。近くの奥津渓は紅葉の名所で、秋には渓谷が赤や黄色に染まります。足元から湯が湧く温泉など、湯そのものの良さも魅力です。
quiz: 奥津温泉に古くから伝わる、川の中で足を使って洗濯する風習を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) is counted among the "Three Hot Springs of Mimasaka," along with Yubara and Yunogo. Inns line the Yoshii River, and it is known for the custom of "ashibumi sentaku," in which women washed laundry in the river by treading on it. Nearby Okutsukei Gorge is famous for autumn leaves, turning red and yellow in fall. The quality of the water itself, including baths where it wells up from beneath your feet, is another attraction.
quiz_en: What is the traditional custom of Okutsu Onsen, in which laundry was washed in the river by treading on it, called?

name: のとろ温泉
desc: 鏡野町富西谷の山あいに湧く温泉です。鏡野町は岡山県北部、中国山地に抱かれた町で、豊かな森と清流に恵まれています。山の高い場所にあり、湯につかりながら周囲の山並みを眺められる開放感が魅力です。静かな山里で自然に囲まれ、ゆったりとした湯浴みのひとときを楽しめます。
quiz: のとろ温泉の山あいの湯で、湯につかりながら眺めたい景色は何ですか？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) wells up in the mountains of the Tominishidani area of Kagamino Town. Kagamino, in northern Okayama Prefecture, is a town nestled in the Chugoku Mountains, blessed with rich forests and clear streams. Set high in the mountains, its charm is the open feeling of gazing at the surrounding peaks while you soak. Surrounded by nature in a quiet mountain village, you can enjoy a leisurely bath.
quiz_en: While soaking in the mountain bath of Notoro Onsen, what kind of scenery would you most like to gaze at?

name: 上齋原温泉
desc: 鳥取県境に近い鏡野町上齋原に湧く温泉です。上齋原は中国山地の高原地帯にあり、冬は雪深く、恩原高原などでスキーやスノーボードが楽しめます。夏は涼しい気候を生かしたキャンプや湖畔の散策が人気です。高原の澄んだ空気の中で、季節のアクティビティのあとに湯で体を温められます。
quiz: 上齋原温泉の近くにある、冬はスキー、夏はキャンプでにぎわう高原の名前は？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) wells up in the Kamisaibara area of Kagamino Town, near the Tottori border. Kamisaibara lies in the highlands of the Chugoku Mountains; winters bring deep snow, and you can enjoy skiing and snowboarding at places such as the Onbara Highlands. In summer, camping and lakeside walks that take advantage of the cool climate are popular. In the clear highland air, you can warm up in the hot water after seasonal activities.
quiz_en: What is the name of the highland near Kamisaibara Onsen that is busy with skiing in winter and camping in summer?

name: 男女山公園
desc: 鏡野町土居にある公園です。鏡野町は吉井川の上流域に広がる自然豊かな町で、山や川に囲まれた穏やかな風景が魅力です。園内では季節の花や緑を楽しみながら散策でき、町並みや周囲の山々を眺めてのんびり過ごせます。地元の人々に親しまれる、憩いのひとときにぴったりの場所です。
quiz: 男女山公園という、ちょっと気になる名前。あなたはどんな由来を想像する？
desc_en: This park is in the Doi area of Kagamino Town. Kagamino is a nature-rich town spreading across the upper Yoshii River basin, and its charm is calm scenery surrounded by mountains and rivers. In the park you can stroll while enjoying seasonal flowers and greenery, and relax while gazing at the town and surrounding mountains. It is a place loved by locals, perfect for a moment of rest.
quiz_en: The name of this park is written with the characters for "man and woman mountain." What origin do you imagine behind such an intriguing name?

name: 誕生寺
desc: 久米南町にある浄土宗の寺院で、浄土宗の開祖・法然上人の生誕地に建てられたことで知られます。法然上人の父母の邸宅跡と伝わる場所に寺が開かれ、大きな山門や本堂が立ち並びます。広い境内には法然上人ゆかりの史跡があり、全国から多くの参拝者が訪れる浄土宗の聖地です。
quiz: 誕生寺の名前の由来となった、この地で生まれた浄土宗の開祖は誰でしょう？
desc_en: This Jodo-shu (Pure Land) temple in Kumenan Town is known for being built at the birthplace of Honen, the founder of the Jodo sect. The temple was founded on the site said to be the residence of Honen's parents, and a large gate and main hall stand here. In the spacious grounds are historic sites associated with Honen, and it is a sacred place of the Jodo sect visited by many worshippers from across Japan.
quiz_en: Who is the founder of the Jodo sect of Buddhism, born on this land, after whose birth Tanjo-ji Temple is named?

name: 三休公園
desc: 美咲町西川上の山の上にある公園です。美咲町は棚田の美しい風景や、卵かけご飯の名所としても知られる町です。高台の公園からは美咲の山並みや里の風景を一望でき、春の花や秋の紅葉など季節ごとの景観を楽しめます。名前のとおり、ひと休みしながらのんびりと景色を眺めたい場所です。
quiz: 三休公園のある美咲町で、名物として知られるシンプルな卵料理は何？
desc_en: This park is on a mountaintop in the Nishikawakami area of Misaki Town. Misaki is a town also known for beautiful terraced rice fields and as a famous place for tamago kake gohan (raw egg over rice). From the hilltop park you can take in Misaki's mountains and rural scenery, enjoying seasonal views such as spring flowers and autumn leaves. As its name suggests, it is a place to take a rest and leisurely enjoy the view.
quiz_en: What simple egg dish is Misaki Town, home of Sankyu Park, famous for as a local specialty?

name: 湯の瀬温泉郷
desc: 吉備中央町にある温泉郷です。吉備中央町は岡山県のほぼ中央、吉備高原に広がる町で、なだらかな丘陵に田畑や森が広がるのどかな風景が魅力です。山あいの静かな湯で、ゆったりと体を温めれば、日々の疲れが和らいでいきます。高原の自然を満喫するドライブの途中に立ち寄りたい温泉です。
quiz: 湯の瀬温泉郷のある吉備高原をドライブするなら、立ち寄りたい場所はどこ？
desc_en: This hot spring village is in Kibichuo Town. Located almost in the center of Okayama Prefecture, Kibichuo spreads across the Kibi Plateau, and its charm is peaceful scenery of fields and forests across gentle hills. Warming up slowly at this quiet mountain spa will ease the fatigue of everyday life. It is a hot spring to stop by during a drive to enjoy the nature of the plateau.
quiz_en: If you were driving across the Kibi Plateau, home of Yunose Onsen Village, where would you like to stop along the way?

name: 広島平和記念公園
desc: 1945年8月6日の原子爆弾で壊滅した広島市中心部に整備された公園です。元安川の対岸に立つ原爆ドームは世界遺産に登録され、園内には原爆死没者慰霊碑や平和の灯、原爆の子の像が並びます。平和記念資料館では被爆の実相を伝える資料が展示され、平和への祈りを新たにできる場所です。
quiz: 広島平和記念公園の対岸に立つ、世界遺産に登録された建物は何でしょう？
desc_en: This park was created in central Hiroshima, which was destroyed by the atomic bomb on August 6, 1945. The Atomic Bomb Dome, standing across the Motoyasu River, is a World Heritage Site, and the park contains the Memorial Cenotaph for the A-bomb Victims, the Flame of Peace and the Children's Peace Monument. The Peace Memorial Museum displays materials conveying the reality of the bombing, and it is a place to renew one's prayers for peace.
quiz_en: What is the World Heritage building that stands across the river from Hiroshima Peace Memorial Park?

name: 広島のカキ料理
desc: 広島県は牡蠣の生産量が全国一位を誇る牡蠣の名産地です。穏やかな瀬戸内海で筏を使って育てられる牡蠣は、身がふっくらとしていて濃厚な味わい。冬の旬には、焼き牡蠣、カキフライ、土手鍋、牡蠣めしなど多彩な料理で楽しめます。川に浮かぶ「かき船」で味わうのも広島ならではです。
quiz: 広島の牡蠣料理で、鍋のふちに味噌を土手のように塗って煮込む料理は何？
desc_en: Hiroshima Prefecture is famous for oysters, boasting the largest production in Japan. Raised on rafts in the calm Seto Inland Sea, the oysters are plump and rich in flavor. In the winter season, you can enjoy them in many dishes, such as grilled oysters, fried oysters, dote-nabe hot pot and oyster rice. Eating them on a "kaki-bune," an oyster boat floating on the river, is also unique to Hiroshima.
quiz_en: Which Hiroshima oyster dish is simmered in a pot whose rim is coated with miso like an embankment?

name: 松濤園
desc: 呉市下蒲刈島にある文化施設の集まりで、江戸時代に朝鮮通信使が寄港した島の歴史を伝えています。朝鮮通信使資料館「御馳走一番館」では、通信使をもてなした料理の再現模型などを展示しています。古い民家を移築した建物や、陶磁器の展示館もあり、瀬戸内の島で文化に触れられます。
quiz: 下蒲刈島が江戸時代に寄港地としてもてなした、朝鮮からの外交使節団は何？
desc_en: This group of cultural facilities on Shimokamagari Island in Kure City conveys the history of an island where Korean diplomatic missions stopped during the Edo period. The Korean Embassy Museum, "Gochiso Ichibankan," displays models recreating the dishes served to the envoys and more. There are also relocated old houses and a ceramics museum, letting you experience culture on an island of the Seto Inland Sea.
quiz_en: What were the diplomatic missions from Korea that Shimokamagari Island hosted as a port of call during the Edo period called?

name: 休暇村大久野島
addr: 竹原市忠海町大久野島
desc: 竹原市の沖に浮かぶ大久野島は、たくさんの野生化したウサギが暮らす「ウサギの島」として知られます。島には休暇村があり、海水浴やサイクリングなどのんびりとした島時間を楽しめます。一方で、戦時中には毒ガスが製造された歴史を持ち、島内の資料館では平和の大切さを伝えています。
quiz: 大久野島はたくさん暮らしている動物から、別名「何の島」と呼ばれている？
desc_en: Okunoshima, an island off the coast of Takehara City, is known as "Rabbit Island," home to many feral rabbits. There is a Kyukamura resort lodge on the island, where you can enjoy relaxed island time with swimming and cycling. On the other hand, the island has a history of poison gas production during the war, and the museum on the island conveys the importance of peace.
quiz_en: Because of the many animals living there, Okunoshima is also known as the island of which animal?

name: 瀬戸内海の多島景観
desc: 三原市の沿岸からは、瀬戸内海に大小の島々が浮かぶ多島美の風景を望めます。筆影山や竜王山といった海辺の山に登れば、穏やかな海に島影が幾重にも重なり、夕日に染まる景色は格別です。三原はタコの町としても知られ、港町らしい海の幸とあわせて瀬戸内の魅力を味わえます。
quiz: 三原の多島美を眺めたあと、港町・三原の名物として味わいたい海の幸は何？
desc_en: From the coast of Mihara City you can view the beautiful scenery of islands large and small floating in the Seto Inland Sea. Climb seaside mountains such as Mount Fudekage or Mount Ryuo, and you will see layers of island silhouettes on the calm sea, with the view at sunset being exceptional. Mihara is also known as an octopus town, so you can savor the charms of the Seto Inland Sea along with seafood typical of a port town.
quiz_en: After admiring Mihara's island views, which seafood would you want to taste as a specialty of the port town of Mihara?

name: すなみ海浜公園海水浴
desc: 三原市須波にある海浜公園で、夏は海水浴場としてにぎわいます。瀬戸内海の穏やかな波が打ち寄せる砂浜からは、沖に浮かぶ島々を眺めることができ、のんびりとした瀬戸内らしい風景が広がります。家族で海遊びを楽しんだり、夕暮れの海辺を散歩したりと、ゆったりとした時間を過ごせます。
quiz: すなみ海浜公園で海水浴をしたあと、三原でぜひ食べたいグルメは何ですか？
desc_en: This seaside park in the Sunami area of Mihara City is busy as a swimming beach in summer. From the sandy beach, where the gentle waves of the Seto Inland Sea lap the shore, you can see islands floating offshore, a relaxed scene typical of the Seto Inland Sea. You can spend leisurely time playing in the sea with your family or walking along the shore at dusk.
quiz_en: After a swim at Sunami Seaside Park, what local food would you most want to eat in Mihara?

name: 県立中央森林公園・三景園
desc: 広島空港に隣接する広大な森林公園で、サイクリングコースやゴルフ場などが整っています。園内にある日本庭園「三景園」は、広島県の山・里・海の三つの景観を表現した回遊式庭園で、滝から流れ出た水が渓流となり、やがて大きな池へと注ぐ構成です。春の桜、秋の紅葉と四季折々の美しさが楽しめます。
quiz: 三景園の庭が表現している、広島県の3つの景観とは山・里と、あと何？
name_en: Hiroshima Central Forest Park and Sankeien Garden
desc_en: This vast forest park next to Hiroshima Airport offers cycling courses, a golf course and more. Sankeien, the Japanese garden within the park, is a strolling garden that expresses three landscapes of Hiroshima Prefecture, mountains, villages and sea, designed so that water flowing from a waterfall becomes a stream and eventually pours into a large pond. You can enjoy beauty in every season, from spring cherry blossoms to autumn leaves.
quiz_en: Sankeien Garden expresses three landscapes of Hiroshima Prefecture: mountains, villages, and what is the third one?

name: 果実の森公園
desc: 三原市大和町の丘陵地にある、果物をテーマにした公園です。広島県中部の高原地帯に位置し、園内では季節の果樹が育てられ、フルーツ狩りなどを楽しめます。広々とした芝生や遊具もあり、家族でのんびり過ごせるのも魅力です。実りの季節には甘い香りが漂い、旬の味覚との出会いが待っています。
quiz: 果実の森公園でフルーツ狩りをするなら、いちばん摘んでみたい果物は何？
desc_en: This fruit-themed park is on hills in the Daiwa area of Mihara City. Located in the highlands of central Hiroshima Prefecture, it grows seasonal fruit trees and lets you enjoy fruit picking. There are also wide lawns and play equipment, and families can relax here at leisure. In harvest season a sweet scent fills the air, and encounters with seasonal flavors await.
quiz_en: If you went fruit picking at Kajitsu no Mori Fruit Park, which fruit would you most like to pick yourself?

name: しまなみ海道諸橋
desc: 広島県尾道市と愛媛県今治市を結ぶ西瀬戸自動車道「しまなみ海道」には、島々をつなぐいくつもの橋が架かっています。吊り橋や斜張橋など形もさまざまで、橋の上からは瀬戸内海の多島美が一望できます。自転車や歩行者用の道も整備され、サイクリストの聖地として世界中から人々が訪れます。
quiz: しまなみ海道は、自転車で島々をめぐる人たちから何の聖地と呼ばれている？
desc_en: The Nishiseto Expressway, known as the "Shimanami Kaido," links Onomichi in Hiroshima Prefecture and Imabari in Ehime Prefecture, with several bridges connecting the islands. Their shapes vary, including suspension and cable-stayed bridges, and from the bridges you can take in the beautiful islands of the Seto Inland Sea. Paths for bicycles and pedestrians are also in place, and people come from all over the world to this cyclists' paradise.
quiz_en: Among people who tour the islands by bicycle, the Shimanami Kaido is called a holy land of what activity?

name: 千光寺山ロープウェイ
desc: 尾道の市街地から千光寺山の山頂まで、わずか数分で結ぶロープウェイです。ゴンドラからは尾道水道を行き交う船や、坂の町に密集する家並み、対岸の向島が一望できます。山頂の千光寺公園は桜の名所として知られ、帰りは文学のこみちや古寺をめぐりながら坂道を下るのが定番の楽しみ方です。
quiz: 千光寺山ロープウェイから見下ろせる、尾道と向島の間の海峡を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: This ropeway connects central Onomichi with the summit of Mount Senkoji in just a few minutes. From the gondola you can take in ships crossing the Onomichi Channel, houses crowded on the hillside town and Mukaishima Island on the opposite shore. Senkoji Park at the summit is known for cherry blossoms, and the classic way to return is to walk down the slopes along the Path of Literature, visiting old temples.
quiz_en: What is the name of the narrow strait between Onomichi and Mukaishima that you can look down on from the Mount Senkoji Ropeway?

name: 因島水軍城
desc: 中世に瀬戸内海で活躍した村上水軍のうち、因島を拠点とした因島村上氏の歴史を伝える資料館です。城の形をした建物の中には、武具や古文書など水軍ゆかりの品々が展示されています。海の武士団がどのように瀬戸内を支配したのか、そのたくましい歴史に触れられる、因島ならではの施設です。
quiz: 因島水軍城で紹介されている、瀬戸内海で活躍した海の武士団の名前は何？
desc_en: This museum conveys the history of the Innoshima Murakami clan, a branch of the Murakami Suigun naval forces that were active in the Seto Inland Sea in medieval times, based on Innoshima. Inside the castle-shaped building, armor, old documents and other items associated with the naval forces are displayed. It is a facility unique to Innoshima, where you can touch the bold history of how these sea warriors controlled the Seto Inland Sea.
quiz_en: What is the name of the band of sea warriors active in the Seto Inland Sea that is introduced at Innoshima Suigun Castle?

name: 因島公園
desc: しまなみ海道が通る因島の土生町にある公園です。島の高台に広がり、瀬戸内海とそこに浮かぶ島々や、造船の町として知られる土生の港を見渡せます。季節の花や緑の中を散策しながら、海の青さと島の暮らしを感じられるのが魅力です。サイクリングの途中に立ち寄って、ひと休みするのもおすすめです。
quiz: 因島公園の高台から瀬戸内海を眺めたら、あなたは何を一番に探しますか？
desc_en: This park is in the Habu area of Innoshima, an island along the Shimanami Kaido. Spreading over high ground on the island, it overlooks the Seto Inland Sea with its floating islands and the port of Habu, known as a shipbuilding town. Its charm is feeling the blue of the sea and island life while strolling among seasonal flowers and greenery. Stopping by for a rest during a cycling trip is also recommended.
quiz_en: Looking out over the Seto Inland Sea from the high ground of Innoshima Park, what would you search for first?

name: 福山市立動物園
addr: 福山市芦田町大字福田276-1
desc: 福山市芦田町の緑豊かな丘陵地にある動物園です。ゾウやキリンといった人気の動物から小動物まで、さまざまな生き物を間近で観察できます。自然の地形を生かした園内は歩くだけでも心地よく、家族連れでにぎわいます。動物たちの愛らしいしぐさに、大人も子どもも思わず笑顔になれる場所です。
quiz: 福山市立動物園に行ったら、あなたが一番会いたい動物は何ですか？
desc_en: This zoo is located in the green hills of the Ashida area of Fukuyama City. You can observe a wide variety of creatures up close, from popular animals such as elephants and giraffes to small animals. The grounds, which make use of the natural terrain, are pleasant just to walk through, and the zoo is busy with families. It is a place where the animals' adorable gestures make both adults and children smile.
quiz_en: If you visited Fukuyama Zoo, which animal would you most like to meet there, and why?

name: 磐台寺阿伏兎観音堂
addr: 福山市沼隈町大字能登原5-2
desc: 福山市沼隈町、阿伏兎岬の突端の断崖に建つ観音堂です。海に突き出した岩の上に朱塗りのお堂がたたずむ姿は、瀬戸内を代表する景観のひとつです。海上安全や安産の祈願所として信仰され、回廊を進むと眼下に海が迫り、スリル満点。鞆の浦からも近く、あわせて訪ねたい名所です。
quiz: 阿伏兎観音は、昔から船乗りたちが何を祈る観音様として信仰してきた？
desc_en: This Kannon hall stands on a cliff at the tip of Cape Abuto in the Numakuma area of Fukuyama City. The sight of the vermilion hall perched on a rock jutting into the sea is one of the signature views of the Seto Inland Sea. It is worshipped as a place to pray for safety at sea and safe childbirth, and as you walk the corridor the sea looms right below you, a real thrill. It is also close to Tomonoura, so visit both together.
quiz_en: Since long ago, what have sailors prayed for at Abuto Kannon, the hall perched above the sea?

name: 三郎の滝
desc: 府中市三郎丸町にある滝で、なめらかな岩肌を水が流れ落ちる様子が涼しげです。夏には、この岩肌を天然の滑り台にして滑り降りる「滝すべり」を楽しむ人々でにぎわいます。周辺は緑豊かな山あいで、水遊びや散策にぴったり。自然の中で思いきり遊べる、夏の府中の人気スポットです。
quiz: 三郎の滝で夏に楽しめる、岩肌を天然の滑り台にして遊ぶことを何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: This waterfall in the Saburomaru area of Fuchu City looks refreshing as water flows down its smooth rock face. In summer it is busy with people enjoying "taki-suberi" (waterfall sliding), using the rock face as a natural slide. The surroundings are lush mountains, perfect for water play and walks. It is a popular summer spot in Fuchu where you can play to your heart's content in nature.
quiz_en: What is the summer activity at Saburo Falls, in which people use the smooth rock face as a natural slide, called?

name: 河佐峡
desc: 府中市久佐町、芦田川の上流に開けた渓谷です。清らかな流れの両岸に木々が茂り、四季折々の景色が楽しめます。夏はキャンプや川遊びを楽しむ人々でにぎわい、秋は紅葉が水面を彩ります。府中の市街地からも近く、気軽に自然の中でリフレッシュできる場所として地元で親しまれています。
quiz: 河佐峡でキャンプをするなら、夜にたき火を囲んで何を作って食べたい？
desc_en: This gorge opens on the upper reaches of the Ashida River in the Kusa area of Fuchu City. Trees grow thickly on both banks of the clear stream, and you can enjoy scenery in every season. In summer it is busy with people camping and playing in the river, and in autumn colorful leaves decorate the water. Close to central Fuchu, it is loved locally as a place to refresh easily in nature.
quiz_en: If you went camping at Kawasa Gorge, what would you like to cook and eat around the campfire at night?

name: 羽高湖
desc: 府中市諸毛町の高原にある湖で、周囲には森が広がり、キャンプ場やコテージなどが整っています。標高が高く夏でもさわやかな空気に包まれ、湖畔の散策や星空観察など、自然の中でゆったりとした時間を過ごせます。秋には周囲の木々が色づき、湖面に映る紅葉が美しい景色をつくり出します。
quiz: 羽高湖の湖畔でキャンプをするなら、夜にいちばん楽しみたいことは何？
desc_en: This lake lies in the highlands of the Morogemachi area of Fuchu City, surrounded by forest, with campgrounds and cottages. At a high elevation and wrapped in fresh air even in summer, it lets you spend relaxed time in nature, with lakeside walks and stargazing. In autumn the surrounding trees change color, and the autumn leaves reflected on the lake create beautiful scenery.
quiz_en: If you went camping on the shore of Lake Hadaka, what would you most look forward to doing at night?

name: 安楽寺
desc: 府中市目崎町にある寺院です。府中市は備後の国府が置かれた歴史ある町で、家具やみその産地としても知られています。町を見守るように建つ寺の境内は静かで、季節の花や木々が参拝者の心をなごませます。府中の古い町並みや旧街道を歩く途中で、ひと息ついてお参りしたい場所です。
quiz: 安楽寺のある府中市は、かつて何という国の国府が置かれた町でしょう？
desc_en: This temple is in the Mesaki area of Fuchu City. Fuchu is a historic town where the provincial capital of Bingo was located, and it is also known for producing furniture and miso. The grounds of the temple, which stands as if watching over the town, are quiet, and seasonal flowers and trees soothe visitors. It is a place to take a breather and pray while walking Fuchu's old streets and former highway.
quiz_en: Fuchu City, home of Anraku-ji Temple, was once the site of the provincial capital of which old province?

name: 県立みよし公園
addr: 三次市四拾貫町神田谷
desc: 三次市にある県立の公園で、広い園内に芝生広場や遊具、スポーツ施設などが整っています。三次市は江の川・西城川・馬洗川が合流する川の町で、秋から冬の朝には盆地を覆う「霧の海」が見られることで知られます。緑の中で体を動かしたり、のんびり散策したりと、思い思いに過ごせます。
quiz: 三次盆地で、秋から冬の朝に町を覆いつくす霧の景色を何と呼んでいる？
desc_en: This prefectural park in Miyoshi City has lawn areas, play equipment and sports facilities across its spacious grounds. Miyoshi is a river town where the Gonokawa, Saijo and Basen rivers meet, known for the "sea of fog" that covers the basin on autumn and winter mornings. You can spend time as you like, exercising in the greenery or taking a leisurely walk.
quiz_en: What is the name for the fog scenery that blankets the town in the Miyoshi Basin on autumn and winter mornings?

name: 平田観光農園
desc: 三次市上田町にある観光農園で、ぶどうやりんご、なしなど、季節ごとにさまざまな果物の収穫体験を楽しめます。三次の山あいに広がる果樹園で、自分で摘んだばかりの果物を味わう喜びは格別です。季節を変えて何度訪れても違う果物に出会える、果物好きにはたまらない実りあふれる場所です。
quiz: 平田観光農園でもぎたての果物を味わうなら、あなたはどの季節に行きたい？
desc_en: This tourist farm in the Kamita area of Miyoshi City lets you enjoy harvesting a variety of fruits depending on the season, such as grapes, apples and pears. Tasting fruit you have just picked yourself in orchards spreading across the mountains of Miyoshi is a special joy. Visit in different seasons and you will meet different fruits each time, making it an irresistible, bountiful place for fruit lovers.
quiz_en: If you wanted to taste freshly picked fruit at Hirata Tourist Farm, in which season would you like to go?

name: 江の川カヌー公園 さくぎ
desc: 三次市作木町、江の川のほとりにあるアウトドアの拠点です。中国地方最大の川・江の川のゆったりとした流れで、カヌーやカヤックを楽しむことができます。キャンプ場やコテージもあり、川辺で自然に包まれた一日を過ごせます。山あいの静かな風景の中、川面を進む爽快感は格別です。
quiz: 江の川カヌー公園さくぎで、カヌーに乗って川を下ったら何が見たい？
desc_en: This outdoor base is on the banks of the Gonokawa River in the Sakugi area of Miyoshi City. On the gentle flow of the Gonokawa, the largest river in the Chugoku region, you can enjoy canoeing and kayaking. There are also campgrounds and cottages, so you can spend a day by the river surrounded by nature. The exhilaration of gliding across the water amid quiet mountain scenery is exceptional.
quiz_en: If you paddled down the river in a canoe at Gonokawa Canoe Park Sakugi, what would you like to see along the way?

name: 出雲大社備後分院
addr: 三次市三良坂町三良坂2674
desc: 三次市三良坂町にある出雲大社の分院です。島根の出雲大社と同じく、縁結びの神として知られる大国主大神をお祀りし、良縁や家内安全を願う人々が訪れます。三次の山あいの静かな環境の中、遠く出雲まで足を運ばずとも縁結びの神様にお参りできる場所として、地域の人々に親しまれています。
quiz: 出雲大社備後分院で縁結びを願うなら、どんなご縁をお願いしたいですか？
desc_en: This is a branch of Izumo Taisha in the Miyoshi area of Miyoshi City. Like Izumo Taisha in Shimane, it enshrines Okuninushi no Okami, known as the god of matchmaking, and people visit to pray for good relationships and family safety. In a quiet mountain setting in Miyoshi, it is beloved by locals as a place where they can pray to the god of matchmaking without traveling all the way to Izumo.
quiz_en: If you prayed for good connections at the Izumo Taisha Bingo Branch Shrine, what kind of bond would you wish for?

name: 国営備北丘陵公園
desc: 庄原市にある、中国地方で唯一の国営公園です。広大な丘陵地には、花畑や芝生広場、里山の暮らしを再現したエリアなどが広がり、一日中遊べます。春のチューリップや秋のコスモスなど季節の花が彩り、冬には園内が光に包まれるイルミネーションも行われ、家族連れでにぎわいます。
quiz: 国営備北丘陵公園は、中国地方で何という種類の公園として唯一の存在？
desc_en: This park in Shobara City is the only national government park in the Chugoku region. Across its vast hills spread flower fields, lawn areas and an area recreating satoyama rural life, so you can play all day. Seasonal flowers such as spring tulips and autumn cosmos add color, and in winter the park is wrapped in illuminations, drawing crowds of families.
quiz_en: Bihoku Hillside Park in Shobara is the only park of what special type to be found in the Chugoku region?

name: どえりゃ祭
desc: 庄原市西城町で開かれる夏祭りです。西城町は中国山地の山あいにある町で、比婆山の伝説や、県境の山々の豊かな自然に恵まれています。「どえりゃ」という土地の言葉を思わせる名前のとおり、元気いっぱいのにぎわいが町を包みます。地元の人々の熱気とあたたかさに触れられる、山里の夏の風物詩です。
quiz: どえりゃ祭のある西城町の山で、伝説の類人猿「ヒバゴン」が出たとされる山は？
desc_en: This summer festival is held in the Saijo area of Shobara City. Saijo is a town in the Chugoku Mountains, blessed with the legends of Mount Hiba and the rich nature of the mountains along the prefectural border. True to its name, which evokes the local dialect word "doerya," energetic festivities fill the town. It is a summer tradition of the mountain village where you can feel the enthusiasm and warmth of the locals.
quiz_en: In which mountain near Saijo, home of the Doerya Festival, is the legendary ape-like creature "Hibagon" said to have appeared?

name: 遊ＹＯＵさろん東城
desc: 庄原市東城町にある施設で、町歩きの拠点になります。東城は江戸時代に城下町・宿場町として栄えた町で、今も白壁や格子のある古い町家が残る通りに、往時のにぎわいがしのばれます。通りには造り酒屋などの古い建物も見られ、昔ながらの風情を感じながらのんびりと散策を楽しめます。
quiz: 遊YOUさろん東城から古い町並みを歩くなら、立ち寄ってみたいお店は何？
desc_en: This facility in the Tojo area of Shobara City serves as a base for walking around town. Tojo prospered as a castle town and post town in the Edo period, and along streets where old townhouses with white walls and latticework still remain, you can sense the bustle of the past. Old buildings such as sake breweries can be seen along the street, and you can enjoy a leisurely stroll while feeling the old-fashioned charm.
quiz_en: If you walked the old streets starting from Yu YOU Salon Tojo, what kind of shop would you like to drop in on?

name: 東城温泉
desc: 庄原市東城町にある温泉です。東城町は岡山県との県境に近い山あいの町で、近くには石灰岩の大地が刻んだ帝釈峡など、豊かな自然が広がります。山里の静かな湯でのんびり体を温めれば、旅の疲れがすっと消えていきます。渓谷散策や古い町並みめぐりとあわせて楽しみたい温泉です。
quiz: 東城温泉で温まったあと、近くの渓谷・帝釈峡で一番見てみたいものは何？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) is in the Tojo area of Shobara City. Tojo is a mountain town near the border with Okayama Prefecture, surrounded by rich nature such as Taishakukyo Gorge, carved into a limestone plateau. Warming up leisurely in a quiet mountain village spa, the fatigue of travel melts away. It is a hot spring to enjoy along with gorge walks and touring the old streets.
quiz_en: After warming up at Tojo Onsen, what would you most like to see at the nearby Taishakukyo Gorge?

name: 鮎の里公園
desc: 庄原市口和町にある、川と親しむ公園です。口和町は中国山地の山あいにある静かな町で、清流が流れ、鮎の棲む川として知られます。夏には川遊びや鮎のつかみどりなどを楽しめ、自然の中で家族そろって過ごせます。炭火で焼いた鮎の塩焼きは、清流の里ならではの夏の味覚です。
quiz: 鮎の里公園で清流の鮎を味わうなら、塩焼き以外にどんな食べ方を試したい？
desc_en: This park in the Kuchiwa area of Shobara City lets you get close to the river. Kuchiwa is a quiet town in the Chugoku Mountains with clear streams, known for rivers where ayu (sweetfish) live. In summer you can enjoy river play and catching ayu by hand, spending time with the whole family in nature. Ayu grilled with salt over charcoal is a summer delicacy unique to this village of clear streams.
quiz_en: If you tasted clear-stream ayu at Ayu no Sato Park, what way of eating it besides salt-grilled would you like to try?

name: 高野温泉
desc: 庄原市高野町にある温泉です。高野は島根県境に近い高原地帯にあり、冬は雪深い地域です。りんごの産地として知られ、秋には果樹園が赤い実で彩られます。雪の季節に温泉で体を温めるのはもちろん、山あいの自然の中で四季を通じてのんびりとした湯浴みを楽しめます。
quiz: 高野温泉のある庄原市高野町で、秋に収穫される名産の果物は何でしょう？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) is in the Takano area of Shobara City. Takano lies in the highlands near the Shimane border and gets deep snow in winter. It is known for apples, and in autumn the orchards are colored with red fruit. Besides warming up in the hot spring during the snowy season, you can enjoy leisurely bathing in mountain nature all year round.
quiz_en: What famous fruit is harvested in autumn in the Takano area of Shobara City, home of Takano Onsen?

name: 三倉岳県立自然公園
desc: 大竹市栗谷町にある自然公園で、三つの花崗岩の岩峰がそびえる三倉岳が中心です。切り立った岩壁はロッククライミングの名所として知られ、登山道を登れば、眼下に瀬戸内海の島々を望む絶景が広がります。山麓にはキャンプ場もあり、新緑や紅葉の季節には多くの登山者でにぎわいます。
quiz: 三倉岳の切り立った岩壁で、多くの人が挑戦するスポーツは何でしょう？
desc_en: This natural park in the Kuriya area of Otake City centers on Mount Mikura, with its three towering granite peaks. Its sheer rock walls are known as a famous rock climbing spot, and climbing the trail reveals a superb view of the islands of the Seto Inland Sea below. There is also a campground at the foot of the mountain, and in the seasons of fresh green and autumn leaves it is busy with many climbers.
quiz_en: What sport do many people take on at the sheer granite rock walls of Mount Mikura?

name: 阿多田島
desc: 大竹市の沖、広島湾に浮かぶ小さな島です。大竹港から船で渡ることができ、漁業が盛んな島として牡蠣やハマチの養殖などが行われています。静かな集落と穏やかな海に囲まれ、島ならではのゆったりとした時間が流れます。釣りや海辺の散策を楽しみながら、のんびりとした島旅を満喫できます。
quiz: 阿多田島に船で渡ったら、島の海辺でのんびり釣ってみたい魚は何ですか？
desc_en: This small island floats in Hiroshima Bay off the coast of Otake City. You can reach it by boat from Otake Port, and as an island where fishing thrives, oysters and yellowtail are farmed here. Surrounded by a quiet village and calm sea, it has a relaxed pace unique to islands. You can fully enjoy a leisurely island trip while fishing and strolling along the shore.
quiz_en: After taking the boat over to Atada Island, which fish would you like to try catching at leisure by the shore?

name: 憩いの森公園
desc: 東広島市西条町の丘陵地にある公園です。西条は酒蔵が立ち並ぶ酒どころとして知られ、名水に恵まれた町です。園内には森の散策路や広場があり、木々に囲まれてのんびりとした時間を過ごせます。家族連れの憩いの場として親しまれ、酒蔵通りの散策とあわせて訪れるのもおすすめです。
quiz: 憩いの森公園のある西条は、何の蔵が立ち並ぶ町として知られている？
desc_en: This park is on hills in the Saijo area of Higashihiroshima City. Saijo is known as a sake town lined with breweries and blessed with excellent water. The park has forest walking paths and open spaces, where you can spend relaxed time surrounded by trees. It is loved as a place of rest for families, and visiting together with a stroll along the brewery street is also recommended.
quiz_en: Saijo, home of Ikoi no Mori Park, is known as a town lined with what kind of storehouses?

name: 嚴島神社
desc: 宮島の入り江に建つ、海上に浮かぶような社殿で知られる神社です。平清盛の崇敬を受け、寝殿造の様式を取り入れた社殿が整えられました。満潮時には朱塗りの大鳥居と社殿が海に浮かび、干潮時には鳥居の根元まで歩いて行けます。1996年に世界遺産に登録され、日本三景のひとつにも数えられます。
quiz: 嚴島神社の社殿を、現在のような壮麗な姿に整えた平安時代の武将は誰？
desc_en: Standing in a cove of Miyajima, this shrine is known for buildings that seem to float on the sea. Revered by Taira no Kiyomori, its buildings were arranged incorporating the shinden-zukuri style of aristocratic residences. At high tide the vermilion Great Torii (shrine gate) and the shrine appear to float on the water, while at low tide you can walk to the base of the gate. It was registered as a World Heritage Site in 1996 and is counted among the Three Views of Japan.
quiz_en: Which Heian-period warlord arranged the buildings of Itsukushima Shrine into the magnificent form they have today?

name: 宮島包ヶ浦自然公園
desc: 宮島の東側、包ヶ浦にある自然公園です。穏やかな浜辺では夏に海水浴が楽しめ、キャンプ場やバンガローも整っています。島には野生の鹿が暮らし、のんびり歩く姿に出会えることもあります。嚴島神社周辺のにぎわいから少し離れ、宮島の豊かな自然と静かな海辺の時間を満喫できる場所です。
quiz: 宮島の包ヶ浦自然公園で、のんびり歩く姿に出会えるかもしれない動物は何？
desc_en: This nature park is at Tsutsumigaura on the east side of Miyajima. Its calm beach offers swimming in summer, and there are campgrounds and bungalows. Wild deer live on the island, and you may come across them strolling leisurely. A little away from the bustle around Itsukushima Shrine, it is a place to fully enjoy Miyajima's rich nature and quiet seaside time.
quiz_en: At Miyajima's Tsutsumigaura Nature Park, which animal might you encounter strolling leisurely around the grounds?

name: 湧永満之記念庭園
addr: 安芸高田市甲田町糘地
desc: 安芸高田市甲田町にある日本庭園です。広々とした園内には池や築山が配され、季節の花木が四季折々の景観をつくり出します。春の桜やつつじ、秋の紅葉が水面に映り込む風景は趣深く、ゆったりと庭を巡りながら心静かな時間を過ごせます。安芸高田の山里に整えられた、落ち着いた癒やしの空間です。
quiz: 湧永満之記念庭園の池のほとりで、どの季節の景色をゆっくり眺めたい？
desc_en: This Japanese garden is in the Koda area of Akitakata City. Ponds and artificial hills are arranged across its spacious grounds, and seasonal flowering trees create views in every season. The scenery of spring cherry blossoms and azaleas or autumn leaves reflected on the water is elegant, and you can spend a peaceful time slowly touring the garden. It is a calm, healing space created in the mountain villages of Akitakata.
quiz_en: Beside the pond of Wakunaga Mitsuyuki Memorial Garden, which season's scenery would you like to gaze at slowly?

name: 神楽門前湯治村（神楽公演）
addr: 安芸高田市美土里町本郷4627
desc: 安芸高田市美土里町にある、神楽と温泉をテーマにした施設です。昔の湯治場の町並みを再現した敷地内には宿や温泉が並び、専用の神楽ドームでは定期的に神楽公演が行われます。安芸高田は神楽が盛んな土地で、きらびやかな衣装と勇壮な舞、大蛇が火を噴く迫力の演目に引き込まれます。
quiz: 神楽門前湯治村で上演される神楽の演目で、大蛇を退治する人気の演目は？
desc_en: This facility in the Midori area of Akitakata City is themed on kagura (sacred dance) and hot springs. Inns and hot springs line the grounds, which recreate the streets of an old healing spa, and kagura performances are held regularly in a dedicated Kagura Dome. Akitakata is a land where kagura thrives, and you will be captivated by its dazzling costumes, powerful dances and thrilling plays in which a giant serpent breathes fire.
quiz_en: Among the kagura plays performed at Kagura Monzen Toji Village, what is the popular one in which a giant serpent is slain?

name: 切串観光干潟
desc: 江田島市の切串地区にある干潟です。江田島は広島湾に浮かぶ島で、牡蠣の養殖が盛んな地域としても知られます。潮が引くと広い干潟が現れ、潮干狩りを楽しむ人々でにぎわいます。小さなカニや貝を探しながら、海の生き物と触れ合えるのも魅力です。穏やかな瀬戸内の海辺で、のんびり過ごせます。
quiz: 切串観光干潟で潮干狩りをするなら、いちばん見つけたい貝は何ですか？
desc_en: These tidal flats are in the Kirikushi district of Etajima City. Etajima is an island in Hiroshima Bay, also known as an area where oyster farming thrives. When the tide goes out, wide flats appear and are busy with people enjoying shellfish gathering. Another charm is getting close to sea creatures while searching for small crabs and shells. You can spend relaxed time on the calm shores of the Seto Inland Sea.
quiz_en: If you went clam digging at the Kirikushi Tidal Flats, which kind of shellfish would you most want to find?

name: 水分峡森林公園
desc: 広島市に隣接する府中町にある森林公園で、渓流沿いに散策路が続きます。市街地からほど近いとは思えないほど豊かな自然が残り、清らかな流れや小さな滝、木々の緑が訪れる人を癒やします。夏は水遊び、秋は紅葉狩りを楽しめ、気軽に出かけられる身近な自然として親しまれています。
quiz: 水分峡森林公園の渓流沿いを歩くなら、新緑と紅葉どちらの季節に行きたい？
desc_en: This forest park in Fuchu Town, next to Hiroshima City, has walking paths along a mountain stream. Rich nature remains here, hard to believe so close to the city, and the clear stream, small waterfalls and green trees soothe visitors. You can enjoy water play in summer and autumn leaf viewing in fall, and it is loved as a familiar natural spot that is easy to visit.
quiz_en: If you walked along the stream at Mikumari Gorge Forest Park, would you rather go in the season of fresh green or autumn leaves?

name: 海田総合公園
desc: 広島市に隣接する海田町の高台にある総合公園です。広い芝生広場や遊具、スポーツ施設などが整い、地元の家族連れでにぎわいます。高台からは海田の町並みや広島湾方面を見渡すことができ、季節の花や緑を楽しみながらの散策も気持ちよく、日常の中で気軽にリフレッシュできる場所です。
quiz: 海田総合公園の高台から町を見渡したら、どんな景色が一番印象に残った？
desc_en: This general park is on high ground in Kaita Town, next to Hiroshima City. It has wide lawn areas, play equipment and sports facilities, and is busy with local families. From the high ground you can look out over the streets of Kaita toward Hiroshima Bay, and strolling while enjoying seasonal flowers and greenery is pleasant, making it an easy place to refresh in daily life.
quiz_en: Looking out over the town from the high ground of Kaita General Park, what scenery left the strongest impression on you?

name: 三段峡
desc: 安芸太田町にある全長十数キロにおよぶ大渓谷で、国の特別名勝に指定されています。三段滝、二段滝、猿飛、黒淵などの見どころが続き、とくに黒淵では渡し舟に乗って深い淵を進むことができます。原生林に囲まれた渓谷は、新緑の季節も紅葉の季節も、息をのむほどの美しさを見せてくれます。
quiz: 三段峡の黒淵で、深い緑色の淵を渡るのに乗ることができる乗り物は何？
desc_en: This great gorge in Akiota Town stretches over ten kilometers and is designated a Special Place of Scenic Beauty of Japan. Highlights such as Sandan Falls, Nidan Falls, Sarutobi and Kurobuchi follow one after another, and at Kurobuchi in particular you can ride a ferry boat across a deep pool. Surrounded by primeval forest, the gorge shows breathtaking beauty in both the fresh green and autumn leaves seasons.
quiz_en: At Kurobuchi in Sandankyo Gorge, what can you ride to cross the deep green pool there?

name: 壬生の花田植
desc: 北広島町壬生地区で毎年6月に行われる田植えの行事で、ユネスコ無形文化遺産に登録されています。華やかな飾りをつけた牛が田をならし、絣の着物に菅笠姿の早乙女たちが、太鼓や笛の囃子と田植え歌に合わせて苗を植えていきます。豊作を祈る、色彩豊かで心浮き立つ農村の祭りです。
quiz: 壬生の花田植で、華やかな衣装を身につけて苗を植える女性たちを何と呼ぶ？
name_en: Mibu no Hana Taue (Flower Rice Planting)
desc_en: This rice planting event, held every June in the Mibu district of Kitahiroshima Town, is inscribed on UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage list. Cattle wearing gorgeous decorations level the paddies, and young women called saotome, in kasuri kimono and sedge hats, plant seedlings to the rhythm of drums, flutes and rice-planting songs. It is a colorful, uplifting rural festival praying for a good harvest.
quiz_en: At Mibu no Hana Taue, what are the women who plant the rice seedlings in gorgeous costumes called?

name: 神峰山
desc: 芸予諸島の大崎上島にある島の最高峰です。山頂の展望台からは、瀬戸内海に大小の島々が浮かぶ多島美の大パノラマが広がり、晴れた日には四国の山並みまで見渡せます。夕暮れどきには島々のシルエットが黄金色の海に浮かび、言葉を失うほどの美しさです。造船とみかんの島の暮らしも感じられます。
quiz: 神峰山の山頂から瀬戸内海を見渡したら、いくつの島を数えられそう？
desc_en: This is the highest peak on Osakikamijima in the Geiyo Islands. From the summit observation deck, a grand panorama of islands large and small floating in the Seto Inland Sea spreads out, and on clear days you can see as far as the mountains of Shikoku. At dusk, the islands' silhouettes float on a golden sea in a beauty that leaves you speechless. You can also sense island life built on shipbuilding and mandarin oranges.
quiz_en: Looking out over the Seto Inland Sea from the summit of Mount Kannomine, how many islands do you think you could count?

name: せら夢公園（せらワイナリー）
desc: 世羅町にある公園で、ワイナリーを併設しています。世羅町は世羅台地と呼ばれる高原地帯にあり、昼夜の寒暖差を生かした果樹栽培や花観光が盛んな町です。園内では季節の花を楽しめるほか、地元産のぶどうでつくられたワインや特産品を味わえます。高原のさわやかな風の中で、ゆったりと過ごせます。
quiz: せら夢公園のワイナリーで、地元産の果物を使ったワインを味わってみたい？
desc_en: This park in Sera Town has an adjoining winery. Sera lies on the highlands called the Sera Plateau, a town where fruit growing that takes advantage of the temperature difference between day and night, as well as flower tourism, thrive. In the park you can enjoy seasonal flowers and taste wine made from local grapes and specialty products. You can spend a relaxed time in the fresh highland breeze.
quiz_en: At the winery in Sera Yume Park, which wine made from local fruit would you like to try tasting?

name: 帝釈峡
desc: 神石高原町と庄原市にまたがる、石灰岩台地を刻んだ全長約18キロの大渓谷です。川の浸食でできた巨大な天然橋「雄橋」は世界的にも珍しい景観で、国の天然記念物に指定されています。人造湖の神龍湖では遊覧船に乗って紅葉に彩られた渓谷を巡ることができ、四季折々の絶景が楽しめます。
quiz: 帝釈峡にある、川の浸食によってできた巨大な天然の石橋を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: Straddling Jinsekikogen Town and Shobara City, this great gorge about 18 kilometers long is carved into a limestone plateau. The "Ondobashi," a giant natural bridge formed by river erosion, is a sight rare even worldwide and is designated a National Natural Monument. On Lake Shinryu, a man-made lake, you can ride a sightseeing boat through the gorge colored by autumn leaves, enjoying superb views in every season.
quiz_en: What is the name of the giant natural stone bridge at Taishakukyo Gorge that was formed by river erosion?

name: 下関のふく料理
desc: 下関はふぐの取扱量で全国に知られる「ふくの本場」です。地元では「不遇」に通じるのを避け、「福」にかけて「ふく」と呼ぶのが習わしです。薄く引いて大皿に菊の花のように盛りつけるふく刺しは、皿の模様が透けて見えるほど。冬はふくちり鍋やひれ酒など、多彩な料理で味わえます。
quiz: 下関では縁起をかついで、ふぐのことを何と呼んでいるでしょう？
desc_en: Shimonoseki is known nationwide as the "home of fuku" for the volume of fugu (pufferfish) it handles. Locally, it is customary to call it "fuku," linking it to the word for good fortune, to avoid the sound of the word for misfortune. Fuku-sashi, sliced thin and arranged on a large platter like a chrysanthemum, is so thin you can see the plate's pattern through it. In winter, you can enjoy it in many dishes such as fuku-chiri hot pot and hire-zake (fin sake).
quiz_en: In Shimonoseki, to bring good luck, what do people call fugu (pufferfish) instead of its usual name?

name: 川棚温泉
addr: 下関市豊浦町川棚湯町
desc: 下関市豊浦町、響灘に近い山あいに湧く温泉で、名物「瓦そば」の発祥の地として知られます。熱した瓦の上に茶そばをのせ、牛肉や錦糸卵、のり、レモン、もみじおろしを添えて温かいつゆでいただく一品は、温泉街を訪れたら必ず味わいたい名物です。落ち着いた湯の町でゆったりと過ごせます。
quiz: 川棚温泉が発祥の地として知られる、熱い瓦の上でいただく名物料理は何？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) wells up in the mountains near the Hibikinada Sea in the Toyoura area of Shimonoseki City, and is known as the birthplace of the famous "kawara soba." Green tea soba is placed on a heated roof tile, topped with beef, shredded egg, seaweed, lemon and grated daikon with chili, and eaten with a warm dipping sauce; it is a specialty you must try when visiting. You can spend relaxed time in this calm hot spring town.
quiz_en: What is the famous dish, served on a hot roof tile, that Kawatana Onsen is known as the birthplace of?

name: 角島灯台公園
addr: 下関市豊北町大字角島2343-2
desc: 下関市豊北町の角島の北西端に建つ灯台を中心とした公園です。角島灯台は明治時代にイギリス人技師ブラントンの設計で建てられた、総御影石造りの美しい灯台で、上まで登ることもできます。島へはコバルトブルーの海に架かる角島大橋を渡って行き、そのドライブも絶景として人気です。
quiz: 角島灯台を設計した、日本各地に灯台を建てたイギリス人技師は誰？
desc_en: This park centers on the lighthouse standing at the northwestern tip of Tsunoshima Island in the Hohoku area of Shimonoseki City. Tsunoshima Lighthouse is a beautiful lighthouse built entirely of granite in the Meiji era to a design by the British engineer Brunton, and you can climb to the top. You reach the island by crossing the Tsunoshima Bridge over a cobalt blue sea, a drive popular for its superb views.
quiz_en: Who was the British engineer who designed Tsunoshima Lighthouse and went on to build many lighthouses throughout Japan?

name: 西ノ市温泉
addr: 下関市豊田町大字中村876-4
desc: 下関市豊田町に湧く温泉です。豊田町は木屋川の清流に恵まれ、初夏にはゲンジボタルが乱舞するホタルの里として知られています。山と川に囲まれたのどかな田園の中で、ゆったりと湯につかれば心まで癒やされます。ホタルの季節には、温泉とホタル観賞をあわせて楽しむのがおすすめです。
quiz: 西ノ市温泉のある豊田町で、初夏の夜に川辺で光を放つ生き物は何？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) wells up in the Toyota area of Shimonoseki City. Toyota is blessed with the clear Koya River and is known as a village of fireflies, where Genji fireflies dance in early summer. Soaking at leisure amid peaceful farmland surrounded by mountains and rivers will soothe even your heart. In firefly season, combining the hot spring with firefly viewing is recommended.
quiz_en: In the Toyota area, home of Nishiichi Onsen, what creatures give off light by the river on early summer nights?

name: 巌流島
addr: 下関市大字彦島字船島
desc: 関門海峡に浮かぶ小島で、正式名称は船島です。江戸時代初めに、宮本武蔵と佐々木小次郎が決闘した舞台として知られ、小次郎の流派「巌流」にちなんで巌流島と呼ばれるようになりました。島内には決闘の場面を表した二人の像が立ち、下関や門司から船で渡って歴史ロマンに浸れます。
quiz: 巌流島で佐々木小次郎と決闘したと伝わる、二刀流で知られる剣豪は誰？
desc_en: This small island in the Kanmon Strait is officially named Funashima. It is known as the stage for the duel between Miyamoto Musashi and Sasaki Kojiro in the early Edo period, and came to be called Ganryu-jima after Kojiro's school of swordsmanship, "Ganryu." Statues of the two depicting the duel stand on the island, and you can cross by boat from Shimonoseki or Moji to immerse yourself in historical romance.
quiz_en: Who is the master swordsman known for fighting with two swords who is said to have dueled Sasaki Kojiro on Ganryu-jima?

name: 菊川温泉
addr: 下関市菊川町大字下岡枝
desc: 下関市菊川町に湧く温泉です。菊川町は下関市の内陸部に位置し、田園と山々に囲まれた穏やかな地域です。素朴な雰囲気の湯で、地元の人々の暮らしに寄り添う温泉として親しまれています。下関の海沿いのにぎわいから少し離れて、のんびりと湯につかりながら山里の空気を味わえます。
quiz: 菊川温泉で温まったあと、下関の内陸の町で味わってみたい名物は何？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) wells up in the Kikugawa area of Shimonoseki City. Kikugawa lies in the inland part of Shimonoseki, a calm area surrounded by fields and mountains. Its water has a simple, rustic atmosphere, and it is loved as a hot spring close to the daily lives of locals. Away from the bustle of Shimonoseki's coast, you can savor mountain village air while soaking at leisure.
quiz_en: After warming up at Kikugawa Onsen, what local specialty would you like to try in this inland town of Shimonoseki?

name: 一の俣温泉
addr: 下関市豊田町大字殿敷1918-1
desc: 下関市豊田町の山あいにある温泉地です。周囲を山々に囲まれた静かな環境にあり、温泉宿が点在する落ち着いた湯の里です。とろりとした肌ざわりの湯にゆったりつかり、自然の中で過ごす時間は格別です。木屋川流域の豊かな自然に恵まれ、季節ごとに新緑や紅葉が谷あいを彩ります。
quiz: 一の俣温泉の静かな湯の里で、湯上がりにどんな景色を眺めたいですか？
desc_en: This hot spring area is in the mountains of the Toyota area of Shimonoseki City. Set in a quiet environment surrounded by mountains, it is a calm hot spring village with inns dotted around. Soaking at leisure in its silky water and spending time in nature is exceptional. Blessed with the rich nature of the Koya River basin, the valley is colored by fresh greenery and autumn leaves with the seasons.
quiz_en: In the quiet hot spring village of Ichinomata Onsen, what kind of scenery would you like to gaze at after your bath?

name: 功山寺
desc: 城下町・長府にある禅寺で、鎌倉時代に建てられた仏殿は禅宗様の代表的な建築として国宝に指定されています。幕末には高杉晋作がこの寺で挙兵したことで知られ、境内には馬上の晋作の像が立ちます。紅葉の名所としても名高く、秋には山門から仏殿までが赤や黄色に彩られます。
quiz: 功山寺で挙兵し、幕末の長州藩の流れを大きく変えた志士は誰でしょう？
desc_en: This Zen temple is in the castle town of Chofu, and its Buddha hall, built in the Kamakura period, is a National Treasure as a representative example of Zen-style architecture. It is known as the place where Takasugi Shinsaku raised troops at the end of the Edo period, and a statue of Shinsaku on horseback stands in the grounds. It is also renowned for autumn leaves, and in fall everything from the main gate to the Buddha hall turns red and yellow.
quiz_en: Who is the late-Edo activist who raised troops at Kozan-ji Temple and greatly changed the course of the Choshu Domain?

name: 住吉神社
desc: 下関市一の宮住吉に鎮座する長門国一宮です。室町時代に大内氏によって建てられた本殿は、九つの社殿が横につながる珍しい造りで、国宝に指定されています。古くから海上安全の神として信仰され、豊かな森に囲まれた境内は厳かな雰囲気に包まれています。
quiz: 住吉神社の国宝本殿を室町時代に建てたとされる、周防の守護大名は何氏？
desc_en: This shrine in Ichinomiya Sumiyoshi, Shimonoseki City, is the Ichinomiya (highest-ranking shrine) of the old Nagato Province. Its main hall, built by the Ouchi clan in the Muromachi period, has an unusual structure of nine shrine buildings joined side by side and is designated a National Treasure. It has long been worshipped as a god of safety at sea, and the grounds, surrounded by a rich forest, are wrapped in a solemn atmosphere.
quiz_en: Which clan of military governors from Suo Province is said to have built the National Treasure main hall of Sumiyoshi Shrine?

name: 中山神社
addr: 下関市豊北町田耕杣地
desc: 下関市豊北町田耕に鎮座する神社で、幕末の公家・中山忠光を祀ります。尊王攘夷運動に加わった忠光は、長州藩に身を寄せていた際にこの地で命を落としました。山あいの静かな社には、動乱の時代を駆け抜けた若き公家の生涯を偲んで、訪れる人が絶えません。
quiz: 中山神社に祀られている、幕末の尊王攘夷運動に加わった公家は誰？
desc_en: This shrine in the Tako area of Hohoku, Shimonoseki City, enshrines Nakayama Tadamitsu, a court noble of the late Edo period. Tadamitsu, who joined the movement to revere the emperor and expel foreigners, lost his life in this area while taking refuge with the Choshu Domain. At this quiet mountain shrine, visitors keep coming to remember the life of the young noble who raced through a turbulent age.
quiz_en: Who is the court noble enshrined at Nakayama Shrine who joined the late-Edo movement to revere the emperor and expel foreigners?

name: 豊田湖
desc: 下関市豊田町、木屋川をせき止めたダムによってできた人造湖です。周囲を緑の山々に囲まれた静かな湖面は四季折々に表情を変え、春の桜や秋の紅葉が湖畔を彩ります。釣りやボート、湖畔の散策を楽しむ人々が訪れ、のんびりとした時間が流れます。冬には水鳥の姿も見られます。
quiz: 豊田湖の湖畔をのんびり歩くなら、桜と紅葉どちらの季節に訪れたい？
desc_en: This man-made lake in the Toyota area of Shimonoseki City was created by a dam on the Koya River. The quiet lake surrounded by green mountains changes its look with each season, with spring cherry blossoms and autumn leaves coloring the shore. People come to enjoy fishing, boating and lakeside walks, and time passes slowly here. In winter, waterbirds can also be seen.
quiz_en: If you took a leisurely walk along the shore of Lake Toyota, would you rather visit in cherry blossom or autumn leaf season?

name: 滝部温泉
desc: 下関市豊北町滝部にある温泉です。豊北町は本州の西の端、響灘に面した町で、角島や特牛港など美しい海辺の景色で知られます。滝部は町の中心地で、地元の人々に親しまれる湯でゆっくり体を温められます。角島へのドライブや海辺の観光の行き帰りに立ち寄るのもおすすめです。
quiz: 滝部温泉で温まったら、豊北町の海辺で次に訪れたい絶景スポットはどこ？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) is in the Takibe area of Hohoku, Shimonoseki City. Hohoku, at the western end of Honshu facing the Hibikinada Sea, is known for beautiful seaside scenery such as Tsunoshima Island and Kottoi Port. Takibe is the center of the town, where you can warm up slowly in water loved by locals. Stopping by on the way to or from a drive to Tsunoshima or seaside sightseeing is also recommended.
quiz_en: After warming up at Takibe Onsen, which scenic spot on the Hohoku coast would you like to visit next?

name: 大河内温泉
addr: 下関市豊浦町宇賀大河内
desc: 下関市豊浦町の山あいに湧く温泉です。豊浦町は響灘に面した町で、海と山の両方の自然に恵まれています。この温泉は山里の静かな環境の中にあり、川のせせらぎや木々の緑に囲まれて、ゆったりと湯浴みを楽しめます。名物の瓦そばで知られる川棚温泉とあわせて、豊浦の湯めぐりをしてみませんか。
quiz: 大河内温泉と同じ豊浦町にある、瓦そば発祥の温泉地の名前は何でしょう？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) wells up in the mountains of the Toyoura area of Shimonoseki City. Toyoura is a town facing the Hibikinada Sea, blessed with the nature of both sea and mountains. This hot spring sits in a quiet mountain village setting, where you can enjoy a leisurely bath surrounded by the murmur of the river and green trees. Why not tour Toyoura's hot springs, together with Kawatana Onsen, known for its famous kawara soba?
quiz_en: What is the name of the hot spring town in Toyoura, like Okawachi Onsen, that is the birthplace of kawara soba?

name: 持世寺温泉
desc: 宇部市北部の吉見地区、田園と里山に囲まれた静かな湯どころが持世寺温泉です。工業都市として知られる宇部の中心部から少し離れるだけで、のどかな景色が広がります。観光地化されすぎていない素朴な雰囲気の中、地元の人に親しまれてきた湯にゆっくり浸かり、旅の疲れを癒してください。
quiz: 持世寺温泉のある宇部市。湯上がりに立ち寄りたいおすすめスポットや名物を教えてください？
desc_en: In the Yoshimi district of northern Ube, surrounded by farmland and wooded hills, lies the quiet hot spring area of Jisei-ji Onsen. Just a short way from the center of Ube, a city known for its industry, a peaceful countryside opens up. In a simple, unspoiled atmosphere, take your time soaking in waters long loved by locals and let the fatigue of travel melt away.
quiz_en: Ube City is home to Jisei-ji Onsen. What spots or local specialties would you recommend visiting after a relaxing soak here?

name: 湯田温泉
desc: 山口市の中心部に湧く湯田温泉は、傷ついた白狐が湯で癒やされていたという開湯伝説で知られます。街のあちこちに白狐のモチーフや無料の足湯があり、旅館やホテルが立ち並ぶ温泉街は夜までにぎやかです。詩人・中原中也の生誕地でもあり、記念館で彼の作品世界に触れることもできます。
quiz: 湯田温泉の開湯伝説で、温泉に浸かって傷を癒していたとされる動物は何でしょう？
desc_en: Yuda Onsen, which springs up in the heart of Yamaguchi City, is known for its founding legend of a wounded white fox that healed itself in the waters. White fox motifs and free footbaths appear all over town, and the hot spring district, lined with ryokan (traditional inns) and hotels, stays lively into the night. It is also the birthplace of the poet Nakahara Chuya, whose literary world you can explore at his memorial museum.
quiz_en: According to the founding legend of Yuda Onsen, which animal is said to have healed its wounds by bathing in the hot spring?

name: 長門峡
desc: 長門峡は阿武川が刻んだ長さ約12kmの峡谷で、国の名勝に指定されています。切り立った岩壁や深い淵、清らかな流れが続き、遊歩道を歩きながら変化に富んだ渓谷美を楽しめます。秋には紅葉が川面を彩る県内屈指の名所となり、中原中也の詩「冬の長門峡」の舞台としても親しまれています。
quiz: 中原中也が詠んだ詩「◯の長門峡」。◯に入る季節は何でしょう？
desc_en: Chomonkyo is a gorge about 12 km long carved by the Abu River and designated a national Place of Scenic Beauty. Sheer rock walls, deep pools and clear water continue along its length, and a walking trail lets you enjoy its ever-changing valley scenery. In autumn, colorful leaves paint the river surface, making it one of the prefecture's finest foliage spots. It is also loved as the setting of Nakahara Chuya's poem 'Winter Chomonkyo'.
quiz_en: Poet Nakahara Chuya wrote a poem titled after a particular season at Chomonkyo Gorge. Which season appears in the title of that poem?

name: 徳佐八幡宮
desc: 山口市阿東の徳佐地区に鎮座する徳佐八幡宮は、参道に続くしだれ桜で知られる神社です。春には長い桜並木が淡い紅色に染まり、多くの花見客が訪れます。徳佐は山あいの盆地に開けた地域で、りんご園が広がる果物の里としても知られ、季節ごとに素朴な里山の風景を楽しめます。
quiz: 徳佐八幡宮のしだれ桜を見に行ったら、阿東地域で味わいたい果物は何？
desc_en: Standing in the Tokusa area of Ato in Yamaguchi City, Tokusa Hachimangu is a shrine famous for the weeping cherry trees lining its approach. In spring, the long avenue of blossoms turns a soft pink, drawing many cherry blossom viewers. Tokusa lies in a basin among the mountains and is also known as a fruit-growing area with spreading apple orchards, offering simple rural scenery in every season.
quiz_en: After viewing the weeping cherry trees at Tokusa Hachimangu Shrine, which fruit would you want to taste in the Ato area?

name: 龍蔵寺・凌雲寺跡
desc: 山口市吉敷の山中にある龍蔵寺は、境内に立つ大イチョウと近くの滝で知られる古刹です。秋には黄金色に染まる巨木が見事な景観をつくります。周辺には大内氏ゆかりの凌雲寺跡があり、山中に残る堅固な石垣が往時の寺の規模を物語ります。中世の山口を治めた大内文化の面影をたどる散策が楽しめます。
quiz: 龍蔵寺の境内で、秋になると黄金色に染まる大きな木は何の木でしょう？
name_en: Ryuzo-ji Temple and Ryoun-ji Temple Ruins
desc_en: Set in the mountains of Yoshiki in Yamaguchi City, Ryuzo-ji is an old temple known for the giant ginkgo tree in its grounds and a nearby waterfall. In autumn, the huge tree turns a brilliant gold, creating a stunning sight. Nearby are the ruins of Ryoun-ji, linked to the Ouchi clan, where sturdy stone walls hint at the temple's former scale. It makes for a walk tracing the legacy of the Ouchi culture that once ruled medieval Yamaguchi.
quiz_en: In the grounds of Ryuzo-ji Temple, a large tree turns golden every autumn. What kind of tree is it?

name: 柚木慈生温泉
desc: 山口市徳地の柚木地区、佐波川流域の山あいにある柚木慈生温泉は、地元で長く親しまれてきた素朴な湯治場です。周囲は緑濃い山々に囲まれ、季節ごとに里山の表情が移ろいます。徳地は和紙づくりの歴史がある地域でもあり、湯に浸かったあとは静かな山里の暮らしの風景をのんびり眺めてみてください。
quiz: 柚木慈生温泉がある山口市徳地。湯上がりに立ち寄りたい里山の名所を教えてください？
desc_en: Located in the Yunoki area of Tokuji in Yamaguchi City, in the mountains along the Saba River, Yunoki Jisho Onsen is a modest healing spa long cherished by locals. It is surrounded by lush green mountains whose rural scenery shifts with the seasons. Tokuji also has a history of washi (Japanese paper) making, so after your soak, take your time gazing at the peaceful landscape of mountain village life.
quiz_en: Yunoki Jisho Onsen is in the Tokuji area of Yamaguchi City. Which countryside sights would you like to visit after a soak here?

name: 阿知須温泉
desc: 阿知須温泉は、山口市南部の阿知須地区にある温泉です。阿知須は瀬戸内海の山口湾に面した町で、干拓地や海辺の公園が広がる開放的な土地柄です。近くには広い芝生や海辺の景色を楽しめるきらら浜の施設もあり、海辺の散策と組み合わせて温泉でひと休みするのがおすすめです。
quiz: 阿知須温泉でのんびりしたあと、阿知須の海辺で楽しみたいことは何ですか？
desc_en: Aio Onsen is a hot spring in the Aio district of southern Yamaguchi City. Aio is a town facing Yamaguchi Bay on the Seto Inland Sea, with an open landscape of reclaimed land and seaside parks. The nearby Kirara-hama facilities offer wide lawns and coastal views, so combining a seaside stroll with a relaxing break at the hot spring is highly recommended.
quiz_en: After unwinding at Aio Onsen, what would you like to do along the seashore of Aio?

name: 長門峡もみじ祭
desc: 長門峡もみじ祭は、紅葉の名所・長門峡が最も色づく秋に開かれる催しです。阿武川の清流沿いに切り立つ岩壁を赤や黄の木々が彩り、渓谷を歩く人々の目を楽しませます。会場周辺では地元の味覚を味わえる出店などもにぎわい、山あいの静かな峡谷が一年で最も華やぐ季節を体感できます。
quiz: 長門峡もみじ祭で紅葉狩りをしたら、ほかに見てみたい長門峡の景色は何？
desc_en: The Chomonkyo Momiji (Autumn Leaves) Festival is held in autumn, when the famous foliage spot of Chomonkyo is at its most colorful. Red and yellow trees decorate the sheer rock walls along the clear Abu River, delighting those walking through the gorge. Around the venue, stalls serving local flavors add to the bustle, letting you experience the season when this quiet mountain gorge is at its liveliest.
quiz_en: After enjoying the autumn leaves at the Chomonkyo Momiji Festival, what other scenery of the gorge would you like to see?

name: 鋳銭司・大村神社・長沢池
desc: 山口市の鋳銭司は、古代に周防国で銭が鋳造されたことに由来する地名で、鋳銭司跡が残ります。この地は幕末から明治の兵学者・大村益次郎の出身地としても知られ、彼を祀る大村神社があります。近くの長沢池は広い水面をたたえるため池で、のどかな田園風景とともに歴史散策が楽しめます。
quiz: 鋳銭司出身で、大村神社に祀られている幕末・明治の兵学者は誰でしょう？
name_en: Suzenji, Omura Shrine and Nagasawa Pond
desc_en: Suzenji in Yamaguchi City takes its name from the ancient minting of coins in Suo Province, and the ruins of the mint remain. The area is also known as the birthplace of Omura Masujiro, a military scholar of the late Edo and Meiji periods, and Omura Shrine is dedicated to him. Nearby Nagasawa Pond is a broad irrigation reservoir, and together with the peaceful farmland it makes for a pleasant historical walk.
quiz_en: Who is the military scholar of the late Edo and Meiji periods, born in Suzenji, who is enshrined at Omura Shrine?

name: 松陰神社
desc: 萩市の松陰神社は、幕末の思想家・吉田松陰を祀る神社です。境内には松陰が多くの若者を教えた松下村塾が当時の姿で残され、高杉晋作や伊藤博文らを輩出した学び舎として世界遺産「明治日本の産業革命遺産」の構成資産にもなっています。学問の神様として、合格祈願に訪れる人も多くいます。
quiz: 松陰神社の境内に残る、吉田松陰が若者たちを教えた塾の名前は何でしょう？
desc_en: Shoin Shrine in Hagi enshrines Yoshida Shoin, a thinker of the late Edo period. In its grounds stands Shokasonjuku, the private school where Shoin taught many young people, preserved as it was. Having produced figures such as Takasugi Shinsaku and Ito Hirobumi, it is a component of the World Heritage Site 'Sites of Japan's Meiji Industrial Revolution.' Many visitors come to pray for success in exams, as Shoin is revered as a deity of learning.
quiz_en: What is the name of the private school, preserved in the grounds of Shoin Shrine, where Yoshida Shoin taught young people?

name: 萩城跡指月公園
desc: 萩城跡は、関ヶ原の戦いの後に毛利輝元が指月山のふもとに築いた城の跡で、現在は指月公園として整備されています。天守は明治時代に解体されましたが、堀に映える石垣や天守台が残り、往時の威容をしのばせます。春には桜が石垣を彩り、城下町萩の散策の起点としても人気です。
quiz: 関ヶ原の戦いの後に萩城を築き、長州藩の基礎をつくった戦国武将は誰でしょう？
desc_en: The Hagi Castle Ruins mark the site of the castle Mori Terumoto built at the foot of Mount Shizuki after the Battle of Sekigahara, now maintained as Shizuki Park. Although the keep was dismantled in the Meiji era, the stone walls reflected in the moat and the keep's base remain, recalling its former grandeur. In spring, cherry blossoms frame the walls, and it is a popular starting point for exploring the castle town of Hagi.
quiz_en: Which warlord built Hagi Castle after the Battle of Sekigahara and laid the foundations of the Choshu domain?

name: 防府天満宮
desc: 防府天満宮は菅原道真を祀る神社で、道真の没後まもなく創建された日本最初の天満宮と称されています。高台にある社殿からは防府の街並みを見渡せ、梅の季節には境内が花の香りに包まれます。秋の御神幸祭は白装束の男たちが御神輿を担ぐ「裸坊祭」として知られ、多くの人でにぎわいます。
quiz: 防府天満宮の御神幸祭は、白装束の男たちの姿から何という通称で呼ばれる？
desc_en: Hofu Tenmangu enshrines Sugawara no Michizane and is said to be Japan's first Tenmangu shrine, founded shortly after his death.
