quiz: 横峰寺の境内を彩る、春から初夏にかけて咲く花木は何でしょう？
desc_en: Yokomine-ji in the Komatsu area of Saijo is Temple No. 60 of the Shikoku 88 Temple Pilgrimage, set high on the slopes of Mount Ishizuchi. The pilgrim path is known as a difficult section with steep mountain trails. Many rhododendrons are planted in the grounds, and in the flowering season the mountain temple is brightly decorated. On clear days, you can also see the majestic form of Mount Ishizuchi.
quiz_en: Which flowering shrub decorates the grounds of Yokomine-ji Temple, blooming from spring into early summer?

name: 法安寺
desc: 西条市小松町北川の法安寺は、古代にさかのぼる歴史を持つ寺院です。境内周辺には古代寺院の礎石が残り、法安寺跡として国の史跡に指定されています。田園の広がる穏やかな地に建ち、はるか昔から仏教文化が根づいていたことを今に伝えています。静かな境内で、古代の伽藍に思いを馳せてみてください。
quiz: 法安寺の境内周辺に残る、古代寺院の建物の柱を支えた石を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: Hoan-ji in the Kitagawa area of Komatsu in Saijo City is a temple with a history dating back to ancient times. Foundation stones of an ancient temple remain around its grounds and are designated a National Historic Site as the Hoan-ji Temple Ruins. Standing in a peaceful area of spreading farmland, it shows that Buddhist culture took root here long ago. In the quiet grounds, imagine the ancient temple buildings.
quiz_en: What are the stones called that remain around Hoan-ji Temple and once supported the pillars of ancient temple buildings?

name: 道前渓温泉
addr: 西条市丹原町大字来見897-1
desc: 道前渓温泉は、西条市丹原町の山あいにある温泉です。近くには道前渓と呼ばれる渓谷が広がり、清流と緑豊かな山々がつくる景観を楽しめます。丹原町は果物づくりが盛んな地域で、季節ごとにさまざまな果物が実ります。渓谷の散策を楽しんだあとに、温泉でゆっくりと体を癒すのがおすすめです。
quiz: 道前渓温泉のある西条市丹原町。湯上がりに味わいたい旬の果物は何？
desc_en: Dozenkei Onsen is a hot spring in the mountains of the Tanbara area of Saijo City. Nearby is a gorge called Dozenkei, where you can enjoy scenery created by clear streams and green mountains. Tanbara is an area where fruit growing thrives, and various fruits ripen with the seasons. After exploring the gorge, relaxing your body in the hot spring is recommended.
quiz_en: Dozenkei Onsen is in the Tanbara area of Saijo City. Which seasonal fruit would you like to taste after your soak?

name: 東予温泉
desc: 東予温泉は、西条市周布にある温泉です。西条市の東予地域は、瀬戸内海に面した平野と石鎚山系の山々に囲まれた土地で、豊かな水に恵まれています。気軽に立ち寄れる温泉で、地元の人々の憩いの場となっています。石鎚山登山や西条の水めぐりの後に、湯に浸かってゆっくり疲れを癒してください。
quiz: 東予温泉でひと休みしたら、水の都・西条で味わいたい名物は何ですか？
desc_en: Toyo Onsen is a hot spring in the Shufu area of Saijo City. The Toyo region of Saijo is surrounded by plains facing the Seto Inland Sea and the mountains of the Ishizuchi range, and is blessed with abundant water. This easy-to-visit hot spring is a relaxing place for local people. After climbing Mount Ishizuchi or touring Saijo's springs, take a soak and slowly ease your fatigue.
quiz_en: After taking a break at Toyo Onsen, what local specialty would you like to taste in Saijo, the city of water?

name: 肱川あらし（肱川の朝霧、雲海）
desc: 肱川あらしは、大洲盆地で発生した霧が、肱川に沿って河口の長浜へ一気に流れ出す現象です。冷え込んだ秋から冬の朝に見られ、白い霧が強い風とともに海へ吹き抜ける光景は迫力満点です。河口に架かる長浜大橋を霧が包み込む姿は、この地ならではの絶景として写真愛好家にも人気があります。
quiz: 肱川あらしの霧が包み込む、河口に架かる現役最古級の可動橋の名前は？
name_en: Hijikawa Arashi (Morning Fog of the Hiji River)
desc_en: Hijikawa Arashi is a phenomenon in which fog formed in the Ozu Basin rushes down the Hiji River to Nagahama at the river mouth. It can be seen on chilly mornings from autumn to winter, and the sight of white fog blowing out to sea with strong winds is truly dramatic. The fog enveloping the Nagahama Ohashi Bridge at the river mouth is a spectacular view unique to this area and popular with photographers.
quiz_en: What is the name of the movable bridge at the river mouth, among the oldest still in use, that is wrapped in the Hijikawa Arashi fog?

name: 冨士山
desc: 大洲市の冨士山は「とみすやま」と読み、つつじの名所として知られる山です。山頂付近の公園には数多くのつつじが植えられ、春には斜面が鮮やかなピンクや赤に染まります。山頂からは大洲の市街地や肱川、大洲城を見下ろすことができ、城下町の景色を一望できる展望地としても親しまれています。
quiz: つつじの名所として知られる大洲市の「冨士山」。何と読むでしょう？
desc_en: Mount Tomisu (Tomisuyama) in Ozu is a mountain known for its azaleas. Many azaleas are planted in the park near the summit, and in spring the slopes are dyed bright pink and red. From the top you can look down on the city of Ozu, the Hiji River and Ozu Castle, and it is loved as a viewpoint overlooking the castle town.
quiz_en: Mount Tomisu in Ozu City is famous for its spring azaleas. What colors would you most like to see covering its slopes?

name: 白滝公園
desc: 白滝公園は、大洲市長浜町白滝にある、大小の滝が連なる渓谷の公園です。岩肌を白く流れ落ちる滝の姿が名前の由来とされ、遊歩道を上るにつれて次々に滝が現れます。春は桜、秋は紅葉と季節ごとに景色が移ろい、夏には渓谷の涼しさが心地よい場所です。肱川の河口に近い自然の名所です。
quiz: 白滝公園の滝めぐり、あなたなら桜と紅葉どちらの季節に訪れたい？
desc_en: Shirataki Park, in the Shirataki area of Nagahama in Ozu City, is a gorge park with a series of large and small waterfalls. Its name, meaning 'white falls,' is said to come from the water flowing white down the rock face, and as you climb the trail one waterfall appears after another. The scenery changes with the seasons, from cherry blossoms in spring to autumn leaves, and in summer the coolness of the gorge is refreshing. It is a natural attraction near the mouth of the Hiji River.
quiz_en: For a waterfall walk at Shirataki Park, would you rather visit in cherry blossom season or autumn leaf season?

name: 丸山公園
desc: 丸山公園は、大洲市肱川町山鳥坂の高台にある公園です。肱川町は肱川の中流域に位置し、山あいに集落が点在する自然豊かな地域です。公園からは周囲の山並みや川沿いの景色を見渡すことができ、季節の花や木々を楽しみながら散策できます。山里の静かな時間を感じられる、地域の憩いの場です。
quiz: 丸山公園から肱川町の山並みを眺めたら、どんな季節の景色が見えましたか？
desc_en: Maruyama Park sits on high ground in the Yamatosaka area of Hijikawa in Ozu City. Hijikawa lies along the middle reaches of the Hiji River, a nature-rich area with villages scattered among the mountains. From the park you can view the surrounding mountain ranges and riverside scenery, and stroll while enjoying seasonal flowers and trees. It is a local relaxation spot where you can feel the quiet time of a mountain village.
quiz_en: Looking out over the mountains of Hijikawa from Maruyama Park, what seasonal scenery did you see?

name: 大洲神社
desc: 大洲神社は、城下町大洲の中心部に鎮座する神社で、古くから大洲の総鎮守として町の人々の崇敬を集めてきました。高台にある境内からは大洲の町並みを見下ろすことができ、近くには大洲城や明治の町並みが残るおはなはん通りもあります。城下町の散策の途中に参拝し、町の歴史に思いを馳せてみてください。
quiz: 大洲神社を参拝したら、城下町大洲で見ておきたい城や町並みはどこ？
desc_en: Ozu Shrine stands in the heart of the castle town of Ozu and has long been revered by townspeople as Ozu's chief guardian shrine. From its hilltop grounds you can look down on the streets of Ozu, and nearby are Ozu Castle and Ohanahan-dori Street, which retains its Meiji-era townscape. Stop to worship during a stroll through the castle town and reflect on its history.
quiz_en: After visiting Ozu Shrine, which castle or historic streets would you like to see in the castle town of Ozu?

name: 沖浦観音
desc: 沖浦観音は、大洲市沖浦にある観音さまを祀る寺院です。大洲市の山あいの静かな地域にあり、地域の人々の信仰を集めてきました。境内は緑に包まれ、季節の花々が参拝者を迎えてくれます。大洲は肱川が流れる城下町で、市街地から足を延ばせば、こうした里山の祈りの場に出会えます。
quiz: 沖浦観音に参拝したあと、大洲で楽しみたい季節の景色は何ですか？
desc_en: Okiura Kannon is a temple in the Okiura area of Ozu City dedicated to Kannon, the Buddhist deity of mercy. Located in a quiet mountain area of Ozu, it has long drawn the devotion of local people. The grounds are wrapped in greenery, and seasonal flowers welcome visitors. Ozu is a castle town along the Hiji River, and venturing out from the center you can discover countryside places of prayer like this one.
quiz_en: After visiting Okiura Kannon, what seasonal scenery would you like to enjoy in Ozu City?

name: 小藪温泉
desc: 小藪温泉は、大洲市肱川町の山深い谷あいにある一軒宿の温泉です。歴史を感じさせる木造の建物が山の緑に溶け込むようにたたずみ、まるで時が止まったかのような懐かしい風情が漂います。周囲は静かな自然に囲まれ、川のせせらぎを聞きながら湯に浸かれば、日常を忘れてくつろぐことができます。
quiz: 山あいの一軒宿・小藪温泉。木造の湯宿に泊まったら何をして過ごしたいですか？
desc_en: Koyabu Onsen is a single-inn hot spring deep in a mountain valley in the Hijikawa area of Ozu City. Its historic wooden building seems to blend into the green of the mountains, giving off a nostalgic charm as if time had stopped. Surrounded by quiet nature, you can soak while listening to the murmur of the river, forget everyday life and truly relax.
quiz_en: Koyabu Onsen is a single wooden inn in the mountains. If you stayed overnight there, how would you like to spend your time?

name: 八幡宮例祭
desc: 八幡宮例祭は、大洲市阿蔵の八幡神社で行われる秋の祭礼です。城下町大洲の人々にとって大切な祭りで、神輿などが町を練り歩き、地域が一体となって盛り上がります。大洲は肱川に抱かれた城下町で、秋には鵜飼のシーズンを終えた川辺に涼しい風が吹き、祭りのにぎわいが季節の移ろいを告げます。
quiz: 大洲の八幡宮例祭のような秋祭り、あなたの地元ではどんな催しがありますか？
desc_en: The Hachimangu Annual Festival is an autumn festival held at the Hachiman Shrine in the Azo area of Ozu City. It is an important festival for the people of the castle town, with mikoshi (portable shrines) and other processions parading through the streets as the whole community celebrates. Ozu is a castle town embraced by the Hiji River, and in autumn, when cool breezes blow along the river after the cormorant fishing season ends, the festival's bustle signals the changing season.
quiz_en: Thinking of autumn festivals like the Hachimangu Annual Festival in Ozu, what kinds of events are held in your hometown?

name: 大谷池
desc: 大谷池は、伊予市上三谷にあるため池です。伊予市は松山平野の南西に位置し、古くから農業用のため池が多くつくられてきました。池の周辺には緑が広がり、静かな水面に周囲の山々が映り込む穏やかな景色を楽しめます。散策や水辺での休憩にぴったりの、地域の人々に親しまれる憩いの場です。
quiz: 大谷池のほとりを散策したあと、伊予市で味わいたい名物は何ですか？
desc_en: Otani Pond is an irrigation reservoir in the Kamimitani area of Iyo City. Iyo lies southwest of the Matsuyama Plain, where many irrigation ponds have been built for farming since long ago. Greenery spreads around the pond, and you can enjoy peaceful scenery with the surrounding mountains reflected on the still water. It is a relaxing spot loved by locals, perfect for a walk or a rest by the water.
quiz_en: After a walk along the shore of Otani Pond, what local specialty would you like to taste in Iyo City?

name: 翠波高原
addr: 四国中央市金砂町平野山306-1
desc: 翠波高原は、四国中央市の法皇山脈にある高原です。春には一面に菜の花が咲き、秋にはコスモスが揺れる花の名所として知られています。高原からは四国中央市の街並みや燧灘を見下ろすことができ、製紙の町らしい工場群と瀬戸内海が織りなす景色が広がります。ドライブやピクニックに人気のスポットです。
quiz: 四国中央市の翠波高原で、春になると一面を黄色く染める花は何でしょう？
desc_en: The Suiha Highlands lie in the Hoo Mountains of Shikokuchuo City. They are known as a flower spot, with blankets of rapeseed blossoms in spring and swaying cosmos in autumn. From the highlands you can look down on the city and the Hiuchi Sea, where the factories of this papermaking town and the Seto Inland Sea combine to form a striking view. It is a popular spot for drives and picnics.
quiz_en: Which flower blankets the Suiha Highlands of Shikokuchuo City in bright yellow every spring, drawing many visitors?

name: 塩塚高原
addr: 四国中央市新宮町上山
desc: 塩塚高原は、四国中央市と徳島県にまたがる高原で、なだらかな山頂一帯にススキの草原が広がっています。秋には黄金色のススキが風になびき、壮大な景色をつくり出します。春には草原を維持するための山焼きが行われ、その後には一面の緑がよみがえります。展望台からは四国の山々を見渡せます。
quiz: 塩塚高原で、秋になると山頂一帯を黄金色に染める植物は何でしょう？
desc_en: The Shiozuka Highlands straddle Shikokuchuo City and Tokushima Prefecture, with grasslands of Japanese pampas grass spreading across the gentle summit area. In autumn, the golden grass waves in the wind, creating a magnificent landscape. In spring, controlled burning is carried out to maintain the grassland, after which a carpet of green returns. From the observation deck you can view the mountains of Shikoku.
quiz_en: Which plant turns the gentle summit area of the Shiozuka Highlands a shimmering gold every autumn as it waves in the wind?

name: 川之江城
desc: 川之江城は、四国中央市川之江町の小高い山に建つ城で、別名を仏殿城といいます。現在の天守は昭和に再建されたもので、春には桜が城山を彩ります。かつては伊予・讃岐・阿波・土佐の四国の境に近い要地にあり、激しい争奪の舞台となりました。天守からは川之江の街並みと瀬戸内海を一望できます。
quiz: 四国中央市の川之江城には、もう一つの別名があります。何と呼ばれる？
desc_en: Kawanoe Castle stands on a small hill in the Kawanoe area of Shikokuchuo City and is also known as Butsuden Castle. The current keep was rebuilt in the Showa era, and in spring cherry blossoms decorate the castle hill. It once stood at a strategic point near the borders of Shikoku's four provinces, Iyo, Sanuki, Awa and Tosa, and became the scene of fierce battles for control. From the keep you can view the town of Kawanoe and the Seto Inland Sea.
quiz_en: Kawanoe Castle in Shikokuchuo City is also known by another name. What is the castle's other name?

name: 三角寺
addr: 四国中央市金田町三角寺75
desc: 四国中央市の三角寺は、四国八十八ヶ所霊場の第六十五番札所で、伊予の国最後の札所です。山の中腹にあり、急な坂道や石段を上ってたどり着きます。境内には三角形の護摩壇が由来とされる池があり、春には桜が美しく咲きます。ここから先は讃岐の「涅槃の道場」へ向かい、結願が近づいてきます。
quiz: 伊予の国で最後の札所となる三角寺は、四国八十八ヶ所霊場の第何番札所？
desc_en: Sankaku-ji in Shikokuchuo City is Temple No. 65 of the Shikoku 88 Temple Pilgrimage and the last temple in Iyo Province. Halfway up a mountain, it is reached by climbing steep slopes and stone steps. In the grounds is a pond said to originate from a triangular fire altar, and in spring the cherry blossoms are beautiful. From here pilgrims head to Sanuki, the 'dojo of nirvana,' as the completion of their journey draws near.
quiz_en: Sankaku-ji is the last pilgrimage temple in Iyo Province. What number does it hold among the Shikoku 88 temples?

name: 延命寺
addr: 四国中央市土居町土居895
desc: 延命寺は、四国中央市土居町にある寺院です。土居町は燧灘に面し、背後に法皇山脈が連なる地域で、のどかな田園が広がっています。境内は落ち着いた雰囲気に包まれ、地域の人々に大切に守られてきました。四国中央市は製紙業で知られる町で、山と海に囲まれた暮らしの中に祈りの場が息づいています。
quiz: 延命寺のある四国中央市は全国有数の生産地。何の製品で知られている？
desc_en: Enmei-ji is a temple in the Doi area of Shikokuchuo City. Doi faces the Hiuchi Sea and is backed by the Hoo Mountains, with peaceful farmland spreading out. The grounds are wrapped in a calm atmosphere and have been carefully protected by local people. Shikokuchuo is a city known for its paper industry, and places of prayer live on amid a life surrounded by mountains and sea.
quiz_en: Shikokuchuo City, home to Enmei-ji Temple, is one of Japan's leading production areas. What kind of products is it known for?

name: 観音水
desc: 観音水は、西予市宇和町明間にある湧水です。山あいから湧き出る清らかな水は、夏に手を浸すとひんやりと冷たく感じられます。周辺は水辺の緑が涼しげな憩いの場となっており、水をくみに訪れる人の姿も見られます。宇和町は昔ながらの町並みや田園が残る、歴史ある地域です。
quiz: 西予市宇和町の観音水。暑い夏に湧水に触れたら、どんな感想を持ちましたか？
desc_en: Kannonsui is a natural spring in the Akema area of Uwa in Seiyo City. The clear water welling up from the mountains feels refreshingly cold when you dip your hands in it in summer. The surroundings form a relaxing spot with cool waterside greenery, and you can see people coming to collect the water. Uwa is a historic area where traditional streets and farmland remain.
quiz_en: If you touched the spring water at Kannonsui in Seiyo City on a hot summer day, how do you think it would feel?

name: 桂川渓谷
desc: 桂川渓谷は、西予市野村町の山中にある渓谷です。清流が岩の間を流れ落ち、大小の滝や淵が続く変化に富んだ景観が見られます。夏は渓谷の木陰が涼しく、秋には周囲の木々が色づいて美しい景色をつくります。野村町は酪農が盛んな地域で、牛乳を使った乳製品も味わえる山あいの町です。
quiz: 桂川渓谷のある西予市野村町。酪農の町で味わいたいものは何ですか？
desc_en: Katsuragawa Gorge lies in the mountains of the Nomura area of Seiyo City. Clear water tumbles between the rocks, creating a varied landscape of large and small waterfalls and pools. In summer the shade of the gorge is cool, and in autumn the surrounding trees change color to create beautiful scenery. Nomura is a mountain town where dairy farming thrives, and you can also taste dairy products made with its milk.
quiz_en: Katsuragawa Gorge is in the Nomura area of Seiyo City. What would you like to taste in this dairy farming town?

name: 竜沢寺緑地公園
desc: 竜沢寺緑地公園は、西予市城川町魚成にある公園です。城川町は四万十川の支流が流れる山あいの地域で、豊かな森林と清流に恵まれています。公園では緑に囲まれた中で散策やひと休みを楽しめます。城川町には地質の見どころも多く、のどかな山里の風景の中で自然の恵みを感じられます。
quiz: 竜沢寺緑地公園のある西予市城川町。山里で楽しみたい自然体験は何？
desc_en: Ryutaku-ji Ryokuchi Park is a park in the Uonashi area of Shirokawa in Seiyo City. Shirokawa is a mountain area through which tributaries of the Shimanto River flow, blessed with rich forests and clear streams. In the park you can enjoy strolling or resting surrounded by greenery. Shirokawa also has many geological highlights, letting you feel nature's blessings amid peaceful mountain village scenery.
quiz_en: Ryutaku-ji Ryokuchi Park is in the Shirokawa area of Seiyo City. What nature experiences would you like to enjoy in this mountain village?

name: 明石寺
desc: 西予市宇和町の明石寺は、四国八十八ヶ所霊場の第四十三番札所で、「あげいしさん」の愛称で親しまれています。山の中腹にある境内は木々に囲まれ、静かで落ち着いた雰囲気に包まれています。ふもとの宇和町卯之町には、白壁の町並みや古い学校建築が残り、札所とあわせて歴史散策が楽しめます。
quiz: 明石寺は地元で親しみを込めて何という愛称で呼ばれているでしょう？
desc_en: Meiseki-ji in the Uwa area of Seiyo City is Temple No. 43 of the Shikoku 88 Temple Pilgrimage and is affectionately known as 'Ageishi-san.' Its grounds, halfway up a mountain, are surrounded by trees and wrapped in a quiet, calm atmosphere. In Unomachi in Uwa at the foot of the mountain, white-walled streets and old school buildings remain, so you can enjoy a historical walk together with the temple.
quiz_en: By what affectionate nickname do local people call Meiseki-ji Temple in the Uwa area of Seiyo City?

name: 游の里温泉
desc: 游の里温泉は、西予市宇和町明間にある温泉です。宇和町は宇和盆地に広がる田園の町で、米どころとしても知られています。周囲に広がるのどかな田園風景を眺めながら、ゆったりと湯に浸かることができます。宇和町には白壁の町並みや歴史ある建物も残り、町歩きと温泉を組み合わせた旅を楽しめます。
quiz: 游の里温泉のある西予市宇和町。米どころで味わいたい食べ物は何ですか？
desc_en: Yunosato Onsen is a hot spring in the Akema area of Uwa in Seiyo City. Uwa is a farming town spread across the Uwa Basin and is known for its rice. You can relax in the water while gazing at the peaceful countryside around you. White-walled streets and historic buildings also remain in Uwa, so you can enjoy a trip combining a town walk with the hot spring.
quiz_en: Yunosato Onsen is in the Uwa area of Seiyo City. What food would you like to taste in this rice-growing region?

name: カロト温泉
desc: カロト温泉は、西予市野村町の中心部近くにある温泉です。野村町は山あいの盆地に広がる町で、酪農や養蚕の歴史を持つ地域です。肱川の上流が町を流れ、緑豊かな山々に囲まれた穏やかな環境が広がっています。地元の人々にも親しまれる湯に浸かり、山里の町のゆったりとした時間を味わってください。
quiz: カロト温泉に入ったあと、野村町で食べたいご当地の味は何ですか？
desc_en: Karoto Onsen is a hot spring near the center of the Nomura area of Seiyo City. Nomura is a town in a mountain basin with a history of dairy farming and silkworm raising. The upper reaches of the Hiji River flow through the town, surrounded by calm, green mountains. Soak in waters also loved by locals and savor the unhurried pace of this mountain town.
quiz_en: After a bath at Karoto Onsen, what local flavors would you like to eat in the Nomura area?

name: 白猪の滝
desc: 白猪の滝は、東温市河之内の山中にある滝です。岩壁を白い糸のように流れ落ちる姿が美しく、正岡子規が訪れたことでも知られています。滝の周辺は緑豊かな渓谷で、夏は涼を求める人々が、秋には紅葉を楽しむ人々が訪れます。厳しい冷え込みの年には滝が凍ることもあり、季節ごとに表情を変えます。
quiz: 白猪の滝を訪れたことでも知られる、松山出身の俳人は誰でしょう？
desc_en: Shiroi Falls is a waterfall in the mountains of the Kawanouchi area of Toon City. Its water falling down the rock wall like white threads is beautiful, and it is also known for having been visited by Masaoka Shiki. The area around the falls is a lush green gorge, attracting people seeking coolness in summer and autumn leaves in autumn. In years of severe cold the falls can freeze, changing their appearance with the seasons.
quiz_en: Which haiku poet from Matsuyama is known for having visited Shiroi Falls in Toon City?

name: 滑川渓谷
desc: 滑川渓谷は、東温市明河にある渓谷で、名前の通りなめらかな一枚岩の川床の上を清流が滑るように流れています。夏には浅瀬で水遊びを楽しむ家族連れの姿も見られ、秋には周囲の木々が赤や黄に色づきます。松山市内からも近く、手軽に自然を満喫できる渓谷として地元の人々に親しまれています。
quiz: 滑川渓谷の川床は、どのような岩でできていることが名前の由来でしょう？
desc_en: Namegawa Gorge in the Myoga area of Toon City is, as its name suggests, a valley where clear water glides over a smooth riverbed of single-slab rock. In summer families can be seen playing in the shallows, and in autumn the surrounding trees turn red and yellow. Close to Matsuyama, it is loved by locals as a gorge where you can easily enjoy nature.
quiz_en: The name of Namegawa Gorge comes from the kind of rock that forms its riverbed. What is the riverbed like?

name: 積善山
desc: 積善山は、上島町の岩城島にある山で、桜の名所として知られています。春には山頂へ向かう道沿いに数多くの桜が咲き、山全体が淡いピンク色に包まれます。山頂の展望台からは、瀬戸内海に浮かぶ島々と行き交う船を一望でき、多島美の絶景が広がります。島の人々が大切に育ててきた桜の山です。
quiz: 岩城島の積善山が、春に山全体をピンク色に染める名所となる花は何？
desc_en: Mount Sekizen is a mountain on Iwagi Island in Kamijima Town, known as a famous cherry blossom spot. In spring, many cherry trees bloom along the road to the summit, wrapping the entire mountain in soft pink. From the observation deck at the top, you can see the islands of the Seto Inland Sea and passing ships, a superb island panorama. It is a mountain of cherry trees carefully cultivated by the islanders.
quiz_en: Which flower turns the whole of Mount Sekizen on Iwagi Island in Kamijima Town pink every spring?

name: 仁淀川
desc: 仁淀川は、石鎚山系を源に愛媛県から高知県へと流れる清流です。愛媛県側の上流部は面河川と呼ばれ、久万高原町には面河渓などの美しい渓谷が広がっています。透き通った水が青く輝く様子は「仁淀ブルー」と呼ばれ、多くの人を魅了しています。新緑や紅葉の季節には、水と緑の美しさが際立ちます。
quiz: 仁淀川の、透き通った水が青く輝いて見える様子は何と呼ばれている？
desc_en: The Niyodo River is a clear river that rises in the Ishizuchi mountains and flows from Ehime Prefecture to Kochi Prefecture. Its upper reaches on the Ehime side are called the Omogo River, and in Kumakogen beautiful gorges such as Omogokei spread out. The way its transparent water shines blue is called 'Niyodo Blue' and captivates many people. In the seasons of fresh greenery and autumn leaves, the beauty of water and greenery stands out.
quiz_en: What is the name given to the way the transparent water of the Niyodo River appears to shine blue?

name: 石鎚山
desc: 石鎚山は、標高1982mを誇る西日本最高峰の山で、日本七霊山の一つに数えられる信仰の山です。山頂付近には巨大な鎖が掛けられた鎖場があり、修験者や登山者が岩壁をよじ登ります。最高地点の天狗岳は切り立った岩峰で、晴れた日には四国の山々と瀬戸内海を見渡せます。秋の紅葉も見事です。
quiz: 日本七霊山の一つにも数えられる西日本最高峰の石鎚山。その標高は何m？
desc_en: At 1,982 m, Mount Ishizuchi is the highest peak in western Japan and a sacred mountain counted among Japan's seven holy mountains. Near the summit are chain routes with huge chains, which ascetic practitioners and climbers use to scale the rock walls. The highest point, Tengudake, is a sheer rocky peak, and on clear days you can see the mountains of Shikoku and the Seto Inland Sea. Its autumn foliage is also superb.
quiz_en: Mount Ishizuchi is the highest peak in western Japan and one of Japan's seven holy mountains. How tall is it in meters?

name: 岩屋寺
desc: 久万高原町の岩屋寺は、四国八十八ヶ所霊場の第四十五番札所です。そそり立つ巨大な岩壁に抱かれるように本堂や大師堂が建ち、岩壁に掛けられたはしごで上る場所もあるなど、修行の場らしい厳しさを感じさせます。山深い参道は杉木立に包まれ、静寂と神秘に満ちた雰囲気が漂います。
quiz: 岩屋寺の本堂が抱かれるように建っている、そそり立つ自然の地形は何？
desc_en: Iwaya-ji in Kumakogen is Temple No. 45 of the Shikoku 88 Temple Pilgrimage. Its main hall and Daishi Hall stand as if embraced by a towering giant rock wall, and some places are reached by ladders set against the cliff, conveying the austerity of a place for ascetic training. The deep mountain approach is wrapped in cedar groves, with an atmosphere full of silence and mystery.
quiz_en: The main hall of Iwaya-ji Temple stands as if embraced by a towering natural feature. What is that feature?

name: 町並み
desc: 内子町の町並みは、江戸時代後期から明治にかけて木蝋の生産で栄えた商家が並ぶ通りです。八日市護国地区には白壁やなまこ壁の美しい建物が連なり、国の重要伝統的建造物群保存地区に選ばれています。近くには大正時代に建てられた芝居小屋・内子座があり、町全体に往時の繁栄の面影が残っています。
quiz: 内子町を繁栄させた、ハゼの実からつくられる特産品は何でしょう？
desc_en: Uchiko's historic townscape is a street lined with merchant houses that prospered from the production of mokuro (Japanese vegetable wax) from the late Edo to Meiji periods. In the Yokaichi-Gokoku district, beautiful buildings with white walls and namako-style tiled walls stand in a row, selected as an Important Preservation District for Groups of Traditional Buildings. Nearby is Uchiko-za, a playhouse built in the Taisho era, and traces of past prosperity remain throughout the town.
quiz_en: What specialty product, made from the berries of the wax tree, brought prosperity to the town of Uchiko?

name: 龍王公園
desc: 龍王公園は、内子町五十崎の高台にある公園です。五十崎は小田川沿いに開けた町で、伝統の和紙づくりや、端午の節句に川をはさんで凧を競い合う凧合戦で知られています。公園からは五十崎の町並みや周囲の山々を見渡すことができ、季節の花を楽しみながら散策できます。山里ののどかな景色に心が和みます。
quiz: 龍王公園のある内子町五十崎で、端午の節句に行われる伝統行事は何？
desc_en: Ryuo Park sits on high ground in the Ikazaki area of Uchiko Town. Ikazaki is a town that grew up along the Oda River, known for its traditional washi (Japanese paper) making and for a kite battle held across the river on Boys' Day. From the park you can look out over the streets of Ikazaki and the surrounding mountains, and stroll while enjoying seasonal flowers. The peaceful mountain village scenery is soothing to the heart.
quiz_en: What traditional event is held on Boys' Day in the Ikazaki area of Uchiko Town, where Ryuo Park is located?

name: 亀ヶ池温泉
desc: 亀ヶ池温泉は、伊方町二見にある温泉です。伊方町は四国の最西端へと細長く伸びる佐田岬半島に位置し、宇和海と瀬戸内海の二つの海に挟まれています。半島の尾根には風車が並び、海辺ならではの開放的な景色が広がります。半島の先端にある佐田岬灯台へのドライブの途中に立ち寄るのもおすすめです。
quiz: 亀ヶ池温泉のある伊方町。四国の最西端へ細長く伸びる半島の名前は何？
desc_en: Kamegaike Onsen is a hot spring in the Futami area of Ikata Town. Ikata lies on the Sadamisaki Peninsula, which stretches long and narrow toward the westernmost tip of Shikoku, sandwiched between two seas, the Uwa Sea and the Seto Inland Sea. Wind turbines line the peninsula's ridge, and open seaside views spread out. It is also a good stop on a drive to Sadamisaki Lighthouse at the tip of the peninsula.
quiz_en: Kamegaike Onsen is in Ikata Town. What is the name of the long, narrow peninsula stretching toward the westernmost tip of Shikoku?

name: 大本神社清明祭
desc: 大本神社清明祭は、鬼北町で行われる春の祭礼です。鬼北町は愛媛県南部の内陸、四万十川の支流が流れる山あいの町で、豊かな自然と田園に囲まれています。春の訪れとともに地域の人々が神社に集い、季節の巡りと五穀豊穣を祈ります。山里に受け継がれてきた伝統行事に、地域の温かさを感じられます。
quiz: 大本神社清明祭のような春のお祭り。山里の春で楽しみたい景色は何？
desc_en: The Omoto Shrine Seimei Festival is a spring festival held in Kihoku Town. Kihoku is a mountain town in inland southern Ehime through which tributaries of the Shimanto River flow, surrounded by rich nature and farmland. With the arrival of spring, local people gather at the shrine to pray for the turning of the seasons and a bountiful harvest. In this traditional event handed down in the mountain village, you can feel the warmth of the community.
quiz_en: At spring festivals like the Omoto Shrine Seimei Festival, what springtime scenery would you like to enjoy in a mountain village?

name: 成川渓谷桜まつり
desc: 成川渓谷桜まつりは、鬼北町の成川渓谷で桜の季節に開かれる催しです。渓谷を流れる清流沿いに桜が咲き、山の緑と淡いピンクの花が美しい景色をつくります。鬼北町は豊かな山林と清流に恵まれた町で、渓谷周辺では自然の中でのんびりと過ごせます。川のせせらぎを聞きながら、春の花見を楽しんでください。
quiz: 成川渓谷桜まつりで、清流沿いの桜を眺めながら食べたいお花見弁当の中身は？
desc_en: The Narukawa Gorge Cherry Blossom Festival is held in cherry blossom season at Narukawa Gorge in Kihoku Town. Cherry trees bloom along the clear stream flowing through the gorge, and the green of the mountains and the pale pink blossoms create beautiful scenery. Kihoku is a town blessed with rich forests and clear streams, and around the gorge you can spend relaxing time in nature. Enjoy hanami (cherry blossom viewing) while listening to the murmur of the river.
quiz_en: While viewing the cherry blossoms along the stream at the Narukawa Gorge Cherry Blossom Festival, what would you like in your picnic lunch box?

name: 篠山
desc: 篠山は、愛南町と高知県宿毛市の県境にそびえる山です。春には、淡いピンクの花を咲かせるアケボノツツジが山頂付近を彩ることで知られています。山頂には篠山神社が鎮座し、古くから信仰の山として親しまれてきました。晴れた日には宇和海や太平洋、四国西南部の山々を見渡すことができます。
quiz: 篠山の山頂付近を春に淡いピンクで彩る、ツツジの仲間の花は何でしょう？
desc_en: Mount Sasayama rises on the border between Ainan Town and Sukumo City in Kochi Prefecture. It is known for the Akebono-tsutsuji azaleas whose pale pink flowers decorate the area near the summit in spring. Sasayama Shrine stands at the summit, and the mountain has long been revered as a sacred peak. On clear days you can see the Uwa Sea, the Pacific Ocean and the mountains of southwestern Shikoku.
quiz_en: Which flower, a member of the azalea family, colors the area near the summit of Mount Sasayama pale pink in spring?

name: 海中公園
desc: 愛南町の海中公園は、足摺宇和海国立公園の一部で、鹿島周辺の海にはサンゴや色とりどりの熱帯魚が見られる海中景観が広がっています。黒潮の影響を受けた暖かな海は透明度が高く、グラスボートなどで海の中をのぞけば、まるで竜宮城のような世界に出会えます。夏には海水浴やシュノーケリングも楽しめます。
quiz: 愛南町の海中公園で見られる海の中の景色、あなたが一番見たい生き物は何？
desc_en: Ainan's Marine Park is part of Ashizuri-Uwakai National Park, and in the waters around Kashima Island a seascape of coral and colorful tropical fish spreads out. Warmed by the Kuroshio Current, the sea is highly transparent, and peering into it from a glass-bottom boat reveals a world like the undersea Dragon Palace of Japanese legend. In summer you can also enjoy swimming and snorkeling.
quiz_en: Thinking of the underwater scenery at Ainan Marine Park, which sea creature would you most like to see?

name: 高茂岬
desc: 高茂岬は、愛南町の西端にある岬で、宇和海に向かって切り立った断崖が続いています。岬の展望台からは、荒々しい岩礁と青い海、点在する島々が織りなす雄大な景色を眺めることができます。夕暮れ時には海に沈む夕日が辺りを赤く染め、四国西南端ならではのダイナミックな景観が楽しめます。
quiz: 愛南町の高茂岬で、断崖の向こうに沈む夕日を見た感想を教えてください？
desc_en: Cape Komo is at the western tip of Ainan Town, where sheer cliffs line the coast facing the Uwa Sea. From the observation deck on the cape, you can enjoy a magnificent view of rugged reefs, blue sea and scattered islands. At dusk, the sun sinking into the sea dyes the surroundings red, offering dynamic scenery unique to the southwestern tip of Shikoku.
quiz_en: How did it feel to watch the sun sink beyond the cliffs at Cape Komo in Ainan Town?

name: 高知城
desc: 高知城は、土佐藩初代藩主・山内一豊が築いた城で、江戸時代に再建された天守が現存する貴重な城です。天守だけでなく本丸の御殿なども残り、本丸の建造物が当時のまま揃う全国でも珍しい城として知られています。追手門から天守を一枚の写真に収められる景色も人気で、春には城山が桜に包まれます。
quiz: 本丸の建造物が今も揃う高知城。この城を築いた土佐藩の初代藩主は誰でしょう？
desc_en: Kochi Castle was built by Yamauchi Kazutoyo, the first lord of the Tosa domain, and is a valuable castle whose keep, rebuilt in the Edo period, still survives. The main enclosure's palace also remains, and it is known as one of the few castles in Japan where all the buildings of the main enclosure survive as they were. The view capturing the keep from the Otemon Gate in a single photo is popular, and in spring the castle hill is covered in cherry blossoms.
quiz_en: Kochi Castle still retains all the buildings of its main enclosure. Who was the first lord of the Tosa domain who built it?

name: お遍路さんのお接待
desc: 高知県は四国遍路で「修行の道場」と呼ばれ、札所と札所の間の距離が長いことで知られています。太平洋沿いの長い道のりを歩くお遍路さんに、地元の人々が飲み物や食べ物を手渡す「お接待」の文化が受け継がれています。厳しい道中だからこそ、土佐の人々の温かなもてなしが旅人の心に深く残ります。
quiz: 札所間の距離が長い四国遍路の高知県。「何の道場」と呼ばれているでしょう？
desc_en: In the Shikoku pilgrimage, Kochi Prefecture is called the 'dojo of ascetic training' and is known for the long distances between its temples. A culture of settai has been passed down, in which local people hand food and drink to henro (pilgrims) walking the long route along the Pacific coast. Precisely because the journey is so tough, the warm hospitality of the people of Tosa leaves a deep impression on travelers.
quiz_en: Kochi Prefecture, with its long distances between temples on the Shikoku pilgrimage, is called what kind of 'dojo'?

name: 高知の皿鉢料理
desc: 皿鉢料理は、高知の宴会に欠かせない郷土料理です。大きな皿に刺身やカツオのたたき、寿司、煮物、果物などを豪快に盛り付け、皆で好きなものを取り分けて楽しみます。宴会を「おきゃく」と呼ぶ高知では、酒を酌み交わしながら大皿を囲むのが定番です。土佐の人々のおおらかな気風が表れた食文化です。
quiz: 高知で皿鉢料理を囲むような宴会のことを、土佐の言葉で何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: Sawachi cuisine is a local dish essential to banquets in Kochi. Sashimi, seared bonito (katsuo no tataki), sushi, simmered dishes, fruit and more are boldly arranged on a large platter, and everyone helps themselves to what they like. In Kochi, where a banquet is called 'okyaku,' gathering around a big platter while sharing sake is the norm. It is a food culture that reflects the generous spirit of the people of Tosa.
quiz_en: In the local Tosa dialect, what is the word for a banquet like the ones where people gather around sawachi platters?

name: 桂浜公園
desc: 桂浜は、高知市浦戸にある弓なりの美しい浜辺で、太平洋の雄大な波が打ち寄せます。高台には太平洋を見つめる坂本龍馬の銅像が立ち、龍馬ファンの聖地としても知られています。よさこい節に「月の名所は桂浜」と歌われるように、月夜の景色も格別です。浜辺は遊泳禁止なので、景色を眺めて楽しみましょう。
quiz: 桂浜の高台に立ち、太平洋を見つめている幕末の志士の銅像は誰？
desc_en: Katsurahama is a beautiful bow-shaped beach in the Urado area of Kochi City, where the mighty waves of the Pacific roll in. On the heights stands a bronze statue of Sakamoto Ryoma gazing at the Pacific, making it a sacred spot for Ryoma fans. As the folk song Yosakoi-bushi sings, Katsurahama is famous for the moon, and its moonlit scenery is exceptional. Swimming is prohibited at the beach, so enjoy the views instead.
quiz_en: Whose bronze statue, a late Edo-period revolutionary, stands on the heights of Katsurahama gazing out at the Pacific Ocean?

name: 竹林寺
desc: 高知市の五台山にある竹林寺は、四国八十八ヶ所霊場の第三十一番札所です。境内には五重塔がそびえ、夢窓疎石の作と伝わる庭園は名勝に指定されています。秋には紅葉が境内を彩り、厳かな雰囲気に包まれます。すぐ近くには県立牧野植物園があり、高知市街を見下ろす五台山の散策とあわせて楽しめます。
quiz: 第三十一番札所・竹林寺がある、高知市街を見下ろす山の名前は何でしょう？
desc_en: Chikurin-ji on Mount Godai in Kochi City is Temple No. 31 of the Shikoku 88 Temple Pilgrimage. A five-story pagoda towers over the grounds, and its garden, said to be the work of Muso Soseki, is designated a Place of Scenic Beauty. In autumn, colorful leaves decorate the grounds, wrapped in a solemn atmosphere. The Kochi Prefectural Makino Botanical Garden is right nearby, and you can enjoy it together with a walk on Mount Godai overlooking the city.
quiz_en: What is the name of the mountain overlooking Kochi City on which Chikurin-ji, Temple No. 31, stands?

name: 梅まつり
desc: 梅まつりは、高知市土佐山東川で梅の花が咲く早春に開かれる催しです。土佐山は高知市北部の山あいにある地域で、清流と緑に囲まれた里山の風景が広がっています。斜面に咲き誇る白や紅の梅の花が春の訪れを告げ、甘い香りに包まれながら山里散策を楽しめます。ゆずなど柑橘の産地でもあります。
quiz: 土佐山の梅まつりで春を感じたら、山里で味わいたい名物は何ですか？
desc_en: The Plum Festival is held in early spring, when the plum blossoms open, in the Higashigawa area of Tosayama in Kochi City. Tosayama is a mountain area in northern Kochi City with countryside scenery surrounded by clear streams and greenery. White and red plum blossoms covering the slopes announce the arrival of spring, and you can enjoy a walk through the village wrapped in their sweet scent. The area also produces citrus such as yuzu.
quiz_en: After feeling spring at the Tosayama Plum Festival, what local specialty would you like to taste in this mountain village?

name: 仁淀川
addr: 高知市・土佐市・いの町・日高村
desc: 仁淀川は、四国山地から高知県中部を流れ太平洋へと注ぐ清流で、全国屈指の水質を誇る川として知られています。その透明な水が光を受けて青く輝く様子は「仁淀ブルー」と呼ばれています。流域には増水時に水面下に沈む沈下橋が点在し、川遊びやカヌーなど、清流と共にある暮らしの風景を楽しめます。
quiz: 仁淀川などに架かる、増水時に水面下に沈むように造られた橋を何と呼ぶ？
area_en: Kochi City, Tosa City, Ino Town and Hidaka Village
desc_en: The Niyodo River is a clear river flowing from the Shikoku Mountains through central Kochi Prefecture into the Pacific, known for having some of the best water quality in Japan. The way its transparent water catches the light and shines blue is called 'Niyodo Blue.' Bridges designed to sink beneath the surface when the water rises are scattered along the river, and you can enjoy scenes of life alongside the river, such as river play and canoeing.
quiz_en: What are the bridges called that span rivers such as the Niyodo and are designed to sink beneath the water when it rises?

name: 室戸岬
desc: 室戸岬は、太平洋に鋭く突き出た岬で、ユネスコ世界ジオパークに認定された室戸の大地の成り立ちを感じられる場所です。海岸には荒々しい岩礁が続き、亜熱帯の植物が生い茂ります。若き日の空海が修行したと伝わる洞窟・御厨人窟もあり、岬の高台には白い室戸岬灯台が立ち、雄大な太平洋を照らしています。
quiz: 室戸岬で、若き日の空海が修行したと伝わる洞窟の名前は何でしょう？
desc_en: Cape Muroto juts sharply into the Pacific Ocean, a place where you can feel the formation of the land of Muroto, certified as a UNESCO Global Geopark. Rugged reefs line the coast, and subtropical plants grow thickly. There is also Mikurodo, a cave where the young Kukai is said to have trained, and on the heights of the cape stands the white Muroto Misaki Lighthouse, shining over the vast Pacific.
quiz_en: At Cape Muroto, what is the name of the cave where the young Kukai is said to have undergone ascetic training?

name: ふるさと室戸まつり
desc: ふるさと室戸まつりは、室戸市の室戸岬町で開かれる市民のお祭りです。室戸はマグロやキンメダイなどの漁業が盛んな港町で、太平洋に面した雄大な自然に囲まれています。祭りの日には、地元の人々が集まって踊りや催しで盛り上がり、港町ならではの活気に満ちあふれます。海の幸の味わいも楽しみの一つです。
quiz: ふるさと室戸まつりで味わいたい、室戸の港で水揚げされる名物の魚は何？
desc_en: The Furusato Muroto Festival is a community festival held in the Murotomisaki area of Muroto City. Muroto is a port town where fishing for tuna, splendid alfonsino (kinmedai) and other fish thrives, surrounded by the magnificent nature of the Pacific coast. On festival day, local people gather to celebrate with dances and events, and the town overflows with the energy of a port town. Tasting the local seafood is another highlight.
quiz_en: Which famous fish landed at Muroto's ports would you like to taste at the Furusato Muroto Festival?

name: 安芸納涼市民祭
addr: 安芸市安田町大字西島40-2
desc: 安芸納涼市民祭は、安芸市で夏に開かれる市民のお祭りです。安芸市は太平洋に面した高知県東部の町で、三菱の創業者・岩崎弥太郎の生誕地としても知られています。夏の夜には、地元の人々や帰省した人々が集まり、催しや出店でにぎわいます。潮風に吹かれながら、土佐の夏の夜を楽しんでください。
quiz: 安芸市の生まれで、三菱の創業者として知られる人物は誰でしょう？
desc_en: The Aki Summer Evening Festival is a community festival held in summer in Aki City. Aki is a town in eastern Kochi Prefecture facing the Pacific, also known as the birthplace of Iwasaki Yataro, founder of Mitsubishi. On summer nights, local residents and people returning home for the holidays gather, and the festival bustles with events and stalls. Enjoy a Tosa summer night in the sea breeze.
quiz_en: Who is the person born in Aki City who is known as the founder of Mitsubishi?

name: 国分寺
desc: 南国市国分の国分寺は、四国八十八ヶ所霊場の第二十九番札所で、奈良時代に聖武天皇の命によって建てられた土佐国分寺にあたります。こけら葺きの金堂は国の重要文化財に指定されており、苔むした境内は落ち着いた趣に満ちています。周辺は土佐の国府が置かれた地域で、古代の歴史を感じられます。
quiz: 全国の国分寺は、奈良時代のどの天皇の命によって建てられたでしょう？
desc_en: Kokubun-ji in the Kokubu area of Nankoku City is Temple No. 29 of the Shikoku 88 Temple Pilgrimage and the Tosa provincial temple built in the Nara period on the orders of Emperor Shomu. Its main hall, with a shingled roof, is designated an Important Cultural Property, and the mossy grounds are full of calm charm. The surrounding area was the site of Tosa's provincial capital, letting you feel ancient history.
quiz_en: The provincial Kokubun-ji temples across Japan were built on the orders of which Nara-period emperor?

name: 禅師峰寺
desc: 南国市十市の禅師峰寺は、四国八十八ヶ所霊場の第三十二番札所で、「峰寺」の名で親しまれています。小高い山の上にあり、境内には奇岩が点在し、土佐湾を一望できる眺めが魅力です。本尊の十一面観音は海上安全の守り仏として漁師たちの信仰を集め、「船魂観音」とも呼ばれてきました。
quiz: 禅師峰寺の本尊の観音さまは、漁師たちから何観音と呼ばれてきた？
desc_en: Zenjibu-ji in the Toichi area of Nankoku City is Temple No. 32 of the Shikoku 88 Temple Pilgrimage, affectionately known as 'Minedera.' It stands on a small hill, with unusual rocks scattered across its grounds and a sweeping view over Tosa Bay. Its principal image, the Eleven-Faced Kannon, has been worshipped by fishermen as a guardian of safety at sea and has also been called 'Funadama Kannon.'
quiz_en: Fishermen have long worshipped the principal Kannon image of Zenjibu-ji Temple. By what name have they called it?

name: ながおか温泉
desc: ながおか温泉は、南国市下末松にある温泉です。南国市は高知平野の東部に広がる町で、温暖な気候を生かした米づくりや園芸農業が盛んです。高知龍馬空港にも近く、旅の始まりや終わりに立ち寄りやすい立地です。田園の中の温泉で、ゆったりと湯に浸かって土佐の旅の疲れを癒してください。
quiz: ながおか温泉のある南国市。高知の玄関口となる空港の愛称は何でしょう？
desc_en: Nagaoka Onsen is a hot spring in the Shimosuematsu area of Nankoku City. Nankoku spreads across the eastern Kochi Plain, where rice farming and horticulture thrive thanks to the warm climate. Close to Kochi Ryoma Airport, it is easy to stop by at the start or end of a trip. At this hot spring among the fields, take a leisurely soak and soothe the fatigue of your journey through Tosa.
quiz_en: Nagaoka Onsen is in Nankoku City. What is the nickname of the airport that serves as the gateway to Kochi?

name: 宇佐大鍋まつり
desc: 宇佐大鍋まつりは、土佐市宇佐町で開かれる、大きな鍋料理がふるまわれる催しです。宇佐は土佐湾に面した漁師町で、新鮮な魚介に恵まれています。大鍋で煮込まれた海の幸の味わいは格別で、地元の人々と観光客が一緒に鍋を囲み、港町の温かいもてなしを感じられます。海辺の景色も楽しみの一つです。
quiz: 宇佐大鍋まつりで大鍋を囲むなら、どんな海の幸を入れてほしいですか？
desc_en: The Usa Onabe (Big Pot) Festival is an event in the Usa area of Tosa City where a hot pot dish cooked in a huge pot is served. Usa is a fishing town facing Tosa Bay, blessed with fresh seafood. The flavor of seafood simmered in the big pot is exceptional, and locals and visitors gather around the pot together, feeling the warm hospitality of the port town. The seaside scenery is another pleasure.
quiz_en: If you gathered around the giant pot at the Usa Onabe Festival, what kinds of seafood would you want in it?

name: 宇佐港まつり
desc: 宇佐港まつりは、土佐市宇佐町の港で開かれる夏のお祭りです。宇佐は土佐湾に面した漁港の町で、横浪半島へ続く宇佐大橋が架かる風光明媚な土地です。祭りの日には港に人々が集まり、海の安全と豊漁を願いながら、催しや出店でにぎわいます。潮風を感じながら、港町の夏の活気を味わってください。
quiz: 宇佐港まつりで港町の夏を満喫するなら、何を一番楽しみたいですか？
desc_en: The Usa Port Festival is a summer festival held at the port in the Usa area of Tosa City. Usa is a fishing port town facing Tosa Bay, a scenic place spanned by the Usa Ohashi Bridge leading to the Yokonami Peninsula. On festival day, people gather at the port to pray for safety at sea and good catches, and the festival bustles with events and stalls. Feel the summer energy of the port town in the sea breeze.
quiz_en: If you were to fully enjoy summer in a port town at the Usa Port Festival, what would you look forward to most?

name: 大綱祭り
desc: 大綱祭りは、土佐市高岡町で行われる夏のお祭りで、大きな綱を使った綱引きが見どころです。たくさんの人が力を合わせて大綱を引き合う姿は迫力があり、観客の声援とともに会場が熱気に包まれます。土佐市は仁淀川の下流域に広がる町で、市街地の高岡は商店が立ち並ぶ土佐市の中心部です。
quiz: 大綱祭りの大綱引き、あなたが参加するなら勝つための作戦はありますか？
desc_en: The Otsuna Festival is a summer festival held in the Takaoka area of Tosa City, highlighted by a tug-of-war with a huge rope. The sight of many people joining forces to pull the giant rope is powerful, and the venue is filled with excitement along with the cheers of spectators. Tosa City spreads along the lower reaches of the Niyodo River, and Takaoka, lined with shops, is the city's center.
quiz_en: If you took part in the giant tug-of-war at the Otsuna Festival, what strategy would you use to win?

name: 桑田山雪割り桜
desc: 桑田山雪割り桜は、須崎市の桑田山地区で早春に咲く早咲きの桜です。まだ寒さの残る時期に、山の斜面をピンク色の花が彩り、一足早い春の訪れを告げます。菜の花とともに咲く年もあり、黄色とピンクの対比が鮮やかです。須崎市は土佐湾に面した港町で、鍋焼きラーメンなどのご当地グルメも楽しめます。
quiz: 桑田山雪割り桜を見に須崎市へ。須崎で味わいたいご当地ラーメンは何？
desc_en: The Sotayama Yukiwari cherry trees are early-blooming cherries that flower in early spring in the Sotayama area of Susaki City. While the cold still lingers, pink blossoms color the mountain slopes, announcing the early arrival of spring. In some years they bloom together with rapeseed flowers, creating a vivid contrast of yellow and pink. Susaki is a port town facing Tosa Bay, where you can also enjoy local dishes such as nabeyaki ramen.
quiz_en: You travel to Susaki City to see the Sotayama Yukiwari cherry blossoms. Which local ramen dish would you like to try there?

name: 須崎まつり
desc: 須崎まつりは、須崎市で開かれる市民のお祭りです。須崎市は土佐湾に面した港町で、天然の良港を持ち、漁業や港湾の町として発展してきました。祭りの日には地元の人々が集まり、踊りやパレード、出店などで町がにぎわいます。ご当地グルメの鍋焼きラーメンを味わいながら、港町の活気を楽しんでください。
quiz: 須崎まつりのにぎわいの中、須崎市で味わってみたいご当地グルメは何？
desc_en: The Susaki Festival is a community festival held in Susaki City. Susaki is a port town facing Tosa Bay with a fine natural harbor, and it developed as a town of fishing and port industries. On festival day, local people gather and the town bustles with dances, parades and stalls. Enjoy the port town's energy while tasting the local specialty, nabeyaki ramen.
quiz_en: Amid the bustle of the Susaki Festival, what local food would you like to try in Susaki City?

name: 延光寺
desc: 宿毛市平田町の延光寺は、四国八十八ヶ所霊場の第三十九番札所で、土佐の国最後の札所です。竜宮城から梵鐘を背負って現れたという赤い亀の伝説が残り、境内には梵鐘を背負った赤亀の像が置かれています。山あいの静かな境内で、厳しい「修行の道場」の道のりを終えたお遍路さんがほっと一息つく場所です。
quiz: 延光寺の伝説で、竜宮城から梵鐘を背負って現れたとされる生き物は何？
desc_en: Enko-ji in the Hirata area of Sukumo City is Temple No. 39 of the Shikoku 88 Temple Pilgrimage and the last temple in Tosa Province. A legend tells of a red turtle that appeared from the undersea Dragon Palace carrying a temple bell on its back, and a statue of the red turtle bearing a bell stands in the grounds. In these quiet mountain grounds, pilgrims who have finished the demanding 'dojo of ascetic training' can finally breathe a sigh of relief.
quiz_en: According to the legend of Enko-ji Temple, what creature appeared from the undersea Dragon Palace carrying a temple bell on its back?

name: 咸陽島公園
desc: 咸陽島公園は、宿毛市大島にある海辺の公園です。沖に浮かぶ咸陽島は、夕日の名所として知られています。冬の晴れた日には、水平線に沈む夕日が海面に映り込み、だるまのような形に見える「だるま夕日」が現れることもあります。宿毛湾の穏やかな海と島々が織りなす景色を眺めながら、ゆったりと過ごせます。
quiz: 宿毛の海で、冬に水平線に沈む太陽がだるまの形に見える現象を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: Kanyojima Park is a seaside park on Oshima in Sukumo City. Kanyojima, the island floating offshore, is known as a famous sunset spot. On clear winter days, the sun setting on the horizon is reflected on the sea surface, and a 'Daruma sunset,' shaped like a daruma doll, may appear. You can spend a relaxing time gazing at the scenery of the calm Sukumo Bay and its islands.
quiz_en: What is the name of the winter phenomenon off Sukumo in which the sun setting on the horizon looks like a daruma doll?

name: 市民祭宿毛まつり
desc: 市民祭宿毛まつりは、宿毛市で開かれる市民のお祭りです。宿毛市は高知県の西南端に位置し、愛媛県と接する町で、宿毛湾の豊かな漁場に恵まれています。祭りの日には、地域の人々が集まり踊りや催しで町を盛り上げます。黒潮が育んだ新鮮な海の幸を味わいながら、宿毛の人々の熱気に触れてください。
quiz: 市民祭宿毛まつりに参加したら、宿毛湾の海の幸で食べたいものは何？
desc_en: The Sukumo Citizens' Festival is a community festival held in Sukumo City. Sukumo lies at the southwestern tip of Kochi Prefecture, bordering Ehime Prefecture, and is blessed with the rich fishing grounds of Sukumo Bay. On festival day, local people gather to liven up the town with dances and events. Savor fresh seafood nurtured by the Kuroshio Current and experience the energy of the people of Sukumo.
quiz_en: If you joined the Sukumo Citizens' Festival, what seafood from Sukumo Bay would you like to eat?

name: 足摺岬
desc: 足摺岬は、四国最南端に位置する岬で、太平洋に向かって高さ数十mの断崖がそそり立ちます。岬の先端には白い足摺岬灯台が立ち、一面の青い海を見渡す景色は圧巻です。近くには四国八十八ヶ所霊場の第三十八番札所・金剛福寺があり、この地出身のジョン万次郎の銅像も立っています。冬には椿が咲きます。
quiz: 足摺岬に銅像が立つ、漂流の末にアメリカに渡った土佐清水出身の人物は誰？
desc_en: Cape Ashizuri is the southernmost point of Shikoku, where cliffs tens of meters high tower over the Pacific Ocean. At the tip of the cape stands the white Ashizuri Misaki Lighthouse, and the view over the endless blue sea is breathtaking. Nearby is Kongofuku-ji, Temple No. 38 of the Shikoku 88 Temple Pilgrimage, and a bronze statue of John Manjiro, a native of this area, also stands here. Camellias bloom in winter.
quiz_en: Who is the Tosashimizu native, honored by a statue at Cape Ashizuri, who reached America after being cast adrift at sea?

name: 市民祭あしずりまつり
desc: 市民祭あしずりまつりは、土佐清水市で開かれる市民のお祭りです。土佐清水市は足摺岬を擁する四国最南端の町で、清水サバなど一本釣りの漁業が盛んな港町です。祭りの日には地域の人々が集まり、踊りや催しで町がにぎわいます。南国らしい開放的な雰囲気の中で、港町の熱気を味わってください。
quiz: あしずりまつりで土佐清水を訪れたら、味わいたい名物の魚は何ですか？
desc_en: The Ashizuri Citizens' Festival is a community festival held in Tosashimizu City. Tosashimizu, home to Cape Ashizuri, is the southernmost town in Shikoku and a port town where pole-and-line fishing, such as for Shimizu mackerel, thrives. On festival day, local people gather and the town bustles with dances and events. Experience the energy of the port town in an open, tropical atmosphere.
quiz_en: If you visited Tosashimizu for the Ashizuri Festival, which famous local fish would you like to taste?

name: 四万十川
desc: 四万十川は、高知県西部をゆったりと蛇行しながら流れる大河で、「日本最後の清流」と呼ばれています。流域には、増水時に水面下に沈むよう欄干を持たない沈下橋が数多く架かり、川と共に生きてきた暮らしの風景をつくっています。屋形船やカヌーで川下りを楽しんだり、川エビや天然うなぎなどの川の幸も味わえます。
quiz: 四万十川は、その美しい水の流れから「日本最後の何」と呼ばれている？
desc_en: The Shimanto River is a great river that meanders slowly through western Kochi Prefecture and is called 'Japan's last clear stream.' Many chinkabashi, bridges without railings designed to sink beneath the water during floods, span the river, creating scenery of a way of life lived alongside it. You can enjoy river trips by roofed boat or canoe, and taste river delicacies such as river shrimp and wild eel.
quiz_en: Because of its beautiful, clear flowing water, the Shimanto River is often called 'Japan's last' what?

name: しまんと市民祭
addr: 四万十市中村天神橋他
desc: しまんと市民祭は、四万十市の中心部、中村の天神橋周辺などで開かれる市民のお祭りです。中村は「土佐の小京都」と呼ばれる町で、碁盤の目状の町並みにその面影が残ります。祭りの日には、四万十川の流れる町に人々が集まり、踊りや催しで大いににぎわいます。清流の町の夏の熱気を楽しんでください。
quiz: しまんと市民祭が開かれる四万十市中村は、「土佐の何」と呼ばれる町？
desc_en: The Shimanto Citizens' Festival is a community festival held in central Shimanto City, around places such as Tenjin Bridge in Nakamura. Nakamura is called the 'Little Kyoto of Tosa,' and its grid-patterned streets retain traces of this. On festival day, people gather in the town along the Shimanto River, and it bustles greatly with dances and events. Enjoy the summer energy of this town of clear streams.
quiz_en: Nakamura in Shimanto City, where the Shimanto Citizens' Festival is held, is called the 'Little' what 'of Tosa'?

name: 四万十市不破八幡宮大祭
desc: 不破八幡宮大祭は、四万十市不破の八幡宮で秋に行われる祭礼で、「神様の結婚式」として知られています。周辺の神社から女神を乗せた神輿が集まり、四万十川の上で神輿どうしが出会う様子など、ユニークな神事が繰り広げられます。地域の豊作と繁栄を願う、古くから受け継がれてきた伝統の祭りです。
quiz: 不破八幡宮大祭は、その独特の神事から何という愛称で知られている？
desc_en: The Fuwa Hachimangu Grand Festival is an autumn festival held at the Hachimangu shrine in the Fuwa area of Shimanto City, known as the 'wedding of the gods.' Mikoshi (portable shrines) carrying goddesses gather from surrounding shrines, and unique rituals unfold, such as the mikoshi meeting one another on the Shimanto River. It is a traditional festival handed down from long ago, praying for good harvests and prosperity in the region.
quiz_en: Thanks to its unique rituals, the Fuwa Hachimangu Grand Festival is known by what affectionate nickname?

name: 高知県立のいち動物公園
desc: 高知県立のいち動物公園は、香南市野市町の丘陵地にある動物園です。動物たちの暮らす環境を再現した展示が特徴で、檻をなるべく感じさせない工夫により、自然に近い姿の動物たちを観察できます。広い園内は緑豊かで、散策しながら世界各地の動物に出会えます。家族連れに人気の憩いのスポットです。
quiz: のいち動物公園で、あなたが一番会いたいと思う動物は何ですか？
desc_en: Kochi Prefectural Noichi Zoological Park is a zoo on the hills of the Noichi area of Konan City. Its exhibits recreate the environments where the animals live, and with designs that minimize the feeling of cages, you can observe animals behaving much as they would in nature. The spacious grounds are green, and you can meet animals from around the world as you stroll. It is a popular spot for families.
quiz_en: If you visited Kochi Prefectural Noichi Zoological Park, which animal would you most like to meet and watch?

name: 黒潮温泉
desc: 黒潮温泉は、香南市野市町東野にある温泉です。香南市は高知平野の東部に位置し、土佐湾に面した温暖な町です。近くにはのいち動物公園などもあり、観光の途中に気軽に立ち寄れます。黒潮の名にふさわしく、南国土佐の明るい雰囲気の中で、湯に浸かってゆったりとした時間を過ごしてください。
quiz: 黒潮温泉でひと休みしたら、香南市で立ち寄りたいスポットはどこですか？
desc_en: Kuroshio Onsen is a hot spring in the Higashino area of Noichi in Konan City. Konan lies in the eastern Kochi Plain, a warm town facing Tosa Bay. Noichi Zoological Park and other attractions are nearby, so it is easy to drop by while sightseeing. True to its name, taken from the Kuroshio Current, you can soak and spend relaxing time in the bright atmosphere of southern Tosa.
quiz_en: After taking a break at Kuroshio Onsen, which spots would you like to stop by in Konan City?

name: 香南市みなこい港まつり
desc: みなこい港まつりは、香南市吉川町の港で開かれる夏のお祭りです。吉川町は土佐湾に面した地域で、海とともに暮らしてきた漁港の町です。祭りの日には港に人々が集まり、催しや出店でにぎわいます。潮風を感じながら、港町ならではの海の幸と夏の夜の楽しさを味わってください。
quiz: みなこい港まつりで味わいたい、香南市の港で水揚げされる海の幸は何？
desc_en: The Minakoi Port Festival is a summer festival held at the port in the Yoshikawa area of Konan City. Yoshikawa faces Tosa Bay, a fishing port town that has lived alongside the sea. On festival day, people gather at the port and it bustles with events and stalls. Feel the sea breeze and enjoy the seafood unique to a port town and the fun of a summer night.
quiz_en: Which seafood landed at Konan City's port would you like to taste at the Minakoi Port Festival?

name: 冬の夏祭り
desc: 冬の夏祭りは、香南市赤岡町で開かれる、その名の通り冬に夏祭り気分を楽しむ催しです。赤岡町は、幕末の絵師・絵金の芝居絵屏風が受け継がれる町として知られ、古い商家の町並みが残っています。冬の寒さの中でにぎやかな催しが行われ、人々の熱気が町を温めます。ユニークな発想の町の祭りを楽しんでください。
quiz: 赤岡町に受け継がれる芝居絵屏風を描いた、幕末の絵師の通称は何でしょう？
desc_en: The Winter Summer Festival, held in the Akaoka area of Konan City, is an event where, as its name suggests, you can enjoy a summer festival mood in winter. Akaoka is known as the town where the folding-screen theater paintings of Ekin, a painter of the late Edo period, have been handed down, and old merchant streets remain. Lively events take place in the winter cold, and the people's energy warms the town. Enjoy this town festival born of a unique idea.
quiz_en: By what popular name is the late Edo-period painter known, whose theater paintings on folding screens are preserved in Akaoka?

name: アカシアの花まつり
desc: アカシアの花まつりは、香南市夜須町で開かれる、アカシアの花が咲く季節の催しです。アカシアは初夏に白い房状の花を咲かせ、甘い香りを漂わせます。夜須町は土佐湾に面した海辺の町で、海とマリンスポーツを楽しめる施設もあります。花の香りと海風を感じながら、のんびりと過ごしてください。
quiz: アカシアの花まつりで甘い香りに包まれたら、夜須の海で何をしたいですか？
desc_en: The Acacia Flower Festival is held in the Yasu area of Konan City in the season when the acacia blooms. In early summer, acacia trees bear white, cluster-shaped flowers that give off a sweet fragrance. Yasu is a seaside town facing Tosa Bay, with facilities for enjoying the sea and marine sports. Relax while feeling the scent of the flowers and the sea breeze.
quiz_en: Wrapped in the sweet scent of the Acacia Flower Festival, what would you like to do in the sea at Yasu?

name: 龍河洞
desc: 龍河洞は、香美市にある鍾乳洞で、国の天然記念物および史跡に指定されています。洞内には鍾乳石や石筍がつくる神秘的な景観が広がり、ひんやりとした空気の中を探検気分で進めます。弥生時代の人々が使った土器が石灰華に包まれた「神の壺」が見られるのも特徴で、自然と人の歴史を感じられる場所です。
quiz: 龍河洞で見られる、弥生土器が石灰華に包まれたものは何と呼ばれている？
desc_en: Ryugado is a limestone cave in Kami City designated both a Natural Monument and a Historic Site. Inside, stalactites and stalagmites create a mysterious landscape, and you can make your way through the cool air with a sense of exploration. A distinctive feature is the 'Kami no Tsubo' (Pot of the Gods), a Yayoi-period earthenware pot encased in limestone, letting you feel both natural and human history.
quiz_en: What is the name of the Yayoi-period earthenware pot encased in limestone that can be seen in Ryugado Cave?

name: べふ峡温泉
desc: べふ峡温泉は、香美市物部町別府にある温泉です。近くのべふ峡は紅葉の名所として知られ、秋には渓谷が赤や黄に染まります。物部町は高知県東部の山深い地域で、豊かな森林と清流に恵まれています。渓谷の紅葉を楽しんだあとに温泉に浸かれば、山里ならではの静けさと癒しの時間を味わえます。
quiz: べふ峡温泉の近くにある、秋の紅葉の名所として知られる渓谷の名前は？
desc_en: Befukyo Onsen is a hot spring in the Befu area of Monobe in Kami City. The nearby Befu Gorge is known as a famous autumn foliage spot, where the valley turns red and yellow in autumn. Monobe is a deeply mountainous area in eastern Kochi Prefecture, blessed with rich forests and clear streams. Soaking in the hot spring after enjoying the gorge's autumn colors lets you savor the tranquility and healing of a mountain village.
quiz_en: What is the name of the gorge near Befukyo Onsen that is known as a famous spot for autumn leaves?

name: 甫喜ヶ峰森林公園
addr: 香美市土佐山田町平山
desc: 甫喜ヶ峰森林公園は、香美市土佐山田町の山中に整備された森林公園です。広い園内には遊歩道や展望台、キャンプ場などがあり、豊かな森の中で自然体験を楽しめます。展望台からは高知平野を見渡すことができ、晴れた日には遠くの山並みや海まで見えることもあります。森林浴にぴったりの場所です。
quiz: 甫喜ヶ峰森林公園で過ごすなら、キャンプと森林浴どちらを楽しみたい？
desc_en: Hokigamine Forest Park is a forest park in the mountains of the Tosayamada area of Kami City. The spacious grounds have walking trails, an observation deck and a campground, where you can enjoy nature experiences in a rich forest. From the observation deck you can look out over the Kochi Plain, and on clear days you may even see distant mountains and the sea. It is the perfect place for forest bathing.
quiz_en: If you spent the day at Hokigamine Forest Park, would you rather enjoy camping or forest bathing?

name: 刃物まつり
addr: 香美市土佐山田町宮の口
desc: 刃物まつりは、伝統の土佐打刃物で知られる香美市土佐山田町で開かれる催しです。土佐打刃物は鎌や鍬、包丁などを鍛造でつくる伝統工芸品で、切れ味と丈夫さで評価されています。祭りでは刃物の販売や鍛冶の実演などが行われ、職人の技を間近に見られます。お気に入りの一本を探してみてください。
quiz: 香美市土佐山田町の刃物まつりで知られる、伝統工芸品の刃物を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: The Hamono Festival is held in the Tosayamada area of Kami City, known for traditional Tosa forged blades. These blades, such as sickles, hoes and kitchen knives, are traditional crafts made by forging and are prized for their sharpness and durability. At the festival, blades are sold and blacksmithing is demonstrated, letting you see the craftsmen's skills up close. Try finding a favorite blade of your own.
quiz_en: What is the traditional craft of forged blades, celebrated at the Hamono Festival in Tosayamada, called?

name: 土佐山田まつり
addr: 香美市土佐山田町楠目831
desc: 土佐山田まつりは、香美市土佐山田町で開かれる地域のお祭りです。土佐山田町は高知平野の北東部に広がる町で、物部川の恵みを受けた田園と、背後の山々に囲まれています。祭りの日には地元の人々が集まり、踊りや催し、出店で町がにぎわいます。龍河洞観光とあわせて、地域の熱気を味わってください。
quiz: 土佐山田まつりで町歩きをしたら、香美市で食べたい名物は何ですか？
desc_en: The Tosayamada Festival is a local festival held in the Tosayamada area of Kami City. Tosayamada spreads across the northeastern Kochi Plain, surrounded by farmland blessed by the Monobe River and the mountains behind it. On festival day, local people gather and the town bustles with dances, events and stalls. Experience the energy of the community together with a visit to Ryugado Cave.
quiz_en: After walking around town at the Tosayamada Festival, what local specialty would you like to eat in Kami City?

name: 奥物部湖湖水祭
desc: 奥物部湖湖水祭は、香美市物部町の奥物部湖で開かれる湖の祭りです。奥物部湖は物部川をせき止めたダム湖で、周囲を深い山々に囲まれた静かな湖です。祭りの日には湖畔に人々が集まり、山あいの湖ならではの催しが行われます。湖面に映る山の緑を眺めながら、山里の夏の一日を楽しんでください。
quiz: 奥物部湖湖水祭で、静かな山あいの湖を眺めながら楽しみたいことは何？
desc_en: The Lake Okumonobe Festival is a lake festival held at Lake Okumonobe in the Monobe area of Kami City. Lake Okumonobe is a dam lake formed by damming the Monobe River, a quiet lake surrounded by deep mountains. On festival day, people gather on the lakeshore, and events unique to a mountain lake take place. Enjoy a summer day in the mountain village while gazing at the green mountains reflected on the water.
quiz_en: While gazing at the quiet mountain lake during the Lake Okumonobe Festival, what would you like to enjoy doing?

name: 生見海岸
desc: 生見海岸は、高知県東端の東洋町にある海岸で、太平洋からの良い波が年間を通して打ち寄せることから、サーフィンの名所として知られています。白い砂浜が続き、夏には海水浴を楽しむ人々でにぎわいます。徳島県との県境に近く、四国東南部の開放的な海の景色が広がる、サーファーの聖地とも呼ばれる場所です。
quiz: 東洋町の生見海岸で人気の、波に乗って楽しむマリンスポーツは何？
desc_en: Ikumi Beach is in Toyo Town at the eastern tip of Kochi Prefecture and is known as a famous surfing spot thanks to the good Pacific waves that roll in all year round. A white sandy beach stretches along the shore, bustling with swimmers in summer. Close to the border with Tokushima Prefecture, it offers open ocean views of southeastern Shikoku and is even called a sacred place for surfers.
quiz_en: What marine sport, enjoyed by riding the waves, is especially popular at Ikumi Beach in Toyo Town?

name: 奈半利町港まつり
desc: 奈半利町港まつりは、奈半利町の港で開かれる夏のお祭りです。奈半利町は高知県東部の土佐湾に面した町で、古い商家の町並みも残る歴史ある地域です。祭りの日には港に人々が集まり、催しや出店で夏の夜がにぎわいます。潮風を感じながら、海の町の活気と地元の人々の温かさに触れてください。
quiz: 奈半利町港まつりのような港町の夏祭りで、一番の楽しみは何ですか？
desc_en: The Nahari Port Festival is a summer festival held at the port of Nahari Town. Nahari is a town in eastern Kochi Prefecture facing Tosa Bay, a historic area where old merchant streets still remain. On festival day, people gather at the port, and the summer night bustles with events and stalls. Feel the sea breeze and experience the energy of this seaside town and the warmth of its people.
quiz_en: At summer festivals in port towns like the Nahari Port Festival, what do you look forward to the most?

name: 北川村温泉
desc: 北川村温泉は、北川村小島にある温泉です。北川村は奈半利川の上流に広がる山あいの村で、ゆずの産地として知られています。幕末の志士・中岡慎太郎の生誕地でもあり、記念館があります。また、モネの庭を再現した「北川村モネの庭マルモッタン」も人気です。自然と歴史に触れたあとに温泉で癒されてください。
quiz: 北川村出身で、坂本龍馬とともに活躍した幕末の志士は誰でしょう？
desc_en: Kitagawa Village Onsen is a hot spring in the Kojima area of Kitagawa Village. Kitagawa is a mountain village spreading along the upper Nahari River, known for producing yuzu citrus. It is also the birthplace of Nakaoka Shintaro, a revolutionary of the late Edo period, and has a memorial museum. The Kitagawa Village 'Monet's Garden' Marmottan, a recreation of Monet's garden, is also popular. After enjoying nature and history, relax in the hot spring.
quiz_en: Who is the late Edo-period revolutionary from Kitagawa Village who was active alongside Sakamoto Ryoma?

name: 馬路温泉
desc: 馬路温泉は、馬路村にある温泉です。馬路村は山深い村で、ゆずの産地として全国的に知られ、ゆずを使ったドリンクや加工品が人気です。かつては魚梁瀬杉を運ぶ森林鉄道が走り、林業で栄えた歴史を持ちます。清流・安田川のほとりで湯に浸かり、ゆずの香りに包まれた山村の時間をゆったり味わってください。
quiz: 馬路村が全国的な産地として知られ、ドリンクなどに加工されている柑橘は何？
desc_en: Umaji Onsen is a hot spring in Umaji Village. Umaji is a village deep in the mountains, known nationwide for producing yuzu citrus, and its yuzu drinks and other products are popular. A forest railway once ran here carrying Yanase cedar, and the village has a history of prospering from forestry. Soak by the clear Yasuda River and enjoy unhurried time in a mountain village wrapped in the scent of yuzu.
quiz_en: Umaji Village is known nationwide for producing a citrus fruit that is made into drinks and other products. Which fruit is it?

name: 帰全山公園
desc: 帰全山公園は、本山町の吉野川が大きく湾曲する場所にある公園です。土佐藩の家老・野中兼山が母の墓所を設けた地として知られ、園内には兼山ゆかりの史跡が残ります。春にはシャクナゲや桜が咲き、吉野川の清流と緑が織りなす景色が美しく、地元の人々の憩いの場として親しまれています。
quiz: 帰全山公園に母の墓所を設けた、土佐藩の家老として知られる人物は誰？
desc_en: Kizenzan Park is located where the Yoshino River makes a large bend in Motoyama Town. It is known as the place where Nonaka Kenzan, a chief retainer of the Tosa domain, built his mother's grave, and historic sites associated with Kenzan remain in the park. In spring, rhododendrons and cherry blossoms bloom, and the scenery woven by the clear Yoshino River and greenery is beautiful, making it a beloved relaxation spot for locals.
quiz_en: Who is the chief retainer of the Tosa domain who built his mother's grave at Kizenzan Park?

name: いの大国様春大祭
desc: いの大国様春大祭は、いの町の椙本神社で行われる春の祭礼で、地元では「大国さま」と呼ばれ親しまれています。いの町は仁淀川の流域に広がり、伝統の土佐和紙の産地として知られる町です。祭りの日には多くの参拝者や露店で境内周辺がにぎわい、春の訪れを祝う地域の一大行事となっています。
quiz: いの大国様春大祭が開かれるいの町は、何という伝統の紙の産地？
desc_en: The Ino Daikoku-sama Spring Grand Festival is a spring festival held at Sugimoto Shrine in Ino Town, affectionately called 'Daikoku-sama' by locals. Ino spreads along the Niyodo River and is known for producing traditional Tosa washi (Japanese paper). On festival day, many worshippers and street stalls fill the area around the shrine, making it a major local event celebrating the arrival of spring.
quiz_en: Ino Town, where the Ino Daikoku-sama Spring Grand Festival is held, is known for producing what kind of traditional paper?

name: ６３３美温泉
desc: いの町の山あいにある温泉です。いの町は土佐和紙の産地として知られ、清流・仁淀川が町を流れています。周囲は四国山地の緑に囲まれ、静かな里山の空気の中でゆったりと湯に浸かれます。ドライブや川遊びの途中に立ち寄り、山の景色を眺めながら旅の疲れを癒やしてください。
quiz: いの町が古くから産地として知られる、高知県の伝統工芸品は何でしょう？
desc_en: This onsen (hot spring) sits in the mountains of Ino Town, a place known for producing Tosa washi paper and crossed by the clear Niyodo River. Surrounded by the green of the Shikoku Mountains, it lets you soak at a relaxed pace in the quiet air of the countryside. Stop by during a drive or a day of river play and ease away your travel fatigue while gazing at the mountain scenery.
quiz_en: Ino Town has long been known as a production center for which traditional craft of Kochi Prefecture, made from plant fibers?

name: 木の香温泉
desc: いの町の北部、旧本川村エリアの山深い地域にある温泉です。名前のとおり木のぬくもりを感じる施設で、森に囲まれた環境が魅力です。周辺は四国山地の高い山々が連なり、新緑や紅葉の時期には車窓の景色も見事です。山歩きやドライブのあとに、静かな湯でひと休みしましょう。
quiz: 木の香温泉のような山の湯でひと息ついたあと、あなたが食べたい高知の山の幸は何？
desc_en: This hot spring lies deep in the mountains of northern Ino Town, in the area of the former Hongawa Village. True to its name, which evokes the scent of wood, the facility has a warm wooden feel, and its forest setting is a big part of its charm. The high peaks of the Shikoku Mountains line the surroundings, and the views from the car are superb in the season of fresh greenery and autumn leaves. Rest in the quiet bath after hiking or driving.
quiz_en: After relaxing in a mountain hot spring like Kinoka Onsen, which of Kochi's mountain delicacies would you most like to eat?

name: 中津渓谷 ゆの森
desc: 仁淀川の支流沿いに続く中津渓谷にある宿泊・入浴施設です。渓谷には遊歩道が整備され、巨岩の間を流れる澄んだ水や滝をめぐる散策が楽しめます。仁淀川の水は「仁淀ブルー」と呼ばれる青さで知られ、晴れた日の渓流は息をのむ美しさです。散策のあとは湯で体を温めてください。
quiz: 仁淀川の澄みきった青い水の色は、何という愛称で呼ばれているでしょう？
desc_en: This lodging and bathing facility is located in Nakatsu Gorge, which runs along a tributary of the Niyodo River. Walking trails lead through the gorge, where you can enjoy a stroll past clear water flowing between huge boulders and waterfalls. The Niyodo's water is famous for its striking blue color, and on sunny days the stream is breathtakingly beautiful. After your walk, warm up in the bath.
quiz_en: The crystal-clear water of the Niyodo River is known for its vivid color. What nickname is used for this famous blue?

name: 秋葉まつり
desc: 仁淀川町の別枝地区で行われる秋葉神社の祭りです。山あいの集落を練り歩く行列は、地域の人々が大切に受け継いできた伝統行事として知られています。華やかな装いの行列が山里の道を進む様子は見ごたえがあります。普段は静かな山の集落が、この日ばかりは大勢の人でにぎわいます。
quiz: 山里の秋葉まつりの行列、あなたが一番見てみたい場面や役どころはどれ？
desc_en: This festival of Akiba Shrine is held in the Betsueda district of Niyodogawa Town. Its procession through the mountain village is known as a traditional event that local people have carefully handed down through the generations. Watching the colorfully costumed procession make its way along the rural roads is a real highlight. On this one day, the usually quiet mountain village bustles with crowds of visitors.
quiz_en: If you watched the Akiba Festival procession winding through this mountain village, which scene or role in it would you most want to see?

name: ひょうたん桜
desc: 仁淀川町の桜地区に立つ一本桜です。樹の形がひょうたんのように見えることからこの名で呼ばれています。山あいの集落にどっしりと立つ大きな桜で、春の開花期には県内外から多くの花見客が訪れます。周囲の山の緑とともに眺めると、のどかな山里の春をしみじみと感じることができます。
quiz: ひょうたん桜の名前の由来は、木の形が何に似ていることからでしょう？
desc_en: This solitary cherry tree stands in the Sakura district of Niyodogawa Town. It gets its name from its shape, which resembles a hyotan, or gourd. The large tree stands proudly in a mountain hamlet, and during the spring blossom season many visitors come from inside and outside the prefecture to view it. Seen together with the green of the surrounding mountains, it offers a deep sense of springtime in a peaceful rural village.
quiz_en: The Hyotan Cherry Tree takes its name from the shape of the tree. What object is the tree's shape said to resemble?

name: 久礼八幡宮大祭
desc: カツオの一本釣りで知られる港町、中土佐町久礼の久礼八幡宮で行われる秋の大祭です。漁師町らしい活気あふれる祭りで、夜には大きな松明が奉納される神事が見どころとなっています。町には新鮮なカツオを扱う久礼大正町市場もあり、祭りとあわせて港町の味を楽しめます。
quiz: 港町・中土佐町久礼が一本釣りの水揚げで有名な、土佐を代表する魚は何でしょう？
desc_en: This grand autumn festival takes place at Kure Hachimangu Shrine in Kure, Nakatosa Town, a port known for pole-and-line bonito fishing. It is a lively festival befitting a fishing town, and the highlight is a nighttime ritual in which huge torches are offered to the deity. The town also has the Kure Taisho-machi Market, which sells fresh bonito, so you can enjoy the flavors of the port along with the festival.
quiz_en: The port of Kure in Nakatosa Town is famous for landing which fish, caught by pole-and-line and a symbol of Tosa?

name: コスモスまつり
desc: 越知町で秋に開かれるコスモスのまつりです。越知町は仁淀川の中流域に位置し、川沿いに広がる平地を彩るコスモス畑が見どころです。ピンクや白の花が風に揺れる景色の向こうに山並みが重なり、秋の高知らしいのどかな眺めが広がります。花畑の散策や記念撮影を楽しんでください。
quiz: 秋の花・コスモスは漢字で書くと「秋◯」。◯に入る漢字一文字は何でしょう？
desc_en: This cosmos festival is held in autumn in Ochi Town, which lies along the middle reaches of the Niyodo River. The highlight is the fields of cosmos coloring the flatlands that spread along the river. Pink and white flowers sway in the breeze against a backdrop of layered mountains, creating a peaceful scene typical of autumn in Kochi. Enjoy a stroll through the flower fields and take some commemorative photos.
quiz_en: If you strolled through the cosmos fields of Ochi Town in autumn, which color of cosmos would you most like to photograph?

name: 雲の上の温泉
desc: 「雲の上の町」と呼ばれる梼原町にある温泉施設です。梼原町は四国カルストのふもとに広がる高原の町で、建築家・隈研吾氏が手がけた木造建築が町内に点在することでも知られています。山の澄んだ空気に包まれた湯で、高原の景色とともにくつろぎのひとときを過ごせます。
quiz: 梼原町に多くの木造建築を手がけた、国立競技場の設計でも知られる建築家は誰？
desc_en: This hot spring facility is in Yusuhara Town, nicknamed the "town above the clouds." Yusuhara is a highland town spreading out at the foot of the Shikoku Karst, and it is also known for the wooden buildings designed by architect Kengo Kuma that dot the town. Wrapped in clear mountain air, you can spend a relaxing time in the bath while enjoying the highland scenery.
quiz_en: Which architect, also known for designing the National Stadium in Tokyo, created many wooden buildings in Yusuhara Town?

name: 四国カルスト天狗高原
desc: 愛媛県との県境に広がる四国カルストの一角、天狗高原です。標高1000mを超える尾根に石灰岩が点在するカルスト地形が続き、日本三大カルストの一つに数えられます。夏は放牧された牛がのんびり草をはみ、晴れた日には遠くの山々まで見渡せます。夜は満天の星空も魅力です。
quiz: 四国カルスト・秋吉台と並び「日本三大カルスト」と呼ばれる、北九州市の台地はどこ？
desc_en: Tengu Highlands is part of the Shikoku Karst, which stretches along the border with Ehime Prefecture. Karst landscapes with scattered limestone rocks continue along ridges more than 1,000 m above sea level, and the area is counted among Japan's three great karsts. In summer, grazing cattle leisurely munch on grass, and on clear days you can see distant mountains. The star-filled night sky is another attraction.
quiz_en: Along with the Shikoku Karst and Akiyoshidai, which plateau in Kitakyushu City is counted among Japan's three great karsts?

name: 岩本寺
desc: 四国八十八ヶ所霊場の第37番札所、岩本寺です。四万十町の市街地にあり、遍路道の中でも高知県の札所をつなぐ重要な寺として多くのお遍路さんが訪れます。本堂の天井には全国から寄せられた絵がはめ込まれており、花や人物などさまざまな画題を見上げて楽しむことができます。
quiz: 四国霊場第37番札所の岩本寺、本堂で見上げると目に入る名物は何でしょう？
desc_en: Iwamoto-ji is Temple No. 37 of the Shikoku 88 Temple Pilgrimage. Located in the town center of Shimanto, it is an important temple linking the pilgrimage sites of Kochi Prefecture, and many pilgrims visit. The ceiling of the main hall is inlaid with paintings sent from all over Japan, and you can look up and enjoy a wide variety of subjects, including flowers and people.
quiz_en: At Iwamoto-ji, Temple No. 37 of the Shikoku Pilgrimage, what famous feature catches your eye when you look up inside the main hall?

name: 西南大規模公園
desc: 黒潮町の入野松原に隣接して整備された大規模公園です。目の前には太平洋に面した入野海岸が広がり、白い砂浜と松林が続く景色が楽しめます。黒潮町は砂浜を美術館に見立てた「砂浜美術館」の取り組みで知られ、Tシャツアート展などの催しも行われます。海風を感じながら散策しましょう。
quiz: 砂浜を美術館に見立てる黒潮町の「砂浜美術館」、あなたならどんな作品を飾りたい？
desc_en: This large park was built next to the Irino Matsubara pine grove in Kuroshio Town. Right in front of it is Irino Beach, facing the Pacific Ocean, with a view of white sand and pine forest stretching along the shore. Kuroshio Town is known for its "Sunahama Museum" initiative, which treats the beach as an art museum, and events such as a T-shirt art exhibition are held. Take a walk and feel the sea breeze.
quiz_en: Kuroshio Town treats its sandy beach as an outdoor art museum. If you could display a work there, what would you choose to exhibit?

name: 博多祇園山笠
addr: 福岡市博多区上川端町1-41
desc: 毎年7月に福岡市博多区で行われる櫛田神社の奉納行事で、国の重要無形民俗文化財です。締め込み姿の男たちが舁き山笠を担いで博多の町を駆け抜ける「追い山笠」は早朝に行われ、迫力満点です。期間中は市内各所に豪華な飾り山笠が立ち並び、夏の博多は熱気に包まれます。
quiz: 博多祇園山笠を締めくくる、早朝に舁き山笠が町を駆け抜ける行事を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: Held every July in Hakata Ward, Fukuoka City, this festival is a dedication to Kushida Shrine and an Important Intangible Folk Cultural Property of Japan. In the thrilling early-morning race, men in traditional loincloths carry heavy festival floats at a run through the streets of Hakata. During the festival period, gorgeous decorative floats stand throughout the city, and summer in Hakata is filled with excitement.
quiz_en: What is the name of the event that concludes the Hakata Gion Yamakasa, when float teams race through the town in the early morning?

name: 中洲川端の屋台村の食事
desc: 那珂川沿いの中洲・天神エリアは、夜になると屋台が並ぶ福岡ならではの風景が広がります。とんこつラーメンやおでん、焼きラーメンなど屋台ごとに個性ある味があり、隣り合わせたお客さんとの会話も楽しみの一つです。川面に映るネオンを眺めながら、博多の夜をのんびり味わってください。
quiz: 博多の屋台でラーメンを食べたあと、麺だけ追加注文することを何と言う？
desc_en: Along the Naka River, the Nakasu and Tenjin areas transform at night into a scene unique to Fukuoka, lined with yatai (open-air food stalls). Each stall has its own distinctive flavors, such as tonkotsu pork-bone ramen, oden stew and fried ramen, and chatting with the customers sitting next to you is part of the fun. Take your time savoring a Hakata night while watching the neon lights reflected on the river.
quiz_en: After finishing a bowl of ramen at a Hakata food stall, what is the term for ordering an extra serving of noodles only?

name: 千光寺あじさいまつり
desc: 久留米市山本町の千光寺で行われるあじさいまつりです。千光寺は耳納連山のふもとにある古刹で、梅雨の時期には境内を色とりどりのあじさいが埋めつくします。雨に濡れて色を深める花々と山寺の落ち着いた雰囲気が調和し、しっとりとした初夏の情景を楽しめます。
quiz: あじさいの花の色は土の性質で変わるといわれます。酸性の土だと何色になりやすい？
desc_en: This hydrangea festival is held at Senko-ji Temple in the Yamamoto area of Kurume City. Senko-ji is an old temple at the foot of the Mino Mountains, and in the rainy season its grounds are filled with hydrangeas of many colors. The rain-soaked flowers deepen in color and blend with the calm atmosphere of the mountain temple, creating a gentle early-summer scene.
quiz_en: The color of hydrangea flowers is said to change depending on the soil. What color do they tend to become in acidic soil?

name: 若宮八幡宮御神幸祭
desc: 久留米市草野町の若宮八幡宮で行われる御神幸祭です。草野町は耳納連山のふもとに位置し、古い町並みや寺社が残る歴史ある地域です。祭りでは神輿や行列が町を巡り、地域の人々が受け継いできた伝統の姿を目にすることができます。祭りの日には静かな町並みが一段とにぎわいます。
quiz: 御神幸祭で神様が神輿に乗って町を巡ることを、一般に何と言うでしょう？
desc_en: This shinko festival, a sacred procession, is held at Wakamiya Hachimangu Shrine in the Kusano area of Kurume City. Kusano lies at the foot of the Mino Mountains and is a historic district where old townscapes, temples and shrines remain. During the festival, a mikoshi (portable shrine) and procession make their way through town, letting you see traditions handed down by local people. On festival day, the quiet streets become far livelier.
quiz_en: In Japanese festivals, what is the general term for the deity riding in a portable shrine and traveling around the town?

name: 高良大社 へこかき祭
desc: 筑後国一宮・高良大社で行われる祭りです。高良大社は久留米市の高良山の中腹に鎮座し、境内からは筑後平野と筑後川を一望できます。へこかき祭は、ふんどし（へこ）を締める年ごろを迎えた子どもの成長を祝う行事として知られています。山上の社殿と眺望もあわせて楽しんでください。
quiz: 高良大社が鎮座し、境内から筑後平野を見渡せる山の名前は何でしょう？
desc_en: This festival takes place at Kora Taisha, the ichinomiya (highest-ranking shrine) of the old Chikugo Province. The shrine sits halfway up Mount Kora in Kurume City, and its grounds offer a panoramic view of the Chikugo Plain and the Chikugo River. The Hekokaki Festival is known as an event celebrating the growth of children who have reached the age to wear a fundoshi loincloth, called a heko. Enjoy the mountain shrine and its view as well.
quiz_en: What is the name of the mountain where Kora Taisha stands, with grounds that overlook the Chikugo Plain?

name: 日吉神社節分祭
desc: 久留米市の中心部に鎮座する日吉神社で行われる節分祭です。節分は季節の分かれ目に邪気を払う行事で、豆まきなどを通じて一年の無病息災を願います。市街地の神社に多くの参拝者が集まり、冬の終わりを告げるにぎやかなひとときとなります。久留米ラーメンなど地元の味も楽しみましょう。
quiz: 節分の豆まきで、「鬼は外」に続けてみんなで唱える言葉は何でしょう？
desc_en: This Setsubun festival is held at Hiyoshi Shrine in central Kurume City. Setsubun is an event marking the turn of the seasons, when people drive away evil spirits and pray for good health through the year with rituals such as bean throwing. Many worshippers gather at the downtown shrine for a lively occasion that signals the end of winter. Enjoy local flavors such as Kurume ramen too.
quiz_en: During the Setsubun bean-throwing ritual, people shout "Demons out!" What phrase does everyone call out next, inviting good luck?

name: 北野天満宮おくんち
desc: 久留米市北野町の北野天満宮で行われる秋の祭り「おくんち」です。北野天満宮は学問の神様・菅原道真公をまつる神社で、地域の人々に親しまれています。おくんちは九州北部で広く行われる秋祭りの呼び名で、実りの季節に感謝を捧げます。神社周辺がにぎわう秋の一日を味わってください。
quiz: 北野天満宮をはじめ、全国の天満宮にまつられている学問の神様は誰でしょう？
desc_en: Okunchi is the autumn festival of Kitano Tenmangu Shrine in the Kitano area of Kurume City. The shrine enshrines Sugawara no Michizane, the god of learning, and is beloved by local people. Okunchi is the name widely used for autumn festivals in northern Kyushu, held to give thanks during the harvest season. Savor an autumn day when the area around the shrine comes alive.
quiz_en: Who is the god of learning enshrined at Kitano Tenmangu and at Tenmangu shrines throughout Japan?

name: 農楽園八木山
desc: 飯塚市の八木山高原にある農業体験型の施設です。八木山は福岡市と飯塚市を結ぶ峠道沿いの高原地帯で、都市部から近いながら自然が豊かな場所です。季節に応じた収穫体験や地元の農産物との出合いが楽しめます。ドライブがてら立ち寄り、高原の空気の中で農の恵みにふれてください。
quiz: 高原で収穫体験をするなら、あなたが一番とってみたい野菜や果物は何？
desc_en: This hands-on farming facility is located on the Yakiyama Plateau in Iizuka City. Yakiyama is a highland area along the mountain pass road connecting Fukuoka City and Iizuka City, rich in nature despite being close to urban areas. You can enjoy seasonal harvesting experiences and discover local farm produce. Stop by on a drive and enjoy the bounty of agriculture in the fresh highland air.
quiz_en: If you tried a harvesting experience on a highland farm, which vegetable or fruit would you most like to pick yourself?

name: 大将陣桜まつり
desc: 飯塚市天道の大将陣公園で開かれる桜まつりです。小高い丘にある公園は市街地を見渡せる眺めのよい場所で、春には園内が桜色に染まります。飯塚市はかつて筑豊炭田の中心として栄えた町で、歴史ある芝居小屋・嘉穂劇場もあります。お花見とともに町の歴史にもふれてみてください。
quiz: 飯塚市に残る、全国的にも知られる歴史ある芝居小屋の名前は何でしょう？
desc_en: This cherry blossom festival is held at Taishojin Park in the Tendo area of Iizuka City. The park sits on a small hill with a fine view over the city, and in spring it turns pink with blossoms. Iizuka once flourished as the center of the Chikuho coalfield and is also home to the historic Kaho Gekijo theater. Along with cherry blossom viewing, take the chance to explore the town's history.
quiz_en: What is the name of the historic playhouse in Iizuka City that is well known throughout Japan?

name: 風治八幡宮川渡り神幸祭
desc: 田川市の風治八幡宮で行われる神幸祭で、色とりどりの幟を立てた山笠が彦山川を渡る勇壮な「川渡り」が見どころです。担ぎ手たちが水しぶきを上げながら山笠を川に入れる様子は、炭坑の町として栄えた田川らしい力強さにあふれています。初夏の田川を代表する祭りです。
quiz: 風治八幡宮の神幸祭で、山笠が川を渡ることから付いた祭りの呼び名は何？
desc_en: This shinko festival is held at Furuji Hachimangu Shrine in Tagawa City. Its highlight is the dramatic "kawatari," in which yamakasa floats topped with colorful banners cross the Hikosan River. As the bearers send up splashes of water while hauling the floats into the river, the scene overflows with a powerful spirit fitting for Tagawa, which once thrived as a coal mining town. It is the leading festival of early summer in Tagawa.
quiz_en: The floats of the Furuji Hachimangu festival cross a river. What is the festival's nickname, which comes from this river crossing?

name: 三柱神社秋季大祭
desc: 柳川市の三柱神社で行われる秋の大祭です。柳川は掘割が縦横にめぐる水郷の町で、どんこ舟による川下りが名物です。三柱神社は柳川藩ゆかりの神社で、秋の大祭は「おにぎえ」とも呼ばれ、町がにぎわいます。祭りの後は掘割沿いを散策し、名物のうなぎのせいろ蒸しを味わってください。
quiz: 柳川の名物で、うなぎを蒸籠で蒸して仕上げる料理を何と呼ぶでしょう？
desc_en: This grand autumn festival is held at Mihashira Shrine in Yanagawa City. Yanagawa is a water town crisscrossed by canals, famous for river cruises on donkobune boats. Mihashira Shrine is associated with the Yanagawa domain, and its autumn festival, also called "Onigie," fills the town with excitement. After the festival, stroll along the canals and enjoy the local specialty of eel steamed in a seiro basket.
quiz_en: What is the name of Yanagawa's specialty dish in which eel is finished by steaming it in a bamboo seiro basket?

name: 柳川温泉
desc: 水郷として知られる柳川市にある温泉です。柳川の町には掘割が張りめぐらされ、船頭さんの操るどんこ舟で川下りを楽しむことができます。北原白秋の生家が残る文学ゆかりの町でもあります。川下りや町歩きで水辺の風情を満喫したあとは、温泉でゆっくりと体を休めてください。
quiz: 柳川市が生誕地で、童謡「この道」などを作詞した詩人は誰でしょう？
desc_en: This hot spring is in Yanagawa City, known as a water town. Canals run throughout Yanagawa, and you can enjoy river cruises on donkobune boats steered by boatmen. It is also a literary town where the birthplace of poet Kitahara Hakushu remains. After soaking up the waterside atmosphere on a river cruise or a walk around town, relax your body in the hot spring.
quiz_en: Which poet, born in Yanagawa City, wrote the lyrics for children's songs such as "Kono Michi" (This Road)?

name: 船小屋温泉郷
desc: 筑後市とみやま市にまたがる矢部川沿いの温泉郷です。船小屋は鉱泉が湧くことで知られ、川沿いにはクスノキの林が続いています。近くには筑後船小屋駅があり、九州新幹線でのアクセスも便利です。川辺の緑と穏やかな流れを眺めながら、のんびりとした湯治場の雰囲気を味わえます。
quiz: 船小屋温泉郷のそばを流れ、川沿いにクスノキ林が続く川の名前は何？
desc_en: This hot spring area lies along the Yabe River, spanning Chikugo City and Miyama City. Funagoya is known for its mineral springs, and a forest of camphor trees lines the riverbank. Chikugo-Funagoya Station is nearby, offering convenient access by the Kyushu Shinkansen. Gazing at the green riverbanks and gentle current, you can enjoy the leisurely atmosphere of a traditional healing spa.
quiz_en: What is the name of the river that flows beside the Funagoya Onsen area, with camphor tree forests along its banks?

name: 天地山公園
desc: 豊前市にある天地山公園は、市街地近くの小高い山に整備された公園です。展望のよい場所からは豊前の町並みや周防灘の海を望むことができます。春には桜が咲き、地元の人々の花見の名所として親しまれています。散策路を歩きながら、海と山に囲まれた豊前の風景を楽しんでください。
quiz: 天地山公園のような展望公園から海を眺めるなら、あなたは朝と夕方どちらが好き？
desc_en: Tenjiyama Park in Buzen City is built on a small mountain near the city center. From its viewpoints you can see the streets of Buzen and the waters of the Suo Sea. Cherry trees bloom in spring, making it a popular local spot for hanami (cherry blossom viewing). Walk the trails and enjoy the scenery of Buzen, surrounded by sea and mountains.
quiz_en: If you looked out over the sea from a hilltop park like Tenjiyama Park, would you prefer the morning view or the evening view?

name: 大富神社
desc: 豊前市四郎丸に鎮座する大富神社です。地域の総鎮守として古くから信仰を集め、地元の人々に親しまれてきました。豊前市は北に周防灘、南に求菩提山などの山々を控えた土地で、海と山の恵みに支えられています。静かな境内を歩き、土地の人々が大切にしてきた神社の空気を感じてください。
quiz: 大富神社のような地域の神社で、あなたが必ずするお参りの習慣は何？
desc_en: Otomi Shrine stands in the Shiromaru area of Buzen City. As the guardian shrine of the region, it has long attracted worshippers and been cherished by local people. Buzen faces the Suo Sea to the north and has mountains such as Mount Kubote to the south, a land supported by the blessings of both sea and mountains. Walk the quiet grounds and feel the atmosphere of a shrine the locals hold dear.
quiz_en: When you visit a local shrine like Otomi Shrine, what worship custom or ritual do you always make sure to follow?

name: 求菩提山
desc: 豊前市にそびえる求菩提山は、古くから修験道の山として栄えた霊山です。山中には修験者の修行の跡や石段、国玉神社などが残り、歴史を感じる登山が楽しめます。ふもとには求菩提資料館があり、山の信仰の歴史を学ぶことができます。木々に包まれた参道を一歩ずつ登ってみてください。
quiz: 求菩提山で古くから行われてきた、山にこもって修行する日本独自の信仰を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: Rising in Buzen City, Mount Kubote is a sacred mountain that long flourished as a center of Shugendo, a form of mountain asceticism. Traces of the ascetics' training, stone steps and Kunitama Shrine remain on the mountain, making for a hike steeped in history. At the foot of the mountain, the Kubote Museum lets you learn about the history of mountain worship. Climb the tree-lined approach one step at a time.
quiz_en: What is the name of the uniquely Japanese religious practice, long followed on Mount Kubote, in which people train in seclusion in the mountains?

name: 犬ヶ岳
desc: 福岡県と大分県の県境にまたがる犬ヶ岳は、耶馬日田英彦山国定公園に含まれる山です。尾根筋にはブナの林が広がり、春にはツクシシャクナゲの花が咲くことで知られています。求菩提山と組み合わせた縦走ルートも人気で、豊かな自然の中を歩く本格的な山歩きが楽しめます。
quiz: 犬ヶ岳のような山の尾根歩きで、春に出会えたらうれしい花はどんな花？
desc_en: Straddling the border between Fukuoka and Oita prefectures, Mount Inugatake is part of Yaba-Hita-Hikosan Quasi-National Park.
