Shimabara is a town of springs called the "City of Water," with canals where carp swim and spring-water spots dotted around. By the lakeshore, feel the history of a town that has lived alongside a volcano.
quiz_en: In Shimabara's spring-fed streets, what ornamental fish can be seen swimming gracefully in the water channels?

name: 白木峰高原
desc: 諫早市の白木峰高原は、多良山系の中腹に広がる花の高原です。春には一面の菜の花、秋にはコスモスが咲き誇り、花畑の向こうに諫早の市街地や有明海、雲仙の山々を望むことができます。花の見頃には多くの人が訪れ、黄色やピンクに染まった丘を散策します。季節の花に囲まれて高原の風を感じてください。
quiz: 白木峰高原で、春に高原を黄色く染める花と、秋に咲く花の組み合わせは何？
desc_en: The Shirakidake Highlands in Isahaya City are a plateau of flowers on the slopes of the Tara Mountains. Fields of rapeseed blossoms in spring and cosmos in autumn bloom in abundance, and beyond them you can see the city of Isahaya, the Ariake Sea and the Unzen mountains. Many people visit when the flowers are at their best, strolling the hills colored yellow and pink. Feel the highland breeze surrounded by seasonal flowers.
quiz_en: At the Shirakidake Highlands, which flower turns the hills yellow in spring, and which flower blooms there in autumn?

name: 唐比ハス園
desc: 諫早市森山町の唐比ハス園は、湿地を生かして整備されたハスの名所です。夏の朝には、大きな葉の間から薄紅色や白のハスの花が次々と開き、園内は清らかな雰囲気に包まれます。ハスの花は早朝に開き昼には閉じるため、朝早めの時間がおすすめです。湿地の自然とともに、涼やかな夏の景色を楽しんでください。
quiz: ハスの花が一番きれいに開いているのは、一日のうちどの時間帯でしょう？
desc_en: The Karakobi Lotus Garden in the Moriyama area of Isahaya City is a lotus spot developed using a wetland. On summer mornings, pale pink and white lotus flowers open one after another among the large leaves, wrapping the garden in a pure atmosphere. Lotus flowers open in the early morning and close by midday, so visiting early is recommended. Enjoy the cool summer scenery along with the wetland nature.
quiz_en: At what time of day are lotus flowers most beautifully open, before they close again later on?

name: 山茶花高原ピクニックパーク
desc: 諫早市小長井町の山茶花高原ピクニックパークは、多良岳の中腹に広がる自然公園です。キャンプ場やコテージ、遊具などが整い、家族連れでアウトドアを楽しめます。高原からは有明海や対岸の雲仙の山並みを見渡せる、開放感あふれる眺めが魅力です。澄んだ高原の空気の中で、のびのびと過ごしてください。
quiz: 高原でキャンプをするなら、あなたが夜に一番楽しみにしたいことは何？
desc_en: Sazanka Highlands Picnic Park in the Konagai area of Isahaya City is a nature park on the slopes of Mount Tara. With a campground, cottages and play equipment, it lets families enjoy the outdoors. Its charm is the open view from the plateau over the Ariake Sea and the Unzen mountains on the far shore. Relax freely in the clear highland air.
quiz_en: If you went camping in the highlands, what would you most look forward to doing at night under the open sky?

name: 月の丘公園
desc: 諫早市飯盛町にある月の丘公園は、高台に整備された公園です。飯盛町は橘湾に面した町で、穏やかな海と丘陵地が織りなすのどかな風景が広がります。ロマンチックな名前の公園で、日中は海や町並みを眺め、晴れた夜には月や星空を楽しむのもおすすめです。静かな丘の上でゆっくり過ごしてください。
quiz: 月の丘公園という名前にちなんで、あなたが一番見てみたい月の姿は何？
desc_en: Tsuki no Oka Park, meaning "Moon Hill Park," is a hilltop park in the Iimori area of Isahaya City. Iimori faces Tachibana Bay, with peaceful scenery woven by calm seas and rolling hills. With its romantic name, the park is a place to view the sea and town by day, and on clear nights it is also recommended for enjoying the moon and starry sky. Take your time on this quiet hill.
quiz_en: Inspired by the name Moon Hill Park, which phase or appearance of the moon would you most like to see there?

name: 大村公園
desc: 大村市の大村公園は、大村藩主大村家の居城だった玖島城の跡に整備された公園です。春には桜の名所としてにぎわい、国の天然記念物に指定された「オオムラザクラ」をはじめ多くの桜が咲き誇ります。初夏には花菖蒲園で色とりどりの花菖蒲が見頃を迎えます。石垣が残る城跡を歩きながら花を楽しんでください。
quiz: 大村公園に咲く、国の天然記念物に指定された大村ゆかりの桜を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: Omura Park in Omura City was built on the site of Kushima Castle, residence of the Omura family, lords of the Omura domain. In spring it bustles as a cherry blossom spot, with many varieties in bloom including the "Omurazakura," designated a national Natural Monument. In early summer, colorful irises reach their peak in the iris garden. Enjoy the flowers while walking the castle ruins, where stone walls remain.
quiz_en: What is the name of the cherry variety linked to Omura that blooms in Omura Park and is a national Natural Monument?

name: 野岳湖公園
desc: 大村市東野岳町にある野岳湖公園は、かんがい用に造られたため池・野岳湖を中心とした公園です。湖の周囲には遊歩道が整い、四季折々の自然を感じながら散策できます。キャンプ場もあり、水辺でのアウトドアを楽しむ人々に親しまれています。水面に映る木々や空を眺めて、静かなひとときを過ごしてください。
quiz: 野岳湖公園の湖畔でキャンプをするなら、朝一番にしたいことは何？
desc_en: Lake Nodake Park in the Higashinodake area of Omura City centers on Lake Nodake, a reservoir built for irrigation. Walking paths circle the lake, letting you stroll while feeling the nature of each season. There is also a campground, and the park is loved by people who enjoy the outdoors by the water. Gaze at the trees and sky reflected on the water and spend a quiet moment.
quiz_en: If you camped beside the lake at Lake Nodake Park, what would you want to do first thing in the morning?

name: 大村藩宿場まつり
desc: 大村市で開かれる大村藩宿場まつりです。大村は江戸時代に大村藩の城下町として、また長崎街道の宿場町として栄えました。祭りでは時代装束の行列などが行われ、かつての宿場町のにぎわいを感じることができます。歴史ある町並みを歩きながら、旅人が行き交った街道の時代に思いを馳せてみてください。
quiz: 大村を通り、小倉と長崎を結んでいた江戸時代の街道の名前は何でしょう？
desc_en: The Omura Domain Shukuba Festival is held in Omura City. In the Edo period, Omura prospered as the castle town of the Omura domain and as a post town on the Nagasaki Kaido highway. The festival features events such as a procession in period costume, letting you feel the bustle of the old post town. Walk the historic streets and imagine the era when travelers came and went along the highway.
quiz_en: What was the name of the Edo-period highway that passed through Omura and connected Kokura with Nagasaki?

name: 平戸城
desc: 平戸市の平戸城は、平戸藩主松浦氏の居城で、平戸港を見下ろす高台に建っています。三方を海に囲まれた地形を生かした城で、現在の天守は昭和期に復元されたものです。平戸は江戸時代初期にオランダやイギリスとの貿易で栄えた港町で、異国との交流の歴史を感じる場所が多く残っています。
quiz: 平戸港を見下ろす平戸城を居城とした、平戸藩を治めた大名家は何氏でしょう？
desc_en: Hirado Castle in Hirado City was the residence of the Matsura clan, lords of the Hirado domain, and stands on high ground overlooking Hirado Port. The castle makes use of terrain surrounded by sea on three sides, and the current keep was reconstructed in the Showa era. Hirado is a port town that thrived on trade with the Netherlands and England in the early Edo period, and many places remain where you can feel this history of foreign exchange.
quiz_en: Which daimyo clan ruled the Hirado domain and made Hirado Castle, overlooking Hirado Port, its residence?

name: 御崎浦海浜公園
desc: 平戸市の生月島にある御崎浦の海浜公園です。生月島は平戸島と生月大橋で結ばれた島で、江戸時代には捕鯨の基地として栄えた歴史を持っています。島の周囲には透明度の高い海が広がり、夏には海水浴やキャンプを楽しむ人々が訪れます。玄界灘の潮風を感じながら、海辺でのんびりと過ごしてください。
quiz: 江戸時代の生月島で盛んに行われ、島の歴史を形づくった漁業は何でしょう？
desc_en: This seaside park is at Misakiura on Ikitsuki Island in Hirado City. Ikitsuki Island is connected to Hirado Island by the Ikitsuki Bridge and has a history of thriving as a whaling base in the Edo period. Highly transparent waters surround the island, and in summer people come to swim and camp. Relax by the sea while feeling the breeze from the Genkai Sea.
quiz_en: What kind of fishing industry flourished on Ikitsuki Island in the Edo period and shaped the island's history?

name: 早崎海浜公園
desc: 平戸市の生月島にある早崎の海浜公園です。生月島の海岸線は変化に富み、北部の大バエ灯台や、柱状の岩が並ぶ塩俵の断崖など迫力ある景観が見どころです。公園では潮風に吹かれながら東シナ海の青い海を眺めることができます。島めぐりのドライブで立ち寄り、のびのびとした海辺の景色を味わってください。
quiz: 生月島に残る、六角形の柱のような岩がずらりと並ぶ断崖を何と呼ぶでしょう？
desc_en: This seaside park is at Hayasaki on Ikitsuki Island in Hirado City. Ikitsuki's coastline is full of variety, with dramatic sights such as the Obae Lighthouse in the north and the Shiodawara cliffs lined with columnar rocks. At the park you can gaze at the blue East China Sea while the sea breeze blows. Stop by on an island drive and enjoy the open seaside scenery.
quiz_en: What is the name of the cliff on Ikitsuki Island lined with rocks shaped like hexagonal columns?

name: 不老山総合公園
desc: 松浦市志佐町にある不老山総合公園は、市街地を見渡す丘の上の公園です。春には桜やツツジが咲き、地元の人々の花見の場として親しまれています。松浦市は伊万里湾に面した港町で、アジの水揚げが多いことから「アジフライの聖地」を掲げています。花見のあとは、揚げたてのアジフライを味わってください。
quiz: 松浦市が「聖地」として名乗っている、アジを使った揚げ物料理は何でしょう？
desc_en: Furozan General Park in the Shisa area of Matsuura City is a hilltop park overlooking the city. Cherry blossoms and azaleas bloom in spring, and locals love it as a place for hanami. Matsuura is a port town facing Imari Bay, and because of its large catches of horse mackerel it calls itself the "Holy Land of Aji Fry." After hanami, enjoy some freshly fried horse mackerel.
quiz_en: Matsuura City calls itself the "holy land" of which deep-fried dish made with horse mackerel?

name: 大山公園
desc: 松浦市の福島にある大山公園は、島の高台に整備された眺めのよい公園です。福島は伊万里湾に浮かぶ島で、橋で本土とつながっています。島には斜面に階段状の田んぼが広がる棚田の風景も見られます。高台からは伊万里湾の穏やかな海や周囲の島々を見渡せ、のんびりとした島の時間を楽しめます。
quiz: 山の斜面に階段状に作られた田んぼのことを、何と呼ぶでしょう？
desc_en: Oyama Park on Fukushima in Matsuura City is a park with fine views on the island's high ground. Fukushima is an island in Imari Bay, connected to the mainland by a bridge. On the island you can also see tanada, rice fields built in terraces on the slopes. From the high ground you can look out over the calm waters of Imari Bay and the surrounding islands, and enjoy relaxed island time.
quiz_en: What is the name for rice paddies built in step-like terraces up the slopes of a mountain or hillside?

name: 初崎公園
desc: 松浦市の福島にある初崎公園は、伊万里湾に面した岬の公園です。福島は橋で本土と結ばれた島で、海と山がすぐ近くにある自然豊かな土地です。岬からは穏やかな海と周囲の島々が見渡せ、夕暮れには海が茜色に染まります。キャンプや海辺の散策を楽しみながら、静かな島の時間をゆっくり味わってください。
quiz: 初崎公園のような岬の公園で夕日を眺めるなら、あなたが一緒に過ごしたい人は誰？
desc_en: Hatsusaki Park on Fukushima in Matsuura City is a cape park facing Imari Bay. Fukushima is an island connected to the mainland by a bridge, a nature-rich place where sea and mountains are close at hand. From the cape you can look out over calm waters and the surrounding islands, and at dusk the sea turns a deep madder red. Enjoy camping or a seaside stroll, and savor the quiet island time at your own pace.
quiz_en: If you watched the sunset from a cape park like Hatsusaki Park, who would you most like to share that moment with?

name: 宮地嶽史跡公園
desc: 伊万里湾の入口に浮かぶ鷹島の北部、阿翁地区にある史跡公園です。鷹島は鎌倉時代の元寇（弘安の役）で元軍の船団が暴風雨に遭った舞台として知られ、周辺の海底からは元軍の船や遺物が見つかっています。高台の公園からは玄界灘と伊万里湾を見渡せ、かつての激戦の海に思いを馳せることができます。
quiz: 鎌倉時代に元の大軍が二度にわたって日本へ攻めてきた出来事を何と呼ぶでしょう？
desc_en: This historic park is in the Ao district of northern Takashima, an island at the entrance to Imari Bay. Takashima is known as the place where the Mongol fleet was struck by a storm during the Mongol invasions of the Kamakura period (the Koan campaign), and Mongol ships and relics have been found on the surrounding seabed. From the hilltop park you can view the Genkai Sea and Imari Bay and reflect on these waters, once the scene of fierce battle.
quiz_en: What is the name for the events of the Kamakura period when great Mongol armies twice attempted to invade Japan?

name: 道の駅 鷹ら島
desc: 松浦市鷹島町にある道の駅で、鷹島と佐賀県唐津市を結ぶ鷹島肥前大橋のたもとにあります。鷹島は元寇の舞台として知られる歴史の島で、周辺の海ではトラフグの養殖など漁業も盛んです。島の特産品や新鮮な海産物が並び、ドライブの休憩にぴったりです。大橋と青い海を眺めながら、ひと息ついてください。
quiz: 道の駅鷹ら島のそば、鷹島と佐賀県唐津市を結ぶ大きな橋の名前は何でしょう？
desc_en: This roadside station in the Takashima area of Matsuura City sits at the foot of the Takashima Hizen Bridge, which links Takashima with Karatsu City in Saga Prefecture. Takashima is a historic island known as a stage of the Mongol invasions, and fisheries such as tiger pufferfish farming thrive in the surrounding waters. Island specialties and fresh seafood are on sale, making it perfect for a break on a drive. Take a breather while gazing at the bridge and the blue sea.
quiz_en: What is the name of the large bridge near this roadside station that connects Takashima with Karatsu City in Saga Prefecture?

name: 牧ノ岳史跡公園
desc: 鷹島の中央部、三里地区にある牧ノ岳史跡公園は、島の高台に整備された公園です。鷹島は元寇の古戦場として知られ、島のあちこちに当時を伝える史跡や地名が残っています。公園からは島を囲む穏やかな海と周囲の島々を見渡すことができます。のどかな島の風景の中で、遠い鎌倉時代の歴史に思いを寄せてください。
quiz: 元寇の舞台となった鷹島の史跡をめぐるなら、あなたが一番知りたい当時の出来事は？
desc_en: Makinodake Historic Park, in the Misato district in the center of Takashima, is built on the island's high ground. Takashima is known as an old battlefield of the Mongol invasions, and historic sites and place names conveying that era remain across the island. From the park you can see the calm sea surrounding the island and the islands nearby. Amid peaceful island scenery, let your thoughts turn to the distant history of the Kamakura period.
quiz_en: If you toured the historic sites of Takashima, stage of the Mongol invasions, which event of that time would you most like to learn about?

name: 宛陵寺
desc: 松浦市今福町の仏坂にある宛陵寺です。今福は伊万里湾に面した地域で、松浦鉄道の駅もある海辺の町です。松浦市一帯は中世に「松浦党」と呼ばれる武士団が活躍した土地として知られています。緑に包まれた静かな境内で手を合わせ、海とともに歩んできた松浦の歴史と人々の暮らしに思いを馳せてください。
quiz: 中世に松浦地方を拠点に海で活躍した武士団は、何と呼ばれていたでしょう？
desc_en: This is Enryo-ji in Hotokezaka, in the Imafuku area of Matsuura City. Imafuku is a seaside town facing Imari Bay, with a station on the Matsuura Railway. The Matsuura area is known as the land where a samurai band called the "Matsuura-to" was active in medieval times. Bring your hands together in the quiet, green grounds and reflect on the history and lives of the people of Matsuura, who have walked alongside the sea.
quiz_en: What was the name of the medieval band of samurai who were based in the Matsuura region and active on the seas?

name: 浅茅湾
desc: 対馬の中央部に広がる浅茅湾は、複雑に入り組んだリアス海岸が続く景勝地で、壱岐対馬国定公園に含まれています。大小の島々や入り江が織りなす景色は穏やかで、真珠の養殖も行われています。湾の南岸には飛鳥時代に築かれた古代山城・金田城の跡が残ります。展望台からの眺めや、遊覧船での湾内めぐりを楽しんでください。
quiz: 浅茅湾のように、山地が沈み込んでできた入り組んだ海岸を何と呼ぶでしょう？
desc_en: Spreading across central Tsushima, Aso Bay is a scenic spot with an intricately indented ria coastline and is part of Iki-Tsushima Quasi-National Park. The scenery woven by islands and inlets of all sizes is tranquil, and pearl farming is carried out here. On the south shore remain the ruins of Kaneda Castle, an ancient mountain fortress built in the Asuka period. Enjoy the view from the observation decks or a cruise around the bay.
quiz_en: What is the name for a complex, indented coastline like Aso Bay's, formed when mountainous land sank into the sea?

name: 和多都美神社
addr: 対馬市豊玉町仁位字和宮55
desc: 対馬の浅茅湾に面して鎮座する和多都美神社は、海の神である豊玉姫命と彦火火出見尊をまつる古社です。本殿の正面から海に向かって鳥居が並び、満潮時には鳥居の足元が海に浸かる幻想的な光景が見られます。海幸山幸の神話ゆかりの地として「竜宮伝説」が残り、神秘的な雰囲気に包まれています。
quiz: 和多都美神社で、満潮時に海の中に立つように見えるものは何でしょう？
desc_en: Watatsumi Shrine, facing Aso Bay on Tsushima, is an ancient shrine dedicated to the sea goddess Toyotama-hime and Hikohohodemi. Torii gates stand in a line from the front of the main hall toward the sea, and at high tide you can see the magical sight of their bases submerged in water. As a place linked to the myth of Umisachi and Yamasachi, it preserves a "Ryugu legend" of the undersea palace and is wrapped in a mystical atmosphere.
quiz_en: At Watatsumi Shrine, what appears to stand in the middle of the sea when the tide is high?

name: 猿岩
addr: 壱岐市郷ノ浦町新田触870-3
desc: 壱岐島の西部、郷ノ浦町の黒崎半島にある猿岩は、海に突き出た玄武岩の岩です。そっぽを向いた猿の横顔そっくりの形をしていることからこの名で呼ばれ、壱岐を代表する観光名所になっています。周囲は断崖の続く海岸で、玄界灘の青い海とのコントラストが見事です。見る角度を変えて猿の顔を探してみてください。
quiz: 壱岐を代表する名所・猿岩は、猿のどんな姿に見えることで有名でしょう？
desc_en: Saruiwa, on the Kurosaki Peninsula in the Gonoura area of western Iki Island, is a basalt rock jutting into the sea. Its name, meaning "Monkey Rock," comes from its shape, which looks just like the profile of a monkey looking away, and it has become Iki's signature sightseeing spot. The surrounding coast is lined with cliffs, creating a superb contrast with the blue Genkai Sea. Try changing your viewing angle to find the monkey's face.
quiz_en: Saruiwa, one of Iki's most famous sights, is known for resembling a monkey in what kind of pose?

name: 七ツ釜鍾乳洞
addr: 西海市西海町中浦北郷2541-1
desc: 西海市西海町にある七ツ釜鍾乳洞は、国の天然記念物に指定されている鍾乳洞です。遠い昔に海の底で積もった石灰質の地層が長い年月をかけて浸食されてできたもので、洞内では鍾乳石や石筍などの造形を見ることができます。ひんやりとした洞内は夏でも涼しく、地下の神秘的な世界を探検気分で楽しめます。
quiz: 鍾乳洞の天井から垂れ下がる鍾乳石に対し、床から伸びる石を何と呼ぶでしょう？
desc_en: Nanatsugama Limestone Cave in the Saikai area of Saikai City is designated a national Natural Monument. It was formed over many years as limestone layers that built up on the ancient seabed were eroded, and inside you can see formations such as stalactites and stalagmites. The cool cave stays chilly even in summer, letting you enjoy the mysterious underground world as if on an expedition.
quiz_en: Stalactites hang down from the ceiling of a limestone cave. What are the formations that grow up from the floor called?

name: 伊佐ノ浦公園
addr: 西海市西海町中浦南郷1133-48
desc: 西海市西海町の伊佐ノ浦公園は、伊佐ノ浦ダムのダム湖を中心に広がる自然公園です。湖畔にはキャンプ場やコテージがあり、カヌーなどの水辺のアクティビティも楽しめます。周囲を森に囲まれた静かな環境で、季節ごとに変わる湖の表情が魅力です。アウトドアで体を動かし、自然の中でリフレッシュしてください。
quiz: 湖畔でキャンプをするなら、あなたが一番挑戦してみたいアクティビティは何？
desc_en: Isanoura Park in the Saikai area of Saikai City is a nature park centered on the reservoir of Isanoura Dam. There are a campground and cottages by the lake, and you can also enjoy waterside activities such as canoeing. Its quiet setting surrounded by forest and the lake's changing look through the seasons are its appeal. Get active outdoors and refresh yourself in nature.
quiz_en: If you went camping beside a lake like the one at Isanoura Park, which outdoor activity would you most like to try?

name: 西海橋
desc: 佐世保市と西海市の間、大村湾の入口にあたる針尾瀬戸に架かる西海橋は、昭和30年に完成したアーチ橋です。橋の下では潮の干満によって激しい潮流が生まれ、大潮の時期には大きな渦潮が見られます。隣には新西海橋もあり、歩道から渦潮を見下ろせます。春には周辺の公園が桜で彩られます。
quiz: 西海橋の下の針尾瀬戸で、潮の干満の差が大きい時期に見られる現象は何？
desc_en: Spanning the Hario Strait at the entrance to Omura Bay, between Sasebo City and Saikai City, Saikai Bridge is an arch bridge completed in 1955. Strong currents form beneath the bridge with the rising and falling tides, and during spring tides large whirlpools can be seen. The New Saikai Bridge stands next to it, and from its walkway you can look down on the whirlpools. In spring the surrounding parks are colored by cherry blossoms.
quiz_en: In the Hario Strait beneath Saikai Bridge, what phenomenon can be seen when the difference between high and low tide is large?

name: 四本堂公園
desc: 西海市西彼町にある四本堂公園は、大村湾に面した自然豊かな公園です。キャンプ場やコテージが整い、穏やかな湾を眺めながらアウトドアを満喫できます。大村湾は外海とつながる部分が狭く、波が静かなことから「琴の海」とも呼ばれます。水辺の散策や海遊びを楽しみ、湾に沈む夕日を眺めてください。
quiz: 波が穏やかな大村湾は、その静けさから何という美しい別名で呼ばれるでしょう？
desc_en: Shihondo Park in the Seihi area of Saikai City is a nature-rich park facing Omura Bay. It has a campground and cottages, so you can enjoy the outdoors while gazing at the calm bay. Omura Bay has only a narrow connection to the open sea, and because its waves are gentle it is also called the "Sea of the Koto," after the Japanese harp. Enjoy waterside walks and play by the sea, and watch the sun set over the bay.
quiz_en: Because of its calm, gentle waves, Omura Bay is known by a beautiful nickname. What is this poetic name?

name: 大島大橋公園
desc: 西海市大島町にある大島大橋公園は、西彼杵半島と大島を結ぶ大島大橋のたもとにある公園です。高台からは海峡をまたぐ橋の雄大な姿と、周囲の島々が浮かぶ青い海を一望できます。大島はかつて炭鉱で栄え、現在は造船の島として知られています。橋と海が織りなす景色を眺めながら、潮風を感じてください。
quiz: 大島大橋のような海を渡る橋、あなたは車で渡る派？歩いて眺める派？
desc_en: Oshima Bridge Park in the Oshima area of Saikai City lies at the foot of the Oshima Bridge, which connects the Nishisonogi Peninsula with Oshima Island. From the high ground you can take in the majestic bridge spanning the strait and the blue sea dotted with islands. Oshima once flourished with coal mining and is now known as an island of shipbuilding. Feel the sea breeze while gazing at the scenery woven by bridge and sea.
quiz_en: When it comes to a bridge across the sea like the Oshima Bridge, would you rather drive across it or admire it on foot?

name: 雪浦海浜公園
addr: 西海市大瀬戸町雪浦下釜郷615-14
desc: 西海市大瀬戸町の雪浦にある海浜公園です。雪浦は東シナ海に面した小さな集落で、雪浦川が海に注ぐ河口に美しい砂浜が広がっています。サーフィンのポイントとしても知られ、豊かな自然に惹かれて移り住む人も多い地域です。夏の海水浴はもちろん、海に沈む夕日を眺める時間も格別です。
quiz: 雪浦の海でサーフィンや海水浴、あなたならどんなふうに海を楽しみたい？
desc_en: This seaside park is in Yukiura, in the Oseto area of Saikai City. Yukiura is a small community facing the East China Sea, with a beautiful sandy beach spreading out where the Yukiura River meets the sea. It is also known as a surfing spot, and many people have moved to the area drawn by its rich nature. Summer swimming is a given, but watching the sun sink into the sea is also exceptional.
quiz_en: Whether surfing or swimming, how would you most like to enjoy a day at the sea in Yukiura?

name: つがね落としの滝
addr: 西海市大瀬戸町雪浦河通郷390
desc: 西海市大瀬戸町雪浦の山あいにあるつがね落としの滝は、雪浦川の上流にある滝です。周囲は緑豊かな森に包まれ、岩肌を流れ落ちる水の音が心地よく響きます。夏は涼を求めて訪れる人々の憩いの場となっています。河口の雪浦の集落から川をさかのぼり、山と海がつながる雪浦の自然を感じてみてください。
quiz: つがね落としの滝のような森の中の滝で、あなたが一番感じたいのは水の音？涼しい風？
desc_en: Tsugane Otoshi Falls, in the hills of Yukiura in the Oseto area of Saikai City, is a waterfall on the upper reaches of the Yukiura River. The surroundings are wrapped in lush forest, and the sound of water tumbling down the rock face echoes pleasantly. In summer it is a place where people come to cool off. Follow the river upstream from the Yukiura community at its mouth and feel the nature of Yukiura, where mountains and sea connect.
quiz_en: At a forest waterfall like Tsugane Otoshi Falls, which would you most like to experience, the sound of the water or the cool breeze?

name: 普賢岳溶岩流
desc: 雲仙岳の普賢岳では、1990年からの噴火活動で大量の溶岩が噴出し、溶岩ドームが成長しました。この溶岩ドームは「平成新山」と名付けられ、雲仙岳の最高峰となっています。噴火に伴う火砕流は大きな被害をもたらしました。仁田峠などからは、荒々しい溶岩の山肌を間近に望み、火山の力を実感できます。
quiz: 普賢岳の噴火で成長した溶岩ドームは、何という名前が付けられたでしょう？
desc_en: On Mount Fugen, part of Mount Unzen, volcanic activity that began in 1990 erupted large amounts of lava, and a lava dome grew. This dome was named "Heisei Shinzan" and is now the highest peak of Mount Unzen. The pyroclastic flows that accompanied the eruption caused great damage. From places such as Nita Pass you can see the rugged lava slopes up close and feel the power of the volcano.
quiz_en: What name was given to the lava dome that grew during the eruption of Mount Fugen beginning in 1990?

name: 雲仙温泉の雲仙地獄と源泉浴場群
desc: 雲仙温泉の中心にある雲仙地獄は、白い噴気が立ちのぼり、硫黄の香りが漂う迫力ある地熱地帯です。遊歩道を歩くと、熱い湯や蒸気が噴き出す様子を間近に見られます。江戸時代にはキリシタンへの迫害の場となった悲しい歴史も持っています。地獄の蒸気で作る温泉たまごを味わい、名湯に浸かってください。
quiz: 雲仙地獄の名物で、地熱の蒸気を使ってゆでた卵を何と呼ぶでしょう？
name_en: Unzen Jigoku and Unzen Onsen Baths
desc_en: Unzen Jigoku (Unzen Hells), at the heart of Unzen Onsen, is a dramatic geothermal area where white steam rises and the smell of sulfur fills the air. Walking the trails, you can see hot water and steam spouting up close. It also has a sad history as a place where Christians were persecuted in the Edo period. Taste onsen eggs cooked in the steam of the hells and soak in the famous hot springs.
quiz_en: What are the eggs boiled in geothermal steam, a famous specialty of Unzen Jigoku, called?

name: 原城跡
desc: 南島原市の原城跡は、江戸時代初期の島原・天草一揆で、天草四郎を総大将とする一揆勢が立てこもった城跡です。幕府の大軍に包囲され、激しい戦いの末に落城しました。世界遺産「長崎と天草地方の潜伏キリシタン関連遺産」の構成資産です。有明海を望む本丸跡に立ち、潜伏の時代の始まりに思いを馳せてください。
quiz: 島原・天草一揆で、原城に立てこもった一揆勢を率いた若き総大将は誰でしょう？
desc_en: The Hara Castle Ruins in Minamishimabara City are where rebels led by Amakusa Shiro barricaded themselves during the Shimabara-Amakusa Rebellion in the early Edo period. Surrounded by a huge shogunate army, the castle fell after fierce fighting. It is a component of the World Heritage site "Hidden Christian Sites in the Nagasaki Region." Stand on the site of the main keep overlooking the Ariake Sea and reflect on the beginning of the era of hidden faith.
quiz_en: Who was the young commander who led the rebels barricaded in Hara Castle during the Shimabara-Amakusa Rebellion?

name: 中尾城公園
desc: 長与町にある中尾城公園は、かつての城跡に整備された高台の公園です。長与町は長崎市の北隣に位置し、大村湾に面したベッドタウンとして発展してきました。また、温州みかんの栽培の歴史を持つ「みかんの町」としても知られています。高台の公園で景色を眺めながら、のどかな時間を過ごしてください。
quiz: 中尾城公園のある長与町は、どんな果物の栽培の歴史で知られる町でしょう？
desc_en: Nakao Castle Park in Nagayo Town is a hilltop park built on the site of a former castle. Nagayo lies just north of Nagasaki City and has developed as a commuter town facing Omura Bay. It is also known as a "mikan town" with a history of growing unshu mandarin oranges. Enjoy a relaxing time while taking in the view from the hilltop park.
quiz_en: Nagayo Town, home of Nakao Castle Park, is known for its history of growing which kind of fruit?

name: 崎野自然公園
desc: 時津町西時津郷にある崎野自然公園は、大村湾に突き出た岬に広がる自然公園です。穏やかな大村湾の海岸線を歩く遊歩道があり、潮風を感じながら散策を楽しめます。磯遊びや釣りを楽しむ人も多く、長崎市街から近いながら豊かな自然が残る場所です。夕暮れどきには湾が茜色に染まる美しい景色が広がります。
quiz: 岬の自然公園で磯遊びをするなら、あなたが見つけたい海の生き物は何？
desc_en: Sakino Nature Park in the Nishitogitsu area of Togitsu Town is a nature park spreading across a cape that juts into Omura Bay. A walking path runs along the calm coastline of the bay, so you can enjoy a stroll in the sea breeze. Many people come to explore tide pools or fish, and although it is close to central Nagasaki, rich nature remains. At dusk the bay turns a deep red, creating a beautiful view.
quiz_en: If you went exploring the rocky tide pools at a cape nature park, which sea creature would you most like to find?

name: やきもの公園
desc: 波佐見町のやきもの公園は、世界の歴史的な窯を再現して展示している屋外の公園です。波佐見町は江戸時代から庶民向けの日用の器を大量に生産してきた焼き物の町で、現在は「波佐見焼」として人気を集めています。公園に隣接する施設では器の展示や販売も行われます。窯の形の違いを見比べてみてください。
quiz: 江戸時代に波佐見で大量に作られ、淀川の舟で売られた庶民向けの茶碗を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: Yakimono Park in Hasami Town is an outdoor park displaying reproductions of historic kilns from around the world. Hasami has been a pottery town since the Edo period, mass-producing everyday tableware for ordinary people, and its products are now popular as "Hasami ware." A facility next to the park also exhibits and sells tableware. Compare the different shapes of the kilns.
quiz_en: In the Edo period, inexpensive rice bowls mass-produced in Hasami were sold from boats on the Yodo River. What were they called?

name: はさみ温泉
desc: 焼き物の町・波佐見町にある温泉です。波佐見町は長崎県の中央部に位置する山あいの町で、陶磁器の里として知られるほか、鬼木の棚田など美しい田園風景も広がっています。窯元めぐりで器を探したり、町を散策したりしたあとは、温泉でゆっくりと体を休めて、波佐見の旅をのんびりと締めくくってください。
quiz: 波佐見焼の器を一つ持ち帰るなら、あなたはどんな料理を盛り付けたい？
desc_en: This hot spring is in Hasami Town, a town of pottery. Hasami is a hilly town in central Nagasaki Prefecture known as a home of ceramics, and beautiful countryside scenery such as the Oniki terraced rice fields also spreads out here. After hunting for tableware on a tour of potteries or strolling around town, rest your body slowly in the hot spring and bring your Hasami trip to a relaxed close.
quiz_en: If you took home one piece of Hasami ware tableware, what kind of dish would you like to serve on it?

name: 皿山公園
desc: 佐々町市瀬免にある皿山公園は、地元の人々に親しまれている公園です。佐々町は佐世保市の北隣に位置し、町の中央を佐々川が流れる自然豊かな町です。「皿山」は九州で焼き物の窯場を意味する言葉としても知られています。季節の花や緑を楽しみながら散策し、のどかな町の雰囲気を味わってください。
quiz: 佐々町の中央を流れ、川沿いの桜並木でも知られる川の名前は何でしょう？
desc_en: Sarayama Park in the Ichinose area of Saza Town is a park loved by local people. Saza lies just north of Sasebo City, a nature-rich town with the Saza River flowing through its center. "Sarayama" is also known in Kyushu as a word meaning a pottery kiln site. Stroll while enjoying seasonal flowers and greenery, and savor the town's peaceful atmosphere.
quiz_en: What is the name of the river that flows through the center of Saza Town and is known for its rows of cherry trees?

name: 河津桜
addr: 佐々町市場免・本田原免・沖田免
desc: 佐々町の佐々川沿いに咲く河津桜です。河津桜はソメイヨシノより早い時期に咲く早咲きの桜で、濃いピンク色の花が特徴です。まだ肌寒い季節に川沿いを彩る花並木は、一足早い春の訪れを感じさせてくれます。菜の花の黄色と桜のピンクが重なる景色も魅力で、川辺の散策がいっそう楽しくなります。
quiz: 河津桜の名前の由来となった「河津」は、どこの県にある町の名前でしょう？
desc_en: These are the Kawazu cherry trees blooming along the Saza River in Saza Town. Kawazu-zakura is an early-blooming cherry that flowers before the Somei-yoshino variety, characterized by its deep pink blossoms. The rows of flowers coloring the riverside while the air is still chilly let you feel spring arriving a little early. The scene where yellow rapeseed blossoms overlap with pink cherry blossoms is also charming, making a riverside walk even more enjoyable.
quiz_en: The Kawazu cherry is named after the town of Kawazu. In which prefecture of Japan is the town of Kawazu located?

name: 熊本城
desc: 熊本市の中心にそびえる熊本城は、加藤清正が築いた日本三名城の一つです。上部に行くほど反り返る「武者返し」の石垣が名高く、西南戦争でも難攻不落ぶりを示しました。2016年の熊本地震で大きな被害を受けましたが、天守閣は復旧を遂げ、今も復興の歩みが続いています。銀杏城の別名でも親しまれます。
quiz: 熊本城の石垣で、上に行くほど急に反り返る独特の形状を何と呼ぶでしょう？
desc_en: Towering in the center of Kumamoto City, Kumamoto Castle was built by Kato Kiyomasa and is one of Japan's three great castles. It is renowned for its "mushagaeshi" stone walls, which curve outward more steeply toward the top, and it proved impregnable even in the Satsuma Rebellion. Though heavily damaged in the 2016 Kumamoto earthquakes, the main keep has been restored, and reconstruction continues today. It is also fondly called Ginnan Castle (Ginkgo Castle).
quiz_en: What is the name of the distinctive shape of Kumamoto Castle's stone walls, which curve outward more steeply toward the top?

name: 水前寺成趣園
addr: 熊本市中央区水前寺公園8-1
desc: 熊本市の水前寺成趣園は、熊本藩主細川家によって造られた桃山式の回遊式庭園です。阿蘇の伏流水が湧き出る池を中心に、東海道五十三次を模したともいわれる景観が広がり、富士山に見立てた築山が目を引きます。園内には細川家の歴代藩主をまつる出水神社もあります。清らかな水と緑の景色をお楽しみください。
quiz: 水前寺成趣園の築山は、日本一の何という山を模したものといわれているでしょう？
desc_en: Suizenji Jojuen in Kumamoto City is a Momoyama-style stroll garden created by the Hosokawa family, lords of the Kumamoto domain. Centered on a pond fed by spring water from underground streams flowing from Aso, its landscape is said to be modeled on the 53 Stations of the Tokaido, and an artificial hill styled after Mount Fuji catches the eye. The garden also contains Izumi Shrine, which enshrines successive Hosokawa lords. Enjoy the clear water and green scenery.
quiz_en: The artificial hill in Suizenji Jojuen Garden is said to be modeled on which mountain, the highest in Japan?

name: 立田自然公園
desc: 熊本市中央区の立田山のふもとにある立田自然公園は、細川家の菩提寺だった泰勝寺の跡地に整備された公園です。園内には細川家初代の藤孝夫妻、二代忠興と夫人ガラシャの墓所「四つ御廟」があります。苔むした庭園や竹林、茶室が残り、緑に包まれた静かな空間です。熊本の歴史を感じながら散策してください。
quiz: 立田自然公園に眠る、細川忠興の妻で戦国時代のキリシタンとしても知られる女性は誰？
desc_en: Tatsuta Nature Park, at the foot of Mount Tatsuta in Chuo Ward, Kumamoto City, was built on the site of Taisho-ji, the family temple of the Hosokawa clan. In the park is the "Yotsu Gobyo," the graves of the first Hosokawa lord Fujitaka and his wife and the second lord Tadaoki and his wife Gracia. A mossy garden, bamboo grove and tea house remain in this quiet space wrapped in greenery. Stroll and feel Kumamoto's history.
quiz_en: Who is the woman resting in Tatsuta Nature Park, the wife of Hosokawa Tadaoki, also known as a Christian of the Warring States period?

name: 藤崎八幡宮秋季例大祭
addr: 熊本市中央区井川淵町3-1
desc: 熊本市の藤崎八幡宮で毎年9月に行われる秋季例大祭です。神幸行列には、飾り馬と勢子と呼ばれる若者たちが「ドーカイ、ドーカイ」の掛け声とともに練り歩く「随兵」の行列が加わり、熊本の街は熱気に包まれます。熊本の秋を代表する祭りで、ラッパや太鼓の音とともに勇壮な飾り馬が街を進みます。
quiz: 藤崎八幡宮の例大祭で、飾り馬を追う勢子たちが叫ぶ独特の掛け声は何？
desc_en: This autumn grand festival is held every September at Fujisaki Hachimangu in Kumamoto City. The sacred procession includes the "Zuibyo" parade, in which decorated horses and young men called seko march along chanting "Dokai, dokai," filling the city of Kumamoto with excitement. It is Kumamoto's signature autumn festival, with bold decorated horses advancing through town to the sound of trumpets and drums.
quiz_en: At the Fujisaki Hachimangu festival, what distinctive chant do the seko shout as they follow the decorated horses?

name: 塚原古墳公園
addr: 熊本市南区城南町塚原1924
desc: 熊本市南区城南町にある塚原古墳公園は、円墳や方墳、前方後円墳など多くの古墳が集まる塚原古墳群を整備した公園で、国の史跡に指定されています。高速道路の建設に伴う調査で発見され、ルートを変更して保存されました。芝生に覆われた古墳が並ぶ風景は穏やかで、古代の人々の営みを身近に感じられます。
quiz: 円墳や方墳のほかに、古墳の代表的な形として知られる鍵穴のような形を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: Tsukahara Kofun Park in the Jonan area of Minami Ward, Kumamoto City, preserves the Tsukahara Kofun Group, a cluster of many burial mounds including round, square and keyhole-shaped tombs, and is a national Historic Site. It was discovered during surveys for expressway construction, and the route was changed to preserve it. The scene of grass-covered mounds in a row is peaceful, letting you feel close to the lives of ancient people.
quiz_en: Besides round and square mounds, what is the name of the representative keyhole-shaped type of ancient burial mound in Japan?

name: 川尻神宮秋季例大祭
desc: 熊本市南区の川尻地区に鎮座する川尻神宮の秋季例大祭です。川尻は緑川と加勢川の舟運で栄えた港町で、熊本藩の御蔵が置かれ、今も古い町並みや蔵が残ります。刃物づくりの伝統も受け継がれ、「川尻刃物」として知られています。祭りでにぎわう歴史ある町並みを歩き、往時の繁栄を感じてください。
quiz: 熊本市の川尻地区で伝統的に作られている、包丁などの名産品は何でしょう？
desc_en: This is the autumn grand festival of Kawashiri Jingu Shrine in the Kawashiri district of Minami Ward, Kumamoto City. Kawashiri was a port town that thrived on boat transport along the Midori and Kase rivers, home to the Kumamoto domain's storehouses, and old streets and warehouses remain today. The tradition of blade-making also lives on, known as "Kawashiri cutlery." Walk the historic streets bustling with the festival and feel the prosperity of the past.
quiz_en: What famous products, such as kitchen knives, are traditionally made in the Kawashiri district of Kumamoto City?

name: 田原坂公園
addr: 熊本市北区植木町豊岡858-1
desc: 熊本市北区植木町の田原坂は、明治10年の西南戦争で最大の激戦地となった場所です。政府軍と西郷隆盛率いる薩摩軍が17日間にわたって激しい攻防を繰り広げました。民謡「田原坂」に「雨は降る降る人馬は濡れる」と歌われています。公園には資料館があり、弾痕の残る家などを通じて戦いの歴史を伝えています。
quiz: 田原坂が激戦地となった、明治時代に西郷隆盛が率いた士族の反乱を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: Tabaruzaka, in the Ueki area of Kita Ward, Kumamoto City, was the site of the fiercest fighting of the Satsuma Rebellion in 1877. Government forces and the Satsuma army led by Saigo Takamori fought a fierce battle here for 17 days. The folk song "Tabaruzaka" sings, "The rain keeps falling, the men and horses are soaked." The park has a museum that conveys the history of the battle through features such as a house marked by bullet holes.
quiz_en: What is the name of the Meiji-era samurai rebellion led by Saigo Takamori that made Tabaruzaka a scene of fierce fighting?

name: 氷室祭
desc: 八代市妙見町の八代神社（妙見宮）で行われる氷室祭です。氷室とは、冷蔵庫のない時代に冬の氷や雪を夏まで貯えておいた貯蔵庫のことです。八代神社は八代の人々に「妙見さん」と親しまれ、秋の妙見祭は国の重要無形民俗文化財で、ユネスコ無形文化遺産にも登録されています。緑に囲まれた境内を訪ねてください。
quiz: 八代神社の秋の祭りで、亀と蛇が合体した姿の霊獣「ガメ」が登場する祭りは何？
desc_en: The Himuro Festival is held at Yatsushiro Shrine (Myoken-gu) in the Myoken area of Yatsushiro City. A himuro is an icehouse used to store winter ice and snow until summer in the days before refrigerators. Yatsushiro Shrine is fondly called "Myoken-san" by locals, and its autumn Myoken Festival is a national Important Intangible Folk Cultural Property, also inscribed on UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage list. Visit its grounds surrounded by greenery.
quiz_en: Which autumn festival of Yatsushiro Shrine features the "Game," a mythical beast combining a turtle and a snake?

name: 五家荘紅葉祭
addr: 八代市泉町仁田尾（五家荘一帯）
desc: 八代市泉町の五家荘一帯で開かれる紅葉祭です。五家荘は九州山地の山深くにある秘境で、平家の落人や菅原道真の子孫が隠れ住んだという伝説が残ります。秋には山々が赤や黄色に染まり、渓谷に架かる吊り橋や、緒方家・左座家などの古い屋敷とともに、山里ならではの見事な紅葉を楽しめます。
quiz: 五家荘に残る伝説で、壇ノ浦の戦いのあと山深くに隠れ住んだとされる人々は誰？
desc_en: This autumn leaves festival is held throughout the Gokanosho area of Izumi, Yatsushiro City. Gokanosho is a remote area deep in the Kyushu Mountains, with legends that fleeing Heike warriors and descendants of Sugawara no Michizane lived here in hiding. In autumn the mountains turn red and yellow, and you can enjoy magnificent foliage along with suspension bridges over the gorges and old residences such as the Ogata and Saza family houses.
quiz_en: According to Gokanosho legend, which group of people fled deep into the mountains to live in hiding after the Battle of Dan-no-ura?

name: 永国寺
desc: 人吉市の永国寺は、「幽霊寺」の名で知られる寺です。江戸時代に住職が描いたとされる幽霊の掛け軸が伝わり、その姿を見ようと多くの人が訪れます。境内の池にもその幽霊にまつわる話が残っています。人吉は球磨川の流れる城下町で、球磨焼酎や川下りでも有名です。静かな境内で不思議な物語にふれてください。
quiz: 人吉市の永国寺に伝わる、怖くて不思議な掛け軸に描かれているものは何でしょう？
desc_en: Eikoku-ji in Hitoyoshi City is known as the "Ghost Temple." It holds a hanging scroll of a ghost said to have been painted by a head priest in the Edo period, and many people visit to see it. A story about the ghost is also linked to the pond on the grounds. Hitoyoshi is a castle town on the Kuma River, also famous for Kuma shochu and river rafting. Encounter this mysterious tale in the quiet grounds.
quiz_en: What is depicted on the eerie and mysterious hanging scroll handed down at Eikoku-ji Temple in Hitoyoshi City?

name: 石水寺
addr: 人吉市下原田町字西門2348
desc: 人吉市下原田町にある石水寺です。人吉は相良氏が約700年にわたって治めた城下町で、市内には相良氏ゆかりの寺社が数多く残っています。石水寺は山あいの緑に包まれた静かな寺で、落ち着いた雰囲気の中でゆっくりと参拝できます。春や秋の景色も楽しみながら、人吉盆地の歴史と自然を感じてください。
quiz: 石水寺のある人吉を、江戸時代末まで長く治め続けた大名家は何氏でしょう？
desc_en: This is Sekisui-ji in the Shimoharada area of Hitoyoshi City. Hitoyoshi is a castle town ruled by the Sagara clan for about 700 years, and many temples and shrines linked to the Sagara remain in the city. Sekisui-ji is a quiet temple wrapped in mountain greenery, where you can worship at your leisure in a calm atmosphere. Enjoy the spring and autumn scenery as you feel the history and nature of the Hitoyoshi Basin.
quiz_en: Which daimyo clan ruled Hitoyoshi, home of Sekisui-ji, for a very long time until the end of the Edo period?

name: 野原八幡宮
desc: 荒尾市の野原八幡宮は、地域の総鎮守として古くから信仰を集めてきた神社です。秋の例大祭では「風流」と呼ばれる芸能が奉納され、古くから受け継がれる伝統として知られています。荒尾市は有明海に面した町で、世界遺産の万田坑など炭鉱の歴史を伝える場所も残ります。由緒ある境内をゆっくり歩いてみてください。
quiz: 荒尾市にある世界遺産「明治日本の産業革命遺産」の構成資産である炭鉱跡は？
desc_en: Nobara Hachimangu in Arao City has long drawn worshippers as the guardian shrine of the region. At its autumn grand festival, a performing art called "furyu" is offered, known as a tradition handed down since long ago. Arao faces the Ariake Sea, and places that convey its coal mining history remain, such as the World Heritage-listed Manda Pit. Take a leisurely walk through the historic grounds.
quiz_en: Which former coal mine in Arao City is a component of the World Heritage site "Sites of Japan's Meiji Industrial Revolution"?

name: 荒炎祭
addr: 荒尾市緑ケ丘1-1-1（あらおシティモール）
desc: 荒尾市の大型商業施設周辺を会場に開かれる荒炎祭です。荒尾市は熊本県の北西端に位置し、有明海に面した町で、かつては三池炭鉱の一部として栄えました。祭りには多くの人が集まり、踊りやステージ、花火などで夏の夜がにぎやかに彩られます。地元の熱気あふれる祭りの雰囲気を存分に楽しんでください。
quiz: 夏祭りで、あなたが一番テンションが上がるのは踊り？花火？それとも屋台？
desc_en: The Araen Festival is held around a large shopping complex in Arao City. Arao sits at the northwestern tip of Kumamoto Prefecture, facing the Ariake Sea, and once thrived as part of the Miike coal mine. Many people gather for the festival, and the summer night is brightened with dancing, stage shows and fireworks. Fully enjoy the atmosphere of this energetic local festival.
quiz_en: At a summer festival, what gets you most excited, the dancing, the fireworks or the food stalls?

name: 四山神社春季大祭
desc: 荒尾市大島の四山神社で行われる春季大祭です。四山神社は「四山さん」と呼ばれて親しまれ、商売繁盛や開運の神様として多くの参拝者が訪れます。小高い四ツ山の上に鎮座し、境内からは有明海を望むことができます。大祭の日には境内や参道に露店が並び、地元の人々でにぎわう春の風物詩となっています。
quiz: 四山神社の大祭に出かけたら、参道の露店であなたが最初に買うものは何？
desc_en: This spring grand festival is held at Yotsuyama Shrine in the Oshima area of Arao City. Fondly called "Yotsuyama-san," the shrine draws many worshippers as a deity of business prosperity and good fortune. It stands atop the small hill of Yotsuyama, and from its grounds you can see the Ariake Sea. On festival days, stalls line the grounds and the approach, making it a spring tradition bustling with local people.
quiz_en: If you went to the Yotsuyama Shrine festival, what would be the first thing you would buy from the stalls along the approach?

name: 湯の児温泉
desc: 水俣市の湯の児温泉は、不知火海に面した海辺の温泉地です。穏やかな海に小さな島々が浮かぶ景色を眺めながら湯に浸かることができ、夕暮れには海を茜色に染める夕日が美しく輝きます。周辺の海は透明度が高く、海釣りや遊覧も楽しめます。潮風に吹かれながら、海の温泉ならではのひとときを過ごしてください。
quiz: 湯の児温泉が面している、不思議な火が見えるという伝説で知られる海は何？
desc_en: Yunoko Onsen in Minamata City is a seaside hot spring resort facing the Shiranui Sea. You can soak while viewing small islands floating on the calm sea, and at dusk the setting sun shines beautifully, dyeing the sea deep red. The surrounding waters are highly transparent, and you can also enjoy sea fishing and boat tours. Feel the sea breeze and spend a moment unique to a seaside hot spring.
quiz_en: Which sea does Yunoko Onsen face, known for a legend about mysterious lights that appear on its waters?

name: 湯の鶴温泉
desc: 水俣市の山あい、湯出川沿いにある湯の鶴温泉は、古くから湯治場として親しまれてきた温泉地です。川沿いに旅館が並ぶ素朴な温泉街で、のどかな山里の風情が漂います。周辺は緑豊かな自然に囲まれ、川のせせらぎが耳に心地よく響きます。静かな山の湯で、心も体もゆっくりと癒やしてください。
quiz: 山あいの温泉地で、夏の夜に川辺で見られたらうれしい光る生き物は何？
desc_en: Yunotsuru Onsen, along the Yude River in the hills of Minamata City, is a hot spring long loved as a place for therapeutic bathing. It is a simple hot spring town with inns along the river, filled with the charm of a peaceful mountain village. The area is surrounded by lush nature, and the murmur of the river is pleasant to the ear. Let a quiet mountain hot spring slowly heal both body and mind.
quiz_en: At a mountain hot spring like Yunotsuru Onsen, which glowing creature would you be delighted to see by the river on a summer night?

name: 恋龍祭
desc: 水俣市で開かれる夏の祭り「恋龍祭」です。水俣市は熊本県の最南端、不知火海に面した町で、温泉や海と山の自然に恵まれています。祭りでは踊りや花火などが行われ、町が多くの人々でにぎわいます。水俣は環境モデル都市として環境を大切にするまちづくりにも取り組んでいます。夏の夜の熱気を楽しんでください。
quiz: 水俣の夏祭りに参加するなら、浴衣とはっぴ、あなたはどっちを着て楽しみたい？
desc_en: The "Koiryu Festival" is a summer festival held in Minamata City. Minamata, at the southernmost tip of Kumamoto Prefecture facing the Shiranui Sea, is blessed with hot springs and the nature of both sea and mountains. The festival features dancing and fireworks, and the town is busy with crowds. As an Environmental Model City, Minamata is also working on town development that values the environment. Enjoy the excitement of a summer night.
quiz_en: If you joined Minamata's summer festival, which would you rather wear, a yukata cotton robe or a happi festival coat?

name: 繁根木八幡宮
desc: 玉名市繁根木に鎮座する繁根木八幡宮です。玉名市は菊池川の下流域に開けた町で、古くから交通と交易の要所として栄えてきました。地域の人々に親しまれる八幡宮で、境内は落ち着いた雰囲気に包まれています。参拝のあとは、近くの玉名温泉や名物の玉名ラーメンを楽しんで、玉名の町をめぐってください。
quiz: 玉名市を流れて有明海へ注ぎ、古くから舟運に使われてきた川の名前は何？
desc_en: This is Hanegi Hachimangu in the Hanegi area of Tamana City. Tamana developed along the lower reaches of the Kikuchi River and has long prospered as a hub of transportation and trade. The shrine is beloved by local people, and its grounds are wrapped in a calm atmosphere. After your visit, enjoy nearby Tamana Onsen and the local specialty, Tamana ramen, as you explore the town.
quiz_en: What is the name of the river that flows through Tamana City into the Ariake Sea and was long used for boat transport?

name: 玉名温泉
addr: 玉名市立願寺565（玉名温泉観光旅館協同組合）
desc: 玉名市の立願寺地区に広がる玉名温泉は、古くから知られる歴史ある温泉地です。菊池川のほとりに開けた温泉街には旅館やホテルが並び、日帰りで入れる施設もあります。玉名市は、にんにくを効かせたとんこつスープの玉名ラーメンでも知られています。湯上がりには名物の味を楽しんでください。
quiz: 玉名温泉で湯上がりに食べたい、玉名名物のラーメンのスープは何味でしょう？
desc_en: Tamana Onsen, spreading across the Ryuganji area of Tamana City, is a historic hot spring known since long ago. In the hot spring town on the banks of the Kikuchi River, ryokan and hotels line the streets, and there are also facilities for day visitors. Tamana is also known for Tamana ramen, with a tonkotsu pork-bone broth flavored with garlic. After your bath, enjoy this local specialty.
quiz_en: After a soak at Tamana Onsen, you might try Tamana ramen. What kind of soup is this local specialty ramen made with?

name: 山鹿温泉
desc: 山鹿市の中心部に湧く山鹿温泉は、江戸時代には豊前街道の宿場町としても栄えた温泉地です。町のシンボル「さくら湯」は、江戸時代の御茶屋を起源とする共同浴場で、木造の堂々とした建物が復元されています。夏には頭に金灯籠を載せた女性たちが踊る「山鹿灯籠まつり」が行われ、幻想的な光景が広がります。
quiz: 山鹿灯籠まつりで、女性たちが頭に載せて踊る灯籠は何色をしているでしょう？
desc_en: Yamaga Onsen, which springs up in central Yamaga City, is a hot spring town that also prospered as a post town on the Buzen Kaido highway in the Edo period. The town's symbol, "Sakura-yu," is a public bathhouse that originated as an Edo-period lord's rest house, and its stately wooden building has been restored. In summer the "Yamaga Toro Festival" is held, where women dance with golden lanterns on their heads, creating a magical scene.
quiz_en: At the Yamaga Toro Festival, what color are the lanterns that the women wear on their heads while they dance?

name: 平山温泉
desc: 山鹿市の平山温泉は、山あいの田園地帯に宿が点在する静かな温泉地です。とろりとした肌触りの湯が特徴で、湯上がりに肌がつるつるになると評判です。旅館の多くが露天風呂や貸切風呂を備え、自然に囲まれた中でゆっくりと湯を楽しめます。喧騒から離れた隠れ家のような湯で、心身をのんびり癒やしてください。
quiz: 平山温泉の貸切露天風呂に入るなら、あなたが一緒に行きたい相手は誰？
desc_en: Hirayama Onsen in Yamaga City is a quiet hot spring area with inns scattered across the farmland of the hills. Its water is known for its silky feel and is said to leave your skin smooth after bathing. Many of the ryokan have open-air baths or private baths, letting you enjoy the water at leisure surrounded by nature. In this hideaway hot spring far from the bustle, let your body and mind relax.
quiz_en: If you could take a private open-air bath at Hirayama Onsen, who would you most like to go there with?

name: 菊鹿温泉
desc: 山鹿市菊鹿町にある菊鹿温泉です。菊鹿町は山と田園に囲まれたのどかな地域で、ワイン用のぶどう栽培が盛んな土地としても知られています。近くには古代の山城・鞠智城の跡もあり、復元された八角形の鼓楼が見どころです。史跡めぐりや田園の散策を楽しんだあと、温泉でほっとひと息ついてください。
quiz: 菊鹿町にある古代山城・鞠智城跡で、復元された八角形の建物を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: This is Kikuka Onsen in the Kikuka area of Yamaga City. Kikuka is a peaceful area surrounded by mountains and farmland, and it is also known for growing grapes for wine. Nearby are the ruins of Kikuchi Castle, an ancient mountain fortress, where the reconstructed octagonal drum tower is a highlight. After touring the historic site and strolling the countryside, relax with a sigh of relief in the hot spring.
quiz_en: What is the reconstructed octagonal building at the ruins of Kikuchi Castle, an ancient mountain fortress in Kikuka, called?

name: 鹿本温泉
desc: 山鹿市鹿本町にある鹿本温泉です。鹿本町は菊池川の流域に広がる田園の町で、来民地区は渋うちわの産地として知られています。のどかな田園風景に囲まれた温泉で、地元の人々にも親しまれています。山鹿温泉や平山温泉など、山鹿市内の個性豊かな温泉とあわせて、湯めぐりの旅を楽しんでみてください。
quiz: 鹿本町の来民地区で古くから作られてきた、柿渋を塗った伝統工芸品は何？
desc_en: This is Kamoto Onsen in the Kamoto area of Yamaga City. Kamoto is a farming town in the Kikuchi River basin, and its Kutami district is known for producing shibu uchiwa fans. This hot spring, surrounded by peaceful countryside, is also loved by locals. Try a hot spring tour, combining it with other distinctive hot springs in Yamaga City such as Yamaga Onsen and Hirayama Onsen.
quiz_en: What traditional craft coated with persimmon tannin has long been made in the Kutami district of Kamoto?

name: 相良寺
desc: 山鹿市菊鹿町の相良寺は、「相良観音」の名で親しまれる寺で、安産や子育ての観音様として信仰を集めています。山あいの静かな境内には、多くの参拝者が願いを込めて訪れ、人々の祈りの深さが伝わってきます。周辺は緑豊かな山里で、四季折々の景色が楽しめます。のどかな菊鹿の里で心を落ち着けてください。
quiz: 相良寺が親しみを込めて呼ばれている名前は「相良◯◯」。◯◯に入る言葉は？
desc_en: Sagara-ji in the Kikuka area of Yamaga City is a temple fondly known as "Sagara Kannon," worshipped as a Kannon of safe childbirth and child-rearing. Many worshippers come to its quiet grounds in the hills with their wishes, conveying the depth of people's prayers. The surroundings are a lush mountain village where you can enjoy the scenery of each season. Calm your mind in the peaceful village of Kikuka.
quiz_en: Sagara-ji Temple is affectionately known as "Sagara ___." Which Buddhist deity's name fills in the blank?

name: 日輪寺公園つつじ祭り
desc: 山鹿市杉の日輪寺公園で開かれるつつじ祭りです。日輪寺の境内に広がる公園には多くのツツジが植えられ、春には山の斜面が赤やピンク、白の花で埋めつくされます。日輪寺は赤穂義士ゆかりの寺としても知られています。色鮮やかな花のじゅうたんの中を歩きながら、春の山鹿を楽しんでください。
quiz: 日輪寺公園の春の祭りで、山の斜面を赤やピンクに染める花は何でしょう？
desc_en: This azalea festival is held at Nichirinji Park in the Sugi area of Yamaga City. Many azaleas are planted in the park spreading across the grounds of Nichirin-ji Temple, and in spring the mountain slopes are covered with red, pink and white flowers. Nichirin-ji is also known as a temple linked to the 47 ronin of Ako. Enjoy spring in Yamaga as you walk through the vivid carpet of flowers.
quiz_en: What flower colors the mountain slopes red and pink during the spring festival at Nichirinji Park?

name: 招魂祭
addr: 山鹿市鹿本町来民686-1（鹿本総合支所駐車場）
desc: 山鹿市鹿本町の来民地区で行われる招魂祭です。招魂祭は戦没者の霊を慰め、平和への願いを新たにするための行事で、地域の人々によって大切に受け継がれてきました。来民は柿渋を塗った渋うちわの産地としても知られる町です。祭りの日の町の様子にふれ、地域の人々の祈りと暮らしの姿を感じてください。
quiz: 来民の渋うちわのような伝統工芸品、あなたが旅先で買って帰りたいものは何？
desc_en: This Shokonsai is held in the Kutami district of the Kamoto area of Yamaga City. Shokonsai is an event to console the spirits of the war dead and renew prayers for peace, and it has been carefully handed down by local people. Kutami is also known as a town producing shibu uchiwa, fans coated with persimmon tannin. Take in the town on the festival day and feel the prayers and lives of the local people.
quiz_en: Like Kutami's traditional persimmon-tannin fans, what kind of traditional craft would you like to buy and bring home from a trip?

name: 菊池渓谷
desc: 阿蘇外輪山の北西に位置する菊池渓谷は、菊池川の源流にある渓谷です。原生林に囲まれた渓流には大小の滝や淵が連なり、日本の名水百選にも選ばれた清らかな水が流れます。夏でも水温が低く、天然のクーラーとして涼を求める人々が訪れます。秋には紅葉が渓谷を鮮やかに染め、多くの観光客でにぎわいます。
quiz: 菊池渓谷の清らかな水も選ばれている、全国の優れた水を選んだ選定を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: Located northwest of the Aso outer caldera rim, Kikuchi Gorge is at the source of the Kikuchi River. Waterfalls and pools of all sizes line the stream surrounded by virgin forest, and the clear water flowing here has been chosen as one of Japan's 100 best waters. The water stays cold even in summer, so people come seeking a natural air conditioner. In autumn the leaves color the gorge vividly, and it bustles with tourists.
quiz_en: What is the name of the nationwide selection of Japan's finest waters that includes the clear water of Kikuchi Gorge?

name: 菊池温泉
desc: 菊池市の中心部、隈府に湧く菊池温泉に到着です。やわらかな肌ざわりのお湯で知られ、市街地に旅館やホテルが集まっています。中世に菊池氏が本拠を置いた歴史ある町で、少し足をのばせば清流と緑が美しい菊池渓谷もあります。湯上がりに城下町の名残を感じながら散策するのも楽しいですよ。
quiz: 菊池温泉でひと風呂浴びたあと、菊池の町で味わいたい名物グルメは何ですか？
desc_en: Welcome to Kikuchi Onsen (hot springs), which rises in Waifu in the heart of Kikuchi City. Known for its soft, gentle water, it has ryokan (traditional inns) and hotels clustered in the town. This historic town was the medieval base of the Kikuchi clan, and a short trip away lies Kikuchi Gorge, beautiful with clear streams and greenery. After your bath, enjoy a stroll while sensing traces of the old castle town.
quiz_en: After a soak at Kikuchi Onsen, what local specialty dish would you like to taste in the town of Kikuchi?

name: 粟嶋神社
desc: 宇土市新開町の粟嶋神社に到着です。有明海に近い穏やかな土地に鎮座する神社で、境内には人がくぐり抜けて願をかける、とても小さな鳥居があることで知られています。腰をかがめてくぐる姿はどこかほほえましく、健康や安産を願う参拝者が訪れます。素朴な境内でゆったりとお参りを楽しんでください。
quiz: 粟嶋神社の小さな鳥居、あなたならどんな姿勢でくぐり抜けますか？体験談も募集中、どうでしたか？
desc_en: Welcome to Awashima Shrine in Shinkai-machi, Uto City. Standing in a calm area near the Ariake Sea, the shrine is known for a very small torii (shrine gate) that people crawl through while making a wish. The sight of visitors bending low to squeeze through is rather charming, and worshippers come to pray for good health and safe childbirth. Take your time and enjoy a relaxed visit to these simple grounds.
quiz_en: How would you squeeze through the tiny torii gate at Awashima Shrine? If you have tried it, how did it go?

name: 西岡神宮
desc: 宇土市神馬町の西岡神宮に到着です。宇土の町で古くから信仰を集めてきた神社で、木々に囲まれた境内には落ち着いた空気が流れています。宇土は宇土半島の付け根に位置し、城下町の面影や石造りの轟泉水道など歴史の見どころが点在する町です。お参りのあとは町歩きで宇土の歴史に触れてみましょう。
quiz: 西岡神宮のある宇土市、江戸時代につくられた石の水道の名前は何でしょう？
desc_en: Welcome to Nishioka Shrine in Jinme-machi, Uto City. Long revered by the people of Uto, the shrine has tree-lined grounds filled with a calm atmosphere. Uto sits at the base of the Uto Peninsula, a town dotted with historic sights such as traces of its castle-town past and the stone Todoroki Water Supply. After your visit, take a walk around town and discover the history of Uto.
quiz_en: Uto City, home of Nishioka Shrine, has a stone water supply system built in the Edo period. What is it called?

name: 松島温泉
addr: 上天草市松島町合津地区
desc: 上天草市松島町の松島温泉に到着です。大小の島々が浮かぶ「天草松島」の景勝地にあり、宿の窓や露天風呂から多島海の眺めを楽しめます。天草五橋が島々を結ぶ風景は夕暮れどきがとくに美しく、海に沈む夕日を眺めながらの湯浴みは格別です。新鮮な魚介料理も旅の楽しみになります。
quiz: 天草の島々を結ぶ「天草五橋」のうち、一号橋につけられた愛称は何でしょう？
desc_en: Welcome to Matsushima Onsen in Matsushima-machi, Kamiamakusa City. Set in the scenic area known as Amakusa Matsushima, where islands large and small dot the sea, it offers views of the island-studded waters from inn windows and open-air baths. The scenery of the Amakusa Five Bridges linking the islands is especially lovely at dusk, and bathing while watching the sun sink into the sea is a special treat. Fresh seafood dishes are another highlight of the trip.
quiz_en: Of the Amakusa Five Bridges that link the islands of Amakusa, what nickname has been given to Bridge No. 1?

name: 大矢野温泉
addr: 上天草市大矢野町一帯
desc: 上天草市の大矢野島に広がる大矢野温泉に到着です。宇土半島から橋を渡ってすぐの島で、海に囲まれたのどかな景色の中に湯どころが点在しています。大矢野は天草四郎ゆかりの地としても知られ、歴史をたどる施設もあります。潮風に吹かれたあとは温泉でゆっくり体を温め、海の幸を味わってください。
quiz: 大矢野島ゆかりの人物で、島原・天草一揆の総大将となった少年は誰でしょう？
desc_en: Welcome to Oyano Onsen, spread across Oyano Island in Kamiamakusa City. Just across a bridge from the Uto Peninsula, the island has hot spring spots scattered among peaceful scenery surrounded by the sea. Oyano is also known for its ties to Amakusa Shiro, and there are facilities that trace this history. After feeling the sea breeze, warm up slowly in the hot springs and savor the bounty of the sea.
quiz_en: Who was the young boy, linked to Oyano Island, who became the supreme leader of the Shimabara-Amakusa Uprising?

name: 西港公園
addr: 宇城市三角町三角浦1263（周辺）
desc: 宇城市三角町の西港公園に到着です。明治時代に築かれた三角西港は、当時の石積みの埠頭や水路、洋風建築が今も残る港町で、「明治日本の産業革命遺産」の構成資産として世界文化遺産に登録されています。海辺に整然と並ぶ石積みと、レトロな建物が織りなす風景をのんびり歩いて楽しんでください。
quiz: 三角西港の石積み埠頭の設計に関わったのはどこの国の技術者でしょう？
desc_en: Welcome to Nishiko Park in Misumi-machi, Uki City. Misumi West Port, built in the Meiji era, is a port town that still keeps its original stone wharves, waterways and Western-style buildings. It is registered as a World Cultural Heritage site as a component of the Sites of Japan's Meiji Industrial Revolution. Take a leisurely walk through the scenery of neat stone walls along the shore and retro buildings.
quiz_en: Engineers from which country were involved in designing the stone wharves of Misumi West Port?

name: 阿蘇山
desc: 阿蘇市の阿蘇山に到着です。世界有数の規模を誇るカルデラの中に中岳や高岳などの山々がそびえ、中岳の火口からは今も噴煙が立ちのぼっています。カルデラの内側には町や田畑が広がり、人々が火山とともに暮らしてきた独特の風景が見られます。火山活動の状況を確かめながら雄大な景色を味わいましょう。
quiz: 阿蘇山の中央にそびえる「阿蘇五岳」、そのうち最も高い山はどれでしょう？
desc_en: Welcome to Mount Aso in Aso City. Within one of the largest calderas in the world rise peaks such as Nakadake and Takadake, and volcanic smoke still billows from the crater of Nakadake. Inside the caldera, towns and farmland spread out, creating a unique landscape where people have long lived alongside the volcano. Check the current volcanic activity and take in the magnificent scenery.
quiz_en: Of the Five Peaks of Aso that rise at the center of Mount Aso, which one is the highest?

name: 草千里
desc: 阿蘇の草千里ヶ浜に到着です。烏帽子岳のふもとに広がる大草原で、雨水がたまった池のまわりでは馬がのんびり草をはむ姿が見られます。背後には噴煙を上げる中岳が望め、阿蘇らしい開放的な景色を一望できます。乗馬体験も楽しめ、春から夏にかけては青々とした草原が一段と美しくなります。
quiz: 草千里ヶ浜の草原でのんびり過ごしている動物といえば何でしょう？
desc_en: Welcome to Kusasenri-ga-hama in Aso. This vast grassland spreads at the foot of Mount Eboshi, and around ponds formed by rainwater you can see horses grazing at their leisure. Behind it rises the smoking Nakadake, giving a sweeping, open view that is classic Aso. Horseback riding is also available, and from spring to summer the lush green grassland becomes even more beautiful.
quiz_en: Which animals can you see relaxing and grazing peacefully around the ponds on the vast grassland of Kusasenri-ga-hama?

name: 阿蘇神社
desc: 阿蘇市一の宮町の阿蘇神社に到着です。阿蘇山の神々をまつる肥後国一の宮で、全国でも珍しい横参道をもつことで知られます。堂々とした楼門は2016年の熊本地震で倒壊しましたが、修復を経て再び立ち上がりました。門前町には湧き水が点在し、水基めぐりをしながら食べ歩きも楽しめます。
quiz: 阿蘇神社の参道は拝殿の正面ではなく横から延びています。この珍しい参道を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: Welcome to Aso Shrine in Ichinomiya-machi, Aso City. Enshrining the deities of Mount Aso, it is the Ichinomiya (highest-ranked shrine) of the old Higo Province and is known for its rare sideways approach path. Its imposing tower gate collapsed in the 2016 Kumamoto Earthquake, but it has risen again after restoration. Spring water bubbles up throughout the shrine town, where you can enjoy snacking as you tour the water spots.
quiz_en: The approach to Aso Shrine runs from the side rather than straight to the front of the hall. What is this unusual approach called?

name: 佐俣温泉
desc: 美里町の佐俣温泉に到着です。緑深い山あいに位置する静かな湯どころで、地元の人にも親しまれています。美里町は江戸時代の石橋が多く残る町として知られ、霊台橋をはじめとする石造りのアーチ橋めぐりも楽しめます。里山の景色を眺めながら、ゆっくり温泉で旅の疲れをいやしてください。
quiz: 美里町にある霊台橋のように、石を組んでつくられた橋を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: Welcome to Samata Onsen in Misato Town. This quiet hot spring spot sits deep in green mountains and is popular with locals too. Misato is known as a town with many surviving Edo-period stone bridges, and you can enjoy touring stone arch bridges such as the Reidai Bridge. Gaze at the countryside scenery and soothe away your travel fatigue in the hot spring.
quiz_en: What do you call a bridge built from fitted stones, like the Reidai Bridge in Misato Town?

name: 三加和温泉
desc: 和水町大田黒の三加和温泉に到着です。熊本県北部の丘陵地に広がる、のどかな里の温泉です。和水町は古墳の町としても知られ、江田船山古墳など古代の歴史を感じる場所が点在しています。田園風景の中で湯につかり、ゆったりした時間の流れを楽しんでください。
quiz: 三加和温泉で温まったあと、和水町の里山で見てみたい景色は何ですか？
desc_en: Welcome to Mikawa Onsen in Otaguro, Nagomi Town. This is a peaceful village hot spring in the rolling hills of northern Kumamoto. Nagomi is also known as a town of kofun (ancient burial mounds), with places that evoke ancient history, such as the Eta Funayama Kofun, scattered around. Soak in the hot water amid the rural scenery and enjoy the slow pace of time.
quiz_en: After warming up at Mikawa Onsen, what scenery would you like to see in the countryside of Nagomi Town?

name: 和水町古墳祭
addr: 和水町江田302（江田船山古墳公園）
desc: 和水町の江田船山古墳公園で行われる古墳祭に到着です。会場の江田船山古墳は、文字が刻まれた大刀が出土したことで知られ、出土品は国宝に指定されています。古代ロマンあふれる古墳を舞台にした祭りで、地域の人々がにぎやかに集います。古墳のまわりを歩いて、はるかな時代に思いをはせてみましょう。
quiz: 江田船山古墳から出土した国宝の大刀には、何が刻まれていたことで知られる？
desc_en: Welcome to the Kofun Festival held at Eta Funayama Kofun Park in Nagomi Town. The venue, the Eta Funayama Kofun (ancient burial mound), is known for yielding a sword engraved with characters, and its excavated artifacts are designated National Treasures. Set at a mound full of ancient romance, the festival brings local people together in lively celebration. Walk around the mound and let your thoughts drift to the distant past.
quiz_en: The National Treasure sword unearthed from the Eta Funayama Kofun is known for having what engraved on it?

name: 共楽園
desc: 南小国町赤馬場の共楽園に到着です。南小国町は阿蘇の外輪山の北側に位置し、黒川温泉をはじめとする温泉地と、杉林や草原が広がる山里の町です。高原のさわやかな空気の中で、四季折々の自然をのんびり楽しめる憩いの場所です。近くの温泉地と組み合わせてゆっくり巡ってください。
quiz: 南小国町を旅するなら、温泉と一緒に楽しみたい地元のグルメは何ですか？
desc_en: Welcome to Kyorakuen in Akababa, Minamioguni Town. Minamioguni lies on the north side of Aso's outer crater rim, a mountain village of cedar forests and grasslands with hot spring areas such as Kurokawa Onsen. This relaxing spot lets you enjoy nature through the four seasons at a leisurely pace in the fresh highland air. Combine it with the nearby hot spring areas for an unhurried tour.
quiz_en: If you travel around Minamioguni Town, what local food would you like to enjoy along with the hot springs?

name: 黒川温泉
desc: 南小国町の黒川温泉に到着です。田の原川沿いに旅館が寄り添うように建ち並び、木々に包まれた風情ある露天風呂が自慢の温泉地です。「入湯手形」を手に、旅館の露天風呂をいくつも巡る湯めぐりが人気です。夜には川沿いの灯りがともり、しっとりとした温泉街の雰囲気を味わえます。
quiz: 黒川温泉で、旅館の露天風呂をめぐるために使う木の札を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: Welcome to Kurokawa Onsen in Minamioguni Town. Ryokan (traditional inns) nestle close together along the Tanoharu River, and the town is proud of its atmospheric open-air baths wrapped in trees. A popular activity is bath-hopping through several inns' open-air baths with a Nyuto Tegata pass in hand. At night, lights glow along the river, and you can savor the gentle, tranquil mood of the hot spring town.
quiz_en: At Kurokawa Onsen, what is the wooden pass called that lets you hop between the inns' open-air baths?

name: 小田温泉
desc: 南小国町満願寺小田の小田温泉に到着です。黒川温泉に近い山あいに湧く湯どころで、静けさの中で温泉を楽しめるのが魅力です。周囲には杉林や田畑が広がり、阿蘇の北側らしい素朴な山里の風景が続きます。にぎやかな温泉街とはまた違う、のんびりした湯治気分を味わってください。
quiz: 小田温泉のような静かな山の湯で、湯上がりにしたいことは何ですか？
desc_en: Welcome to Oda Onsen in Mangan-ji Oda, Minamioguni Town. This hot spring rises in the mountains near Kurokawa Onsen, and its charm is enjoying the baths in peace and quiet. Cedar forests and fields surround it, with the simple mountain village scenery typical of northern Aso. Unlike a bustling hot spring town, it lets you savor a relaxed, old-style healing retreat.
quiz_en: At a quiet mountain hot spring like Oda Onsen, what would you like to do after your bath?

name: 白川温泉
desc: 南小国町満願寺の白川温泉に到着です。阿蘇の外輪山北側、黒川温泉にもほど近い山里の温泉です。周辺は小国杉の森や清らかな川に恵まれ、季節ごとに表情を変える自然が楽しめます。小さな湯どころならではの落ち着いた雰囲気の中で、ゆっくりとお湯につかって過ごしましょう。
quiz: 南小国町周辺で育てられ、建材として知られる杉は何と呼ばれる？
desc_en: Welcome to Shirakawa Onsen in Mangan-ji, Minamioguni Town. It is a mountain village hot spring on the north side of Aso's outer crater rim, close to Kurokawa Onsen. The area is blessed with forests of Oguni cedar and clear rivers, and you can enjoy nature that changes with each season. Relax and take your time soaking in the calm atmosphere unique to a small hot spring spot.
quiz_en: What is the cedar grown around Minamioguni Town and known as a building material called?

name: 遊水峡
desc: 小国町西里の遊水峡に到着です。阿蘇の北側に位置する小国町の山あいにある渓谷で、岩の間を清らかな水が流れる涼しげな景色が広がります。夏は水辺の涼を求めて、秋は色づく木々を眺めに訪れたい場所です。せせらぎの音に耳を傾けながら、小国の豊かな自然をのんびり楽しんでください。
quiz: 遊水峡のような涼しい渓谷で、夏にやってみたい川遊びや過ごし方は何ですか？
desc_en: Welcome to Yusuikyo in Nishizato, Oguni Town. This gorge lies in the mountains of Oguni, north of Aso, where clear water flows between rocks in a refreshing scene. It is a place to visit in summer to cool off by the water and in autumn to admire the colorful leaves. Listen to the murmur of the stream and enjoy the rich nature of Oguni at your own pace.
quiz_en: In a cool gorge like Yusuikyo, what river play or way of spending time would you like to try in summer?

name: 風鎮祭
desc: 高森町の風鎮祭に到着です。阿蘇の南外輪山のふもとにある高森町で、夏に行われる伝統の祭りです。日用品などを組み合わせて人物や風景を表現する「造り物」が町のあちこちに飾られ、そのユニークな出来栄えを見て歩くのが楽しみです。夜には町がにぎわい、阿蘇南郷谷の夏を彩ります。
quiz: 高森の風鎮祭で、身近な日用品を使って町中に飾られる作品を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: Welcome to the Fuchinsai Festival in Takamori Town. This traditional summer festival takes place in Takamori, at the foot of Aso's southern outer crater rim. Tsukurimono, figures that depict people and scenes by combining everyday items, are displayed all around town, and walking around to see their quirky craftsmanship is the highlight. At night the town bustles, adding color to summer in Aso's Nango Valley.
quiz_en: At the Fuchinsai Festival in Takamori, what are the works made from everyday household items and displayed around town called?

name: 白糸の滝
desc: 西原村の白糸の滝に到着です。阿蘇外輪山の西側、緑に囲まれた岩肌を細い水の筋が白糸のように流れ落ちる滝です。夏でもひんやりとした空気に包まれ、水しぶきが心地よく感じられます。西原村は阿蘇へ向かう途中にある自然豊かな村で、周辺の草原や山々の景色もあわせて楽しめます。
quiz: 全国に「白糸の滝」は数多くありますが、その名の由来になった滝の姿とは？
desc_en: Welcome to Shiraito Falls in Nishihara Village. On the west side of Aso's outer crater rim, thin streams of water fall like white threads down a rock face surrounded by greenery. Even in summer the air is cool, and the spray feels refreshing. Nishihara is a village rich in nature on the way to Aso, where you can also enjoy the surrounding grasslands and mountain scenery.
quiz_en: There are many falls called Shiraito (White Thread) across Japan. What appearance of the falls gave rise to that name?

name: 当銭神社
desc: 南阿蘇村河陰の当銭神社に到着です。南阿蘇村は阿蘇五岳の南側に広がる南郷谷にあり、湧き水が豊かなことで知られる土地です。のどかな集落の中に鎮座する神社で、地域の人々に大切に守られてきました。お参りのあとは、湧水地や田園風景をめぐって南阿蘇の穏やかな時間を味わってください。
quiz: 湧き水の里として知られる南阿蘇村で、あなたが訪ねてみたい水源はどこですか？
desc_en: Welcome to Tozeni Shrine in Kawakage, Minamiaso Village. Minamiaso lies in the Nango Valley on the south side of the Five Peaks of Aso, an area known for its abundant spring water. The shrine stands in a peaceful hamlet and has been carefully cared for by local people. After your visit, tour the springs and rural landscapes to savor the gentle pace of southern Aso.
quiz_en: In Minamiaso Village, known as a land of spring water, which water source would you like to visit?

name: 一心行公園
desc: 南阿蘇村中松の一心行公園に到着です。ここの主役は「一心行の大桜」と呼ばれる一本桜で、大きく枝を広げた姿が春に満開を迎えると、背後の阿蘇の山々と見事な景色をつくります。菜の花が咲く頃にはさらに華やかになり、多くの花見客でにぎわいます。一本の桜がもつ迫力をぜひ間近で感じてください。
quiz: 一心行の大桜が満開を迎える頃、まわりの畑を黄色く彩る花は何でしょう？
desc_en: Welcome to Isshingyo Park in Nakamatsu, Minamiaso Village. The star here is a solitary cherry tree called the Great Cherry Tree of Isshingyo. When its wide-spreading branches reach full bloom in spring, it forms a stunning scene with the Aso mountains behind. When the rapeseed blossoms are out, it becomes even more colorful and draws crowds of flower viewers. Be sure to feel the power of this single tree up close.
quiz_en: When the Great Cherry Tree of Isshingyo is in full bloom, what flowers color the surrounding fields yellow?

name: 立神峡公園
desc: 氷川町の立神峡公園に到着です。氷川の流れに沿って石灰岩の岩壁がそびえ立つ渓谷で、切り立った崖が川面に迫る迫力ある景観が見どころです。川をまたぐつり橋からは渓谷を見渡せ、夏は川遊び、秋は紅葉の名所としても親しまれています。水と岩が織りなす景色をのんびり歩いて楽しみましょう。
quiz: 立神峡の岩壁をつくっている、セメントの原料にもなる岩石は何でしょう？
desc_en: Welcome to Tategami Gorge Park in Hikawa Town. In this gorge, limestone cliffs tower along the Hikawa River, and the steep walls pressing close to the water make for a powerful view. A suspension bridge over the river offers a view across the gorge, and the area is popular for river play in summer and colorful leaves in autumn. Stroll at your own pace and enjoy the scenery woven by water and rock.
quiz_en: What rock, also used as a raw material for cement, forms the cliffs of Tategami Gorge?

name: 竜北公園
desc: 氷川町大野の竜北公園に到着です。八代平野の北側に位置する氷川町の公園で、地域の人々の憩いの場として親しまれています。氷川町は梨や柿などの果物づくりが盛んな町で、周囲には果樹園や田園が広がります。季節の花を眺めながら散策し、のんびりとした町の空気を味わってください。
quiz: 果物づくりが盛んな氷川町で、旅の途中に味わいたいフルーツは何ですか？
desc_en: Welcome to Ryuhoku Park in Ono, Hikawa Town. Located in the northern part of the Yatsushiro Plain, this park is loved as a relaxing spot by local people. Hikawa is a town where fruit growing, such as pears and persimmons, is thriving, and orchards and farmland spread around it. Take a walk while admiring seasonal flowers and soak up the laid-back atmosphere of the town.
quiz_en: In Hikawa Town, where fruit growing thrives, what fruit would you like to taste during your trip?

name: 御立岬公園
desc: 芦北町田浦の御立岬公園に到着です。八代海（不知火海）に突き出した岬に広がる公園で、温泉施設や宿泊施設、遊び場がそろったレジャースポットとして人気です。夏は海水浴やプールでにぎわい、高台からは海に浮かぶ天草の島々を望めます。潮風を感じながら一日ゆっくり過ごしてください。
quiz: 御立岬公園から望む八代海は、夜の海に光が揺らめく現象でも知られます。その名は？
desc_en: Welcome to Otachimisaki Park in Tanoura, Ashikita Town. This park spreads across a cape jutting into the Yatsushiro Sea (Shiranui Sea) and is a popular leisure spot with hot spring and lodging facilities and play areas. In summer it is lively with sea bathing and pools, and from the high ground you can see the Amakusa islands floating on the sea. Spend a relaxing day feeling the sea breeze.
quiz_en: The Yatsushiro Sea, seen from Otachimisaki Park, is known for a phenomenon of lights flickering on the night sea. What is it called?

name: 恵比須神社秋季大祭
desc: 多良木町の恵比須神社秋季大祭に到着です。多良木町は人吉球磨盆地の東部に位置し、球磨川の流れと田園が広がる町です。秋の大祭は実りの季節に地域が一体となる行事で、商売繁盛や豊作の神として親しまれる恵比須さまに感謝を捧げます。球磨焼酎の里らしい、温かな祭りの雰囲気を味わってください。
quiz: 商売繁盛の神として親しまれる恵比須さまが、小脇に抱えている魚といえば何でしょう？
desc_en: Welcome to the Autumn Grand Festival of Ebisu Shrine in Taragi Town. Taragi is in the eastern part of the Hitoyoshi-Kuma Basin, a town of rice fields along the Kuma River. The autumn festival brings the whole community together in the harvest season to give thanks to Ebisu, a deity beloved for bringing prosperous business and bountiful harvests. Enjoy the warm festival atmosphere of this home of Kuma shochu.
quiz_en: Ebisu, beloved as the god of prosperous business, is shown holding a fish under his arm. What fish is it?

name: 丸岡公園
desc: 山江村の丸岡公園に到着です。人吉盆地の北側に位置する山江村の高台にある公園で、人吉の町並みや周囲の山々を見渡せます。春には桜が咲き、花見を楽しむ人々でにぎわいます。山江村は栗の産地として知られ、秋には甘い栗を使った味覚も楽しみのひとつです。
quiz: 山江村の特産として知られ、秋になると甘く実る味覚といえば何でしょう？
desc_en: Welcome to Maruoka Park in Yamae Village. This park sits on high ground in Yamae, north of the Hitoyoshi Basin, overlooking the streets of Hitoyoshi and the surrounding mountains. In spring the cherry trees bloom, and the park bustles with people enjoying hanami (cherry blossom viewing). Yamae is known for growing chestnuts, and in autumn treats made with sweet chestnuts are one of the pleasures here.
quiz_en: What autumn delicacy, known as a specialty of Yamae Village, ripens sweetly as the season arrives?

name: 球泉洞
desc: 球磨村大瀬の球泉洞に到着です。球磨川のほとりに口を開ける鍾乳洞で、九州でも最大級の規模を誇ります。洞内には長い年月をかけて形づくられた鍾乳石や石筍が連なり、地下を流れる水の音が神秘的に響きます。一年を通してひんやりとした洞内を探検気分で歩いてみてください。
quiz: 鍾乳洞で天井から垂れ下がる鍾乳石に対し、床から伸びる石を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: Welcome to Kyusendo in Ose, Kuma Village. This limestone cave opens on the banks of the Kuma River and is one of the largest in Kyushu. Inside, stalactites and stalagmites formed over long ages line the passages, and the sound of underground water echoes mysteriously. Walk through the cave, which stays cool all year round, and feel like an explorer.
quiz_en: In a limestone cave, stalactites hang down from the ceiling. What are the formations that grow up from the floor called?

name: 春日神社
desc: 大分市勢家町の春日神社に到着です。大分市の中心部に近い場所に鎮座し、市民に「春日さん」として親しまれている神社です。都会の中にありながら境内には木々が茂り、落ち着いた空気が漂います。大分駅周辺の町歩きの途中に立ち寄って、静かなひとときを過ごしてみてください。
quiz: 春日神社の総本社として知られ、鹿がたくさんいることで有名な神社はどこ？
desc_en: Welcome to Kasuga Shrine in Seie-machi, Oita City. Located near the center of Oita City, it is affectionately called Kasuga-san by residents. Even though it stands in the city, its grounds are thick with trees and filled with a calm atmosphere. Drop by during a walk around Oita Station and spend a quiet moment here.
quiz_en: Which shrine, famous for its many deer, is known as the head shrine of all Kasuga shrines?

name: 早吸日女神社
desc: 大分市佐賀関の早吸日女神社に到着です。豊予海峡を望む佐賀関半島の港町に鎮座する古社で、海とともに生きる人々の信仰を集めてきました。タコにまつわる言い伝えがあり、願い事の間はタコを食べずに祈願する風習で知られます。佐賀関は関あじ・関さばの水揚げ地としても有名です。
quiz: 佐賀関の沖で一本釣りされ、ブランド魚として知られる二つの魚は何？
desc_en: Welcome to Hayasuhime Shrine in Saganoseki, Oita City. This ancient shrine stands in a port town on the Saganoseki Peninsula overlooking the Hoyo Strait, and has long been worshipped by people who live by the sea. It has legends involving octopus and is known for the custom of praying for a wish while abstaining from eating octopus until it comes true. Saganoseki is also famous as the landing port of Seki-aji and Seki-saba.
quiz_en: Which two fish, caught by single-line fishing off Saganoseki, are known as premium brand fish?

name: 佐野植物公園
desc: 大分市佐野の佐野植物公園に到着です。大分市郊外の丘陵地にある植物公園で、温室や花壇でさまざまな植物を観察できます。季節ごとに花が入れ替わり、散策しながら植物の色や香りを楽しめるのが魅力です。家族連れにも人気の、緑に包まれた憩いの場所でゆっくり過ごしてください。
quiz: 植物公園の温室で見てみたい、南国の花や珍しい植物は何ですか？
desc_en: Welcome to Sano Botanical Park in Sano, Oita City. Set in the hills on the outskirts of Oita City, this botanical park lets you observe a wide variety of plants in its greenhouse and flowerbeds. The flowers change with each season, and you can enjoy their colors and scents as you stroll. It is a green, relaxing place popular with families, so take your time here.
quiz_en: What tropical flowers or rare plants would you like to see in the botanical park's greenhouse?

name: 海部古墳資料館・亀塚古墳公園
desc: 大分市里の亀塚古墳公園と海部古墳資料館に到着です。亀塚古墳は大分県内でも最大級の前方後円墳で、海を見下ろす台地の上に築かれています。古墳は築造当時の姿に近づけて整備され、隣の資料館では出土品から古代の海の民の暮らしを学べます。墳丘に登って海と古墳を一緒に眺めてみましょう。
quiz: 亀塚古墳のように、円形と四角形を組み合わせた形の古墳を何と呼ぶ？
name_en: Ama Kofun Museum and Kamezuka Kofun Park
desc_en: Welcome to Kamezuka Kofun Park and the Ama Kofun Museum in Sato, Oita City. Kamezuka Kofun is one of the largest keyhole-shaped burial mounds in Oita Prefecture, built on a plateau overlooking the sea. The mound has been restored close to its original appearance, and at the museum next door you can learn about the lives of ancient seafaring people from excavated artifacts. Climb the mound and take in the sea and the tomb together.
quiz_en: What do you call a burial mound like Kamezuka Kofun, shaped by combining a circle and a square?

name: 別府温泉郷（八湯）の湯けむり景観と鉄輪地獄、伝統的共同浴場群と入浴法（泥湯、砂湯）
desc: 別府温泉郷に到着です。源泉数と湧出量で日本一を誇る温泉地で、「別府八湯」と呼ばれる個性豊かな温泉地が集まっています。鉄輪では町のあちこちから湯けむりが立ちのぼり、地獄めぐりも人気です。昔ながらの共同浴場や砂湯、泥湯など、さまざまな入浴法を体験できるのも別府ならではです。
quiz: 別府の鉄輪で、温泉の噴気の蒸気を使って食材を蒸し上げる料理を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: Welcome to the Beppu hot spring area. It boasts Japan's greatest number of hot spring sources and volume of flow, gathering distinctive hot spring districts known as the Beppu Hatto (Eight Hot Springs of Beppu). In Kannawa, steam rises from all over town, and touring the Jigoku (hells) is popular. Being able to try old-fashioned public bathhouses and various bathing styles, including sand baths and mud baths, is something unique to Beppu.
quiz_en: In Kannawa, Beppu, what is the cooking method called that steams food using the steam of hot spring vents?

name: 神楽女湖
desc: 別府市の神楽女湖に到着です。別府の市街地から山手に入った森の中にある小さな湖で、初夏には湖畔の菖蒲園で色とりどりの花菖蒲が咲きそろいます。紫や白の花が水辺を彩る風景は見事で、花の季節には多くの人が訪れます。木々に囲まれた静かな水辺で、別府のもうひとつの顔に出会ってください。
quiz: 初夏の神楽女湖を彩る、紫や白の花を咲かせる植物は何でしょう？
desc_en: Welcome to Lake Kagurame in Beppu City. This small lake lies in a forest in the hills above central Beppu, and in early summer colorful Japanese irises bloom together in the lakeside iris garden. The sight of purple and white flowers decorating the water's edge is splendid, drawing many visitors in the flowering season. At this quiet waterside surrounded by trees, discover another side of Beppu.
quiz_en: What plant colors the lakeside of Lake Kagurame in early summer with its beautiful purple and white flowers?

name: 耶馬渓
addr: 中津市本耶馬渓町曽木
desc: 中津市本耶馬渓町の耶馬渓に到着です。山国川沿いに奇岩がそびえる渓谷で、秋の紅葉は全国有数の名所として知られます。本耶馬渓には、僧が長い年月をかけて岩をノミで掘り抜いたと伝わるトンネル「青の洞門」があり、その物語は菊池寛の小説にも描かれました。岩峰群「競秀峰」の眺めもお見逃しなく。
quiz: 耶馬渓の「青の洞門」を題材にした、菊池寛の小説のタイトルは何でしょう？
desc_en: Welcome to Yabakei in Honyabakei-machi, Nakatsu City. In this gorge, strange rock formations tower along the Yamakuni River, and its autumn foliage is known as among the finest in Japan. Honyabakei has Ao-no-Domon, a tunnel said to have been dug through the rock with a chisel by a monk over many years, and its story was told in a novel by Kikuchi Kan. Don't miss the view of the rocky peaks of Kyoshuho.
quiz_en: What is the title of the novel by Kikuchi Kan based on Ao-no-Domon tunnel in Yabakei?

name: 薦神社
desc: 中津市大貞の薦神社に到着です。宇佐神宮とゆかりの深い古社で、境内の三角池（みすみいけ）そのものを御神体とすることで知られます。池に生える真薦が神事に用いられてきたといわれ、水辺に立つ鳥居と神門が静かなたたずまいを見せています。神秘的な池の景色を眺めながら、ゆっくりお参りしてください。
quiz: 薦神社で御神体とされている、境内にある池の名前は何と読むでしょう？
desc_en: Welcome to Komo Shrine in Ohsada, Nakatsu City. This ancient shrine has deep ties to Usa Jingu and is known for worshipping Misumi Pond in its grounds as the sacred body of the deity itself. It is said that the makomo (wild rice) growing in the pond has been used in rituals, and the torii and shrine gate standing by the water have a serene presence. Take your time to pray while gazing at the mysterious pond.
quiz_en: At Komo Shrine the pond itself is worshipped as a deity. What would you most like to see or feel by the water there?

name: 天ヶ瀬温泉
desc: 日田市天瀬町の天ヶ瀬温泉に到着です。玖珠川の両岸に旅館が並ぶ温泉地で、川辺には誰でも利用できる共同の露天風呂があるのが特徴です。せせらぎの音を聞きながら開放的な湯につかる体験は、ここならではの楽しみです。周辺には滝や渓谷も多く、山あいの自然とともに湯の町の情緒を味わってください。
quiz: 天ヶ瀬温泉の川辺にある露天風呂、入ってみた感想や入るときのコツは何ですか？
desc_en: Welcome to Amagase Onsen in Amagase-machi, Hita City. Ryokan line both banks of the Kusu River here, and a distinctive feature is the communal open-air baths along the riverside that anyone can use. Soaking in an open bath while listening to the murmuring river is a pleasure found only here. There are also many waterfalls and gorges nearby, so enjoy the charm of this hot spring town together with mountain nature.
quiz_en: What did you think of the riverside open-air baths at Amagase Onsen, and do you have any tips for using them?

name: 杖立温泉
desc: 大分と熊本の県境、杖立川沿いに湧く杖立温泉に到着です。谷あいの狭い土地に旅館が段々と重なる独特の町並みで、細い路地をめぐる散策が楽しい温泉地です。春には川の上に数多くの鯉のぼりが泳ぐ光景が名物となり、温泉の蒸気を使った蒸し料理も味わえます。湯けむり漂う路地をのんびり歩いてみましょう。
quiz: 杖立温泉で春に川の上をたくさん泳ぐ、こどもの日の飾りは何でしょう？
desc_en: Welcome to Tsuetate Onsen, which springs up along the Tsuetate River on the border of Oita and Kumamoto. Inns stack up in tiers on the narrow valley floor, creating a unique townscape, and wandering its narrow alleys is a joy. In spring, the sight of countless koinobori (carp streamers) swimming above the river is a famous attraction, and you can also taste dishes steamed with hot spring vapor. Take a leisurely walk through the steamy alleys.
quiz_en: What Children's Day decorations swim in great numbers over the river at Tsuetate Onsen in spring?

name: 慈恩の滝
desc: 日田市天瀬町の慈恩の滝に到着です。二段になって流れ落ちる滝で、滝の裏側に回り込んで流れを内側から眺められる「裏見の滝」として知られています。国道沿いにあり立ち寄りやすいのも魅力です。水しぶきを感じながら、滝の裏から見る景色を楽しんでください。夜にはライトアップされる時期もあります。
quiz: 慈恩の滝のように、滝の裏側に回り込んで流れを見られる滝を何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: Welcome to Jion Falls in Amagase-machi, Hita City. This two-tiered waterfall is known as an urami-no-taki, where you can walk around behind the falls and view the water from the inside. Its location along a national highway makes it easy to stop by. Feel the spray and enjoy the view from behind the falls. In some seasons it is also lit up at night.
quiz_en: What do you call a waterfall like Jion Falls, where you can walk around behind it and view the flow?

name: 地底博物館鯛生金山
desc: 日田市中津江村の地底博物館鯛生金山に到着です。かつて国内有数の産金量を誇った金山の坑道を活用した施設で、ひんやりとした地下の坑道を歩きながら当時の採掘の様子を見学できます。砂金採りの体験もでき、子どもから大人まで楽しめます。山深い中津江村に眠る、金の歴史を探検してください。
quiz: 鯛生金山で体験できる、水の中で砂をすくって金の粒を探す遊びを何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: Welcome to the Taio Gold Mine Underground Museum in Nakatsue Village, Hita City. This facility uses the tunnels of a gold mine that once boasted one of the largest gold outputs in Japan, letting you walk through cool underground shafts and see how mining was done. You can also try gold panning, so both children and adults can enjoy it. Explore the history of gold hidden deep in the mountains of Nakatsue.
quiz_en: At Taio Gold Mine, what is the activity called where you scoop sand in water to look for grains of gold?

name: 日田祇園祭
desc: 日田市の日田祇園祭に到着です。江戸時代から受け継がれる夏の祭りで、豪華な飾りをまとった山鉾が日田の町を巡行します。「山・鉾・屋台行事」のひとつとしてユネスコ無形文化遺産にも登録されています。夜には提灯をともした山鉾が通りを進み、天領として栄えた町に祭りばやしが響きます。
quiz: 日田祇園祭で町を巡行する、豪華な飾りをまとった山車を何と呼ぶでしょう？
desc_en: Welcome to the Hita Gion Festival in Hita City. Handed down since the Edo period, this summer festival features yamaboko floats in lavish decorations parading through the town of Hita. It is registered as UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage as one of the Yama, Hoko, Yatai float festivals. At night, the floats glowing with lanterns move through the streets, and festival music echoes through this town that once flourished as shogunate land.
quiz_en: What are the lavishly decorated floats called that parade through the town during the Hita Gion Festival?

name: 天領まつり
addr: 日田市中心部豆田地区、月隈公園周辺
desc: 日田市の天領まつりに到着です。江戸時代に幕府の直轄地「天領」として栄えた日田の歴史を伝える祭りで、豆田地区の古い町並みや月隈公園周辺が会場になります。白壁の商家や土蔵が残る豆田町は散策が楽しく、祭りの日はいっそう華やかなにぎわいに包まれます。歴史ある町並みとともに楽しんでください。
quiz: 江戸時代の日田のように、幕府が直接治めた土地を一般に何と呼ぶでしょう？
desc_en: Welcome to the Tenryo Festival in Hita City. This festival conveys the history of Hita, which flourished in the Edo period as tenryo, land directly ruled by the shogunate, and it is held in the old streets of the Mameda district and around Tsukikuma Park. Mameda-machi, with its white-walled merchant houses and storehouses, is fun to stroll, and on festival days it becomes even more lively. Enjoy the festival along with the historic townscape.
quiz_en: Like Hita in the Edo period, what is land that was directly governed by the shogunate generally called?

name: 小半鍾乳洞
desc: 佐伯市本匠の小半鍾乳洞に到着です。番匠川の上流、本匠地区の山あいにある鍾乳洞で、石灰岩の地下に広がる空間に鍾乳石が連なっています。洞内は一年を通してひんやりとしており、夏の暑い日には涼を求めて訪れるのにぴったりです。周辺は清流と緑に恵まれ、川遊びや山歩きとあわせて楽しめます。
quiz: 鍾乳洞で、鍾乳石と石筍がつながって柱のようになったものを何と呼ぶ？
desc_en: Welcome to the Ogaki Limestone Cave in Honjo, Saiki City. This cave lies in the mountains of the Honjo area on the upper Bansho River, with stalactites lining a space that spreads beneath the limestone. The inside stays cool all year round, making it perfect for escaping the heat on hot summer days. The area is blessed with clear streams and greenery, so you can combine your visit with river play or mountain walks.
quiz_en: In a limestone cave, what do you call a stalactite and stalagmite that have joined to form a pillar?

name: 城山
desc: 佐伯市の城山に到着です。山頂には江戸時代初めに築かれた佐伯城の石垣が残り、城跡からは佐伯の町並みと港、豊後水道を見渡せます。ふもとには武家屋敷の面影を残す「歴史と文学の道」が延び、若き日に佐伯で暮らした国木田独歩ゆかりの施設もあります。登城道を歩いて城下町の歴史を感じてください。
quiz: 若い頃に佐伯で教師として暮らし、作品にも佐伯を描いた明治の作家は誰？
desc_en: Welcome to Shiroyama in Saiki City. At the summit remain the stone walls of Saiki Castle, built in the early Edo period, and from the castle ruins you can look out over Saiki's streets, its harbor and the Bungo Channel. At the foot of the hill runs the Road of History and Literature, which retains traces of samurai residences, along with a facility linked to Kunikida Doppo, who lived in Saiki in his youth. Walk the castle path and feel the history of the castle town.
quiz_en: Which Meiji-era writer lived in Saiki as a young teacher and later depicted Saiki in his works?

name: 番匠公園
addr: 佐伯市弥生大字小田番匠川左岸河川敷
desc: 佐伯市弥生の番匠公園に到着です。佐伯市を流れる清流、番匠川の河川敷に広がる公園で、ゆったりとした川の流れと山々の景色を眺めながら過ごせます。番匠川は水のきれいな川として知られ、夏には水辺で遊ぶ家族連れでにぎわいます。川風に吹かれながら散歩やピクニックを楽しんでください。
quiz: 番匠公園のそばを流れる清流で、あなたがしてみたい川遊びは何ですか？
desc_en: Welcome to Bansho Park in Yayoi, Saiki City. This park spreads along the riverbed of the Bansho River, a clear stream flowing through Saiki City, where you can relax while watching the gentle current and the mountain scenery. The Bansho River is known for its clean water, and in summer families come to play by the water. Enjoy a walk or a picnic in the river breeze.
quiz_en: What kind of river play would you like to try in the clear stream that flows beside Bansho Park?

name: 尺間神社
desc: 佐伯市弥生の尺間神社に到着です。尺間山の山上に鎮座する神社で、古くから地域の人々の信仰を集めてきました。山道をたどって参拝する道のりには、山岳信仰の場らしい厳かな雰囲気があります。山頂付近からは佐伯の山並みを見渡すことができ、参拝とあわせて眺望も楽しめます。
quiz: 尺間神社のように山の上にある神社へ参拝するとき、あなたが持っていきたいものは？
desc_en: Welcome to Shakuma Shrine in Yayoi, Saiki City. Sitting atop Mount Shakuma, this shrine has long attracted the faith of local people.
